address: 上海市浦东新区金桥镇金湘路1288号
intro_zh: 上海浦东足球场位于上海市浦东新区金桥镇金湘路1288号，东至金湘路、南至金葵路、西至金滇路、北至锦绣东路，距市中心约13公里，是上海海港足球俱乐部主场，也是国内首个按国际足联A级比赛与亚足联标准建成的专业足球场。球场占地100842平方米，总建筑面积139304平方米，建筑高度38米，固定坐席33765个，极限容量37000人，其中首层看台19229席、二层看台13388席、贵宾席1148席。看台为矩形倒圆角双层布局，第一排距草坪仅8.5米，达到国际足联规定的极限距离；屋盖采用中置压环轮辐式索结构，跨度212米，膜结构顶棚可收音聚音并覆盖全部座席，草坪为锚固混合草并配补光灯与通风设备。建筑表皮以白色金属材料模拟中国传统白瓷，因而得名“白玉碗”，夜间可投影呈现不同影像。地下一层设320平方米新闻发布厅，可容纳250人；一层商业区引入击剑、壁球、乒乓球、室内高尔夫等项目。交通方面，地铁14号线浦东足球场站、云顺路站步行可达，另有浦东42路、88路等公交。球场沿南北向布置（北偏西15°），西侧设两片室外训练场，北侧靠近锦绣东路留出绿化入口广场。
intro_en: Shanghai Pudong Football Stadium stands at 1,288 Jinxiang Road in Jinqiao, Pudong New Area, bounded by Jinxiang Road to the east, Jinkui Road to the south, Jindian Road to the west and Jinxiu East Road to the north, about 13 km from the city centre. It is the home of Shanghai Port FC and the first stadium in China built to FIFA A-level and AFC standards. The site covers 100,842 sqm with 139,304 sqm of gross floor area and a height of 38 m. Fixed seating totals 33,765, with a maximum capacity of 37,000; the lower tier holds 19,229 seats, the upper tier 13,388 and VIP seating 1,148. The rectangular bowl with rounded corners brings the first row just 8.5 m from the pitch, the minimum permitted by FIFA, and the 212 m cable-supported roof with a central compression ring covers every seat while helping to retain crowd noise. The pitch uses anchored hybrid grass with grow lights and ventilation equipment. The white metal skin evokes Chinese white porcelain, hence the nickname 'White Jade Bowl', and can be used for projection. A 320 sqm news conference room for 250 people sits on the basement level, while the ground-floor commercial zone houses fencing, squash, table tennis, indoor golf and other sports. Metro Line 14 stops at Pudong Football Stadium and Yunshun Road stations, and bus routes 42 and 88 serve the site. The pitch is laid out north-south, 15 degrees west of north, with two outdoor training pitches to the west and a landscaped entry plaza off Jinxiu East Road.

address: 上海市浦东新区三林镇泳耀路300号
intro_zh: 浦发银行东方体育中心位于上海市浦东新区三林镇泳耀路300号，紧邻黄浦江与2010年世博会园区，是上海“新十年”的标志性体育建筑群，现由久事体育受托运营。中心占地34.75公顷，建筑面积18.8万平方米，由综合馆“海上皇冠”、游泳馆“玉兰桥”、室外跳水馆“月亮湾”和东方体育大厦四座建筑，以及标高11米的大平台、人工湖和室外运动场组成。综合馆建筑面积7.8万平方米，座位最大容量18000个，是上海座席最多的室内场馆，可在24至72小时内完成泳池、60米×30米冰场与78米×47米大地板的转换，满足游泳、篮球、排球、体操、冰球、短道速滑等二十余项赛事；游泳馆设4945席，含10道51米×25米标准池；跳水馆设4753席，跳水池25米×30米、水深6米。建筑以水为母题，综合馆形似抛起的波浪与白帆，游泳馆如层层波浪，室外跳水池置于湖心岛上，屋盖为半月形。交通方面，地铁6号线、8号线、11号线东方体育中心站直达，周边公交与停车设施完善。东方体育大厦地上15层，一层设735平方米新闻大厅，三层与十五层为会议层，配10间大小会议室。
intro_en: SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center occupies 300 Yongyao Road in Sanlin, Pudong New Area, on the Huangpu River beside the former 2010 Expo site. Built for the 14th FINA World Championships in 2011 and now operated by Juss Sports, it is one of Shanghai's signature sports complexes. The 34.75-hectare site contains 188,000 sqm of floor area across four buildings — the main arena known as the 'Crown of the Sea', the swimming hall 'Magnolia Bridge', the outdoor diving hall 'Moon Bay' and the Oriental Sports Tower — linked by an 11 m podium, with an artificial lake and outdoor courts. The arena has 78,000 sqm and up to 18,000 seats, the largest indoor capacity in Shanghai, and can switch within 24 to 72 hours between a 50 m pool, a 60 m by 30 m ice rink and a 78 m by 47 m sports floor, suiting more than 20 sports from swimming and basketball to gymnastics, ice hockey and short-track speed skating. The swimming hall seats 4,945 around a 51 m by 25 m ten-lane pool, and the diving hall seats 4,753 with a 25 m by 30 m, 6 m-deep diving pool. Water is the unifying theme: the arena rises like a wave or sail, the swimming hall reads as layered breakers, and the outdoor diving platform sits on an island under a half-moon roof. Metro Lines 6, 8 and 11 meet at Oriental Sports Center station, with buses and parking nearby. The 15-storey Oriental Sports Tower adds a 735 sqm news hall on the ground floor and ten meeting rooms on its third and fifteenth floors.

address: 上海市浦东新区源深路655号
intro_zh: 源深体育中心位于上海市浦东新区陆家嘴金融贸易区源深路655号，东起桃林路、南抵羽山路、西迄源深路、北至张杨路，毗邻世纪大道交通枢纽，是浦东新区规模最大、功能最全的区属综合性公共体育场馆和全民健身基地。中心占地16万平方米，由“一场一馆一池”及网球中心、综合训练馆等组成：室外体育场可容纳16115名观众，极限容量2万人，设标准足球场与塑胶跑道；室内体育馆可容纳5500人，可举办篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球等赛事；游泳馆设50米×25米标准池、25米×11米训练池及戏水池。场馆自1997年起陆续建成，2007年新馆启用，曾作为特奥会、中超联赛及国际箭联射箭世界杯等赛事场地。日常以公益价格向市民开放羽毛球、乒乓球、网球、游泳、足球等二十余个项目，并设老年晨练、学生专场等惠民时段。交通方面，地铁6号线源深体育中心站步行约300米，地铁2号、4号、6号、9号线世纪大道站亦在附近，周边公交线路密集。中心各场馆通过室外广场与步行道串联，绿地日常向周边社区开放，形成街区级的体育公园。
intro_en: Yuanshen Sports Center lies at 655 Yuanshen Road in the Lujiazui financial district of Pudong New Area, Shanghai, bounded by Taolin Road, Yushan Road, Yuanshen Road and Zhangyang Road and close to the Century Avenue transport hub. It is the largest and most complete district-level public sports complex in Pudong and a major base for mass fitness. The 160,000 sqm site is organised as 'one stadium, one hall and one pool' together with a tennis centre and a multi-purpose training hall. The outdoor stadium holds 16,115 spectators for football, with a maximum of 20,000, and has a standard pitch and synthetic track; the indoor arena seats 5,500 for basketball, volleyball, badminton and table tennis; the swimming hall includes a 50 m by 25 m standard pool, a 25 m by 11 m training pool and a leisure pool. Construction began in 1997, with the training hall opening first in 1998 and the new arena completed in 2007; the centre has hosted Special Olympics events, Chinese Super League matches and Archery World Cup stages. Today it opens more than 20 sports to the public at subsidised prices, including badminton, table tennis, tennis, swimming and football, with dedicated sessions for elderly morning exercisers and school students. Metro Line 6 stops at Yuanshen Sports Center about 300 m away, Lines 2, 4, 6 and 9 converge at Century Avenue, and many bus routes pass the site. The venues are linked by outdoor plazas and walking routes, with lawns that open to neighbouring communities and make the centre work as a district-level sports park.

address: 上海市静安区江宁路428号静安体育中心4层
intro_zh: 666号馆位于上海市静安区江宁路428号静安体育中心四层，处在江宁路与武定路一带、南京西路商圈北侧，2017年5月16日正式开业，开业前已试运营约半年。场馆室内面积约2,100平方米，最初办理的是体育馆执照而不是网吧牌照，定位为面向职业赛事、玩家体验与内容制作的“电竞泛文娱体验中心”，这也是它区别于普通网咖的关键。2017年年初，英雄联盟甲级职业联赛LSPL春季赛在这里开赛，成为场馆的首秀；此后LSPL夏季季后赛决赛等赛事也在此举行，DAN战队曾在这里通过BO5晋级赛打入LPL，场馆因此被写入英雄联盟赛事史。  空间上，A区是面向玩家的体验区，透明BOX式房间内配置赛事级电脑与外设；C区设有“蚕茧”型VR游戏空间，探索“VR+电竞”的线下玩法；比赛区则配备职业联赛舞台、LED大屏、灯光投影与环绕音效，整体视觉覆盖面积超过2,000平方米，可满足中小型职业联赛、杯赛的转播与观赛需求。除赛事外，场馆也承接音乐会、商务发布、企业团建和内容拍摄，配有策划、导播、转直播团队，可提供从前期编排到现场制作的一条龙服务。2020年9月，上海市公布首批电竞场馆评级结果，666号馆获评C类场馆。它的出现，是上海专业电竞馆从“网吧升级版”走向独立赛事空间的一个早期样本。
intro_en: Located on the fourth floor of the Jing'an Sports Centre at 428 Jiangning Road in Jing'an District, 666 Arena opened on 16 May 2017 after about half a year of soft operation. The venue covers roughly 2,100 square metres and was registered under a sports-hall licence rather than an internet-cafe licence, a deliberate choice that positioned it as a professional esports and entertainment venue rather than an upgraded net bar. Its first major event was the spring season of the League of Legends Secondary Pro League (LSPL) in early 2017; the venue later hosted the LSPL summer play-offs, and Team DAN's best-of-five promotion into the LPL took place there, a match that gave the arena a place in Chinese League of Legends history.  The interior is organised into several zones. Zone A offers player experience rooms in transparent box-like pods equipped with tournament-grade PCs and peripherals; Zone C contains a cocoon-shaped VR space that explores combined VR and esports programming; the competition area has a professional stage, LED screens, lighting, projection and surround sound, with more than 2,000 square metres given over to visual production. The venue can handle small and mid-sized professional leagues and cup events, and also hosts concerts, product launches, corporate team-building and content shoots, supported by an in-house planning, directing and broadcast team. In September 2020 it was rated a Class C esports venue in Shanghai's first official venue grading. It is an early example of the city's shift from net-bar-style gaming rooms towards stand-alone esports spaces. The name itself comes from the '666' that viewers type into live chat to praise a spectacular play, a piece of gaming slang that the founders adopted for the venue.

address: 上海市徐汇区天钥桥路666号（漕溪北路、零陵路之间）
intro_zh: 上海体育场位于上海市徐汇区天钥桥路666号，处在漕溪北路、零陵路与天钥桥路围合的地块内，因第八届全国运动会而建，1997年10月建成启用，上海人习惯称它“八万人体育场”。体育场占地约19万平方米，建筑面积约17万平方米，主体平面呈圆形，东西跨度288.4米、南北跨度274.4米，建筑高度约70.6米，屋面为马鞍形曲面膜结构，是中国第一座采用该种膜结构的大型体育场。场内原设105米×68米标准足球场与400米环形塑胶跑道，三层环形看台之间布置百余间豪华包厢。  建成后，这里先后承接过第八届全运会、2007年世界夏季特殊奥林匹克运动会、2008年北京奥运会上海赛区足球赛，以及中超、亚冠、足协杯、上海马拉松和国际田联钻石联赛上海站等赛事，长期是上海申花足球俱乐部的主场。2020年至2023年，体育场为适应世俱杯与专业足球场需求进行改造，拆除田径跑道，观众席由约5.68万座扩展至7.2万座，看台更贴近草坪，2023年4月16日以申花对阵山东泰山的中超比赛重新启用。除足球赛外，场馆也承接大型演唱会、音乐节和商业活动，张惠妹等歌手曾在此演出。交通方面，地铁1号线上海体育馆站、4号线上海体育场站和11号线上海游泳馆站均可步行到达，周边另有近1,600个停车泊位。
intro_en: Shanghai Stadium stands at 666 Tianyaoqiao Road in Xuhui District, within the block bounded by Caoxi North Road, Lingling Road and Tianyaoqiao Road. Built for the Eighth National Games and opened in October 1997, it is commonly known as the '80,000-seat Stadium'. The site covers about 190,000 square metres with roughly 170,000 square metres of gross floor area. Its circular form rises 70.6 metres and spans 288.4 metres east-west and 274.4 metres north-south, and its saddle-shaped membrane roof was the first of its kind on a major Chinese stadium. The original layout combined a 105 by 68 metre football pitch with a 400-metre synthetic running track, and more than a hundred boxes were set between the three tiers of seating.  The stadium has hosted the Eighth National Games, the 2007 Summer Special Olympics, football matches of the 2008 Beijing Olympics, Chinese Super League and AFC Champions League fixtures, the Shanghai Marathon and the Shanghai Diamond League meeting, and has long been the home ground of Shanghai Shenhua. Between 2020 and 2023 it was rebuilt as a football-specific venue: the running track was removed, capacity rose from about 56,800 to 72,000, and the stands were brought closer to the pitch. It reopened on 16 April 2023 with a Shenhua match against Shandong Taishan. The venue also stages large concerts and commercial events, and is served by Shanghai Indoor Stadium station on Line 1, Shanghai Stadium station on Line 4 and Shanghai Swimming Centre station on Line 11, with around 1,600 parking spaces nearby. The stadium is owned by the Shanghai East Asia Sports and Culture Centre.

address: 上海市宝山区永清路700号
capacity_text: 综合篮球馆7,073席（固定5,079、活动1,004、VIP包厢500等）
intro_zh: 上海宝山体育中心位于上海市宝山区永清路700号，处在宝山中心城区、友谊路街道一带，2011年底建成对外开放，由宝山区政府投资约5亿元、历时两年建设，是北上海功能较完整的综合性公共体育场馆，日常由上海宝山体育中心管理有限公司运营。中心占地70,499平方米，总建筑面积81,562平方米，由综合篮球馆、市民健身馆、图书馆和市民文体广场四部分组成，配套停车位532个，其中地上96个、地下436个。  综合篮球馆按NBA-07标准建造，采用沉降式碗型看台，共有7,073个座位，包括5,079个固定座、396个吧椅、480个VIP座椅、1,004个活动座和500个VIP包厢座，曾承办CBA、WCBA等赛事，也承接过“超级企鹅”篮球名人赛。市民健身馆位于北侧，三层设25米×50米温水泳池和儿童戏水池，四层有4片网球场和20张乒乓球台，另有羽毛球馆、健身房及商业配套。市民文体广场面积约12,000平方米，铺400米跑道和1,000米健身步道，中央布置8片篮球场和2片五人制足球场，并设16米×9米LED大屏的露天舞台。中心年均承办体育赛事、文娱活动约90项，接待市民约540万人次，也曾作为《中国好声音》《中国达人秀》等节目的录制场地。交通上，地铁3号线友谊路站、1号线共富新村站均可换乘公交到达，周边永清路、友谊路公交线路密集。
intro_en: Baoshan Sports Centre occupies 700 Yongqing Road in Baoshan District, in the district's central urban area near Youyi Road. Completed at the end of 2011 after two years of construction and an investment of about RMB 500 million by the district government, it is one of northern Shanghai's most complete public sports complexes and is managed by Shanghai Baoshan Sports Centre Management Co. The site covers 70,499 square metres with 81,562 square metres of gross floor area, comprising an indoor basketball arena, a public fitness building, a library and an outdoor culture and sports plaza, with 532 parking spaces, 96 above ground and 436 below.  The basketball arena was built to NBA-07 standards and has a sunken bowl-shaped seating tier with 7,073 places: 5,079 fixed seats, 396 bar stools, 480 VIP seats, 1,004 movable seats and 500 VIP box seats. It has hosted CBA and WCBA games and the Super Penguin celebrity basketball event. The fitness building contains a 25 by 50 metre heated swimming pool and a children's pool on the third floor, four tennis courts and 20 table-tennis tables on the fourth, plus badminton courts, a gym and commercial space. The 12,000-square-metre plaza has a 400-metre running track, a 1,000-metre fitness trail, eight basketball courts, two five-a-side football pitches and an outdoor stage with a 16 by 9 metre LED screen. The centre stages about 90 sports and cultural events a year and receives around 5.4 million visits annually; it has also been used for recordings of television shows. Bus connections from Youyi Road station on Line 3 and Gongfu Xincun station on Line 1 serve the site.

address: 上海市徐汇区中山南二路1300号
capacity_text: 原看台约4,000席；2023年改造后拆除看台，转为市民水上运动中心
intro_zh: 上海游泳馆位于上海市徐汇区中山南二路1300号，地处徐家汇体育公园南侧，地铁11号线上海游泳馆站1号口步行约230米。场馆1983年建成，占地10.6公顷，总建筑面积47,800平方米，其中比赛馆为直径114米、最高点33.6米的圆形建筑，建筑面积31,016平方米，内设比赛池、跳水池和练习馆，原看台可容纳约4,000名观众。它曾承办两届全运会、首届东亚运动会以及世界杯游泳跳水赛等赛事，2002年起向公众开放，是上海竞技游泳与全民游泳的重要载体。  2023年4月2日，经过改造的上海游泳馆重新开放。改造拆除了原有看台，把竞技看台空间转为市民服务空间，馆内共四层、四个泳池：一至二层保留标准泳池、培训池和跳水池，三层增加儿童池，四层为配套用房和健身房。标准池为50米×25米、8条泳道，采用循环过滤，适合日常健身、青少年培训和中小型游泳赛事。改造后的场馆以“市民水上运动中心”为定位，与上海体育场、上海体育馆、综合馆“万体汇”共同构成徐家汇体育公园的场馆群，由久事体育负责运维。交通上，除地铁11号线外，还可乘公交至中山南二路、天钥桥路一带；自驾可使用体育公园地下车库。
intro_en: Shanghai Swimming Centre is at 1300 Zhongshan South Second Road in Xuhui District, on the southern edge of Xujiahui Sports Park and about 230 metres from Exit 1 of Shanghai Swimming Centre station on Metro Line 11. Completed in 1983, it occupies 10.6 hectares with 47,800 square metres of gross floor area. Its circular competition hall, 114 metres in diameter and 33.6 metres high, accounts for 31,016 square metres and originally contained a competition pool, a diving pool and a training hall, with stands for about 4,000 spectators. The venue has hosted two National Games, the first East Asian Games and World Cup swimming and diving events, and opened to the public in 2002.  After renovation it reopened on 2 April 2023. The old grandstand was removed and the space converted to public facilities; the building now has four levels and four pools. The standard 50 by 25 metre pool, with eight lanes, remains on the lower floors together with a training pool and diving pool. A children's pool was added on the third floor, and the fourth floor holds support rooms and a gym. Water is treated with circulation filtration. The centre now positions itself as a public aquatic centre for fitness, youth training and smaller competitions rather than a large-spectator arena. It forms part of the Xujiahui Sports Park cluster with Shanghai Stadium, Shanghai Indoor Stadium and the underground Wan-ti-hui complex, and is operated by Juss Sports. Bus routes serve Zhongshan South Second Road and Tianyaoqiao Road, and drivers can use the park's underground car park.

name_zh: 上海静安量子光电竞中心
address: 上海市静安区灵石路709号园区
area_text: 约26,000㎡（含电竞场馆、体验馆、培训与办公）
intro_zh: 上海静安量子光电竞中心位于上海市静安区灵石路709号园区，处在上海电竞产业最密集的“灵石路”一带，由英雄体育VSPO（现英雄电竞Hero Esports）建设运营。场馆建筑面积约26,000平方米，不是单一的比赛厅，而是把电竞赛场、未来游戏与科技体验馆、电竞培训空间、产业办公和线下泛游戏周边商店放在同一园区内的内容制作综合体，可同时承担赛事举办、节目录制、战队训练和产业办公等功能。  作为上海最早一批专业电竞场馆之一，这里承办过王者荣耀、QQ飞车、皇室战争等多个项目的职业联赛与杯赛。按静安区公开信息，场馆投入使用以来已举办近千场电竞赛事；2022年3月，运营方又把总面积约2,000平方米、具备全球赛事远程制作能力的演播室集群“全球制作中心”落在静安，进一步强化了场馆的内容制作属性。2020年9月，上海公布首批电竞场馆评级，上海静安量子光电竞中心获评C类场馆；2025年，它又进入上海市文创资金成果资助类（电竞）拟扶持项目名单。场馆所在的灵石路沿线聚集了游戏厂商、赛事运营、俱乐部、直播与经纪机构，形成从内容生产到赛事落地的完整链条，是观察上海“全球电竞之都”产业空间组织的一个典型样本。
intro_en: Shanghai Jing'an Quantum Esports Centre occupies the campus at 709 Lingshi Road in Jing'an District, in the middle of the Lingshi Road cluster that has become Shanghai's densest esports industry belt. It was built and is operated by Hero Sports VSPO, now Hero Esports. With about 26,000 square metres of floor space, it is not a single competition hall but a content-production complex that combines an esports arena, a future-games and technology experience hall, training space, industry offices and a retail store for games merchandise, allowing competition, broadcast production, team training and office use to sit on one site.  As one of Shanghai's earliest professional esports venues, it has hosted professional leagues and cup events for games including Honor of Kings, QQ Speed and Clash Royale. According to Jing'an district information, the venue has staged nearly 1,000 esports events since opening. In March 2022 the operator added a 2,000-square-metre global production centre with remote-production studios for international events, reinforcing the site's role as a content hub. In September 2020 it was graded a Class C esports venue in Shanghai's first official assessment, and in 2025 it appeared on the city's cultural-creative fund list for esports projects. Lingshi Road itself gathers game publishers, tournament operators, clubs, streaming platforms and talent agencies, forming an integrated chain from content creation to event delivery and making the centre a useful example of how Shanghai has organised space for its 'global esports capital' ambitions. It is one of several venues in the operator's national network, alongside Chengdu Quantum and Xi'an Quantum Morning, and its size allows an event to use the arena, rehearsal rooms, production galleries and offices at the same time.

name_zh: 主场ESP电竞文化体验中心
address: 上海市普陀区同普路428号5号楼-6号楼（长风生态商务区）
area_text: 项目体量近30,000㎡
intro_zh: 主场ESP电竞文化体验中心位于上海市普陀区同普路428号5号楼至6号楼，处在长风生态商务区、泸定路与中环之间，毗邻上海市儿童医院，地铁2号线、13号线均可到达。项目由超竞集团打造，是国内较早提出“电竞+商业”模式的电竞文化体验中心：商业部分于2021年6月23日开业，内部电竞赛馆“上海KPL电竞中心”已于2020年5月28日投入运营，项目整体体量近3万平方米。  电竞赛馆设有1,000个座席，配备应援区、VIP观赛区、云观赛弹幕、加油打赏和无人机送礼等互动系统，启用后成为王者荣耀职业联赛KPL东部赛区主赛场和EDG.M战队主场，年均比赛场次超过300场，也承接王者荣耀全国大赛城市海选、水友赛和高校赛事。商业部分围绕电竞、二次元、新文创和跨界零售布局，引进过GOOD SMILE COMPANY中国首家官方实体店、王者荣耀IP剧本杀快闪店等业态，中庭高约20余米的交叉式玫瑰金阶梯是项目的标志性空间。2020年9月，主场ESP获评上海市首批电竞场馆B类场馆。它把职业赛事、玩家体验、IP零售和餐饮娱乐叠在同一栋建筑里，是上海“电竞+商业”落地最早、规模较大的样本之一。
intro_en: Home ESP Esports Culture Experience Centre occupies Buildings 5 and 6 at 428 Tongpu Road in Putuo District, in the Changfeng Ecological Business District between Luding Road and the Middle Ring Road, next to Shanghai Children's Hospital and reachable by Metro Lines 2 and 13. Developed by SuperGen Group, it was one of China's earliest projects to pair an esports venue with a shopping centre. The retail portion opened on 23 June 2021, while the indoor arena, Shanghai KPL Esports Centre, had already begun operating on 28 May 2020. The whole scheme measures nearly 30,000 square metres.  The arena seats 1,000 and includes supporter zones, VIP viewing areas, bullet-screen interaction, tipping and drone-delivery features. It became the main venue for the eastern division of the King Pro League (KPL) and the home arena of Team EDG.M, staging more than 300 matches a year as well as national qualifiers, community tournaments and university events. The commercial floors are themed around esports, anime, new cultural products and crossover retail, and have hosted China's first official GOOD SMILE COMPANY store and an Honor of Kings-themed scripted mystery pop-up. A 20-metre rose-gold criss-cross staircase in the atrium is the project's signature interior. In September 2020 Home ESP was rated a Class B esports venue in Shanghai's first grading. By stacking professional competition, player experience, IP retail and food and beverage in one building, it remains one of the city's earliest and largest examples of the esports-plus-retail model. The project also hosts Honor of Kings city qualifiers, community 'water-friend' matches and university tournaments, which keep the arena busy outside the professional calendar.

address: 上海市黄浦区大吉路208号（方斜路555号）
intro_zh: 南市公共体育场位于上海市黄浦区老西门街道大吉路208号、方斜路555号，处大林路、方斜路与大吉路交界处，是首个由中国人自办的公共体育场，现为上海市黄浦学校校址。1915年，上海县知事沈宝昌委托县教育会会长吴馨筹办，租借上海慈善团在小西门外的一块26亩三角地，1917年3月30日建成，初名西门公共体育场，场内设300米跑道、足球场、网球场、排球场、室内篮球场和健身房。  这里是中国近代体育与公共集会的重要现场。1919年5月7日，上海市民两万余人在这里集会声援五四运动；1925年五卅惨案后，6月11日又有二十万人参加的市民大会在此举行。1928年场地改为公办，定名上海市立第一公共体育场，后改称南市公共体育场。1937年八一三事变后，场馆在日军轰炸中成为废墟，曾被日军用作营房和仓库；1946年重建，修350米跑道、足球场和可容3,000人的木质看台；1958年改建为水泥看台，容量增至5,000人，1983年曾作为第五届全运会足球赛场地之一。1995年再度改建，1997年竣工后称上海沪南体育活动中心。1977年它被列为上海市革命纪念地，2014年由上海市人民政府公布为上海市文物保护单位。如今校舍与操场仍延续着体育功能，是上海城市体育史层叠最完整的一处遗址。
intro_en: Nanshi Public Stadium stands at 208 Daji Road, at the corner of Fangxie Road and Daji Road in the Laoximen area of Huangpu District. It was the first public sports ground built by Chinese citizens and is now the campus of Shanghai Huangpu School. In 1915 the Shanghai county magistrate asked Wu Xin, head of the county education association, to establish a public ground; a 26-mu triangular plot was leased outside the old West Gate and the stadium opened on 30 March 1917 as Ximen Public Stadium, with a 300-metre track, football pitch, tennis and volleyball courts, an indoor basketball court and a gymnasium.  The site became a stage for both sport and public assembly. On 7 May 1919 more than 20,000 Shanghai residents gathered here in support of the May Fourth Movement, and after the May Thirtieth Incident a city meeting of some 200,000 people was held on 11 June 1925. The ground was taken over by the municipality in 1928 and renamed Shanghai Municipal First Public Stadium, later Nanshi Public Stadium. It was destroyed during the Japanese bombing of 1937 and used as barracks and storage; it was rebuilt in 1946 with a 350-metre track, a football pitch and wooden stands for about 3,000 spectators. In 1958 the stands were rebuilt in concrete and capacity rose to 5,000, and in 1983 it was one of the football venues of the Fifth National Games. After further reconstruction it reopened in 1997 as the Shanghai Hunan (south Shanghai) Sports Activity Centre. It was listed as a Shanghai revolutionary memorial site in 1977 and as a municipal cultural relic in 2014. The school playground still keeps the site in sporting use, making it one of the most layered records of Shanghai's urban sports history.

address: 上海市黄浦区肇嘉浜路128号
intro_zh: 卢湾体育馆位于上海市黄浦区肇嘉浜路128号，靠近打浦桥与瑞金医院一带，是上海中心城区一座中等规模的多功能体育馆。现馆占地7,000平方米，建筑面积20,730平方米，设3,500个观众座位，1997年建成。它的历史可以追溯到1929年在亚尔培路（今陕西南路）、霞飞路（今淮海中路）建成的回力球场（Auditorium，又名中央运动场），那座球场长56米、宽13米，可容纳两千多名观众；1958年划归卢湾区体委管理，1974年因上海体育馆落成而更名卢湾体育馆。1992年为配合地铁工程和淮海中路商业改造，旧馆拆迁，新馆在肇嘉浜路重建。  新馆整幢建筑呈飞艇造型，分上下两部分，虚实对比明显，是1990年代上海区级体育场馆的代表作。馆内可举行篮球、排球、网球、手球、羽毛球、乒乓球、五人制足球、举重、武术等比赛，也可承接群众性运动会和大型文艺演出，比赛场地平时布置12片羽毛球训练场。这里曾是上海大鲨鱼男篮的主场，2002年大鲨鱼在卢湾体育馆夺得CBA总冠军；2009年男篮主场搬离，2010年上海男排和上海女排将主场迁至此处。1983年第五届全运会举重比赛在此举行，选手吴数德在56公斤级抓举中打破世界纪录。交通上，地铁9号线打浦桥站、12号线嘉善路站均可步行到达，肇嘉浜路沿线公交线路密集。
intro_en: Luwan Gymnasium is at 128 Zhaojiabang Road in Huangpu District, near Dapuqiao and Ruijin Hospital in central Shanghai. The present building covers 7,000 square metres of land with 20,730 square metres of floor area and 3,500 seats, and was completed in 1997. Its history goes back to the Auditorium, a jai-alai fronton built in 1929 on Avenue du Roi Albert (now Shaanxi South Road) at Avenue Joffre (now Middle Huaihai Road); that hall was 56 metres long and 13 metres wide and held more than 2,000 spectators. It was placed under the Luwan district sports authority in 1958 and renamed Luwan Gymnasium in 1974 after the new Shanghai Indoor Stadium opened. The old building was demolished in 1992 to make way for metro construction and the Huaihai Road commercial redevelopment, and the replacement was built on Zhaojiabang Road.  The new hall has an airship-like profile split into two volumes, a characteristic piece of 1990s district-level sports architecture in Shanghai. It can stage basketball, volleyball, tennis, handball, badminton, table tennis, five-a-side football, weightlifting and martial arts, as well as mass sports meetings and large performances; in everyday use the main floor is laid out with 12 badminton courts. It was the home arena of the Shanghai Sharks basketball team, which won the CBA championship there in 2002. The men's team moved out in 2009, and in 2010 the Shanghai men's and women's volleyball teams moved in. The 1983 Fifth National Games weightlifting competition was held here, where Wu Shude set a world record in the 56 kg snatch. Dapuqiao station on Line 9 and Jiashan Road station on Line 12 are within walking distance, and many bus routes run along Zhaojiabang Road.

name_zh: 外滩国际电竞文化中心
address: 上海市黄浦区龙华东路68号
area_text: 总建筑面积5,150㎡；主厅45×45m、挑高12m
intro_zh: 外滩国际电竞文化中心位于上海市黄浦区龙华东路68号，处在黄浦江畔的世博滨江区域，东临中国船舶馆、西临世博会博物馆、南临黄浦江，与世博公园和梅赛德斯-奔驰文化中心隔江相望，距新天地、人民广场、豫园约15分钟车程。场馆2020年8月竣工，同年12月6日正式启用，总投资约1.1亿元，由中电创智（上海）科技有限公司运营，启用时成为RNG电子竞技俱乐部的主场。  主建筑共两层，总建筑面积5,150平方米，可同时容纳3,000余人；内部为45米×45米、挑高12米的无柱空间，设64个悬挂吊点、3块互动电子屏幕，以及多功能间和VIP室，一层另有近300平方米序厅。场馆配备广电级直转播设备及专用线路，适合大型电竞赛事、发布会、展览和综艺录制。室外广场及廊桥区域约70,000平方米，廊桥长约667米，可承载外场活动与人流集散。2021年3月，它在上海市第二批电竞场馆等级评审中获评专业B级场馆，是黄浦区首个B级电竞场馆。启用以来，场馆承接过INCLUSION·外滩大会、网易游戏黄金总决赛、和平精英校园菁英赛、中国电子集团青年电竞大赛等活动，也举办过电竞+足球观赛、电竞+交响音乐会等跨界项目，是上海“全球电竞之都”建设中滨江文化地标的一环。
intro_en: The Bund International Esports Cultural Centre stands at 68 Longhua East Road in Huangpu District, on the Huangpu River waterfront of the former Expo site. It faces the China State Shipbuilding Pavilion to the east, the World Expo Museum to the west and the river to the south, with Expo Park and Mercedes-Benz Arena across the water, about 15 minutes by car from Xintiandi, People's Square and Yu Garden. Completed in August 2020 and opened on 6 December that year at a cost of about RMB 110 million, it is operated by Zhongdian Chuangzhi (Shanghai) Technology, a China Electronics platform company, and opened as the home venue of the RNG esports club.  The two-storey main building has 5,150 square metres of floor area and holds more than 3,000 people. Its core is a column-free hall measuring 45 by 45 metres with a 12-metre clear height, 64 rigging points, three interactive screens, multi-function rooms and VIP suites, plus a foyer of nearly 300 square metres on the ground floor. Broadcast-grade production equipment and dedicated transmission lines make it suitable for major esports events, launches, exhibitions and television recording. The outdoor plaza and covered walkway add about 70,000 square metres, including a 667-metre bridge that can handle overflow crowds and outdoor programming. In March 2021 the venue was rated a professional Class B esports venue in Shanghai's second round of grading, the first in Huangpu District. It has hosted the INCLUSION Bund Conference, NetEase's Golden Finals, the Peace Elite campus championship and China Electronics' youth esports tournament, as well as crossover events combining esports with football viewing and symphony concerts.

address: 上海市徐汇区零陵路、漕溪北路、中山南二路、天钥桥路围合区域
area_text: 占地35.96公顷（约36万㎡）；总建筑面积约25万㎡
capacity_text: 上海体育场72,000席；上海体育馆10,000席（演出）/12,000席（比赛）
intro_zh: 徐家汇体育公园位于上海市徐汇区，由零陵路、漕溪北路、中山南二路和天钥桥路围合，呈五边形，占地35.96公顷，总建筑面积约25万平方米，前身是始建于1960年代的上海体育中心，由久事集团建设管理、久事体育运营。公园以上海体育馆和上海体育场为中轴线，北面是面向市民免费开放的“有氧公园”，以健身步道和绿化为主；南面是“运动公园”，集中布置上海游泳馆、综合馆“万体汇”和室外球场；南北两部分由健身步道串联。  园内的“三件套”各自承担不同功能：上海体育场1997年建成，改造后可容纳7.2万人，是上海申花主场，也是大型演唱会和足球赛的主要场地；上海体育馆1975年建成，因可坐一万人而被称为“万体馆”，设10,000个演出座席、12,000个比赛座席，是上海久事大鲨鱼男篮主场；上海游泳馆1983年建成，2023年改造后设标准池、培训池、跳水池和儿童池。2022年2月试运营的综合馆“万体汇”是园内唯一新建场馆，建筑主体沉入地下，地下一层设35片羽毛球场地、3片室内网球场地和4片壁球场，地下二层设18片乒乓球场地；室外另有4片标准篮球场、8片半场、1片七人制足球场、4片五人制足球场、4片网球场和1片板式网球场。多数场地可通过久事体育App或小程序预订，地铁1号线上海体育馆站、4号线上海体育场站、11号线上海游泳馆站均可到达。
intro_en: Xujiahui Sports Park lies in Xuhui District, enclosed by Lingling Road, Caoxi North Road, Zhongshan South Second Road and Tianyaoqiao Road. The five-sided site covers 35.96 hectares with about 250,000 square metres of gross floor area. It descends from the Shanghai Sports Centre planned in the 1960s and is now built and managed by the Juss Group and operated by Juss Sports. Shanghai Indoor Stadium and Shanghai Stadium form its central axis; to the north is a free 'oxygen park' of lawns and fitness trails, and to the south a 'sports park' containing the swimming centre, the Wan-ti-hui complex and outdoor courts, with the two halves linked by running and walking paths.  The three historic venues each have a distinct role. Shanghai Stadium, completed in 1997 and renovated in 2023, seats 72,000 and is the home of Shanghai Shenhua as well as a major concert venue. Shanghai Indoor Stadium, completed in 1975 and known as the '10,000-seat hall', has 10,000 seats for performances and 12,000 for sport, and is the home arena of the Shanghai Sharks. Shanghai Swimming Centre, completed in 1983 and renovated in 2023, contains a standard pool, training pool, diving pool and children's pool. Wan-ti-hui, the only new building, opened for trial operation in February 2022 with its main volume sunk underground: the first basement holds 35 badminton courts, three indoor tennis courts and four squash courts, while the second basement has 18 table-tennis tables. Outdoors there are four full basketball courts, eight half-courts, one seven-a-side and four five-a-side football pitches, four tennis courts and a padel court. Most courts can be booked through the Juss Sports app or mini-programme, and the park is served by Shanghai Indoor Stadium station on Line 1, Shanghai Stadium station on Line 4 and Shanghai Swimming Centre station on Line 11.

address: 上海市闵行区马桥镇元江路5500号
capacity_text: 13,779（中央球场固定座，赛事可扩至约15,000）
intro_zh: 旗忠网球中心全称上海旗忠森林体育城网球中心，位于上海市闵行区马桥镇旗忠村元江路5500号，距市中心约27公里，是上海西南部以网球为核心的大型单项体育基地，也是上海劳力士大师赛的举办地。基地用地约508亩，总建筑面积85,438平方米，容积率0.187、建筑密度15.1%、绿化率46.1%，配993个停车位，整体以“森林体育城”为概念，把球场放进大片绿地之中。  中心拥有1号馆（中央球场）、2号馆、3号馆，以及6片室内和16片室外球场，合计25片国际标准网球场。中央球场建筑面积30,649平方米，地上四层、高约40米，固定座席13,779个，赛事时可扩至约1.5万座，是亚洲规模最大的网球场之一。它的可开启屋盖由8片叶瓣状钢屋面板组成，直径144米，开启时宛如上海市花白玉兰绽放，为世界首创；屋盖四周向内悬挑61.5米，上表面为铝合金面板、下表面为PTFE膜材。场馆2005年启用，2005年至2008年连续举办四届网球大师杯，2009年起举办上海ATP1000大师赛；2023年中央球场完成装修提升后重新亮相，2025年又启动2号馆改建和室外17号场地新建。2019年10月起由久事体育运营，日常也向市民开放网球场地，可通过久事体育渠道预订。
intro_en: Qizhong Tennis Centre, formally the Shanghai Qizhong Forest Sports City Tennis Centre, is at 5500 Yuanjiang Road in Qizhong Village, Maqiao Town, Minhang District, about 27 kilometres from central Shanghai. It is the city's main tennis-specific venue and the home of the Shanghai Rolex Masters. The 508-mu site, roughly 33.9 hectares, contains 85,438 square metres of gross floor area at a plot ratio of 0.187, 15.1 per cent building coverage and 46.1 per cent greenery, with 993 parking spaces. Its 'forest sports city' concept places the courts within extensive landscaped grounds.  The centre has Court 1, the centre court, plus Courts 2 and 3, six indoor courts and 16 outdoor courts, 25 international-standard tennis courts in all. The centre court has 30,649 square metres of floor area, four levels above ground, a height of about 40 metres and 13,779 fixed seats, expandable to about 15,000 for tournaments, making it one of Asia's largest tennis arenas. Its retractable roof consists of eight petal-shaped steel panels forming a 144-metre-diameter circle that opens like a blooming white magnolia, the city flower of Shanghai; it was the first roof of its kind in the world. The roof cantilevers 61.5 metres inward, with aluminium panels above and PTFE membrane below. The venue opened in 2005, hosted four Tennis Masters Cups from 2005 to 2008 and has staged the ATP Masters 1000 event since 2009. The centre court was refurbished and reopened in 2023, and in 2025 work began on rebuilding Court 2 and adding outdoor Court 17. Juss Sports has operated the centre since October 2019, and courts are also available to the public through its booking channels.

name_zh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰文化中心
address: 上海市浦东新区世博大道1200号
area_text: 用地67,242.6㎡；总建筑面积近16万㎡（地上约10.8万㎡、地下约5.2万㎡）
intro_zh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰文化中心位于上海市浦东新区世博大道1200号，毗邻中华艺术宫与世博轴，西沿上南路、东临高科西路，是2010年上海世博会的永久性场馆之一，2010年3月31日竣工，最初称上海世博文化中心，2011年起由梅赛德斯-奔驰冠名。场馆用地面积67,242.6平方米，总建筑面积近16万平方米，其中地上约10.8万平方米、地下约5.2万平方米，建筑檐口高度26.5米，外形呈“飞碟”状，从空中俯瞰又像贝壳。  主场馆是一个面积7.6万多平方米的多功能空间，最多可容纳18,000名观众，并可根据演出或赛事需要调整为12,000、10,000或8,000座，配备82个VIP包厢、贵宾室、多功能酒廊和会议室。场地可在61米×30米的冰球场、28米×15米的奥运标准篮球场和各种舞台布局之间转换，是中国首个观众容量可变的大型室内演艺场馆。场馆还包含可容纳约800人的音乐俱乐部、729座影院、2,109平方米的真冰溜冰场和约2万平方米商业休闲区。它由东方明珠新媒体、美国AEG和NBA中国合资运营，曾举办滚石乐队、泰勒·斯威夫特、张学友、王菲等艺人演唱会，以及NBA中国赛、UFC格斗之夜和Dota 2国际邀请赛。2020年9月，它以总分第一获评上海市首批A级电竞场馆。交通上，地铁8号线中华艺术宫站、7/8号线耀华路站、13号线世博大道站均可到达。
intro_en: Mercedes-Benz Arena stands at 1200 Shibo Avenue in Pudong New Area, next to the China Art Museum and the Expo Axis, with Shangnan Road to the west and Gaoke West Road to the east. One of the permanent buildings of Expo 2010, it was completed on 31 March 2010 as the Shanghai Expo Cultural Centre and took the Mercedes-Benz name in 2011. The site covers 67,242.6 square metres with nearly 160,000 square metres of gross floor area, about 108,000 above ground and 52,000 below, and a 26.5-metre eaves height. Its saucer-like form reads as a shell from above.  The main arena offers more than 76,000 square metres of flexible space with 18,000 seats, adjustable to 12,000, 10,000 or 8,000 depending on the event, plus 82 VIP boxes, hospitality suites, lounges and meeting rooms. The floor can convert between a 61 by 30 metre ice-hockey rink, a 28 by 15 metre Olympic basketball court and a range of stage layouts, making it China's first large indoor venue with variable capacity. The complex also contains a music club for about 800 people, a 729-seat cinema, a 2,109-square-metre ice rink and some 20,000 square metres of retail and leisure space. It is operated by a joint venture of Oriental Pearl, AEG and NBA China, and has hosted concerts by the Rolling Stones, Taylor Swift, Jacky Cheung and Faye Wong, as well as NBA China Games, UFC Fight Night and The International Dota 2 championships. In September 2020 it was ranked first among Shanghai's first batch of Class A esports venues. It is served by China Art Museum station on Line 8, Yaohua Road stations on Lines 7 and 8 and Expo Avenue station on Line 13.

address: 上海市杨浦区黄兴路221号互联宝地F1栋
area_text: 建筑面积超5,000㎡（另有报道称近6,000㎡）；主场馆约3,500㎡
intro_zh: 火柴电竞馆位于上海市杨浦区黄兴路221号互联宝地F1栋，处在五角场商圈附近、内环高架黄兴路匝道旁，距离地铁8号线、12号线约600米。场馆所在地前身是始建于1942年的上海第二钢铁厂老厂房，2019年1月15日正式揭幕，由北京火柴互娱科技股份有限公司旗下全资子公司耀炬莱体育发展（上海）有限公司独家运营，总投资超过6,000万元。它是上海首座明确以承接S级赛事为目标建造的专业电竞馆，建筑面积超过5,000平方米（另有报道称近6,000平方米），主场馆规划面积约3,500平方米，可容纳1,000名观众同时观赛。  馆内设双直播通道，可同时以四种语言对外直播，配置8支战队的备赛空间和11间风格各异的VIP观赛室，VIP室可居高临下俯瞰全场，并同步接收赛事音画。舞台、灯光、音响和网络按职业赛事主客场制设计，宽带做了均载平衡，以满足长时间直播和异地制作的需要。2020年9月，火柴电竞馆获评上海市首批电竞场馆C类场馆。它的出现填补了上海缺少固定专业电竞观赛场的空白，也是杨浦区把老工业厂房改造为文娱空间的一个代表案例；周边互联宝地园区已转型为互联网与文创产业园区，地铁8号线黄兴路站、12号线宁国路站均可步行到达。
intro_en: Huochai Esports Arena occupies Building F1 of the Hulian Baodi park at 221 Huangxing Road in Yangpu District, near the Wujiaochang commercial area and the Huangxing Road ramp of the inner ring expressway, about 600 metres from Metro Lines 8 and 12. The building was formerly part of the Shanghai No. 2 Steel Works, founded in 1942. The arena opened on 15 January 2019, is operated exclusively by Yaojulai Sports Development (Shanghai), a wholly owned subsidiary of Beijing Huochai Interactive Entertainment, and represents an investment of more than RMB 60 million. It was the first venue in Shanghai purpose-built to host S-tier esports events, with more than 5,000 square metres of floor area (some reports say nearly 6,000) and a main hall of about 3,500 square metres seating 1,000 spectators.  The arena has two broadcast channels and can transmit in four languages simultaneously. It provides preparation space for eight teams and 11 individually styled VIP viewing rooms that overlook the main floor and receive synchronised event audio and video. Stage, lighting, sound and network systems were designed around a home-and-away league format, with load-balanced broadband for long live broadcasts and remote production. In September 2020 it was rated a Class C venue in Shanghai's first esports venue grading. Its arrival filled a gap in the city's supply of permanent professional esports spectator venues and made it a showcase for Yangpu's conversion of former industrial buildings into cultural and entertainment space. The surrounding Hulian Baodi park has become an internet and creative-industry campus, and Huangxing Road station on Line 8 and Ningguo Road station on Line 12 are within walking distance.

area_text: 逾700㎡室内电竞演播室
capacity_text: 未公布（比赛日免费开放，建议预约）
intro_zh: 网易暴雪游戏电竞馆位于上海市普陀区真北路818号近铁城市广场北座B2下沉式广场西端，地处真北路与金沙江路交汇处，地铁13号线真北路站上盖。它由网易与暴雪合作打造，2017年已投入使用，是一间逾700平方米的大型室内电子竞技演播室，而不是传统意义上的网吧或体育馆。场馆主要承担暴雪系游戏的职业赛事、直播和内容录制，曾举办《风暴英雄》《星际争霸2》《炉石传说》黄金联赛等赛事，舞台、解说席、转播工位和观众区按演播需求布置，比赛日向观众免费开放，因座位有限通常建议提前预约。  场馆选址在购物中心的地下二层，与星巴克、麦当劳等餐饮和零售业态同层相邻，观众可以在逛街、用餐之余直接入场观赛，这种“商业综合体+电竞演播馆”的组合是它最鲜明的特征。2020年9月，上海市公布首批电竞场馆评级结果，网易暴雪游戏电竞馆获评C类场馆，是普陀区入选的场馆之一。2023年1月，网易与暴雪的代理合作到期，暴雪系游戏在中国大陆的运营一度终止，场馆所依托的暴雪赛事内容随之中断；但它作为上海早期“商场里的电竞演播室”样本，仍常被用来讨论电竞空间如何借助商业客流降低观赛门槛。交通上，地铁13号线真北路站多个出入口直通近铁城市广场，周边另有真北路金沙江路公交站。
intro_en: The NetEase-Blizzard Esports Arena is at the western end of the sunken B2 plaza in the north block of MTR City Plaza, 818 Zhenbei Road, Putuo District, at the junction of Zhenbei Road and Jinshajiang Road and directly above Zhenbei Road station on Metro Line 13. Built through the NetEase-Blizzard partnership and already in use by 2017, it is a broadcast studio of more than 700 square metres rather than a conventional net bar or sports hall. It was designed for professional events, live streaming and content recording around Blizzard titles, and hosted Gold League competitions for Heroes of the Storm, StarCraft II and Hearthstone. The stage, commentary desks, production positions and spectator area are arranged for studio use; entry is free on match days, and advance booking is advised because seating is limited.  Its location on the lower ground floor of a shopping centre, alongside cafes, fast-food outlets and shops, lets spectators combine a shopping or dining trip with watching a match. This 'mall plus esports studio' pairing is the venue's defining feature. In September 2020 it was rated a Class C venue in Shanghai's first esports venue grading, one of the venues recognised in Putuo District. The NetEase-Blizzard licensing agreement expired in January 2023 and Blizzard games temporarily ceased operation in mainland China, after which the Blizzard event content the arena was built around came to an end. It is still cited as an early example of how esports space can use retail footfall to lower the threshold for live spectators. Multiple exits from Zhenbei Road station on Line 13 lead directly into MTR City Plaza, and bus stops on Zhenbei Road and Jinshajiang Road are nearby.

address: 上海市普陀区万航渡后路19号沪西文化艺术中心（近长寿路、曹家渡商圈）
intro_zh: 网鱼电竞万航渡路店位于上海市普陀区万航渡后路19号沪西文化艺术中心，靠近长寿路与万航渡路交界的曹家渡商圈，处在静安、普陀、长宁三区交界地带。门店体量约700平方米，由观众候场区、观众互动区和观众观赛区组成，可容纳200名观众同时观赛，2020年获评时是网鱼网咖在上海唯一一家以电竞为内核的门店，也是其从连锁网吧向“电竞场馆”转型的代表。2020年9月，它以“网鱼网咖（曹家渡店）/网鱼电竞万航渡路店”的名义获评上海市首批电竞场馆C类场馆。  门店年均举办比赛50余场，曾承接《CS:GO》《DOTA2》《炉石传说》《英雄联盟》等项目的线下体验赛，也为职业、半职业和娱乐赛事提供办赛场地；2021年、2022年和2024年，电竞上海全民锦标赛均把这里列为主办场地之一，与主场ESP购物中心、百联中环购物广场等商圈赛场串联。网鱼品牌1998年创立于上海松江，是国内首家具有连锁网吧经营资质的品牌，2021年由“网鱼网咖”升级为“网鱼电竞”；截至2026年1月，其全球会员超过4,000万，服务覆盖80多个城市，年服务人次超过7,000万。万航渡路店把连锁网咖的日常运营与小型赛事、观赛活动结合，是上海“全民电竞”落地社区商业的一个样本。交通上，地铁13号线武宁路站、11号线隆德路站均可步行到达，长寿路沿线公交线路密集。
intro_en: Wanyoo Esports Wanhangdu Road store occupies space in the Huxi Culture and Arts Centre at 19 Wanhangdu Hou Road in Putuo District, near the Caojiadu junction where Changshou Road meets Wanhangdu Road and within the Caojiadu commercial area on the border of Jing'an, Putuo and Changning districts. The store covers about 700 square metres and is divided into a waiting area, an interactive zone and a spectator area seating 200. At the time of the 2020 grading it was the only Wanyoo outlet in Shanghai built around esports rather than general internet-cafe use, and represents the chain's shift from net bar to esports venue. In September 2020 it was rated a Class C venue in Shanghai's first esports venue grading, listed as Wanyoo Internet Cafe (Caojiadu store) and Wanyoo Esports Wanhangdu Road store.  The store stages more than 50 matches a year and has hosted offline events for CS:GO, Dota 2, Hearthstone and League of Legends, as well as competitions for professional, semi-professional and amateur players. In 2021, 2022 and 2024 the Shanghai Esports Citizens Championship listed it as one of its venues, alongside Home ESP and Bailian Zhonghuan shopping centre. Wanyoo was founded in Songjiang, Shanghai, in 1998 and was the first chain in China licensed to operate multiple internet cafes; it rebranded from Wanyoo Internet Cafe to Wanyoo Esports in 2021. By January 2026 it reported more than 40 million members worldwide, coverage of over 80 cities and more than 70 million visits a year. The Wanhangdu Road store combines everyday cafe operation with small tournaments and viewing events, an example of how grassroots esports has settled into neighbourhood retail. Wuning Road station on Line 13 and Longde Road station on Line 11 are within walking distance, with frequent buses along Changshou Road.

area_text: 场馆面积官方未公布；所在长泰广场总建筑面积约32万平方米
capacity_text: 官方未公布（室内多功能厅，按活动搭建）
intro_zh: 长泰国际文化中心位于上海市浦东新区金科路2889弄长泰广场D座一层，是长泰广场的泛娱乐体验中心，以电竞为核心基因，同时覆盖演艺、文化体验、展览与会议会务。2020年9月，上海市电子竞技运动协会等机构依据《电竞场馆建设规范》团体标准公布首批获评级电竞场馆，长泰国际文化中心列入C类场馆，是浦东张江板块最早拿到官方评级的专业电竞空间之一。场馆由长甲集团旗下珑讯电竞运营：2018年4月，珑讯电竞品牌发布会暨CBEL商业电竞超级联赛启动仪式在此举行；此后这里长期承接商业电竞赛事、战队训练营和电竞产业培训，上海交通大学海外教育学院与珑讯电竞学院合办的电竞产业高端管理研修班也在此签约发布。空间为室内多层布局，可在比赛舞台、观众区、展陈区之间切换，适合中小型电竞赛事、品牌快闪、新品发布与节目录播；建筑面积与固定座位数官方未公布；场馆未单独公布直线电话，联络需经长泰广场总服务台转接，档期、搭建与用电需与运营方逐场确认。交通上，地铁2号线金科路站4号口出站步行约5分钟即到，祖冲之路金科路站有636、1029、1046、1113、浦东12路等线路。需要说明：本场实际位于上海，因名单归入广州批次而被误列，本条按上海实况记录，不作改写。
intro_en: Changtai International Cultural Center occupies the first floor of Block D at Changtai Plaza, 2889 Jinke Road, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. It is the plaza's pan-entertainment experience centre, built around esports as its core DNA and extending into live performance, cultural experience, exhibitions and meetings. In September 2020 the Shanghai Esports Association and partner bodies published the city's first rated esports venues under the group standard for esports venue construction; Changtai International Cultural Center was placed in Class C, making it one of the earliest officially rated professional esports spaces in the Zhangjiang district of Pudong. The venue is operated by Longxun Esports under the Changjia Group: in April 2018 the Longxun Esports brand launch and the kick-off of the CBEL commercial esports super league were held here, and since then it has hosted commercial tournaments, team bootcamps and industry training, including the esports management programme jointly launched by Shanghai Jiao Tong University's School of Overseas Education and the Longxun Esports Academy. The interior is arranged over several levels and can be reconfigured between competition stage, spectator zone and exhibition area, which suits mid-sized esports events, brand pop-ups, product launches and broadcast recording. Gross floor area and fixed seat counts are not published by the operator, and the venue has no direct public telephone line, so enquiries go through the Changtai Plaza service desk; availability, rigging and power supply must be confirmed event by event. Metro Line 2, Jinke Road station, exit 4, is about a five-minute walk; bus routes 636, 1029, 1046, 1113 and Pudong 12 stop at Zuchongzhi Road/Jinke Road. Note: the venue is in Shanghai, not Guangzhou; it was misfiled into this Guangzhou batch list, and the record follows the Shanghai facts rather than rewriting them.

name_zh: 上海旗忠森林体育城网球中心
address: 上海市闵行区马桥镇元江路5500号
area_text: 用地508亩；总建筑面积85,438㎡；主赛场（中央球场）30,649㎡
intro_zh: 上海旗忠森林体育城网球中心简称旗忠网球中心，位于上海市闵行区马桥镇旗忠村元江路5500号，地处上海西南，距市中心约27公里，是上海建设“全球著名体育城市”布局中的大型单项场馆，也是亚太地区唯一的ATP1000大师赛——上海劳力士大师赛的举办地。它以“森林体育城”为概念，把专业网球设施放进大片绿地之中，与市区的徐家汇、浦东场馆群形成“城郊大型赛事+城市日常健身”的分工。  基地用地约508亩，总建筑面积85,438平方米，容积率0.187、建筑密度15.1%、绿化率46.1%，配993个停车位。比赛区设主赛场一座、室外网球场18片（其中10片设看台），另有2号馆、3号馆，合计1号馆（中央球场）、2号馆、3号馆与6片室内、16片室外共25片国际标准网球场。主赛场建筑面积30,649平方米，地上四层、高约40米，固定座席13,779个，赛事时可扩至约1.5万座，是亚洲规模最大的网球场之一。  建筑的最大特色是可开启屋盖：由8片叶瓣状钢屋面板组成，直径144米，每片结构连装置重约200吨，开启过程宛如上海市花白玉兰绽放，为世界首创；屋盖上表面为铝合金面板，下表面为PTFE膜材，膜面积约8,848平方米，屋盖四周向内悬挑61.5米。场馆2005年启用，2005至2008年连续举办四届网球大师杯，2009年起举办上海劳力士大师赛，2023年中央球场完成装修提升后重新亮相，灯光指标超过奥运会与CIE83标准。交通上，自驾经沪闵高架—莘庄—元江路可达，赛事期间设专线接驳与地铁5号线颛桥站换乘。
intro_en: The Qizhong Forest Sports City Tennis Centre, known simply as Qizhong, occupies 5500 Yuanjiang Road in Maqiao town, Minhang District, in south-western Shanghai about 27 kilometres from the city centre. It is a single-sport venue of national scale in Shanghai's plan to become a global sports city and the home of the Shanghai Rolex Masters, the only ATP Masters 1000 event in Asia-Pacific. Conceived as a forest sports city, it places tournament-grade tennis facilities inside a large green site, complementing the downtown clusters at Xujiahui and Pudong with a division of labour between suburban mega-events and urban daily fitness.  The 508-mu site has 85,438 square metres of floor area, a plot ratio of 0.187, 15.1 per cent building coverage and 46.1 per cent greenery, with 993 parking spaces. The competition zone contains the main stadium and eighteen outdoor courts, ten of them with stands, plus courts two and three, giving 25 international-standard courts in total: the centre court, two secondary stadia, six indoor and sixteen outdoor courts. The main stadium has 30,649 square metres over four storeys at about 40 metres in height, with 13,779 fixed seats expandable to roughly 15,000 for tournaments, making it one of the largest tennis venues in Asia.  Its signature is the retractable roof: eight petal-shaped steel roof panels forming a 144-metre-diameter cover, each weighing about 200 tonnes with its machinery, opening like the white magnolia, Shanghai's city flower, in a world first. The panels are aluminium on top and PTFE membrane beneath, with some 8,848 square metres of membrane, and the roof cantilevers 61.5 metres inward from its perimeter. The venue opened in 2005, hosted four Tennis Masters Cups from 2005 to 2008 and has staged the Shanghai Rolex Masters since 2009; the centre court reopened after a refurbishment in 2023 with lighting levels exceeding Olympic and CIE83 standards. Drivers reach the site via the Humin elevated road, Xinzhuang and Yuanjiang Road, and tournament shuttles connect with Zhuanqiao station on metro line 5.
source: zh.wikipedia.org/上海旗忠森林体育城网球中心；siadr.com/旗忠网球中心；sportsbeams.cn/旗忠网球中心；trip.com/旗忠网球中心（电话）

address: 上海市徐汇区漕溪北路1111号
area_text: 建筑面积约3.1万㎡（1975年建成时）；屋盖网架直径110m、重约660吨
intro_zh: 上海体育馆俗称“万体馆”，位于上海市徐汇区漕溪北路1111号，处在内环高架与沪闵高架交汇处，是徐家汇体育公园“一场两馆”中的室内馆。它1973年重新动工、1975年竣工、1976年投用，由中国工程院院士魏敦山设计，是当时全国规模最大、设施最先进的综合性体育馆；因可容纳1.8万名观众，上海人习惯叫它“万体馆”，这个名字后来也派生出公园里综合馆“万体汇”的昵称。  主馆平面呈圆形，高33米，屋顶网架跨度直径110米，整个屋盖重约660吨，可容纳观众18,000人（后按赛事与演出需要调整为体育比赛12,000人、文艺演出10,000人）。1999年10月，在保留体育馆功能的基础上改建成“上海大舞台”，舞台平面呈橄榄型，左右两端最大有效使用距离60米、前后最大纵深32米、舞台面积约1,250平方米；2004年为世乒赛和NBA中国赛再度翻新。2023年完成新一轮改造后，场馆设近1.3万个座位（含2,000余个活动坐席）和可移动看台，成为CBA上海大鲨鱼的主场。  建筑价值是它最硬的标签：这是中国第一个大跨度网架结构体育馆，直径110米、仅660吨重的屋盖采用整体吊装提升安装，也是中国第一座可容纳万人以上的体育馆，与上海游泳馆一同被载入英国皇家建筑学会出版的《世界建筑史》。作为徐家汇体育公园的一部分，它与上海体育场、上海游泳馆、综合馆“万体汇”共享地下空间与步行系统。交通极为便利，地铁1号线、4号线上海体育馆站出站即到，3号线漕溪路站、11号线上海游泳馆站也在步行范围。
intro_en: Shanghai Gymnasium, popularly called Wantiguan or the ten-thousand-seat hall, stands at 1111 Caoxi North Road in Xuhui District, at the junction of the Inner Ring and Humin elevated roads, and is the indoor arena of the stadium-park pair at Xujiahui Sports Park. Restarted in 1973, completed in 1975 and opened in 1976, it was designed by Wei Dunshan, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, and was then the largest and best equipped multi-purpose hall in the country. Its capacity of 18,000 spectators gave it the nickname that later inspired Wantihui, the name of the park's new underground complex.  The main hall is circular in plan, 33 metres high, with a roof space frame 110 metres in diameter and a roof weighing about 660 tonnes, originally seating 18,000 and later configured for 12,000 at sport and 10,000 for performances. In October 1999 it was rebuilt as the Shanghai Grand Stage while retaining its sports function, with an olive-shaped stage offering 60 metres of usable width, 32 metres of depth and about 1,250 square metres of stage area. It was refurbished again in 2004 for the World Table Tennis Championships and an NBA China game. A further renovation completed in 2023 produced nearly 13,000 seats including more than 2,000 movable places, and the hall became the home of the Shanghai Sharks in the CBA.  Its architectural significance is the strongest claim on the building: it is China's first long-span space-frame gymnasium, with the 110-metre, 660-tonne roof lifted into place as a single unit, and the country's first indoor arena seating more than ten thousand; together with the Shanghai Swimming Pool it was entered in the World Architecture History published by the Royal Institute of British Architects. As part of Xujiahui Sports Park it shares underground space and pedestrian routes with the Shanghai Stadium, the swimming pool and the Wantihui complex. Access is unusually easy: Shanghai Gymnasium station on metro lines 1 and 4 opens at the door, with Caoxi Road station on line 3 and Shanghai Swimming Pool station on line 11 also within walking distance.
source: zh.wikipedia.org/上海体育馆；siadr.com/上海体育馆；epaper.gmw.cn/上海万体馆建成记；amap.com/上海体育馆（电话）

address: 上海市静安区汶水路116号
intro_zh: 静安体育中心位于上海市静安区汶水路116号，处中环汶水路立交东南角、地铁1号线汶水路站旁，是静安区政府投资建设、2017年9月17日启用的区级综合体育设施，也是静安区体量最大的公共体育场馆。它以“天空之城”的造型成为上海北部的新地标：在寸土寸金的中心城区，把体育场“叠”到屋顶，用垂直复合的方式解决用地紧张，是上海城市更新中“向空中要场地”的代表案例。  中心占地61,733.8平方米，建设总规模87,544平方米，建筑面积71,291平方米，其中地上约44,880平方米。馆内设5,600个座位的综合体育馆，以及2片篮球场、2片排球场、4片网球场、16片乒乓球场、20片羽毛球场和1个游泳馆，配有标准池与儿童池，可同时容纳千人健身。屋顶是最特别的部分：在13米标高屋面建成的室外标准足球场面积约1.62万平方米，设6条跑道和看台，是上海首个屋顶标准足球场，空中跑道分时段免费开放。  建筑由上海建筑设计研究院设计，把综合体育馆、全民健身馆与屋顶体育场竖向叠加，外立面以水平线条和通透玻璃强调体量的轻盈，屋顶球场四周设防护网与照明，夜间从汶水路望去像一座悬空的球场。运营上由华润文化体育发展有限公司上海分公司负责，2022年闭馆改造、2023年7月1日全面重新开放，对游泳馆、羽毛球场地、商业配套和电力扩容做了升级，日常以游泳、羽毛球、篮球、网球和青少年培训为主，也承接小型赛事与演艺活动。交通上，地铁1号线汶水路站2号口步行约390米，中环高架汶水路匝道近在咫尺，周边公交线路密集。
intro_en: Jing'an Sports Centre occupies 116 Wenshui Road in Jing'an District, at the south-east corner of the Wenshui Road interchange on the Middle Ring Road and beside Wenshui Road station on metro line 1. Funded by the district government and opened on 17 September 2017, it is the largest public sports venue in Jing'an and has become a northern Shanghai landmark under the name Sky City: in a dense central district it stacks the stadium onto the roof, using vertical layering to solve a land shortage and exemplifying the city's strategy of building upwards for sports space.  The site covers 61,733.8 square metres with a total development size of 87,544 square metres and 71,291 square metres of floor area, about 44,880 of it above ground. Inside are a 5,600-seat multi-purpose arena, two basketball courts, two volleyball courts, four tennis courts, sixteen table tennis tables, twenty badminton courts and a natatorium with a standard pool and a children's pool, able to host a thousand people exercising at once. The roof is the signature move: a standard outdoor football pitch of about 16,200 square metres at 13 metres above ground, with six running lanes and a small grandstand, the first rooftop standard football ground in Shanghai, whose running track is free in set hours.  Designed by the Shanghai Architectural Design and Research Institute, the complex stacks the arena, the fitness halls and the rooftop stadium vertically, with horizontal bands and transparent glazing keeping the mass light; the roof pitch is enclosed by safety netting and floodlights, so from Wenshui Road at night it reads as a floating field. China Resources Culture and Sports Development (Shanghai) operates the centre. It closed for renovation in 2022 and fully reopened on 1 July 2023 after upgrading the pool, badminton courts, retail areas and power capacity. Day to day it serves swimming, badminton, basketball, tennis and junior coaching, and also takes small competitions and entertainment events. Wenshui Road station on metro line 1 is about 390 metres from exit 2, the Middle Ring Road ramp is next door, and bus routes are dense in the area.
