address: 广东省东莞市南城街道体育路3号（东莞市体育中心内）
intro_zh: 东莞体育馆位于东莞市南城街道体育路3号，在东莞市体育中心园区内，紧邻市行政中心，1992年9月26日动工、1994年10月15日竣工，馆内设4000个固定座席。自1995年CBA元年以来，这里长期是广东宏远男篮的主场，直到2013年球队迁出；18个赛季里见证了2003—2006赛季三连冠、2008—2011赛季四连冠，共8次总冠军，并创下连续11年承办CBA总决赛的纪录，至今未被打破，因此被称为东莞的“冠军殿堂”。2001年场馆承办第九届全国运动会篮球比赛，2010年广州亚运会举重比赛在此举行，产生15枚金牌，赛前市里投入近3000万元对场馆做了全面改造。2025年，为迎接第十五届全国运动会，场馆再次整体升级：照明改为可切换模式的LED智能控制系统，场内木地板与观众席翻新，场外增设无障碍停车位，入口新建无障碍电梯，内部通道铺设盲道和轮椅坡道，运动员休息区配无障碍卫生间，并新增集母婴室功能于一体的第三卫生间，兴奋剂检测室也完成无障碍改造。2025年11月4日至12日，这里承办十五运会男子成年组篮球部分赛事，12月7日至16日承办残特奥会聋人女子篮球赛；赛事之外，东莞市篮球联赛（莞BA）多次把总决赛放在这里，2024赛季南城与麻涌的总决赛首战即在此进行。
intro_en: Dongguan Gymnasium stands at 3 Tiyu Road in Nancheng Subdistrict, inside the Dongguan Sports Centre campus beside the city's administrative quarter. Construction began on 26 September 1992 and the building was completed on 15 October 1994 with 4,000 fixed seats. From the first CBA season in 1995 until the club moved out in 2013 it was the home court of the Guangdong Hongyuan basketball team, and over 18 seasons it saw three consecutive titles from 2003 to 2006, four in a row from 2008 to 2011 and eight championships in all, plus a run of 11 straight years hosting CBA finals that still stands as a record, which is why locals call it the hall of champions. The gym staged basketball at the 9th National Games in 2001 and weightlifting at the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games, where 15 gold medals were decided after the city spent close to 30 million yuan on a full refit. In 2025 the venue was upgraded again for the 15th National Games: lighting moved to a switchable LED system, timber flooring and seating were renewed, accessible parking bays were added outside, a new accessible lift serves the entrance, tactile paving and wheelchair ramps line the interior circulation, the athletes' area gained accessible washrooms, a new family and baby-care room was built and the doping control room was made accessible. From 4 to 12 November 2025 it hosted part of the men's basketball tournament of the National Games, and from 7 to 16 December the deaf women's basketball competition of the National Para Games. Between events the Dongguan city league, known as Guan BA, repeatedly brings its finals here, including game one of the 2024 final between Nancheng and Machong.

address: 新疆维吾尔自治区乌鲁木齐市新市区北京中路460号
intro_zh: 新疆体育中心（全称新疆维吾尔自治区体育中心）位于乌鲁木齐市新市区北京中路460号，占地256,667平方米，建筑面积超过15万平方米，由体育场、体育馆和综合训练馆三大主体建筑组成，是新疆规模最大的综合性体育场馆群。工程2001年4月开工，由北京市建筑设计研究院与新疆建筑设计研究院设计、新疆维吾尔自治区第四建筑公司承建，2004年9月30日挂牌成立，体育馆于10月1日对外开放，体育场2005年底竣工启用；体育场投资4.08亿元、体育馆投资2.21亿元。体育场建筑面积75,000平方米，设42,300个座位，平面外圈为直径260米的圆形，内圈是长轴近182米、短轴近134米的椭圆，看台共6层、上部覆盖3,500平方米环形钢桁罩棚，罩棚采用斜拉钢结构。体育馆在体育场西北角，建筑面积超过24,300平方米，设6,068个座位，屋顶为直径120米的圆拱，造型是一朵有13瓣花瓣的雪莲花，馆内比赛场地长70米、宽45米、高35米，达到国际一类标准，另配长50米、宽35米的热身场、8间会议室、健身馆和新闻发布厅。综合训练馆建筑面积30,000平方米，为长方形钢桁结构，分篮球排球训练区、田径投掷区和生活区。2017年中心建成悬浮式篮球场，2011年起逐步免费向公众开放；2024年实施体育场抗震加固、钢结构维护及水电气暖、消防系统改造，同年还改造了网球馆灯光和线路。这里曾是新疆天山雪豹足球俱乐部和新疆天山神鹿女子篮球俱乐部的主场，2019年底有15个运动项目俱乐部在此活动，新疆国际民族舞蹈节等文化活动也常在此举办。
intro_en: The Xinjiang Sports Centre, formally the sports centre of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, occupies 256,667 sqm at 460 Beijing Middle Road in the Xinshi District of Urumqi, with more than 150,000 sqm of floor area spread across three main buildings: a stadium, an indoor arena and an indoor training hall. Work began in April 2001 to designs by the Beijing Institute of Architectural Design and the Xinjiang Institute of Architectural Design, and the complex was formally established on 30 September 2004; the arena opened on 1 October that year and the stadium was completed at the end of 2005, at a cost of 408 million yuan for the stadium and 221 million for the arena. The stadium has 75,000 sqm of floor area and 42,300 seats, with a circular outer ring 260 m across enclosing an elliptical inner bowl roughly 182 m by 134 m; six tiers of seating are covered by a 3,500 sqm annular steel truss canopy on cable-stayed supports. The arena in the northwest corner has more than 24,300 sqm and 6,068 seats under a 120 m domed roof shaped as a thirteen-petal snow lotus, and its competition floor measures 70 m by 45 m with a 35 m clear height, meeting international first-class standards, alongside a 50 m by 35 m warm-up hall, eight meeting rooms, a gym and a press room. The training hall adds 30,000 sqm in a rectangular steel truss building with volleyball and basketball courts, athletics and throwing areas, and changing rooms. A suspended basketball court was added in 2017, general public access has been free since 2011, and in 2024 the stadium underwent seismic strengthening, steelwork maintenance and full mechanical and fire-system renewal. The centre has been home to the Xinjiang Tianshan Leopard football club and the Tianshan Divine Deer women's basketball team, hosted 15 sports clubs by the end of 2019, and stages cultural events including the Xinjiang International Ethnic Dance Festival.

address: 新疆维吾尔自治区乌鲁木齐市水磨沟区新民西街90号（紧靠红山公园东门）
area_text: 占地15,558.52㎡，建筑高度24.8米，地下1层、地上4层；场地34×45米（活动座椅收起）／33×21米（活动座椅开放）
intro_zh: 红山体育中心体育馆位于乌鲁木齐市水磨沟区新民西街90号，紧靠红山公园东门，是乌鲁木齐市红山体育中心的室内场馆，也就是通常所说的红山体育馆。2019年市体育局机构改革，把原红山体育中心与红山游泳中心合并为新的红山体育中心，下辖红山体育馆、红山体育场、红山游泳馆和红山室外游泳池四处场馆，体育馆是其中承担室内赛事和全民健身的主馆。场馆占地总面积15,558.52平方米，高24.8米，地下1层、地上4层，可容纳3500人；活动座椅收起时场地长34米、宽45米，活动座椅开放时场地长33米、宽21米，可承接篮球、排球、手球、乒乓球、羽毛球、摔跤、跆拳道等项目的比赛，也可举办室内小型运动会、文艺演出、会议和讲座。馆内除比赛场地和相应的体育配套设施外，前后共设4个贵宾室和运动员休息室。目前体育馆一层由新疆宏辉合展商业服务有限公司整体租赁，用于体育、全民健身、文化等相关产业的商业运营，其余空间继续承担训练、比赛和群众健身功能。场馆地处乌鲁木齐老城中心，与红山体育场、红山游泳馆共同构成红山片区的体育设施集群，周边为红山公园、新民西街一带的居住和商业区，观众多以步行和公交到达。
intro_en: The Hongshan Sports Centre Gymnasium stands at 90 Xinmin West Street in the Shuimogou District of Urumqi, hard against the east gate of Hongshan Park, and is the indoor arena of the municipal Hongshan Sports Centre, better known simply as the Hongshan Gymnasium. A 2019 reorganisation of the municipal sports bureau merged the former Hongshan Sports Centre with the Hongshan swimming centre into one body that now runs four facilities: the gymnasium, Hongshan Stadium, the Hongshan natatorium and an outdoor pool. The gymnasium covers a site of 15,558.52 sqm and rises 24.8 m over one basement and four upper floors, seating 3,500 people. With the retractable seats stowed the floor measures 34 m by 45 m; with them open it measures 33 m by 21 m, which allows basketball, volleyball, handball, table tennis, badminton, wrestling and taekwondo competitions as well as small indoor meets, stage shows, conferences and lectures. Beyond the competition floor and its sports fit-out, the building has four VIP and athlete rest rooms at front and rear. The ground floor is currently leased in its entirety to Xinjiang Honghui Hezhan Commercial Services, which runs sports, fitness and cultural businesses there, while the rest of the building continues to serve training, competition and public exercise. Sitting in the old centre of the city, the arena forms a sports cluster with Hongshan Stadium and the Hongshan natatorium, surrounded by the park and the residential and commercial streets off Xinmin West Street, and most spectators arrive on foot or by bus. It is one of four venues in a centre that also runs Hongshan Stadium with 9,600 seats, the natatorium and an outdoor pool, an arrangement formalised when the municipal sports bureau merged the two older bodies in 2019.

address: 新疆维吾尔自治区乌鲁木齐市水磨沟区新民西街90号
intro_zh: 红山体育场位于乌鲁木齐市水磨沟区新民西街90号，与红山体育馆相邻，是红山体育中心四处场馆中的田径场。体育场总建筑面积8,566.55平方米，占地面积24,218.55平方米，场地设400米标准塑胶跑道和草坪足球场，环形观众看台可容纳9,600位观众。场内配有田径运动会所需的各种器械设备，并装有彩色电子显示屏和专业音响设备，可为大型演出、运动会及各类比赛提供场地和服务。成立至今，这里累计承接大型比赛及演出活动500余场次、社会公益性活动400余场次，同时为乌鲁木齐市运动学校、市业余体校、市体育传统项目学校的田径、足球、男女篮球、摔跤、射箭、柔道、跆拳道等项目训练提供场地，是乌市青少年素质教育基地的组成部分，兼具训练、科研和全民健身功能。2025年国庆假期，体育场免费向市民开放，刷身份证即可进场，田径场和足球场同时用于晨练、羽毛球和青少年训练，看台与场地在假期全天保持较高使用率。体育场紧靠红山公园，周边为新民西街城市生活区，从市区各处乘公交可直达，是乌鲁木齐老城区使用率最高的公共田径场地之一。
intro_en: Hongshan Stadium sits at 90 Xinmin West Street in Urumqi's Shuimogou District, next to the Hongshan Gymnasium, and is the athletics ground among the four venues of the Hongshan Sports Centre. The stadium has 8,566.55 sqm of floor area on a 24,218.55 sqm site, with a standard 400 m synthetic track, a grass football pitch and a ring of terracing seating 9,600 spectators. It is equipped with the full range of athletics apparatus plus a colour electronic scoreboard and a professional sound system, so it can serve major concerts, sports meetings and competitions alike. Since opening it has taken more than 500 major competitions and performances and over 400 public-interest events, and it provides training ground for athletics, football, men's and women's basketball, wrestling, archery, judo and taekwondo squads from the Urumqi sports school, the municipal spare-time sports school and schools with traditional sports programmes. It forms part of the city's youth quality-education base and combines training, research and mass fitness in one site. During the 2025 National Day holiday the stadium opened free of charge, with residents entering simply by scanning their identity cards, and the track and pitch were used simultaneously for morning exercise, badminton and youth training, keeping both field and stands busy through the holiday. Backing onto Hongshan Park and surrounded by the residential streets off Xinmin West Street, the ground is reachable by bus from across the city and ranks among the most heavily used public athletics facilities in Urumqi's old town. Because the track is a standard 400 m oval, the ground can be set up for track-and-field meetings as well as football, and the same address and forecourt are shared with the gymnasium next door.

address: 新疆维吾尔自治区乌鲁木齐市水磨沟区新民西街（紧靠红山公园东门；门牌有90号、92号两种记载）
area_text: 占地15,558.52㎡，建筑高度24.8米，地下1层、地上4层
capacity_text: 4500（维基百科；乌鲁木齐市政府2025年简介按3500人计）
intro_zh: 红山体育馆位于乌鲁木齐市水磨沟区新民西街，紧靠红山公园东门，门牌有90号与92号两种记载，2002年启用，由红山体育中心运营，是乌鲁木齐最知名的室内篮球馆。场馆座位数在不同资料中分别记为4,500个（维基百科）和3,500人（乌鲁木齐市政府2025年场馆简介），差别主要来自活动座椅与固定看台的统计口径；建筑占地15,558.52平方米、高24.8米，地下1层、地上4层。自2002年起，这里长期是CBA新疆广汇飞虎男篮的主场，也是球队成绩最好年代的主场：2016—2017赛季，新疆广汇在这里打完主场并夺得队史首个CBA总冠军；主场以满座和高上座率著称，2014年媒体报道其主场平均上座率在95%以上，位居全国前列。2023年3月，新疆广汇将主场迁往乌鲁木齐奥体中心，红山体育馆随之退出CBA赛场，转为全民健身、青少年篮球培训、群众赛事和文艺演出的场地，一层空间引入商业运营。场馆处在红山公园景区东侧，紧邻新民西街，公交线路密集，步行可至红山塔和公园各入口，周边是乌鲁木齐老城区的商业与居住片区，比赛日人流由新民西街和红山路方向集散。
intro_en: Hongshan Gymnasium stands on Xinmin West Street in Urumqi's Shuimogou District, against the east gate of Hongshan Park, with street numbers recorded as both 90 and 92. It opened in 2002, is operated by the Hongshan Sports Centre and is the best known indoor basketball arena in the city. Published capacity varies: Wikipedia gives 4,500 seats while the municipal government's 2025 venue profile counts 3,500 people, a difference that comes mainly from how retractable and fixed seating are counted. The building covers 15,558.52 sqm on a 24.8 m high structure with one basement and four upper floors. From 2002 it was the long-standing home court of the Xinjiang Guanghui Flying Tigers in the CBA and the backdrop to the club's strongest years: in the 2016-17 season the team played its home games here and won the first championship in its history. The arena was known for full houses and high attendance, with local media reporting an average of more than 95 per cent in 2014, among the best in the league. In March 2023 Guanghui moved its home games to the Urumqi Olympic Sports Centre, and Hongshan Gymnasium left the CBA circuit, shifting to mass fitness, youth basketball coaching, amateur competitions and stage shows, with its ground floor let for commercial use. The arena sits on the eastern edge of Hongshan Park, close to Xinmin West Street and a dense bus network, within walking distance of the Hongshan Pagoda and the park entrances, and on match days crowds used to arrive and disperse along Xinmin West Street and Hongshan Road. The city lists it as one of the four venues of the Hongshan Sports Centre, together with the stadium, the natatorium and the outdoor pool.

address: 新疆维吾尔自治区乌鲁木齐市沙依巴克区滨河南路284号（室外池位于滨河南路214号）
area_text: 游泳场馆区占地14,000㎡；室内馆1座、室外池2个，池长50米、宽22.5米
intro_zh: 红山游泳馆位于乌鲁木齐市沙依巴克区滨河南路284号，与滨河南路214号的红山室外游泳池同属红山体育中心，是乌鲁木齐市唯一一座标准的游泳训练和全民健身公益性游泳场所。游泳场馆区占地14,000平方米，包含一座室内馆和两个室外池，池长均为50米、宽22.5米，符合标准比赛池规格，可承办大中型游泳比赛。这里每年接待游泳人群近20余万人次，并常年开设多元化的游泳及救生培训科目。2006年，游泳馆注册成立海豚游泳俱乐部并设立培训机构，长年开设游泳长训班、短训班和救生员培训班，定期向市游泳队输送有潜力的苗子；培训对象覆盖25至45岁的在校学生、社会青年以及游泳场所尚未通过职业技能鉴定的从业人员，为全市游泳救生队伍补充人员，保障游泳场所安全开放。2024年，俱乐部依托红山游泳馆成为乌鲁木齐首家“游泳进校园”活动的承办单位，与周边的第三小学、第六小学、第55小学、第41小学和第九小学签订培训协议，近千名学生参加，推动中小学生掌握游泳专项技能和自救自护技能。冬季室外池不封闭，常年有冬泳爱好者在此锻炼，2018年12月新华社曾报道当地气温接近零下20摄氏度时泳者仍照常下水。
intro_en: The Hongshan Natatorium at 284 Binhe South Road in Urumqi's Saybag District, together with the Hongshan outdoor pool at number 214 on the same road, belongs to the Hongshan Sports Centre and is the only standard swimming facility in the city run as a public training and fitness venue. The swimming compound covers 14,000 sqm and contains one indoor hall and two outdoor pools, all 50 m long and 22.5 m wide to championship dimensions, and it stages medium and large swimming competitions. Around 200,000 visits are recorded each year, and the venue runs a year-round programme of swimming and lifesaving courses. In 2006 the natatorium registered the Dolphin Swimming Club and set up a training arm that runs long and short courses plus lifeguard certification, feeding promising swimmers to the municipal squad; courses are aimed at students and young people aged 25 to 45 as well as pool staff who have not yet passed vocational assessment, which keeps the city's lifeguard pool supplied and its pools safe to open. In 2024 the club, working through the natatorium, became the first organiser of a swimming-into-schools programme in Urumqi, signing training agreements with the nearby No. 3, No. 6, No. 55, No. 41 and No. 9 primary schools and bringing nearly a thousand pupils into the programme so that they learn to swim and to rescue themselves. The outdoor pools stay open through winter and draw cold-water swimmers year after year; in December 2018 Xinhua reported swimmers still entering the water as air temperatures approached minus 20 degrees Celsius. Both pool types are 50 m by 22.5 m, the standard racing length, so competitions can be swum over Olympic distances without reconfiguring the water.

name_zh: 佛山世纪莲游泳跳水馆
address: 广东省佛山市顺德区乐从镇岭南大道南1号（佛山世纪莲体育中心内）
area_text: 建筑面积31,052㎡，长220米、宽88.8米、高22米；地下3层、地上1层
intro_zh: 佛山世纪莲游泳跳水馆位于佛山市顺德区乐从镇岭南大道南1号，是佛山世纪莲体育中心三大场馆之一，坐落在东平河畔的佛山新城核心区。场馆2006年8月中旬竣工，同年10月8日随体育中心整体落成开放，建筑面积31,052平方米，平面长220米、宽88.8米、高22米，地下3层、地上1层，设观众座位2,767个。建筑采用钢结构配大面积玻璃幕墙和索膜屋面，大跨度钢结构拱架覆盖三个国际标准水池——跳水池、比赛池和训练池，水质采用臭氧水处理技术净化。2010年广州亚运会期间，这里是花样游泳比赛的举办地。作为公共体育场馆，游泳跳水馆常年对社会开放，2026年6月至9月实施免费开放政策，每天放出50个免费名额，需提前3天在预约系统抢号，室内池开放时间为6:30至20:30，室外池为6:30至8:30和17:00至22:00；预约须实名核验，不接受截图，同一账号成功预约后须间隔满3个自然日方可再次预约。场馆交通便利，广佛地铁世纪莲站直达体育中心，园区配1,100个停车位，周边为佛山新城文化中心、图书馆和东平河滨水绿道，赛后与体育场、网球场共同承担赛事、演出和全民健身功能。
intro_en: The Century Lotus Swimming and Diving Hall at 1 Lingnan Avenue South in Lecong, Shunde District, is one of the three main buildings of the Foshan Century Lotus Sports Centre, set in the heart of Foshan New Town on the bank of the Dongping River. It was completed in mid-August 2006 and opened with the rest of the centre on 8 October that year, with 31,052 sqm of floor area in a volume 220 m long, 88.8 m wide and 22 m high, three storeys below ground and one above, seating 2,767 spectators. The structure combines a steel frame with large glazed walls and a cable-membrane roof, and a long-span steel arch system covers three international-standard pools: diving, competition and training. Water is treated with ozone. During the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games the hall hosted the synchronised swimming competition. As a public venue it stays open to residents all year, and from June to September 2026 it ran a free-entry scheme releasing 50 places a day, bookable three days ahead through the reservation system, with the indoor pool open from 06:30 to 20:30 and the outdoor pools from 06:30 to 08:30 and 17:00 to 22:00; bookings are identity-checked, screenshots are not accepted, and the same account must wait three clear days before booking again. The site is easy to reach, with Century Lotus station on the Guangfo metro line serving the centre and 1,100 parking spaces on site, and it sits among the Foshan New Town cultural centre, the library and the riverside greenway, sharing event, performance and public-fitness duties with the stadium and the tennis centre. Its three pools allow competition, training and warm-up sessions to run at the same time.

address: 广东省佛山市禅城区岭南大道北79号（佛山电视塔北侧）
area_text: 占地约335亩，建筑面积7.6万㎡；主馆占地3,500㎡、建筑面积75,967㎡、高33米、直径132米
intro_zh: 佛山岭南明珠体育馆位于佛山市禅城区岭南大道北79号、佛山电视塔北侧，是佛山市为承办广东省第十二届运动会兴建的大型场馆。工程2004年4月25日动工，2005年2月28日封顶，2006年7月28日竣工，总投资约5.5亿元，建筑方案由日本株式会社环境设计研究所（仙田满）中标设计，广州市第三建筑工程有限公司承建。场馆占地约335亩，建筑面积7.6万平方米，由综合体育馆（主馆）、训练馆、大众馆和全民健身广场组成，三个馆通过穹顶连廊连为一体，结构取中国传统斗拱意象并结合膜结构，白色圆弧外形像三颗明珠，可自然采光和通风，西侧设圆形风雨廊围合市民健身广场。主馆占地3,500平方米、建筑面积75,967平方米、高33米、直径132米，地下1层、地上4层，设8,500多个观众座席，其中固定座位5,788个、可移动座位2,804个；训练馆设920多个座席，平日作羽毛球场地，重大赛事时作主馆热身场；大众馆为多功能小型运动场馆；全民健身广场面积28,000平方米，含600米户外回廊和18个露天篮球场。2010年广州亚运会期间，主馆承办拳击比赛。2007年1月1日起，佛山市政府将场馆委托给中体产业集团旗下的佛山中奥广场管理有限公司运营，日常开放羽毛球、篮球等项目，订场走“中体运动空间”小程序。
intro_en: Foshan Lingnan Mingzhu Gymnasium stands at 79 Lingnan Avenue North in Chancheng District, just north of the Foshan television tower, and was built for the 12th Guangdong Provincial Games. Work began on 25 April 2004, the structure was topped out on 28 February 2005 and the building was completed on 28 July 2006 at a cost of about 550 million yuan, to a winning scheme by Japan's Environmental Design Institute under Minoru Senda, with Guangzhou No. 3 Construction as main contractor. The complex covers roughly 335 mu with 76,000 sqm of floor area and comprises the main arena, a training hall, a public hall and a fitness plaza; the three buildings are linked by domed corridors, their structure drawing on the traditional dougong bracket in combination with membrane roofing, so that the white arcs read as three pearls and the interior is naturally lit and ventilated, while a circular covered walkway encloses the plaza on the west. The main arena occupies a 3,500 sqm footprint with 75,967 sqm of floor area, rises 33 m, spans 132 m and has one basement and four upper floors, seating more than 8,500 spectators in 5,788 fixed and 2,804 movable seats. The training hall seats more than 920 and serves as a badminton hall day to day and as the main arena's warm-up space during major events; the public hall is a smaller multi-purpose sports building; and the fitness plaza covers 28,000 sqm with a 600 m outdoor gallery and 18 open-air basketball courts. During the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games the main arena hosted boxing. Since 1 January 2007 the municipal government has entrusted operation to Foshan Zhongao Plaza Management, part of the China Sports Industry group, which runs badminton and basketball sessions bookable through the Zhongti Sports Space mini-programme.

address: 甘肃省兰州市七里河区深安大道（毗邻地铁1号线兰州奥体中心站）
area_text: 总用地约51.6万㎡，总建筑面积约45万㎡；体育场建筑面积80400㎡
intro_zh: 兰州奥体中心位于甘肃省兰州市七里河区深安大道，毗邻地铁1号线兰州奥体中心站，距兰州西站高铁站直线距离约6公里，是甘肃省首座具备承办国际单项赛事和国内综合性赛事能力的现代化体育场馆群。项目采用PPP模式，总投资54亿元，总用地面积约51.6万平方米，总建筑面积约45万平方米，2019年7月开工、2022年建成运营，由“一场三馆”及配套组成：玫瑰体育场建筑面积80400平方米、6万座；郁金香综合馆40750平方米、8000座；百合游泳馆32000平方米、3000座；荷花网球馆11500平方米、3000座，另有兰花体育综合体、室外全民健身场地、运动员公寓和体育产业用房。设计以“飞天花舞”为理念，单体取“舞动于丝绸之路上的花朵”意象，五座主要建筑呼应奥林匹克五环，暖金色与浅灰色铝板配透明玻璃幕墙，在黄河两岸的天际线上形成连续的花瓣轮廓。综合馆预埋制冰系统可实现冰篮快速转换，可办短道速滑与冰球；游泳馆水池深度可调，兼顾健身、水上乐园与潜水培训；网球馆屋面可开闭，可承接网球、电竞、演出与展会。交通方面，场馆经深安大道、南滨河路进出，地铁1号线设奥体中心站，公交与自驾均可便捷到达。
intro_en: Lanzhou Olympic Sports Center lies on Shen'an Avenue in Qilihe District, Lanzhou, beside Metro Line 1's Lanzhou Olympic Sports Center station and about 6 km in a straight line from Lanzhou West high-speed railway station. It is Gansu's first modern venue cluster able to host international single-sport championships and national multi-sport games. Delivered as a PPP project with 5.4 billion yuan of investment, it covers about 516,000 sqm of land with roughly 450,000 sqm of floor area; construction began in July 2019 and the centre opened in 2022. The one-stadium, three-halls programme comprises the Rose Stadium with 80,400 sqm and 60,000 seats, the Tulip arena with 40,750 sqm and 8,000 seats, the Lily swimming hall with 32,000 sqm and 3,000 seats and the Lotus tennis hall with 11,500 sqm and 3,000 seats, plus the Orchid sports complex, outdoor fitness grounds, athletes' apartments and sports industry space. The design concept, dancing flowers on the flying apsaras' ribbons, gives each building the form of a flower dancing on the Silk Road; the five main volumes echo the Olympic rings, clad in warm gold and pale grey aluminium with glass curtain walls, tracing a continuous petal silhouette along the Yellow River skyline. The arena has an embedded ice-making system for rapid ice-to-basketball conversion and can host short-track speed skating and ice hockey; the swimming hall has adjustable depth for fitness, water park and diving programmes; the tennis hall has a retractable roof for tennis, esports, concerts and exhibitions. Shen'an Avenue and the South Binhe Road serve the site, with Metro Line 1 and bus routes providing public access.

address: 北京市朝阳区国家体育场南路1号（奥林匹克公园中心区）
intro_zh: 国家体育场位于北京市朝阳区奥林匹克公园中心区南部、国家体育场南路1号，是2008年北京奥运会主体育场、2022年北京冬奥会开闭幕式场地，也是全球首个承担夏奥与冬奥开闭幕式的“双奥”场馆。场馆占地20.4公顷，建筑面积25.8万平方米，可容纳观众约9.1万人，主体为南北长333米、东西宽296米、最高处69米的椭圆钢结构，由一系列钢桁架围绕碗状坐席区编织成“鸟巢”造型，按特级体育建筑、设计使用年限100年的标准建造。场内设标准田径场与足球场，碗形看台分上、中、下三层，上、中层之间布置包厢；基座以上共七层，设观众服务、媒体工作、贵宾接待和商业空间，基座以下三层为内部环路、停车场及功能用房。赛后长期承接国际足球赛、田径赛、大型演唱会与冰雪活动，是北京中轴线北端的城市地标。交通方面，地铁8号线奥林匹克公园站、奥体中心站及15号线奥林匹克公园站均可步行到达，周边公交线路密集、停车配套完善。屋顶采用半透明膜结构，为场内引入自然采光；赛后场馆持续引入冰雪、演艺与旅游项目，保持全年运营。
intro_en: The National Stadium, known as the Bird's Nest, stands at 1 National Stadium South Road in the Olympic Green, Chaoyang District, Beijing. Built as the main stadium of the 2008 Summer Olympics and reused for the opening and closing ceremonies of the 2022 Winter Olympics, it is the world's first venue to host ceremonies for both a Summer and a Winter Games. The site covers 20.4 hectares with 258,000 sqm of gross floor area and about 91,000 seats. Its elliptical steel structure measures 333 m north-south, 296 m east-west and 69 m at its highest point, with steel trusses woven around a bowl-shaped seating tier to create the nest image; it is classified as a special-grade sports building with a 100-year design life. Inside are a standard athletics track and football pitch, three seating tiers with boxes between the middle and upper levels, and seven above-podium floors housing spectator services, media areas, VIP reception and retail; three basement levels contain an internal ring road, parking and plant rooms. The design brief stressed sustainable construction, natural ventilation, daylight and intelligent building systems. Since the Games it has hosted international football and athletics, concerts and winter events, and remains the anchor landmark at the north end of Beijing's central axis. Metro Lines 8 and 15 serve Olympic Green and Olympic Sports Center stations within walking distance, with bus routes and car parks nearby. Translucent membrane panels in the roof filter daylight onto the pitch, and since the Games the venue has added ice-and-snow, performance and tourism programmes to keep it busy year-round.

address: 北京市朝阳区工人体育场北路（地铁3号线、17号线工人体育场站）
intro_zh: 北京工人体育场位于北京市朝阳区工人体育场北路，地处东二环与东三环之间，紧邻三里屯、新老使馆区和工人体育馆，是1959年国庆十周年“十大建筑”之一，也是北京国安足球俱乐部的长期主场。2020年至2023年，场馆按“传统外观、现代场馆”原则进行保护性改造复建，由综合性体育场转为国际标准专业足球场。主体建筑总建筑面积38万平方米，其中地上约10.1万平方米、地下约27.8万平方米，场内设四层碗形看台、6.8万个座席，另配套总占地13万平方米的城市体育公园与湖区。改造取消田径跑道，观众席贴近草坪；罩棚整合排水、融雪、遮阳与光伏发电功能，草坪采用锚固草技术并铺设地暖，可在冬季保持比赛状态；地下空间布置商业、餐饮、停车与设备用房，形成比赛、演出、休闲一体的城市综合体。交通方面，地铁3号线与17号线在工人体育场站换乘，2号线东四十条站及多条公交线路亦可到达。改造保留了原有椭圆形轮廓与看台碗的基本尺度，首层界面向城市公园打开，使老工体的城市记忆得以延续。
intro_en: Beijing Workers' Stadium occupies Workers' Stadium North Road in Chaoyang District, between the East Second and Third Ring Roads and next to Sanlitun, the old and new embassy quarters and the Workers' Gymnasium. Completed in 1959 as one of the capital's Ten Great Buildings for the tenth anniversary of the People's Republic, it long served as a multi-purpose arena and the home of Beijing Guoan. Between 2020 and 2023 it was rebuilt under a 'traditional look, modern venue' brief and reopened as an international-standard football-specific stadium, keeping the rhythm of its original facade and colonnade. The main building has 380,000 sqm of gross floor area, about 101,000 sqm above ground and 278,000 sqm below, with a four-tier bowl of 68,000 seats and a 130,000 sqm public sports park and lake alongside. The running track was removed so that seats sit close to the pitch; the roof integrates drainage, snow melting, shading and photovoltaic generation, while the pitch uses anchored hybrid grass with undersoil heating to stay playable through winter. Underground space carries retail, food and beverage, parking and plant, turning the venue into a mixed-use city complex for matches, concerts and daily leisure. Metro Lines 3 and 17 interchange at Workers' Stadium station, with Line 2 at Dongsi Shitiao and numerous bus routes also within reach. The rebuilt stadium keeps the original elliptical outline and the scale of the old bowl, while the ground-floor edge opens onto the surrounding park so that the memory of the old Gongti remains legible.

address: 北京市朝阳区天辰东路9号
intro_zh: 国家体育馆位于北京市朝阳区天辰东路9号，处在奥林匹克公园中心区南部，与国家体育场“鸟巢”、国家游泳中心“水立方”相邻，是2008年北京奥运会三大主场馆之一，并在2022年北京冬奥会承担冰球比赛。场馆占地6.78公顷，2008年建成时总建筑面积约8.09万平方米，经冬奥改造并在北侧扩建训练馆后约9.78万平方米，固定座位1.8万个。主馆比赛场地约3000平方米，场芯71米×41米，建筑高度42.35米，屋顶设202个吊点、总荷载3000千牛，可在冰球、花样滑冰、短道速滑与篮球、体操、演唱会、节目录制之间转换；看台分四层，每层约4500座，配包厢、赞助商展示区、餐饮区与文化走廊。建筑以“折扇”为意象，屋面呈波浪形起伏，改造后以“冰之帆”形象成为奥林匹克公园夜景的组成部分。交通方面，地铁8号线奥林匹克公园站、奥体中心站步行可达，15号线奥林匹克公园站亦可换乘，周边公交线路密集，场馆地下设停车场。场馆由比赛馆与北侧训练馆组成，训练馆同样以“中国折扇”为造型，与原馆屋面无缝衔接。
intro_en: The National Indoor Stadium at 9 Tianchen East Road, Chaoyang District, sits in the southern part of the Olympic Green next to the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube. It was one of the three main venues of the 2008 Beijing Olympics, hosting gymnastics, trampoline and handball, and was converted for ice hockey at the 2022 Winter Olympics. The site covers 6.78 hectares; the building opened with about 80,900 sqm of floor area and, after the Winter Games renovation and a northern training-hall extension, now totals roughly 97,836 sqm with 18,000 fixed seats plus about 240 in the training rink. The main field is approximately 3,000 sqm with a 71 m by 41 m ice slab, a height of 42.35 m and 202 roof rigging points rated for 3,000 kN in total, allowing conversion between ice hockey, figure skating, short-track speed skating, basketball, gymnastics, concerts and television production. Four seating levels of about 4,500 seats each include boxes, sponsor displays, dining and a cultural corridor. The architecture takes the Chinese folding fan as its motif, with a wave-like roof that has earned the nickname 'Ice Sail' and makes the hall a distinctive part of the Olympic Green skyline at night. Metro Line 8 serves Olympic Sports Center and Olympic Green stations, Line 15 also stops at Olympic Green, and the venue has underground parking. A new training hall to the north, also shaped like a Chinese folding fan, was added for the Winter Games and connects seamlessly to the original roof.

address: 北京市海淀区中关村南大街56号（白石桥东北角）
area_text: 占地54,600㎡；本馆建筑面积54,707㎡；首体园区总建筑面积约20万㎡
intro_zh: 首都体育馆位于北京市海淀区中关村南大街56号，坐落在白石桥东北角、长河与南长河之间，与紫竹院公园、国家图书馆相距不远。上世纪60年代，北京的大型体育馆集中在城东南的体育馆路和东郊工体一带，为平衡布局，周恩来总理亲自拍板把这座新馆定在西郊白石桥，1966年6月动工，1968年10月竣工，是新中国成立后北京西郊第一座万人级室内体育馆，也是2008年夏季奥运会与2022年冬季奥运会的“双奥场馆”。  馆内以比赛大厅为核心，比赛大厅平面为99米×112.2米，净高20.3至20.8米，场地最大尺寸40米×88米，可在冰面与地板之间转换，能够承接短道速滑、花样滑冰、冰球，也能举办体操、篮排球、乒乓球比赛和大型演出。2008年这里承办奥运会排球比赛，2022年冬奥会承办短道速滑和花样滑冰，共产生多枚金牌。场馆占地54,600平方米，本馆建筑面积54,707平方米；经过冬奥改造，首体园区总建筑面积约20万平方米，由南园的竞赛馆、综合训练馆、运动员公寓、冬奥赛事中心与北园的滑冰馆、综合训练馆组成，共有六座建筑、五块冰面，设1.5万个坐席和80个无障碍坐席。  建筑上，首体保持了1960年代“平板型双向空间钢网架”屋盖的简洁轮廓，东西长122米、南北宽107米，2018年起的改造秉持“修旧如旧”，外立面石材的颜色与样式与原馆保持一致；2007年它被列入《北京优秀近现代建筑保护名录（第一批）》。2022年7月16日，修整后的首体重新对公众开放，冰场可通过“中国冰雪”公众号预约，馆群与首体体育公园也向市民免费开放。交通方面，场馆紧邻中关村南大街与西直门外大街，地铁4号线国家图书馆站、9号线白石桥南站步行可达。
intro_en: Capital Indoor Stadium stands at 56 Zhongguancun South Street in Haidian District, at the north-east corner of Baishiqiao in western Beijing, a short walk from the National Library and the Zizhuyuan park. Built between 1966 and 1968, it was the first 10,000-seat indoor arena in the western half of the capital: in the 1960s Beijing's big halls were clustered at Tiyuguan Road in the south-east and at the Workers' Stadium in the east, and Zhou Enlai personally chose the Baishiqiao site to balance the city's sports geography. The arena has since become one of the very few venues to host both a Summer and a Winter Olympics, serving volleyball in 2008 and short-track speed skating and figure skating in 2022.  The competition hall measures 99 by 112.2 metres in plan, with a clear height of 20.3 to 20.8 metres and a maximum floor of 40 by 88 metres. The floor can be converted between ice and timber, so the hall stages short-track, figure skating and ice hockey as well as gymnastics, basketball, volleyball, table tennis and concerts. The site covers 54,600 square metres and the original building has 54,707 square metres of floor area. After the Winter Games upgrade the wider Capital Indoor Stadium park reached roughly 200,000 square metres, organised into a southern cluster with the competition hall, a training hall, athletes' accommodation and an Olympic events centre, and a northern cluster with a skating hall and a multi-purpose training hall: six buildings and five ice sheets in total, with 15,000 seats including 80 accessible places.  Architecturally the building keeps its 1960s flat double-curved steel space-frame roof, 122 metres east to west and 107 metres north to south. The 2018 refit followed a principle of repairing the old as it was, matching the colour and cut of the exterior stone to the original fabric, and the hall was listed in the first batch of Beijing's outstanding modern buildings in 2007. It reopened to the public on 16 July 2022, with public skating bookable through the China Ice and Snow mini-programme. The site sits on Zhongguancun South Street near Xizhimenwai Avenue, within walking distance of National Library station on metro line 4 and Baishiqiao South station on line 9.

address: 北京市朝阳区速滑馆南路甲1号院（奥林匹克森林公园西侧，近林萃路）
area_text: 占地约17公顷；建筑面积96,980㎡；冰面约1.2万㎡
intro_zh: 国家速滑馆又叫“冰丝带”，位于北京市朝阳区奥林匹克森林公园西侧、速滑馆南路甲1号院，南邻国家网球中心，西临林萃路，东临奥林西路，与“鸟巢”“水立方”共同构成北京这座世界首个“双奥之城”的标志性建筑群。它的原址是2008年奥运会的临时曲棍球场和射箭场，2017年拆除后新建，是北京2022年冬奥会北京赛区唯一新建的冰上竞赛场馆，也是速度滑冰项目的比赛场地。  馆内核心是一条标准400米速度滑冰赛道，采用全冰面设计，冰面面积约1.2万平方米，接近一个田径场大小，是亚洲最大的全冰面室内冰场，可通过分区划线同时满足速滑、短道、花滑、冰球、冰壶和大众上冰的需要。场馆占地约17公顷，建筑面积96,980平方米，东西约180米、南北约240米，地上三层、地下两层，建筑高度33.8米，设12,000个座席。2022年冬奥会期间这里产生了14枚金牌。  建筑是“冰丝带”名字的来源：外立面由3,360块曲面和平板玻璃组成高工艺曲面幕墙，22条灯带环绕建筑盘旋而上，象征冰上运动的速度与轨迹；屋盖采用国产高钒封闭索的单层索网结构，是世界跨度最大的索网体育馆屋面。制冰使用二氧化碳跨临界直冷系统，是首个采用该技术的冬奥会速滑场馆，制冷量最大可达4兆瓦，并带热回收，可满足生活热水、除湿和浇冰需求。赛后场馆于2022年7月9日对公众开放，既办国际滑联世界杯、花滑演出，也承接演唱会、发布会和大型企业活动。交通上，地铁8号线林萃桥站步行可达，周边为奥林匹克森林公园与北五环路。
intro_en: The National Speed Skating Oval, known as the Ice Ribbon, occupies a site on Suchangguan South Road in Chaoyang District, on the western edge of the Olympic Forest Park. It faces the National Tennis Centre to the south, with Lincui Road to the west and Aolin West Road to the east, and forms part of the landmark cluster, with the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube, that makes Beijing the first city to have hosted both a Summer and a Winter Olympics. The oval stands on the site of the temporary hockey and archery venues of 2008, demolished in 2017; it is the only new competition venue built for the Beijing 2022 Winter Games in the city zone and hosted the long-track speed skating events.  At its heart is a standard 400-metre speed skating track laid on a single continuous ice sheet of about 12,000 square metres, roughly the size of an athletics infield and the largest full-ice indoor rink in Asia. Lane markings can be reconfigured so the same sheet serves long-track and short-track racing, figure skating, ice hockey, curling and public skating. The site covers about 17 hectares and the building has 96,980 square metres of floor area, measuring some 180 metres east to west and 240 metres north to south, three storeys above ground and two below, with a height of 33.8 metres and 12,000 seats. Fourteen gold medals were decided here during the 2022 Games.  The architecture gives the venue its name: a high-precision curved facade of 3,360 curved and flat glass panels, wrapped by 22 ribbon-like light bands that spiral up the building as a metaphor for speed on ice. The roof is a single-layer cable-net structure using domestically produced high-vanadium closed cables, the largest cable-net roof of any arena in the world. Ice making relies on a transcritical CO2 direct-cooling system, the first Winter Olympic speed skating venue to use the technology, with up to four megawatts of cooling capacity and heat recovery for hot water, dehumidification and ice resurfacing. The oval opened to the public on 9 July 2022 and now hosts ISU World Cup events, figure skating shows, concerts, product launches and corporate events. Lincuiqiao station on metro line 8 is within walking distance, and the site sits between the Olympic Forest Park and the North Fifth Ring Road.

address: 北京市朝阳区林萃路2号（奥林匹克森林公园西门附近）
area_text: 占地16.68公顷；2008年赛时建筑面积26,514㎡；园区共30片场地
capacity_text: 17,400（园区总坐席；中心赛场/莲花球场约10,000）
intro_zh: 北京网球中心即国家网球中心，位于北京市朝阳区林萃路2号、奥林匹克森林公园西门附近，北临北五环路，东临奥林西路，西临林萃路，是2008年北京奥运会网球与轮椅网球比赛场地，也是中国网球公开赛的举办地。它把北京的专业网球赛事从城南的光彩网球中心带到奥林匹克公园，使这一片区在鸟巢、水立方之外又多了一处可常年运营的球类园区，是北京北部“奥园体育带”的组成部分。  园区占地16.68公顷，拥有30片国际标准比赛场地，包括17片室外场、12片室内场（其中有2片符合国际赛事标准的红土场）以及1座屋顶可开启的钻石球场，另配套气膜室内馆、莲花球场、映月球场和综合配套服务楼。2008年赛时建筑面积26,514平方米，共设坐席17,400个，其中莲花球场（中心赛场）可容纳观众约1万人，奥运会网球和轮椅网球比赛在此举行；2023年4月红土场启用，2025年完成南广场通道、5片训练场和红土主题花园观赛区的升级，园区比赛区域可容纳观众近3万人。  建筑与场地以“专业赛事+日常开放”为特色：室外场采用国际赛事认证的丙烯酸硬地系统，室内馆以气膜结构实现大跨度无柱空间，冬季和雨天也能训练比赛；钻石球场则以可开合屋盖承担中网夜场和决赛。平时园区每天9时至22时向公众开放，提供场地预订、培训和青少年赛事。交通上，地铁8号线林萃桥站出站步行约400米即到园区东侧，自驾可经北五环奥林西桥进入，园区周边为奥林匹克森林公园绿地。
intro_en: Beijing Tennis Centre, better known as the National Tennis Centre, occupies 2 Lincui Road in Chaoyang District, near the west gate of the Olympic Forest Park, with the North Fifth Ring Road to the north, Aolin West Road to the east and Lincui Road to the west. Built as the tennis and wheelchair tennis venue for the 2008 Olympic Games, it later became the home of the China Open, moving the capital's flagship tennis event from Guangcai in the south to the Olympic Green and adding a year-round racket-sports cluster to a district already anchored by the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube.  The 16.68-hectare site holds 30 international-standard courts: 17 outdoor, 12 indoor, including two clay courts built to tournament specification, plus the retractable-roof Diamond Court. Support buildings include the air-dome indoor hall, Lotus Court, Yingyue Court and a service complex. At the 2008 Games the built area was 26,514 square metres with 17,400 seats across the site, of which Lotus Court, the then centre court, held about 10,000 spectators for the Olympic tennis and wheelchair tennis events. The clay courts opened in April 2023; a 2025 upgrade added a south-plaza link, five international-standard training courts and a clay-themed garden viewing area, lifting the competition zone's capacity to nearly 30,000.  The venue is run on a dual track of tournament-grade sport and daily public use. Outdoor courts use tournament-certified acrylic hard-court systems, the indoor halls use air-supported membranes to create long-span column-free space for winter and wet-weather play, and Diamond Court's opening roof carries the China Open night sessions and finals. The park is normally open to the public from 9am to 10pm with court booking, coaching and junior events. Lincuiqiao station on metro line 8 is about 400 metres from the eastern edge of the site, and drivers reach it from the Aolin West Bridge of the North Fifth Ring Road, surrounded by the green of the Olympic Forest Park.

address: 北京市朝阳区安定路1号（国家奥林匹克体育中心内）
area_text: 建筑面积44,635㎡；设比赛池、跳水池、热身池、放松池四池
capacity_text: 4,852（2008年改造后固定坐席；赛时口径6,000）
intro_zh: 英东游泳馆位于北京市朝阳区安定路1号的国家奥林匹克体育中心院内北侧，与奥体中心体育场、体育馆同处北四环中路南侧这一片场馆群。1986年，香港企业家霍英东在北京成功申办1990年第十一届亚运会后捐资1亿港元兴建此馆，1987年6月开工、1989年12月竣工，是当时亚洲规模最大的游泳馆，也把“亚运村—奥体中心”这一带推成了北京北部的体育新城。  馆内设四个泳池：一个25米×50米、深1.4至4.5米的标准比赛池，一个25米×25米的标准跳水池，一个11.5米×50米的热身池，以及放松用池，另配7.5米跳台与8条泳道。2006年4月至2007年8月为北京奥运会改扩建后，总建筑面积达44,635平方米，固定坐席4,852个（赛时口径常写作6,000座）。这里先后承办1990年亚运会游泳比赛、2001年世界大学生运动会游泳比赛，以及2008年奥运会水球预赛和现代五项游泳比赛，2008年残奥会期间作为游泳训练场馆。  建筑上，馆体以大面积玻璃幕墙和简洁的白色体量面向奥体中心人工湖，改造后强调“绿色奥运、科技奥运”的节能与水质系统，池水采用臭氧消毒配合氯制剂辅助的方式。赛后它转为“游泳康体中心”模式运营，向公众开放游泳、培训和水球活动，单次票价约50元，另有月卡与次卡。交通上，地铁8号线奥体中心站出站即达奥体中心东门，院内步行可至；周边安定路、北四环中路公交线路密集，与国家体育场“鸟巢”隔北四环相望。
intro_en: Yingdong Natatorium sits in the northern part of the National Olympic Sports Centre at 1 Anding Road, Chaoyang District, sharing the campus south of the North Fourth Ring Road with the centre's stadium and indoor arena. It was financed by a HK$100 million donation from the Hong Kong businessman Henry Fok after Beijing won the bid for the 1990 Asian Games, built between June 1987 and December 1989, and was the largest swimming hall in Asia at the time; together with the Asian Games village it helped turn this stretch of northern Beijing into a new sports district.  The hall contains four pools: a 25 by 50 metre competition pool with a depth of 1.4 to 4.5 metres, a 25 by 25 metre diving pool, an 11.5 by 50 metre warm-up pool and a relaxation pool, along with a 7.5 metre diving platform and eight racing lanes. After the rebuild for the Beijing Olympics between April 2006 and August 2007 the building reached 44,635 square metres with 4,852 fixed seats, often quoted as 6,000 in Games-time figures. It hosted swimming at the 1990 Asian Games and the 2001 Universiade, then water polo preliminaries and the swimming leg of the modern pentathlon at the 2008 Olympics, and served as a swimming training venue during the 2008 Paralympics.  Architecturally the natatorium presents a large glazed curtain wall and a clean white volume towards the artificial lake at the centre of the Olympic complex; the 2007 refit emphasised green and technological standards, with ozone disinfection supported by chlorine for the pool water. After the Games it shifted to a public natatorium model, offering lap swimming, coaching and water polo, with a single visit of about 50 yuan and monthly and ten-visit cards. Olympic Sports Centre station on metro line 8 opens onto the east gate of the campus, and the building faces the Bird's Nest across the North Fourth Ring Road, with dense bus routes along Anding Road.

address: 北京市丰台区西四环南路55号
area_text: 占地约22万㎡；垒球场建筑面积15,570㎡
capacity_text: 体育场31,043（另有体育馆、游泳馆等）
intro_zh: 北京丰台体育中心位于北京市丰台区西四环南路55号，处在北京城西南、丰台镇北部，东临西四环，南接丰北路城市快速路，北至京石高速，距北京西站约5公里。它是为举办1990年第十一届亚运会而兴建的一组现代体育建筑群，也是丰台区唯一成规模的大型综合体育场馆，承担着北京西南部竞技训练与全民健身的双重功能。  园区占地约22万平方米，主体建筑包括体育场、体育馆、游泳馆、网球场，以及棒球场和垒球场、篮球场等。体育场可容纳观众31,043人，场地为105米×68米，曾是北京国安和北京人和的中超主场；垒球场总建筑面积15,570平方米，含两片比赛场地、两片热身场地和功能用房，2008年北京奥运会垒球比赛在此举行。这里还办过第十一届亚运会足球、藤球、棒垒球比赛，第21届世界大学生运动会排球比赛，第七届全运会足球、柔道、摔跤比赛以及中国棒球联赛等。  场馆群以“一场多馆、集中布局”为特点，看台与训练场地围绕中心草坪展开，观众动线与运动员流线分离；游泳馆设两个25米×50米、8泳道的泳池，浅水区1.1至1.2米、深水区1.8至2.2米，是丰台居民常用的温水泳池。近年来园区持续做适老化与全民健身改造，室外篮球、网球和健身步道分时免费或低收费开放。交通上，自驾经西四环南路、丰北路均可直达，园区设停车位；公交有丰台体育中心站多条线路停靠，地铁可乘14号线至西局站换乘公交前往。
intro_en: Fengtai Sports Centre occupies 55 Xisihuan South Road in Fengtai District, in the south-western part of Beijing at the northern edge of Fengtai town. It is bounded by the West Fourth Ring Road to the east, the Fengbei Road expressway to the south and the Jingshi expressway to the north, about five kilometres from Beijing West railway station. The complex was built for the 11th Asian Games in 1990 and remains the district's only large-scale public sports complex, carrying both elite training and mass fitness functions for south-west Beijing.  The 220,000 square metre site contains a stadium, an indoor arena, a natatorium, tennis courts, baseball and softball fields and outdoor basketball courts. The stadium holds 31,043 spectators on a 105 by 68 metre pitch and has served as the Chinese Super League home ground of Beijing Guoan and Beijing Renhe. The softball venue, with 15,570 square metres of floor area, two competition diamonds, two warm-up diamonds and a support building, hosted the softball tournament of the 2008 Olympic Games. The centre has also staged football, sepak takraw and baseball at the 1990 Asian Games, volleyball at the 21st Universiade, and football, judo and wrestling at the Seventh National Games, as well as China Baseball League fixtures.  The layout is a compact campus of one stadium and several halls, with stands and training areas wrapped around the central pitch and separate circulation for spectators and athletes. The natatorium has two 25 by 50 metre, eight-lane pools, with 1.1 to 1.2 metres of water in the shallow end and 1.8 to 2.2 metres in the deep end, and is a popular heated pool for local residents. Recent work has focused on accessibility and mass fitness, with outdoor basketball and tennis courts and a jogging trail opened free or at low cost in set time slots. Drivers reach the site from Xisihuan South Road or Fengbei Road, where parking is available, and several bus routes stop at the Fengtai Sports Centre stop; metro line 14 to Xiju station connects with those buses.

address: 北京市东城区体育馆路甲2号
area_text: 占地16公顷；建筑面积近3.3万㎡
intro_zh: 北京体育馆位于北京市东城区体育馆路甲2号，隶属国家体育总局训练局，是新中国成立后建成的第一座大型综合性体育馆。1954年动工、1955年10月21日落成，由苏联专家参与主要设计，建成初期含比赛馆、游泳馆、练习馆三大主馆；此后到2000年又陆续建成田径场、田径馆、足球场、乒乓球馆、网球馆、体操馆、跳水馆、举重馆、羽毛球馆、排球馆、水球馆和综合训练馆等十余个专业训练场馆。体育馆路这条街道，正是因它而得名。  场馆占地16公顷，建筑面积近3.3万平方米。主馆比赛馆位于正中，拱形钢屋架跨度56米，场内高度25米，比赛场地宽22.4米、长36.4米，四周20排固定看台共6,000个观众席，可进行篮球、排球、乒乓球、体操等比赛；西侧游泳馆池长50米、宽20米、深1.4至4.5米，8条泳道并设7.5米跳台，观众席2,000个；东侧练习馆铺双层硬木地板，可摆3个篮球场，2003年后成为国家体操队训练馆，占地4,334平方米。主馆西南的田径场可容纳5,000名观众。  它的特色在于“训练基地”属性：截至2010年代初，男篮、女篮、男排、女排、乒乓、羽毛、举重、跳水、体操、游泳、田径、花样游泳、蹦床等14支国家队在此训练；主馆南楼的国家体育总局训练局荣誉馆2006年12月开馆，面积1,900平方米，是体育界首个全国爱国主义教育示范基地。建筑立面为1950年代苏式风格，比例端庄、装饰克制，2009年国家体育总局训练局健身中心在此成立，向周边居民开放。交通上，场馆距天坛东侧路不远，地铁5号线天坛东门站步行约十分钟可达，公交体育馆路、天坛东路一线线路密集。
intro_en: Beijing Gymnasium stands at Jia 2 Tiyuguan Road in Dongcheng District and belongs to the General Administration's Training Bureau. Completed on 21 October 1955 after construction began in 1954, with Soviet specialists among the principal designers, it was the first large multi-purpose indoor sports hall built in the People's Republic; the street it fronts, Tiyuguan Road, is named after it. The original complex had three main halls, for competition, swimming and practice, and by 2000 more than a dozen specialist training halls had been added, including facilities for athletics, football, table tennis, tennis, gymnastics, diving, weightlifting, badminton, volleyball and water polo.  The site covers 16 hectares with nearly 33,000 square metres of floor area. The central competition hall has a 56-metre arched steel roof truss and a 25-metre internal height, with a floor 22.4 metres wide and 36.4 metres long, ringed by 20 rows of fixed seating for 6,000 spectators and suited to basketball, volleyball, table tennis and gymnastics. The swimming hall to the west has a 50 by 20 metre pool, 1.4 to 4.5 metres deep, eight lanes, a 7.5-metre diving platform and 2,000 seats. The practice hall to the east, with double-layer hardwood flooring for three basketball courts and 4,334 square metres of space, has housed the national gymnastics team since 2003, and the athletics ground to the south-west seats 5,000.  What defines the venue is its role as a training base: by the early 2010s fourteen national squads trained here, covering men's and women's basketball and volleyball, table tennis, badminton, weightlifting, diving, gymnastics, swimming, athletics, synchronised swimming and trampoline. The Training Bureau's Hall of Honour opened in the south building in December 2006; at 1,900 square metres it was the sports world's first national patriotic education base. The facades are 1950s Soviet in manner, restrained in ornament and balanced in proportion, and in 2009 the bureau's fitness centre opened here for local residents. The site is a short walk from Tiyuguan Road and Tiantan East Road, about ten minutes on foot from Tiantandongmen station on metro line 5, with frequent buses along both streets.

address: 北京市东城区工人体育场北路（工人体育场园区内）
area_text: 建筑面积40,200㎡；圆形轮辐式悬索屋盖跨度约94米
intro_zh: 北京工人体育馆位于北京市东城区工人体育场北路，坐落在由北京工人体育场、工人体育馆和游泳场组成的工体园区内，占地约40万平方米的园区位于东二环与东三环之间，周边使馆区、三里屯商业区环绕，是北京最有代表性的“城市文体客厅”之一。工人体育馆1961年建成，是为举办第26届世界乒乓球锦标赛而兴建，与1959年落成的工人体育场同属新中国成立十周年北京“十大建筑”序列，也是北京最早的一批大型室内体育馆。  馆内以一个圆形比赛大厅为主体，场地可布置乒乓球、篮球、排球、体操、拳击等比赛，也可转换为演唱会舞台。建筑面积40,200平方米，设固定座位12,000个、临时座位1,000个；2008年北京奥运会期间这里是拳击比赛场馆，残奥会期间承办盲人柔道。馆内另有贵宾室、运动员休息室、新闻发布厅和训练房，赛时与演出时可分区使用。  建筑上最著名的是其屋盖：直径约94米的圆形轮辐式悬索结构，钢索从中心环梁向周边外环辐射张拉，是中国大跨度悬索结构的早期经典案例，室内因此没有一根立柱，视线通透；外立面为规整的竖向线条与实体墙板，呈现1960年代“民族形式+现代结构”的折衷风格。由于地处市中心，工人体育馆长期是演唱会、发布会、体育赛事和电竞活动的热门场地，与改造后的新工体专业足球场形成“一场一馆”的组合。交通上，地铁2号线东四十条站步行约15分钟，10号线团结湖站亦在步行范围内，园区周边工人体育场北路、工体西路公交线路密集。
intro_en: The Workers' Indoor Arena stands on Gongrentiyuchang North Road in Dongcheng District, inside the Workers' Stadium campus that also contains the football stadium and a swimming complex. The 400,000 square metre campus lies between the East Second and East Third Ring Roads, ringed by the diplomatic quarter and the Sanlitun shopping district, and is one of Beijing's most recognisable urban culture and sports addresses. The arena was completed in 1961 for the 26th World Table Tennis Championships, alongside the 1959 Workers' Stadium, and belongs to the group of capital projects marking the tenth anniversary of the People's Republic; it is among the city's earliest large indoor halls.  A circular competition hall forms the core, configurable for table tennis, basketball, volleyball, gymnastics and boxing, or convertible into a concert stage. The building has 40,200 square metres of floor area with 12,000 fixed seats and 1,000 temporary places. During the 2008 Olympics it hosted boxing, and during the Paralympics, judo for blind athletes. Supporting space includes VIP rooms, athletes' changing rooms, a press conference room and training rooms, which allow the hall to be split between competition and performance use.  Its most celebrated feature is the roof: a circular radial cable structure about 94 metres across, with cables tensioned from a central ring beam to an outer compression ring, an early classic of long-span cable roofing in China that leaves the hall entirely column-free with unobstructed sightlines. The facade uses regular vertical fins and solid panels, an eclectic 1960s mix of national form and modern structure. Because of its central location the arena has long been a favourite for concerts, launches, sports events and esports, pairing with the rebuilt Workers' Stadium next door as a stadium-and-arena combination. Dongsi Shitiao station on metro line 2 is about fifteen minutes on foot, Tuanjiehu station on line 10 is also within walking distance, and buses run frequently along Gongrentiyuchang North Road and Gongti West Road.

address: 北京市朝阳区天辰东路9号（国家体育馆内）
area_text: 副馆场地3,000㎡（50m×60m），场内净高25m（至马道20m）
intro_zh: 国家体育馆副馆位于北京市朝阳区天辰东路9号国家体育馆内，处在奥林匹克公园中心区南部、鸟巢与水立方之间的场馆带东侧，与国家体育场、国家游泳中心共同构成奥林匹克公园“三大主场馆”建筑群。国家体育馆主馆2007年11月建成，2008年奥运会承办体操、蹦床、手球和轮椅篮球，2018年至2020年改造后成为“双奥场馆”，2022年冬奥会承办男子冰球和残奥冰球；副馆则是主馆之外独立运营的辅助大厅，承担训练、排练和小型活动。  副馆场地面积3,000平方米，平面尺寸50米×60米，场内净高25米、地面至马道20米，设1,800个座位，配套VIP室、包厢、功能房和停车场。这样的尺度足以容纳标准篮球场、排球场、羽毛球场组合，也可搭建舞台与展台；官方口径明确其赛后用途是“与主馆大型活动形成有效联动”，可承接文化活动、小型体育赛事、节目录制及各类商务活动。主馆改造后总建筑面积约97,836平方米，座位约18,000席（含训练馆240席），副馆与之共用前厅、安检和卸货资源。  建筑上，主馆以“折扇”式金属屋面与玻璃幕墙相间为特征，副馆延续相同的银灰色金属与玻璃语汇，体量低伏于主馆一侧，屋面为双坡曲面，室内为无柱大空间。运营上，国家体育馆由北京演艺集团所属公司运营，除冰球、花滑、短道训练外，也承接演唱会、电竞赛事和品牌发布。交通上，地铁8号线奥林匹克公园站出站步行可达天辰东路，15号线奥林匹克公园站亦在同一枢纽；周边北辰东路、北四环中路公交线路密集，园区内部有统一停车与安检入口。
intro_en: The Auxiliary Hall of the National Indoor Stadium sits within the National Indoor Stadium at 9 Tianchen East Road, Chaoyang District, in the southern part of the Olympic Green between the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube, part of the trio of principal venues that define the park. The main arena was completed in November 2007 and hosted gymnastics, trampoline, handball and wheelchair basketball at the 2008 Games; after a refit between 2018 and 2020 it became a dual-Olympic venue, staging men's ice hockey and para ice hockey in 2022. The auxiliary hall is a separately operated secondary space used for training, rehearsal and smaller events.  The hall offers 3,000 square metres of floor on a 50 by 60 metre plan, with 25 metres of clear height and 20 metres to the catwalk, seating for 1,800 and supporting VIP rooms, boxes, function rooms and parking. That scale accommodates combinations of basketball, volleyball and badminton courts, or a stage and exhibition build. The operator states explicitly that post-Games the hall is meant to work alongside major events in the main arena, taking cultural programmes, small sports competitions, television recordings and business functions. The refurbished main building has about 97,836 square metres of floor area and roughly 18,000 seats including 240 in the training hall, and the auxiliary hall shares its foyers, security screening and loading facilities.  Architecturally the main arena is known for its alternating folded-fan metal roof and glass curtain wall; the auxiliary hall continues the same silver-grey metal and glass language, sitting low beside the parent building with a shallow double-pitched curved roof over a column-free interior. The stadium is operated by a company under the Beijing Performing Arts Group and, besides ice hockey, figure skating and short-track training, hosts concerts, esports and brand launches. Aolinpike Gongyuan station on metro line 8 opens within walking distance of Tianchen East Road, line 15 serves the same interchange, buses run along Beichendong Road and the North Fourth Ring Road, and the campus has centralised parking and security entry.

name_zh: 国家奥林匹克体育中心
address: 北京市朝阳区北四环中路南侧（安定路1号）
area_text: 占地66公顷；2008年改造后总建筑面积约22万㎡
intro_zh: 国家奥林匹克体育中心简称奥体中心，位于北京市朝阳区北四环中路南侧、安定路1号，与奥林匹克公园、奥林匹克森林公园及奥运村相邻，隔北四环路与鸟巢相望。它始建于1986年，是为承办1990年第十一届亚运会而兴建的大型专业性场馆群，由建筑学家马国馨主持设计，1990年建成投用，现为国家体育总局直属训练基地，也是北京“双奥”布局里承训功能最集中的一片园区。  园区占地66公顷，主要设施包括体育场、体育馆、英东游泳馆、曲棍球场与网球场、综合训练馆、足球田径垒球训练场、运动员公寓和反兴奋剂检测中心。体育场位于中南部，2008年前扩建后建筑面积3.7万余平方米，观众席36,228个；体育馆在园区北侧，建筑面积32,400余平方米，场地40米×70米，可容纳观众6,300余人；英东游泳馆总建筑面积44,635平方米，观众约6,000人；曲棍球场有3片101.4米×63米人造草灯光场，南侧另有12片硬地网球灯光训练场。2006年启动的奥运改造投入约13亿元，改造后园区建筑总面积增至22万平方米。  奥体中心的特色是“训练+赛事+全民健身”三线并行：这里办过亚运会、七运会、远南残运会、世界大学生运动会和2008年奥运会，也长期承担国家队驻训；同时园区向市民开放游泳、网球、曲棍球、田径等场地，形成北四环沿线少见的成片体育公园。建筑以1990年代体育建筑的朴实体量与2008年改造后的金属屋面、玻璃幕墙为主调，体育场东西看台对称展开，游泳馆临湖而建。交通上，地铁8号线奥体中心站直达园区，奥林匹克公园站亦在步行范围；北四环中路、安定路公交线路密集，园区设多处停车场。
intro_en: The National Olympic Sports Centre, known as Aoti, lies south of the North Fourth Ring Road at 1 Anding Road in Chaoyang District, next to the Olympic Green, the Olympic Forest Park and the athletes' village, facing the Bird's Nest across the ring road. It was begun in 1986 as a specialised venue cluster for the 11th Asian Games, designed under the architect Ma Guoxin, completed and opened in 1990, and now serves as a training base directly under the General Administration of Sport; it is the most training-intensive campus in Beijing's dual-Olympic map.  The 66-hectare site contains a stadium, an indoor arena, the Yingdong Natatorium, hockey and tennis grounds, a multi-purpose training hall, football, athletics and softball training fields, athletes' accommodation and the anti-doping laboratory. The stadium in the south-central area was enlarged before 2008 to more than 37,000 square metres with 36,228 seats. The arena to the north has over 32,400 square metres, a 40 by 70 metre floor and about 6,300 seats. The natatorium totals 44,635 square metres for some 6,000 spectators, while the hockey ground offers three floodlit 101.4 by 63 metre artificial-turf pitches and twelve floodlit hard tennis courts lie to its south. The Olympic refit launched in 2006 cost about 1.3 billion yuan and lifted total floor area to 220,000 square metres.  What distinguishes Aoti is the parallel running of training, competition and mass fitness. It has staged the Asian Games, the Seventh National Games, the Far East and South Pacific Games for the Disabled, the Universiade and the 2008 Olympics, and it hosts national squads year round, while opening swimming, tennis, hockey and athletics facilities to the public as one of the few large sports parks along the North Fourth Ring Road. The architecture is a plain 1990s sports modernism, refreshed after 2008 with metal roofs and glass curtain walls; the stadium's east and west stands face each other symmetrically and the natatorium sits by the lake. Aoti station on metro line 8 opens directly into the campus, Olympic Green station is also within walking distance, and buses run densely along the North Fourth Ring Road and Anding Road, with several car parks on site.

address: 北京市朝阳区天辰东路11号（奥林匹克公园内）
area_text: 建筑面积79,532㎡；膜结构幕墙约10万㎡；建筑高度31m
intro_zh: 国家游泳中心俗称“水立方”，位于北京市朝阳区天辰东路11号、奥林匹克公园内，北四环北辰西桥以东、“鸟巢”西侧，与国家体育场一街之隔，是2008年北京奥运会的标志性建筑之一。它与鸟巢共同构成奥林匹克公园中心区的中轴线双地标，2022年冬奥会期间又转换为“冰立方”承办冰壶比赛，成为少数完成“水冰转换”的双奥场馆。  馆内以奥林匹克比赛大厅为核心，设标准50米比赛池、跳水池和热身池，赛时可容纳17,000名观众，赛后保留6,000个固定座席；建筑面积79,532平方米，建筑高度31米，地上四层、地下两层。除比赛大厅外，还设有“08大道”、南北连接桥、水立方探秘馆、水滴剧场和公益文化展区；赛后西侧热身池（霍英东厅）改造为向公众开放的50米泳池，分深水6道、浅水4道，顶层还藏有一座标准网球馆。2026年12月，这里将承办世界泳联短池游泳世锦赛。  建筑是它最著名的部分：立面由ETFE气枕构成，面积约10万平方米，灵感来自细胞排列与肥皂泡结构，蓝色的气枕在阳光下呈现水晶般的质感；结构为多面体钢框架，跨度大而自重轻，是世界最大的膜结构工程之一。水冰转换通过可拆卸冰场与可升降泳池实现，使同一大厅在泳池与冰壶赛道之间切换。赛后运营以“水立方”品牌做游泳健身、青少年培训、旅游参观和大型活动，嬉水乐园与冰雪季交替使用。交通上，地铁8号线奥林匹克公园站步行可达，15号线奥林匹克公园站同一枢纽；周边北辰西路、北四环中路公交线路密集。
intro_en: The National Aquatics Centre, universally known as the Water Cube, stands at 11 Tianchen East Road in Chaoyang District, inside the Olympic Green east of Beichen West Bridge on the North Fourth Ring Road and immediately west of the Bird's Nest. Completed for the 2008 Olympic Games, it forms one half of the central-axis pair of landmarks in the park, and in 2022 it converted into the Ice Cube for curling, making it one of the few venues to have staged both Summer and Winter Olympic competition through a water-to-ice transformation.  The Olympic competition hall is the core, with a standard 50-metre racing pool, a diving pool and a warm-up pool, seating 17,000 during the Games and retaining 6,000 fixed seats afterwards. The building has 79,532 square metres of floor area, rises 31 metres over four storeys above ground and two below. Beyond the hall there is the 08 Avenue, north and south link bridges, the Water Cube Discovery Museum, the Water Drop theatre and public exhibition areas. After the Games the western warm-up pool, the Fok Ying Tung hall, became a public 50-metre pool with six deep-water and four shallow lanes, and a standard indoor tennis court sits on the top floor. In December 2026 the venue will host the World Aquatics short-course swimming championships.  Its architecture is the attraction: the facade is a cushion of ETFE foil panels covering about 100,000 square metres, inspired by the geometry of cells and soap bubbles, so the blue cushions read like crystal in daylight. The structure is a polyhedral steel frame of long span and low self-weight, one of the largest membrane structures in the world. The ice conversion uses a demountable rink and an adjustable pool floor, letting the same hall switch between swimming and curling. Post-Games operation uses the Water Cube brand for swimming, coaching, sightseeing and events, with a water park and a winter ice season alternating through the year. Aolinpike Gongyuan station on metro line 8 is within walking distance and line 15 serves the same interchange, with frequent buses on Beichen West Road and the North Fourth Ring Road.

name_zh: 国家网球中心（钻石球场）
address: 北京市朝阳区林萃路2号（国家网球中心西侧）
area_text: 钻石球馆建筑面积51,199㎡，占地16,900㎡；地下1层、地上8层
intro_zh: 国家网球中心钻石球场位于北京市朝阳区林萃路2号国家网球中心园区西侧，北临北五环，东临奥林西路，是2008年奥运会网球场地群在赛后追加建设的一座专用中央球场。它2009年底开工、2011年8月10日落成点亮，同年9月7日正式命名为“国家网球场”，设计之初曾叫“花冠球场”，建成后取代莲花球场成为亚洲顶级网球赛事中国网球公开赛的主赛场，使北京在奥林匹克公园形成了“奥运场馆—职业赛事—大众网球”三层叠加的运营结构。  球馆占地16,900平方米，总建筑面积51,199平方米，地下1层、地上8层，设观众坐席13,520座（部分资料记固定座14,602个），另有上下两层共48间可视空中包房，是亚洲唯一拥有双层空中包厢的网球场馆。场内配套1,500平方米球员区，可同时容纳500名球员休息，并设6间15至30平方米的球员专属休息室，含休息、淋浴、按摩功能；外环设观众观景平台，可俯瞰周边球场与奥林匹克森林公园。  建筑由中国建筑设计研究院拾壹建筑工作室设计，以形式与功能统一为原则，用16组V型合柱同时支撑看台与外维护系统，V型构件与类三角形语言贯穿整体，主体为混凝土浇筑，摒弃附加装饰。屋盖为水平推拉双向开启结构，可在12分钟内完成闭合或开启，迅速在“场”与“馆”之间转换，使中网夜场与雨天赛程得以保障。2025年中网期间园区单日入园超4.5万人次，创赛事新高。交通上，地铁8号线林萃桥站步行可达园区东侧入口，自驾经北五环奥林西桥进入，赛事期间设临时交通管制与接驳。
intro_en: Diamond Court of the National Tennis Centre stands on the western side of the tennis park at 2 Lincui Road, Chaoyang District, with the North Fifth Ring Road to the north and Aolin West Road to the east. Construction began in late 2009, the court was completed and lit on 10 August 2011, and it was formally named the National Tennis Court on 7 September that year; during design it had been called the Flower Crown. It replaced Lotus Court as the main stadium of the China Open, giving the Olympic Green a three-layer tennis economy of Olympic legacy, professional tournament and public play.  The building occupies a 16,900 square metre plot with 51,199 square metres of floor area over one basement and eight upper levels, seating 13,520 spectators, with some sources quoting 14,602 fixed seats. It also contains 48 sky boxes on two levels, the only double-tier box arrangement at an Asian tennis venue. Inside, a 1,500 square metre players' area can hold 500 players at once, supported by six private player rooms of 15 to 30 square metres with rest, shower and massage functions. An external viewing deck rings the bowl, letting spectators watch neighbouring courts, the tournament festival plaza and the Olympic Forest Park.  The design, by the Shi Yi studio of the China Architecture Design and Research Group, pursues unity of form and function: sixteen groups of V-shaped columns support both the stands and the cladding, and the V motif and triangular language run through the whole composition, with a concrete primary structure and no applied ornament. The roof is a horizontal sliding, bi-directional retractable structure that closes or opens in twelve minutes, switching the venue between an outdoor court and an indoor hall and protecting the China Open night sessions and rain-affected schedules. During the 2025 tournament the park recorded more than 45,000 entries in a single day, a record. Lincuiqiao station on metro line 8 serves the eastern entrance on foot, drivers arrive from the Aolin West Bridge of the North Fifth Ring Road, and temporary traffic controls and shuttle services operate during the tournament.

address: 北京市朝阳区姚家园路77号（平房乡）
area_text: 占地约44万㎡；网球馆3,200㎡、净高14m；北区新增场地3.2万余㎡
intro_zh: 朝阳体育中心又称朝阳区体育健身休闲公园，位于北京市朝阳区平房乡姚家园路77号，毗邻机场第二高速入口，占地约44万平方米，是平房乡唯一一座区属大型综合体育场馆，也是北京东部规模最大的区级体育园区之一。它与六里屯的朝阳体育馆分属不同园区，前者以室外场地和网球为特色，后者以室内馆为主，共同构成朝阳区“一场一馆”的公共体育网络。  园区以主体育场为中心，场内设8,000个观众席，拥有国际田联认证的A级塑胶跑道、一片标准天然草足球场，以及贵宾休息室、运动员休息室、场地照明、扩声、计分和大屏系统，可承接综合性赛事、文艺演出、运动会和大型展览展示。网球是这里的另一条主线：网球馆有4片室内场、总面积3,200平方米、净高14米、照度650勒克斯以上，配多间VIP休息室；室外场由原有8片增至20片，新增部分占地约一万余平方米，2023年3月完工；2025年“潮朝体”网球场亮相，12片球场加装可开合风雨棚、鹰眼和照明系统。北区另新建3.2万余平方米场地，含4片七人制足球场、3片室外篮球场和1片棒球场。  办赛履历是它的底气：2006年第11届国际田联世界青年田径锦标赛主场，2008年奥运会和残奥会田径项目唯一训练场地，2009年国庆60周年游行彩车组装场地，2015年北京国际田联世界田径锦标赛训练场地之一；足球方面曾是北京八喜的中乙、中甲主场，拜仁慕尼黑、那不勒斯等球队也到此训练。近年来园区以“体育+”思路引入网球商店、网球咖啡馆和网球会客厅。交通上，自驾经姚家园路、机场第二高速直达，园区设停车场；公交姚家园路沿线多条线路停靠。
intro_en: Chaoyang Sports Centre, also called the Chaoyang District Sports and Fitness Leisure Park, occupies 77 Yaoyuan Road in Pingfang township, Chaoyang District, next to the entrance of the Second Airport Expressway. At about 440,000 square metres it is the only large district-owned sports complex in Pingfang and one of the biggest district-level sports parks in eastern Beijing. It is a separate campus from the Chaoyang Gymnasium at Liulitun: the centre is oriented to outdoor fields and tennis, the gymnasium to indoor halls, and together they form the district's public sports network.  The main stadium sits at the heart of the park with 8,000 seats, an IAAF-certified Class A synthetic track, a standard natural-turf football pitch, VIP and athlete rooms, and full field lighting, sound, scoring and video-board systems, making it suitable for multi-sport events, performances, sports meetings and large exhibitions. Tennis is the second pillar. The indoor tennis hall has four courts in 3,200 square metres with 14 metres of clear height and illumination above 650 lux, plus several VIP rooms. Outdoor courts grew from eight to twenty, with the new block covering more than 10,000 square metres and completed in March 2023; in 2025 the Chaochaoti courts opened with twelve courts fitted with retractable weather canopies, Hawk-Eye and floodlighting. A further 32,000 square metres in the northern zone provides four seven-a-side football pitches, three outdoor basketball courts and a baseball field.  The competition record is the venue's credential: main stadium of the 11th IAAF World Youth Championships in 2006, the only athletics training venue for the 2008 Olympics and Paralympics, the assembly ground for the floats of the 60th national day parade in 2009, and a training venue for the 2015 IAAF World Championships. In football it was the home ground of Beijing Baxi in League Two and League One, and Bayern Munich and Napoli have trained here. Recent years have followed a sports-plus strategy, adding a tennis shop, a tennis café and a tennis lounge. Drivers reach the site via Yaoyuan Road and the Second Airport Expressway, with parking on site, and several bus routes stop along Yaoyuan Road.
