address: 江苏省南京市玄武区孝陵卫街道灵谷寺路8号（南京体育学院内，中山陵园风景区）
area_text: 占地1,200亩（约80万㎡）；建筑群含田径场、国术场、篮球场、游泳池、棒球场、网球场、足球场、跑马场等
intro_zh: 中央体育场（中央体育场旧址）位于南京市玄武区孝陵卫街道灵谷寺路8号，坐落在中山陵园风景区内的南京体育学院校园中，是民国时期兴建的大型综合体育建筑群。1930年，为举办全国运动大会，国民政府圈定灵谷寺南部约80公顷（1200亩）土地建场，1931年5月10日举行奠基典礼，由基泰工程司关颂声、杨廷宝设计，利源建筑公司承造，1933年竣工，造价140余万元。建筑群包括田径场、国术场、篮球场、游泳池、棒球场、网球场、足球场和跑马场，一次可接纳6万名观众，全部采用钢筋混凝土结构，同时以中国传统纹样装饰，各场出入口多为中国式牌楼，是近代中国体育建筑中西合璧的代表作，也是当时全国最大、远东规模最大的体育场。1933年10月10日，第五届全国运动会在此开幕，全国33个代表团、2000多名运动员参加，其中包括从东北秘密入关的短跑名将刘长春。1956年，南京体育学校在旧址成立，后发展为南京体育学院，这里先后培养出16位奥运冠军和106位世界冠军。中央体育场旧址2006年被列为第六批全国重点文物保护单位，2017年入选第二批中国20世纪建筑遗产，2018年国术场完成修缮，2024年起以“开放日”形式向公众预约开放；田径场、看台和牌楼至今仍在使用，是南京重要的体育历史地标。
intro_en: Central Stadium, preserved as the Central Stadium site, stands at No. 8 Linggu Temple Road in Xiaolingwei subdistrict, Xuanwu district, Nanjing, inside the campus of Nanjing Sport Institute within the Zhongshan Mausoleum scenic area. It is the great multi-sport complex built in the Republican era. After 1928 the government set aside about 80 hectares, or 1,200 mu, south of Linggu Temple to host the national games; the foundation stone was laid on 10 May 1931, with design by Guan Songsheng and Yang Tingbao of Jitai Engineering and construction by Liyuan Building Company, and the complex was completed in 1933 at a cost of more than 1.4 million yuan. It comprises an athletics stadium, a Chinese martial arts arena, basketball courts, a swimming pool, a baseball field, tennis courts, a football pitch and a racecourse, and could admit 60,000 spectators at once. Everything is built in reinforced concrete but decorated with traditional Chinese motifs, and the entrances take the form of Chinese ceremonial archways, making the site a landmark of Sino-Western architectural fusion and the largest stadium in China and the Far East at the time. On 10 October 1933 the fifth National Games opened here with more than 2,000 athletes from 33 delegations, including sprinter Liu Changchun, who had travelled secretly from the Japanese-occupied northeast. In 1956 Nanjing Sports School was founded on the site and grew into Nanjing Sport Institute, which has since produced 16 Olympic champions and 106 world champions. The site was listed as a national key cultural relic in 2006, joined the second batch of China's 20th-century architectural heritage in 2017, saw its martial arts arena restored in 2018, and has opened to booked public visits since 2024. The track, stands and archways remain in use as a living monument to Chinese sport.

name_zh: 南京奥林匹克体育中心
address: 南京市建邺区江东中路222号
area_text: 占地89.6万㎡；总建筑面积约40.1万㎡
intro_zh: 南京奥林匹克体育中心位于南京市建邺区江东中路222号，坐落在河西新城中心区，占地89.6万平方米，总建筑面积约40.1万平方米，是2005年第十届全国运动会、2013年亚洲青年运动会和2014年夏季青年奥林匹克运动会的主会场。中心由澳大利亚HOK体育建筑设计公司设计，2002年1月开工，2005年5月投入使用，总投资约40亿元，主体为体育场、体育馆、游泳馆、网球中心和体育科技中心，道路与停车场约15万平方米，绿地近40万平方米。体育场建筑面积13.63万平方米，设6.1万个座位，屋顶为双曲面构造，两道红色大拱向外倾斜45度、跨度达361.58米，是奥体的标志；跑道采用意大利蒙多面层，南北两块大屏总面积560平方米。体育馆建筑面积约6万平方米，1.3万个观众席，其中部分可拆装移动，并设29个俱乐部包厢；游泳馆近3万平方米、4000座。这里曾是江苏队主场，2025年“苏超”南京队主场单场涌入60,396名观众。交通方面，地铁2号线奥体东站2号口出站由东门进入，地铁10号线奥体中心站2号口出站由西便门进入，另有河西有轨电车奥体东站和多条公交线路。
intro_en: Nanjing Olympic Sports Centre occupies 222 Jiangdong Middle Road in Jianye District, at the heart of the Hexi new town. Covering 896,000 sqm with about 401,000 sqm of floor area, it was the main venue for the 10th National Games in 2005, the 2013 Asian Youth Games and the 2014 Summer Youth Olympic Games. Designed by HOK Sport of Australia, construction started in January 2002 and the centre opened in May 2005 at a total cost of around four billion yuan. It comprises a stadium, an arena, a swimming hall, a tennis centre and a sports science centre, with some 150,000 sqm of roads and parking and nearly 400,000 sqm of landscaped grounds. The stadium has 136,340 sqm of floor area and 61,000 seats under a double-curved roof marked by two red arches leaning outwards at 45 degrees with a span of 361.58 m; the track is Italian Mondo and two end screens total 560 sqm. The arena offers about 60,000 sqm and 13,000 seats, some removable, plus 29 club boxes, while the swimming hall covers nearly 30,000 sqm with 4,000 seats. Once home to Jiangsu FC, the stadium drew 60,396 spectators for a Jiangsu City League match in 2025. Metro Line 2 at Olympic East station and Line 10 at Olympic Sports Centre station serve the east and west gates. The centre still works as a public sports park, with swimming, tennis, badminton, basketball, table tennis, ice skating and archery clubs based on site, and the stadium bowl is regularly used for concerts and exhibitions.
source: 南京奥体中心官网 njaoti.com（联系我们/商务开发）；zh.wikipedia.org/南京奥林匹克体育中心；新华日报 xhby.net

address: 南京市江北新区环奥路2号
area_text: 总占地18万㎡；总建筑面积16万㎡（体育馆12.8万㎡、体育场3.3万㎡、训练馆约3000㎡）
intro_zh: 南京青奥体育公园位于南京市江北新区环奥路2号，处在国家级江北新区核心区，是南京唯一的市级体育中心，也是2014年南京青奥会唯一新建的场馆群。项目2011年12月开工，2017年6月全面竣工，总占地18万平方米，总建筑面积16万平方米，由体育馆、体育场、训练馆和训练场四部分组成。体育馆建筑面积12.8万平方米（地上8.8万、地下4万），最大直径166米、顶高43米，设2万个观众席，其中活动座位3708个、贵宾包厢38个、包厢坐席1433个，玻璃幕墙由11000多块玻璃拼成，整体呈弧形类椭圆锥体，硬件达到承办NBA比赛和FIBA世界杯的要求，并可实现冰篮转换，是国内可容纳观众最多的室内体育馆之一。体育场建筑面积3.3万平方米，观众坐席18022个，比赛场地20667.87平方米，看台高35.3米，采用意大利蒙多跑道，足球场内套设橄榄球场地；训练馆约3000平方米、净高12.35米，可容纳3000人。主体育馆获2018—2019年度中国建设工程鲁班奖，2024年由洋河股份冠名为“梦之蓝体育馆”。交通方面，地铁10号线设临江·青奥体育公园站，场馆紧邻环奥路与横江大道。
intro_en: Nanjing Youth Olympic Sports Park stands at 2 Huan'ao Road in Jiangbei New Area, the only municipal-level sports centre in Nanjing and the only venue cluster built new for the 2014 Youth Olympic Games. Work started in December 2011 and the park was completed in June 2017, covering 180,000 sqm of land with 160,000 sqm of floor area across an arena, a stadium, an indoor training hall and training pitches. The arena accounts for 128,000 sqm, 88,000 above ground and 40,000 below, with a maximum diameter of 166 m and a roof height of 43 m. It seats 20,000, including 3,708 movable places, 38 VIP boxes and 1,433 box seats, and its curved, near-elliptical cone is wrapped in a curtain wall of more than 11,000 glass panels. Built to NBA and FIBA World Cup standards, it can switch between ice and basketball and ranks among the largest indoor arenas in China. The stadium covers 33,000 sqm with 18,022 seats, a 20,667.87 sqm playing field and stands 35.3 m high; its Mondo track surrounds a football pitch that also accommodates rugby. The training hall offers about 3,000 sqm with a 12.35 m clear height and 3,000 spectators. The arena won a Luban Prize in 2019 and was renamed Mengzhilan Arena after a 2024 sponsorship by Yanghe. Metro Line 10 stops at Linjiang Youth Olympic Sports Park station. The park also includes an 8,000 sqm training ground used for athletics camps and youth football, rugby and taekwondo, and since 2017 it has hosted League of Legends finals, concerts and international basketball.
source: 南京市体育局 sports.nanjing.gov.cn；zh.wikipedia.org/南京青奥体育公园；南京体育集团官网 nsig.com.cn

address: 南京市鼓楼区广州路173号
area_text: 体育场占地5.5万㎡
intro_zh: 南京五台山体育中心位于南京市鼓楼区广州路173号，地处市中心鼓楼区，紧邻新街口与广州路商圈，是江苏历史最悠久的综合性体育场馆群。体育场1952年8月18日动工、1953年建成启用，占地5.5万平方米，足球草坪南北长105米、东西宽66米，可容纳18600名观众，是江苏省最早的专业灯光足球场地。中心内部设施包括万人体育馆、游泳跳水馆、综合训练馆、保龄球馆、网球场、宾馆和田径足球场，其中体育馆设8000个篮球坐席，游泳跳水馆形似腾空而起的巨鲸，是第三届全国城市运动会标志性建筑。这里先后作为江苏舜天、南京有有、南京钱宝、南京城市等球队的主场，承办过第三届城市运动会、第六届全国残疾人运动会、第十届全国运动会男子足球比赛，1998年以来还长期承接刘德华、张学友、张惠妹等大型演唱会。2025年“苏超”南京队在此比赛，单场观众超过1.5万人，创下这片老赛场的上座纪录。交通方面，地铁4号线云南路站2号口步行约600米可达，周边为广州路、拉萨路、上海路路网，公交线路密集。
intro_en: Nanjing Wutaishan Sports Centre occupies 173 Guangzhou Road in Gulou District, in the central city close to Xinjiekou and the Guangzhou Road commercial area, and is the oldest comprehensive sports complex in Jiangsu. The stadium broke ground on 18 August 1952 and opened in 1953 on 55,000 sqm of land, with a football pitch measuring 105 m north to south and 66 m east to west and seating for 18,600; it was the first floodlit professional football ground in the province. The centre also contains a ten-thousand-seat indoor arena, a swimming and diving hall, a multi-purpose training hall, a bowling alley, tennis courts, a hotel and athletics facilities. The arena seats 8,000 for basketball, while the swimming and diving hall, shaped like a breaching whale, was a landmark building of the third National City Games. The ground has been home to Jiangsu Shuntian, Nanjing Youyou, Nanjing Qianbao and Nanjing City, has staged the third National City Games, the sixth National Games for persons with disabilities and men's football at the 10th National Games, and since 1998 has hosted concerts by Andy Lau, Jacky Cheung and A-Mei. In 2025 a Jiangsu City League match drew more than 15,000 fans, a record for the old ground. Metro Line 4 at Yunnan Road station, exit 2, is about 600 m away. The complex is owned by the Jiangsu provincial government, and its central location keeps the halls busy with badminton, swimming, basketball and bowling bookings as well as match days. It also acts as a provincial training base for youth tennis and swimming.
source: zh.wikipedia.org/南京五台山体育中心；南京市人民政府 nanjing.gov.cn；2026年江苏省五台山体育中心开放公告（电话）

address: 广西壮族自治区南宁市青秀区桃源路62号
capacity_text: 2000（田径场看台）；1000余（桃源游泳场）；800余（综合训练一馆）
intro_zh: 南宁市体育场位于南宁市青秀区桃源路62号，前身是1935年12月建成的“民众运动场”，又称“跑马场”，1953年10月正式建立，是南宁历史最久的公共体育场地，现为南宁市体育局下属单位；2025年2月，原南宁市体育场与原南宁手球训练基地整合组建南宁市体育场馆服务中心，加挂南宁手球训练基地牌子。体育场以田径场为核心，田径场建筑面积25,000平方米、使用面积19,394平方米，铺设400米塑胶跑道和标准足球场，建有可容纳2,000名观众的主席台和看台。周边分布网球场、综合训练一馆、综合训练二馆、手球馆和桃源游泳场：网球场建筑面积3,000平方米，设4片标准塑胶比赛场地；综合训练一馆1,760平方米、共三层，一楼为体操馆和技巧训练馆，二楼乒乓球馆设41张球台，三楼篮球馆可变换为羽毛球、气排球场地，能容纳800多名观众；综合训练二馆1,500平方米，一楼举重馆、二楼武术馆、三楼羽毛球馆设6片专业场地；手球馆1,900平方米，内设手球场和羽毛球场；桃源游泳场6,600平方米，有1个标准池和1个儿童池，固定看台可容纳1,000多名观众，配24小时水循环设备。全场可容纳19个项目、近千人同时训练，年接待量超过90万人次。2021年体育场对网球场做智能化改造并上线线上订场，同年获“2017—2020年度全国群众体育先进单位”；2024年全民健身日单日接待锻炼者1.23万人次，2025年全民健身日及“五一”“五四”期间免费开放综合训练一馆、手球馆和田径场。
intro_en: Nanning Municipal Stadium at 62 Taoyuan Road in the Qingxiu District traces its origin to the People's Sports Ground, also called the racecourse, laid out in December 1935; it was formally established in October 1953 and is the oldest public sports ground in the city, now run under the municipal sports bureau. In February 2025 the stadium and the former Nanning handball training base were merged into the Nanning Sports Venues Service Centre, which also carries the handball base name. The athletics ground is the core: 25,000 sqm of floor area and 19,394 sqm in use, with a 400 m synthetic track, a standard football pitch and a main stand seating 2,000. Around it sit a tennis centre, two indoor training halls, a handball hall and the Taoyuan swimming pool. The tennis centre has 3,000 sqm and four standard synthetic courts; Training Hall One has 1,760 sqm over three floors, with gymnastics and acrobatics on the ground floor, 41 table tennis tables on the second and a basketball court on the third that converts to badminton and light volleyball, seating more than 800; Training Hall Two has 1,500 sqm with weightlifting, wushu and six professional badminton courts stacked floor by floor; the handball hall has 1,900 sqm for handball and badminton; and the Taoyuan pool complex covers 6,600 sqm with a standard pool, a children's pool, fixed terracing for more than 1,000 and 24-hour water recirculation. Together the site supports 19 sports and close to a thousand athletes training at once, with more than 900,000 visits a year. The tennis courts were smartened up in 2021 with online booking, the stadium was named a national advanced unit for mass sport in 2021, and 12,300 people used the site on National Fitness Day in 2024.

address: 广西壮族自治区南宁市江南区星光大道3号
area_text: 建筑面积1.2万㎡，广场约2.5万㎡；比赛场地50×25米，室内净高17米
intro_zh: 广西体育馆又称江南体育馆，位于南宁市江南区星光大道3号，与南宁剧场隔街相望，1965年建成，总建筑面积1.2万平方米，广场面积约2.5万平方米，是南宁邕江南岸的老牌大型体育馆。建筑设计充分考虑南宁炎热气候，采用开敞式形式而非常规封闭空调建筑，主体朝向和平面、立体布置都利于自然通风降温，同时配备人工照明和大功率中央空调。主场馆比赛场地长50米、宽25米，室内净高17米，原设观众座位5,502个，2023年调整观众席后为4,500个，场内可承办篮球、排球、手球、羽毛球、乒乓球、举重、摔跤、体操、舞蹈等赛事以及文艺演出、会议和培训。附属场馆包括羽毛球馆、篮球馆、综合馆、游泳池各1个和2片五人制足球场。1998年为自治区成立四十周年大庆，场馆内外全面装修改造并加装中央空调，更换电气照明和音响设施；2003年以来投资300多万元购进专业舞台灯光音响设备，曾承接理查德·克莱德曼钢琴演奏会等演出的灯光音响制作工程。场馆长期向社会开放健身场地，2024年全面落实免费、低收费开放政策，曾获“全国群众体育先进单位”，2023年被列为公共体育场馆开放典型案例，是广西壮族自治区体育局直属场馆。
intro_en: Guangxi Gymnasium, also known as Jiangnan Gymnasium, stands at 3 Xingguang Avenue in Nanning's Jiangnan District, across the street from the Nanning Theatre. Completed in 1965, it has 12,000 sqm of floor area and a plaza of about 25,000 sqm, and remains one of the largest and oldest indoor arenas on the south bank of the Yong River. The design responds to Nanning's heat by using an open form rather than a sealed, air-conditioned box: the orientation, plan and massing all encourage natural ventilation and cooling, while artificial lighting and a high-capacity central air system were fitted later. The competition floor measures 50 m by 25 m under a 17 m clear height, with 4,500 seats after a 2023 reseating that reduced the original 5,502, and it can stage basketball, volleyball, handball, badminton, table tennis, weightlifting, wrestling, gymnastics and dance as well as concerts, conferences and training. Ancillary facilities comprise one badminton hall, one basketball hall, a multi-purpose hall, a swimming pool and two five-a-side football pitches. For the autonomous region's 40th anniversary in 1998 the building was refitted inside and out, with central air conditioning and new electrical, lighting and sound systems; since 2003 more than three million yuan has gone into professional stage lighting and audio, and the hall has handled the sound and lighting production for concerts including Richard Clayderman's piano recital. The venue has long opened its fitness spaces to the public, fully implemented free and low-cost access in 2024, holds a national advanced-unit award for mass sport, was cited in 2023 as a model case of public venue opening, and is administered directly by the regional sports bureau.

name_zh: 广西壮族自治区体育场
address: 广西壮族自治区南宁市兴宁区公园路5号（人民公园旁）
intro_zh: 广西壮族自治区体育场位于南宁市兴宁区公园路5号，紧邻人民公园，1956年建成，占地62,390平方米，是广西第一座配有训练比赛灯光设施的足球田径场。场内足球田径场设十条标准塑胶跑道和一片足球场，配有可容纳600多人座席的主席台和30,000人的观众坐席看台，装备功能齐全的音控设施、四座标准灯塔和配电房。建成后，这里长期是广西举办国际、国内重大比赛和重大社会集庆活动的首选场所之一，第四届全国少数民族运动会、第一届至第四届南宁国际民歌艺术节开幕式均在体育场举行，广西历届全区运动会的开幕式和大部分比赛也放在这里。体育场还拥有一个室内游泳馆、两个露天游泳池和一个儿童游泳池，可承接高水平水上训练和比赛，第一游泳馆在“五一”“五四”等节点向市民免费开放。多年来体育场承担全民健身和竞技体育保障任务，2021年9月获“2017—2020年度全国群众体育先进单位”；2026年7月11日至13日，体育场作为主办方承办广西少年射箭公开赛，为123名青少年运动员提供竞赛环境，场长韦云珍表示承办此类赛事意在激活场地资源、助力射击射箭后备人才培养。体育场由广西壮族自治区体育局直属管理，办公地址即公园路5号。
intro_en: The Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Stadium at 5 Gongyuan Road in Nanning's Xingning District, beside the People's Park, was completed in 1956 on a 62,390 sqm site and was the first football and athletics ground in Guangxi fitted with lighting for training and competition. The pitch is ringed by ten standard synthetic lanes, and the ground has a main stand for just over 600 people plus terracing for 30,000 spectators, served by a full sound system, four standard floodlight towers and a power distribution building. Since opening it has been one of the region's first choices for major international and national competitions and large public celebrations: the 4th National Minority Traditional Sports Games and the opening ceremonies of the first four Nanning International Folk Song Arts Festivals were held here, as were the opening ceremonies of successive Guangxi regional games and most of their competition. The stadium also has an indoor swimming hall, two open-air pools and a children's pool capable of hosting high-level aquatic training and competition, and the first swimming hall opens free to residents at points such as Labour Day and Youth Day. The ground has long carried mass-fitness and elite-sport duties and in September 2021 was named a national advanced unit for mass sport for 2017-2020. From 11 to 13 July 2026 it hosted the Guangxi youth archery open, providing a competition setting for 123 young archers; venue director Wei Yunzhen said such events are meant to activate the site and support the pipeline for shooting and archery. The stadium is administered directly by the regional sports bureau.

address: 广西壮族自治区南宁市青秀区凤岭南路13号（东临铜鼓岭路）
area_text: 占地527亩（用地约35.17万㎡），建筑面积约3.59万㎡（设计方案计31,688㎡）
intro_zh: 李宁体育园位于南宁市青秀区凤岭南路13号，东临铜鼓岭路、南靠凤岭南路，地处凤岭片区、东盟国际商务区南部的丘陵地带，由李宁及其家族成员捐资设立的广西李宁基金会投资建设，是以非营利为目的的公益性体育公园，2010年建成并投入运营，是李宁集团在全国运营的第一个体育园。园区占地527亩（用地约35.17万平方米），建筑面积约3.59万平方米（设计方案计31,688平方米），总体规划与建筑方案由澳大利亚柏涛咨询公司完成，设计创意取自象征绿城南宁的绿树，并结合李宁公司创办、发展、回馈社会的历程。园区分标准游泳训练区、室外运动区、后勤办公区、休闲娱乐区和自然生态区五大功能区，既满足竞技比赛和训练要求，也向市民开放。游泳馆内设50米×25米标准池一个、25米×13.5米儿童池一个，恒温泳池采用24小时水循环处理，是南宁市游泳场所卫生监督量化分级管理A级单位；园内还有综合馆、羽毛球馆、乒乓球馆、篮球场、网球场、五人制足球场，以及攀岩、蹦床、射箭、匹克球等新兴项目场地和智能健身路径。2025年5月，李宁谌龙羽毛球单打公开赛南宁站在综合馆举行，1329名爱好者参赛；2026年1月9日至10日，“李宁杯”中国—东盟匹克球公开赛暨中国—东盟城市网球赛在此开幕。园区常年对部分场馆实行免费或低收费开放。
intro_en: The Li-Ning Sports Park at 13 Fengling South Road in Nanning's Qingxiu District, with Tongguiling Road to the east and Fengling South Road to the south, occupies the hilly ground at the southern edge of the ASEAN international business district in Fengling. It was funded by the Guangxi Li-Ning Foundation, set up with money from Li Ning and his family, and built as a non-profit public sports park; it opened in 2010 and was the first sports park operated by the Li-Ning group anywhere in China. The site covers 527 mu, about 351,700 sqm, with roughly 35,900 sqm of floor area, or 31,688 sqm on the design drawings; master planning and architecture came from Australia's PTW consultancy, taking the branching structure of the green trees that give Nanning its nickname and weaving in the company's own story of founding, growth and giving back. The park is divided into a standard swimming training zone, outdoor sports zone, back-of-house zone, leisure zone and ecological zone, serving both competition and training and everyday public use. The swimming hall holds a 50 m by 25 m standard pool and a 25 m by 13.5 m children's pool, heated and run on 24-hour water recirculation, and is rated A in the city's health-inspection grading of swimming pools. There are also a multi-purpose hall, badminton and table tennis halls, basketball and tennis courts, five-a-side football, climbing, trampoline, archery and pickleball, plus smart outdoor fitness equipment. In May 2025 the Nanning leg of the Li-Ning Chen Long badminton open drew 1,329 players, and on 9-10 January 2026 the Li-Ning Cup China-ASEAN pickleball open and the China-ASEAN city tennis tournament opened here. Parts of the park stay free or low-cost all year.

address: 广西壮族自治区南宁市良庆区五象大道669号（五象新区核心区）
area_text: 广西体育中心总占地约2000亩（约133.3万㎡），总建筑面积约50.8万㎡；一期主体育场建筑面积约12.3万㎡
intro_zh: 广西体育中心位于南宁市良庆区五象大道669号，处在五象新区核心区、五象大道南侧，是广西壮族自治区成立以来规模最大的体育设施，也是南宁城市向南拓展的标志性公共建筑群。中心总占地约2000亩（约133.3万平方米），总建筑面积约50.8万平方米，分三期建设，包含可容纳6万名观众的体育场、8719座的体育馆、3943座的游泳跳水馆和6347座的网球中心。一期主体育场于2010年8月11日正式开放，首场比赛为中国国家足球队对阵巴林国家足球队，建筑面积约12.3万平方米，看台沿椭圆环形两层展开，屋面采用多曲线飘逸造型，呈现轻盈的现代气质，场芯为天然草坪足球场与400米跑道，可承办全国性运动会主会场、区域性国际运动会及国际国内重大单项赛事。体育中心同时承担文艺演出、集会展览、健康娱乐等功能，是集体育比赛与城市公共活动于一体的综合体，周边五象总部基地、广西文化艺术中心等构成南宁新的城市中心。交通方面，场馆紧邻五象大道与平乐大道，公交线路密集，自驾经五象大道、南宁大桥可快速连接青秀区与老城，距南宁东站约半小时车程。
intro_en: Guangxi Sports Center stands at No. 669 Wuxiang Avenue in Liangqing District, Nanning, in the heart of Wuxiang New Area on the southern bank of the Yong River. It is the largest sports facility built in Guangxi and the flagship public architecture of Nanning's southward urban expansion. The site covers about 2,000 mu, roughly 1.333 million sqm, with some 508,000 sqm of floor area developed in three phases: a 60,000-seat stadium, an 8,719-seat arena, a 3,943-seat swimming and diving hall and a 6,347-seat tennis centre. The first-phase stadium opened on 11 August 2010 with a match between the Chinese and Bahraini national football teams. Its 123,000 sqm of floor area wraps two seating tiers around an oval bowl beneath a roof of flowing multi-curve surfaces, giving the building a light, contemporary profile over a natural-turf pitch and 400 m track. It was built to serve as the main venue for national multi-sport games, regional international games and major single-sport championships, and it also carries concerts, exhibitions and public recreation, making it a combined sports and civic events complex. The surrounding Wuxiang headquarters base and Guangxi Culture and Arts Centre have turned the district into Nanning's new city centre, and the riverside embankment in front of the stadium now doubles as a public promenade on event nights. Wuxiang Avenue and Pingle Avenue border the site, bus routes are dense, and the Wuxiang Avenue and Nanning Bridge corridors connect quickly to Qingxiu District and the old town, with Nanning East railway station about half an hour away.

address: 江西省南昌市高新技术产业开发区紫阳大道666号（昌东高校园区、瑶湖西岸）
area_text: 占地140,487㎡（奥体中心首期用地）；体育场单体建筑面积官方未单独公布
intro_zh: 江西奥体中心体育场（正式名江西省奥林匹克中心体育场）位于南昌市高新技术产业开发区紫阳大道666号，处在昌东高校园区、瑶湖西岸，与江西师范大学隔路相望。体育场为2011年第七届全国城市运动会的主体育场之一，2011年6月建成启用，所在的奥体中心首期用地约14.05万平方米，可容纳5万名观众，是江西省最重要的体育场之一。场内设标准400米田径跑道和足球场，看台沿跑道连续环绕；屋盖与立面以花瓣为意象，主体育场形似含苞的花蕾，周围五座场馆如大小不一的花朵，共同组成“一朵花”的群体造型。建成后这里长期作为中甲球队江西联盛的主场，2014年11月中国国家队曾在主场与新西兰队1比1战平；除足球、田径赛事外，场地也承接大型演唱会、运动会开幕式和群众体育活动。交通方面，地铁1号线奥体中心站直达，208路、220路和308路夜间线等公交可达。场馆现由江西省体育发展有限公司运营，公开。需要说明的是，体育场单体的建筑面积未见官方公布，公开资料中的14.05万平方米为中心首期用地面积，不宜与建筑面积混用。
intro_en: Jiangxi Olympic Sports Center Stadium, officially the Jiangxi Provincial Olympic Center Stadium, stands at 666 Ziyang Avenue in Nanchang's High-tech Development Zone, on the western shore of Yaohu Lake in the Changdong university district and across the road from Jiangxi Normal University. Completed in June 2011, it was one of the principal venues of the 7th National City Games and is one of Jiangxi's flagship stadiums, seating 50,000 spectators on continuous tiers wrapped around a standard 400 m track and a natural-grass football pitch. The roof and facade take the flower petal as their motif: the stadium reads as a closed bud, while the five halls around it resemble blossoms of different sizes, together forming a single flower-shaped group. The ground has long served as the home of Jiangxi Liansheng and in November 2014 hosted a 1-1 friendly between China and New Zealand. Beyond football and athletics it stages concerts, opening ceremonies and mass-sport events, and its forecourt is used for warm-up and public activities. Metro Line 1 stops at Olympic Stadium station, and bus routes 208, 220 and night route 308 also serve the site. The venue is operated by Jiangxi Provincial Sports Development Co., Ltd., whose public telephone is not included in this public dataset. The 140,487 sqm figure published for the centre is the phase-one land area rather than the stadium's own floor area, and the two should not be confused; the single-building floor area has not been released. The ground is owned by the Nanchang municipal government, and its construction cost was reported at 1.05 billion yuan.

name_zh: 江西省奥林匹克体育中心
address: 江西省南昌市高新技术产业开发区紫阳大道666号（昌东高校园区、瑶湖西岸）
area_text: 建设用地800亩（约533,333㎡，规划用地约937亩）；总建筑面积官方未公布
intro_zh: 江西省奥林匹克体育中心坐落在南昌市高新技术产业开发区昌东高校园区的瑶湖西岸，门牌为紫阳大道666号，与江西师范大学隔路相望。中心总体规划为“一场五馆”，建设用地800亩，规划用地约937亩，首期以“一场两馆”为主体，政府投资约7亿元；中心总建筑面积未见官方公布。所谓“一场”，是可容纳5万名观众的主体育场；“五馆”包括4,000座的体育馆、3,000座的游泳跳水馆，以及球类馆、网球馆和田径训练馆。2011年，这里作为第七届全国城市运动会的主赛场投入使用，此后既是江西省专业运动队的训练基地，也是南昌市民健身和大型演出的场所。规划设计以花的形态为主题：主体育场鸟瞰如巨大的含苞花蕾，环绕其外的场馆像朵朵形态各异的鲜花，配合瑶湖水面形成滨水景观空间，是南昌的城市地标之一。中心由江西省体育发展有限公司负责运营，公开，官网提供场馆介绍与赛事信息。地铁1号线奥体中心站直达，208路、220路、308路夜间线等公交可达。
intro_en: Jiangxi Provincial Olympic Sports Center occupies the western shore of Yaohu Lake in the Changdong university district of Nanchang's High-tech Development Zone, at 666 Ziyang Avenue, facing Jiangxi Normal University across the road. Its master plan is known as 'one stadium and five halls'. The construction land covers 800 mu, about 533,333 sqm, with a planned site of roughly 937 mu. The first phase, built with some 700 million yuan of government funding, centred on the stadium and two halls; no total floor area for the whole centre has been published, so the land figures should not be read as building area. The stadium seats 50,000. The five halls comprise a 4,000-seat arena, a 3,000-seat swimming and diving hall, a ball-games hall, a tennis hall and an athletics training hall. The complex opened for the 7th National City Games in 2011 and has since served both as a training base for provincial teams and as a venue for public fitness, concerts and ceremonies. The design takes the flower as its theme: from above the stadium resembles a large closed bud, while the surrounding halls look like blossoms of different sizes, set against the lake to form a waterfront landscape and one of Nanchang's urban landmarks. Jiangxi Provincial Sports Development Co., Ltd. operates the centre; its public telephone is not included in this public dataset, while its website carries venue and event information. Metro Line 1 stops at Olympic Stadium station, with bus routes 208, 220 and night route 308 also serving the site. The tennis facilities are regularly used for the Jiangxi Open.

address: 江西省南昌市青山湖区洪都北大道489号（洪都北大道与南京西路交界处）
area_text: 总占地57亩，室外场地面积19,800㎡
intro_zh: 南昌八一体育场位于南昌市青山湖区洪都北大道489号，处在洪都北大道与南京西路交界处，2000年10月建成，原名南昌市体育中心，建设投资3,000多万元，总占地面积57亩，室外场地面积19,800平方米，观众座位数20,126个。场内设国际标准全塑胶400米×8道跑道，一片通过国际足联FIFA二星认证的人造草坪足球场，以及2片五人制笼式足球场，另配套体育公园笼式篮球场。体育场全年365天开放：田径场每日6:00—8:00、9:00—12:00及下午至17:00免费；足球场周一至周五9:00—12:00免费，周一、周三、周五19:00—21:00低收费，其余时段正常收费，11人制每场两小时正常价2,000元、低收费1,000元，7人制1,500元和800元，5人制500元和260元；笼式篮球场每日9:00—12:00、13:30—17:00免费；全民健身日所有场地全天免费。场馆计划全年接待不低于60万人次，为28个协会和运动项目俱乐部提供活动场所，每周六、周日承接南昌市足球协会5个年龄段青少年精英队训练，并承办南昌市中小学秋季田径运动会等单位运动会。2025年7月12日，江西省城市足球超级联赛（赣超）在此揭幕，南昌队对阵景德镇队。
intro_en: Nanchang Bayi Stadium at 489 Hongdu North Avenue in the Qingshanhu District, where that road meets Nanjing West Road, was completed in October 2000 under its former name, the Nanchang Municipal Sports Centre, at a cost of more than 30 million yuan. The site covers 57 mu with 19,800 sqm of outdoor sports ground and seating for 20,126 spectators. Inside are an international-standard 400 m eight-lane synthetic track, a FIFA two-star certified artificial turf football pitch, two caged five-a-side pitches and caged basketball courts in the adjoining sports park. The stadium opens 365 days a year: the track is free from 06:00 to 08:00, from 09:00 to 12:00 and through the afternoon until 17:00; the football pitch is free from 09:00 to 12:00 Monday to Friday and charged at the low rate from 19:00 to 21:00 on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, with normal rates at other times - 2,000 yuan per two-hour slot for the full-size pitch against 1,000 at the low rate, 1,500 and 800 for seven-a-side, and 500 and 260 for five-a-side. The caged basketball courts are free daily from 09:00 to 12:00 and 13:30 to 17:00, and everything is free on National Fitness Day. The venue plans to receive at least 600,000 visits a year, hosts 28 associations and clubs, gives the Nanchang football association's five age-group elite squads their weekend training and stages school and company sports meetings. On 12 July 2025 it opened the Jiangxi city football super league, with Nanchang playing Jingdezhen. The ground is run by the Nanchang sports development centre, which published the 2026 opening plan, and because it has no indoor space its programme is entirely outdoor; opening costs for 2026 are budgeted at 5.5 million yuan, of which 500,000 yuan covers water, electricity, gas and heating.

address: 江西省南昌市红谷滩区国体大道333号
area_text: 占地1,045.3亩；主体育场9.5万㎡、体育馆3.77万㎡、游泳馆1.54万㎡
intro_zh: 南昌国际体育中心位于南昌市红谷滩区国体大道333号，占地1,045.3亩，建有“一场四馆”，即主体育场、体育馆、游泳馆、网球馆和综合训练馆，是江西省规模最大、功能最全的大型体育产业综合体。主体育场建筑面积9.5万平方米，设60,000个座位（另有57,000个固定座位和58,235座两种统计口径），2011年建成，投资总额54,636.86万元，室内、室外场地面积各0.5万平方米；体育馆建筑面积3.77万平方米，设12,000个座位；游泳馆建筑面积1.54万平方米，设1,500个座位；网球馆和综合训练馆承担训练与全民健身功能。中心对外开放羽毛球、篮球、乒乓球、网球、足球、健身房和恒温游泳等项目，日常实行免费或低收费开放：户外公共区域和健身器材在工作日8:00—11:00免费，室外篮球场全年免费，综合训练馆（体育馆副馆）的羽毛球、乒乓球在工作日上午免费。主体育场是大型演出的主要承载地，张学友演唱会单场观众达55,000人，WCBA全明星赛观众6,000人，2018年还承接了WCBA联赛、全国现代五项冠军赛、IBO拳赛和多场演唱会。2025年12月，2026年江西省城市足球超级联赛（赣超）确定南昌队主场设在这里；同月起体育场进行全面提升改造，拆除老旧跑道、更新塑胶跑道和灯光，预计2026年4月以新面貌登场。
intro_en: Nanchang International Sports Center at 333 Guoti Avenue in the Honggutan District covers 1,045.3 mu and comprises one stadium and four halls: the main stadium, an indoor arena, a swimming hall, a tennis hall and a multi-purpose training hall. It is the largest and most fully equipped sports complex in Jiangxi. The main stadium has 95,000 sqm of floor area and 60,000 seats - other counts give 57,000 fixed seats or 58,235 - was completed in 2011 at a total investment of 546.4 million yuan, and has half a hectare each of indoor and outdoor ancillary space. The arena has 37,700 sqm and 12,000 seats; the swimming hall 15,400 sqm and 1,500 seats; the tennis hall and training hall carry training and mass-fitness duties. The centre opens badminton, basketball, table tennis, tennis, football, a gym and a heated pool to the public, mostly free or at low cost: the outdoor areas and fitness equipment are free from 08:00 to 11:00 on weekdays, the outdoor basketball courts are free all year, and badminton and table tennis in the training hall, the arena's secondary hall, are free on weekday mornings. The stadium is the city's main concert venue, with a Jacky Cheung show drawing 55,000 people and the WCBA all-star game 6,000; in 2018 it also hosted the WCBA league, the national modern pentathlon championships, IBO boxing and several concerts. In December 2025 the stadium was confirmed as the home ground of the Nanchang team for the 2026 Jiangxi city football super league, and from that month it underwent a full upgrade, with the old track removed and new synthetic surfacing and lighting installed, due to reopen in April 2026.

address: 安徽省合肥市瑶海区新站高新区东方大道288号（东方大道与卧龙湖路交口西南侧）
website: https://www.hefei.gov.cn/（合肥市政府门户；场馆未单独建站，订场与活动信息经“少荃体育中心”微信公众号发布）
area_text: 总占地约250亩；总建筑面积约12万㎡，其中体育馆约7.3万㎡（地上约4.6万㎡）
intro_zh: 少荃体育中心位于合肥市瑶海区新站高新区东方大道288号，处在东方大道与卧龙湖路交口西南侧，紧邻轨道交通4号线综保区站，是合肥首个地铁车辆段上盖的TOD体育综合体。项目总占地约250亩，总建筑面积约12万平方米，由体育馆、长空公园户外体育公园、花园里运动潮流街区和体育配套商业四部分组成；其中体育馆建筑面积约7.3万平方米，地上加地下共六层，2023年9月底竣工，同年12月23日正式启用。馆内采用U型三面看台，固定坐席9,558个，比赛场地净尺寸70米×40米，配备全自动升降端屏、可拆卸CBA标准木地板，吊挂荷载约200吨，是安徽省座席最多、功能最全的甲级综合体育馆，可承办国际单项赛事、赛会制比赛以及演唱会、音乐节和商业发布活动。启用以来已举办超过100场赛事和演艺活动，并入选2024年中国体育场馆协会国家级典型案例。交通方面，地铁4号线综保区站步行可达，681路、686路、M402路、T43路等公交在人才公寓站停靠。场馆没有独立官网，公开订场与活动信息主要通过微信公众号发布。
intro_en: Shaoquan Sports Center stands at 288 Dongfang Avenue in the Xinzhan High-tech Zone of Hefei's Yaohai District, at the south-west corner of its junction with Wolonghu Road and next to Zongbao District station on Metro Line 4. It is Hefei's first TOD sports complex built above a metro depot. The 250-mu site contains about 120,000 sqm of floor space in four parts: the arena, the Changkong Park outdoor sports ground, the Huayuanli sports and lifestyle street and a supporting retail block. The arena alone accounts for roughly 73,000 sqm over six levels above and below ground. Completed in September 2023 and opened on 23 December that year, it has U-shaped seating on three sides with 9,558 fixed seats and a clear playing floor of 70 by 40 metres. Equipment includes fully automatic rising end screens, a removable CBA-standard timber floor and a hanging load of about 200 tonnes, the largest of any arena in Anhui. It is the province's largest and most comprehensively equipped Class-A indoor venue, able to stage international single-sport events, tournament-format competitions, concerts, music festivals and product launches. More than 100 sports and entertainment events have been held since opening, and the arena was listed among the China Sports Venues Association's national representative cases in 2024. Metro Line 4 stops at Zongbao District, and buses 681, 686, M402 and T43 serve the nearby Talent Apartment stop. Shaoquan has no standalone website; bookings and event notices are published through its WeChat account, and the municipal government portal carries the project's public information.

name_zh: 合肥奥林匹克体育中心
address: 安徽省合肥市蜀山区政务文化新区（北临习友路、南临环区南路、西临怀宁路、东临潜山路）
intro_zh: 合肥奥林匹克体育中心位于安徽省合肥市蜀山区政务文化新区南部，北临习友路、南临环区南路、西临怀宁路、东临潜山路，处在合肥行政中心与天鹅湖商圈之间的城市新中轴上，是合肥承办大型赛事与演出的主力场馆。项目总用地面积34.7万平方米（521亩），建筑面积15.3万平方米，总投资约15亿元，由一座可容纳6万人的主体育场、一座8000座的综合体育馆、一座3000座的游泳跳水馆，以及三星级体育宾馆、室外网球场、室外足球场、热身训练馆、商业娱乐设施和五环喷泉广场等组成。主体育场看台沿椭圆环形展开，罩棚以轻钢桁架支承，场芯为天然草坪足球场与400米塑胶跑道，可满足田径、足球赛事及大型演唱会需求；体育馆为多功能室内馆，可切换篮球、羽毛球、体操与演出模式；游泳跳水馆设标准比赛池与跳台，常年向市民开放。作为合肥市属核心体育设施，这里承担过全国性单项赛事、省运会及众多商业演出，也是政务文化新区居民日常健身的主要去处，周边配套酒店、商业与办公集聚。交通方面，场馆东侧为潜山路、西侧为怀宁路，南侧接环区南路，公交线路密集，自驾经潜山路、习友路可快速接入金寨路高架与绕城高速，距合肥南站约二十分钟车程。
intro_en: Hefei Olympic Sports Center occupies the southern part of the Zhengwu Wenhua New District in Shushan District, Hefei, framed by Xiyou Road to the north, Huanqu South Road to the south, Huaining Road to the west and Qianshan Road to the east. It sits on the city's new civic axis between the municipal government quarter and the Swan Lake commercial area, and is Hefei's principal venue for major sport and entertainment events. The 347,000 sqm (521-mu) site contains 153,000 sqm of building area built for about 1.5 billion yuan: a 60,000-seat main stadium, an 8,000-seat multi-purpose arena, a 3,000-seat swimming and diving hall, plus a three-star sports hotel, outdoor tennis and football courts, a warm-up training hall, commercial and leisure space and a five-ring fountain plaza. The stadium's seating runs around an oval bowl under a light steel truss roof, with a natural-turf pitch and 400 m synthetic track suited to athletics, football and stadium concerts; the arena switches between basketball, badminton, gymnastics and performance configurations, and the swimming hall offers a standard competition pool and diving platform with year-round public sessions. As the city's core sports asset, the centre has staged national single-sport championships, provincial games and a heavy calendar of commercial concerts, and it doubles as the everyday fitness base for residents of the surrounding civic district, where hotels, retail and offices cluster. Qianshan Road and Huaining Road carry bus routes on either side, Huanqu South Road closes the southern edge, and drivers reach the Jinzhai Road elevated section and the ring expressway within minutes; Hefei South railway station is roughly twenty minutes away.

address: 内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市新城区成吉思汗大街28号
intro_zh: 内蒙古体育馆位于呼和浩特市新城区成吉思汗大街28号，坐落在成吉思汗大街西侧，与呼和浩特体育场相邻，地铁2号线内蒙古体育馆站出站即到。现馆占地66,700平方米，建筑面积33,255平方米，馆体长170米、宽93米、高25米，由比赛馆和附属馆两部分组成。比赛馆设6,000个座位，场地可进行篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球、手球、摔跤、拳击等室内项目，也能承接大型文艺演出、杂技表演和其他集会活动；附属馆用于训练、热身和配套服务。场馆由内蒙古自治区体育场馆服务中心管理，日常向公众开放羽毛球、乒乓球等健身时段，公开，订场通过“蒙享动”平台办理。需要区分的是，1977年建于回民区新华大街的旧馆建筑面积15,376平方米、观众席5,374个，现以“内蒙古自治区体育场馆服务中心旧体育馆”的名称单独开放；本条收录的是成吉思汗大街现馆。成吉思汗大街沿线还聚集了呼和浩特体育场、游泳跳水馆等设施，共同构成呼和浩特最主要的体育场馆片区。
intro_en: Inner Mongolia Gymnasium stands at 28 Genghis Khan Avenue in Hohhot's Xincheng District, on the western side of the avenue next to Hohhot Stadium and immediately outside Inner Mongolia Gymnasium station on Metro Line 2. The present hall occupies a 66,700 sqm site with 33,255 sqm of floor area; the building measures 170 m long, 93 m wide and 25 m high and is divided into the competition hall and an ancillary hall. The competition hall seats 6,000 and can host basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, handball, wrestling and boxing, as well as large-scale variety performances, acrobatics and assemblies. The ancillary hall supports training, warm-up and back-of-house services. The venue is managed by the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Sports Venue Service Centre and opens badminton, table tennis and other fitness sessions to the public; the published telephone is not included in this public dataset, while court bookings are handled through the Mengxiangdong platform. By both floor area and seating it is one of the largest indoor venues in the autonomous region. A distinction matters here: the old hall built in 1977 on Xinhua Avenue in Huimin District, with 15,376 sqm of floor area and 5,374 seats, now operates separately as the Old Gymnasium of the regional sports venue service centre. This entry covers the Genghis Khan Avenue building. Together with Hohhot Stadium and the swimming and diving hall along the same avenue, it forms the city's main sports venue cluster. The venue is listed on the Inner Mongolia public fitness platform for badminton, table tennis, basketball, football and tennis, which reflects its mixed public-fitness and competition role.

address: 内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市新城区成吉思汗大街以南（气象局西巷以西、赛马场北路以北，与呼和浩特体育场一街之隔）
intro_zh: 呼和浩特体育中心是呼和浩特市体育局下属的公益二类事业单位，位于新城区成吉思汗大街，由呼和浩特体育场、游泳跳水馆、综合体育馆、扎达盖公园网球馆和运动员公寓组成，形成“一场、一校、二馆”的功能布局。游泳跳水馆与综合体育馆项目2013年立项、2014年开工，2021年建成并投入试运营，其中游泳跳水馆于2021年4月19日完工，是自治区成立70周年献礼工程和全市重点民生项目；两馆总用地63,192平方米，总建筑面积48,000平方米，总投资7.81亿元。游泳跳水馆单体建筑面积31,645.9平方米，水面约2,700平方米，设25米×50米十泳道比赛池、25米×21米跳水池（3米、5米、7.5米、10米跳台）和50米×15米热身池，观众席3,050座、贵宾席45座。综合体育馆高28米，地上三层，比赛大厅可在冰面与地面之间转换，固定座位2,200个、活动座位1,300个，合计3,500座，可进行篮球、排球、羽毛球、手球、击剑、台球、短道速滑和冰球比赛；馆外另设14.5米×45米的可移动冰壶场地，含三条标准冰壶道。中心公开。
intro_en: Hohhot Sports Center is a public-service unit under the Hohhot Municipal Sports Bureau, located on Genghis Khan Avenue in Xincheng District. It brings together Hohhot Stadium, the swimming and diving hall, the multi-purpose arena, the Zhadagai Park tennis hall and an athletes' residence, forming what the city describes as one stadium, one school and two halls. The swimming and diving hall and the arena were approved in 2013, started in 2014 and were completed and entered trial operation in 2021, with the swimming and diving hall finishing on 19 April, as a project marking the 70th anniversary of the autonomous region and a key municipal livelihood scheme. The two buildings share a 63,192 sqm site with 48,000 sqm of floor area and a total investment of 781 million yuan. The swimming and diving hall has 31,645.9 sqm of floor area and about 2,700 sqm of water: a 25 by 50 m ten-lane competition pool, a 25 by 21 m diving pool with 3, 5, 7.5 and 10 m platforms, and a 50 by 15 m warm-up pool, with 3,050 spectator seats and 45 VIP seats. The arena is 28 m high over three above-ground levels, and its competition hall can switch between ice and dry-floor configurations. It has 2,200 fixed and 1,300 movable seats, 3,500 in total, and hosts basketball, volleyball, badminton, handball, fencing, billiards, short-track speed skating and ice hockey. A 14.5 by 45 m movable curling rink with three standard sheets stands alongside. The centre's public telephone is not included in this public dataset. The two halls share circulation and service areas so that a single event can use both.

address: 内蒙古自治区呼和浩特市新城区成吉思汗大街30号（成吉思汗大街南侧）
intro_zh: 呼和浩特体育场位于新城区成吉思汗大街南侧、门牌成吉思汗大街30号，当地人称“新体育场”，以区别于1952年建成、位于公园东路的呼和浩特市人民体育场（“老体育场”）。体育场2005年6月开工，2007年7月6日竣工投用，投资约6亿元，是内蒙古自治区成立60周年献礼工程；占地约12.2公顷，建筑面积57,737平方米，设观众席51,632个。场内为天然草皮足球场和标准400米田径跑道，可承办大型足球、田径赛事；建筑造型取“大雁展翅”的意象，是呼和浩特的城市地标之一。2007年8月自治区成立60周年纪念大会在此举行；2009年9月中国国家队在此以4比1战胜博茨瓦纳队；2012年和2015年，这里先后作为呼和浩特东进、内蒙古中优两支中甲球队的主场。体育场也是呼和浩特大型演唱会的主要场地，周华健、刘德华、张学友、五月天、陈奕迅、周杰伦、张杰、薛之谦、邓紫棋等都曾在此开唱。场馆现由呼和浩特体育中心管理，公开，与游泳跳水馆、综合体育馆同处成吉思汗大街场馆群。
intro_en: Hohhot Stadium sits on the southern side of Genghis Khan Avenue at number 30 in Xincheng District. Locals call it the New Stadium to distinguish it from the People's Stadium built in 1952 on Gongyuan East Road. Work began in June 2005 and the ground opened on 6 July 2007 at a cost of about 600 million yuan, as a project marking the 60th anniversary of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. It occupies roughly 12.2 hectares, or 122,000 sqm, with 57,737 sqm of floor area and 51,632 seats. The pitch is natural grass and the running track is a standard 400 m oval, allowing the venue to stage major football and athletics meetings. The roof and stands are shaped to suggest a spreading wild goose, a form that has become one of Hohhot's urban landmarks. The regional anniversary assembly was held here in August 2007, and in September 2009 China beat Botswana 4-1 in an international friendly. In 2012 and 2015 it served as the home ground of Hohhot Dongjin and then Inner Mongolia Zhongyou in China League One. The stadium is also the city's main concert venue: Wakin Chau, Andy Lau, Jacky Cheung, Mayday, Eason Chan, Jay Chou, Jason Zhang, Joker Xue and G.E.M. have all performed here. Hohhot Sports Center manages the ground, whose public telephone is ; it forms a venue cluster on Genghis Khan Avenue with the swimming and diving hall and the multi-purpose arena. Its scale and central location keep it in use for major civic ceremonies as well as sport.

name_zh: 哈尔滨会展中心体育场
address: 黑龙江省哈尔滨市南岗区红旗大街301号（哈尔滨经济技术开发区会展中心区域内）
area_text: 中心总占地63公顷、总建筑面积约32万㎡；体育场单体建筑面积官方未单独公布
intro_zh: 哈尔滨会展中心体育场位于南岗区红旗大街301号，处在哈尔滨经济技术开发区会展中心区域内，是哈尔滨国际会展体育中心的主体育场，2004年由哈尔滨工大集团出资建成，可容纳48,000名观众，为哈尔滨规模最大的综合性体育场。体育场建成初期以演唱会、汽车交易等活动为主，场内一度没有草坪和塑胶跑道；2009年9月为承办中国队与塞内加尔队的友谊赛，哈尔滨市投入600余万元进行改造，此后逐步转为职业足球主场。2011年4月，大连毅腾迁至此处并改名哈尔滨毅腾，曾在这里创下15场主场连胜；2016年黑龙江火山鸣泉（后称黑龙江冰城）入驻，2017年11月5日在此夺得中国足球乙级联赛冠军。体育场同时是哈尔滨大型演出的主要场地，刘德华、周杰伦、张学友、张惠妹、莫文蔚、薛之谦、林俊杰等都曾在此开唱。中心区域总占地63公顷、总建筑面积约32万平方米，除体育场外还有10,603座的体育馆、A至D四个展馆、华旗饭店和红博商业。场馆公开；26、51、71、74、76、90、91、201、203路公交可达会展中心站。
intro_en: Harbin Convention and Exhibition Center Stadium stands at 301 Hongqi Avenue in Nangang District, inside the exhibition district of the Harbin Economic and Technological Development Zone. It is the main stadium of the Harbin International Conference, Exhibition and Sports Center, built in 2004 with funding from the Harbin Institute of Technology Group and seating 48,000, the largest capacity of any multi-purpose stadium in the city. In its early years the ground was used mainly for concerts and car-trade events and had neither a grass pitch nor a synthetic track. In September 2009, ahead of a friendly between China and Senegal, the city spent more than six million yuan on renovations, and the venue gradually became a professional football home. Dalian Yiteng moved here in April 2011 and renamed itself Harbin Yiteng, going on a 15-match home winning run. Heilongjiang Huoshan Mingquan, later Heilongjiang Ice City, arrived in 2016 and won the China League Two title here on 5 November 2017. The stadium remains a major concert site, with Andy Lau, Jay Chou, Jacky Cheung, A-Mei, Karen Mok, Joker Xue and JJ Lin among those who have performed. The wider complex covers 63 hectares with about 320,000 sqm of floor area, and also contains a 10,603-seat arena, exhibition halls A to D, the Huagi Hotel and Hongbo retail. The public telephone is not included in this public dataset, and buses 26, 51, 71, 74, 76, 90, 91, 201 and 203 stop at the Convention Center. Because the four exhibition halls and a hotel sit on the same campus, the stadium can be programmed alongside trade fairs and conventions.

name_zh: 哈尔滨国际会展体育中心体育场
address: 黑龙江省哈尔滨市南岗区红旗大街301号（会展中心区域内）
area_text: 综合体总用地63万㎡（63公顷）；体育场平面长247.5米、宽236.866米、最大高度53.9米
intro_zh: 哈尔滨国际会展体育中心体育场位于南岗区红旗大街301号，是哈尔滨国际会议展览体育中心的主场馆。体育场所在的综合体总用地面积63万平方米，整体平面呈椭圆形，长247.5米、宽236.866米，最大高度53.9米，观众席48,000个，2004年落成启用。它与10,603座的体育馆、A至D四个展览厅、华旗饭店、红博购物中心等共同组成一个集展览、体育、会议、酒店和商业于一体的超大型综合体，整片区域被黄河路、长江路、南直路和红旗大街围合。体育场以足球比赛和大型演唱会为主要用途，曾长期作为哈尔滨毅腾、黑龙江冰城的主场，也是哈尔滨承办国际足球友谊赛的场地之一；由于气候与养护原因，草皮多次更换，2012年曾整体重铺。交通方面，地铁3号线会展中心站直达，26、51、71、74、76、90、91、201、203路公交在会展中心站停靠；场馆公开。需要说明的是，公开资料对中心总建筑面积有32万平方米与36万平方米两种口径，本条采用32万平方米，体育场单体的建筑面积未见单独公布。
intro_en: Harbin International Conference, Exhibition and Sports Center Stadium at 301 Hongqi Avenue in Nangang District is the main stadium of the Harbin International Conference, Exhibition and Sports Center. The stadium project occupies a site of 630,000 sqm. Its elliptical plan measures 247.5 m by 236.866 m and rises to a maximum height of 53.9 m, with 48,000 seats; it opened in 2004. Together with the 10,603-seat indoor arena, exhibition halls A to D, the Huagi Hotel and the Hongbo shopping centre, it forms a very large complex combining exhibitions, sport, conferences, hospitality and retail, enclosed by Huanghe Road, Changjiang Road, Nanzhi Road and Hongqi Avenue. Football and large concerts are its main uses. It served for years as the home of Harbin Yiteng and Heilongjiang Ice City and has hosted international football friendlies; because of the climate and maintenance difficulties the turf was replaced several times, including a complete re-laying in 2012. Metro Line 3 stops at Convention and Exhibition Center station, and buses 26, 51, 71, 74, 76, 90, 91, 201 and 203 also serve the site. The public telephone is not included in this public dataset. Published figures for the complex's total floor area differ, at 320,000 and 360,000 sqm; this record uses 320,000 sqm, and no separate floor area for the stadium itself has been released. Its 53.9 m height and 247.5 m length make it the dominant structure on the exhibition campus. The complex as a whole was the main venue of the 2009 Winter Universiade and of the 2025 Asian Winter Games, with the stadium, arena and exhibition halls used together during both events.

name_zh: 哈尔滨国际会展体育中心体育馆
address: 黑龙江省哈尔滨市南岗区红旗大街301号（会展中心区域内）
area_text: 中心总占地63公顷、总建筑面积约32万㎡；体育馆单体建筑面积官方未单独公布
intro_zh: 哈尔滨国际会展体育中心体育馆位于南岗区红旗大街301号会展中心区域内，1999年动工、2004年落成，由哈尔滨工大集团出资建设，观众席10,603个，是黑龙江省规模最大、功能最齐全的室内体育馆。馆内可举办篮球、排球、冰球等室内赛事，2007年花样滑冰大奖赛中国站曾在此举行；2009年第24届世界大学生冬季运动会的开幕式、闭幕式及室内赛事在此举办；2025年第九届亚洲冬季运动会开幕式同样选择这座体育馆，使其成为少数两度承办国际综合性冬季运动会开闭幕式的室内场馆之一。体育馆与48,000座的体育场、A至D四个展览厅、华旗饭店、红博购物中心等共同构成哈尔滨国际会展体育中心，整片区域被黄河路、长江路、南直路和红旗大街围合，是哈尔滨会展与体育功能最集中的地段。交通方面，地铁3号线会展中心站直达，26、51、71、74、76、90、91、201、203路公交在会展中心站停靠。场馆公开；单体建筑面积未见官方单独公布，中心总建筑面积有32万平方米与36万平方米两种口径。
intro_en: Harbin International Conference, Exhibition and Sports Center Arena stands at 301 Hongqi Avenue in Nangang District. Construction began in 1999 and the hall opened in 2004, funded by the Harbin Institute of Technology Group. With 10,603 seats it is the largest and most comprehensively equipped indoor arena in Heilongjiang. It hosts basketball, volleyball, ice hockey and other indoor sports, and staged the Cup of China figure skating Grand Prix in 2007. The arena hosted the opening and closing ceremonies and indoor events of the 24th Winter Universiade in 2009, and it was chosen again for the opening ceremony of the 9th Asian Winter Games in 2025, making it one of the few indoor venues to have opened two international multi-sport winter games. Together with the 48,000-seat stadium, exhibition halls A to D, the Huagi Hotel and the Hongbo shopping centre, it forms the Harbin International Conference, Exhibition and Sports Center, a district enclosed by Huanghe Road, Changjiang Road, Nanzhi Road and Hongqi Avenue and the city's densest concentration of exhibition and sports facilities. Metro Line 3 stops at Convention and Exhibition Center station, and buses 26, 51, 71, 74, 76, 90, 91, 201 and 203 also serve the site. The public telephone is not included in this public dataset. No separate floor area for the arena has been published; the complex is variously given as 320,000 and 360,000 sqm. Its arena floor is used for both ice and court sports. Over two decades it has hosted national and international figure skating, basketball, volleyball and ice hockey fixtures, as well as concerts and ceremonies.

name_zh: 哈尔滨奥林匹克体育中心
address: 黑龙江省哈尔滨市南岗区红旗大街301号（哈尔滨国际会展体育中心，会展中心区域内）
area_text: 中心总占地63公顷、总建筑面积约32万㎡；室内展览面积约7万㎡
intro_zh: 需要先说明名称口径：截至本次检索，公开资料中没有以“哈尔滨奥林匹克体育中心”独立命名的场馆，公开资料中与“奥体中心”形态最接近的大型场馆群是哈尔滨国际会展体育中心，位于南岗区红旗大街301号；本条按该场馆群收录，名称按任务单原样保留，不把其他城市或规划中项目的参数混入。中心总占地63公顷，总建筑面积约32万平方米，由48,000座的体育场、10,603座的体育馆、A至D四个展览厅、华旗饭店、红博购物中心等组成，是集展览、体育、会议、酒店与商业于一体的超大型综合体。室内展览面积约7万平方米，可设3,400余个国际标准展位；体育馆曾承办2009年世界大学生冬季运动会开闭幕式，并于2025年承办第九届亚洲冬季运动会开幕式。体育场以足球和演唱会为主，曾为哈尔滨毅腾、黑龙江冰城主场。整片区域被黄河路、长江路、南直路和红旗大街围合，地铁3号线会展中心站直达，26、51、71、74、76、90、91、201、203路公交可达。公开。若后续出现独立的哈尔滨奥体中心项目，应另立条目，不与本条合并。
intro_en: A note on naming comes first. As of this research, no separately named venue called Harbin Olympic Sports Center could be found in public sources. The large complex in Harbin that matches the form of an Olympic sports centre is the Harbin International Conference, Exhibition and Sports Center at 301 Hongqi Avenue in Nangang District, and this record covers that complex while keeping the name given in the task list. No data from other cities or from planned projects has been mixed in. The centre occupies 63 hectares with about 320,000 sqm of floor area. It comprises a 48,000-seat stadium, a 10,603-seat arena, exhibition halls A to D, the Huagi Hotel and the Hongbo shopping centre, forming an unusually large combination of exhibition, sport, conference, hospitality and retail functions. The indoor exhibition area is about 70,000 sqm and can accommodate more than 3,400 international-standard booths. The arena hosted the opening and closing ceremonies of the 2009 Winter Universiade and the opening ceremony of the 9th Asian Winter Games in 2025. The stadium is used mainly for football and concerts and has been the home of Harbin Yiteng and Heilongjiang Ice City. The site is bounded by Huanghe Road, Changjiang Road, Nanzhi Road and Hongqi Avenue; Metro Line 3 stops at Convention and Exhibition Center station, and buses 26, 51, 71, 74, 76, 90, 91, 201 and 203 also serve it. The public telephone is not included in this public dataset. Should a standalone Harbin Olympic Sports Center project appear later, it should be recorded separately rather than merged into this entry.

address: 天津市静海区团泊新城西区体育大道与常海道交口
area_text: 占地14.23公顷，总建筑面积8万平方米
intro_zh: 天津国际网球中心位于静海区团泊新城西区，毗邻团泊湖湿地与萨马兰奇纪念馆，2010年6月动工、2012年落成，2013年8月14日正式启用，曾名天津团泊国际网球中心。中心由中心赛场、半决赛场、室内网球馆、室外预赛场与练习场及体育会所组成，占地14.23公顷，总建筑面积约8万平方米，中心赛场可容纳3366名观众，另配12片室外灯光球场和4片室内比赛级球场，合计16片专业场地，并设有20球道保龄球馆与台球设施。这里承办过2013年第六届东亚运动会网球比赛、2013至2017年ITF国际男子与女子网球巡回赛、WTA天津公开赛以及近年多站ITF赛事，是天津职业网球赛事与青少年培训的主要承载地。看台沿中心球场四周布置，罩棚覆盖观众席，场地面层、灯光与转播条件按职业赛事配置。交通上，场馆位于团泊新城西区体育大道与常海道交口，距天津市区约30公里，经津沧高速、团泊大道可达，周边为团泊健康城的体育、康养与居住片区，萨马兰奇纪念馆、尚柏奥特莱斯步行可达。
intro_en: Tianjin International Tennis Center sits in the western start-up zone of Tuanbo New Town, Jinghai District, beside Tuanbo Lake wetland and the Samaranch Memorial. Work began in June 2010, the complex was completed in 2012 and opened on 14 August 2013; it was formerly called Tianjin Tuanbo International Tennis Center. The site covers 14.23 hectares with about 80,000 sqm of building floor area, organised around a centre court seating 3,366 spectators, a semi-final court, an indoor tennis hall, outdoor qualifying and practice courts, and a clubhouse. Sixteen professional courts are available, twelve outdoor floodlit courts and four indoor match-grade courts, together with a 20-lane bowling centre and billiard facilities. The venue staged the tennis competition of the 6th East Asian Games in 2013, the ITF men's and women's World Tennis Tour events between 2013 and 2017, the WTA Tianjin Open and, in recent years, a growing number of ITF and junior tournaments, making it the main base for professional tennis in the city. Seating wraps the centre court under a shaded roof, and court surfaces, lighting and broadcast provisions are built to tour standards. The centre stands at the junction of Tiyu Avenue and Changhai Road, roughly 30 km from central Tianjin and reached via the Jin-Cang expressway and Tuanbo Avenue, within the sports, health and residential district of Tuanbo Health City; the Samaranch Memorial and an outlet mall are within walking distance. The centre is owned by Tianjin Binhai Tuanbo New Town Investment and Development and operated by the municipal sports bureau.

address: 天津市南开区复康路9号（增2号）
area_text: 占地约7万平方米，主馆建筑面积5400平方米
intro_zh: 天津网球中心位于南开区复康路9号，处中环线复康路沿线，2010年4月开工，2013年4月5日正式启用，是2013年第六届东亚运动会网球比赛场馆。主馆南北长105米、东西宽45米，建筑面积5400平方米，看台设3400个座席，场内可同时布置6个台区比赛；场地铺设塑胶面层，墙面与屋顶采用浅绿色吸音矿棉板，配运动员休息室、裁判员休息室、贵宾室、新闻发布厅及电视转播条件。中心占地约7万平方米，除主馆外还有两座各含6片室内球场的训练比赛馆、1片可容纳1000名观众的室外比赛场以及24片室外训练场，合计38片网球场，是天津中心城区场地数量较多的网球基地。启用当年即承办戴维斯杯亚大区I组附加赛，此后承接东亚运动会软式网球、第十三届全运会网球以及多项职业与青少年赛事，平日向社会开放场地预订与培训。场馆紧邻中环线复康路，从八里台、王顶堤方向均可快速到达，多条公交线路在门前停靠，周边为南开区高校与成熟居住区。
intro_en: Tianjin Tennis Center stands at 9 Fukan Road in Nankai District, along the Fukan Road section of the middle ring. Construction started in April 2010 and the centre opened on 5 April 2013 as the tennis venue for the 6th East Asian Games. The main hall measures 105 m north to south and 45 m east to west, with 5,400 sqm of floor area and seating for 3,400 spectators; six match courts can operate inside at the same time. Courts are laid with a synthetic surface, walls and ceiling are finished in pale green acoustic mineral wool, and the building includes athlete and referee rooms, a VIP lounge, a press conference room and television broadcast provisions. The centre covers about 70,000 sqm in total. Beyond the main hall there are two indoor training and competition buildings with six courts each, an outdoor match court seating 1,000 and 24 outdoor practice courts, 38 courts altogether, which makes it one of the busiest tennis bases in central Tianjin. In its opening year it hosted the Davis Cup Asia/Oceania Zone Group I play-off, followed by East Asian Games soft tennis, the tennis events of the 13th National Games and a long run of professional and junior tournaments; courts are also let to the public for booking and coaching. The site sits directly on Fukan Road, easily reached from Balitai and Wangdingdi, with several bus routes stopping at the gate and universities and established residential districts around it. The centre is owned by the Tianjin municipal government and operated by the municipal sports bureau.

address: 天津市和平区贵州路33号
area_text: 占地28140平方米，建筑面积15700平方米
intro_zh: 天津人民体育馆位于和平区贵州路33号，1954年动工、1955年12月完工、1956年正式启用，是天津现存较早的大型室内体育馆之一，2019年入选第四批中国20世纪建筑遗产名录。馆舍占地28140平方米，建筑面积15700平方米，主馆设3462个观众座席，配备空调、声控、灯光照明与电视转播系统，院内另设训练馆、健身室、室外灯光篮球场与塑胶网球场。建筑座东北朝西南，自成院落，立面在西洋古典构图基础上融入传统装饰细部，是贵州路—五大道一带的城市记忆节点。启用后长期承担天津市大型活动与重要会议，1987年海鸥杯国际女排邀请赛以该馆为主赛场，此后承接排球、篮球、乒乓球、羽毛球、体操等赛事以及文艺演出、展览和群众集会。场馆地处和平区核心，贵州路与成都道、马场道相接，步行可达五大道历史街区，周边公交线路密集、地铁站点临近，办赛、演出与日常健身使用强度都较高，是中心城区少有的老馆改造型综合体育馆。
intro_en: Tianjin People's Gymnasium occupies 33 Guizhou Road in Heping District. Work started in 1954, the building was finished in December 1955 and opened in 1956, making it one of the oldest large indoor sports halls still in use in the city; in 2019 it was listed in the fourth batch of China's 20th-century architectural heritage. The compound covers 28,140 sqm with 15,700 sqm of floor area. The main hall seats 3,462 spectators and is equipped with air conditioning, sound control, stage and sports lighting and television broadcast systems, while the grounds also hold a training hall, a fitness room, outdoor floodlit basketball courts and synthetic tennis courts. Oriented north-east to south-west and enclosed as its own courtyard, the building combines a classical Western composition with traditional decorative detail and remains a landmark of the Guizhou Road and Wudadao area. Since opening it has carried many of Tianjin's major ceremonies and conferences; the 1987 Seagull Cup international women's volleyball invitation tournament used the hall as its main venue, and it has since hosted volleyball, basketball, table tennis, badminton and gymnastics events as well as concerts, exhibitions and public gatherings. Standing in the heart of Heping District where Guizhou Road meets Chengdu and Machang roads, it is a short walk from the Wudadao historic quarter, well served by buses and metro, and heavily used for both competition and daily fitness. It is owned by the municipal government and run by the municipal sports bureau, and the main hall still carries volleyball and basketball fixtures, trade shows and public fitness sessions through the year.

address: 天津市南开区宾水西道（卫津南路西侧）
area_text: 用地12.23万平方米，建筑面积5.4万平方米
intro_zh: 天津体育馆位于南开区宾水西道、卫津南路西侧，与天津广播电视塔相邻，1992年9月28日动工、1994年12月建成、1995年启用，为举办第43届世界乒乓球锦标赛而建。主馆为圆形飞碟状造型，市民称其为“飞碟”或“大馆”，用地面积12.23万平方米，建筑面积5.4万平方米，建筑高度53米；主馆建筑面积24677平方米，屋盖跨度108米，设固定座席6713个、活动座席2378个，场地内设200米室内田径跑道，可承接国际室内田径比赛。1995年世乒赛、1999年世界体操锦标赛、2013年东亚运动会开幕式均在此举行，此后长期承办排球、篮球、乒乓球、羽毛球赛事以及大型演唱会、展会与年会。场馆与奥体中心体育场“水滴”、游泳跳水馆“第三滴水”隔湖相望，共同构成宾水西道体育建筑群。交通方面，场馆北临宾水西道、东靠卫津南路，地铁6号线及多条公交线路可达，周边为水上公园、奥城商业区与宾馆群，办赛期间人流集散条件较好。场馆现为天津市重要的大型室内活动场地，承担赛事、演出与展会等多类用途。
intro_en: Tianjin Gymnasium stands on Binshui West Road, west of Weijin South Road in Nankai District, next to the Tianjin radio and television tower. Construction began on 28 September 1992, the building was completed in December 1994 and opened in 1995 for the 43rd World Table Tennis Championships. Its circular, saucer-like form earned it the local names Feidie, the flying saucer, or simply the Big Hall. The site covers 122,300 sqm with 54,000 sqm of floor area and a height of 53 m; the main hall alone has 24,677 sqm, a roof span of 108 m, 6,713 fixed seats and 2,378 movable seats, and a 200 m indoor athletics track that allows international indoor meetings. The 1995 world table tennis championships, the 1999 world gymnastics championships and the opening ceremony of the 2013 East Asian Games were all held here, and it has since hosted volleyball, basketball, table tennis and badminton events along with large concerts, exhibitions and corporate conferences. The hall faces the Water Drop stadium and the swimming and diving hall known as the third drop across an artificial lake, forming the Binshui West Road sports cluster. Bounded by Binshui West Road to the north and Weijin South Road to the east, it is served by Metro Line 6 and several bus routes, with the Water Park, the Olympic City retail district and a cluster of hotels around it that help absorb event-day crowds. The hall is owned by the municipal government and operated by the sports bureau, and it remains a regular stop for national league volleyball and basketball fixtures.

name_zh: 天津奥林匹克体育中心游泳跳水馆
address: 天津市南开区红旗南路586号增1号（奥林匹克中心内）
area_text: 建筑面积37002平方米
intro_zh: 天津奥林匹克体育中心游泳跳水馆位于南开区宾水西道奥林匹克中心内、红旗南路586号增1号，2009年奠基、2011年落成，曾名天津奥林匹克中心水上中心。馆体为钢筋混凝土结构，地下一层、地上局部四层，南北长154米、东西宽102米，建筑面积37002平方米，建筑最大高度31.15米；上部钢结构采用空间钢桁架，跨度64米、共12榀，外圈刚架与内圈桁架连成整体。馆内设50米、10泳道比赛池，10米跳台，3米板3块、1米板2块，观众座席2981个、主席台28席、活动座席616个，可容纳近4000人观赛，另配50米6泳道热身池以及运动员更衣室、裁判员休息室、兴奋剂检测站、贵宾室和新闻发布厅。场馆外观似迎风的水滴，与体育场“水滴”、体育馆“大馆”并称“三滴水”。这里承办2013年东亚运动会游泳与跳水比赛、2017年第十三届全运会游泳、跳水和花样游泳项目以及全国游泳锦标赛，平时向社会开放游泳健身。场馆北邻天津体育馆，西与体育场隔湖相望。
intro_en: The Swimming and Diving Hall of the Tianjin Olympic Sports Center stands inside the Olympic complex at 586-1 Hongqi South Road, Nankai District. The foundation stone was laid in 2009 and the building was completed in 2011; it was formerly called the Tianjin Olympic Center Aquatic Center. A reinforced concrete structure with one basement level and up to four storeys above ground, it measures 154 m north to south and 102 m east to west, with 37,002 sqm of floor area and a maximum height of 31.15 m. The upper steel structure uses a space truss with a 64 m span across twelve trusses, tied into an outer rigid frame. Inside are a 50 m competition pool with ten lanes, a 10 m platform, three 3 m springboards and two 1 m boards, with 2,981 fixed seats, 28 seats on the main stand and 616 movable seats, giving a capacity of nearly 4,000 spectators. A 50 m six-lane warm-up pool, athlete changing rooms, referee rooms, a doping control station, VIP lounge and press conference room complete the programme. The exterior resembles a drop of water driven by the wind, and together with the stadium known as the Water Drop and the gymnasium it forms the so-called three drops of the Olympic centre. The hall hosted swimming and diving at the 2013 East Asian Games, swimming, diving and synchronised swimming at the 13th National Games in 2017 and national swimming championships, and opens its pools to public swimmers between events. It sits north of Tianjin Gymnasium and faces the stadium across the lake.

address: 天津市河北区铁东路（北宁公园南侧）
area_text: 使用面积21000平方米
status_note: 无对外座机，仅地图商户页手机号，未入库
intro_zh: 天津火车头体育场位于河北区北宁公园南侧、铁东路一侧，又称中国铁路工会天津火车头体育场，始建于20世纪50年代初，原为天津铁路分局职工与家属开展体育活动的场地，也是中国火车头足球队训练比赛的基地。1992年由铁道部、北京铁路局与天津铁路分局共同投资1600万元在原址重建，1994年主体竣工投用，建成水泥看台12000个座席、400米塑胶跑道、标准足球场、主席台、贵宾室与运动员休息室。2005年因京津城际铁路过境拆除西看台，2008年北宁公园改造期间停止对外开放，2015年5月整修后重新开放并增建两块标准足球场，使用面积达到21000平方米，2016年重建西看台。球场现为火车头足球俱乐部训练基地，同时向周边居民开放，承担足球、田径训练与日常健身。场馆紧邻北宁公园与天津北站片区，铁东路、中山北路在此交汇，多路公交可达，是河北区少有的带固定看台的足球场，也是天津铁路系统体育传统的实物见证。
intro_en: Tianjin Huochetou Stadium, also known as the China Railway Union Tianjin Locomotive Stadium, lies on the southern edge of Beining Park along Tiedong Road in Hebei District. First built in the early 1950s as a sports ground for Tianjin railway bureau staff and their families, it also served as the training and match base of the China Locomotive football team. In 1992 the Ministry of Railways, the Beijing Railway Bureau and the Tianjin Railway Branch invested 16 million yuan to rebuild it on the same site; the main structure was finished and opened in 1994 with concrete terracing for 12,000 seats, a 400 m synthetic track, a standard football pitch, a main stand, VIP room and athletes' changing rooms. The west stand was demolished in 2005 when the Beijing-Tianjin intercity railway passed through, the ground closed in 2008 during the remodelling of Beining Park, and it reopened in May 2015 after refurbishment with two additional full-size football pitches, bringing the usable area to 21,000 sqm; the west stand was rebuilt in 2016. The stadium now serves as the training base of the Huochetou football club while remaining open to nearby residents for football, athletics and daily exercise. Adjacent to Beining Park and the Tianjin North railway station area, where Tiedong Road meets Zhongshan North Road and several bus routes pass, it is one of the few football grounds in Hebei District with permanent terracing and a physical record of the city's railway sporting tradition. The ground is owned and operated by the railway authorities.

name_zh: 天津奥林匹克中心体育场
address: 天津市南开区宾水西道3号
area_text: 占地7.8万㎡；建筑面积15.8万㎡
intro_zh: 天津奥林匹克中心体育场位于天津市南开区宾水西道3号，坐落在市区西南部的天津奥林匹克中心内，东临卫津南路、西临水上东路、南临红旗南路、北临宾水西道，因形似水滴而被称作“水滴”。体育场2003年8月开工，2007年8月19日启用，由日本佐藤综合计划公司设计，占地7.8万平方米，建筑面积15.8万平方米，设54696个座位，是2008年北京奥运会足球比赛场地之一，落成时是中国规模仅次于国家体育场的第二大综合体育场。建筑南北长380米、东西长270米、高53米，设计分为六层：一层设22670平方米室内停车场、3460平方米展示场、6400平方米餐饮用房、5930平方米健康中心和4010平方米竞赛用房，二层设3840平方米专卖店，三层设4320平方米健身厅，四层设4166平方米包厢和3030平方米国际会议中心。场地周边环绕约12万平方米湖面，与天津体育馆、水上运动中心共同组成体育中心建筑群。这里长期作为天津津门虎足球俱乐部主场，也承办大型演唱会与商业赛事。交通方面，地铁5号线设体育中心站，周边为宾水西道、红旗南路与卫津南路。
intro_en: Tianjin Olympic Centre Stadium stands at 3 Binshui West Road in Nankai District, inside the Tianjin Olympic Centre in the south-west of the city, bounded by Weijin South Road, Shuishang East Road, Hongqi South Road and Binshui West Road. Its water-drop form gives it the nickname Shuidi, the Water Drop. Construction began in August 2003 and the stadium opened on 19 August 2007; designed by Sato Comprehensive Planning of Japan, it covers 78,000 sqm with 158,000 sqm of floor area and 54,696 seats. It was a football venue of the 2008 Beijing Olympics and, when completed, was China's second-largest comprehensive stadium after the National Stadium. The building measures 380 m north to south, 270 m east to west and 53 m high across six levels. The ground floor holds a 22,670 sqm indoor car park, a 3,460 sqm exhibition area, 6,400 sqm of dining space, a 5,930 sqm health centre and 4,010 sqm of competition rooms; the second floor has 3,840 sqm of shops, the third a 4,320 sqm fitness hall, and the fourth 4,166 sqm of boxes plus a 3,030 sqm international conference centre. A lake of about 120,000 sqm wraps the site, shared with the Tianjin Gymnasium and aquatic centre. It is the long-standing home of Tianjin Jinmen Tiger and hosts concerts and commercial events. Metro Line 5 stops at Sports Centre station. The stadium is owned by the Tianjin municipal government and run by the municipal sports bureau, and its pitch was fitted with undersoil heating in 2018 using more than 31,000 m of pipe.
source: zh.wikipedia.org/天津奥林匹克中心体育场；天津市体育局 ty.tj.gov.cn

address: 天津市滨海新区奥运路（泰达大街交叉口东北侧，泰达时尚广场南侧）
area_text: 占地约6.3万㎡；总建筑面积约8.1万㎡
intro_zh: 泰达足球场位于天津市滨海新区奥运路，在泰达大街交叉口东北侧、泰达时尚广场南侧，是继上海虹口足球场之后中国第二座专业足球场。球场2002年6月开工，2004年4月竣工投用，占地约6.3万平方米，总建筑面积约8.1万平方米，设约3.6万个全坐席，总投资约5.3亿元，由美国派森斯公司设计，2005年获中国建筑工程鲁班奖。场内不设田径跑道，观众席贴近场地，比赛场地长105米、宽68米，四周设深1.4米、宽1.8米的安全壕沟，草坪下设加热系统以防冬季结冻。看台东西两侧为四层、南北两侧为二层，三层设贵宾包厢，约70%的座席有顶棚遮盖。2004年5月承办首届中超开幕式，2004年至2013年共举办107场中超、3场足协杯、2场中超杯和9场亚冠赛事。2015年天津港爆炸事故后球场受损并因地面沉降关闭，2023年7月完成提升改造后回归，采用国际足联锚固草技术，成为天津津门虎的双主场之一，也是2023年亚洲杯原定比赛场地。交通方面，津滨轻轨9号线会展中心站距球场约570米。
intro_en: TEDA Football Stadium stands on Aoyun Road in Binhai New Area, north-east of its junction with TEDA Avenue and south of TEDA Fashion Plaza, and was the second specialist football ground in China after Shanghai Hongkou. Work began in June 2002 and the stadium opened in April 2004, covering about 63,000 sqm with some 81,000 sqm of floor area, roughly 36,000 all-seater places and a total investment of about 530 million yuan. Designed by Parsons of the United States, it won a Luban Prize in 2005. There is no running track, so spectators sit close to a pitch measuring 105 m by 68 m, surrounded by a safety moat 1.4 m deep and 1.8 m wide, with undersoil heating to prevent winter freezing. The east and west stands rise four tiers, the north and south stands two, VIP boxes occupy the third tier, and about 70 per cent of seats are covered. The stadium staged the opening of the first Chinese Super League season in May 2004 and between 2004 and 2013 hosted 107 CSL, three FA Cup, two CSL Cup and nine AFC Champions League matches. Damaged in the 2015 Tianjin port explosion and closed because of ground settlement, it reopened in July 2023 after renovation using FIFA-standard anchored grass, becoming one of Tianjin Jinmen Tiger's two home grounds. Metro Line 9 at Convention and Exhibition Centre station is about 570 m away. The ground is owned by Tianjin TEDA Investment Holding and operated by Tianjin Jinmen Tiger; the 2023 renovation added a mixed zone and a news conference room and replanned the dressing rooms.

name_zh: 天津市海河教育园体育中心
address: 天津市津南区海河教育园区体育环路5号（19号门）
area_text: 体育场建筑面积约4.3万㎡；游泳馆建筑面积1.2万㎡
intro_zh: 天津市海河教育园体育中心位于天津市津南区海河教育园区体育环路5号，19号门临体育环路，是天津市体育局直属的大型体育场馆，主要承担承办赛事、运动队训练保障、全民健身服务和体育产业拓展等职能，内设综合办公室、经营科等四个科室。体育中心2011年1月开工，2012年6月竣工、9月启用，体育场建筑面积约4.3万平方米，设符合国际标准的8跑道田径场和标准足球场，观众固定坐席约2.9万个，南北两侧另设残疾人坐席及陪同坐席180个，可承接田径、足球等赛事。2012年9月这里承办第九届全国大学生运动会部分赛事，2013年承办东亚运动会女子足球项目，2016年至2018年作为天津权健足球俱乐部主场。配套的游泳馆2012年建成，用地1.5万平方米、总建筑面积1.2万平方米，由比赛池、训练池和戏水池组成，设四个更衣室，可满足200人同时游泳，二层另有两片羽毛球场。体育中心地处海河教育园区，周边聚集多所高校与职业院校，是津南区全民健身和校园体育的重要载体。交通方面，场馆经天津大道、津港公路可达，园区内以公交和校际班车接驳为主。
intro_en: Tianjin Haihe Education Park Sports Centre stands at 5 Tiyu Huan Road in the Haihe Education Park, Jinnan District, with gate 19 opening onto the ring road. A large venue directly under the Tianjin Municipal Sports Bureau, it is responsible for staging events, supporting team training, delivering public fitness services and developing sports business, and is organised into four departments including a general office and an operations section. Construction started in January 2011, the centre was completed in June 2012 and opened that September. The stadium has about 43,000 sqm of floor area, an eight-lane athletics track and a standard football pitch built to international specifications, roughly 29,000 fixed seats and a further 180 seats for spectators with disabilities and their companions in the north and south stands, allowing it to stage athletics and football. It hosted part of the ninth National University Games in September 2012 and women's football at the 2013 East Asian Games, and served as the home of Tianjin Quanjian from 2016 to 2018. The accompanying swimming hall, completed in 2012, occupies 15,000 sqm of land with 12,000 sqm of floor area and contains a competition pool, a training pool and a leisure pool, four changing rooms for 200 swimmers at a time and two badminton courts on the first floor. The centre sits among universities and vocational colleges and is a focus for fitness and school sport in Jinnan. Tianjin Avenue and Jingang Highway provide road access. The swimming hall is open to the public with its competition, training and leisure pools, and the centre also runs badminton and fitness programmes for local residents alongside school and district competitions.
