address: 山西省太原市万柏林区和平北路北段
website: https://www.sxtywbl.gov.cn/（万柏林区人民政府门户；场馆未单独建站）
intro_zh: 万柏林体育场坐落在太原市万柏林区和平北路北段，1956年筹建、1957年建成投用，是太原六个城区中较早向群众开放的体育场之一。场地占地45,666平方米，设足球场和400米标准田径场，东西两面为简易看台和主席台，西北部布置办公楼、篮球场、网球场、门球场和手球场，看台座位约2,000个，草坪为人造草皮。2003年太原拓宽道路时占用了体育场11亩土地，田径场南段、小足球场和部分看台被拆除；同年8月区政府启动整修，因资金不到位一度停工，2008年4月复工，当年9至10月重新投用，投资约3,000万元。2012年，新成立的中乙球队山西嘉怡曾把这里作为主场，后因场地承接商业活动而迁出。2025年5月，太原市第十三届运动会在此开幕；2026年7月，中部六省足球邀请赛在此举行。体育场产权属万柏林区政府，周边是国营大企业社区，晨练人数众多，承担的主要功能是群众健身、青少年足球和区级运动会。场馆没有独立官网和公开直线电话，开放安排由万柏林区体育主管部门发布。
intro_en: Wanbailin Stadium stands on the northern section of Heping North Road in Taiyuan's Wanbailin District. Planned in 1956 and opened in 1957, it is one of the earliest grounds in the city's six urban districts to be opened to ordinary residents. The 45,666 sqm site contains a football pitch and a standard 400 m athletics track, with simple stands and a main rostrum on the east and west sides. The north-west corner holds an office building, basketball courts, tennis courts, gateball courts and handball courts. Seating is about 2,000 and the playing surface is artificial turf. When Taiyuan widened the road in 2003, 11 mu of the stadium land was taken and the southern section of the track, the small football pitch and part of the stands were demolished. The district government began renovations in August that year, but work stalled for lack of funds; it restarted in April 2008 and the ground reopened in September and October after an investment of about 30 million yuan. In 2012 the newly formed China League Two club Shanxi Jiayi used the stadium as its home until commercial events forced a move. The 13th Taiyuan Municipal Games opened here in May 2025, and the six-province Central China football invitation tournament was held here in July 2026. Surrounded by the residential quarters of large state-owned enterprises, the ground serves mass fitness, youth football and district-level games. It has no standalone website or published direct line; opening arrangements are issued by the district sports authority. The ground is owned by the Wanbailin District government.

address: 山西省太原市万柏林区漪汾街1号（汾河西岸、漪汾桥西侧）
intro_zh: 太原市滨河体育中心位于万柏林区漪汾街1号，地处汾河西岸、漪汾桥西侧，隶属太原市体育局。中心1998年建成，2017年启动改扩建，2019年完成并重新投用。改造前占地150亩、建筑面积21,300平方米；改造后占地近300亩，建筑面积104,409.9平方米，其中场馆49,032.53平方米、地下车库55,377.37平方米、绿地78,550.7平方米，绿地率约40%，主建筑东西长约261米、南北长约113米。中心设比赛馆、全民健身馆、游泳馆、乒乓球训练馆、室外网球场和南北地下车库；比赛馆与全民健身馆为连体建筑，内外由走廊联通，游泳馆和乒乓球训练馆包含在全民健身馆内。比赛馆建筑面积21,216平方米、高23.95米、地上四层、4,650座，比赛场50米×33米，一层为竞赛功能区和运动员、裁判、会议、贵宾用房，二三层为观众集散与服务区，四层为包厢和设备用房；全民健身馆27,817平方米、高23米，地下一层、地上三层，设活动座位；游泳馆位于两馆中部地下，设10条泳道。2024年1月，“太原市滨河体育中心”微信小程序上线，可实时查看场地并在线订场。中心承办过第二届全国青年运动会乒乓球比赛以及“锦绣杯”羽毛球、篮球系列赛事。
intro_en: Taiyuan Riverside Sports Center occupies 1 Yifen Street in Wanbailin District, on the western bank of the Fen River beside the Yifen Bridge, and reports to the Taiyuan Municipal Sports Bureau. Built in 1998, it was rebuilt and extended from 2017 and reopened in 2019. Before the works the site covered 150 mu with 21,300 sqm of floor area; it now extends over nearly 300 mu with 104,409.9 sqm, of which 49,032.53 sqm is buildings, 55,377.37 sqm is underground parking and 78,550.7 sqm is green space, a green ratio of about 40 percent. The main building runs about 261 m east to west and 113 m north to south. The centre contains a competition hall, a fitness hall, a swimming pool, a table tennis training hall, outdoor tennis courts and two underground car parks. The competition hall and fitness hall are joined into one structure linked internally by corridors, while the pool and table tennis hall sit inside the fitness hall. The competition hall has 21,216 sqm of floor area, stands 23.95 m high over four levels and seats 4,650 around a 50 by 33 m field; the ground floor holds competition areas and rooms for athletes, referees, meetings and guests, the middle levels handle spectator circulation and the top floor contains boxes and plant. The fitness hall has 27,817 sqm at 23 m high, one basement and three upper levels, with movable seating, and the pool in the basement between the two halls has ten lanes. A WeChat mini-program launched in January 2024 shows live availability and allows online booking. The centre has hosted table tennis at the second National Youth Games and the Jinxiu Cup badminton and basketball series.

address: 山西省太原市晋源区健康南街1号
intro_zh: 山西体育中心位于太原市晋源区健康南街1号，西临晋阳湖、东依汾河，处在太原城市南部晋阳湖片区的核心位置，是山西省迄今规模最大、功能最全的公益性体育设施，也是太原“第四代”体育场馆的代表。园区总占地1238亩（约82.5万平方米），总建筑面积273812平方米，由“一场六馆两配套”构成：以“红灯笼”体育场为核心，另有汾酒体育馆、游泳跳水馆、自行车馆、球类训练馆、综合训练馆和射击射箭馆，并配套运动员公寓楼与山西国际体育交流中心，具备承办全国综合性运动会和国际单项比赛的能力。主体育场建筑面积90066平方米，设6万个观众坐席，场内铺设国际田联标准400米赛道与国际足联标准足球草坪，南北方位配有大型彩色显示屏。建筑以“大鼓之形、灯笼之构、剪纸之饰”为设计理念，中国红主色调配合透明阳光板模拟剪纸的图底关系，夜景下如一盏亮起的灯笼，是太原辨识度最高的体育建筑之一。这里同时是国家体育综合训练基地和国家全民健身示范基地，自行车、体操、田径、游泳、武术、空手道、跆拳道七个国家训练基地落户于此。2023年至2025年，园区累计举办大型演艺活动36场，吸引观众172万人次，第二届全国青年运动会开幕式、奥运摔跤选拔赛、中巴国际足球赛等赛事也在此举行。交通上，场馆经滨河西路、健康南街直达，紧邻晋阳湖公园与汾河景观带，公交与自驾均较便利。
intro_en: Shanxi Sports Center stands at No. 1 Jiankang South Street in Jinyuan District, Taiyuan, with Jinyang Lake to the west and the Fen River to the east, anchoring the city's southern Jinyang Lake district. It is the largest and most complete public sports complex Shanxi has built, and the province's benchmark fourth-generation venue. The 1,238-mu (about 825,333 sqm) site contains 273,812 sqm of floor area arranged as one stadium, six halls and two supporting buildings: the Red Lantern stadium, a basketball hall, a swimming and diving hall, a velodrome, a ball-sports training hall, a multi-purpose training hall and a shooting and archery hall, plus an athletes' residence and the Shanxi International Sports Exchange Center. The main stadium alone covers 90,066 sqm with 60,000 seats, a World Athletics-standard 400 m track and a FIFA-standard pitch, and can stage national multi-sport games and international single-sport championships. Its design borrows the shape of a drum, the structure of a lantern and the ornament of paper-cut art; the red palette and translucent polycarbonate panels mimic paper-cut negative space, so the building reads as a lit lantern at night. The complex is a national comprehensive training base and a national fitness demonstration base, hosting seven national training centres for cycling, gymnastics, athletics, swimming, wushu, karate and taekwondo. Between 2023 and 2025 it staged 36 concerts and events drawing 1.72 million spectators, alongside the opening ceremony of the second National Youth Games and international football and wrestling fixtures. Access is via Binhe West Road and Jiankang South Street, next to Jinyang Lake Park and the Fen River greenway.

name_zh: 宁波半边山沙滩排球中心
address: 浙江省宁波市象山县石浦镇东海半边山旅游度假区内
area_text: 占地90余亩（约6万㎡）；总建筑面积超2万㎡
intro_zh: 宁波半边山沙滩排球中心位于宁波市象山县石浦镇东海半边山旅游度假区内，2020年6月开工，历经284天竣工，2021年9月通过赛事功能验收，2022年4月通过杭州亚运会沙滩排球项目技术代表验收。项目占地90余亩，总建筑面积超过2万平方米，包含一座C字形半开放式主场馆（内设一片主场地）、一座副场馆、5片热身训练场地以及比赛配套基础设施。主场馆可容纳观众2,000余人，副场馆可容纳500人。场馆翠峰环绕、面朝大海，蓝白相间的看台与C字口疏浚湖的柔波、不远处的蓝天碧海相互呼应，是亚运场馆中景观特色鲜明的一座。2023年9月，杭州第19届亚运会沙滩排球比赛在此举行；2024年，亚排联沙滩排球洲际杯半决赛、决赛暨巴黎奥运会沙滩排球资格赛落户于此；2025年全国沙滩排球巡回赛（宁波象山站）暨第十五届全运会沙滩排球资格赛也在此举办。场馆所在的东海半边山度假区公开客服电话未在本库列出。
intro_en: Ningbo Banbianshan Beach Volleyball Center lies inside the Donghai Banbianshan tourist resort at Shipu Town, Xiangshan County, Ningbo. Construction began in June 2020 and was completed in 284 days; the venue passed its functional acceptance in September 2021 and the technical delegate's inspection for the Hangzhou Asian Games beach volleyball tournament in April 2022. The 90-mu site, roughly 60,000 sqm, contains more than 20,000 sqm of floor area: a C-shaped, half-open main court with one competition court, a secondary court, five warm-up and training courts and the supporting event infrastructure. The main stand holds more than 2,000 spectators and the secondary stand 500. Ringed by green peaks and facing the sea, the blue-and-white seating echoes the calm water of the dredged lake at the C-shaped opening and the blue sea beyond, making it one of the most scenic of the Asian Games venues. The beach volleyball competition of the 19th Asian Games was held here in September 2023. In 2024 the venue hosted the AVC Beach Volleyball Continental Cup semi-finals and finals, which doubled as the Paris Olympic qualifier, and in 2025 the National Beach Volleyball Tour Ningbo Xiangshan leg and the beach volleyball qualifier for the 15th National Games. The resort's public service line and email are not included in this public dataset. The C-shaped plan keeps the sea view open behind one end of the court. Its 90-mu site, more than 20,000 sqm of buildings and the adjoining resort facilities let it operate as both a competition venue and a beach-sports destination outside the event calendar.

address: 浙江省宁波市江北区云飞路1280号（姚江北岸）
area_text: 占地815亩（约543,333㎡）；一期三馆总建筑面积约12.81万㎡；二期体育场约20万㎡
capacity_text: 体育馆13,000；游泳馆按国际单项赛事标准；二期体育场81,000（在建，2026年6月封顶）
intro_zh: 宁波奥体中心位于江北区云飞路1280号、姚江北岸，是宁波规模最大的体育场馆建筑群。项目占地815亩，分两期建设：一期2014年12月29日开工，2019年7月初试运营，同年10月19日正式运营，由体育馆、游泳馆、综合馆和奥体公园组成；二期建设主体育场和国际体育交流中心。体育馆总建筑面积53,934平方米，按体育建筑甲级标准建造，主馆设13,000个座位，内场实际使用面积3,327.75平方米，副馆1,680.21平方米、内场1,591平方米，常设2片篮球训练场，另有309.69平方米新闻发布厅和26个功能用房。游泳馆总建筑面积34,054.87平方米，设50米×25米比赛池与热身池、25米×10米儿童池、25米×25米跳水池及218平方米新闻发布厅。综合馆40,109.78平方米、共四层，含4,499平方米篮球馆（6片全场）、2,282.6平方米网球馆（3片）和2,015平方米乒乓球馆（30张球台）。奥体公园设400米田径场、1,280米慢跑道、6,400平方米足球场、2片网球场和2片篮球场。二期主体育场建筑面积约20万平方米、设计座席8.1万座，2026年6月22日主体结构封顶，是继国家体育场“鸟巢”、广东奥林匹克体育场、杭州奥体中心体育场之后全国第四座8万人级体育场，截至2026年10月尚未见投用报道。地铁4号线奥体中心站直达，官网为www.nbosc.com。
intro_en: Ningbo Olympic Sports Center occupies 1,280 Yunfei Road in Jiangbei District on the north bank of the Yao River and is the largest sports building group in Ningbo. The 815-mu site is built in two phases. Phase one broke ground on 29 December 2014, began trial operation in early July 2019 and opened formally on 19 October 2019; it comprises an arena, a swimming hall, a multi-purpose hall and the Olympic park. Phase two adds the main stadium and an international sports exchange centre. The arena has 53,934 sqm of floor area, is built to Class-A standards and seats 13,000 in the main hall, whose usable field area is 3,327.75 sqm; the secondary hall covers 1,680.21 sqm with a 1,591 sqm field and two permanent basketball training courts, alongside a 309.69 sqm press room and 26 function rooms. The swimming hall covers 34,054.87 sqm and contains 50 by 25 m competition and warm-up pools, a 25 by 10 m children's pool, a 25 by 25 m diving pool and a 218 sqm press room. The four-storey multi-purpose hall has 40,109.78 sqm, including a 4,499 sqm basketball hall with six full courts, a 2,282.6 sqm tennis hall with three courts and a 2,015 sqm table tennis hall with 30 tables. The park adds a 400 m track, a 1,280 m jogging path, a 6,400 sqm football pitch, two tennis courts and two basketball courts. The phase-two stadium, with about 200,000 sqm of floor area and 81,000 seats, topped out on 22 June 2026 and will be China's fourth 80,000-seat stadium after the Bird's Nest, Guangdong Olympic Stadium and Hangzhou Olympic Sports Center Stadium; no opening had been reported as of October 2026. Metro Line 4 stops at Olympic Sports Center station.

address: 浙江省宁波市象山县松兰山旅游度假区（亚帆中心）
website: http://tyj.ningbo.gov.cn/（宁波市体育局官网；亚帆中心为市体育系统场馆）
area_text: 占地15.3公顷（用地237亩），用海47公顷（700亩）；陆上建筑1.6万平方米，海上竞赛操作平台2万平方米，港池33.6万平方米
capacity_text: 公开资料未公布固定座位数（海上竞赛场地）
intro_zh: 宁波象山亚帆中心又称中国·浙江海洋运动中心，位于象山县松兰山旅游度假区，是杭州第19届亚运会帆船帆板项目的比赛与训练场地，也是那届亚运会唯一涉海场馆，一半在陆上、一半在海上。项目总投资约6.02亿元，用地237亩（约15.3公顷），用海700亩（约47公顷）；陆上1.6万平方米布置运动员中心、比赛控制中心和后勤服务中心，海上建有2万平方米竞赛操作平台、33.6万平方米港池和240个泊位（规划约800个），两座防浪堤环抱出一片风平浪静的内湾，供各类船艇停泊。松兰山海域常年温度10℃至32℃、年平均风速约4.5米每秒，是国内少有的可常年办海上运动的岸线。亚运会期间这里产生14枚帆船金牌；2024年4月中心取得港口经营许可证，港内116个游艇泊位可合法停靠出海，同年11月被亚洲帆船联合会授予“亚帆联高水平训练基地”，亚洲仅中国与阿曼获此称号，中国宁波一号帆船队也把母港设在这里。赛后中心承接中国·中东欧国际帆船赛、梅沙杯全国青少年帆船联赛总决赛、宁波国际帆船赛等赛事，并开放游艇帆船体验与滨海观光；建筑单体取意象山开渔节的渔船，依山就势、顺坡而建，屋面与山体轮廓相接。
intro_en: Xiangshan Asian Sailing Center, also known as China Zhejiang Ocean Sports Center, occupies a stretch of the Songlanshan resort coast in Xiangshan County, Ningbo. It was built as the sailing and windsurfing venue for the 19th Asian Games in Hangzhou and is the only Games venue that sits half on land and half at sea. The project cost about 602 million yuan and covers 15.3 hectares of land and 47 hectares of sea. On shore, 16,000 square metres hold the athletes' center, race control and logistics buildings; offshore, a 20,000 square metre race operations platform, a 336,000 square metre harbour basin and 240 berths (about 800 are planned) are protected by two breakwaters that keep the inner bay calm. Water temperatures of 10 to 32 degrees Celsius and an average wind of 4.5 metres per second make the area usable for sailing almost all year. Fourteen sailing gold medals were decided here during the Asian Games. In April 2024 the centre obtained a port operating licence, allowing 116 yacht berths to take visiting boats legally, and in November 2024 the Asian Sailing Federation named it a High-Level Training Base, a status held in Asia only by China and Oman. China Ningbo No.1, a professional offshore racing team, has since made the centre its home port. After the Games the venue has hosted the China-CEEC International Sailing Regatta, the Meisha Cup national youth sailing finals and the Ningbo International Sailing Regatta, while opening yacht experiences and coastal visits to the public. The buildings take their shape from the fishing boats of the Xiangshan fishing festival and step up the hillside so that rooflines meet the ridge.

address: 广州市番禺区小谷围岛广州大学城中心湖公园（环湖路）
area_text: 230亩（约15.3万平方米）
intro_zh: 大学城铁人三项赛场位于番禺区小谷围岛广州大学城中心湖公园，是广州大学城体育中心的室外场地之一。赛场占地230亩（约15.3万平方米），设2648个固定座位，游泳段利用中心湖水域，自行车与跑步段串联环湖路及大学城道路。中心湖岸线全长约1.9公里，湖面面积约11.8万平方米，其中水面约10.67万平方米，最大水深8米，开阔的静水面适合举办公开水域游泳。大学城体育中心总占地约41万平方米，是广州规模第三大的体育场馆群。2008年大学城曾承办铁人三项世锦赛，2010年广州亚运会期间，铁人三项、公路自行车、马拉松等项目在此举行。赛后场地用于国家队集训、青少年赛事与公开水域活动。赛场与大学城体育中心体育场、2500座的自行车馆、2500座的轮滑馆同处一个园区，另有占地310亩的极限运动场，内设攀岩、滑板、U形台、小轮车特技与障碍场。观众可乘地铁四号线至大学城北站步行前往。场馆由广州大学城体育中心管理，预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: The Guangzhou Higher Education Mega Center Triathlon Venue covers 230 mu, roughly 153,000 square metres, on the shore of Central Lake at the heart of Xiaoguwei Island in Panyu District. It is the outdoor open-water component of the Guangzhou University Town Sports Centre, a 410,000-square-metre cluster that ranks third in size among Guangzhou's sports venues after the Tianhe and Guangdong Olympic centres. Central Lake has a 1.9-kilometre shoreline, about 118,000 square metres of water surface and a maximum depth of eight metres, making it well suited to the swimming leg of a triathlon. The course has 2,648 fixed seats, and the three disciplines connect the lake, its ring road and the campus street grid. The site first drew international attention when University Town hosted the ITU Triathlon World Championships in 2008; in November 2010 it served the Guangzhou Asian Games for triathlon, road cycling and marathon events. Since the Games it has been used for national-team training camps, age-group races and public open-water swimming. It sits in the same park as the 50,000-seat centrepiece stadium, a 2,500-seat velodrome and a 2,500-seat roller-skating hall, while a separate 310-mu extreme sports park adds climbing walls, skateboarding, a U-ramp, BMX stunt courses and an obstacle area. Spectators normally arrive on Metro Line 4 to University Town North station, about a kilometre's walk from the lake. A secondary training pitch adjoins the main stadium. The venue is managed by the Guangzhou University Town Sports Centre under the Guangzhou Municipal Sports Bureau, and bookings go through the centre's public channels.

address: 广州市天河区大观南路36号广东奥林匹克体育中心北端
area_text: 33146平方米（占地）
intro_zh: 奥体射箭场位于广东奥林匹克体育中心北端的独立用地，占地33146平方米，看台设2600个座席，是2010年广州亚运会射箭比赛场地。射箭项目要求安静、稳定的风场，规划时特意把场地与主体育场分开，四周密植数排防风林，比赛场规格为130米×200米，发射方向由南向北，场地铺设天然草坪，南侧设休息长廊和两栋功能用房，供竞赛组织与裁判使用。2010年11月13日至26日，亚运会射箭比赛在此举行。奥体中心整体占地约100万平方米，由体育场、网球中心、游泳跳水馆、射击馆、射箭场等组成，地铁四号线、二十一号线可达黄村一带。赛后射箭场用于广东省射箭队训练、青少年培训和全国及省级射箭赛事，是广州少数按国际箭联标准布置的专用射箭场地。场地与奥体其他场馆共享停车、安保与观众集散配套。奥体中心于2001年建成，曾承办第九届全国运动会，2010年亚残运会开闭幕式也在此举行，射箭场与主体育场、网球中心、游泳跳水馆共同构成园区的竞赛场馆群。预约与场地咨询可联系奥体中心经营部。
intro_en: The Guangdong Olympic Sports Center Archery Range occupies a separate 33,146-square-metre plot at the northern end of the Olympic centre in Tianhe District, with 2,600 spectator seats. It was built for the archery competition of the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games, held from 13 to 26 November that year. Archery demands quiet surroundings and a stable wind field, so the range was deliberately detached from the main stadium and screened by several rows of windbreak trees. The shooting field measures 130 by 200 metres, faces from south to north and is laid to natural turf, with a rest colonnade and two service buildings on its southern edge for competition officials and technical staff. The Olympic centre as a whole covers about one million square metres and also contains the main stadium, tennis centre, swimming and diving hall and shooting hall, with Metro Lines 4 and 21 serving the Huangcun area. After the Asian Games the range has been used by the Guangdong provincial archery squad, for youth training and for national and provincial tournaments, and it remains one of the few purpose-built archery grounds in Guangzhou laid out to international federation standards. The centre was completed in 2001 for the 9th National Games and also hosted the opening and closing ceremonies of the 2010 Asian Para Games, so the range now forms part of a competition cluster that includes the main stadium, tennis centre and swimming and diving hall. Enquiries and bookings are handled by the centre's business department through its public channels.

address: 广州市番禺区市桥街繁华路106号
area_text: 9900平方米（建筑面积）
intro_zh: 英东体育馆位于番禺区市桥街繁华路106号，与英东体育场、英东游泳场共同组成英东体育中心，由香港商人霍英东出资兴建，1987年建成，是番禺老城区的标志性体育建筑。体育馆建筑面积9900平方米，中央比赛大厅38米×24米，铺设柚木地板，四周看台设2499个固定座位。馆内配置大型电子计时计分屏、中央空调、音响和消防系统，可承接篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球等室内项目以及集会、演出活动。2010年广州亚运会篮球比赛在此举行。作为区属综合性体育馆，这里长期承担番禺区级赛事、青少年培训与全民健身开放；公共文化设施目录公布的开放时间为每天9:00—12:00、14:00—20:00。体育馆地处市桥中心，公交与地铁接驳便利，是番禺市民日常运动的主要室内场地之一。英东体育中心地处市桥中心，体育场、体育馆与游泳场步行可达，周边为番禺传统商业与居住区。英东体育馆见证了番禺体育事业的发展，也是市桥市民熟悉的公共场馆。场馆咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Yingdong Gymnasium stands at 106 Fanhua Road in Shiqiao, the old town of Panyu District, and forms the Yingdong Sports Centre together with Yingdong Stadium and the Yingdong swimming pool. It was financed by the Hong Kong businessman Henry Fok, completed in 1987 and has become a landmark of Panyu's central district. The building has 9,900 square metres of floor area. Its main competition hall measures 38 by 24 metres, is floored in teak and is surrounded by 2,499 fixed seats. A large electronic scoreboard, central air-conditioning, a sound system and fire protection equipment were installed, allowing the hall to stage basketball, volleyball, badminton and table tennis as well as assemblies and performances. During the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games it hosted basketball matches. As a district-level multi-purpose hall it has long served Panyu's own competitions, youth training and public fitness programmes, and it is operated together with the neighbouring stadium and swimming pool; the district's public cultural facilities directory lists opening hours of 09:00 to 12:00 and 14:00 to 20:00 daily. The three venues sit within walking distance of one another in the old town, close to Shiqiao's traditional shopping streets and residential neighbourhoods. Sitting in the middle of the old town, it remains one of the main indoor sports venues for local residents. They are managed as a single sports centre by the Panyu District Sports Venue Development Centre, which runs district competitions, training and subsidised public sessions. The gymnasium has witnessed the growth of sport in Panyu and remains a familiar public venue in Shiqiao. The venue's enquiry line is not included in this public dataset.

address: 广州市天河区天河路229号天河体育中心内
area_text: 25600平方米（建筑面积）
intro_zh: 天河网球学校位于天河体育中心东门一侧，毗邻体育东路，地铁一号线体育西路站、体育中心站步行可达，是广州市网球训练基地和青少年网球培训中心。学校建筑面积25600平方米，拥有国际标准室外灯光网球场12片（后续报道多称14片），附设700个座位的观众看台；2001年10月建成室内网球馆，内设4片国际标准球场、大型电子计分屏和可容纳2300名观众的看台。2010年广州亚运会软式网球比赛在此举行，当时设2400个座位。学校常年开设青少年儿童业余培训班，承办“市长杯”广州市中小学生网球公开赛等青少年赛事，并通过“群体通”平台向市民开放室外场与中心场，免费时段不接受电话预约、需线上订场。学校与广州网球中心场、天河体育场、天河游泳馆、天河棒球场和天河保龄球馆同在园区内，训练、比赛与全民健身功能相互补充，共同构成天河体育中心的场馆群。室内馆使教学与比赛在高温和多雨季节也能继续进行。咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Tianhe Tennis School sits beside the east gate of Tianhe Sports Centre, next to Tiyu East Road and within walking distance of Tiyu Xilu and Tianhe Sports Center stations on Metro Line 1. It is Guangzhou's tennis training base and its main centre for junior tennis development. The school has 25,600 square metres of floor area and twelve international-standard outdoor floodlit courts, later reports refer to fourteen, with a 700-seat spectators' stand. An indoor tennis hall opened in October 2001, containing four full-size courts, a large electronic scoreboard and a stand for 2,300 spectators. The soft tennis competition of the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games was staged here, when the venue was configured with 2,400 seats. The school runs year-round amateur classes for children and teenagers and hosts junior events such as the Mayor's Cup Guangzhou primary and secondary school tennis open. Public courts are released through the Quntitong booking platform, and free sessions must be reserved online rather than by telephone. Within the same park it works alongside the Guangzhou Tennis Centre courts, the main stadium, the Tianhe swimming hall, the baseball ground and the Tianhe bowling hall, so that training, competition and public fitness functions complement one another. The complex is served by extensive bus routes and by Metro Lines 1 and 3. Its indoor hall lets coaching and competition continue through the hot and rainy seasons. The school also hosts regional junior tournaments during the school year. The school's courts are also used by local clubs in the evenings. Enquiries go through the school's public channels.

address: 广州市天河区奥体路818号
area_text: 约104万平方米（总占地）
intro_zh: 黄村体育基地即广东省黄村体育训练中心，位于天河区奥体路818号，毗邻广东奥林匹克体育中心，是广东省体育局直属的综合性训练基地。基地前身为1958年成立的广东省广州航空俱乐部，2013年更名为广东省黄村体育训练中心，总占地面积约104万平方米。中心承担射击、射箭、自行车、棒球、垒球、现代五项、马术、曲棍球、手球、攀岩、铁人三项等项目的布局、选材、训练与竞赛管理，拥有射击馆、曲棍球场、马术场、手球场以及科研、康复、运动员公寓和餐厅等配套。2015年，基地被国家体育总局命名为国家综合体育训练基地。为承办2025年第十五届全国运动会现代五项赛事，中心完成升级改造，新建综合训练馆并扩建广东射击馆，两馆总建筑面积约3.8万平方米，新增符合国际比赛标准的游泳馆、手球馆等设施。这里培养出奥运冠军易思玲及近百名世界冠军、亚洲冠军和五百多名全国冠军。基地周边为大观路、广园快速路与奥体路，地铁四号线、二十一号线可达，训练与保障车辆可经奥体路直接进出。基地的射击、射箭、自行车和马术场地供省队使用，并多次承接国家队训练与比赛保障任务。。
intro_en: Huangcun Sports Base, formally the Guangdong Huangcun Sports Training Centre, lies at 818 Aoti Road in Tianhe District, next to the Guangdong Olympic Sports Centre. It is a comprehensive training base directly under the Guangdong Provincial Sports Bureau. Its predecessor was the Guangdong Guangzhou Aviation Club founded in 1958, and it took its present name in 2013; the site covers about 1.04 million square metres. The centre is responsible for the selection, training, competition and management of shooting, archery, cycling, baseball, softball, modern pentathlon, equestrianism, hockey, handball, climbing and triathlon, and it contains a shooting hall, hockey pitches, equestrian grounds and handball courts, together with research, rehabilitation, dormitory and dining facilities. In 2015 the General Administration of Sport named it a national comprehensive training base. For the modern pentathlon events of the 15th National Games in 2025 the centre was upgraded: a new multi-sport training hall was built and the Guangdong shooting hall extended, adding about 38,000 square metres of floor area between them and introducing an international-standard swimming pool and handball hall. The base has produced Olympic champion Yi Siling together with nearly one hundred world and Asian champions and more than five hundred national champions. It adjoins the Olympic centre, with Daguang Road, the Guangyuan Expressway and Aoti Road nearby and Metro Lines 4 and 21 serving the area, so teams and service vehicles can enter directly from Aoti Road. Its shooting, archery, cycling and equestrian facilities are used by provincial squads, and the base has repeatedly hosted training camps and competition support for national teams. Its switchboard is not included in this public dataset.

address: 广州市番禺区大学城外环东路382号华南理工大学（大学城校区）
area_text: 12377平方米（建筑面积）
intro_zh: 华工体育馆位于华南理工大学大学城校区，总建筑面积12377平方米，设5632个固定座位，是大学城校园场馆中规模较大的一座。建筑由四个扭壳组合成反曲屋面，线条流畅，是校园里的标志性建筑。屋面以金属板覆盖，壳体跨越整个比赛大厅，室内不设柱子。2010年广州亚运会柔道、摔跤比赛在此举行；馆内为无柱大空间，赛时可布置柔道、摔跤垫，平时可切换为篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球场地，也能承担开学典礼、毕业典礼和大型活动。体育馆日常用于学校体育教学与校队训练，并按学校安排向师生及周边社区分时段开放。校区位于大学城外环东路382号，地铁四号线大学城南站可达，周边为十所高校组成的大学城核心区。校内教学时段优先保障课程与校队使用，寒暑假则按学校通知调整开放安排。华南理工大学大学城校区的公共场馆可对外租赁，按上午、下午、晚上三个时段计费，由校区管委会统一管理。
intro_en: SCUT Gymnasium stands on the South China University of Technology's University Town campus at 382 Waihuan East Road in Panyu District. With 12,377 square metres of floor area and 5,632 fixed seats, it is one of the larger campus arenas in the University Town cluster. Its roof is formed from four twisted shells that combine into a reverse-curved surface, giving the building a flowing profile and making it a campus landmark. During the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games the hall hosted judo and wrestling. Inside, the column-free main space can be fitted with judo and wrestling mats for competition and converted for basketball, volleyball, badminton and table tennis, and it is also used for opening ceremonies, graduation ceremonies and other university events. Day to day it serves physical education classes and varsity training, and it opens to students, staff and nearby residents in scheduled sessions. The campus is reached from University Town South station on Metro Line 4 and sits within the core of the ten-university town. Teaching hours give priority to classes and varsity teams, and opening arrangements during summer and winter holidays are adjusted by university notice. The shells are clad in metal panels and span the hall without internal columns, making the roof one of the campus's most recognisable structures. The gymnasium is one of the largest indoor spaces on the campus. The University Town campus makes its public venues available for external hire, charged by morning, afternoon and evening sessions and administered by the campus management committee; rental enquiries are handled at

address: 广州市天河区大观南路36号广东奥林匹克体育中心内
intro_zh: 奥体射击馆位于广东奥林匹克体育中心内，是2010年广州亚运会射击比赛场馆，设1500个固定座位。馆内按国际比赛标准配置100米、50米、25米和10米气枪靶场以及一个决赛靶场，部分主要设备采用进口产品，通风与吸音按射击项目要求专门设计，是亚洲规模较大的射击馆之一。2010年11月13日至24日，亚运会射击赛事在此举行。场馆与奥体中心其他设施共享交通、安保和观众集散配套，地铁四号线、二十一号线可达黄村一带。赛后射击馆用于专业队训练、青少年射击培训以及经审批的公众射击体验，是华南地区重要的射击运动基地。需要说明的是，亚运资料中“建筑面积30万平方米”实为奥体中心整体建筑规模，射击馆单馆面积未见公开数据，故本条目留空。奥体中心于2001年落成，占地约100万平方米，由体育场、游泳跳水馆、网球中心、射箭场与射击馆等组成，是广州承办大型赛事最集中的场馆群之一。场地咨询可联系奥体中心经营部。
intro_en: The Shooting Hall of the Guangdong Olympic Sports Center in Tianhe District was the shooting venue of the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games and has 1,500 fixed seats. Inside, it provides 100-metre, 50-metre, 25-metre and 10-metre air-gun ranges together with a separate finals range, all built to international competition standards, with some key equipment imported and ventilation and acoustic treatment designed specifically for shooting. It is counted among the largest shooting halls in Asia. The Asian Games shooting events took place here between 13 and 24 November 2010. The hall shares transport, security and spectator circulation with the rest of the Olympic centre, which is served by Metro Lines 4 and 21 via the Huangcun area. After the Games it has been used for professional squad training, youth shooting programmes and approved public experience sessions, making it an important shooting base in southern China. One clarification on the figures: the Asian Games venue note that gives a floor area of 300,000 square metres in fact describes the Olympic centre as a whole, not this building, and no separate published floor area for the shooting hall could be found, so the area field is left blank. The centre was completed in 2001 and covers about one million square metres, comprising the main stadium, the swimming and diving hall, the tennis centre, the archery range and this shooting hall, making it one of Guangzhou's most concentrated clusters for major events. It is used for provincial squad training and youth development programmes. Enquiries can be made to the centre's business department through its public channels.

address: 广州市荔湾区环市西路7号
area_text: 39882平方米（占地），建筑面积18336平方米
intro_zh: 广州市工人体育场位于荔湾区环市西路7号，1955年由广州市总工会筹建、1956年初步建成，是广州最早一批综合性大型体育场馆之一，占地约39882平方米，建筑面积约18336平方米。这里是广州工人足球队的发源地，容志行、吴群立等足球名将从这里走出；场馆曾作为2010年广州亚运会足球项目的训练场地，2019年在此举行广州足球七十年系列活动。2019年3月，足球场进行大幅修整，由原来的1个11人制球场、1个7人制球场和8条100米直跑道，改为105米×68米天然草标准11人制球场、6条400米环形跑道，并附设4个5人制人造草球场，同年9月19日重新启用；2024年完成看台和雨棚改造，新增可容纳1000多人的钢结构看台。现为广州市芳村工人文化宫（广州市职工体育活动中心），设多功能综合体育馆、羽毛球馆、乒乓球馆、游泳馆、地掷球场和室外篮球场。体育场毗邻地铁五号线西村站，周边为环市西路与西村商圈，看台改造后可满足职工运动会、足球联赛与日常跑步、健身活动需要。体育场产权属广州市总工会，至今仍是广州职工体育活动的主要阵地之一。订场。
intro_en: Guangzhou Workers' Stadium at 7 Huanshi West Road in Liwan District was planned by the Guangzhou Federation of Trade Unions in 1955 and substantially completed in 1956, making it one of the city's earliest large multi-purpose sports grounds. It covers about 39,882 square metres with roughly 18,336 square metres of building area. The stadium is the birthplace of the Guangzhou Workers' football team, and internationals such as Rong Zhixing and Wu Qunli began their careers here. It served as a football training venue for the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games and in 2019 hosted the events marking seventy years of Guangzhou football. In March 2019 the pitch was rebuilt: the previous eleven-a-side pitch, seven-a-side pitch and eight 100-metre straight lanes gave way to a 105 by 68 metre natural-turf eleven-a-side field with a six-lane 400-metre track and four five-a-side artificial pitches, reopened on 19 September 2019. A further renovation in 2024 added a steel grandstand and canopy seating more than a thousand spectators. Today the complex operates as the Guangzhou Fangcun Workers' Cultural Palace and Guangzhou Workers' Sports Centre, with a multi-purpose indoor hall, badminton hall, table tennis hall, swimming pool, bocce courts and outdoor basketball courts. It is close to Xicun station on Metro Line 5 and sits beside Huanshi West Road and the Xicun commercial area; after the renovation it can accommodate workers' sports meetings, football leagues and daily running and fitness. The ground is owned by the Guangzhou Federation of Trade Unions and remains one of the main focuses for workers' sport in the city. Court bookings go through the venue's public channels.

address: 广州市增城区荔城街滨江东路增江（雁塔大桥以南1800米河段）
area_text: 水域面积58.36万平方米
intro_zh: 增城龙舟场位于增城区荔城街滨江东路增江畔，赛场设在雁塔大桥以南1800米的河段，是2010年广州亚运会龙舟比赛场地。比赛水域面积58.36万平方米，设6条航道，单程长1000米，属静水赛道，看台可容纳668名观众。2010年11月18日至20日，亚运龙舟在这里举行，设男子、女子400米、500米、600米、800米、1000米直道竞速等项目。赛场依增江而建，两岸是滨江公园、绿道与增江画廊水利风景区，水面开阔、流速平缓，适合直道竞速。赛后场地继续服务于龙舟训练、龙舟景和端午竞渡，是广州龙舟赛事与民俗活动的主要水上场地之一；增城每年端午在新塘、石滩、荔城等镇街举办龙舟例景，龙舟文化延续至今。场地由增城区体育主管部门统筹使用，日常不设固定售票窗口，赛事期间按活动方案开放看台。赛道按标准龙舟直道竞速布置，起点、终点与航道标识齐全，可容纳六条龙舟同时出发。咨询可联系增城区文化广电旅游体育局。
intro_en: Zengcheng Dragon Boat Course lies on the Zengjiang River along Binjiang East Road in Licheng, Zengcheng District, with the racing stretch beginning 1,800 metres south of Yanta Bridge. It was the dragon boat venue of the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games. The competition water covers 583,600 square metres and is divided into six lanes, each 1,000 metres long, on a calm stretch of river; the grandstand seats 668 spectators. The Asian Games dragon boat events were held from 18 to 20 November 2010, with men's and women's 400, 500, 600, 800 and 1,000 metre straight-course races. The course runs along the Zengjiang, flanked by riverside parks, greenways and the Zengjiang Gallery water-park scenic area, and its wide, slow-moving water suits straight-course sprinting. After the Games it has continued to serve dragon boat training, the traditional dragon-boat festival gatherings and the Dragon Boat Festival races that Zengcheng still holds each year in Xintang, Shitan and Licheng. It is one of Guangzhou's main open-water venues for dragon boat sport and folk culture. The course lies a short distance from central Zengcheng, with Yanta Bridge, Binjiang Park and the Zengjiang Gallery greenway framing both banks, so that during regattas the grandstand and the embankments together form the spectator area. It is administered by the district sports authority, has no permanent ticket office, and opens its stand according to each event plan. The start, finish and lane markers are laid out for six boats to race side by side on calm water. Enquiries: Zengcheng District Culture, Radio, Television, Tourism and Sports Bureau; contact details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 广州市白云区钟落潭镇龙塘村进场路136号
area_text: 106公顷
intro_zh: 广东国际划船中心位于白云区钟落潭镇龙塘村进场路136号，流溪河畔，1998年4月建成、2001年6月启用，占地106公顷，是广东省体育局直属的船艇训练基地，由广东省船艇训练中心运营。中心建成长2500米、宽160米的人工赛艇湖，安装自动启航设备、电子计时系统、分段计时塔、终点塔和大型自动计分系统，设600个固定座位；陆上配竞赛中心、新闻中心、运动员公寓、集训楼、餐厅、艇库和体育馆，另有两块塑胶篮球场、四块塑胶网球场和一块400米田径场。这里曾承办2001年第九届全国运动会、2010年广州亚运会和2025年第十五届全国运动会的赛艇、皮划艇比赛。2024年至2025年，为承办十五运会，中心完成赛道清淤、赛场与建筑修缮、景观升级，竞赛航道按2028年洛杉矶奥运会标准优化为1500米。中心同时是广东赛艇队、皮划艇队和激流队的训练基地，部分赛场向社会开放，可承接休闲皮划艇、赛艇与测功仪等企事业单位活动。人工赛艇湖与流溪河相连，比赛用水由河水补给，赛道水位与水质随河水调节。。
intro_en: Guangdong International Rowing Centre occupies 106 hectares beside the Liuxi River at 136 Jinchang Road, Longtang Village, Zhongluotan Town, Baiyun District. Built from April 1998 and opened in June 2001, it is the boat-racing training base of the Guangdong Provincial Sports Bureau, operated by the Guangdong Provincial Rowing and Canoeing Training Centre. The centre created an artificial rowing lake 2,500 metres long and 160 metres wide, equipped with automatic starting gear, electronic timing, split-time towers, a finish tower and a large automatic scoring system, with 600 fixed seats. On land it provides a competition centre, media centre, athletes accommodation, training blocks, dining hall, boat house and gymnasium, plus two synthetic basketball courts, four synthetic tennis courts and a 400-metre athletics track. It has staged the rowing and canoeing events of the 9th National Games in 2001, the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games and the 15th National Games in 2025. For the 2025 Games the centre dredged the course and renovated the course infrastructure, buildings and landscaping between 2024 and 2025, and the racing course was reconfigured to 1,500 metres to match the standard planned for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics. The centre is also the training base for the Guangdong rowing, canoeing and slalom squads, and parts of the course are open to the public, accommodating recreational kayaking, rowing and ergometer sessions for companies and community groups. The artificial lake is linked to the Liuxi River, which supplies and drains the course and helps regulate water quality and level. Telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 广州市花都区花东镇山前旅游大道3号九龙湖社区
intro_zh: 九龙湖高尔夫球会位于花都区花东镇山前旅游大道3号九龙湖社区，坐落在九龙湖度假区内，背倚连绵群山、环抱九龙湖，2.5平方公里湖面与42平方公里汇水面积构成独立而安静的山地湖景环境。球场由加拿大戴伟信高尔夫球场设计公司设计，2004年5月一期18洞国际锦标赛标准球场正式营业，2006年11月二期9洞灯光球场开放，现共27洞、总占地2600余亩。A场开阔、球道较宽，分布水障碍与水溪；B场丘陵起伏，树林与山地区较多；C场即9洞灯光场，综合前两者特点并以沙坑造景。球会设练习场、球车、更衣室与餐饮，部分球洞曾入选国内高尔夫球洞评选。2010年广州亚运会高尔夫项目的竞赛与训练在此举行。球会位于花东镇山前旅游大道，从广州白云国际机场经机场高速北延线可达，度假区内设酒店、欧洲风情小镇与别墅，适合赛训与商务接待结合。一期18洞锦标赛球场占地约1760亩，9洞灯光场为后续加建。订场。
intro_en: Dragon Lake Golf Club is set within the Dragon Lake resort at 3 Shanqian Tourist Avenue, Huadong Town, Huadu District, backed by long ridges of wooded hills and wrapped around Dragon Lake, whose 2.5 square kilometres of water and 42 square kilometres of catchment give the course a quiet, enclosed landscape. The course was designed by the Canadian firm David Richardson Golf Course Design. Its first eighteen-hole championship layout opened in May 2004, the second, nine-hole floodlit loop followed in November 2006, and the club now offers 27 holes across about 2,600 mu. The A nine is open with wide fairways and water hazards and streams; the B nine is hillier, with dense trees and mountainous ground; the C nine, the floodlit loop, blends the two characters and relies on bunkering for its strategy. A driving range, carts, changing rooms and dining are provided, and individual holes have appeared in Chinese golf hole rankings. The club served as the competition and training venue for golf at the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games. It stands on Shanqian Tourist Avenue in Huadong Town and is reached from Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport via the northern extension of the Airport Expressway; the resort also contains hotels, a European-style town and villas, suiting a combination of training and corporate hospitality. The club's three nines can be combined into 18-hole rounds for tournaments and everyday play. The eighteen-hole championship course covers about 1,760 mu, with the floodlit nine added later. Water comes into play on several holes of the A nine, while the B nine climbs into the hills. Tee-time enquiries go through the venue's public channels.

address: 广州市番禺区沙头街道禺山西路668号大夫山森林公园内
area_text: 2138平方米（配套建筑），赛道约3.5公里
intro_zh: 大夫山自行车场位于番禺区大夫山森林公园内，是2010年广州亚运会山地自行车比赛场地。赛道总长约3.5公里，主要经过马饮泉、大林岗、长岗一带，利用山体起伏、林间小路与天然落差布置，体现岭南丘陵地形，兼具爬坡、下坡与技术路段。场地配套建筑占地646平方米、总建筑面积2138平方米，为三层：一层布置公共休息间，满足休息等待与公告功能；二层为办公室及工作人员休息室；三层为裁判、贵宾和官员休息室。2010年11月，亚运山地自行车项目在此举行。赛后赛道并入大夫山森林公园的骑行与徒步系统，公园免费开放，园内道路宽敞、坡度适中，是番禺市民山地骑行、越野跑和日常健身的主要场所之一；公园开放时间随季节调整，一般为8:00至18:00前后。大夫山森林公园以海拔226.6米的大夫山为主峰，园内山塘与人工湖星罗棋布，赛道穿行林间，赛后成为广州山地车友常用的练习线路。票务与园区咨询请走园区公开渠道。
intro_en: The Dafushan Mountain Bike Course lies inside Dafushan Forest Park in Panyu District and was the mountain bike venue of the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games. Its loop runs about 3.5 kilometres, passing mainly through the Mayin Quan, Dalin Gang and Chang Gang areas, and uses the natural rise and fall of the hills, forest tracks and gradients to create climbs, descents and technical sections typical of Lingnan hill country. The supporting building covers a 646-square-metre footprint with 2,138 square metres of floor area over three storeys: the ground floor holds public rest areas and notice boards, the first floor offices and staff rest rooms, and the top floor rooms for judges, guests and officials. The Asian Games mountain bike events were held here in November 2010. After the Games the course was absorbed into the forest park's cycling and hiking network. The park is free to enter, its roads are wide and its gradients moderate, and it has become one of the main places in Panyu for mountain biking, trail running and everyday exercise. Dafushan Forest Park takes its name from the 226.6-metre peak within it and contains numerous ponds and artificial lakes; the race loop threads through the woods and has become a regular practice route for Guangzhou mountain bikers. Opening hours vary with the season, generally from 08:00 to around 18:00. Its forest tracks and hill roads suit mountain biking and hiking. The park is managed by Panyu District and charges no admission fee. Ticket and park enquiries go through the park's public channels.

name_zh: 大湾区文化体育中心体育馆
address: 广州市南沙区万顷沙镇文体路1号
area_text: 约11万平方米（建筑面积）
intro_zh: 大湾区文化体育中心体育馆位于南沙区万顷沙镇二十一涌以南岛尖、文体路1号，是2025年6月交付启用的大湾区文化体育中心“一场两馆”中的综合体育馆。项目由扎哈·哈迪德建筑事务所参与设计，整体呈“C”字形面海布局，运营单位为华润文体旗下广州华润湾心文化体育发展有限公司。体育馆建筑面积约11万平方米，按2万座多功能综合体育馆规划；施工方披露看台采用固定看台加伸缩看台、综合马道设计，低区座位比例约50%，座位总数约1万个，演艺模式下容量更大。馆内可在冰场与篮球场之间快速转换，并能承接演出、展览与电竞活动；八面外环屏与四面内环屏组成双环斗屏，总显示面积660.34平方米，可升降组合。2025年8月10日，广州篮球城市联赛总决赛在此举行，是场馆交付后的首场赛事。体育中心位于南沙最南端、面朝伶仃洋，2025年6月通过竣工验收，8月起陆续承接篮球联赛与大型演出，成为广州南部的新地标。地址：南沙区万顷沙镇文体路1号。
intro_en: The Gymnasium of the Greater Bay Area Cultural and Sports Centre stands at 1 Wenti Road on the island tip south of the 21st Chong in Wanqingshan, Nansha District. It is the indoor arena of the three-venue complex delivered in June 2025, designed with Zaha Hadid Architects and laid out in a sea-facing C-shaped plan; it is operated by Guangzhou Huarun Wanxin Culture and Sports Development, part of China Resources Culture and Sports. The gymnasium has about 110,000 square metres of floor area and is planned as a 20,000-seat multi-purpose arena. The contractor describes fixed plus retractable stands with a service catwalk, a lower-bowl seat ratio of about 50 per cent and a total of roughly 10,000 installed seats, with larger capacities in concert configuration. The hall can switch quickly between ice and basketball, and also hosts performances, exhibitions and esports. A double-ring centre-hung screen made of eight outer and four inner panels offers 660.34 square metres of display and can be raised, lowered and combined. On 10 August 2025 the finals of the Guangzhou Basketball City League were played here, the venue's first event after handover. The centre occupies the southern tip of Nansha facing the Lingdingyang estuary, passed its completion inspection in June 2025 and began hosting basketball leagues and large concerts from August, becoming a new landmark in southern Guangzhou. It also includes a 60,000-seat stadium and a 4,000-seat swimming and diving hall. The building sits within a 700,000-square-metre waterfront park. The arena is the indoor centrepiece of the Nansha complex. Telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 广州市天河区天河路229号天河体育中心内（体育中心东门旁二楼）
area_text: 7228平方米（建筑面积），占地4000平方米
intro_zh: 天河保龄球馆位于天河体育中心内、体育中心东门旁二楼，1994年始建，1996年1月正式对外营业，是广州保龄球文化的发源地之一。场馆占地4000平方米，建筑面积7228平方米，球场为3000平方米无柱空间，设38条美国AMF全自动保龄球道，另配台球、乒乓球、电子游戏机和咖啡快餐厅。1998年，球馆通过ISO9000国际质量体系认证，是中国保龄球协会和广州市保龄球协会的训练中心与比赛场地。2010年广州亚运会保龄球比赛在此举行，设300个座位。场馆至今仍在运营，承办广州市体育节保龄球公开赛、广州市保龄球联赛、夕阳红保龄球赛等群众赛事，也是天河体育中心全民健身项目的组成部分。球馆位于天河体育中心二楼，邻近天河体育场与广州网球中心场，周边为天河路商圈，地铁一号线、三号线体育西路站及APM线体育中心站步行可达，夜间营业至次日凌晨。球馆有38条球道，曾承办亚洲保龄球巡回赛、全国保龄球锦标赛等赛事，并提供教练与钻球服务。订场。
intro_en: Tianhe Bowling Hall occupies the second floor beside the east gate of Tianhe Sports Centre at 229 Tianhe Road. First built in 1994 and opened to the public in January 1996, it is one of the birthplaces of bowling culture in Guangzhou. The venue covers a 4,000-square-metre site with 7,228 square metres of floor area, and its 3,000-square-metre playing floor is column-free, holding 38 fully automatic AMF lanes together with billiards, table tennis, arcade machines and a cafe. In 1998 it became the first bowling centre in China to obtain ISO 9000 quality certification, and it serves as a training and competition centre for both the Chinese Bowling Association and the Guangzhou Bowling Association. The bowling events of the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games were held here, with 300 seats provided for spectators. The hall is still in operation and stages mass-participation events including the Guangzhou Sports Festival Bowling Open, the Guangzhou Bowling League and senior competitions, forming part of the fitness offer of Tianhe Sports Centre. It sits next to the main stadium and the Guangzhou Tennis Centre courts, in the middle of the Tianhe Road commercial district, with several metro and APM stations within walking distance and late-night opening. With 38 lanes under one roof, the hall has hosted the Asian Bowling Tour and national bowling championships, and it offers coaching and ball-drilling services. The centre remains a base for the Guangzhou Bowling Association and for amateur league play. It is also used for school and corporate events. Bookings go through the centre's public channels.

address: 广州市天河区大观南路36号广东奥林匹克体育中心内
area_text: 33331平方米（建筑面积）
intro_zh: 奥体游泳馆即广东奥林匹克体育中心游泳跳水馆，位于天河区大观南路36号的奥体中心园区内，建筑面积33331平方米，设4584个固定座位，是2010年广州亚运会游泳、跳水和现代五项游泳比赛的主要场馆。馆内设标准比赛池、跳水池与训练池，水温、水质、灯光和计时记分按国际赛事标准配置，看台分上下层，观众视线覆盖泳池与跳台。赛后场馆定位为国家南方训练基地，满足国家队冬训以及亚运会后举办重大赛事的要求。奥体中心整体占地约100万平方米，由体育场、游泳跳水馆、网球中心、射箭场、射击馆等组成，地铁四号线、二十一号线可达黄村一带，园区内各场馆共享停车与观众集散配套。游泳馆现由广东省奥林匹克体育中心运营，面向专业训练、赛事和公众开放，夏季提供惠民泳票。奥体中心于2001年落成，曾承办第九届全国运动会，2010年亚运会与亚残运会期间承担游泳、跳水比赛及开闭幕式相关任务，园区场馆群由此成型。游泳馆位于奥体园区内，运动员可就近使用田径场等训练设施。咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: The Guangdong Olympic Sports Center Swimming and Diving Hall stands inside the Olympic centre at 36 Daguang South Road, Tianhe District. It has 33,331 square metres of floor area and 4,584 fixed seats, and was the principal venue for swimming, diving and the swimming leg of the modern pentathlon at the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games. Inside are a standard competition pool, a diving pool and a training pool, with water temperature, water quality, lighting and timing equipment set to international competition standards; the stands are arranged in two tiers so that spectators can see both the pools and the diving platforms. After the Games the hall was designated a national training base for southern China, intended for winter training by national squads and for major events. The Olympic centre as a whole covers about one million square metres and contains the main stadium, this swimming and diving hall, the tennis centre, the archery range and the shooting hall; Metro Lines 4 and 21 serve the Huangcun area, and the venues share parking and spectator circulation. The hall is operated by the Guangdong Olympic Sports Center and is used for professional training, competition and public swimming, with subsidised tickets in summer. The centre was completed in 2001 for the 9th National Games and during the 2010 Asian Games and Asian Para Games hosted swimming and diving competition as well as ceremonies, establishing the venue cluster that exists today. Its position within the Olympic park means athletes can use the athletics track and other training facilities nearby. Enquiries go through the venue's public channels.

address: 广州市天河区东圃镇黄村广东奥林匹克体育中心西北侧（大观南路36号）
area_text: 总占地面积约56398平方米（主比赛馆、副馆及13片室外场）
capacity_text: 主比赛馆约10000座，副馆约2000座
intro_zh: 奥体网球中心是广东奥林匹克体育中心西北角的一片网球建筑群，也是广州网球日常训练与业余赛事最集中的场地之一。它由一栋开敞式网球主比赛馆、一栋副馆、13片室外标准网球场（部分资料记为14片）以及附属用房组成，总占地面积约56398平方米。主比赛馆可容纳约一万名观众，副馆约两千座；开敞式设计让岭南湿热气候下的通风成为可能，看台与场地之间没有封闭外壳，比赛时靠临时设施补足竞赛功能。这片场地在2010年广州亚运会期间承担网球比赛，当时的正式名称是广州亚运会网球馆中心，赛后以广东省奥林匹克网球中心之名继续运营，因此今天说的“奥体网球中心”与“广东省奥林匹克网球中心”指的是同一处设施，只是前者偏场馆群俗称、后者偏官方名称。2015年至2018年间，这里成为广州国际女子网球公开赛的比赛场地，是WTA巡回赛在广州的主要落脚点之一；此后场地转向公众开放，室外场按小时出租，成为天河东部网球培训与约球的主要供给。2023年起，广东奥林匹克体育中心整体进行十五运会品质提升，网球中心的外立面与屋面纳入改造范围，但比赛场地的基本格局未变。对活动与赛事主办方而言，这里的价值在于“大场+多片外场”的组合：主馆可承接决赛与演出型开幕式，13片室外场可同时容纳大规模分组赛与训练，副馆则在雨天提供室内备份，这种配置在广州中心城区并不多见。交通上，场馆位于广园快速路与大观路交界一侧，地铁4号线、21号线黄村站可达，奥体中心内部停车资源充足。
intro_en: The Olympic Tennis Centre occupies the north-western corner of the Guangdong Olympic Sports Centre in Huangcun, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, and is the city's main cluster for competitive and recreational tennis. The complex is made up of an open-sided main match hall, a secondary hall, thirteen outdoor standard courts and support buildings, on a site of about 56,398 square metres. The main hall seats roughly 10,000 spectators and the secondary hall about 2,000; the open structure, with stands looking straight onto the courts rather than enclosed in a sealed envelope, suits Guangzhou's hot, humid climate and lets air move through the venue, while temporary facilities are added for tournament operations. The courts were built for the tennis competition of the 2010 Asian Games, when the venue was officially called the Guangzhou Asian Games Tennis Centre; after the Games it continued in service as the Guangdong Provincial Olympic Tennis Centre, so the two names used in venue lists refer to one and the same place, one being the popular shorthand used by the Olympic Sports Centre and the other the formal title. Between 2015 and 2018 the centre hosted the Guangzhou International Women's Open, the city's WTA stop, which fixed its reputation as a tournament venue rather than a training ground only. Since then the outdoor courts have been opened to the public on an hourly basis and now supply much of eastern Tianhe's tennis coaching and casual play. From 2023 the wider Olympic Sports Centre was upgraded for the 15th National Games, and the tennis centre's facades and roof were included in the works, although the playing layout stayed as it was. For event organisers the appeal is the combination of one large hall with many outdoor courts: the main hall can carry a final or a ceremony-style opening, the thirteen outside courts can run large draws and practice at the same time, and the secondary hall provides an indoor fallback in the rainy season, a mix that is hard to find inside central Guangzhou. The site sits off the Guangyuan Expressway and Daguang Road, is reachable from Huangcun station on metro lines 4 and 21, and has ample parking within the Olympic park.

name_zh: 广东省奥林匹克网球中心
address: 广州市天河区东圃镇黄村广东奥林匹克体育中心西北
area_text: 占地56398平方米，总建筑面积约2.1万平方米
capacity_text: 固定座位11379个（主赛场1万座、副赛场2千座）
intro_zh: 广东省奥林匹克网球中心位于广州天河区东圃镇黄村，广东奥林匹克体育中心西北面，是2010年广州亚运会12座新建场馆之一，赛时名为广州亚运会网球馆中心。项目占地56398平方米，总建筑面积约2.1万平方米，总投资约1.8亿元，由一个可容纳一万名观众的主比赛场、一个可容纳两千名观众的副比赛场及14片室外标准网球场组成。主比赛场为甲级体育建筑，地上三层，副场地上一层，两者通过室外场地串联成一个完整的竞赛单元；亚运官方口径的固定座位数为11379个，与主副场分项数字的合计略有差异，引用时宜注明口径。2010年11月13日至23日，这里承办了亚运会的网球比赛，是当时广州新建场馆中技术标准最高的一处网球设施。亚运结束后场馆转为长期运营，2015年至2018年成为广州国际女子网球公开赛的比赛场地，把WTA级别的赛事留在天河东部；此后又作为广东省网球队训练与青少年培训基地使用，室外场分时段向公众开放。建筑上，主比赛场采用开敞式看台，屋盖轻巧，立面以浅色构件为主，与奥体中心体育场的飘带造型形成呼应而不抢主体。场馆隶属广东省奥林匹克体育中心，由省体育局系统管理，与体育场、游泳跳水馆、曲棍球场、射击馆、射箭场、马术场等共同构成奥体片区。2023年起奥体片区按十五运会标准整体提升，网球中心的外立面与屋面一并修缮。对赛事主办方来说，这里的核心资产是“一个万人主赛场+一个两千座副赛场+14片室外场”的组合，可在同一园区内完成正赛、资格赛、训练与媒体运行，不必跨城转场。
intro_en: The Guangdong Provincial Olympic Tennis Centre stands in Huangcun, Dongpu, in Tianhe District, on the north-western side of the Guangdong Olympic Sports Centre. It was one of twelve venues newly built for the 2010 Asian Games, when it was known as the Guangzhou Asian Games Tennis Centre. The project covers 56,398 square metres with about 21,000 square metres of floor area and cost roughly RMB 180 million, and comprises a 10,000-seat main match court, a 2,000-seat secondary court and fourteen outdoor standard courts. The main court is a Grade A sports building of three storeys above ground, the secondary court is single-storey, and the outdoor courts tie the two together into one competition precinct; the Asian Games figure for fixed seating was 11,379, slightly different from the sum of the main and secondary court capacities, so the basis of any seat count should be stated. The tennis competition of the 2010 Asian Games ran here from 13 to 23 November, and at the time it was the most technically advanced tennis facility among Guangzhou's new venues. After the Games it moved into long-term operation and from 2015 to 2018 served as the venue for the Guangzhou International Women's Open, keeping a WTA-level tournament in eastern Tianhe; it has since been used as a training base for the provincial team and for junior coaching, with the outdoor courts opened to the public in time slots. Architecturally the main court is an open stand under a light roof, with pale cladding that answers the ribbon form of the neighbouring Olympic stadium without competing with it. The centre belongs to the Guangdong Olympic Sports Centre and is managed within the provincial sports bureau system, alongside the stadium, aquatics hall, hockey pitch, shooting hall, archery range and equestrian grounds that make up the Olympic park. From 2023 the park was upgraded to 15th National Games standards, and the tennis centre's facades and roof were renovated with it. For event owners the key asset is the combination of a 10,000-seat main court, a 2,000-seat secondary court and fourteen outdoor courts, which allows main draw, qualifying, practice and media operations to sit inside one precinct with no need to move between sites.

address: 广州市天河区广州大道中1268号广州体育学院内（河东片区）
area_text: 总建筑面积约14500平方米（地上约13000平方米、地下约1500平方米）
intro_zh: 广体体育馆的正式名称是广州体育学院亚运篮球馆，位于广州大道中1268号广州体育学院河东片区，是为2010年广州亚运会新建的篮球比赛馆。项目总建筑面积约14500平方米，其中地上主体约13000平方米、地下室约1500平方米，室外配套约2800平方米，设约5000个观众席位，配120个汽车位与200个自行车位，总投资5901万元。设计由广东省建科建筑设计院承担，外立面以柱廊与玻璃幕墙交替，柱子的做法借鉴岭南骑楼，阳光透过柱与玻璃形成虚实相间的效果，是亚运新建场馆中体量不大但完成度较高的一座。2010年亚运会期间这里承办男子篮球比赛；赛后归广州体育学院使用，成为教学、训练与校队主场，同时向周边社区分时开放。2025年第十五届全国运动会，场馆经过全面翻新后承办排球男子20岁以下组比赛和霹雳舞项目，是广州赛区少数同时承接两个竞赛项目的场馆之一；为配合赛事，学院对校园流线、热身区、媒体区与灯光音响系统做了整体升级。对活动主办方而言，这座馆的优势是“校园内的专业馆”：座席规模适中，适合篮球、排球、霹雳舞、电竞与中型演出；场芯按比赛标准铺设木地板，灯光满足国际比赛照度；学院本身可提供志愿者、裁判与训练团队，办赛人力成本低于纯商业场馆。局限在于校园管理，赛演活动需与教学错峰，观众入口与安检区设于校园边界，大型演出的搭台时间与噪声控制要与校方单独协商。交通上，场馆紧邻广州大道中，地铁3号线林和西站与广州东站均在步行或短驳范围内，外地队伍从广州东站抵达只需十余分钟。
intro_en: Guangti Gymnasium, formally the Guangzhou Sport University Asian Games Basketball Hall, sits inside the Heyong compound of Guangzhou Sport University at 1268 Guangzhou Avenue Middle, Tianhe District. It was built for the basketball tournament of the 2010 Asian Games, with about 14,500 square metres of floor area, of which some 13,000 square metres is above ground and 1,500 below, plus 2,800 square metres of external works; it seats around 5,000 spectators and provides 120 car spaces and 200 bicycle spaces at a cost of RMB 59.01 million. The design was won by the Guangdong Provincial Architectural Design and Research Institute, and its facades alternate colonnade and glass, the columns borrowing from the arcaded qilou of Lingnan street architecture so that sunlight through the columns and glazing produces a shifting solid-and-void effect. It is a small venue by Asian Games standards but a well-resolved one. During the 2010 Games it hosted the men's basketball competition; afterwards it passed to the university for teaching, training and varsity fixtures, and it opens to neighbouring residents in scheduled slots. For the 15th National Games in 2025 the hall was comprehensively renovated and hosted the men's under-20 volleyball tournament and the breaking events, making it one of the few Guangzhou venues to carry two competition programmes; the university upgraded campus circulation, warm-up areas, media zones and the lighting and sound systems for the Games. For organisers the advantage is a professional hall inside a campus: the seating scale suits basketball, volleyball, breaking, esports and mid-sized concerts, the floor is competition-grade timber, the lighting meets international competition levels, and the university can supply stewards, officials and training staff at a lower operating cost than a purely commercial arena. The constraint is campus management: events must be scheduled around teaching, spectator entry and security screening sit at the campus boundary, and load-in times and noise limits for large concerts have to be agreed separately with the university. The site fronts Guangzhou Avenue Middle, with Linhexi station on metro line 3 and Guangzhou East railway station both within a short walk or shuttle ride, so visiting teams arriving by rail reach the hall in about ten minutes.

address: 广州市黄埔区科学城开泰大道6号（尖塔山南麓）
area_text: 占地约10万㎡（建筑面积未公开）
capacity_text: 中心赛场5000座，东侧两片场可设2000座临时看台
intro_zh: 广州国际网球中心位于黄埔区科学城中部、尖塔山南麓，是华南地区规模最大的网球中心之一，也是广州东部唯一按甲级体育建筑标准建设的网球比赛场。项目2007年开工，2009年7月15日竣工，总耗资约1.8亿元。场地依山势分成三块：中部是中心赛场区，南侧是练习球场区，北侧是停车区。全场设1个中心赛场、9片标准室外赛场和3片室内标准练习场；中心赛场可容纳5000名观众，东侧两片场地可加设2000座临时看台，其余每片标准场可容纳约250人，平时作为训练场使用。这样的布局让中心既可以承办国际职业赛事，也能在同一时段消化青少年培训、业余联赛和企业团建——中心场负责决赛与转播，外场负责分组赛与训练，室内练习场在雨季提供替代方案。建成后，这里长期承担广州开发区网球培训与赛事功能，同址的广州开发区国际网球学校是广州东部最主要的网球青训机构，2025年广州黄埔国际网球公开赛暨ATP100国际男子职业网球挑战赛即在网球学校场地举行，使这一片区成为黄埔区网球赛事的固定落点。场地为硬地，符合国际网联比赛要求，夜间照明完备，看台与场地距离近，观赛视线集中。交通上，中心位于科学城开泰大道，地铁21号线科学城站可达，周边为科学城体育公园，与尖塔山、牛角岭公园连成一片绿地，赛时可利用公园空间设置观众集散与赞助商活动区。
intro_en: The Guangzhou International Tennis Centre lies at the southern foot of Jiantashan in the middle of the Science City district of Huangpu, and is one of the largest tennis complexes in southern China and the only tennis venue in eastern Guangzhou built to Grade A sports-building standards. Construction began in 2007 and was completed on 15 July 2009 at a cost of about RMB 180 million. The site follows the slope in three bands: the centre court zone in the middle, practice courts to the south and parking to the north. It contains one centre court, nine standard outdoor courts and three indoor standard practice courts. The centre court seats 5,000, the two courts on its eastern side can take temporary stands for 2,000 more, and each of the remaining standard courts holds around 250, being used as training courts most of the time. That arrangement lets the centre run an international professional tournament while also absorbing junior coaching, amateur leagues and corporate days in the same session: the centre court carries finals and broadcast, the outside courts carry draws and practice, and the indoor practice courts provide cover in the rainy season. Since completion it has anchored tennis training and competition in the Guangzhou Development District, and the Guangzhou Development District International Tennis School on the same site is the main junior tennis academy in eastern Guangzhou; the 2025 Guangzhou Huangpu International Tennis Open, an ATP Challenger 100 event, was played on the school's courts, which has made this corner of Huangpu a fixed stop on the regional tennis calendar. The surfaces are hard courts meeting International Tennis Federation requirements, floodlighting is complete, and the stands sit close to the playing area so sightlines are tight. The centre is on Kaitai Avenue in Science City, reachable from Science City station on metro line 21, and adjoins the Science City Sports Park, whose lawns and paths around Jiantashan and Niujiaoling can be used for spectator dispersal and sponsor activations during tournaments.

name_zh: 广州大学城体育中心自行车馆
address: 广州市番禺区小谷围岛广州大学城体育中心内（星风路2号）
area_text: 占地约2.4万平方米
intro_zh: 广州大学城体育中心自行车馆位于番禺区小谷围岛，是大学城体育中心“一馆四场”极限运动公园的核心建筑，2010年8月落成，为第16届广州亚运会场地自行车比赛而建。馆体占地约2.4万平方米，外形像一个硕大的银色自行车头盔，曲面金属屋面在日照下呈现流动的高光，是大学城中心湖区最容易辨认的建筑之一。馆内设一条250米长、7.5米宽的专业木质赛道，赛道由进口木材铺装，弯道超高按国际自行车联盟标准设置，可承办场地自行车国际赛事；看台设3000个座位，座席沿赛道两侧展开，观众与赛道之间没有跑道阻隔，冲刺时几乎能听到轮胎压过木缝的声音。亚运会期间这里承担场地自行车项目，赛后成为华南地区规模最大、设备最先进的自行车馆，长期供广东省及广州市自行车队训练，并向公众提供场地体验与青少年培训。自行车馆所在的极限运动公园还包含小轮车场、轮滑场、滑板场与攀岩场，形成“一馆四场”的组合，2014年10月试运营、2015年1月1日正式开放，使大学城体育中心从单一的比赛场馆转为日常运动公园。对赛事与活动主办方而言，自行车馆的独特之处在于室内无柱大空间与环形看台：场地自行车赛、轮滑赛、室内小轮车表演都可直接落地，闭幕式、发布会与品牌快闪也能借用赛道做背景；但木赛道对地面保护要求极高，搭台与撤场需铺设保护层并限制重载车辆入场。交通上，场馆位于大学城中心湖区，地铁4号线大学城北站转公交或步行可达，周边为十所高校，青年观众基础好。
intro_en: The Velodrome of the Guangzhou Higher Education Mega Centre Sports Centre stands on Xiaoguwei Island in Panyu District and is the core building of the centre's extreme-sports park, completed in August 2010 for the track cycling events of the 16th Asian Games. The hall covers about 24,000 square metres and is shaped like an oversized silver cycling helmet, its curved metal roof throwing moving highlights in the sun and making it one of the most recognisable structures around the Mega Centre's central lake. Inside is a 250-metre professional timber track, 7.5 metres wide, laid with imported wood and banked to International Cycling Union standards so that international track events can be staged; the stands hold 3,000 spectators along both sides of the track, with no barrier between audience and racing surface, so that during a sprint the sound of tyres crossing the timber joints carries straight up. The venue hosted track cycling at the 2010 Asian Games and afterwards became the largest and best-equipped velodrome in southern China, used for training by provincial and municipal squads and opened for public track sessions and junior coaching. The wider extreme-sports park around it also contains a BMX track, a roller-skating track, a skate park and a climbing wall, forming the 'one hall, four grounds' cluster that began trial operation in October 2014 and opened fully on 1 January 2015, turning the Mega Centre from a Games venue into an everyday sports park. For event owners the velodrome's distinguishing feature is its column-free interior and the ring of seating: track cycling, roller racing and indoor BMX displays can all be staged as they are, and ceremonies, launches and brand pop-ups can use the banking as a backdrop. The timber track, however, demands strict floor protection, with protective decking and a ban on heavy vehicles during load-in and load-out. The site sits by the central lake, reachable from Higher Education Mega Centre North station on metro line 4 by bus or on foot, and is surrounded by ten universities, which gives it a young spectator base.

address: 广州市天河区天河路299号
area_text: 占地约52万平方米（另有58.8万平方米口径）
capacity_text: 体育场52611座（2024年改造后）；体育馆8628座
intro_zh: 广州天河体育中心位于天河区天河路299号，地处城市新中轴线与天河南商圈之间，1984年7月动工、1987年8月30日落成，是为第六届全国运动会兴建的大型综合体育设施，也是中国改革开放后第一个一次建成体育场、体育馆、游泳馆“一场两馆”的体育中心。中心占地约52万平方米，不同时期的资料有51万至58.8万平方米的口径，引用时宜注明来源。体育场呈马鞍形，最初可容纳六万人，2009年改造后减至5.6万座，2024年为十五运会再次升级，固定座席调整为52611个，并成为全国首个近零碳大型体育场馆；体育馆设8628座，游泳馆、棒球场、网球中心场、保龄球馆、篮球城等陆续增建，形成完整的场馆群。这里的历史节点密集：1987年六运会开闭幕式与田径、足球比赛；1991年首届女子世界杯足球赛的主会场，承办开、闭幕式与决赛；2010年亚运会足球比赛；2011年至2021年作为广州恒大淘宝的主场，见证了中超最热的球市；2018年看台座椅换成红紫粉白四色木棉花图案，2021年跑道与灯光改造后获得国际田联与中国田协双一级认证。中心还是全民健身的样本，1995年起免费向市民开放，建成全国第一条健身路径，年均开放时间约七万小时。对活动主办方而言，天体最大的优势是“城市中心+多馆组合”：体育场适合大型演唱会与开幕式，体育馆适合室内赛事与中型演出，外围广场可做嘉年华与赞助商展区，地铁1号线、3号线体育西路站与APM线林和西站步行可达，散场压力可由多条轨道线分担。
intro_en: The Guangzhou Tianhe Sports Centre occupies 299 Tianhe Road, between the city's new central axis and the Tianhe South commercial district. Work began in July 1984 and the complex opened on 30 August 1987 for the 6th National Games; it was the first sports centre in reform-era China to deliver a stadium, an indoor arena and a swimming hall as one project, the so-called 'one ground, two halls' model. The site covers about 520,000 square metres, although figures from different periods range from 510,000 to 588,000, so any area quoted should carry its source. The stadium has a saddle-shaped profile and originally held 60,000 people; renovation for the 2010 Asian Games cut capacity to 56,000, and the 2024 upgrade for the 15th National Games settled it at 52,611 fixed seats while making it the first near-zero-carbon large stadium in China. The arena seats 8,628, and a swimming hall, baseball ground, tennis centre courts, bowling alley and basketball courts were added over the years to form a full venue cluster. Its history is unusually dense: the 1987 National Games opening and closing ceremonies with athletics and football; the 1991 inaugural FIFA Women's World Cup, for which it was the main venue and hosted the opening, closing and final; football at the 2010 Asian Games; and from 2011 to 2021 the home ground of Guangzhou Evergrande Taobao, when it held the hottest ticket in Chinese football. In 2018 the seating was replaced with a red, purple, pink and white kapok pattern, and after the 2021 track and lighting works the stadium earned dual first-class certification from World Athletics and the Chinese Athletics Association. The centre is also a national model for public sport: it has opened free of charge since 1995 and built China's first fitness trail, logging about 70,000 open hours a year. For organisers the appeal is a city-centre site with several halls: the stadium for stadium-scale concerts and ceremonies, the arena for indoor sport and mid-sized shows, and the surrounding plaza for festivals and sponsor villages, with Tiyu Xilu stations on metro lines 1 and 3 and Linhexi on the APM within walking distance to spread the crowd across several rail lines.

address: 广州市越秀区横枝岗路289号
area_text: 占地约12205平方米
capacity_text: 不设固定观众座席，设比赛大厅
intro_zh: 广州棋院位于越秀区横枝岗路289号，北望白云山、西邻麓湖，占地约12205平方米，是广州市棋牌运动的主管单位，也是2010年广州亚运会的棋类比赛场馆。它的前身是1956年成立的广州棋艺社，2005年更名为广州市棋院，2007年定名广州棋院，2010年加挂“广州市棋牌运动管理中心”牌子，为广州市体育局直属正处级事业单位，负责围棋、象棋、国际象棋、桥牌、扑克牌五个协会的业务指导，承担培训、竞赛、管理与对外交流。建筑是这座场馆最特别的地方：设计用“院”把山体景观引入建筑组群，通过建筑与山、建筑与建筑、建筑与景观的围合，让庭园空间收放有致，白墙、灰瓦、连廊与竹林层层递进，被称为“最具文化味的亚运场馆”。2010年11月13日至26日，亚运会围棋、象棋、国际象棋三棋比赛在此举行，这是亚运史上首次实现“三棋全会”，场馆按棋类比赛要求设置了比赛大厅、对局室、直播与裁判区，不设大型观众看台，观众通过大盘讲解与转播观赛。赛后这里回归日常：一楼与副楼开设培训教室，常年举办少儿棋类培训、段级位赛与“市长杯”等群众赛事，比赛大厅可承接全国及省级棋牌赛事，也可用于发布会、文化展览与小规模沙龙。对活动主办方而言，棋院的优势是文化调性与安静环境，适合品牌沙龙、围甲联赛主场、棋类主题展览与小型颁奖礼；局限是场地以对局空间为主，不适合大型演出与高密度人流活动。交通上，场馆位于横枝岗路，公交横枝岗路北站、横枝岗总站可达，从市中心乘车约半小时。
intro_en: The Guangzhou Chess Institute stands at 289 Hengzhigang Road in Yuexiu District, with Baiyun Mountain to the north and Luhu Lake to the west, on a site of about 12,205 square metres. It is the city's governing body for board and card games and was the chess venue of the 2010 Asian Games. Its predecessor, the Guangzhou Chess Arts Society, was founded in 1956; it was renamed the Guangzhou Municipal Chess Institute in 2005, took its present name in 2007, and in 2010 was also designated the Guangzhou Board and Card Games Administration Centre. It is a department-level public institution directly under the municipal sports bureau, guides the five associations for go, xiangqi, international chess, bridge and card games, and handles training, competition, administration and international exchange. The architecture is the most distinctive thing about it: the design uses the idea of a courtyard to draw the hillside landscape into the building group, closing and opening the garden spaces through the relationship between building and hill, building and building, building and landscape, so that white walls, grey tiles, covered walks and bamboo groves succeed one another in layers; it is often called the most cultured of the Asian Games venues. From 13 to 26 November 2010 the go, xiangqi and international chess competitions were held here, the first time all three board games appeared at a single Asian Games. The building was fitted with a competition hall, playing rooms, broadcast and arbiter areas rather than large spectator stands, and spectators followed the games through demonstration boards and television. Afterwards it returned to everyday use: classrooms in the main and side buildings run children's coaching, grading tournaments and mass events such as the Mayor's Cup, while the competition hall can host national and provincial championships as well as launches, cultural exhibitions and small salons. For organisers the appeal is cultural atmosphere and quiet, suiting brand salons, home matches of the Chinese Go league, board-game themed exhibitions and small award ceremonies; the limitation is that the rooms are built for play, not for large performances or dense crowds. The site is on Hengzhigang Road, served by the Hengzhigang Road North and Hengzhigang terminus bus stops, about half an hour by car from the city centre.
