name_zh: 广州自行车轮滑极限运动中心
address: 广州市番禺区小谷围岛广州大学城中心湖区（大学城体育中心内）
area_text: 占地152992平方米，建筑面积26642平方米（自行车馆11692、轮滑场3450、极限运动馆11500）
intro_zh: 广州自行车轮滑极限运动中心位于番禺区小谷围岛广州大学城中心湖区，是2010年广州亚运会为自行车与轮滑项目新建的场馆群，由自行车馆、轮滑场和极限运动中心区组成。项目占地152992平方米，建筑面积26642平方米，其中自行车馆11692平方米、轮滑场3450平方米、极限运动馆11500平方米。设计以“极、核、旋、风”为理念，把极限运动的速度、力量与技巧转译成建筑语言：自行车馆的造型考虑南方湿热多雨的气候，借鉴骑楼街的做法，在东西向设置遮阴外廊，观众在廊下排队与疏散时不必暴晒；轮滑场布置在基地南侧，赛道开敞，与看台形成半围合；极限运动区则用碗池、坡道与平台组成连续的运动场景。2010年11月13日至26日，亚运会的场地自行车、小轮车与轮滑比赛在此举行，赛后这里成为大学城体育中心“一馆四场”极限运动公园的主体，2014年10月12日试运营、2015年1月1日正式开放。今天园区内有250米木质赛道的自行车馆、200米速度轮滑赛道、BMX泥地竞速场、1.6万平方米滑板场和7000平方米攀岩场，其中攀岩场设8条速度赛道、20条难度赛道和12条攀石赛道，是亚洲规格最高的攀岩场之一，2016年世界青年攀岩锦标赛、2017至2019年国际攀联中国攀岩公开赛均在此举办。对活动主办方而言，这里的价值是“极限运动场景+开敞空间”：滑板、轮滑、小轮车、攀岩赛事可直接落地，品牌快闪、青年文化节与音乐节可利用碗池与坡道做舞台背景；但场地多为室外，雨季与高温时段的排期需要留出备份方案。
intro_en: The Guangzhou Cycling, Roller-Skating and Extreme Sports Centre occupies the central lake area of the Guangzhou Higher Education Mega Centre on Xiaoguwei Island, Panyu District. It was built for the cycling and roller-skating events of the 2010 Asian Games and consists of a velodrome, a roller-skating track and an extreme-sports zone. The site covers 152,992 square metres with 26,642 square metres of building, of which the velodrome accounts for 11,692, the roller track 3,450 and the extreme-sports hall 11,500. The design works around four ideas — extreme, core, spin and wind — translating the speed, strength and skill of action sports into architectural form. The velodrome's shape responds to the hot, wet southern climate by borrowing the arcaded qilou street, with shaded verandahs on the east and west so that spectators queue and disperse out of the sun; the roller track sits on the southern part of the site, open to the air and half-enclosed by its stands; and the extreme zone strings bowls, ramps and platforms into a continuous course. From 13 to 26 November 2010 the Asian Games track cycling, BMX and roller-skating competitions were held here. Afterwards the complex became the core of the Mega Centre's extreme-sports park, which began trial operation on 12 October 2014 and opened fully on 1 January 2015. Today the park holds the velodrome with its 250-metre timber track, a 200-metre speed roller track, a BMX dirt track, a 16,000-square-metre skate park and a 7,000-square-metre climbing wall with eight speed routes, twenty lead routes and twelve bouldering routes, one of the highest-specification climbing walls in Asia; the 2016 World Youth Climbing Championships and the China Climbing Open from 2017 to 2019 were held here. For event owners the value lies in an action-sports setting with open ground: skate, roller, BMX and climbing competitions can be staged as they are, and brand pop-ups, youth culture festivals and music events can use the bowls and ramps as stage scenery. Most of the site is outdoors, however, so schedules in the rainy season and the hottest months need a backup plan.

address: 广州市海珠区素社街道仲恺路628号
area_text: 总用地37188平方米，中心场馆建筑面积约2.5万平方米
intro_zh: 海珠体育中心位于海珠区仲恺路628号、海印桥南，是为2010年广州亚运会藤球比赛新建的专业场馆，也是当时广州市中心唯一新建的亚运场馆。项目总用地37188平方米，中心场馆建筑面积约2.5万平方米，总投资约1.35亿元，2010年8月13日落成并举行首场表演赛。主场馆设1742个固定座位，场地按藤球国际比赛要求布置，净空与灯光满足电视转播需要；亚运期间这里承办藤球项目全部比赛，世界藤球联合会负责人曾评价其为当时世界上仅有的两个国际级藤球馆之一。亚运结束后场馆转向全民健身，一层与三层改造为羽毛球场，成为广州市区规模最大的羽毛球专业场馆之一，室外羽毛球场与乒乓球台免费开放，日常由海珠区体育场馆全民健身中心运营。2025年9月17日，紧邻一期东侧的二期工程海珠文化服务中心（海珠体育中心二期）启用，总建筑面积约5.6万平方米，内设游泳馆、少年宫与图书馆，靠近地铁10号线滨江东路站，使这一片区从单一体育馆扩展为文体综合体。对活动主办方而言，海珠体育中心的价值在于“市中心+中小型馆”：1742座的看台规模适合羽毛球、乒乓球、藤球、篮球等室内赛事，也适合发布会、电竞比赛与中型演出；场馆层高充足，搭台不受限，周边为成熟居住区，观众到达便利，但大型活动需与居民区噪声要求协调。交通上，场馆位于仲恺路，公交仲恺路站可达，地铁2号线市二宫站、10号线滨江东路站均在短驳范围内。
intro_en: The Haizhu Sports Centre stands at 628 Zhongkai Road in the Sushe subdistrict of Haizhu District, just south of Haizhu Bridge, and was built for the sepak takraw tournament of the 2010 Asian Games. It was the only new Asian Games venue erected in central Guangzhou at the time. The site covers 37,188 square metres, the main hall about 25,000 square metres, and the project cost around RMB 135 million; it was completed on 13 August 2010 with a demonstration match. The main hall has 1,742 fixed seats, a court laid out to international sepak takraw requirements, and clear height and lighting sufficient for television broadcast. During the Games it staged the whole sepak takraw programme, and the then head of the international federation described it as one of only two international-standard sepak takraw halls in the world. After the Games the venue turned to public sport: the first and third floors were converted into badminton courts, making it one of the largest dedicated badminton halls in central Guangzhou, while outdoor badminton courts and table tennis tables opened free of charge, all run by the Haizhu District Sports Venues and Fitness Centre. On 17 September 2025 a second phase, the Haizhu Cultural Service Centre, opened immediately east of the first phase with about 56,000 square metres of floor area, adding a swimming hall, a children's palace and a library near Binhai Donglu station on metro line 10, so that the site has grown from a single hall into a culture-and-sport complex. For event owners the appeal is a central location with a mid-sized hall: 1,742 seats suit badminton, table tennis, sepak takraw and basketball tournaments as well as launches, esports and mid-scale concerts, the clear height allows staging without obstruction, and the surrounding mature residential districts make audience access easy, although noise limits have to be agreed with neighbours for large shows. The venue is on Zhongkai Road with bus stops at the gate, and both Jiangnanxi station on line 2 and Binhai Donglu on line 10 are a short shuttle ride away.

address: 广州市黄埔区丰乐北路398号黄埔体育中心内
area_text: 总建筑面积约31690平方米，建筑高度22.4米
capacity_text: 固定坐席3254个，亚运期间加临时坐席后近5000席
intro_zh: 黄埔中心体育馆位于黄埔区丰乐北路398号黄埔体育中心东北角，是为2010年广州亚运会男子篮球小组赛新建的场馆。黄埔体育中心本身建成于2001年，总投资3.96亿元，占地约17万平方米，内有体育场与体育馆两座主体建筑；体育馆于亚运前建成，总建筑面积约31690平方米，建筑高度22.4米，由比赛馆与训练馆组成，固定坐席3254个，亚运期间加设临时坐席后总坐席接近5000个。外立面以“蕉叶”“阔叶”“艳阳”三种意象相互穿插，竖向百叶与曲面檐口组合出热带植物的舒展感，是广州亚运场馆中少见的以植物形态为主题的建筑。亚运期间这里承办男子篮球小组赛，赛后成为黄埔区最大的综合馆，可承接篮球、羽毛球、排球、乒乓球等赛事以及文艺演出、展览和群众活动，日常由黄埔区体育发展中心运营，体育馆对外提供分时订场。场馆与黄埔体育场共用一片园区，体育场设12000个座位、标准田径场与足球场，两者可联合承办大型运动会与开幕式；园区东邻镇东路、西邻丰乐路、南靠护林路、北靠广园快速线，距地铁5号线大沙东站约500米，公交总站就在护林路对面，观众疏散条件较好。对活动主办方而言，这座馆的定位是“区级万人级以下综合馆”：座席规模适中、场芯可按篮球或演出模式切换、配套训练馆可作后台与热身区，适合区域赛事、企业年会、电竞与中型演唱会；不足是场馆建成时间较早，灯光与吊挂系统虽经亚运改造，但大型演出的荷载与吊点仍需逐场核算。
intro_en: The Huangpu Central Gymnasium sits in the north-eastern corner of Huangpu Sports Centre at 398 Fengle North Road, Huangpu District, and was built for the men's basketball preliminaries of the 2010 Asian Games. The sports centre itself was completed in 2001 at a cost of RMB 396 million on a site of about 170,000 square metres, with a stadium and a gymnasium as its two main buildings. The gymnasium was finished before the Games with about 31,690 square metres of floor area and a height of 22.4 metres, made up of a competition hall and a training hall, with 3,254 fixed seats and close to 5,000 once temporary seating was added for the Games. Its facade interweaves three motifs — banana leaf, broadleaf and bright sun — through vertical louvres and curved eaves that give it the spreading quality of a tropical plant, an unusual botanical theme among Guangzhou's Asian Games venues. During the Games it hosted the men's basketball group matches; afterwards it became the largest multi-purpose hall in Huangpu, able to take basketball, badminton, volleyball and table tennis as well as performances, exhibitions and community events, and it is run day to day by the Huangpu District Sports Development Centre with hourly public booking. The hall shares a campus with the Huangpu Stadium, which has 12,000 seats and a standard track and football pitch, so the two can jointly host larger meets and opening ceremonies. The campus is bounded by Zhendong Road to the east, Fengle Road to the west, Hulin Road to the south and the Guangyuan Expressway to the north, about 500 metres from Dashatou East station on metro line 5, with a bus terminus across Hulin Road, which helps crowd dispersal. For organisers the hall works as a sub-10,000-seat district arena: the seating scale is moderate, the floor can switch between basketball and performance modes, and the training hall can serve as backstage and warm-up space, suiting regional tournaments, corporate annual meetings, esports and mid-sized concerts; the constraint is age, since although the lighting and rigging were upgraded for the Asian Games, load capacity and hanging points for large shows still have to be checked event by event.

name_zh: 广东奥林匹克体育中心
address: 广州市天河区大观南路36号
intro_zh: 广东奥林匹克体育中心位于广州市天河区大观南路36号，地处东圃黄村，北临广深高速，南接广深铁路与广园快速路，西邻华南理工大学、暨南大学等高校区，是广东省体育局直属的大型体育场馆群。中心占地约100万平方米，由体育场、田径场、游泳跳水馆、曲棍球场、射击馆等组成；主体育场总建筑面积32.8万平方米，设80012个座位，2001年为九运会建成，2025年第十五届全运会前完成改造，并作为开幕式和田径比赛主场。体育场以飘带状屋顶和“缎带”造型著称，改造后金属屋面达9万平方米，采用PTFE吊膜；二层增设800米环形开放式跑道与3.9万平方米绿地，首层形成骑楼式风雨环廊，座椅以蓝、红、紫、绿等色块拼出花城意象，通道改为微倾斜坡道以提升无障碍体验。赛后新建的8000平方米赛事指挥中心将转为篮球、羽毛球、壁球等全民健身空间。交通方面，地铁4号线与21号线黄村站、21号线大观南路站可达，周边公交及停车配套齐全。体育场屋盖以两条巨大的飘带相交形成中央开口，赛后草坪与田径场继续承办足球、田径赛事及大型演出。
intro_en: Guangdong Olympic Sports Center is located at 36 Daguannan Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, in the Huangcun area of Dongpu. It is bounded by the Guangzhou-Shenzhen Expressway to the north and the Guangzhou-Shenzhen railway and Guangyuan Expressway to the south, with the university district of South China University of Technology and Jinan University to the southwest. The centre is a provincial facility under the Guangdong Sports Bureau and covers about 1 million sqm, comprising the main stadium, athletics facilities, a swimming and diving hall, hockey pitches and shooting ranges. The stadium, completed in 2001 for the Ninth National Games, has 328,000 sqm of gross floor area and 80,012 seats; it was renovated for the 15th National Games in 2025 and used for the opening ceremony and athletics. Its ribbon-like roof is the signature element, with 90,000 sqm of metal roofing and PTFE tensioned membrane after renovation. An 800 m elevated running track and 39,000 sqm of lawn were added at the second level, while the ground floor forms an arcaded all-weather concourse; seating is arranged in blocks of blue, red, purple and green, and entrances were regraded as gentle ramps for accessibility. An 8,000 sqm command centre will become basketball, badminton and squash courts for public use. Metro Lines 4 and 21 stop at Huangcun, Line 21 also at Daguannanlu, and bus and parking facilities serve events. Two great roof ribbons cross above the bowl and leave the centre open to the sky, so the pitch and track can keep hosting football, athletics and concerts after the Games.

address: 广州市南沙区文体路1号（万顷沙镇二十一涌以南岛尖）
area_text: 占地约680,000㎡（0.68平方公里）；综合体育场建筑面积约186,000㎡
intro_zh: 大湾区文化体育中心位于广州市南沙区万顷沙镇最南端、二十一涌以南岛尖，地址为南沙区文体路1号，面向伶仃洋，处于粤港澳大湾区的地理几何中心，2025年正式启用。中心占地约0.68平方公里，包含6万座甲级综合体育场、2万座综合体育馆、游泳跳水馆，以及运动员中心、新闻中心等配套，是集文化、旅游、体育于一体的大型城市综合体。综合体育场总建筑面积约18.6万平方米，以中华之礼“扇子”为设计理念，屋顶如扇面徐徐打开，呈现叠瓦般的韵律；看台大部分座位可望见海景，形成“边看比赛边看海”的独特体验。场馆由中建三局、中建八局承建，按国内顶级综合赛事与国际单项赛事标准配置，可兼顾演出、展览及赛平两用转换；2025年广东省足球超级联赛在此开幕，并作为第十五届全运会重要场馆。交通方面，地铁18号线万顷沙站出站后可换乘南沙25路、旅游1路或赛事接驳大巴直达，周边连接深中通道与南沙站枢纽，广州、深圳、中山方向均可快速抵达。综合体育馆设2万座，游泳跳水馆可承接国际单项赛事，各馆通过室外平台与滨海步道相连。
intro_en: The Greater Bay Area Culture and Sports Center occupies the southern tip of Wanqingsha in Nansha District, Guangzhou, at 1 Wenti Road, facing the Lingdingyang estuary at what planners call the geometric centre of the Greater Bay Area. Opened in 2025, the complex covers about 0.68 sq km and comprises a 60,000-seat Class-A stadium, a 20,000-seat indoor arena, a swimming and diving hall, and supporting athlete and media centres, forming a large urban complex for sport, culture and tourism. The stadium has about 186,000 sqm of gross floor area and takes the Chinese ceremonial fan as its concept: the roof opens like a folding fan in overlapping tile-like planes. Most seats have a sea view, creating the venue's signature experience of watching a match while looking out over the water. Built by China State Construction's Third and Eighth Engineering Bureaus, it meets standards for top domestic multi-sport events and international single-sport championships, and can be converted for concerts, exhibitions and dual peace-time uses. The 2025 Guangdong Provincial Football Super League opened here, and the venue is a key site for the 15th National Games. Metro Line 18 reaches Wanqingsha station, from where Nansha bus 25, Tourist Line 1 or event shuttles run to the centre; the Shenzhen-Zhongshan Link and the Nansha station hub connect Guangzhou, Shenzhen and Zhongshan. The 20,000-seat arena and the swimming and diving hall share outdoor terraces with the stadium, and a waterfront promenade links the buildings to the estuary edge. The centre is a key venue for the 15th National Games, which Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao co-host, reinforcing its role as shared infrastructure for the whole bay area.

address: 广州市天河区天河路299号（天河体育中心内）
area_text: 建筑面积约65,600㎡；天河体育中心占地520,000㎡
intro_zh: 天河体育场位于广州市天河区天河路299号，地处天河体育中心核心区，毗邻广州东站、中信广场与天河路商圈，是广州城市新中轴上的地标体育场。体育场1984年动工、1987年8月30日落成，为第六届全运会而建，此后承办1991年首届女足世界杯、2010年亚运会足球赛及多届全运会赛事，2011年至2021年长期作为广州恒大（广州队）主场。场馆总建筑面积约6.56万平方米，其中田径足球场1.9万平方米、看台2.2万平方米，2024年改造后固定观众席52611座；轮廓呈马鞍形，两侧为白色拱顶，南北看台28级、东西看台40余级，座椅以红、紫、粉、白四色拼出广州市花木棉花图案。场内设标准田径场与足球场，拥有国际田联和中国田协田径场地双一级认证，2024年改造后成为全国首个近零碳大型体育场馆，并更新LED大屏、草坪与赛事功能用房。交通方面，地铁1号线、3号线体育西路站及APM线体育中心南站步行可达，周边公交线路密集。体育场与体育馆、游泳馆共同构成中心场馆群，赛时观众经中心广场与二层平台集散。
intro_en: Tianhe Stadium stands at 299 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, at the heart of the Tianhe Sports Center beside Guangzhou East railway station, CITIC Plaza and the Tianhe Road retail district, on the city's new central axis. Construction began in 1984 and the stadium opened on 30 August 1987 for the Sixth National Games; it later hosted the first FIFA Women's World Cup in 1991, the 2010 Asian Games football tournament and several National Games, and from 2011 to 2021 was the home of Guangzhou Evergrande. The building has about 65,600 sqm of gross floor area, including a 19,000 sqm athletics and football field and 22,000 sqm of stands, with 52,611 fixed seats after the 2024 renovation. Its outline is saddle-shaped, with white arched roofs over the east and west stands, 28 rows in the north and south stands and more than 40 rows east and west; seats in red, purple, pink and white form the kapok, Guangzhou's city flower. The pitch and track carry dual first-class certification from World Athletics and the Chinese Athletics Association, and the 2024 upgrade made it the country's first near-zero-carbon large stadium, with a new LED screen, turf and event rooms. Metro Lines 1 and 3 stop at Tiyu Xilu, the APM line at Tianhe Sports Center South, and buses serve the surrounding streets; the wider 520,000 sqm sports centre also includes an arena, swimming hall and public fitness facilities. The stadium forms a trio with the neighbouring arena and swimming hall, with crowds distributed through the central plaza and raised platforms on event days.

address: 广州市番禺区大学城内环东路208号（大学城中心区生态公园北端）
area_text: 体育场占地约26万平方米；广州大学城体育中心总占地约40万平方米
intro_zh: 大学城中心区体育场坐落于广州市番禺区小谷围岛、大学城中心区生态公园北端，北临内环路，南向中心湖，三面环山，2007年5月落成，是2010年广州亚运会的主要比赛场地之一。体育场占地约26万平方米，由一个主体育场和一个田径训练副场组成，主副场各有一片符合比赛标准的天然草坪足球场和一条400米PU田径跑道；主体育场屋顶以绿、白两色组合，取意“云山珠水”，远看像一片停在山间水上的白云，是大学城最具辨识度的建筑之一。看台可容纳约4万名观众，规模在广州仅次于广东奥林匹克体育中心体育场和天河体育场。这里承接过亚运会的足球、七人制橄榄球比赛和铁人三项跑步项目，也办过世界杯亚洲区预选赛、世界女子七人制橄榄球系列赛、东京奥运会女子七人制橄榄球亚洲区资格赛；2015年曾作为广州富力的临时主场，2021年成为中超联赛广州赛区场馆。非赛时它是最活跃的大型演出场地之一，陈奕迅、五月天、薛之谦、张信哲、华晨宇、林忆莲、张惠妹、王源、谢霆锋等歌手先后在此开唱，2023至2025年间几乎每年都有多场体育场级演唱会。场馆由广州市体育局管理，日常向市民开放健身跑道与副场，场地租赁、搭建限高与音响时段需与场馆方逐场确认。
intro_en: The University Town Central Stadium stands at the northern edge of the Central District Ecological Park on Xiaoguwei Island, Panyu District, Guangzhou, with the inner ring road to the north, Central Lake to the south and hills on three sides. Completed in May 2007, it was one of the principal competition venues of the 2010 Asian Games. The stadium covers about 260,000 square metres and consists of a main stadium plus an athletics training ground, each with a full-size natural-turf football pitch and a 400-metre polyurethane running track. The main roof combines green and white panels, a reference to the Cantonese phrase for cloud-covered hills and Pearl River water, and reads from a distance as a bank of cloud resting between the hills and the lake; it is one of the most recognisable buildings in the university town. The stands hold roughly 40,000 spectators, making the venue the third largest stadium in Guangzhou after Guangdong Olympic Sports Centre and Tianhe Stadium. It has staged Asian Games football, rugby sevens and the running leg of triathlon, as well as World Cup Asian qualifying matches, the World Rugby Women's Sevens Series and the Tokyo Olympic women's sevens Asian qualifier. It served as Guangzhou R&F's temporary home in 2015 and as a Chinese Super League Guangzhou hub venue in 2021. Outside the sporting calendar it is one of the city's busiest concert sites, with Eason Chan, Mayday, Joker Xue, Jeff Chang, Hua Chenyu, Sandy Lam, A-Mei, Wang Yuan and Nicholas Tse all playing here; between 2023 and 2025 it hosted several stadium-scale shows almost every year. The stadium is managed by the Guangzhou Municipal Sports Bureau and opens its track and training ground to the public; rental terms, rigging height limits and sound curfews must be confirmed with the venue for each event.

name_zh: 广州大学城体育中心体育场
address: 广州市番禺区大学城内环东路208号
area_text: 体育场占地约26万平方米；体育中心总占地约40万平方米
capacity_text: 约37,784座（另一常用口径约40,000座）
intro_zh: 广州大学城体育中心体育场是大学城体育中心六座公共场馆中的主体育场，位于番禺区小谷围岛内环东路208号，2007年5月落成，由广州市体育局管理。需要说明的是，本场与“大学城中心区体育场”是同一座场地，本库分别以场馆本体和场馆群两个口径收录，座位数一说约3.78万、一说约4万，差异来自是否计入临时座席与主席台区域。体育中心整体占地约40万平方米，规模在广州仅次于广东奥林匹克体育中心和天河体育中心，总投资6.83亿元，除主体育场和400米田径副场外，还建有自行车馆、轮滑场、小轮车场、攀岩场和滑板场，合计六馆一场，是国内少见的“竞赛场馆＋极限运动公园”组合。其中自行车馆2010年8月落成，占地约2.4万平方米，外形像一顶银色头盔，馆内是250米长、7.5米宽的专业木质赛道，设3,000个座位，为华南地区规模最大、设备最先进的自行车馆；极限运动公园占地约14万平方米，2014年10月试运营、2015年1月1日正式开放，包含1.6万平方米滑板场、4,600平方米轮滑场、1,200平方米小轮车场和7,000平方米攀岩场，攀岩场设8条速度道、20条难度道和12条攀石道。主体育场自2016年起将副场以20年租期交广州富力（后广州城）作训练基地，主场比赛、演唱会与商业活动的档期由中心统一排布。
intro_en: The stadium at Guangzhou Higher Education Mega Centre Sports Centre is the main arena within a six-venue public sports complex at 208 Inner Ring East Road, Xiaoguwei Island, Panyu District, completed in May 2007 and managed by the Guangzhou Municipal Sports Bureau. It is the same physical stadium catalogued elsewhere in this library as University Town Central Stadium; the two entries record it once at venue level and once at complex level, and the published capacity varies between about 37,784 and about 40,000 depending on whether temporary seats and the VIP platform are counted. The sports centre as a whole covers roughly 400,000 square metres, is the third largest venue cluster in Guangzhou after Guangdong Olympic Sports Centre and Tianhe Sports Centre, and represents an investment of RMB 683 million. Besides the main stadium and a 400-metre athletics training ground, it contains a velodrome, a roller-skating track, a BMX course, a climbing wall and a skatepark. The velodrome, completed in August 2010, covers about 24,000 square metres, is shaped like a silver cycling helmet and holds a 250-metre professional timber track 7.5 metres wide with 3,000 seats, making it the largest and best-equipped velodrome in South China. The extreme sports park covers about 140,000 square metres, trialled in October 2014 and fully opened on 1 January 2015; it includes a 16,000-square-metre skatepark, a 4,600-square-metre roller rink, a 1,200-square-metre BMX course and a 7,000-square-metre climbing wall with eight speed routes, twenty difficulty routes and twelve bouldering routes. Since 2016 the training ground has been leased to Guangzhou R&F, later Guangzhou City, on a twenty-year term as the club's training base, while match, concert and commercial dates are scheduled centrally by the centre.

address: 广州市越秀区洪桥街道应元路34号
area_text: 用地面积39,900平方米；建筑面积12,165.45平方米
intro_zh: 越秀山体育场位于广州市越秀区洪桥街道应元路34号，越秀山南麓、镇海楼之下，是广州第一座市立公共体育场，也是南粤足球公认的“福地”。场地的前身是1925年划地1.7万平方米辟建的观音山足球场，1926年在此举办第一届广州市辖学校运动会；1950年3月18日，时任广州市市长叶剑英号召全市青年“用自己的双手在越秀山建设一个人民体育场”，体育场当年10月9日启用，1953年正式建成。体育场依山谷而建，北、西、南三面看台顺着自然山坡做成约45度斜坡，形成俯瞰式的观赛视角，东面是1956年建成、2001年改扩建的七层门楼，内设广州市足球协会与越秀山体育中心办公区、新闻发布厅，首层两侧为球员更衣室。场内是105米×68米的标准足球场，草坪采用“兰引三号”天然草茎并配节水灌溉，外围环绕一条4条分道、400米长的蓝色塑胶跑道。看台座椅为渐变黄色，现设约1.8万至2万个座位，历史峰值曾达3.3万座；南北看台顶棚装有LED照明，西看台设LED计分牌，北看台三层功能楼带解说席与贵宾包厢。1979年首届省港杯首回合在此举行，六运会、九运会、广州亚运会和十五运会均有足球赛事落在此地；2024年为十五运会改造，2025年1月15日以省港杯赛场重新亮相，同年列入第十批中国20世纪建筑遗产。
intro_en: Yuexiushan Stadium sits at 34 Yingyuan Road, Hongqiao Subdistrict, Yuexiu District, at the southern foot of Yuexiu Hill below the Zhenhai Tower. It is Guangzhou's first municipal public sports ground and is widely regarded as the spiritual home of Cantonese football. The site began as the 17,000-square-metre Guanyinshan football ground laid out in 1925, which hosted the first Guangzhou inter-school games in April 1926. On 18 March 1950 the then mayor Ye Jianying called on the city's youth to build a people's stadium with their own hands; the ground opened on 9 October 1950 and was formally completed in 1953. The stadium is cut into a valley: the north, west and south stands follow the natural slope at roughly 45 degrees to create a plunging view of the pitch, while the east side is closed by a seven-storey gate building erected in 1956 and rebuilt and extended in 2001, which houses the Guangzhou Football Association, the Yuexiushan Sports Centre offices and the press room, with dressing rooms at ground level. The pitch measures 105 by 68 metres, is planted with Lanyin No. 3 natural turf and irrigated by a water-saving system, and is ringed by a four-lane, 400-metre blue synthetic track. Seating is in graduated yellow, currently about 18,000 to 20,000 places against a historic peak of 33,000; the north and south stand roofs carry LED lighting, the west stand has an LED scoreboard, and a three-storey function building behind the north stand contains commentary positions and VIP boxes. The first leg of the inaugural Guangdong-Hong Kong Cup was played here in 1979, and football matches of the 6th and 9th National Games, the 2010 Asian Games and the 15th National Games have all been staged on this pitch. The stadium was renovated for the 15th National Games and reopened on 15 January 2025 for the Guangdong-Hong Kong Cup; in the same year it was listed among the tenth batch of China's 20th-century architectural heritage.

name_zh: 广州国际体育演艺中心
address: 广州市黄埔区萝岗街道开创大道2666号
area_text: 总占地6.5万平方米；总建筑面积12万平方米
intro_zh: 广州国际体育演艺中心（现冠名宝能广州国际体育演艺中心）位于广州市黄埔区萝岗街道开创大道2666号，地铁6号线萝岗站旁，是2010年广州亚运会篮球比赛的新建主场馆，也是国内最早按NBA标准设计建造的篮球馆之一。场馆由NBA常用设计方美国MANICA建筑设计事务所负责方案、广州市设计院深化设计，外形是椭圆而不规则的跳动火焰曲面，被称作“南方鸟巢”。全馆总占地6.5万平方米，总建筑面积12万平方米，设1.8万个观众席、60个豪华VIP包厢和1,270个停车位，看台坡度与视线按篮球赛事优化，冰场、演唱会舞台和展会平面都可转换。亚运之后它转向“体育＋演艺”双主线：湖南卫视跨年演唱会、王菲2011巡演、蔡依林2015巡演等大型演出先后落地，2024年全年承接近60场大型商业演出，被广东省演出行业协会评为“年度最活跃演艺场馆”。2017年宝能系以约37亿元接盘场馆运营主体，此后场馆名称随冠名几度调整，但场地参数与档期体系未变。对活动主办方而言，这里的优势是室内无天气风险、后台与吊点系统成熟、可容纳万人级售票演出；限制是舞台搭建需服从场馆既有马道与承重条件，超大型机械舞台要提前做结构复核。
intro_en: The Guangzhou International Sports and Performing Arts Centre, now branded Baoneng Guangzhou International Sports and Performing Arts Centre, stands at 2666 Kaichuang Avenue, Luogang Subdistrict, Huangpu District, next to Luogang station on Metro Line 6. Built as the basketball venue for the 2010 Asian Games, it is one of the first arenas in China designed and built to NBA standards. The scheme was designed by MANICA Architecture, the American practice regularly used by the NBA, with Guangzhou Design Institute as the local architect; the exterior is an elliptical, irregular flame-like curved form, earning it the nickname the Southern Bird's Nest. The site covers 65,000 square metres and the building 120,000 square metres, with 18,000 spectator seats, 60 VIP suites and 1,270 parking spaces. Sightlines and stand rake are optimised for basketball, and the bowl can be converted for ice events, concert staging and exhibition layouts. After the Asian Games the venue moved onto two tracks, sport and entertainment: Hunan TV's New Year concert, Faye Wong's 2011 tour and Jolin Tsai's 2015 tour all played here, and in 2024 the arena hosted close to 60 large commercial shows, earning the Guangdong Performing Arts Association's award for the most active performance venue of the year. In 2017 the Baoneng group acquired the operating company for about RMB 3.7 billion, and the naming rights have changed several times since, although the building's parameters and booking system have not. For promoters the advantages are a weather-proof interior, mature backstage and rigging infrastructure and capacity for five-figure ticketed shows; the constraint is that staging must work within the existing catwalks and load limits, and very large mechanical sets need a structural review in advance.

address: 广州市番禺区市桥街道康乐路110号
area_text: 占地3.85万平方米；建筑面积2.3万平方米
intro_zh: 英东体育场位于广州市番禺区市桥街道康乐路110号，由香港商人霍英东出资兴建，1986年11月动工、1988年3月竣工，当年造价约522万元，是番禺撤县设市前后最具标志性的公共建筑之一，也是全国首个县级体育中心的组成部分。体育场占地3.85万平方米，建筑面积2.3万平方米，整体呈椭圆形，外墙为乳白色喷漆，四周看台做成阶梯状，装设分色塑料座椅，共14,818个全坐席，看台下层与二层布置了比赛和集会所需的功能室、贵宾室与新闻用房。场地中央是105米×68米的标准足球场，外围环绕8条分道、400米长的红色塑胶跑道，可承接足球与田径赛事。这里的高光时刻集中在女足：1988年和1991年两度承办世界女足锦标赛，2001年2月11日举办中美女足对抗赛，同年作为第九届全国运动会足球比赛场地，2010年又是广州亚运会的比赛场馆，为亚运改造时政府投入近4,000万元，草坪专门引进“南引五号”。目前体育场由番禺区体育场馆发展中心管理，隶属番禺区文化广电旅游体育局，全年对外开场，日常以足球、田径训练和市民健身为主，看台与内场也可用于企业运动会和拍摄，具体档期需向管理方申请。
intro_en: Henry Fok Stadium stands at 110 Kangle Road, Shiqiao Subdistrict, Panyu District, Guangzhou. Funded by the Hong Kong businessman Henry Fok, it broke ground in November 1986, was completed in March 1988 at a cost of about RMB 5.22 million, and remains one of the defining public buildings of the period when Panyu was still a county; it forms part of what was the first county-level sports centre in the country. The stadium covers 38,500 square metres with 23,000 square metres of built area. Its plan is elliptical, the exterior is painted off-white, and the stepped stands are fitted with colour-banded plastic seats for 14,818 spectators in full seating configuration, with function rooms, VIP rooms and press facilities on the lower and first floors beneath the stands. The pitch measures 105 by 68 metres and is surrounded by an eight-lane, 400-metre red synthetic track, so the venue can stage both football and athletics. Its strongest association is with women's football: it hosted the Women's World Championship in 1988 and 1991, the China-USA women's international on 11 February 2001, football matches of the 9th National Games the same year, and matches of the 2010 Asian Games, for which the district spent nearly RMB 40 million on renovation and imported Nanyin No. 5 turf. The stadium is now managed by the Panyu District Sports Venue Development Centre under the district's culture, radio, television, tourism and sports bureau, and opens year-round for football and athletics training and public fitness; the stands and pitch are also used for corporate sports days and filming, with dates arranged through the management centre.

address: 广州市花都区新华街道体育路18号（花都体育中心内）
area_text: 花都体育中心占地11.6万平方米；建筑面积14万平方米
intro_zh: 花都体育场是花都体育中心的主体场地，位于广州市花都区新华街道体育路18号，毗邻花果山公园与花都电视塔，与花都体育馆、花都东风体育馆并称“花都体育三馆”。花都体育中心占地11.6万平方米，建筑面积14万平方米，由体育场、多功能综合球馆、游泳馆和室外球场组成，首期田径跑道、足球场、网球场基础工程、足球训练场和室内游泳馆于2000年建成，总投资约1.5亿元。体育场为标准的田径足球场，看台可容纳约1.3万名观众，具体数字一作13,395座；场地曾长期作为广州足球俱乐部和广东铭途足球俱乐部的主场，目前是广州蒲公英足球俱乐部的主场，联赛与杯赛期间这里的使用强度很高。对商业活动而言，体育场的内场草坪与跑道之间留有较宽的缓冲带，适合搭建中小型舞台、做品牌足球赛、企业运动会和亲子运动会；看台下层设有功能房，可改作签到、医疗与媒体工作区。交通以自驾和公交为主，地铁9号线花果山公园站距场地约1.5公里，广州北站车程约10分钟；场馆由花都区体育部门管理，订场须通过群体通或电话预约并服从赛期封闭安排。
intro_en: Huadu Stadium is the principal ground of Huadu Sports Centre at 18 Tiyu Road, Xinhua Subdistrict, Huadu District, Guangzhou, next to Huaguoshan Park and the Huadu television tower; together with Huadu Gymnasium and Huadu Dongfeng Gymnasium it forms the district's trio of sports venues. The centre covers 116,000 square metres with 140,000 square metres of built area and comprises the stadium, a multi-purpose indoor ball hall, a swimming pool and outdoor courts. Its first phase, including the athletics track, football pitch, tennis court foundations, a training pitch and the indoor pool, was completed in 2000 at a total investment of about RMB 150 million. The stadium is a standard athletics and football ground whose stands hold roughly 13,000 spectators, with one published figure of 13,395. It served for several seasons as the home of Guangzhou FC and Guangdong Mingtu, and is currently the home ground of Guangzhou Puhongqian; during China League One, League Two and FA Cup fixtures the pitch and access roads are heavily used. For commercial events the gap between the pitch and the track allows a mid-sized stage to be built, which suits brand football matches, corporate sports days and family sports meets; function rooms under the stands can be converted into registration, medical and media areas. Access is mainly by car or bus, with Huaguoshan Park station on Metro Line 9 about 1.5 kilometres away and Guangzhou North railway station about ten minutes by road. The venue is managed by the district sports authority, and bookings are made through the Quntitong app or by telephone, subject to closure during match periods. The surrounding sports centre adds indoor courts and a pool, so a multi-day programme can run across buildings.

address: 广州市增城区增江街教育路2号
area_text: 总用地18,000平方米；建筑面积7,285平方米
capacity_text: 室内2,300个固定座位；室外体育场约12,000座
intro_zh: 增城体育馆位于广州市增城区增江街教育路2号，1987年3月建成，是广州地区建成较早的区县级体育馆之一。场馆总用地18,000平方米，建筑面积7,285平方米，室内看台设2,300个固定座位，馆内比赛厅通高、跨度较大，可布置篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球、排球、体操和体育舞蹈场地；同一院区内还有增城康威体育场与增城游泳场，室外体育场看台可容纳约1.2万人，三处场地共用一个出入口与停车区，是增城城区最集中的公共体育组团。2010年广州亚运会期间，增城体育馆承担体育舞蹈比赛，这也是体育舞蹈首次进入亚运大家庭，为此场馆对灯光、音响、地板与运动员流线做了专项改造，赛后长期作为区级赛事与全民健身场地使用。目前馆内日常开放羽毛球、篮球和乒乓球，承接区级联赛、青少年培训、企业年会与展览，内场面积与看台规模适合800至2,000人规模的活动；由于建成年代较早，重型吊挂与大型机械舞台需要现场复核结构承载，活动用电也需与场馆电工共同确认。交通上，场馆距增城广场约2公里、地铁21号线增城广场站车程约10分钟，周边以公交和自驾为主。
intro_en: Zengcheng Gymnasium stands at 2 Jiaoyu Road, Zengjiang Subdistrict, Zengcheng District, Guangzhou. Completed in March 1987, it is one of the earlier district-level indoor arenas in the Guangzhou area. The site covers 18,000 square metres and the building 7,285 square metres, with 2,300 fixed seats in the indoor stand. The competition hall is a clear-span column-free space that can be laid out for basketball, badminton, table tennis, volleyball, gymnastics and dance sport; the same compound contains the Zengcheng Kangwei Stadium, whose outdoor stands hold about 12,000, and the Zengcheng swimming pool, all sharing one entrance and parking area, which makes this the densest cluster of public sports facilities in the Zengcheng urban area. During the 2010 Asian Games the gymnasium hosted dance sport, the first time the discipline appeared in the Asian Games, and the venue was upgraded for the occasion with new lighting, sound, flooring and athlete circulation. Since then it has served district competitions and public fitness. Today the hall opens for badminton, basketball and table tennis and hosts district leagues, youth training, corporate annual meetings and exhibitions; the floor area and seating suit events of roughly 800 to 2,000 people. Because the building dates from the 1980s, heavy rigging and large mechanical staging require an on-site structural check, and event power loads must be agreed with the venue's electricians. The gymnasium is about two kilometres from Zengcheng Plaza and roughly ten minutes by car from Zengcheng Plaza station on Metro Line 21; access is mainly by bus and car. The compound also has surface parking shared by the three venues, which simplifies load-in for exhibitions and corporate events.

address: 广州市白云区景泰街道白云大道南783号
area_text: 占地24万平方米；建筑面积近10万平方米
capacity_text: 11,466座（其中固定座椅6,393个；含24个包厢）
intro_zh: 广州体育馆（又称新广州体育馆）位于广州市白云区景泰街道白云大道南783号，白云新城中部、白云山西侧，是为第九届全国运动会兴建的综合多功能场馆，由法国建筑师保罗·安德鲁设计，1999年11月奠基，2001年6月30日落成，投资约10亿元人民币，2003年获中国建筑工程鲁班奖。场馆整体采用下沉式设计，由南向北依次为主比赛馆、练习馆和大众活动中心：1号馆总建筑面积39,635平方米，椭圆造型，纵向最大跨度160米、横向110米，设24个包厢、常规座位11,466个，其中固定座椅6,393个；2号馆为训练馆，建筑面积19,412平方米，内设练习区、游泳池、篮球场、热身室与科技厅；3号馆为大众活动中心，建筑面积9,000余平方米，布置健身、娱乐与商业配套。这里办过九运会体操决赛、第49届世界乒乓球锦标赛团体赛、2009年苏迪曼杯、2010年亚运会、2019年国际篮联篮球世界杯，以及十五运会的蹦床和U18女子排球、残特奥会轮椅篮球；也长期承接演唱会、年会与展览。场馆由广州珠江体育文化发展股份有限公司运营，地铁12号线广州体育馆站直达，场馆周边另有公交总站与停车区，适合万人级室内活动。
intro_en: Guangzhou Gymnasium, also known as the New Guangzhou Gymnasium, stands at 783 Baiyun Avenue South, Jingtai Subdistrict, Baiyun District, in the middle of Baiyun New Town on the western side of Baiyun Mountain. Built for the 9th National Games, it was designed by the French architect Paul Andreu, had its foundation stone laid in November 1999, opened on 30 June 2001 at a cost of about RMB 1 billion, and won the Luban Prize, China's top construction award, in 2003. The complex is set into the ground and runs from south to north through three buildings: Hall 1, the main arena, has 39,635 square metres of floor area, an elliptical form with a maximum longitudinal span of 160 metres and a transverse span of 110 metres, 24 suites and 11,466 regular seats of which 6,393 are fixed; Hall 2 is the training building with 19,412 square metres containing practice areas, a swimming pool, a basketball court, warm-up rooms and a technology hall; Hall 3, the public activity centre, has more than 9,000 square metres for fitness, recreation and retail. The venue has staged the gymnastics finals of the 9th National Games, the team events of the 49th World Table Tennis Championships, the 2009 Sudirman Cup, the 2010 Asian Games and the 2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup, and for the 15th National Games it hosts trampoline and women's under-18 volleyball, while the National Games for Persons with Disabilities uses it for wheelchair basketball. It also runs a steady calendar of concerts, annual meetings and exhibitions. The operator is Guangzhou Pearl River Sports Culture Development Co., Ltd, a subsidiary of the municipal Pearl River Industrial group; Metro Line 12 stops at Guangzhou Gymnasium station directly outside, and there is a bus terminus and parking on site, which suits indoor events at the ten-thousand scale.

address: 广州市黄埔区丰乐北路398号（黄埔体育中心内）
area_text: 体育场占地3.6万平方米（建筑面积1.6万平方米）；黄埔体育中心占地约17万平方米
intro_zh: 黄埔中心体育场即黄埔体育场，位于广州市黄埔区丰乐北路398号黄埔体育中心内，东邻镇东路、西邻丰乐路、南靠护林路、北接广园快速线，1999年1月完工、2001年6月启用，造价约2.6亿元，是九运会配套的区级体育设施。体育场占地3.6万平方米，建筑面积1.6万平方米，看台设12,000个观众席，场内是按国际标准布置的400米田径场与天然草坪足球场，配有运动员休息室、裁判室与地面停车场。所在的黄埔体育中心占地约17万平方米，2001年建成、总投资3.96亿元，除体育场外还有一座建筑面积31,690平方米、固定坐席3,254个（亚运会期间加临时座席后接近5,000席）的体育馆，一座室内游泳馆与水上游乐中心，以及约3万平方米、15片场地的室外球类区，可作网球、篮球、排球场地使用。体育场先后承办九运会女子足球比赛、2004年中国—缅甸足球对抗赛，2014年是广东日之泉的主场，2024年成为广东广州豹的主场。地铁5号线、7号线大沙东站距场馆约500米，交通在区级体育场中相当便利；商业活动可使用内场与看台下功能房，赛事期需为球队让出档期。
intro_en: Huangpu Central Stadium, usually called Huangpu Stadium, sits inside Huangpu Sports Centre at 398 Fengle North Road, Huangpu District, Guangzhou, bounded by Zhendong Road to the east, Fengle Road to the west, Hulin Road to the south and the Guangyuan expressway to the north. Completed in January 1999 and opened in June 2001 at a cost of about RMB 260 million, it was built as a district facility alongside the 9th National Games. The stadium covers 36,000 square metres with 16,000 square metres of building area and 12,000 spectator seats; the infield holds an international-standard 400-metre track and a natural-turf football pitch, with athlete lounges, officials' rooms and surface parking. The surrounding Huangpu Sports Centre covers about 170,000 square metres, was completed in 2001 at a total investment of RMB 396 million, and contains, besides the stadium, a 31,690-square-metre gymnasium with 3,254 fixed seats that rose to nearly 5,000 with temporary seating during the Asian Games, an indoor swimming and water-play centre, and about 30,000 square metres of outdoor courts in fifteen bays usable for tennis, basketball and volleyball. The stadium has hosted the women's football tournament of the 9th National Games and the China-Myanmar international of 2004; in 2014 it was the home of Guangdong Rizhiquan and in 2024 of Guangdong Guangzhou Leopard. Dashadong station on Metro Lines 5 and 7 is roughly 500 metres away, unusually good access for a district stadium. Commercial events can use the pitch and the function rooms under the stands, although match fixtures take priority in the calendar. The centre is also used by district schools and clubs for athletics training through the week.

address: 广州市天河区天河南街道天河路299号（天河体育中心内）
area_text: 占地25,600平方米；主馆建筑面积17,159平方米
intro_zh: 天河体育馆位于广州市天河区天河路299号广州天河体育中心西南角，1987年8月30日随天河体育中心一同落成，是六运会三大主场馆之一，也是广州城市新中轴线上的地标建筑。体育馆占地25,600平方米，主馆建筑面积17,159平方米，外观为六角形，屋顶跨度126米，屋盖以钢结构网架实现大跨度无柱空间，比赛厅可容纳7,600名观众（早期资料多写9,000座，改造后按7,600座计），内场可切换篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球、网球、手球场地，并配置可拆式全彩LED大屏幕、电子字幕屏与专业舞台灯光音响，具备大型文艺演出、会议和展览功能。2001年九运会前场馆做过一次全面翻新，增设接待室、更衣室、赛前练习室、兴奋剂检查室，并升级照明与音响；2010年亚运会承担羽毛球比赛和部分篮球比赛。2016年成为CBA龙狮篮球俱乐部主场，2019年5月1日起由俱乐部直接运营，是CBA少数由球队运营的主场馆。所在的广州天河体育中心占地58.8万平方米，1987年为六运会建成，2018年列入中国20世纪建筑遗产，2024至2025年为十五运会完成整体改造。
intro_en: Tianhe Gymnasium occupies the south-western corner of Guangzhou Tianhe Sports Centre at 299 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District. It opened on 30 August 1987 together with the sports centre as one of the three principal venues of the 6th National Games, and it remains a landmark on the city's new central axis. The building covers 25,600 square metres with 17,159 square metres of main hall floor area; its plan is hexagonal and the roof spans 126 metres, achieved with a steel space frame that leaves the competition hall column-free. Seating is 7,600 after renovation, although earlier sources quote 9,000. The floor can be converted for basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, tennis and handball, and the hall is equipped with a demountable full-colour LED screen, electronic scoreboards and professional stage lighting and sound, which extends its use to large performances, conferences and exhibitions. The venue was comprehensively refurbished before the 9th National Games in 2001, when reception rooms, dressing rooms, a warm-up hall and a doping control room were added and the lighting and audio systems upgraded; during the 2010 Asian Games it hosted badminton and some basketball matches. In 2016 it became the home arena of the CBA's Long Lions and since 1 May 2019 the club has operated the building directly, one of the few CBA venues run by its tenant team. The parent Tianhe Sports Centre covers 588,000 square metres, was built for the 6th National Games in 1987, was listed in 2018 among China's 20th-century architectural heritage, and was comprehensively upgraded for the 15th National Games in 2024 and 2025. Its position inside the sports centre means concourse space, warming-up areas and neighbouring pitches can be borrowed for larger events.

address: 广州市南沙区黄阁镇坦尾村凤凰大道（体育三路与凤凰大道交叉口）
area_text: 占地12.7公顷；建筑面积30,236.3平方米（区体育设施目录按场地83,500平方米计）
intro_zh: 南沙体育馆位于广州市南沙区黄阁镇坦尾村，处在体育三路与凤凰大道的交叉口，是2010年广州亚运会武术与卡巴迪比赛的场馆。项目2008年10月10日动工，2009年6月主体封顶，2010年7月14日落成，总投资约4.5亿元人民币；场馆占地12.7公顷，建筑面积30,236.3平方米，设6,000个固定座位和2,080个临时座位，亚运期间按武术套路、散打和卡巴迪的竞赛要求配置了比赛台、热身区、兴奋剂检查与媒体工作区。建筑以舒展的曲面屋顶覆盖单一比赛大厅，观众从东西两侧集散，赛后功能房被改造成健身、培训与办公空间。目前馆内常年开放羽毛球、篮球、乒乓球和健身房，看台带观众席的羽毛球场地是南沙城区最抢手的时段资源之一，区里的公共体育设施目录把这一片区的场地面积合计记为83,500平方米。对活动方而言，馆内适合4,000至6,000人规模的赛事、发布会、年会和中小型演出，内场可搭建舞台但需为羽毛球地胶与木地板做保护；南沙全民文化体育综合体6万座体育场正在片区内建设，未来会改变这一带的场地供给结构。交通以自驾为主，地铁4号线蕉门站车程约15分钟，凤凰大道沿线有公交站点。
intro_en: Nansha Gymnasium stands in Tanwei Village, Huangge Town, Nansha District, Guangzhou, at the junction of Tiyu San Road and Fenghuang Avenue. It was the venue for wushu and kabaddi at the 2010 Asian Games. Construction began on 10 October 2008, the main structure topped out in June 2009 and the building was completed on 14 July 2010 at a total investment of about RMB 450 million. The site covers 12.7 hectares and the building 30,236 square metres, with 6,000 fixed seats and 2,080 temporary ones. For the Games the hall was fitted out with competition platforms, a warm-up area, doping control and media working space to the requirements of wushu taolu, sanda and kabaddi. A single sweeping curved roof covers the competition hall, spectators circulate from the east and west, and the post-Games function rooms have been converted into fitness, training and office space. Today the hall opens year-round for badminton, basketball, table tennis and gym use, and its badminton courts with spectator seating are among the most sought-after slots in the Nansha urban area; the district's public sports facilities directory records 83,500 square metres of floor space for the site as a whole. For event organisers the hall suits competitions, launches, annual meetings and mid-sized shows of roughly 4,000 to 6,000 people; a stage can be built on the floor but protection is needed for the badminton matting and timber surface. The 60,000-seat stadium of the Nansha Civic, Cultural and Sports Complex is under construction nearby and will change the supply of large venues in the district. Access is mainly by car, with Jiaomen station on Metro Line 4 about fifteen minutes away and bus stops along Fenghuang Avenue.

address: 广州市越秀区较场西路18号
area_text: 占地面积39,645平方米
intro_zh: 广东省人民体育场位于广州市越秀区较场西路18号，老广州人叫它“东较场”，是中国现存延续使用时间最长的体育场地之一。此地自唐代长安二年（702年）设“阅武堂”起便用于武科举与军事操练，明清两代称东较场，1906年1月10日中国历史上最早的运动会“广东省大运动会”就在这里举行；1930年省政府收回场地兴建广东省立体育场，1932年10月竣工，是当时全国最大、最标准的体育场之一。1950年7月更名为广东省人民体育场，1953年安装可容8,000人的钢看台，1980年改造后拥有23级钢筋混凝土看台、27,000多个座位和四座照明铁塔；1990年为首届女足世界杯，霍英东资助加建东西看台风雨篷、铺设塑胶跑道，占地39,645平方米、座位27,096个。这里自1981年起长期是省港杯的广州主场，办过1991年首届女足世界杯、2010年亚运会足球赛，2023至2025年又为十五运会完成改造，座位调整为约1.5万个，2025年承办十五运会女子16岁以下组足球比赛，同年6月18日起恢复向公众开放田径跑道。场地现由广东省体育局所有，地铁1号线烈士陵园站A口步行约110米。
intro_en: Guangdong Provincial People's Stadium stands at 18 Jiaochang West Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, and is known to older residents as Dongjiaochang, the eastern parade ground. It is the longest continuously used sports ground in China. The site was used for military examinations and drill from 702 AD, when a martial examination hall was established in the Tang dynasty, and through the Ming and Qing it served as the Dongjiaochang parade ground; on 10 January 1906 it hosted the Guangdong Provincial Games, the earliest modern athletics meeting held in China. In 1930 the provincial government recovered the land and built the Guangdong Provincial Stadium, completed in October 1932 and then among the largest and best-equipped grounds in the country. It was renamed the Guangdong Provincial People's Stadium in July 1950, received an 8,000-seat steel grandstand in 1953, and after a 1980 reconstruction had 23 tiers of reinforced concrete terracing, more than 27,000 seats and four floodlight towers. For the first Women's World Cup in 1991, funded by Henry Fok, roofs were added to the east and west stands and a synthetic track laid, giving a site of 39,645 square metres and 27,096 seats. Since 1981 it has been the regular Guangzhou venue for the Guangdong-Hong Kong Cup, and it hosted matches of the 1991 Women's World Cup and the 2010 Asian Games football tournament. Between 2023 and 2025 it was rebuilt for the 15th National Games with capacity reset at about 15,000; it staged the women's under-16 football competition in 2025 and reopened its running track to the public on 18 June 2025. The ground is owned by the Guangdong Provincial Sports Bureau, and Exit A of Martyrs' Park station on Metro Line 1 is about 110 metres away.

name_zh: 广州亚运城综合体育馆
address: 广州市番禺区石楼镇兴亚大道33号
area_text: 占地101,086平方米；总建筑面积65,315平方米
intro_zh: 广州亚运城综合体育馆位于广州市番禺区石楼镇兴亚大道33号，北临莲花湾，与运动员村、升旗广场隔水相望，通过空中漫步廊道与主新闻中心相连，是进入亚运城的门户，也是2010年广州亚运会建设规模最大的场馆。项目2008年8月动工，2009年9月1日封顶，2010年3月竣工，投资7.9亿元；占地101,086平方米，总建筑面积65,315平方米，设计灵感取自体操运动员手中的彩带，用流动的线条表现岭南建筑的轻灵。建筑群由体操比赛馆、台球馆、壁球馆和广州亚运历史博物馆组成：体操馆内场3,552平方米，固定观众座位5,971个，可加1,500个临时座位，三层观众区设13个包厢，另有2,100平方米体操热身馆，日常改作羽毛球场；台球馆内场999平方米、看台475座；壁球馆分1,100平方米决赛馆与864平方米预赛馆，看台200座；纪念馆四层，陈列亚运火炬、礼仪服饰、文献与龙舟等实物。亚运期间这里承担体操、艺术体操、蹦床、台球和壁球比赛。2014年12月，场馆由广州珠江文体与广州广电城市服务的合资公司——广州亚运城综合体育馆运营管理有限公司接管，转向“体育＋商业活动”运营，每年承接企业年会、新品发布、音乐节和见面会等商业活动100余场，流线型外立面与内环廊也是广告与影视拍摄的热门取景地。
intro_en: Guangzhou Asian Games Town Gymnasium stands at 33 Xingya Avenue, Shilou Town, Panyu District, Guangzhou, on the northern shore of Lianhua Bay, facing the athletes' village and flag-raising square across the water and linked to the main press centre by an elevated walkway. It forms the gateway to the Asian Games Town and was the largest venue built for the 2010 Games. Construction began in August 2008, the structure topped out on 1 September 2009 and the building was completed in March 2010 at a cost of RMB 790 million. The site covers 101,086 square metres and the complex 65,315 square metres. The design draws on the ribbon held by a rhythmic gymnast, using flowing lines to express the lightness of Lingnan architecture. The complex comprises a gymnastics hall, a billiards hall, a squash hall and the Guangzhou Asian Games history museum. The gymnastics hall has a 3,552-square-metre floor, 5,971 fixed seats plus room for 1,500 temporary ones, thirteen boxes on the third-level concourse, and a separate 2,100-square-metre warm-up hall now used for badminton. The billiards hall has a 999-square-metre floor and 475 seats; the squash hall is split into a 1,100-square-metre final court and an 864-square-metre preliminary court with 200 seats; the four-level museum displays torches, ceremonial dress, documents and dragon boats from the Games. During the Asian Games the venue hosted gymnastics, rhythmic gymnastics, trampoline, billiards and squash. In December 2014 operations passed to Guangzhou Asian Games Town Gymnasium Operation Management Co., a joint venture of Pearl River Sports and Guangzhou Radio and Television City Services, which shifted the business towards sport plus commercial events; the venue now stages more than a hundred corporate annual meetings, product launches, music festivals and fan events a year, and its streamlined facade and inner ring corridor are frequently used for advertising and film shoots.

address: 广州市天河区五山路381号华南理工大学五山校区西区
area_text: 官方未公布（西区体育场为中国田径协会认证Ⅱ类田径场地）
capacity_text: 官方未公布（校方未公布固定看台座位数）
intro_zh: 华工体育场指华南理工大学五山校区西区体育场，位于广州市天河区五山路381号，紧邻校园西湖，与2006年建成的五层西区体育馆同处一个组团。西区体育场初建于2006年，2017年8月完成升级改造，是中国田径协会认证的Ⅱ类田径场地，可开展田径、足球等教学、训练与比赛，场内为天然草坪足球场加标准田径跑道，配有基础照明，夜间使用需开启场地灯光。作为高校场地，它首要服务教学与校队训练，其次在课余时段向师生和预约的校外球队开放，日常开放时间约为8时至22时，寒暑假与考试周会调整。西区体育馆一楼架空层是6片标准篮球场，三至五楼设乒乓球馆、健身房、健美操房、武术室、羽毛球馆和网球馆，是体育学院办公所在地，因此这片组团可以承接校运会、院系联赛、青少年训练营和企业团建。需要提醒的是，本库早期表格曾给这一条目记5,634座，经核对，该数字实际对应华南理工大学大学城校区体育馆（5,632个固定座位，2010年亚运会柔道、摔跤场馆），与五山校区西区体育场并非同一处，故本条座位数与面积均按“官方未公布”记录，不做推算。校外单位使用场地须经学校场馆管理方审批并办理入校预约。
intro_en: Huagong Stadium refers to the West Sports Ground of the South China University of Technology Wushan campus at 381 Wushan Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, next to the campus lake and in the same cluster as the five-storey West Gymnasium completed in 2006. The ground was first built in 2006 and upgraded in August 2017; it is a Class II athletics facility certified by the Chinese Athletics Association, able to host teaching, training and competition in track and field and football. It consists of a natural-turf football pitch inside a standard running track with basic floodlighting, and evening use requires the lights to be switched on. As a university facility it serves teaching and varsity training first, then opens to students, staff and booked outside teams in off-peak hours, generally from 08:00 to 22:00 with adjustments during holidays and examination periods. The ground floor of the neighbouring West Gymnasium is left open as six standard basketball courts, while the third to fifth floors house table tennis, gym, aerobics, martial arts, badminton and tennis rooms, and the building also contains the School of Physical Education offices; the cluster can therefore host university sports meets, faculty leagues, youth camps and corporate team-building. One caution on the data: an earlier version of this library recorded 5,634 seats for this entry, but that figure actually belongs to the gymnasium on the university's Higher Education Mega Centre campus, which has 5,632 fixed seats and was the judo and wrestling venue of the 2010 Asian Games, not to the Wushan West Ground. The seat count and floor area are therefore recorded here as not published rather than estimated. Outside organisations must obtain approval from the university venue office and register vehicles and visitors for campus entry.

address: 广州市番禺区大学城外环东路132号中山大学东校园
intro_zh: 中山大学体育馆位于广州市番禺区大学城外环东路132号中山大学东校园，坐落在新校区主轴线最南端，北望中山大学图书馆，南临大学城中环路，与校内田径场、游泳馆等设施共同构成东校园体育区。体育馆建筑面积约11,600平方米，由主馆与三层副馆组成，固定及活动看台合计可容纳约5,000名观众，其中约1,700个为可伸缩座椅，场地按国际赛事标准建造，可满足排球、篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球等室内项目及大型活动的需要。2010年广州亚运会期间，这里是排球比赛场馆之一，赛事于11月13日至27日举行；赛后场馆转为学校体育教学、训练与群体活动的主场地，并通过中山大学体育部的场馆预订系统向师生及社会开放。作为大学城21个亚运场馆之一，它的设计兼顾赛事流线与日常教学：比赛大厅、热身区与功能用房可分可合，观众入口与运动员通道各自独立。体育馆周边以中环路、外环东路连接大学城各高校，地铁四号线大学城南站及大学城1线、3线、382路公交可到达，是大学城中部重要的室内场馆之一。东校园体育馆与大学城中心区体育场、华工体育馆等场馆相距不远，亚运期间共同承担了大学城赛区的比赛任务；如今馆内常年安排篮球联赛、羽毛球培训和新生体育课，周末时段亦向外来团体开放。
intro_en: Sun Yat-sen University Gymnasium stands at 132 Waihuan East Road on the university's East Campus in Guangzhou Higher Education Mega Centre, at the southern end of the new campus's main axis. The library lies to the north and the mega centre's Central Ring Road to the south, and the building completes a cluster of sports facilities that also includes track-and-field grounds and a swimming pool. The gymnasium covers about 11,600 square metres in a main hall plus a three-storey annex. Its stands hold roughly 5,000 spectators, some 1,700 of them on retractable seating, and the hall was built to international competition standards so that volleyball, basketball, badminton and table tennis can all be staged there, with the floor cleared for ceremonies and other large gatherings. During the 2010 Asian Games the venue hosted volleyball, with matches running from 13 to 27 November. After the Games it returned to teaching, team training and mass sport, and it is now booked through the university sports department's reservation system, which opens the hall to students, staff and outside users. As one of the 21 Asian Games venues concentrated in the mega centre, the design separates competition and warm-up zones and gives spectators and athletes independent entrances, so that a major fixture and an ordinary teaching day can coexist. The site is reached from Central Ring Road and Waihuan East Road, with Metro Line 4's Higher Education Mega Center South station and buses 1, 3 and 382 serving the campus. The hall is also part of a wider Asian Games legacy in the mega centre, sitting a short distance from the central stadium and the neighbouring campus arenas, and it now hosts intramural basketball leagues, badminton courses and freshman physical education through the week, with weekend slots released to outside groups.

address: 广州市天河区大观南路36号广东奥林匹克体育中心内
intro_zh: 广东奥林匹克体育中心曲棍球场位于广州市天河区大观南路36号奥体中心园区内，是2010年广州亚运会曲棍球项目的比赛场地。球场占地约25,000平方米，在原有场地基础上新建一片91.4米×55米的国际标准人造草球场，草皮采用荷兰特力素（TenCate）产品，配套国际标准灯光和功能用房一栋；看台设4,200个固定座位，赛时总容量约5,000人。2010年11月13日至25日，这里承接了亚运会曲棍球比赛。奥体中心为2001年第九届全运会而建，占地约100万平方米，拥有体育场、游泳跳水馆、网球中心、射击馆、射箭场、棒球场等场馆群，是华南地区规模最大的体育场馆群之一；2025年第十五届全运会开幕式在中心体育场举行，园区随之完成整体升级。曲棍球场紧邻奥体中心北门与环场路，观众可乘地铁4号线、21号线及多条BRT、公交线路到达，自驾由广园快速路、大观南路进入。赛后球场主要承担专业队训练、青少年培训和群众曲棍球活动，并继续承办各类曲棍球赛事。场地面层与喷灌系统按国际曲棍球联合会标准维护；奥体中心园区内另有全民健身中心、智慧体育公园和环场步道，日常向市民开放。
intro_en: The hockey field of the Guangdong Olympic Sports Centre occupies the northern part of the centre's grounds at 36 Daguanshan South Road in Tianhe District, Guangzhou. The 25,000-square-metre facility was rebuilt for the 2010 Asian Games around a new 91.4 by 55 metre artificial pitch, the standard dimensions for international hockey, laid with TenCate turf imported from the Netherlands and lit to international competition levels. A single function building provides changing rooms, officials' rooms, medical space and equipment storage, while the grandstand holds 4,200 fixed seats and swells to about 5,000 with temporary seating during the Games. Hockey matches ran from 13 to 25 November 2010. The field sits inside a complex built for the Ninth National Games in 2001 and covering roughly one million square metres, with a stadium of 80,012 seats, a swimming and diving hall, tennis centre, shooting hall, archery range and baseball ground; the stadium staged the opening ceremony of the 15th National Games in November 2025, after which the whole park was upgraded. Spectators reach the venue by Metro Line 4 or 21 and by BRT and city buses serving the Olympic Sports Centre North Gate, or by car via the Guangyuan Expressway and Daguanshan South Road. Since the Asian Games the pitch has been used for provincial squad training, junior coaching and public hockey, and it continues to stage hockey fixtures. The surface and irrigation system are maintained to International Hockey Federation standards, and the wider park also contains a public fitness centre, a smart sports park and a looped running trail that are open to residents day to day.

address: 广州市番禺区大学城外环西路100号广东工业大学大学城校区
intro_zh: 广东工业大学板球场位于广州市番禺区大学城外环西路100号广东工业大学大学城校区内，西邻广州美术学院，北临大学城中环路，南靠南亭村，用地面积约46,871.3平方米，建筑面积4,155平方米。场地分东、西两处永久建筑与南、北临时看台，设2,001个固定座位和3,001个临时座位，中心为天然草比赛场，外围设跑道与练习区。板球在2010年广州亚运会上首次成为正式比赛项目，这座球场即为该届赛事新建的专用场地，2010年6月完工交付，8月14日至17日举行亚运测试赛，11月7日至26日承接正式比赛。赛后场地交由学校管理，用于板球、橄榄球、足球等项目的教学与训练，是中国为亚运会新建的少数专用板球场之一。观众可由大学城中环路、外环西路进入校区，地铁四号线大学城南站步行约十分钟可达；校区内另设体育馆、田径场与游泳馆，形成完整的体育设施群，板球场与体育馆共同构成广工在大学城的体育片区。球场看台采用永久与临时结合的做法，亚运后拆除临时坐席，保留东西两侧永久看台与功能房；平日的天然草场用于校队训练和院际比赛。
intro_en: The Guangdong University of Technology cricket ground lies inside the university's Higher Education Mega Centre campus at 100 Waihuan West Road, Panyu District, Guangzhou, with the Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts to the west, the campus ring road to the north and Nanting village to the south. The site covers about 46,871 square metres, of which 4,155 square metres is built. Permanent structures stand on the east and west sides, temporary stands were added to the north and south, and the ground provides 2,001 fixed seats plus 3,001 temporary places. A natural-turf oval forms the centre, with a running track and practice areas around it. Cricket became a medal sport at the Asian Games for the first time in Guangzhou in 2010, and this ground was purpose-built for that debut. It was handed over in June 2010, staged the official test event from 14 to 17 August, and hosted the tournament from 7 to 26 November. After the Games the ground passed to the university for teaching and training in cricket, rugby and football, and it remains one of the few purpose-built cricket grounds constructed for an Asian Games. The campus is reached from the Central Ring Road and Waihuan West Road, about ten minutes on foot from Metro Line 4's Higher Education Mega Center South station, and the university's gymnasium, athletics track and swimming pool stand nearby, forming a compact sports quarter. The stands were conceived as a permanent-temporary hybrid: the temporary seating was removed after the Games, leaving the east and west permanent structures and function rooms. On ordinary days the turf oval is used for varsity practice and inter-faculty matches.

address: 广州市番禺区大学城外环东路280号广东药科大学教学区
area_text: 建筑面积9,786㎡（主馆）
intro_zh: 广东药科大学体育馆（亚运期间称广药体育馆）位于广州市番禺区大学城外环东路280号广东药科大学教学区，东邻运动场，西依中环路，南北紧靠东二路、东三路。主馆建筑面积9,786平方米，设4,986个固定座位，比赛场地可布置排球、篮球、羽毛球等室内项目。2010年广州亚运会期间承办排球比赛，赛期为11月13日至27日；场馆为多功能设计，主馆与副馆、训练房相连，比赛区、热身区与观众区可分区使用，赛时按排球项目要求布置场地与功能用房。赛后体育馆由学校体育部门管理，承担体育课教学、校队训练、开学典礼、毕业典礼和大型讲座，并在空余时段向师生及周边社区开放。场馆位于大学城东侧生活区与教学区之间，地铁四号线大学城南站、大学城1线、2线、3线及381路公交可到达，是大学城东侧主要的综合体育馆之一。场馆东侧紧邻运动场，学生宿舍与食堂分布在其北面，赛时人流可由校园道路分流。
intro_en: The Guangdong Pharmaceutical University gymnasium, known during the 2010 Asian Games as the Guangyao Gymnasium, stands in the teaching zone of the university's Higher Education Mega Centre campus at 280 Waihuan East Road, Panyu District, Guangzhou. The sports field lies to the east, the Central Ring Road to the west, and East Second and East Third Roads close the site to north and south. The main hall covers 9,786 square metres. Fixed seating provides 4,986 places, and the hall can be set up for volleyball, basketball, badminton and other indoor sports. Volleyball matches of the 2010 Asian Games were played here between 13 and 27 November. The building is multi-purpose in plan, with the main hall linked to training and support rooms so that competition, warm-up and spectator areas can be zoned separately, and during the Games the floor and support rooms were fitted out for volleyball. After the Games the university's sports department took over management for physical education classes, squad training, matriculation and graduation ceremonies and large lectures, opening the hall to staff, students and neighbouring residents when it is free. The campus is served by Metro Line 4 and by Higher Education Mega Centre buses 1, 2, 3 and 381, and the gymnasium is one of the principal indoor halls in the ten-university cluster. Xiaoguwei island holds ten university campuses, and the hall sits between the teaching zone and the dormitories, which keeps it in use from morning to evening. The Asian Games left the university with a hall that now anchors its sports curriculum, and the building is also let out for examinations and public lectures.

address: 广州市番禺区小谷围街道外环东路178号广东外语外贸大学大学城校区
intro_zh: 广东外语外贸大学体育馆位于广州市番禺区小谷围街道外环东路178号广外大学城校区，建筑面积约10,000平方米，设4,415个固定座位，是大学城高校场馆群中规模居中的一座综合体育馆。2010年广州亚运会期间，这里承办排球比赛（11月13日至27日），并承担足球项目的训练任务。馆内以比赛大厅为核心，辅以训练房与赛事配套用房，场地可按排球、篮球、羽毛球等项目要求转换，看台环绕比赛区布置。赛后场馆纳入学校体育部场馆管理中心统一管理，用于体育教学、校队训练、校运会和毕业典礼，并在课余时间向师生开放。广外大学城校区以语言学科见长，体育馆同时是校园文化活动的主要室内场地。交通方面，场馆位于外环东路东侧，地铁四号线大学城南站、大学城1线、3线、381路、382路可到达，中环东路公交站步行约910米可达。馆外为校区中央草坪与教学楼群，场馆与教学区、生活区之间以步行道连接，学生从宿舍步行即可到达。
intro_en: The Guangdong University of Foreign Studies gymnasium stands on the university's Higher Education Mega Centre campus at 178 Waihuan East Road, Xiaoguwei Subdistrict, Panyu District, Guangzhou. The building covers about 10,000 square metres and holds 4,415 fixed seats, making it a mid-sized indoor arena within the campus cluster. During the 2010 Asian Games it hosted volleyball from 13 to 27 November and also served as a football training venue. The competition hall is the core of the building, supported by training rooms and event accommodation, and the floor can be converted for volleyball, basketball or badminton, with seating wrapped around the field of play. After the Games the venue came under the university's sports department and its venue management centre, which uses it for physical education, varsity training, the annual sports meeting and graduation ceremonies, and opens it to students and staff outside teaching hours. The campus is known for its language programmes, and the gymnasium doubles as its main indoor space for cultural events. It sits on the east side of Waihuan East Road, about 910 metres on foot from the Zhonghuan East Road bus stop, and is served by Metro Line 4 and buses 1, 3, 381 and 382. Outside, the hall faces the campus lawn and teaching buildings, and the campus itself is laid out on a ring-and-radial road plan, so the gymnasium is a short walk from the teaching blocks and dormitories. The building is also used for open days, examinations and alumni events, which keeps it busy well beyond the sports calendar.

address: 广州市天河区大观南路36号广东奥林匹克体育中心内
area_text: 建筑面积2,346㎡
intro_zh: 广东奥林匹克体育中心棒球场（又称奥体棒垒球场）位于广州市天河区大观南路36号奥体中心园区内，是2010年广州亚运会棒球项目的比赛场地。球场建筑面积2,346平方米，看台设4,200个固定座位，比赛区按国际棒球标准布置，配有灯光、电子记分牌、球员休息区、投球练习区和赛事功能用房，可同时满足棒球与垒球训练比赛需要。2010年11月13日至19日，亚运会棒球比赛在此举行。奥体中心为2001年九运会而建，占地约100万平方米，园区内还有体育场、游泳跳水馆、网球中心、曲棍球场、射击馆和射箭场，形成华南地区最集中的大型场馆群；2025年十五运会开幕式在中心体育场举行，园区完成整体改造。赛后棒球场主要服务广东省棒球队训练、青少年棒球培训和群众赛事，也承接企业团建与校园联赛。观众可乘地铁4号线、21号线及多条公交至奥体中心北门，自驾经广园快速路、大观南路抵达，场内设有停车区。棒球场与曲棍球场相邻，同属奥体中心场馆群，园区以环场路串联各场馆；平日外围跑道与练习区为周边学校的体育活动提供场地。
intro_en: The baseball ground of the Guangdong Olympic Sports Centre, also known as the centre's baseball and softball field, stands at 36 Daguanshan South Road in Tianhe District, Guangzhou. The building covers 2,346 square metres and the grandstand provides 4,200 fixed seats. The field itself is laid out to international baseball standards, with floodlighting, an electronic scoreboard, dugouts, bullpen areas and event function rooms, and it can be configured for softball as well. Baseball at the 2010 Asian Games was played here from 13 to 19 November. The ground forms part of a complex built for the Ninth National Games in 2001 and covering about one million square metres, alongside the main stadium, swimming and diving hall, tennis centre, hockey field, shooting hall and archery range, making it one of the largest concentrations of sports venues in southern China. The stadium hosted the opening ceremony of the 15th National Games in November 2025, when the park was comprehensively upgraded. Since the Asian Games the ground has mainly served the Guangdong provincial baseball squad, junior coaching and amateur competitions, and it is also hired for corporate events and school leagues. Spectators arrive by Metro Line 4 or 21 and by bus to the Olympic Sports Centre North Gate, or by car via the Guangyuan Expressway and Daguanshan South Road; parking is available on site. The ground stands next to the hockey field within the same Olympic centre cluster, with the loop road linking the venues, and its outer running area and practice cages serve nearby schools on ordinary days.

address: 广州市从化区良口镇御泉大道348号（香港赛马会从化马场）
area_text: 建筑面积65,315㎡；现马场占地150余公顷
capacity_text: 4,000个固定座位（2010亚运看台）；新建看台9,500座
intro_zh: 广州马术场位于广州市从化区良口镇，地处群山环抱的谷地，面朝流溪河，紧邻G105国道，距广州外环线约50分钟车程，距广州白云国际机场约60分钟，距亚运城超过100分钟。场地为2010年广州亚运会马术项目而建，建筑面积65,315平方米，主看台可容纳4,000名观众；环形赛马跑道宽25米、内侧周长1,000米，周围布置马房、兽医站、贵宾区与赛事辅助用房。亚运会马术比赛于2010年11月13日至25日在此举行，涵盖盛装舞步、三项赛和场地障碍。赛后场地由香港赛马会接手改造，2018年8月28日以“香港赛马会从化马场”名义启用，成为世界级赛马训练中心：占地150多公顷，建有多条跑道、马房、登山跑道和马医院，可同时容纳逾千匹赛马训练，并与沙田马场形成“双基地”模式。二期工程投资40亿元，新建可容纳9,500人的看台已于2026年竣工；按计划将于2026年10月31日起举办常规性国际标准速度赛马赛事，这将是内地首次定期举行国际水平纯血马比赛。马场也是内地唯一获国际认可的“无马疫区”。亚运赛道沿谷地展开，看台设于跑道一侧；改造为训练中心后，场地在原赛道基础上扩建多条跑道、马房与马医院，并保留原主看台。
intro_en: The Guangzhou Equestrian Venue lies in Liangkou town, Conghua District, in a valley ringed by hills, facing the Liuxi River and bordering National Highway 105, about 50 minutes from Guangzhou's outer ring road, an hour from Baiyun International Airport and more than 100 minutes from the Asian Games Town. Built for the equestrian events of the 2010 Asian Games, it has 65,315 square metres of building area and a main grandstand for 4,000 spectators. The race track is 25 metres wide with a 1,000-metre inner circumference, surrounded by stables, a veterinary station, VIP areas and support buildings. Dressage, eventing and show jumping were contested here from 13 to 25 November 2010. After the Games the Hong Kong Jockey Club took over the site and reopened it on 28 August 2018 as Conghua Racecourse, a world-class training centre of more than 150 hectares with several tracks, stables, a hillside gallop and a horse hospital, able to train over a thousand horses and forming a twin-site model with Sha Tin. A second phase costing RMB 4 billion is complete, including a grandstand for 9,500 spectators, and from 31 October 2026 it is scheduled to stage regular internationally sanctioned thoroughbred race meetings, the first such series on the mainland. The site is also the only equine disease-free zone in China to be internationally recognised. The Asian Games track follows the valley floor with the grandstand set along one side. When the site became a training centre, several tracks, stables and a horse hospital were added around the original layout, and the main grandstand was kept.

address: 广州市番禺区大学城外环西路230号广州大学
area_text: 建筑面积8,196㎡
intro_zh: 广州大学体育馆（又称何世杰体育馆）位于广州市番禺区大学城外环西路230号广州大学校园内，建筑面积8,196平方米，设3,712个观众席位，2006年12月建成投入使用。体育馆屋顶为弧形网架结构，外墙为素混凝土配淡蓝色玻璃窗，造型简洁，比赛大厅可满足篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球等项目和大型集会需要。2010年广州亚运会期间，这里承办击剑比赛，赛时按击剑项目要求布置剑道以及裁判、器材区域。赛后场馆由广州大学体育学院场馆中心管理，承担体育课教学、校队训练、校运会和毕业典礼，并在课余时间向师生开放；馆内还设有健身房、乒乓球室和体质测试中心。场馆位于大学城西侧，地铁四号线大学城南站、大学城1线、4线、B25路、35路可到达，外环西路与中环西路在校园外围交汇，交通便利。广州大学体育学院同时负责全校体育场地预约系统的运行，体育馆与北区体育场、南区足球场、网球场共同构成校园体育设施网络。馆前广场与校园主环路相连，大型活动时作为观众集散与安检区域；体育馆与图书馆、教学楼相距不远，是校园中轴的公共节点。
intro_en: Guangzhou University Gymnasium, also named the He Shijie Gymnasium, stands on the university's Higher Education Mega Centre campus at 230 Waihuan West Road, Panyu District, Guangzhou. Completed in December 2006, the building covers 8,196 square metres and seats 3,712 spectators. Its roof is a curved space frame, the walls are fair-faced concrete set against pale blue glazing, and the competition hall can be arranged for basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis or large assemblies. During the 2010 Asian Games the hall hosted fencing, with the floor divided into pistes and the ancillary rooms given over to refereeing and equipment control. After the Games it passed to the venue centre of the university's School of Physical Education, which runs physical education classes, varsity training, the annual sports meeting and graduation ceremonies there and opens it to students and staff in the evenings; the building also contains a fitness room, table-tennis room and a fitness testing centre. The campus lies on the western edge of the mega centre, reached from Metro Line 4's Higher Education Mega Center South station and by buses 1, 4, B25 and 35, with Waihuan West Road and Central Ring Road meeting around the campus perimeter. The school also operates the university's online booking system, which ties the gymnasium to the north stadium, the south football pitches and the tennis courts. The forecourt opens onto the campus ring road and doubles as a queuing and security area for big events, while the building's position near the library and teaching blocks makes it a public node on the campus axis.

address: 广州市番禺区大学城外环西路100号广东工业大学大学城校区
capacity_text: 3,204个固定座位＋188个主席台座位＋1,650个活动座位
intro_zh: 广东工业大学体育馆位于广州市番禺区大学城外环西路100号广东工业大学大学城校区，临近中环西路，总建筑面积14,050平方米。馆内设固定座位3,204个、主席台座位188个、活动座位1,650个，比赛场地可布置手球、篮球、排球、羽毛球等项目。体育馆平面为正方形，外形完整简洁，与旁边的风雨操场共同组成可承办国内B级赛事的场馆组合。2010年广州亚运会期间，这里承办手球比赛，赛期为11月13日至26日。赛后场馆由学校体育学院场馆中心管理，用于体育教学、校队训练、校运会及大型活动，并通过学校场馆预订系统向师生开放。场馆东侧为广工板球场，两者共同构成大学城广工体育片区。交通方面，地铁四号线大学城南站步行约730米可达，大学城4线、86路等公交在校区设站，外环西路连接大学城各高校与南沙港快速路。体育馆周边还分布学生宿舍与食堂，赛时观众与运动员流线可借助校园环路分开组织。馆内比赛区、热身区与观众区相对独立，赛时可分区管理；场地四周留有缓冲，适合手球这类需要边线冲刺的项目。
intro_en: The Guangdong University of Technology gymnasium stands at 100 Waihuan West Road on the university's Higher Education Mega Centre campus in Panyu District, Guangzhou, close to the Central Ring Road. The building has 14,050 square metres of floor area and provides 3,204 fixed seats, 188 seats on the main rostrum and 1,650 movable seats, and the floor can be set for handball, basketball, volleyball or badminton. Its plan is a simple square and the exterior is deliberately plain; together with the adjoining covered sports hall it forms a pair of venues capable of staging domestic B-level competitions. Handball at the 2010 Asian Games was played here between 13 and 26 November. The university's sports college now manages the hall through its venue centre, using it for teaching, squad training, the annual sports meeting and large events and taking bookings from students and staff through an online system. The cricket ground lies immediately to the east, so the two make up the university's sports quarter within the mega centre. Metro Line 4's Higher Education Mega Center South station is about 730 metres away, buses on routes 4 and 86 stop on campus, and Waihuan West Road links the site to the other universities and to the Nansha Port Expressway. Dormitories and canteens stand nearby, so spectator and athlete routes can be separated using the campus ring road. Competition, warm-up and spectator areas are kept relatively separate so that they can be zoned on match days, and the runoff around the court suits a fast, edge-to-edge game such as handball.

address: 广州市番禺区石楼镇广州亚运城亚运公园（清河东路以南、京珠高速以东）
intro_zh: 亚运城沙滩排球场位于广州市番禺区石楼镇广州亚运城东部的亚运公园内，清河东路以南、京珠高速以东，是2010年广州亚运会沙滩排球项目的比赛场地。场地占地36,400平方米，建筑面积3,946平方米，其中永久建筑2,558平方米；主比赛场由西侧主看台与东、南、北三面临时看台围合，赛时可提供3,006个座席，亚运场馆信息记为3,030个固定座位。建筑设计以“与自然共生”为意，白色膜结构如风帆浮于江面，椭圆外形似明珠嵌在公园绿地中，围栏上悬挂种植本土植被的花槽，形成岭南特色的绿篱。2010年11月15日至24日，亚运会沙滩排球比赛在此举行。赛后场地作为亚运公园的一部分保留，沙地与膜结构顶棚继续用于沙滩排球、沙滩足球和群众体育活动。观众可乘地铁四号线至海傍站（亚运城），或由南沙港快速路自驾抵达，亚运城内设有公交接驳；场馆与亚运城综合体育馆、运动员村隔水相望，共同构成亚运城的体育与公共空间轴线。亚运城片区每年举办社区体育文化节等活动，沙滩排球场与亚运城综合体育馆同为片区体育活动的载体。
intro_en: The Asian Games Town beach volleyball ground occupies the Asian Games Park on the eastern side of the Asian Games Town in Shilou town, Panyu District, Guangzhou, south of Qinghe East Road and east of the Beijing–Zhuhai expressway. The site covers 36,400 square metres, with 3,946 square metres of building area of which 2,558 square metres is permanent. The main court is enclosed by a grandstand on the west and temporary stands to the east, south and north, giving 3,006 seats during the Games, while venue records list 3,030 fixed places. The design was meant to sit lightly in the landscape: white membrane roofs float like sails above the river, the oval enclosure reads as a pearl set in the park, and planters of local species hang from the perimeter fence to form a Lingnan-style green hedge. Beach volleyball at the 2010 Asian Games ran from 15 to 24 November. The ground has been kept as part of the park, and its sand courts and membrane canopy continue to serve beach volleyball, beach soccer and community sport. Spectators reach it by Metro Line 4 to Haibang station in the Asian Games Town, or by car via the Nansha Port Expressway, with local bus connections inside the town. The ground faces the Asian Games Town gymnasium and the athletes' village across the water, forming the public spine of the town. The Asian Games Town now holds an annual community sports and culture festival, and the beach ground and the town gymnasium together carry its sporting programme.

address: 广州市番禺区大学城外环西路378号华南师范大学大学城校区
area_text: 建筑面积约30,000㎡
intro_zh: 华南师范大学体育馆位于广州市番禺区大学城外环西路378号华南师范大学大学城校区，是大学城高校场馆群中的综合体育馆，建筑面积约3万平方米，设观众席位约3,000个。比赛区长38米、宽27米，铺设木地板，比赛功能室齐全，可满足手球、篮球、排球、羽毛球等室内项目的比赛要求。2010年广州亚运会期间，这里承办手球比赛，赛期为11月13日至26日。在此之前，场馆曾承办第八届全国大学生运动会羽毛球比赛，并作为第八届全国少数民族传统体育运动会珍珠球比赛场地之一。赛后体育馆由华南师范大学体育科学学院场馆中心统一管理，用于体育教学、校队训练、校运会和大型文艺活动，并在课余时间向师生及周边居民开放。场馆位于大学城西侧，地铁四号线大学城南站、B25路、383路、381路、387路及大学城4线可到达，外环西路与中环西路在校园外围交汇。体育馆同时承担体育教学实验与运动人体科学测试任务，是华师大学城校区体育设施的核心。华师场馆中心成立于2007年9月，负责大学城校区与石牌校区场馆的日常管理、教学训练及对社会开放；体育馆在亚运期间承担手球比赛与训练任务。
intro_en: The South China Normal University gymnasium stands at 378 Waihuan West Road on the university's Higher Education Mega Centre campus in Panyu District, Guangzhou. The complex covers about 30,000 square metres of floor area and seats roughly 3,000 spectators. Its competition area measures 38 by 27 metres on a wooden floor, and its support rooms meet the needs of handball, basketball, volleyball and badminton. Handball at the 2010 Asian Games was staged here from 13 to 26 November. Before that the hall had hosted badminton at the Eighth National University Games and served as one of the venues for the pearl-ball competition at the Eighth National Traditional Ethnic Minority Sports Games. Since the Asian Games it has been managed by the venue centre of the university's School of Physical Education, which uses it for teaching, varsity training, the annual sports meeting and major cultural performances, and opens it to students, staff and nearby residents outside teaching hours. The campus sits on the western side of the mega centre, served by Metro Line 4's Higher Education Mega Center South station and by buses B25, 383, 381, 387 and route 4, with Waihuan West Road and Central Ring Road running around its perimeter. The hall also supports teaching laboratories and human-performance testing, and it is the core of the campus sports estate. The university's venue centre was set up in September 2007 to manage facilities on both the mega centre and Shipai campuses, covering teaching, training and public access; during the Games the hall took handball matches and training sessions.

address: 广州市天河区天河路299号天河体育中心西北角
intro_zh: 天河棒垒球场位于广州市天河区天河路299号天河体育中心西北角，毗邻中信广场，地处广州新城市中轴线，是2010年广州亚运会垒球项目的比赛场地。球场占地1.44万平方米，设有一座三层综合楼看台，可容纳约2,000名观众，亚运场馆信息记为3,000个座位；场地为符合国际标准的成年棒垒球比赛场，配置灯光、电子记分系统、音响设备和自动喷淋系统。2010年11月19日至26日，亚运会垒球比赛在此举行。天河体育中心为1987年第六届全运会而建，占地超过50万平方米，开创了体育场、体育馆、游泳馆“一场两馆”同时建成的模式，此后陆续增建棒球场、网球场、门球场和轮滑场；2025年十五运会前，中心完成整体改造，成为近零碳的既有大型体育场改造项目。赛后棒垒球场用于青少年棒球培训、业余联赛和群众健身，可通过“群体通”平台预约。观众乘地铁一号线至体育西路站或体育中心站即可到达，周边公交线路密集，球场与体育场、体育馆、游泳馆同为体育中心的主要场馆。球场紧靠体育中心西北入口，赛时观众由天河路一侧步行进入，与体育场、体育馆的观众流线分开；场地外围设练习笼与热身区，平日向棒球俱乐部和学校队伍开放。
intro_en: The Tianhe baseball and softball field occupies the north-western corner of Tianhe Sports Centre at 299 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, beside CITIC Plaza on the city's new central axis. The site covers 14,400 square metres and includes a three-storey grandstand building for about 2,000 spectators, while Asian Games venue records give 3,000 seats. The field meets international standards for adult baseball and softball and is equipped with floodlighting, an electronic scoring system, a public-address system and automatic irrigation. Softball at the 2010 Asian Games was played here from 19 to 26 November. Tianhe Sports Centre was built for the Sixth National Games in 1987 on more than 50 hectares, the first Chinese-designed complex to open a stadium, a gymnasium and a swimming hall at the same time, and it later added baseball, tennis, gateball and roller-skating facilities. Ahead of the 15th National Games in 2025 the centre was comprehensively renovated as a near-zero-carbon retrofit of an existing large stadium. The baseball ground now serves junior coaching, amateur leagues and public fitness, bookable through the Quntitong platform, and is a short walk from Metro Line 1's Tiyu Xilu and Tianhe Sports Center stations. Dense bus routes serve the surrounding streets, and the ground ranks with the stadium, gymnasium and natatorium as one of the centre's main venues. The ground sits beside the centre's north-west entrance, so on match days spectators walk in from Tianhe Road on a route separate from the stadium and gymnasium crowds; practice cages and a warm-up area flank the field and are let to baseball clubs and school teams on ordinary days.

address: 广州市天河区天河路299号天河体育中心内
intro_zh: 天河游泳馆位于广州市天河区天河路299号天河体育中心内，1987年建成，是为第六届全国运动会配套的三大场馆之一。馆体建筑面积23,000平方米，南北跨度62米、东西长118米，设观众席位约3,000个。馆内拥有符合国际标准的50米游泳比赛池、标准训练池和21米×21米跳水池，游泳池水深3米，可满足游泳、花样游泳、水球和跳水等水上项目的比赛与训练要求，池岸设有计时记分、灯光音响和观众看台。2010年广州亚运会期间，这里承办水球比赛，赛期为11月13日至25日。赛后场馆作为天河体育中心全民健身设施的一部分对外开放，常年开设游泳培训、花样游泳和水球课程，2022年重新开放，并纳入“群体通”预约系统。场馆地处天河商圈核心，地铁一号线体育西路站、体育中心站步行可达，周边公交线路密集，是天河区使用率最高的公共游泳馆之一；游泳馆与体育场、体育馆围合出中心广场，赛时观众经广场集散，与训练人群分开。每年8月8日全民健身日，天河游泳馆与市内其他公共游泳场馆一同向市民免费开放，市民需在“群体通”平台提前实名预约；平日开放分惠民专场与普通场次，暑期增设青少年游泳培训班。
intro_en: The Tianhe Natatorium stands inside Tianhe Sports Centre at 299 Tianhe Road, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, and was completed in 1987 as one of the three principal venues built for the Sixth National Games. The building has 23,000 square metres of floor area, spans 62 metres from north to south and runs 118 metres from east to west, with seating for about 3,000 spectators. Inside are a 50-metre competition pool built to international standards, a standard training pool and a 21 by 21 metre diving pool, with the main pool three metres deep, so that swimming, artistic swimming, water polo and diving can all be staged and trained for. Poolside timing and scoring equipment, lighting, sound and spectator galleries complete the hall. Water polo at the 2010 Asian Games was played here from 13 to 25 November. After the Games the natatorium became part of the centre's public fitness offering, running swimming lessons, artistic swimming and water polo programmes; it reopened in 2022 and takes bookings through the Quntitong platform. Sitting in the heart of the Tianhe commercial district, it is within walking distance of Metro Line 1's Tiyu Xilu and Tianhe Sports Center stations and is one of the busiest public indoor pools in the district. The natatorium, stadium and gymnasium enclose the centre's main plaza, which handles crowd distribution on event days and keeps spectators away from training groups. Every year on 8 August, National Fitness Day, the natatorium joins other public pools in Guangzhou in offering free admission, with places booked in advance through the Quntitong platform; ordinary weeks mix subsidised sessions with standard ones, and youth swimming courses are added during the summer holidays.

address: 广州市增城区派潭镇榕树吓村
intro_zh: 广州飞碟训练中心位于广州市增城区派潭镇榕树吓村，临近白水寨风景区，距广州市中心约90公里，是2010年广州亚运会五个市属新建场馆之一。项目占地117,800平方米，分飞碟靶场、主体建筑和赛事辅助区三部分，设1,000个固定坐席和2,000个临时坐席，总投资1.6亿元，2008年底动工、2010年4月底建成，是继北京射击场飞碟靶场之后全国第二个可承办国际赛事的专用飞碟场馆。2010年11月，亚运会飞碟项目在此举行，设12个小项、产生12枚金牌。赛后中心成为广州市射击射箭运动基地，也是国家射击队和广东省射击队的常驻训练基地，常年承接省飞碟锦标赛，被誉为“冠军摇篮”。为迎接2025年第十五届全运会，中心进行了近8个月改造，在保留原有建筑形态的基础上，对室内9,656.15平方米、室外51,659平方米空间全面升级，设备更新对标巴黎奥运会，并承办十五运会射击（飞碟）项目。观众可经广河高速、G105转派潭镇方向自驾前往，或由天河客运站乘班车至从化、增城后换乘；中心周边以山林和农田为主，赛时设临时停车与接驳。中心设多向、双向等飞碟靶场，靶机与计分设备在十五运会改造中同步更新，赛后可承接国际邀请赛与国家队冬训。
intro_en: The Guangzhou Clay Target Shooting Training Centre lies at Rongshuxia village, Paitan town, Zengcheng District, about 90 kilometres from central Guangzhou and close to the Baishuizhai scenic area. One of five new municipal venues built for the 2010 Asian Games, it covers 117,800 square metres divided into clay target ranges, a main building and an event support zone, with 1,000 fixed seats and 2,000 temporary ones. The project cost RMB 160 million, began at the end of 2008 and was completed in April 2010, making it the second purpose-built venue in China able to stage international clay target competitions after the Beijing Shooting Range. The Asian Games shotgun events were held here in November 2010, with twelve events and twelve gold medals. The centre then became Guangzhou's shooting and archery base and the resident training base of both the national shooting team and the Guangdong provincial team, hosting provincial championships year after year and earning the nickname 'cradle of champions'. For the 15th National Games in 2025 it underwent nearly eight months of renovation that kept the original building form while upgrading 9,656.15 square metres indoors and 51,659 square metres outdoors, with equipment benchmarked against the Paris Olympics, and it staged the Games' clay target shooting events. Access is by road via Highway 105 and local routes towards Paitan, or by coach from Tianhe with a change at Conghua or Zengcheng; the surrounding land is mainly forest and farmland, with temporary parking and shuttle services on event days. The centre has trap and skeet layouts whose traps and scoring equipment were renewed in the National Games upgrade, so it can host international invitationals and winter training for national squads.
