address: 广州市越秀区二沙岛大通路28号广东省二沙体育训练中心内
intro_zh: 广东体育馆位于广州市越秀区二沙岛大通路28号广东省二沙体育训练中心内，珠江北岸，1987年10月建成，为第六届全运会配套场馆。全馆占地面积1.22万平方米，比赛场地面积1,700平方米，铺设优质木地板，场内设多功能电动计时记分装置，配有空调、音响和灯光设备，观众席可容纳2,800人。1989年12月，体育馆西侧建成网球馆，两层建筑，底层为1,680平方米的多功能比赛大厅，南北两侧各有一片标准网球练习场。2010年广州亚运会期间，这里承办跆拳道和空手道比赛，赛期为11月13日至26日。二沙基地始建于1954年，占地约22万平方米，是广东最大的竞技体育训练基地，游泳、田径、乒乓球、羽毛球等项目国家队与省队长期在此训练。为迎接2025年第十五届全运会，广东体育馆及副馆完成改造，改造总建筑面积约15,290平方米、用地约25,086平方米，赛时作为女子足球比赛热身训练场馆。赛后场馆继续服务专业队训练和全民健身，是二沙岛体育公园片区的重要组成部分，馆外为二沙岛体育公园与珠江沿岸绿地。二沙基地四面环水、以桥连城，基地内场馆、运动员宿舍与绿地相间；广东体育馆主馆、副馆与网球馆共同构成基地的室内场馆群，长期承接省级赛事与对外交流。
intro_en: Guangdong Gymnasium stands at 28 Datong Road on Ersha Island, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, inside the Guangdong Ersha Sports Training Centre on the north bank of the Pearl River. Completed in October 1987 for the Sixth National Games, it occupies a site of 12,200 square metres and has a competition floor of 1,700 square metres laid in high-quality timber, with electronic timing and scoring, air conditioning, sound and lighting, and seating for 2,800 spectators. A two-storey tennis hall was added to the west in December 1989, with a 1,680-square-metre multi-purpose hall on the ground floor and a standard practice court on each of its north and south sides. Taekwondo and karate at the 2010 Asian Games were contested here between 13 and 26 November. The Ersha base itself dates from 1954 and covers about 220,000 square metres, the largest elite training centre in Guangdong, where national and provincial squads in swimming, athletics, table tennis and badminton have long trained. For the 15th National Games in 2025 the gymnasium and its annex were renovated, with about 15,290 square metres of building area and 25,086 square metres of site works, and served as a warm-up venue for the women's football tournament. It continues to host squad training and public fitness programmes as part of the Ersha Island sports park. The Ersha base is ringed by water and linked to the city by bridges, with venues, athlete housing and green space set among one another; the main hall, its annex and the tennis hall form the base's indoor cluster, which has long hosted provincial competitions and exchange events.

address: 成都市双流区东升街道花园路（银河路路口）
area_text: 占地234亩（约15.6万平方米），总建筑面积37495平方米
intro_zh: 双流体育中心位于成都市双流区东升街道花园路与银河路路口，2008年7月建成并投入使用，是双流新城区的地标性体育建筑群。园区占地234亩，约15.6万平方米，总建筑面积37495平方米，其中体育场22869平方米，体育馆、训练馆及游泳池合计14626平方米，地下建筑面积706平方米，绿化率约53.3%。体育场设26000个座位，场内为10条直道、9条弯道的标准400米预制型塑胶跑道与天然草坪足球场，可承办田径、足球赛事；体育馆主场地45米×28米、净高21米，可布置14片羽毛球场地，2023年成都大运会期间作为羽毛球比赛与热身场馆。这里的历史节点包括2010年女足亚洲杯、熊猫杯国际青年足球邀请赛，以及2023年第31届世界大学生夏季运动会的田径比赛；成都天诚、成都钱宝、成都蓉城、四川九牛等球队都曾把主场设在双流，2025年起成都蓉城B队亦在此比赛。除竞技赛事外，体育场还是成都大型演唱会的重要场地，2017年至2019年多场巡回演唱会在此举行。运营方为成都空港瞿上体育文化产业运营管理有限公司（双流区属国企），大运会后风雨篮球场、训练场、五人制足球场与室外健身路径陆续向公众开放，形成“比赛+训练+全民健身+演出”的复合使用模式。对活动主办方而言，双流的优势是场地纵深大、疏散面充足、停车与后勤车辆进出方便，适合大型赛事、运动会开幕式与体育场级演唱会；不足是距成都市中心约15公里，观众依赖地铁3号线、10号线加接驳。
intro_en: The Shuangliu Sports Centre stands at the junction of Huayuan Road and Yinhe Road in Dongsheng, Shuangliu District, Chengdu, and has been in use since July 2008 as the anchor sports complex of the district's new town. The campus covers 234 mu, about 156,000 square metres, with 37,495 square metres of building: 22,869 for the stadium, 14,626 for the gymnasium, training hall and swimming pool, and 706 underground, with roughly 53.3 per cent of the site landscaped. The stadium seats 26,000 and has a standard 400-metre prefabricated rubber track with ten straight and nine curved lanes plus a natural-turf football pitch, so it can stage athletics and football. The gymnasium has a 45 by 28 metre main floor with 21 metres of clear height and fourteen badminton courts, and served as the badminton competition and warm-up hall during the Chengdu 2021 World University Games in 2023. The venue's record includes the 2010 AFC Women's Asian Cup, the Panda Cup international youth football tournament and the athletics programme of the 31st Summer Universiade in 2023; Chengdu Tiancheng, Chengdu Qianbao, Chengdu Rongcheng and Sichuan Jiuniu have all used it as a home ground, and Chengdu Rongcheng B has played here since 2025. Beyond sport, the stadium is one of Chengdu's main concert sites, with several touring shows between 2017 and 2019. It is operated by Chengdu Airport Qushang Sports Culture Industry Operation and Management Co., a district-owned state enterprise, and since the Universiade the covered basketball courts, training ground, five-a-side pitches and outdoor fitness trail have opened to the public, giving the site a mixed programme of competition, training, public sport and concerts. For organisers the advantages are depth of site, generous dispersal areas and easy access for parking and production vehicles, which suit major meets, games opening ceremonies and stadium-scale concerts; the drawback is distance, about 15 kilometres from central Chengdu, with audiences dependent on metro lines 3 and 10 plus a shuttle.

address: 成都市双流区金河路66号
area_text: 占地近26万平方米
capacity_text: 中心决赛场8000座，两片半决赛场各2000座
intro_zh: 四川国际网球中心又称四川川投国际网球中心，位于成都市双流区金河路66号，是西南地区规模最大的网球综合体。园区占地近26万平方米，由1座可容纳8000名观众的中心决赛场、2座各可容纳2000名观众的半决赛场、14片室外场、8片风雨球场和1片室内球场组成，另有室外练习场、红土场与室内训练馆，场地按国际网联ATP赛事标准建设。运营方为四川川能国际网球中心开发有限责任公司，公司2008年10月建成并投入试运营，注册资金9.29亿元，总资产规模15.1亿元，隶属四川能源发展集团旗下的四川能源医药健康集团，业务覆盖场馆管理、赛事运营、酒店与体育公园。赛事方面，这里举办过3届ATP冠军巡回赛、4届成都公开赛—ATP世界巡回赛以及ITF青少年总决赛等50余项国际国内赛事，是成都网球公开赛的固定主场；2023年第31届世界大学生夏季运动会期间，中心同时承担网球比赛、热身与训练三项功能。园区内还有川能国际酒店、川网国际花园与凤鸣湖体育公园，形成“赛事+住宿+训练+休闲”的封闭园区，适合队伍长期驻训与多日赛。对活动主办方而言，四川国际网球中心的核心优势是场地密度与配套完整性：中心场可做决赛与转播，半决赛场可并行进行两场高强度比赛，室外场与风雨球场保证雨天赛程不中断，园区酒店让球员、裁判与媒体不必每日往返市区；不足是距成都市中心约20公里，观众以自驾与赛事接驳为主。
intro_en: The Sichuan International Tennis Centre, also known as the Sichuan Chuantou International Tennis Centre, stands at 66 Jinhe Road in Shuangliu District, Chengdu, and is the largest tennis complex in south-west China. The park covers nearly 260,000 square metres and comprises an 8,000-seat centre court, two 2,000-seat semi-final courts, fourteen outdoor courts, eight covered courts and one indoor court, together with outdoor practice courts, clay courts and an indoor training hall, all built to ATP standards. It is operated by Sichuan Chuanneng International Tennis Centre Development Co., which completed the venue and began trial operation in October 2008 with registered capital of RMB 929 million and total assets of RMB 1.51 billion; the company sits under the Sichuan Energy Pharmaceutical and Health Group within the Sichuan Energy Development Group, and its business spans venue management, event operations, hotels and sports parks. The centre has hosted three ATP Champions Tour events, four editions of the Chengdu Open on the ATP World Tour and the ITF Junior Finals among more than fifty international and domestic tournaments, and is the permanent home of the Chengdu Open. During the 31st Summer Universiade in 2023 it carried the tennis competition, warm-up and training at the same time. Within the grounds are the Chuanneng International Hotel, the Chuanwang International Garden residential development and the Fengming Lake Sports Park, forming an enclosed campus of competition, accommodation, training and leisure that suits long team camps and multi-day tournaments. For event owners the core strength is court density plus complete supporting facilities: the centre court handles finals and broadcast, the semi-final courts allow two high-intensity matches in parallel, and the outdoor and covered courts keep the schedule running through rain, while the on-site hotel spares players, officials and media a daily commute into the city. The drawback is distance, about 20 kilometres from central Chengdu, with spectators arriving mainly by car and event shuttles.

address: 成都市青羊区人民中路一段11号（东华门街18号片区）
area_text: 占地140亩（约9.3万平方米）
status_note: 已停止作为体育场馆运营：原址改建为东华门遗址公园
intro_zh: 成都市体育中心位于青羊区人民中路一段11号，地处旧城核心的骡马市—皇城片区，占地140亩，足球场设39225个座位，是成都第一座可承办大型田径与足球比赛的综合性体育场。体育场1987年9月开工，1991年12月28日竣工，1992年投入使用，南北两层、东西三层的看台围合出完整的碗形；建成后迅速成为城市地标，1994年中国足球职业化元年的甲A揭幕战在此举行，四川全兴由此把成都变成“金牌球市”，1995年11月12日四川全兴对青岛海牛的“成都保卫战”更涌入约六万名观众，远超设计容量。这里还承办过2007年女足世界杯部分比赛、世界杯预选赛、全国田径锦标赛以及大量演唱会，是上世纪九十年代至2010年代成都大型活动的第一选择。转折发生在2013年：场馆改造施工中发现唐代建筑基址、明代蜀王府与摩诃池遗存，考古发掘持续至2018年，发掘面积约4.9万平方米；2014年该片区被确定为成都东华门考古遗址公园，2016年12月体育中心启动改造，2022年12月11日遗址公园首次向市民开放，2023年7月20日外场遗址区正式开放，免费入园、开放时间7:30至22:00。按2023年公布的计划，内场（原体育中心建筑）继续按遗址展示要求建设。这意味着成都市体育中心作为竞技场馆的功能已经终止，今天它是一处考古遗址公园而非可预订的赛事场地；场馆库收录此条，主要用于历史项目溯源与“已停用”标注。
intro_en: The Chengdu Sports Centre stood at 11 Renmin Middle Road Section 1 in Qingyang District, in the Luomashi and Huangcheng area of the old city, on a site of 140 mu with a football ground of 39,225 seats. It was Chengdu's first comprehensive stadium capable of staging major athletics and football, begun in September 1987, completed on 28 December 1991 and opened in 1992, with two tiers of seating on the north and south sides and three on the east and west closing a full bowl. It quickly became a city landmark: the opening match of the inaugural professional Jia-A season in 1994 was played here, and Sichuan Quanxing turned Chengdu into a byword for a gold-medal football market, with the derby against Qingdao Hainiu on 12 November 1995, remembered as the Defence of Chengdu, drawing some 60,000 spectators into a ground designed for far fewer. It also hosted matches of the 2007 FIFA Women's World Cup, World Cup qualifiers, national athletics championships and a long list of concerts, and for two decades it was the default venue for large events in the city. The turning point came in 2013, when renovation works uncovered Tang building foundations, the Ming palace of the Shu princes and the remains of Mochi pond; excavation ran to 2018 over about 49,000 square metres. In 2014 the area was designated the Chengdu Donghuamen Archaeological Site Park, renovation of the sports centre began in December 2016, the park first opened to citizens on 11 December 2022, and the outer site area opened formally on 20 July 2023, free of charge, from 7.30 am to 10 pm. Under the plan published in 2023 the inner area, the former sports centre building itself, is being developed for archaeological display. The Chengdu Sports Centre has therefore ceased to function as a competition venue: it is now a heritage park rather than a bookable stadium, and it is listed here mainly for tracing past events and for marking the site as closed.

address: 成都市金牛区北星大道一段（敬成路交叉口，天回街道杜家碾片区）
intro_zh: 成都凤凰山体育公园位于成都市金牛区北星大道一段、敬成路交叉口一带，地处天回街道杜家碾片区，是成都主城区北部的大型体育综合体，也是2021年世界大学生夏季运动会篮球比赛场馆和2023年亚洲杯足球赛的比赛、训练场地。公园占地43.67公顷（约655亩），总建筑面积约45.6万平方米，由“一场两馆一中心”组成：6万座专业足球场、1.8万座综合体育馆、2160平方米多功能馆及超过1万平方米全民健身中心，并配天府俱乐部、商业服务设施与大面积绿地广场。专业足球场按国际足联A级标准设计，采用世界首例葵花形大开口索穹顶结构，屋盖由拉索与ETFE膜共同受力；综合体育馆满足NBA标准，可在篮球、冰球、羽毛球、乒乓球、体操之间转换。园区以体育为主题组织步行系统，串联商业、酒店与训练空间，赛时可分流数万观众，赛后向市民开放健身、培训和演艺功能。交通方面，地铁5号线杜家碾站、九道堰站分别位于公园西、东两侧，周边还有46路、157路、168路等公交线路。专业足球场、综合体育馆与天府俱乐部之间以两道结构缝分为独立单元，可按赛事规模分区开放。
intro_en: Chengdu Phoenix Hill Sports Park lies along the First Section of Beixing Avenue in Jinniu District, at the junction with Jingcheng Road in the Dujianian area of Tianhui Subdistrict, in the north of Chengdu's main urban area. It was a basketball venue for the 2021 Summer World University Games and a match and training site for the 2023 AFC Asian Cup. The park covers 43.67 hectares, about 655 mu, with roughly 456,000 sqm of gross floor area, organised as one stadium, two halls and one centre: a 60,000-seat football stadium, an 18,000-seat indoor arena, a 2,160 sqm multi-purpose hall and a public fitness centre of more than 10,000 sqm, supported by the Tianfu Club, commercial space and extensive lawns. The football stadium is designed to FIFA A-level standards and uses the world's first sunflower-shaped large-opening cable dome, with cables and an ETFE membrane sharing the roof load and sightlines tuned for football. The arena meets NBA standards and can switch between basketball, ice hockey, badminton, table tennis and gymnastics. A pedestrian network links the venues with retail, hotels and training space, allowing crowds of tens of thousands to be handled on match days while the park opens to residents for fitness, training and performances afterwards. Metro Line 5 stops at Dujianian and Jiudaoyan stations on the west and east sides, and bus routes 46, 157, 168 and 651 serve the park. Two structural joints divide the stadium, the arena and the Tianfu Club into independent units, so the park can open in phases according to event size.

name_zh: 凤凰山体育公园专业足球场
address: 成都市金牛区北星大道一段（凤凰山体育公园内）
intro_zh: 凤凰山体育公园专业足球场位于成都市金牛区北星大道一段的凤凰山体育公园内，是成都第二座专业足球场，2018年12月开工、2021年6月投用，2022年1月9日以中国足协杯决赛完成首秀，现为中超成都蓉城足球俱乐部主场，并被商业冠名为五粮液文化体育中心。球场按国际足联标准建设，看台不设田径跑道，草坪与首排观众距离近，场内有50695个固定座席，极限容量57087人，其中首层看台25437席（含3128个伸缩座椅）、顶层看台22269席，另设SVIP HALL 220席、VIP 496席、包厢1682席、V88 369席、天府俱乐部164席及58个无障碍座席。建筑最大特色是葵花形大开口索穹顶屋盖，钢结构与ETFE膜材结合，中央开口引入自然光与通风，屋面形态轻盈，成为成都北部城市天际线的一部分；场内配套更衣、媒体、贵宾与商业空间，可承接国际A级足球赛及演唱会。交通方面，地铁5号线杜家碾站、九道堰站分列场馆西东两侧，公交46路、157路、168路、651路等可至凤凰山体育公园站。球场与综合体育馆、天府俱乐部之间以结构缝分开，非比赛日可各自独立运营。
intro_en: The Phoenix Hill Sports Park Football Stadium sits inside Chengdu Phoenix Hill Sports Park on the First Section of Beixing Avenue, Jinniu District. It is Chengdu's second football-specific stadium, begun in December 2018, completed in June 2021 and opened with the Chinese FA Cup final on 9 January 2022; it is the home of Chengdu Rongcheng in the Chinese Super League and carries the commercial name Wuliangye Culture and Sports Center. Built to FIFA standards, it has no running track, bringing the stands close to the pitch. Fixed seating totals 50,695, with a maximum of 57,087: the lower tier holds 25,437 including 3,128 retractable seats, the top tier 22,269, and there are 220 SVIP hall seats, 496 VIP seats, 1,682 box seats, 369 V88 seats, 164 Tianfu Club seats and 58 accessible seats. Its defining feature is the sunflower-shaped large-opening cable dome, combining a steel structure with an ETFE membrane; the central opening admits daylight and ventilation and gives the roof a light, taut profile that has become part of Chengdu's northern skyline. Inside are dressing rooms, media and VIP facilities and commercial space, allowing the venue to stage international A-level football and concerts. Metro Line 5 serves Dujianian and Jiudaoyan stations west and east of the park, and buses 46, 157, 168 and 651 stop at Phoenix Hill Sports Park, with traffic controls and shuttle services on event days. The stadium is structurally separated from the arena and the Tianfu Club, allowing each to operate independently on non-match days.

address: 成都市龙泉驿区东安街道体育公园路16号
area_text: 总建筑面积约320,000㎡；占地约5,000亩
intro_zh: 东安湖体育公园位于成都市龙泉驿区东安街道体育公园路16号，地处东安新城核心、龙泉山下，是2021年第31届世界大学生夏季运动会主会场和开幕式场地，2025年世界运动会期间继续承担体操、啦啦操、无人机竞速等项目。公园占地约5000亩，总建筑面积约32万平方米，由“一场三馆”组成：4万座大型甲级体育场、1.8万座特大型甲级体育馆、4500座游泳跳水馆和小球馆，并配套酒店、图书馆、剧院与环湖绿道。主体育场为国内少见的正圆形平面，建筑面积约12万平方米、占地约30.7万平方米，屋顶以12540块彩釉玻璃拼出宽约46米、总面积约2.7万平方米的“太阳神鸟”图案，远看如飞碟降落；场内设标准田径场与足球场，看台分上下层并设包厢，可举办世界性综合赛事与大型演唱会。三馆由共同平台层连接，银色铝制百叶幕墙延伸至屋面，与东安湖水面形成整体景观。交通方面，地铁2号线连山坡站、界牌站可换乘接驳公交至公园西门，地铁7号线迎晖路站可换乘K6、K7至东安湖站，周边蜀都大道、汽车城大道自驾可达。公园环湖布置绿道与开敞草坪，赛后成为龙泉驿城区重要的公共休闲空间。
intro_en: Dong'an Lake Sports Park is at 16 Sports Park Road, Dong'an Subdistrict, Longquanyi District, Chengdu, at the core of the Dong'an New Town below Longquan Mountain. It was the main venue and opening ceremony site of the 31st Summer World University Games in 2021 and hosted gymnastics, cheerleading, drone racing and tug-of-war during the 2025 World Games. The park covers about 5,000 mu, roughly 3.3 sq km, with some 320,000 sqm of gross floor area, arranged as one stadium and three halls: a 40,000-seat Class-A stadium, an 18,000-seat extra-large Class-A arena, a 4,500-seat swimming and diving hall and a small-ball hall, together with a hotel, library, theatre and lakeside greenway. The main stadium has a rare circular plan, about 120,000 sqm of floor area on a 307,000 sqm site, and its roof carries a Sun Bird pattern about 46 m wide and 27,000 sqm in area made from 12,540 glazed glass panels, so that the building reads as a flying saucer from a distance. Inside are a standard track and football pitch, upper and lower tiers and boxes, allowing world-level multi-sport events and large concerts. The three halls share a podium, their silver aluminium louvre facades running up to the roofs and framing the lake. Metro Line 2 at Lianshanpo and Jiepai stations connects by shuttle to the west gate, Line 7 at Yinghui Road connects by bus K6 or K7 to Dong'an Lake station, and the site is reached by car via Shudu Avenue and Qichecheng Avenue. Lakeside greenways and open lawns wrap the venues, and after the Games the park has become an important public recreation space for the Longquanyi district.

address: 西藏自治区拉萨市城关区江苏路16号
area_text: 公开资料未公布（场内为田径场、草坪足球场及少量篮球场地）
intro_zh: 拉萨市人民体育场位于城关区江苏路16号，始建于1960年，是拉萨建成的第一座现代体育设施。建场之初设施简单，只有一片田径场、一片草坪足球场和少量篮球场地，此后经历多次翻修、扩建，逐步补齐看台、灯光和附属用房。它长期是拉萨足球赛事和群众体育活动的主要场地，草坪足球场至今仍是全市主要的足球比赛场地之一；1999年8月18日，第六届全国少数民族传统体育运动会在这里开幕，是这座高原场馆承办过的规格最高的综合性赛事。体育场坐落在拉萨老城与江苏路片区之间，海拔约3650米，空气稀薄、日照强烈，足球飞行速度比平原快、体能消耗也更大，是典型的高原主场环境。如今它与周边学校、机关和社区健身设施连成一片，日常免费或低收费向市民开放，清晨和傍晚是跑步、踢球和跳锅庄最热闹的时段。作为拉萨体育从无到有的起点，这座体育场被本地人视作城市体育记忆的原点，也是了解西藏现代体育史绕不开的一处场地。
intro_en: Lhasa People's Stadium on Jiangsu Road in Chengguan District dates from 1960 and was the first modern sports facility built in the city. It began modestly, with a athletics track, a grass football pitch and a few basketball courts, and was enlarged and renovated several times as stands, lighting and support buildings were added. For decades it has been the main stage for football and mass sport in Lhasa, and its grass pitch is still one of the city's principal football grounds. On 18 August 1999 the stadium hosted the opening ceremony of the 6th National Traditional Games of Ethnic Minorities, the largest multi-sport event the venue has staged. Sitting between the old town and the Jiangsu Road neighbourhood at about 3,650 metres above sea level, it offers the thin air and strong sunlight of a classic high-altitude home ground, where the ball travels faster and players tire sooner than at sea level. The stadium now connects with neighbouring schools, government compounds and community fitness facilities, and is open to residents free of charge or at low cost, with early mornings and evenings busy with runners, footballers and circle dances. As the starting point of organised sport in Lhasa, it is treated locally as the origin of the city's sporting memory and remains essential to any account of modern sport in Tibet. The ground also hosts school sports days, district tournaments and festival gatherings, and its open setting keeps it in use from dawn until dusk. Its history mirrors the growth of organised sport across the plateau, from a bare pitch to a venue used by national and provincial teams for high-altitude training.

name_zh: 拉萨市群众文化体育中心
address: 西藏自治区拉萨市堆龙德庆区柳梧新区（察古大道以东、奥体大街以南、东环路以西、柳梧新村路以北）
area_text: 占地387亩（约25.8万平方米），总建筑面积约6.9万平方米（维基百科记67501平方米）
intro_zh: 拉萨市群众文化体育中心位于堆龙德庆区柳梧新区，四至为察古大道以东、奥体大街以南、东环路以西、柳梧新村路以北，是北京市援藏的重点项目，也是西藏和平解放60周年大庆的奠基工程。中心2011年8月31日奠基、2012年7月开工，2014年10月整体竣工并通过验收，占地387亩，总建筑面积约6.9万平方米，北京援藏投资约7.35亿元，由“一场两馆”及音乐广场组成：3万座体育场、6000座体育馆和西藏牦牛博物馆。因主体建筑造型舒展，市民称它“小鸟巢”；2015年11月获中国建筑业最高奖鲁班奖，并被称为世界海拔最高的现代化体育场馆。牦牛博物馆2014年5月18日开馆，展陈面积8000多平方米，是国家二级博物馆和4A级景区。中心全年365天开放，时间从早8点延续到午夜，室内篮球、足球、羽毛球、乒乓球和游泳馆实行免费或低收费，室外篮球场、健身步道、儿童游乐区和锅庄舞广场常年免费，配有570个免费停车位。2025年中心开放6054场次、接待健身群众46万人次；2019年10月莫文蔚世界巡回演唱会在此举行，被称为海拔最高的万人演唱会。
intro_en: Lhasa Public Culture and Sports Center stands in Liuwu New Area, Doilungdeqen District, bounded by Chagu Avenue, Aoti Street, the East Ring Road and Liuwu Xincun Road. It was a flagship aid project from Beijing and the foundation-laying scheme for the 60th anniversary of the peaceful liberation of Tibet. Ground was broken on 31 August 2011, construction began in July 2012 and the complex was completed and accepted in October 2014. It covers 387 mu, about 25.8 hectares, with roughly 69,000 square metres of floor space and an investment of about 735 million yuan. The layout is a stadium, a gymnasium and the Tibet Yak Museum around a music plaza: the stadium seats 30,000, the gymnasium 6,000, and the museum occupies more than 8,000 square metres. Residents call the building the Little Bird's Nest; in November 2015 it won the Luban Prize, China's top construction award, and it is described as the world's highest-altitude modern sports complex. The Yak Museum opened on 18 May 2014 and is a national second-grade museum and a 4A scenic site. The center opens 365 days a year from 8 am to midnight, with indoor basketball, football, badminton, table tennis and swimming free or cheap, outdoor courts, fitness trails, a children's area and a circle-dance plaza always free, and 570 free parking spaces. In 2025 it hosted 6,054 sessions and received 460,000 visits. Karen Mok's 2019 world tour concert here was billed as the highest-altitude arena concert. Swimming, badminton and table tennis programmes run alongside the museum, and the campus stays open until midnight every day.

name_zh: 拉萨市群众文化体育中心体育馆
address: 西藏自治区拉萨市堆龙德庆区柳梧新区新村北路1号（群众文化体育中心园区内）
area_text: 未单独公布（属中心约6.9万平方米建筑群，体育馆为其中一馆）
intro_zh: 拉萨市群众文化体育中心体育馆位于柳梧新区新村北路1号的中心园区内，是“一场两馆”中的室内馆，2013年8月18日主体结构封顶，2014年9月投入使用，设6000个座位。场馆地处海拔约3650米，是国内少有的高原大型室内馆，主场地以篮球布置为主，也可承接羽毛球、乒乓球、排球、体操和文艺演出，配有运动员更衣室、裁判室、媒体工作区和贵宾接待区。2015年2月拉萨净土男子篮球俱乐部成立后把主场设在这里，高原缺氧、球速偏快的特点让客队颇不适应，满场的声音成为球队的一大利器。作为公共体育场馆，体育馆常年免费或低收费开放，白天接待单位赛事和青少年培训，晚间向社会开放羽毛球、篮球场地，是柳梧新区居民日常健身的主要去处。它与相邻的3万座体育场、西藏牦牛博物馆共用广场、停车和疏散系统，大型赛事期间可整体联动，形成拉萨规模最大、功能最集中的群众文体片区，也是高原室内赛事保障能力的一次集中体现。
intro_en: The gymnasium of Lhasa Public Culture and Sports Center sits inside the Liuwu New Area campus at 1 Xincun North Road. It is the indoor hall of the stadium-gymnasium-museum trio, topped out on 18 August 2013, opened in September 2014 and fitted with 6,000 seats. At about 3,650 metres above sea level it is one of the very few large indoor arenas on the Tibetan plateau. The main floor is set up for basketball but can be converted for badminton, table tennis, volleyball, gymnastics and stage performances, with dressing rooms, officials' rooms, a media area and VIP reception space. When the Lhasa Jingtu men's basketball club was founded in February 2015 it made this hall its home court, where the thin air and quick ball trouble visiting teams and a full house becomes a real advantage. As a public venue the gymnasium is free or low-cost all year, hosting corporate tournaments and youth training by day and opening badminton and basketball courts to residents in the evening, which makes it the main indoor fitness option in Liuwu. It shares plazas, parking and evacuation routes with the 30,000-seat stadium and the Tibet Yak Museum next door, so major events can use the whole campus as one integrated complex, the largest and most concentrated public culture and sports precinct in Lhasa. The building shares its entrance plaza with the stadium and the museum, and the whole campus stays open until midnight. It is open every day of the year, including public holidays, and access is free or low cost.

address: 西藏自治区拉萨市城关区娘热路27号
area_text: 总建筑面积约0.81万平方米（比赛馆7181平方米）
intro_zh: 西藏体育馆位于城关区娘热路27号，是1984年中央第二次西藏工作座谈会确定的43项援藏工程之一，也是其中的三大重点项目之一，由浙江省承建，属“钥匙工程”，1984年5月动工、1985年9月随43项工程整体竣工，为西藏自治区成立20周年献礼。全馆总建筑面积约0.81万平方米，比赛馆7181平方米，三层钢筋混凝土框架结构，屋面钢桁架跨度56.4米、檐高18.1米；场地长36米、宽22米，铺双层硬木地板，场心至平顶净高12.5米，四周阶梯看台设3100个固定座椅，另配1000个活动座椅，可按集会4000人、演出2200人、电影2400人转换使用。声学上采用木条钢丝网吸音墙面与防火吸音平顶，配120回路可控硅调光；南北看台装计算机控制的大型计时计分牌，可用藏、汉、英三种文字显示；西看台活动看台收起后形成16米宽、9.2米深的大舞台，东看台下设电影放映间。场馆冬季有热水采暖和新风加温加湿，场内维持16℃。2024年6月这里承办过押加项目比赛。
intro_en: Tibet Gymnasium at 27 Niangre Road in Chengguan District is one of the 43 aid projects decided at the second Central Work Conference on Tibet in 1984 and one of its three priority schemes. Zhejiang Province built it as a turnkey project: work started in May 1984 and the hall was completed with the rest of the programme in September 1985, marking the 20th anniversary of the Tibet Autonomous Region. The building has about 8,100 square metres of floor area, of which the competition hall accounts for 7,181. It is a three-storey reinforced concrete frame with a 56.4-metre steel roof truss and an eaves height of 18.1 metres. The playing floor measures 36 by 22 metres on double-layer hardwood, with 12.5 metres of clear height to the ceiling and 3,100 fixed seats in stepped stands, plus 1,000 movable seats, allowing capacities of 4,000 for rallies, 2,200 for stage shows and 2,400 for film screenings. Timber-and-mesh acoustic walls, a fireproof acoustic ceiling, 120-circuit thyristor dimming, computer-controlled scoreboards able to display Tibetan, Chinese and English, and a retractable west stand that opens into a 16 by 9.2 metre stage were all advanced for their time. Hot-water heating and tempered fresh air keep the hall at 16 degrees Celsius in winter. In June 2024 it hosted the Tibetan tug-of-war competition. The hall remains in use for regional tournaments, ceremonies and public events, and is a representative example of 1980s Chinese aid architecture in Lhasa. Its stage, projection room and three-language scoreboards still give it unusual flexibility for a building of its age.

address: 云南省昆明市盘龙区东风东路99号
website: https://tyj.yn.gov.cn/（云南省体育局官网；拓东体育中心为省体育局系统场馆）
area_text: 体育中心占地200余亩；体育馆建筑面积未单独公布
intro_zh: 拓东体育中心体育馆位于盘龙区东风东路99号，始建于1959年，是新中国成立十周年昆明“十大献礼建筑”之一，苏式风格，已被列为不可移动文物。主馆因设施老化于1990年代末至2000年间停用（有1997年、2000年两种说法），长期闲置后于2025年3月启动提升改造，投资8400万元，2026年4月竣工、7月向市民开放。改造坚持“修旧如旧”，完整保留苏式建筑轮廓、水磨石外立面和屋顶五角星，同时把木结构改为框架结构，增设疏散通道，满足抗震与消防要求。改造后由主馆、练习馆及附属配套用房组成，主馆可容纳3000名观众，场地可布置一片标准篮球场，既能承接小型赛事，也能做文化演艺、品牌发布和群众健身。它与一街之隔的拓东体育场组成“一场一馆”，体育场改造投资约2.5亿元，两者合计超过3.3亿元，同步补齐了昆明主城缺少高端赛事与演艺场地的短板。室外篮球场长期免费开放，体育馆开放后接受场地预订，是昆明老城更新中少见的“留建筑、换功能”样本。
intro_en: The gymnasium of Tuodong Sports Center at 99 Dongfeng East Road in Panlong District was built in 1959 as one of ten buildings presented by Kunming for the tenth anniversary of the People's Republic. It is a Soviet-style structure now listed as an immovable cultural relic. The main hall closed in the late 1990s, variously dated to 1997 or 2000, and stood idle for years before a renovation began in March 2025 with an investment of 84 million yuan. Work was completed in April 2026 and the hall reopened to the public that July. The project followed a restore-as-found approach, keeping the Soviet outline, the terrazzo facade and the five-pointed star on the roof while replacing the timber structure with a frame and adding escape routes to meet seismic and fire codes. The rebuilt complex consists of the main hall, a practice hall and support rooms; the main hall seats 3,000 and can hold one standard basketball court, suiting small competitions, stage productions, brand launches and public fitness. It forms a stadium-and-hall pair with Tuodong Stadium across the road, where renovation cost about 250 million yuan, bringing the joint programme to more than 330 million yuan and filling Kunming's gap in venues for high-level sport and entertainment. Outdoor basketball courts stay free, and the hall now takes bookings, making the project a rare case of keeping the building and changing its use in the old city. The square outside is used for morning exercise, and the hall takes bookings through the center.

address: 云南省昆明市五华区环城西路49号（体育场门牌42号、体育馆51号）
area_text: 官方未公布；第三方场馆资料记用地约4.6万平方米、建筑面积约3.0万平方米
intro_zh: 昆明市体育中心位于五华区环城西路49号，地处昆明主城核心区，主体建筑1994年建成投用，是云南省第九届运动会的主会场，次年又承办了全国少数民族传统体育运动会。中心由体育场、体育馆和综合训练馆等组成，体育场设1.6万个坐席，体育馆以羽毛球、乒乓球为主，另有多片室外球场和健身路径，是主城区使用频率最高的公共体育场馆群之一。足球在这片场地上留下了浓重一笔：1995至1996年八一足球队以此为甲A主场并夺得联赛季军，1997至1999年云南红塔队又在这里征战甲B、甲A。2024年12月，体育场启动全面提升改造，重铺国际标准复合型塑胶跑道，足球场改用天然草与人工草混合系统并配套全自动喷灌，排水能力大幅提升，灯光、高清显示屏、音响、功能房和无障碍设施同步升级，1.6万个座椅全部换新。2025年12月27日改造后首秀，昆明队在此打了9个主场保持全胜，累计超过12万人次入场，“魔鬼主场”由此得名；2026年这里承担了云南省第十七届运动会的田径比赛。场馆常年免费或低收费开放。
intro_en: Kunming Municipal Sports Center occupies a prime site at 49 Huancheng West Road in Wuhua District. Its main buildings were completed in 1994 for the 9th Yunnan Provincial Games and hosted the national traditional games of ethnic minorities the following year. The complex comprises a stadium, a gymnasium and an indoor training hall; the stadium seats 16,000, the gymnasium is used mainly for badminton and table tennis, and outdoor courts and fitness trails fill the gaps, making this one of the busiest public sports compounds in the city centre. Football history runs deep here: the Bayi team used the ground as its home in the 1995 and 1996 Jia-A seasons and finished third, and Yunnan Hongta played Jia-B and Jia-A matches here between 1997 and 1999. In December 2024 the stadium began a full upgrade, relaying an international-standard rubber track, converting the pitch to a hybrid natural and artificial turf system with automatic irrigation and much better drainage, and renewing floodlights, a large high-definition screen, sound, function rooms and accessibility facilities, along with all 16,000 seats. The first match after the works, on 27 December 2025, drew more than 13,000 spectators, and Kunming won all nine home games of the season before crowds totalling over 120,000, earning the ground its fortress reputation. In 2026 it staged the athletics programme of the 17th Yunnan Provincial Games. The venue stays free or low-cost year round, and its gymnasium hosted the badminton and dance sport events of the provincial games in May and June 2026.

address: 云南省昆明市盘龙区东风东路99号
website: https://tyj.yn.gov.cn/（云南省体育局官网；拓东体育中心为省体育局系统场馆）
area_text: 体育中心占地200余亩；体育场建筑面积未单独公布
capacity_text: 35000（维基百科）；2026年改造后为4万座以上
intro_zh: 昆明拓东体育场位于盘龙区东风东路99号，海拔1891米，1958年启用，最初只建成室内的综合比赛馆，1972年增建足球练习场，1990年经过两年重修后形成四层看台，成为中国国家足球队的固定主场之一。高原、稀薄空气和偏快的球速让对手难以适应，这里留下过2001年5比1胜印度尼西亚、2008年0比0逼平澳大利亚、2011年7比2胜老挝等比赛，1996年八一队还在此1比5负于本菲卡。场外的记忆同样密集，张学友、张惠妹、周杰伦、陈奕迅、五月天等都曾在这里开唱。因场馆老化，体育场2018年后停止举办大型活动，2025年5月动工改造，投资约2.5亿元，2026年5月7日通过竣工验收，升级为可容纳4万人以上的甲级综合性场馆，达到国际单项赛事和全国综合赛事标准。改造保留标志性大圆顶，新增25万颗可变色LED灯珠，铺设国际标准草皮与跑道，疏散通道增至26个，可满足4万人8分钟疏散，并配7间VIP包间、贵宾厅和新闻发布厅。2026年7月这里承办滇超联赛决赛，10月1日迎来焕新后的首场大型演唱会。
intro_en: Tuodong Stadium at 99 Dongfeng East Road in Panlong District sits at 1,891 metres above sea level and opened in 1958, initially with only an indoor multi-purpose hall on the site. A football practice pitch followed in 1972 and a two-year rebuild completed in 1990 produced the four-tier stands that made the ground one of the China national team's regular homes. Thin air and a quick ball have always troubled visitors, and the record includes a 5-1 win over Indonesia in 2001, a 0-0 draw with Australia in 2008 and a 7-2 win over Laos in 2011; in 1996 Bayi lost 1-5 here to Benfica. The stadium has also carried the city's concert memory, with Jacky Cheung, A-Mei, Jay Chou, Eason Chan and Mayday all performing on the pitch. After 2018 it stopped hosting major events as the fabric aged. Work began in May 2025 with an investment of about 250 million yuan and passed completion inspection on 7 May 2026, turning the ground into a Grade A complex seating more than 40,000 and meeting standards for international single-sport and national multi-sport events. The landmark dome was kept, 250,000 colour-changing LED points were added, international-standard turf and a new track were laid, escape routes were increased to 26 so that 40,000 people can leave within eight minutes, and seven VIP boxes, a reception hall and a media room were fitted. The stadium hosted the Yunnan city league final in July 2026 and its first post-renovation concert on 1 October 2026.

name_zh: 浙江师范大学（萧山校区）体育馆
address: 杭州市萧山区宁围街道萧山高教园耕文路1108号（浙江师范大学萧山校区内）
intro_zh: 浙江师范大学（萧山校区）体育馆位于杭州市萧山区宁围街道萧山高教园耕文路1108号，坐落在浙师大萧山校区西南角，是杭州第19届亚运会手球项目的比赛场馆，含主比赛馆与热身馆，距亚运村东南侧约8.4公里。场馆总建筑面积16393平方米，观众席2302座；用地面积约33668平方米，总建筑面积约1.7万平方米，其中地上1.25万平方米、地下4500平方米。建筑由浙江大学建筑设计研究院体育建筑事业部沈晓鸣团队设计，取意钱塘江水与江南丝绸，外立面以灰白色融入校园，主体用象征运动的红色，外围笼罩308缕自顶部垂落的“水幔”，形似百叶窗，既是天然遮阳层、可减少室内眩光，夜间又能投屏成像。屋顶采用张弦梁结构，室内视觉清爽并节省材料；看台经视线分析做成不对称的两面布置，保证每个座位都能看到手球场边线上方1米的位置。馆内配置高规格新风系统，顶部四周使用吸声环保材料。赛后场馆转换为综合性体育馆，交由学校用于教学与师生健身，是亚运场馆进校园、赛后回归校园的代表。校区地处萧山高教园，经耕文路、奔竞大道连接钱塘江南岸路网。
intro_en: The Zhejiang Normal University Gymnasium on the Xiaoshan campus stands at 1108 Gengwen Road in the Xiaoshan Higher Education Park, Ningwei, Hangzhou, occupying the south-western corner of the campus. It was the handball venue of the 19th Asian Games, about 8.4 km south-east of the Asian Games Village, and consists of a main competition hall plus a warm-up hall. The building has 16,393 sqm of gross floor area and 2,302 seats; the site covers about 33,668 sqm with roughly 17,000 sqm built, of which 12,500 sqm is above ground and 4,500 sqm below. Designed by the sports architecture studio of Zhejiang University's Architectural Design and Research Institute under Shen Xiaoming, the hall abstracts the Qiantang River and Jiangnan silk into 308 'water curtains' hanging from the roof to the planting below. They act as a natural brise-soleil that cuts glare and cools the interior, and at night become a projection surface. A beam-string roof keeps the hall visually clean while saving material, and the stands were made deliberately asymmetrical after sightline studies so that every seat sees a point one metre above the touchline. High-grade fresh-air systems and sound-absorbing materials around the roof perimeter support the indoor environment. After the Games the venue was converted into a multi-purpose gymnasium for teaching, campus sport and staff fitness, a clear case of an Asian Games venue returning to its university. The campus sits in the Xiaoshan Higher Education Park, linked to the Qiantang River south bank road network by Gengwen Road and Benjing Avenue. The design team chose the grey-white shell to sit quietly among the campus's pale buildings, with red kept for the volume inside the water curtains, and the screens also cut solar gain on the glazing. The hall was one of two handball venues placed on Hangzhou university campuses for the Games.

address: 杭州市富阳区银湖街道九龙大道3号
intro_zh: 富阳银湖体育中心位于杭州市富阳区银湖街道九龙大道3号，地处亚运村西南侧约40公里，是杭州第19届亚运会射击、射箭、现代五项三个大项的比赛场馆及训练场馆，也是当届12个新建场馆之一，赛时产生47枚金牌。中心用地面积275182平方米，建筑面积82360平方米，由射击综合馆（含射击比赛与现代五项击剑大循环）、新闻媒体与安保中心、4片室外飞碟靶场、射箭场和现代五项“五合一”场地组成，观众席位10531个。设计由浙江大学建筑设计研究院完成，以山水意向为蓝本：场地西、北环山，南侧临水，通过5个标高的台地呼应山地高差、减少山体开挖，二层平台把三个比赛项目高效串起，10米、25米、50米资格赛与决赛馆垂直分布。射击综合馆东侧与南侧幕墙装设约34000块旋转百叶，每块以5度为模数在15度至85度之间转动，借日光在立面上“绘”出《富春山居图》，人字屋顶与200米“江水灯带”呼应富春山水。看台为可拆装的钢结构临时看台，新闻安保中心、辅助用房与马厩大量采用可循环钢结构；赛后场地转向游泳、篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球等大众项目，向市民开放。
intro_en: Fuyang Yinhu Sports Centre stands at 3 Jiulong Avenue in Yinhu Subdistrict, Fuyang District, Hangzhou, about 40 km south-west of the Asian Games Village. It hosted shooting, archery and modern pentathlon at the 19th Asian Games, with 47 gold medals decided there, and was one of the twelve venues built from scratch for the Games. The site covers 275,182 sqm with 82,360 sqm of floor area, containing a shooting hall that also staged the modern pentathlon fencing round, a media and security centre, four outdoor skeet and trap ranges, an archery field and a five-in-one modern pentathlon venue, with 10,531 spectator seats. Zhejiang University's Architectural Design and Research Institute shaped the complex around the landscape: hills wrap the west and north, water lies to the south, and five terraced levels follow the slope so that excavation is minimised. A second-floor platform links the three sports, and the 10 m, 25 m and 50 m qualification ranges stack vertically above the finals hall. Some 34,000 rotating louvres cover the east and south facades, each turning between 15 and 85 degrees in five-degree steps, so that sunlight draws a shifting 'Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains' across the skin; pitched roofs and a 200 m river-light band continue the theme. Stands are demountable steel structures, while the media centre, support buildings and stables use recyclable steel frames. After the Games the ranges were converted for swimming, basketball, badminton and table tennis and opened to the public. Yinhu is a technology and residential district of Fuyang, and the ranges were among the first new-build sites to pass equipment acceptance, with Olympic champion Zhu Qinan firing the opening shot in a 2022 test.

address: 杭州市萧山区城厢街道市心南路398号（萧山体育中心内）
area_text: 总建筑面积10,802㎡
intro_zh: 萧山体育中心体育馆位于杭州市萧山区城厢街道市心南路398号，处在萧山区体育中心园区内，距亚运村东南方向约11.7公里，是杭州第19届亚运会举重项目的比赛场地，含比赛馆及相关赛事服务用房，总建筑面积10802平方米，观众席位1901个。萧山区体育中心是一处成组布局的区级体育设施，除体育馆外还有体育场、游泳馆、网球馆和综合馆，亚运会足球比赛在中心体育场举行，杭州第4届亚残运会的举重比赛也放在这座体育馆。场馆按亚运标准对竞赛场地、观众区域、功能房间和赛事专用系统做了提升，赛时以举重台为核心组织比赛与转播流线。亚运结束后，中心整体转入赛后运营，自2024年1月1日起进入运营期，由广州珠江体育文化发展股份有限公司（珠江文体）负责运营，体育馆与体育场、游泳馆一起向市民开放篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球、游泳、网球和健身房等项目，并继续承接举重、篮球等赛事与全民健身活动。园区位于萧山老城厢，市心南路与萧绍路一带路网成熟，地铁2号线人民广场站步行可达。
intro_en: The Xiaoshan Sports Centre Gymnasium sits at 398 Shixin South Road in Chengxiang Subdistrict, Xiaoshan District, inside the Xiaoshan Sports Centre grounds about 11.7 km south-east of the Asian Games Village. It was the weightlifting venue of the 19th Asian Games, with a competition hall and supporting event-service rooms in 10,802 sqm of floor area and 1,901 seats. The sports centre is a grouped district facility that also includes a stadium, a swimming hall, tennis courts and a multi-purpose hall; football at the Asian Games was played in the stadium next door, and weightlifting at the 4th Asian Para Games was also staged in this gymnasium. The hall was upgraded to Games standards across the field of play, spectator areas, functional rooms and event-specific systems, and the competition and broadcast flows were organised around the weightlifting platform. After the Games the whole centre moved into legacy operation, run since 1 January 2024 by Guangzhou Pearl River Sports Culture Development (Pearl River Sports). The gymnasium, stadium and swimming hall now offer basketball, badminton, table tennis, swimming, tennis and gym facilities to the public while continuing to host weightlifting, basketball and mass-fitness events. The site lies in the old town of Xiaoshan, where Shixin South Road and Xiaoshao Road form a mature street network, within walking distance of People's Square station on Metro Line 2. The centre's stadium, with about 10,000 seats, staged the football matches while the gymnasium took weightlifting, and the two venues share the same ticket concourse and warm-up areas. Weightlifting ran for several days in this hall, and the para powerlifting competition followed in the same building.

name_zh: 浙江工业大学（屏峰校区）板球场
address: 杭州市西湖区留和路288号（浙江工业大学屏峰校区内）
intro_zh: 浙江工业大学（屏峰校区）板球场位于杭州市西湖区留和路288号浙工大屏峰校区内，选址在原田径场西侧、子午潮山国家森林公园屏峰山麓，毗邻学校图书馆，南侧为古运河路、北侧为上埠河路。项目用地面积49400平方米，新建场馆总建筑面积12689平方米，地上三层，比赛场地约1.35万平方米，相当于两个标准足球场，观众席1347个，球道尺寸26.5米×12.5米，是浙江省内唯一符合国际竞赛标准的板球场，也是国内建筑面积最大的板球场。设计由浙江工业大学工程设计集团完成，灵感取自民间“红灯笼”，沿用校区经典红砖做双层“砖幕帘”，与内墙间隔1.8米，西侧立面以长短不一的铝格栅续写《富春山居图》的山形；大悬挑屋顶网架最大出挑18.7米，顺应椭圆场地弧线，俯瞰如展翅雄鹰。场馆2020年建成，2023年承办杭州亚运会板球比赛，此后举办女子T20东亚杯等国际赛事，并作为浙江省板球队与浙工大板球队的主场，场内设雨水回收处理系统，收集过滤后用于绿化浇灌，赛后与校园共用。
intro_en: The cricket ground of Zhejiang University of Technology's Pingfeng campus lies at 288 Liuhe Road in Xihu District, Hangzhou, on the western side of the old athletics field at the foot of Pingfeng Mountain in the Ziwuchao Mountain National Forest Park, next to the library, with the old canal road to the south and Shangbu River Road to the north. The 49,400 sqm site carries a 12,689 sqm building of three storeys above ground and a playing field of about 13,500 sqm, roughly the size of two football pitches, with 1,347 seats and a 26.5 by 12.5 metre pitch. It is the only cricket ground in Zhejiang that meets international competition standards and the largest by floor area in China. Zhejiang University of Technology's engineering design group took the folk red lantern as its image and wrapped the hall in a double-layer 'brick curtain' of the campus's signature red brick, held 1.8 m off the inner wall; on the west facade aluminium fins of varying length continue the mountain lines of 'Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains'. The large cantilevered roof truss reaches 18.7 m, following the oval of the field so that the building reads from above as a spreading eagle. Completed in 2020, it staged cricket at the 2023 Asian Games and later the Women's T20 East Asia Cup, and serves as home ground for the Zhejiang and ZJUT cricket teams. A rainwater harvesting system irrigates the planting, and the ground is shared with the campus after the Games. The ground sits beside the campus athletics track and the university's indoor gymnasium, forming a compact sports cluster on the northern edge of the Pingfeng campus.

address: 杭州市钱塘区东部湾总部基地（22号大街以南、之江东路以北；滑板公园位于拾里路100号）
area_text: 总建筑面积46,209㎡（轮滑馆约3.6万㎡，滑板公园约5,660㎡）
status_note: 无场馆咨询电话，仅有场地预约手机号
intro_zh: 钱塘轮滑中心位于杭州市钱塘区东部湾总部基地，处在22号大街以南、杭州绕城公路以西、之江东路以北、规划支路二以东的杭州东部湾体育公园内，距亚运村东侧约17公里，是杭州第19届亚运会轮滑、滑板项目的比赛场馆及训练场馆，由亚运轮滑馆与亚运滑板公园两部分组成，总建筑面积46209平方米，观众席位1384座。轮滑馆俯瞰如两个“6”叠加，也像一枚“旋风陀螺”，馆内设国际轮滑协会最新200米×7米标准速度轮滑赛道和50米×25米花样轮滑比赛场地，观众席环绕赛道布置，是亚洲最专业的室内轮滑场馆之一。北侧的滑板公园用地约5660平方米，分碗池与街式两块场地：碗池最深处约3米，含垂直壁、火山口、人字脊等道具；街式场地配置抛台、台阶、可升降扶手与滑杆，看台设862个座位。中心是亚洲第一个把滑板与轮滑合在一处的综合性轮滑中心，赛后长期免费或低收费向市民开放，2025年完成升级，新增4片专业网球场（含2片带防雨棚）和一片70米×90米十一人制足球场，滑板公园、网球场与足球场一并对外运营，成为钱塘区青训、赛事与潮流运动的据点。
intro_en: The Qiantang Roller Sports Centre occupies the Eastern Bay headquarters base in Qiantang District, Hangzhou, inside Eastern Bay Sports Park between 22nd Avenue to the south, the Hangzhou ring road to the west and Zhijiang East Road to the north, about 17 km east of the Asian Games Village. It was the competition and training venue for roller sports and skateboarding at the 19th Asian Games and combines two parts, an indoor roller hall and a skate park, in 46,209 sqm of floor area with 1,384 seats. Seen from above the hall reads as two interlocking figure sixes, or a spinning top; inside is a 200 by 7 metre speed-skating track built to the latest World Skate standard and a 50 by 25 metre artistic-skating floor, with seating wrapped around the track, making it one of Asia's most specialised indoor roller venues. The skate park to the north covers about 5,660 sqm and splits into a bowl and a street course: the bowl reaches roughly 3 m deep with vertical walls, a volcano and a hip, while the street section offers banks, stairs, adjustable rails and ledges, with 862 seats. It was the first complex in Asia to put skateboarding and roller sports on one site. After the Games it opened to the public on free or low-cost terms; an upgrade completed in 2025 added four tennis courts, two of them covered, and a 70 by 90 metre eleven-a-side football pitch, and the park now runs as a base for youth training, competitions and street culture in Qiantang. Inside the hall, some 1,300 small blue seats echo the curve of the blue track, and the roof and skin are shaped to suggest speed.

address: 杭州市富阳区东洲街道华墅沙村（北支江南岸）
area_text: 用地约192亩；建筑面积约6.7万㎡（地下2.2万㎡）
intro_zh: 富阳水上运动中心位于杭州市富阳区东洲街道华墅沙村、北支江南岸，与黄公望隐居地隔江相望，是杭州第19届亚运会赛艇、皮划艇（静水、激流回旋）的比赛场地，赛时产生30枚金牌。项目2019年3月开工、2021年3月完成验收，用地约192亩，建筑面积约6.7万平方米，地下1层2.2万平方米、地上6层，建筑高24米、宽40至120米、长550米。设计取意《富春山居图》，以“山”为形、以“水”为韵，弧线形体与两跨空间异斜拱桥结构让建筑如一个舒展的“H”；中庭设950平方米水景水系，屋顶覆土做成超过2万平方米的空中花园，是华东地区最大的屋顶花园之一，场馆绿化率达45%。真正的赛场是北支江：赛艇与皮划艇静水共用长2150米、宽150米的水域，设9条航道、3000个观众席；东侧激流回旋赛道长281米、宽8米、落差4.5米，由6台水泵从江中引水，布置16个顺水门与6个逆水门，设900个观众席，终点塔悬挑于江面。场馆为绿色建筑二星，赛后保留部分体育功能并改造为水上运动主题度假酒店，屋顶花园向市民开放。
intro_en: Fuyang Water Sports Centre lies at Huashusha village in Dongzhou Subdistrict, Fuyang District, Hangzhou, on the south bank of the North Branch of the Fuchun River and facing the retreat where Huang Gongwang painted 'Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains'. It staged rowing and canoe sprint plus canoe slalom at the 19th Asian Games, with 30 gold medals decided on the water. Work began in March 2019 and the venue was accepted in March 2021; the 192-mu site carries about 67,000 sqm of floor area, including 22,000 sqm underground, in a building 24 m high, 40 to 120 m wide and 550 m long, six storeys above ground. The design borrows the painting's mountains for its form and its water for the landscape, an arc-shaped volume braced by two skewed arch spans that reads as a stretched letter H, with a 950 sqm water garden in the courtyard. The roof is covered with soil to create more than 20,000 sqm of sky garden, among the largest in East China, lifting the site's green ratio to 45 per cent. Racing happens on the river itself: a 2,150 by 150 metre rowing and sprint course with nine lanes and 3,000 seats, and to the east a 281 by 8 metre slalom channel with a 4.5 m drop, fed by six pumps, holding 16 downstream and 6 upstream gates with 900 seats, watched over by a finish tower cantilevered above the water. Certified as a two-star green building, the centre keeps part of its sporting role after the Games and converts to a water-sports resort hotel, with the roof garden open to the public. Six functional zones — spectator services, venue management, media and sponsors, competition management, indoor training and athlete reception, and boat storage — are arranged along the water, and spectators reach the finish area on foot along the bank.

name_zh: 杭州奥体中心国博壁球馆
address: 杭州市萧山区钱江世纪城奔竞大道353号（杭州国际博览中心4D展厅）
intro_zh: 杭州奥体中心国博壁球馆位于杭州市萧山区钱江世纪城奔竞大道353号杭州国际博览中心内，由国博原4D展厅临时改建而成，改造面积约9504平方米，是杭州第19届亚运会壁球项目的比赛场馆，赛时产生5枚金牌。场馆位于国博30米标高层，起重、吊装与运输设备都无法直达，建设团队用5个多月工期，以BIM建模把壁板、座席等构件拆成符合电梯尺寸的模块，运进馆内再拼装，并在馆内加设三道总重240吨的钢质防火墙以满足消防规范。馆内布置8片国际赛事标准玻璃球场，包括4片单打预赛球场、3片双打球场和1片单打决赛球场，约1000个观众座席（另有997席口径）环绕赛场；球场三面为蓝色半透玻璃墙，观众可360度观赛，运动员则不受干扰，配“湖山绿”主色与蓝色座椅，被称作藏在展厅里的“水晶宫”。场馆按“无废”理念搭建，材料可回收、设备以租代买，赛后全部拆除恢复展厅功能，7片球场转给社区、学校与教育机构，1片赠予亚运博物馆。
intro_en: The Hangzhou Olympic Sports Centre Squash Hall occupies the former 4D exhibition hall of the Hangzhou International Expo Center at 353 Benjing Avenue in Qianjiang Century City, Xiaoshan District. Built as a temporary conversion of about 9,504 sqm, it hosted squash at the 19th Asian Games, where five gold medals were decided. The hall sits on the expo centre's 30-metre level, out of reach of cranes and heavy lifting equipment, so the team spent just over five months using BIM models to break panels and seating into modules sized for the lifts, carrying them in and assembling on site; three steel firewalls weighing 240 tonnes in total were added inside to meet fire codes. Eight glass courts built to international standard fill the space: four singles qualifying courts, three doubles courts and one singles final court, ringed by about 1,000 seats (997 in one count). Three sides of each court are blue translucent glass, so spectators see play from every angle while players are shielded from distraction; with the lake-and-mountain green palette and blue seating the room is nicknamed a crystal palace inside an exhibition hall. Assembled under the Games' zero-waste policy with recyclable materials and leased equipment, the hall was dismantled afterwards to restore the exhibition floor, with seven courts handed to community, school and education bodies and one given to the Asian Games Museum. The host building, with 850,000 sqm of floor area, served as the Games' main press centre and was the main venue of the 2016 G20 summit. At the time of construction the eight courts were described as the city's only glass courts built to international competition standard.

name_zh: 临安文化体育会展中心
address: 杭州市临安区锦南新城九州街599号
area_text: 总建筑面积34,060㎡
intro_zh: 临安文化体育会展中心（又称临安体育文化会展中心）位于杭州市临安区锦南新城九州街599号，处在锦南新城核心区域，距亚运村西南约64公里，是杭州第19届亚运会跆拳道、摔跤项目的比赛场馆，总建筑面积34060平方米，观众席位3728座。场馆按“两馆一场”布局，2014年建成投用，亚运改造秉承节俭原则，以外墙清洗和内部提升为主，新建一座热身馆，并对竞赛场地、观众区域设施、赛事功能房间、赛事专用系统等7个方面85项指标做提升；原有地板被完整保留，仅以防护膜与防护网保护，节省数百万元。馆内采用光导管无电照明系统，通过屋顶采光罩采集自然光并经导光管漫射入场，照明能耗至少降低80%，同时配置楼宇自动化、能耗采集与集成运维系统。场馆此前是浙江卫视《梦想的声音》《来吧！冠军》等节目录制地，也办过理查德·克莱德曼音乐会。地铁16号线九州街站出站即到；亚运后体育馆、综合馆与游泳馆转入全民健身开放，提供羽毛球、游泳、篮球等项目。
intro_en: The Lin'an Sports Culture and Exhibition Centre, also written Lin'an Culture and Sports Exhibition Centre, stands at 599 Jiuzhou Street in the Jinnan New Town of Lin'an District, Hangzhou, about 64 km south-west of the Asian Games Village. It hosted taekwondo and wrestling at the 19th Asian Games with 34,060 sqm of floor area and 3,728 seats, arranged as two halls and one outdoor ground. Completed and opened in 2014, it was upgraded for the Games on a frugal basis: the facades were only cleaned, works concentrated on the interior, a warm-up hall was added, and 85 indicators across seven areas — field of play, spectator facilities, functional rooms and event systems — were brought up to standard, while the existing timber floor was kept intact under protective film and netting, saving several million yuan. Light pipes provide daylight without electricity, collecting sun on the roof and diffusing it through tubes into the hall to cut lighting energy by at least 80 per cent, backed by building automation, energy monitoring and integrated maintenance systems. Before the Games the venue hosted television shows such as 'The Sound of Dreams' and 'Come On, Champion' and a Richard Clayderman concert. Jiuzhou Street station on Metro Line 16 is at the door. After the Games the gymnasium, multi-purpose hall and swimming hall moved into public fitness use, offering badminton, swimming and basketball. Besides the competition gymnasium, the complex includes a multi-purpose hall and a swimming hall that stay open for public bookings, and an outdoor ground used for athletics and football. The exterior is clad in perforated aluminium panels, which were cleaned rather than replaced during the upgrade.

address: 杭州市拱墅区申花单元（东至学院北路、西至丰潭路、南至申花路、北至留祥路）
area_text: 占地701亩（约46.7万㎡）；总建筑面积约18.5万㎡
intro_zh: 拱墅运河体育公园又称运河亚运公园，位于杭州市拱墅区申花单元，东至学院北路、西至丰潭路、南至申花路、北至留祥路，占地701亩，总建筑面积约18.5万平方米，是杭州第19届亚运会乒乓球、霹雳舞、曲棍球三个项目的比赛场地，也是杭州主城区唯一新建的亚运场馆群、浙江省首座把体育馆、公园、运动场与商业配套合在一处的城市体育公园。园区由“一场一馆一广场两中心”组成，按“南馆北场”布置：南侧体育馆取意良渚玉琮，建筑面积约2.2万平方米、座位6852个、总投资约4.97亿元，赛时办乒乓球与霹雳舞，赛后的热身馆转为全民健身中心；北侧体育场形似江南油纸伞，人称“杭州伞”，承担曲棍球比赛。园内还有1609米长的景观主轴、约4公里环形跑道与3.6公里花神跑道、1.4万平方米全民健身中心、三叶湖、申花广场、儿童乐园与约1.4万平方米商业街区，保留北庄河、永兴河原有走向，种植水松、银缕梅等4000余株乔木。地块原为城中村“花园岗”，2019年初动工，2021年6月主体验收、12月开放，由荷兰Archi-Tectonics事务所参与规划；亚运期间同时承接亚残运会乒乓球与盲人足球，赛时高峰日接待游人约5万人次，项目获中国建设工程鲁班奖。
intro_en: Gongshu Canal Sports Park, also called the Canal Asian Games Park, occupies the Shenhua block of Gongshu District, Hangzhou, bounded by Xueyuan North Road to the east, Fengtan Road to the west, Shenhua Road to the south and Liuxiang Road to the north. Covering 701 mu (about 467,000 sqm) with some 185,000 sqm of floor area, it staged table tennis, breaking and hockey at the 19th Asian Games and is the only newly built Asian Games venue cluster in the city's central districts, as well as Zhejiang's first urban sports park to combine a gymnasium, parkland, playing fields and commercial space. The layout follows a south hall and north field pattern. The gymnasium to the south takes the form of a Liangzhu jade cong, with about 22,000 sqm of floor area, 6,852 seats and a cost of roughly 497 million yuan; it hosted table tennis and breaking, and its warm-up hall has become a public fitness centre. The stadium to the north, shaped like an oil-paper umbrella and nicknamed the Hangzhou Umbrella, held the hockey. Between them run a 1,609 m landscaped spine, a four-kilometre loop track and a 3.6 km flower-god route, a 14,000 sqm fitness centre, Sanye Lake, Shenhua Plaza, a children's playground and about 14,000 sqm of shops; the original Beizhuang and Yongxing rivers keep their courses, and more than 4,000 trees, including rare Glyptostrobus and Sinowilsonia, fill the grounds. The site was the Huayuangang urban village until work began in early 2019; the main structure passed inspection in June 2021 and the park opened that December, with Dutch practice Archi-Tectonics among the planners. During the Games it also hosted table tennis and blind football at the Asian Para Games, drawing up to 50,000 visitors a day at peak, and the project won a Luban Prize.

name_zh: 拱墅运河体育公园体育场
address: 杭州市拱墅区申花单元拱墅运河体育公园北区（丰潭路以东、申花路以北）
area_text: 建筑面积约1.3万㎡
intro_zh: 拱墅运河体育公园体育场位于公园北区，是杭州第19届亚运会曲棍球比赛、杭州第4届亚残运会盲人足球比赛的场地，因屋面形似江南油纸伞而被称为“杭州伞”。体育场建筑面积约1.3万平方米，共设约5000个座位，总投资约3.39亿元。主体是一个轻巧的大跨度屋盖，顶面最大跨度约120米，结构采用三角管桁架体系，屋面覆盖PTFE膜材，兼具轻便、高透光、自洁与独特光学性能；球场四周定制安装专项照明灯柱，配不同角度的遮光与反射系统，把光线控制在场地内，减少对周边住宅的溢散光。场馆与南侧“玉琮”造型的体育馆一南一北遥相呼应，构成公园“南馆北场”的格局。2023年10月6日，国际曲棍球发展训练基地在此授牌，国际曲棍球联合会主席Tayyab Ikram出席，认为场馆硬件、观赛氛围与赛会组织令人印象深刻；2023年亚运会中国女曲在此夺金，2025年9月这里又承办女子曲棍球亚洲杯决赛，冠军直接获得2026年女曲世界杯参赛资格，赛事以低票价向市民开放。
intro_en: The stadium of Gongshu Canal Sports Park stands in the northern half of the park in the Shenhua block of Gongshu District, Hangzhou, east of Fengtan Road and north of Shenhua Road. It hosted hockey at the 19th Asian Games and blind football at the 4th Asian Para Games, and is nicknamed the Hangzhou Umbrella after the oil-paper umbrella shape of its roof. The building has about 13,000 sqm of floor area, roughly 5,000 seats and a cost of some 339 million yuan. Its main body is a light, long-span roof reaching about 120 m at its widest, carried on a triangular tubular truss system and covered in PTFE membrane that is light, highly translucent, self-cleaning and optically distinctive. Purpose-made lighting masts stand at the corners of the pitch, with shielding and reflection systems set at different angles so that light stays on the field and spills less into neighbouring housing. The stadium faces the jade-cong gymnasium across the park, forming the south hall, north field arrangement. On 6 October 2023 the International Hockey Federation designated the ground an international hockey development and training base, with FIH president Tayyab Ikram attending and praising the facilities, the crowd and the organisation. China's women won hockey gold here at the 2023 Asian Games, and in September 2025 the ground hosted the women's Hockey Asia Cup final, whose winner qualified for the 2026 World Cup, with tickets kept cheap for local spectators. The stands sit under the membrane roof, and a 14,000 sqm public fitness centre beside the ground takes bookings for hockey, football, basketball and table tennis.

address: 杭州市拱墅区体育场路169号
area_text: 占地约9万㎡
intro_zh: 杭州体育场位于杭州市拱墅区体育场路169号，处在武林商圈核心，是杭州近代体育的发源地，也是市中心唯一保留至今的大型室外综合性田径场。场地原为清代至民国的军营“大营盘”，1928年浙江获得第四届全国运动会承办权，在体育教育家舒鸿主持下改建为公共运动场，1930年2月竣工定名大营盘体育场，同年4月1日第四届全国运动会在此举行，是杭州首次承办全国性综合赛事；赛后更名浙江省立体育场，1931年场馆门前道路正式定名体育场路并沿用至今。2002年黄龙体育中心建成后，场馆管理权由浙江省移交杭州市，定名杭州体育场，此后长期免费向公众开放。体育场占地约9万平方米，场内是标准400米环形塑胶跑道与中心天然草坪足球场，四周为露天阶梯看台，可容纳万余人，配夜间照明，日常供市民跑步、健身与球类活动，也曾是市区学校、企业运动会的常用场地。因达到设计使用年限、设施老化，体育场自2025年12月14日晚起封闭改造，按“最小干预、最低成本、最少投资”保留主体结构并加固修缮，全面更新看台座椅、田径场与足球场、照明、扩声、安保和显示屏系统，预计2027年年底重新开放；贴邻的中国丝绸城70余间商铺已先行搬迁过渡。
intro_en: Hangzhou Stadium stands at 169 Tiyuchang Road in Gongshu District, at the heart of the Wulin commercial district, and is the birthplace of modern sport in the city as well as its last surviving large outdoor athletics ground in the centre. The site was the Dayingpan military parade ground from the Qing dynasty into the republic; in 1928, when Zhejiang won the right to stage the 4th National Games, the sports educator Shu Hong led its conversion into a public sports field. It was completed in February 1930 as Dayingpan Stadium and on 1 April 1930 hosted the 4th National Games, the first national multi-sport event held in Hangzhou. Renamed the Zhejiang Provincial Stadium afterwards, it gave its name to Tiyuchang Road, formally titled in 1931 and still so called. When the Huanglong Sports Centre opened in 2002, management passed from the province to the city and the ground took its present name, remaining free and open to the public. The 90,000 sqm site holds a standard 400 m synthetic track around a natural-turf football pitch, with open stepped stands for more than 10,000 people and floodlighting; residents use it daily for running, fitness and ball games, and schools and companies have long held their sports days here. Because it has reached the end of its design life, the stadium closed on the evening of 14 December 2025 for renovation on a minimum-intervention, lowest-cost basis: the main structure is retained and strengthened while seating, track and pitch, lighting, sound, security and scoreboards are all renewed. It is due to reopen at the end of 2027, and some seventy shops of the adjacent China Silk City have already moved out.

address: 杭州市余杭区闲林街道（东至创景路、南至规划云湖北路、西至规划河道、北至文二西路）
area_text: 总用地约26.1万㎡；总建筑面积53.4万㎡
intro_zh: 杭州国际体育中心（余杭国际体育中心）位于杭州市余杭区闲林街道，东至创景路、南至规划云湖北路、西至规划河道、北至文二西路，处在未来科技城核心区与杭州城市新中心中轴线上，是浙江省“千项万亿”重大项目和杭州“后亚运”时代新建的旗舰体育设施。项目总用地约26.1万平方米（395.85亩），总建筑面积53.4万平方米，总投资概算95.8亿元，其中工程费约71亿元，规划“一场两馆”：6万座专业足球场、1.8万座综合体育馆和3000座游泳跳水馆。专业足球场呈碗形，总建筑面积约30万平方米，高61米，南北跨度超300米、东西跨度约270米，顶部以轻盈的索膜屋盖横跨近200米，设计汲取良渚玉璧与径山茶田的意象，由英国的扎哈·哈迪德建筑事务所担纲。足球场2023年10月开工，综合体育馆与游泳跳水馆2024年2月开工，2026年1月“一场两馆”屋面钢结构全面合龙，计划2027年完工。场馆设赛事与演艺两种模式，可办足球、篮球、羽毛球、网球、跳水、游泳比赛以及演唱会、跨年晚会和电竞活动；2万平方米中心大平台串联三馆与全民健身空间，1.5公里平台跑道、室外慢跑道、滨水步道、童玩区和五人制足球场向市民开放。
intro_en: The Hangzhou International Sports Centre, also called the Yuhang International Sports Centre, lies in Xianlin Subdistrict of Yuhang District, Hangzhou, bounded by Chuangjing Road to the east, the planned Yunhu North Road to the south, a planned canal to the west and Wen'er West Road to the north. It sits in the core of Future Sci-Tech City on the central axis of the city's new centre, and is a provincial 'thousand projects, trillion investment' scheme and Hangzhou's flagship post-Asian Games sports build. The 261,000 sqm site (395.85 mu) carries 534,000 sqm of floor area at a budget of 9.58 billion yuan, about 7.1 billion of it construction, laid out as one field and two halls: a 60,000-seat football stadium, an 18,000-seat multi-purpose arena and a 3,000-seat diving and swimming hall. The football ground is a bowl of some 300,000 sqm, 61 m high, more than 300 m north to south and about 270 m east to west, roofed by a light cable-and-membrane structure spanning nearly 200 m, its form drawn from Liangzhu jade discs and the tea terraces of Jingshan; Zaha Hadid Architects of London designed it. The stadium broke ground in October 2023, the two halls followed in February 2024, the roof steelwork of all three was joined up in January 2026, and completion is scheduled for 2027. The venue runs in competition and performance modes, hosting football, basketball, badminton, tennis, diving and swimming as well as concerts, New Year galas and esports; a 20,000 sqm central deck links the halls with public fitness space, and a 1.5 km elevated track, outdoor running paths, waterside walks, a children's zone and five-a-side pitches open to residents.

address: 杭州市萧山区博奥路2657号（杭州奥体博览城内）
intro_zh: 杭州奥体中心游泳馆位于杭州市萧山区博奥路2657号、钱塘江南岸的杭州奥体博览城内，与相邻的杭州奥体中心体育馆采用“双馆合一”设计，合称“化蝶”双馆：两馆共用流线形体量与双层全覆盖银白色金属屋面，两翼张开的平台形式如蝴蝶展翅，靠钱塘江一侧的“翅膀”即游泳馆。游泳馆总建筑面积53959平方米，建筑总高35米，其中地上43965平方米、地下11146平方米，总座席6484座，全部为固定看台座椅。馆内设50米×25米×3米比赛池与25米×25米×6米跳水池，配标准跳台跳水设施，杭州第19届亚运会的游泳、跳水和花样游泳比赛以及亚残运会游泳比赛在此举行，是当届产生金牌最多的场馆之一。水处理采用独立系统，核心设备烛式硅藻土过滤器过滤精度可达1至2微米，既能滤除悬浮物，也能滤除常规消毒难以杀灭的寄生虫；循环水泵采用变频工艺，可按需调节处理速度，节能15%以上。场馆2021年4月与主体育馆、综合训练馆一同通过竣工验收，亚运后以“奥体AT中心”名义向公众开放游泳、培训与健身项目。
intro_en: The Hangzhou Olympic Sports Centre Aquatics Centre stands at 2657 Bo'ao Road in Xiaoshan District, inside the Olympic Sports Expo City on the south bank of the Qiantang River. It is built as one structure with the neighbouring gymnasium, the pair known as the Butterfly: the two halls share a streamlined volume and a double-layer, fully clad silver-white metal roof, with platforms spreading like wings, and the wing nearest the river is the aquatics hall. The building has 53,959 sqm of floor area and rises 35 m, with 43,965 sqm above ground and 11,146 sqm below, and 6,484 seats, all fixed. Inside are a 50 by 25 m pool, 3 m deep, and a 25 by 25 m diving pool 6 m deep with standard diving platforms. Swimming, diving and artistic swimming at the 19th Asian Games were held here, along with swimming at the Asian Para Games, making it one of the venues that awarded the most gold medals. A dedicated water-treatment system uses candle-type diatomaceous-earth filters that screen particles down to one or two microns, catching not only suspended solids but parasites that ordinary disinfection struggles to kill, while variable-frequency circulation pumps adjust throughput to demand and save more than 15 per cent of energy. The hall passed completion inspection in April 2021 together with the main gymnasium and the training hall, and since the Games it has opened to the public as the Olympic Sports AT Centre for swimming, coaching and fitness. Seating runs along both sides of the pool, and the functional rooms include VIP lounges and a press conference hall.

address: 杭州市滨江区、萧山区交界七甲河两侧（博奥路沿线）
area_text: 总面积5.8平方公里；核心区154.37公顷，核心区总建筑面积272万㎡
capacity_text: 主体育场80,000席；体育馆18,000席；游泳馆6,484席；网球中心10,000席
intro_zh: 杭州奥体博览城位于杭州市钱塘江南岸，以七甲河为界跨越滨江区与萧山区，与钱塘江北岸的钱江新城隔江相望，是以体育、博览为特色，集文化、商贸、旅游、居住、演艺、休闲、购物于一体的大型城市综合体，由杭州奥体中心、杭州国际博览中心、杭州世纪中心三部分组成。项目2006年谋划、2007年正式启动、2009年9月开工，总面积5.8平方公里，其中核心区154.37公顷、总建筑面积272万平方米，总投资271.8亿元，含主体育场、体育游泳馆、国际博览中心、综合训练馆、七甲船闸改建、七甲河整治（含跨河桥梁）、观澜路、沿江配套设施及车库、滨盛路下穿隧道、杭州之门双塔以及地铁奥体中心站、博览中心站上盖物业共12个项目。七甲河左岸的滨江区一侧布局主体育场“大莲花”、网球中心“小莲花”与奥体中心站上盖3幢高楼；右岸的萧山区一侧布局体育游泳馆“化蝶”、杭州国际博览中心、综合训练馆“玉琮”与“城市之门”双塔。这里是杭州第19届亚运会的主会场，开闭幕式与田径比赛在大莲花举行，国博曾作为2016年G20杭州峰会主会场和亚运主媒体中心。地铁6号线、7号线奥体中心站与6号线博览中心站直达，场馆群沿江步道与钱江世纪公园相连。
intro_en: Hangzhou Olympic Sports Expo City lies on the south bank of the Qiantang River, straddling the boundary between Binjiang and Xiaoshan districts along the Qijia River and facing Qianjiang New City across the water. It is a large urban complex built around sport and exhibitions that also carries culture, commerce, tourism, housing, performance, leisure and shopping, made up of three parts: the Hangzhou Olympic Sports Centre, the Hangzhou International Expo Center and the Hangzhou Century Centre. Planned in 2006, launched in 2007 and begun in September 2009, it covers 5.8 sq km, of which the 154.37-hectare core holds 2.72 million sqm of floor area at a total investment of 27.18 billion yuan. Twelve projects make up that core: the main stadium, the aquatic and gymnasium halls, the expo centre, the training hall, the rebuilt Qijia lock, the Qijia River improvement with its bridges, Guanlan Road, riverside facilities and car parks, the Binsheng Road underpass, the twin towers of Hangzhou Gate, and the developments above Aoti Centre and Expo Centre metro stations. On the Binjiang bank stand the Big Lotus stadium, the Little Lotus tennis centre and three towers above Aoti Centre station; on the Xiaoshan bank are the Butterfly aquatic and gymnasium halls, the expo centre, the jade-cong training hall and the City Gate towers. The site was the main stage of the 19th Asian Games, with opening and closing ceremonies and athletics in the stadium, while the expo centre served as the main venue of the 2016 G20 summit and the Games' main press centre. Metro lines 6 and 7 stop at Aoti Centre and line 6 at Expo Centre, and riverside walks link the venues to Qianjiang Century Park.

name_zh: 杭州奥林匹克体育中心
address: 杭州市滨江区飞虹路3号（杭州奥体博览城内）
area_text: 主体育场用地8.23万㎡、总建筑面积约21.6万㎡；综合训练馆18.45万㎡
capacity_text: 主体育场约80,000席；体育馆18,000席；游泳馆6,484席；网球中心10,000余席
intro_zh: 杭州奥林匹克体育中心（杭州奥体中心）位于杭州市滨江区飞虹路3号、钱塘江南岸的杭州奥体博览城内，由主体育场“大莲花”、体育馆与游泳馆“化蝶”、网球中心“小莲花”和综合训练馆“玉琮”组成，是国内规模最大的系列体育场馆群之一，杭州第19届亚运会开幕式、闭幕式与田径比赛均在此举行。主体育场俗称“大莲花”，用地面积8.23万平方米，总建筑面积约21.6万平方米，座席约8万个，规模居全国第三；屋顶由28片大花瓣与27片小花瓣构成，总用钢量2.6万吨，造型取意杭州丝绸纹理与编织体系，体态源于钱塘江水，半透明花瓣交错排列使这座“钢莲花”显得轻盈通透。网球中心“小莲花”设1万余席，24片固定花瓣围出“含苞待放”的形态，穹顶8片花瓣可像镜头光圈一样在约15分钟内旋转开合。综合训练馆高近百米，总建筑面积18.45万平方米，亚运期间承担篮球、排球、手球、击剑、跆拳道训练。主体育场2009年12月奠基、2019年竣工投用，2019年8月10日以王力宏世界巡回演唱会完成首秀，2021年7月举办“韵味杭州”田径邀请赛；亚运后场馆转入赛事与演艺并行的运营，演唱会、田径赛与公众健身同步开放。
intro_en: The Hangzhou Olympic Sports Centre stands at 3 Feihong Road in Binjiang District, inside the Olympic Sports Expo City on the south bank of the Qiantang River. It comprises the Big Lotus stadium, the Butterfly gymnasium and aquatics hall, the Little Lotus tennis centre and the jade-cong training hall, one of the largest clusters of sports venues in China, and hosted the opening and closing ceremonies and the athletics of the 19th Asian Games. The main stadium, known as the Big Lotus, occupies 82,300 sqm of land with about 216,000 sqm of floor area and roughly 80,000 seats, the third largest in the country. Its roof is formed of 28 large and 27 small petals using 26,000 tonnes of steel; the form draws on Hangzhou's silk weave and the motion of the Qiantang River, and the translucent petals overlap so that the steel lotus reads as light and porous. The Little Lotus tennis centre seats more than 10,000, with 24 fixed petals holding the bud shape and eight roof petals that rotate open and shut like a camera iris in about fifteen minutes. The training hall rises nearly 100 m with 184,500 sqm of floor area and served during the Games as a training base for basketball, volleyball, handball, fencing and taekwondo. The stadium's first pile was driven in December 2009 and it opened in 2019, making its debut on 10 August 2019 with a Wang Leehom world tour concert, followed by the 2021 Hangzhou athletics invitational that July. Since the Games the centre has run competitions, concerts and public fitness in parallel. Seating in the stadium is split into three tiers, and the northern side of the bowl is left open.

address: 杭州市临平区南苑街道东湖南路177号
area_text: 17,283㎡（体育场建筑面积；场馆群总建筑面积94,934㎡）
intro_zh: 临平体育中心体育场位于杭州市临平区南苑街道东湖南路177号，是临平体育中心场馆群中的室外主场地，与体育馆、游泳馆、综合训练馆、风雨操场以连廊平台串成一体。场馆始建于1997年，2018年立项改造、2019年进场施工，2021年9月5日以改扩建后的面貌重新启用，是浙江省首批通过亚运赛事功能综合验收的场馆之一。体育场为甲级体育场，占地约22050平方米，建筑面积17283平方米，设400米标准环形跑道和10200个观众席位，草坪采用95%天然草与5%人工草混合的锚固草系统，跑道为盟多预制型面层，看台在保留东看台的基础上改建西看台并新增柱列与屋面。杭州亚运会期间，这里承办足球项目比赛，整个临平体育中心场馆群共进行301场比赛、产生15枚金牌。赛后场馆坚持“还馆于民”，跑道全年6:00至22:00开放，体育场自2025赛季起成为中乙球队杭州临平吴越的主场，并承接女超联赛、亚足联U-20亚洲杯等赛事。咨询电话未在本库列出。
intro_en: Linping Sports Center Stadium stands at 177 Donghu South Road in Nanyuan Subdistrict, Linping District, Hangzhou, and serves as the outdoor main ground of the Linping Sports Center complex, whose stadium, indoor arena, swimming hall, training hall and covered sports field are linked by elevated corridors. The stadium dates from 1997. A rebuilding programme was approved in 2018, construction started in 2019 and the renovated venue reopened on 5 September 2021 as one of the first Asian Games venues in Zhejiang to pass the organisers' comprehensive functional inspection. It is a Class A stadium covering about 22,050 square metres of land with 17,283 square metres of floor area, a 400-metre standard running track and 10,200 spectator seats. The pitch uses an anchored hybrid turf of 95 per cent natural grass and 5 per cent synthetic fibre, while the track is a Mondotrack prefabricated surface. The east stand was retained and the west stand rebuilt with new columns and a new roof. During the Asian Games the stadium hosted football matches; across the whole Linping complex 301 matches were played and 15 gold medals decided. After the Games the venue adopted a public-first policy: the track is free from 06:00 to 22:00 all year and the stadium is reported to have served more than 700,000 visits in 2024. From the 2025 season it became the home ground of China League Two club Hangzhou Linping Wuyue, and it has also staged Women's Super League fixtures. The stadium sits about 1.3 kilometres from Linping station on metro line 9 and is scheduled to be one of the grounds for the AFC U-20 Asian Cup in 2027.

name_zh: 杭州奥体中心网球中心
address: 杭州市滨江区滨盛路8号
area_text: 52,300㎡（网球中心总建筑面积；决赛馆27,400㎡）
intro_zh: 杭州奥体中心网球中心俗称“小莲花”，位于杭州市滨江区滨盛路8号，地处钱塘江南岸的奥体博览城东南侧，与主体育场“大莲花”相邻。网球中心总建筑面积5.23万平方米，用地面积3.05万平方米，由一座赛时设座10177个的决赛馆、两片2000座半决赛场、八片预赛场、八片练习场和一座室内网球馆组成，总席数约1.56万座。决赛馆“小莲花”建筑面积2.74万平方米，建筑高度37.956米，直径135米，下半部由24片固定花瓣围合，上半部8片各重约160吨的花瓣可同步旋转开合，是国内首创的旋转开闭屋顶；2020年获国际网联二星认证，并获中国钢结构金奖。场馆2017年奠基、2021年竣工，杭州亚运会期间承办网球、软式网球比赛，亚残运会期间承办轮椅网球比赛。赛后于2022年7月1日起惠民开放，2024年7月起取消预约、每日6:00至22:00开放，并成为杭州网球公开赛（ATP）的举办场地。8片活动花瓣在约40米高空同步开合，可依天气快速切换室内外比赛条件。预订及服务咨询电话未在本库列出。
intro_en: Nicknamed the Little Lotus, the Hangzhou Olympic Sports Centre Tennis Centre occupies 8 Binsheng Road in Binjiang District, on the south bank of the Qiantang River at the south-eastern edge of the Olympic Sports Expo City, next to the main stadium known as the Big Lotus. The centre has 52,300 square metres of building area on a 30,500 square metre site. It comprises a 10,000-seat covered final court, two 2,000-seat semifinal courts, eight match courts, eight practice courts and an indoor tennis hall, for a total of roughly 15,600 seats. The final court alone accounts for 27,400 square metres, rises 37.956 metres and spans 135 metres in diameter. Twenty-four fixed petals form its lower shell, while eight upper petals of about 160 tonnes each rotate and close in unison some 40 metres above the court, producing a retractable roof described as the first of its kind in China and allowing play to continue through rain or strong sun. The venue earned two-star certification from the International Tennis Federation in 2020 and a national steel structure award, and its structural work later contributed to a national science and technology progress award. Ground was broken in 2017 and the centre was completed in 2021. It hosted tennis and soft tennis during the Asian Games and wheelchair tennis during the Asian Para Games. Public access began on 1 July 2022; since July 2024 booking has no longer been required and the courts open daily from 06:00 to 22:00. The centre now stages the Hangzhou Open on the ATP Tour and has also been used for concerts and exhibitions.

address: 杭州市萧山区城厢街道市心南路398号
area_text: 34,542㎡（体育场建筑面积）
intro_zh: 萧山体育中心体育场位于杭州市萧山区城厢街道市心南路398号，是萧山体育中心的核心室外场地，与体育馆、游泳馆、综合健身馆共同构成区级综合性场馆群。体育中心始建于1989年，长期是萧山唯一的体育场馆和大型演艺活动承办地。2019年起，作为杭州首批33个亚运场馆及设施项目之一，体育中心启动整体改造提升，总投资约4.28亿元，内容包括体育场改造、体育馆改造、新建地下停车场和整体景观提升。改造后体育场建筑面积34542平方米，设10118个观众席位，看台加设一体化镂空顶棚，兼顾遮阳、通风与建筑形象，草坪、灯光和竞赛用房均按足球赛事标准重做。杭州亚运会期间，这里承办足球项目比赛。赛后场馆由杭州市萧山区文化旅游体育发展服务中心运营，体育场、体育馆、游泳馆和综合健身馆分时段向市民免费或低收费开放，是萧山城区跑步、篮球、羽毛球、游泳的主要去处。场馆咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Xiaoshan Sports Center Stadium stands at 398 Shixin South Road in Chengxiang Subdistrict, Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou, and is the principal outdoor ground of the Xiaoshan Sports Center, a district-level complex that also includes an indoor arena, a swimming hall and a fitness building. The centre opened in 1989 and for years was the only sports venue and large-performance site in Xiaoshan. In 2019 it became one of the first 33 Asian Games venue projects in Hangzhou and began a comprehensive upgrade worth about 428 million yuan, covering the stadium, the indoor arena, a new underground car park and a full redesign of the landscape. The rebuilt stadium has 34,542 square metres of floor area and 10,118 spectator seats. Its stands were given an integrated perforated canopy that provides shade and ventilation while giving the building a clearer identity, and the pitch, floodlighting and competition rooms were rebuilt to football standards. The neighbouring arena, with 10,802 square metres and 1,901 seats, was remodelled around a Qiantang tide motif and hosted weightlifting during the Games. The stadium itself hosted football. It is now operated by the Xiaoshan District Culture, Tourism and Sports Development Service Centre, and the stadium, arena, swimming hall and fitness building open to residents on free or low-cost schedules at different times of day. The complex lies about 500 metres from Panshui metro station. For three decades the centre was Xiaoshan's main stage for sports events and large gatherings, including concerts and ceremonies, and the Asian Games football tournament used the stadium as one of several grounds across the city.

name_zh: 杭州师范大学（仓前校区）体育馆
address: 杭州市余杭区余杭塘路2318号（杭州师范大学仓前校区内）
area_text: 43,938㎡（体育馆总建筑面积）
intro_zh: 杭州师范大学（仓前校区）体育馆位于杭州市余杭区余杭塘路2318号杭州师范大学仓前校区内，是杭州亚运会排球项目比赛场馆及训练场馆，含主比赛馆与热身馆。场馆属续建改造项目，2020年7月开工、2021年3月完工，总建筑面积43938平方米，亚运会期间设观众席位8033个，亚组委公布的常规观众席位数则为7105个。建筑由同济大学建筑设计院郑时龄院士团队领衔设计，取江南民居院落意象，以白墙黑瓦、层叠屋顶和自由形体延续仓前校区整体的“书院”基调，并坚持使用普通材料、控制造价，比新建同类场馆节省上亿元。馆内以排球比赛场地为核心，配套热身馆、新闻发布厅、竞赛技术用房、电视转播和兴奋剂检查等功能空间。亚运会后由学校管理运营，以承办体育赛事和开展全民健身为主、承接文旅活动为辅，已举办亚洲U16女子排球锦标赛、浙港女排友谊赛、浙江省青少年快乐气排球大赛等，并分批向市民低收费开放。校区场馆管理单位的咨询与预约请走其公开渠道。
intro_en: The Hangzhou Normal University Cangqian Campus Gymnasium stands inside the university's Cangqian campus at 2318 Yuhangtang Road in Yuhang District, Hangzhou. It served as the volleyball competition and training venue for the Asian Games and consists of a main competition hall and a warm-up hall. The project was a continuation and refurbishment rather than a new build: work began in July 2020 and was completed in March 2021, producing 43,938 square metres of floor area. Seating during the Games was 8,033, while the organising committee's standard spectator capacity figure is 7,105. The building was designed by a team led by academician Zheng Shiling of the Tongji University Architectural Design Institute. It borrows the language of Jiangnan courtyard houses — white walls, dark roofs, layered eaves and freely composed volumes — to continue the campus-wide shuyuan, or academy, theme, and it deliberately uses ordinary materials to keep costs down, saving more than 100 million yuan compared with an equivalent new building. Inside, the volleyball court is the centrepiece, supported by a warm-up hall, news conference room, competition technical rooms, broadcast space and doping control. Since the Games the university has run the hall, giving priority to sports events and public fitness and secondary priority to cultural and tourism activities. It has hosted the Asian U16 Women's Volleyball Championship, a Zhejiang-Hong Kong women's friendly and provincial youth events, and opens to residents on low-cost schedules in phases. The campus has its own metro station, Hangzhou Normal University Cangqian, about 130 metres from the main gate, and the gymnasium sits roughly 22 kilometres north-west of the Asian Games village.

name_zh: 拱墅运河体育公园体育馆
address: 杭州市拱墅区丰潭路888号
area_text: 58,395㎡（体育馆总建筑面积）
intro_zh: 拱墅运河体育公园体育馆位于杭州市拱墅区丰潭路888号，是拱墅运河体育公园“南馆北场”布局中的南侧体育馆，与北侧形似油纸伞的体育场（曲棍球场）南北相望。体育馆为杭州亚运会乒乓球、霹雳舞项目比赛场馆及训练场馆，含比赛馆和热身馆，热身馆设在副馆，通过地下通道与主馆相连。场馆总建筑面积58395平方米，亚运会期间设观众席位6852个，亚组委公布的观众席位数则为6928个。建筑造型取意良渚文化玉琮，外立面结合丝绸的光泽与平滑，形成轻盈、经典而有标志性的形体；比赛馆按乒乓球顶级赛事标准布置场地、灯光与转播条件，赛后可快速转换用途。整个公园占地701亩，总建筑面积约18.5万平方米，其中地上4.7万平方米、地下13.8万平方米，是杭州主城区最大的新建亚运场馆群，也是浙江省首座集体育馆、公园、运动场、商业配套于一体的城市体育公园。赛后体育馆转型为全民健身中心，提供泳池、篮球场、羽毛球场等公共体育空间。咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: The Gongshu Canal Sports Park Gymnasium stands at 888 Fengtan Road in Gongshu District, Hangzhou. It is the southern indoor hall of the Canal Sports Park, whose layout places the gymnasium in the south and the stadium in the north, the latter shaped like an oil-paper umbrella and used for hockey. The gymnasium served as the table tennis and breaking competition and training venue for the Asian Games. It contains a competition hall and a warm-up hall, the latter in the annexe and connected to the main building by an underground passage. Total floor area is 58,395 square metres, with 6,852 seats during the Games against an organising committee figure of 6,928. The form takes its cue from the jade cong of Liangzhu culture, while the facade borrows the sheen and smoothness of silk to create a light, classical and highly recognisable volume. The competition hall was fitted out to top-level table tennis standards in terms of field of play, lighting and broadcast conditions, and can be converted quickly for other uses. The wider park covers 701 mu, or about 47 hectares, with roughly 185,000 square metres of building area, of which 47,000 square metres are above ground and 138,000 below. It is the largest new Asian Games venue cluster in central Hangzhou and the first urban sports park in Zhejiang to combine an arena, parkland, playing fields and commercial space. After the Games the gymnasium became a public fitness centre with a swimming pool, basketball courts and badminton courts. The site lies about 14.5 kilometres north-west of the Asian Games village and is approached from Fengtan Road, a main north-south artery in Gongshu District.

name_zh: 浙江大学（紫金港校区）体育馆
address: 杭州市西湖区余杭塘路866号
area_text: 16,954㎡（体育馆总建筑面积）
intro_zh: 浙江大学（紫金港校区）体育馆位于杭州市西湖区余杭塘路866号浙江大学紫金港校区东门附近，东侧为风雨操场，北侧为游泳馆，几座场馆高度整合，形成校园东部的一片综合性体育场区。体育馆为杭州亚运会五人制篮球项目比赛场馆，总建筑面积16954平方米，亚运会期间设观众席位5307个，亚组委公布的常规观众席位数则为4821个。为满足亚运篮球赛事要求，场馆于2019年启动改造提升，保留主体结构、外立面和屋顶等围护结构，新增室内夹层建筑面积720平方米，改造涉及用地约53940平方米，重点更新比赛场地、灯光、音响、计时计分、转播和运动员功能区。场馆由浙江大学公共体育与艺术部场馆服务中心负责日常运营，承担公共体育教学、校队训练、师生活动和校内外赛事，并通过学校场馆共享服务平台受理大型活动申请。亚运会后，体育馆继续作为校园篮球、羽毛球、排球等活动的主场地，并向社会开放部分时段。场馆咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: The Zhejiang University Zijingsang Campus Gymnasium stands near the east gate of the university's Zijingsang campus at 866 Yuhangtang Road in Xihu District, Hangzhou. To its east lies the covered sports field and to its north the swimming hall, so that several halls are tightly grouped into a single sports zone on the eastern side of the campus. The gymnasium was the venue for five-a-side basketball at the Asian Games. It has 16,954 square metres of floor area and seated 5,307 spectators during the Games, while the organising committee's standard capacity figure is 4,821. To meet Asian Games basketball requirements the hall was upgraded from 2019. The main structure, facade and roof envelope were retained, an internal mezzanine of 720 square metres was added, and the work covered a site of about 53,940 square metres. The field of play, lighting, sound, timing and scoring, broadcast positions and athlete areas were all renewed. The venue is managed day to day by the venue service centre of Zhejiang University's Department of Public Physical Education and Art, which runs physical education classes, varsity training, student activities and campus competitions, and handles applications for large events through the university's shared venue platform. After the Games it remains the main hall for campus basketball, badminton and volleyball while opening selected sessions to the public. Because the hall sits inside a working campus rather than a standalone sports precinct, organisers coordinate access, security and parking with the university's venue service centre, which reviews applications for large gatherings through an online approval process introduced in 2019.
