name_zh: 萧山瓜沥文化体育中心
address: 杭州市萧山区瓜沥镇建设四路10778号
area_text: 33,045㎡（主副馆总建筑面积）
intro_zh: 萧山瓜沥文化体育中心位于杭州市萧山区瓜沥镇建设四路10778号，处在瓜沥新区核心地段，西临七彩未来社区、北临瓜沥镇政府、东临瓜沥商业中心。中心2013年1月开工、2017年8月竣工，总投资约2.5亿元，占地58.5亩，总建筑面积33045平方米，含主比赛馆与热身馆，杭州亚运会期间设观众席位4251个；另有资料按主馆容纳人数记为4600座。主馆为椭圆形比赛馆，共三层，按CBA赛事标准设计，可满足体操、篮球、手球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球、拳击、柔道、摔跤、跆拳道、举重、击剑、武术等比赛需要；副馆为方形训练馆，共五层，下沉广场设有购物中心。设计取瓜沥“中国花边之乡”的花边元素，外形被认为兼具“鸟巢”“水立方”的意味。杭州亚运会期间承办武术、卡巴迪项目，亚残运会期间承办跆拳道项目；赛后以卡巴迪为特色，推动“中国卡巴迪运动之乡”建设。场馆预约通过浙里办“亚运场馆在线”或“AI动杭州”小程序办理。
intro_en: The Xiaoshan Guali Culture and Sports Center stands at 10778 Jianshe 4th Road in Guali Town, Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou, at the heart of the town's new district, with the Qicai Future Community to the west, the Guali town government to the north and the town's commercial centre to the east. Construction began in January 2013 and the centre was completed in August 2017 at a cost of about 250 million yuan. It occupies 58.5 mu, roughly 3.9 hectares, and has 33,045 square metres of floor area across a main competition hall and a warm-up hall, seating 4,251 spectators during the Asian Games; other sources quote 4,600, the capacity of the main hall alone. The main hall is oval and rises three storeys. It was designed to CBA standards and can accommodate gymnastics, basketball, handball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, boxing, judo, wrestling, taekwondo, weightlifting, fencing and wushu. The annexe is a square, five-storey training hall with shops set into its sunken plaza. The design borrows the lace motifs for which Guali is known as a hometown of Chinese lace, and the outline has been compared to both the Bird's Nest and the Water Cube. During the Asian Games the centre hosted wushu and kabaddi, and during the Asian Para Games it hosted taekwondo. It has since built on that legacy by promoting itself as a national base for kabaddi. Bookings are made through the Asian Games venue service on the Zhejiang government app or the AI Dong Hangzhou mini-programme. For the Asian Games the town spent about 85 million yuan on ten packages of work, including civil alterations and finishes, sports lighting and intelligent building systems.

name_zh: 杭州电子科技大学体育馆
address: 杭州市钱塘区学林街280号
area_text: 14,595㎡（主比赛馆、预赛馆、热身馆合计）
intro_zh: 杭州电子科技大学体育馆位于杭州市钱塘区学林街280号，地处下沙高教园区杭州电子科技大学教学区西北面，西邻文渊路、北邻学林街，因外形酷似飞碟被师生称为“飞碟馆”。体育馆2006年建成，原为学校篮球馆，曾承办CBA联赛、第八届全国残疾人运动会轮椅篮球、第十三届全国大学生运动会男子足球等赛事，也曾是浙江万马篮球队的主场。杭州亚运会期间为击剑项目比赛场馆，含主比赛馆、预赛馆和热身馆，总建筑面积14595平方米，亚运会期间设观众席位4368个，亚组委公布的观众席位数则为4599个。改造秉持“原有结构少变动、原来空间高利用”的原则，保留并清洗再利用了已使用15年的5000多个座椅，仅此一项即节约约400万元；主馆作决赛馆，旁边新建两座副馆作预赛馆和热身馆，馆内设5条击剑道。赛后场馆由学校体育教学部管理，纳入学校体育场馆预约系统向师生开放，并承接校内外赛事与活动。学校总机。
intro_en: The Hangzhou Dianzi University Gymnasium stands at 280 Xuelin Street in Qiantang District, Hangzhou, on the north-western edge of the university's teaching area in the Xiasha higher education park, with Wenyuan Road to the west and Xuelin Street to the north. Students and staff call it the flying saucer because of its disc-like profile. Completed in 2006 as the campus basketball hall, it has hosted CBA fixtures, wheelchair basketball at the 8th National Games for Persons with Disabilities and men's football at the 13th National University Games, and was once the home court of the Zhejiang Wanma basketball team. During the Asian Games it served as the fencing venue, comprising a main competition hall, a preliminary hall and a warm-up hall, with 14,595 square metres of floor area and 4,368 seats during the Games; the organising committee's published spectator capacity is 4,599. The refurbishment followed a principle of minimal structural change and maximum reuse of existing space. More than 5,000 seats that had been in use for 15 years were removed, cleaned, stored and reinstalled, saving about 4 million yuan on its own. The main hall became the final piste hall with five fencing strips, while two new annexes provided the preliminary and warm-up halls. After the Games the venue is run by the university's physical education department, integrated into the campus booking system and used for university and outside competitions. The campus lies about 15 kilometres north-east of the Asian Games village, and the gymnasium is a short walk from Xuelin Street, one of the main spines of the Xiasha university town.

intro_zh: 临平体育中心体育馆位于杭州市临平区东湖南路177号临平体育中心内，与体育场、游泳馆、综合训练馆、风雨操场共同组成以“丝绸之路”为主题的场馆群，各馆之间以连廊平台串联。体育馆为杭州亚运会排球、空手道项目比赛场馆，并承办亚残运会坐式排球比赛，含比赛馆与热身馆。场馆总建筑面积16888平方米，亚运会期间设观众席位4300个，其中固定座3340个、活动座900个。改造以“丝绸之府”为主题，外立面采用曲面金属格栅模拟丝绸纹理，夜间以RGBW全彩灯具呈现多色渐变；馆内铺设悬浮式单实木龙骨结构的国际标准木地板，配备符合世界空手道联合会认证标准的竞技垫层，空手道比赛首次采用双面屏技术。无障碍设计细致：运动员出入口采用平坡平阶，休息室配无障碍淋浴间与卫生间，电梯按钮设盲文，看台设无障碍坐席及陪护座席。赛后临平区以“低免结合”推动开放，日常开放时间多为6:00至21:00，开放篮球场3片、羽毛球场8片及400米跑道。咨询电话未在本库列出。
intro_en: The Linping Sports Center Gymnasium forms part of the Linping Sports Center at 177 Donghu South Road in Linping District, Hangzhou, a cluster built around a Silk Road theme in which the arena, stadium, swimming hall, training hall and covered field are joined by elevated walkways. The arena was the volleyball and karate venue for the Asian Games and also hosted sitting volleyball at the Asian Para Games. It contains a competition hall and a warm-up hall across 16,888 square metres of floor area, with 4,300 seats during the Games made up of 3,340 fixed and 900 retractable seats. The refurbishment took the silk capital as its theme: curved metal louvres on the facade imitate the texture of silk, and RGBW lighting washes the building in shifting colour at night. Inside, the floor is an international-standard timber system on a floating single-solid-wood joist base, and the competition mat meets World Karate Federation certification, with a dual-screen display used for karate for the first time. Accessibility was treated in detail, with level thresholds at athlete entrances, accessible showers and toilets in the changing rooms, braille on lift buttons and wheelchair spaces with companion seats in the stands. Since the Games the district has combined low-fee and free access, typically opening from 06:00 to 21:00 with three basketball courts, eight badminton courts and the 400-metre track available. Linping has since positioned the hall as a karate base, hosting World Karate Federation K1 Premier League events and Asian youth championships, while the shared podium lets spectators move between halls without going outdoors.

intro_zh: 杭州体育馆位于杭州市拱墅区体育场路210号，前身为浙江省人民体育馆，始建于1966年、1969年建成投用，是20世纪杭州的标志性体育建筑，现为市级文物保护单位。场馆由建筑师唐葆亨设计，采用马鞍形悬索“船体”造型，获中国建筑学会优秀建筑创作奖，也是目前世界上仅存的该造型建筑，主体结构经加固后保留原貌，并新增11根承重索增强整体稳定性。2018年9月起，作为首批33个亚运场馆及设施之一实施全面改造，坚持“修旧如故”，重点做外立面修复、特色风貌提升和使用功能提级，改造后总建筑面积34203平方米，设观众席位4300个，并建成含180个停车位的地下停车场。杭州亚运会期间承办拳击项目比赛。2022年7月恢复对外开放，2024年承接CBA广厦主场等37场各级赛事，2025年还举办多场演唱会与公益讲座。场馆日常以羽毛球、乒乓球、壁球、体育舞蹈等项目惠民开放，并长期坚持低免开放政策。企事业单位举办文体活动可拨打预约，场馆总机。
intro_en: Hangzhou Gymnasium stands at 210 Tiyuchang Road in Gongshu District, Hangzhou. Its predecessor, the Zhejiang Provincial People's Gymnasium, was begun in 1966 and opened in 1969, and the building is now a municipal heritage site and one of the city's landmark sports structures of the twentieth century. It was designed by the architect Tang Baoheng with a saddle-shaped suspended cable hull, a form that won an outstanding architectural creation award from the Architectural Society of China and is described as the only surviving example of its kind anywhere. The main structure was retained and strengthened with eleven new load-bearing cables. From September 2018 the hall was one of the first 33 Asian Games venue projects and underwent a full upgrade guided by a principle of repairing the old as it was. Work concentrated on restoring the facade, enhancing its distinctive character and lifting functional standards, producing 34,203 square metres of floor area, 4,300 seats and an underground car park with 180 spaces. The gymnasium hosted boxing during the Asian Games. It reopened to the public in July 2022, staged 37 events at various levels in 2024 including CBA Guangsha home games, and in 2025 added concerts and public lectures. Companies and institutions can book cultural and sports activities through the venue's public channels. Day to day the hall runs badminton, table tennis, squash and dance sport sessions under a low-fee and free-access policy it has maintained for years, and it sits within the old city core a few hundred metres from the Zhejiang Daily offices. Its programme also includes public lectures on sports medicine, and the hall has become a fixture on the city's indoor events circuit.

intro_zh: 滨江体育馆又称“小白碗”，位于杭州市滨江区江虹路996号，2014年9月开建、2017年10月投入使用，总建筑面积58224平方米，含主比赛馆及热身馆，共5000座，其中固定座位4000个、活动座位1000个；亚运会期间设观众席位4143个。场馆以花朵为原型，外观经切割处理形成富有韵律感的花瓣造型，与奥体中心“大小莲花”相互呼应，市民更爱称其“小白碗”。亚运改造前这里是按NBA标准建设的篮球馆，地板为悬浮式拼装、选用进口加拿大枫木，每个观众座椅下方或背后均可出冷气。2020年10月启动亚运改造、2022年6月完工，外侧新建东面三层媒体中心和西面两层安保中心两栋玻璃房，并加装8K超高清摄像机与AI芯片，可实时捕捉观众席动态。杭州亚运会、亚残运会期间承办羽毛球比赛，是亚组委确定的示范场馆之一。场馆是滨江区第一座真正面向市民开放的综合性体育场所，赛后设有免费开放时段，羽毛球场地通常提前7天开放预约。2024年4月1日起正式对外运营，开放羽毛球、篮球等项目。咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Binjiang Gymnasium, known to residents as the Little White Bowl, stands at 996 Jianghong Road in Binjiang District, Hangzhou. Construction began in September 2014 and the hall opened in October 2017 with 58,224 square metres of floor area covering a main competition hall and a warm-up hall. Total capacity is 5,000, made up of 4,000 fixed and 1,000 retractable seats, while 4,143 seats were used during the Asian Games. The design takes a flower as its prototype; the outer shell is cut back into rhythmic petals that echo the Big and Little Lotus of the Olympic Sports Centre, although the public prefers the bowl nickname. Before the Games it was a basketball hall built to NBA standards, with a floating demountable floor of imported Canadian maple and cold air outlets beneath or behind every spectator seat. The Asian Games upgrade ran from October 2020 to June 2022. Two glass pavilions were added outside, a three-storey media centre to the east and a two-storey security centre to the west, together with 8K cameras and AI chips that track activity in the stands in real time. The hall hosted badminton during the Asian Games and Asian Para Games and was designated a model venue by the organising committee. It opened for public operation on 1 April 2024 with badminton and basketball among the available sports. It was the first comprehensive sports facility in Binjiang genuinely open to the public, and after the Games it set aside free sessions, with badminton courts normally released for booking seven days in advance. Coaches run youth badminton and basketball classes there on weekday evenings and at weekends.

name_zh: 浙江工商大学文体中心
address: 杭州市钱塘区学正街18号（浙江工商大学下沙校区内）
intro_zh: 浙江工商大学文体中心位于杭州市钱塘区学正街18号浙江工商大学下沙校区西北角，北临学府街，东、南面为学校田径场，西靠文翰路，与浙江经济职业技术学院相邻，基地设有专门出入口连接城市干道。文体中心为杭州亚运会手球项目比赛场馆，含主馆（比赛馆）及副馆（热身馆），总建筑面积19149平方米，亚运会期间设观众席位4439个；按设计座席规模为5415座，其中固定座席4765座、活动座席650座，体育建筑等级为乙级、属中型馆。建筑形体取意“太阳花”，以运动、波浪、弧形元素组织立面，寓意向阳而生。馆内属一般球类馆，内场可进行篮球、排球、手球、网球、乒乓球、体操等比赛，并可承接大型室内文艺表演和集会，设计时即兼顾面向社会开放的要求。场馆由浙江省建筑设计研究院设计，用地面积23000平方米，主体三层、无地下室，架空层约3914平方米。赛后将转换为综合性体育馆，主要供学校教学使用，同时承接校内外赛事。体育中心咨询与预约请走其公开渠道。
intro_en: The Zhejiang Gongshang University Sports and Arts Centre occupies the north-western corner of the university's Xiasha campus at 18 Xuezheng Street in Qiantang District, Hangzhou. Xuefu Street runs along its north side, the university's athletics field lies to the east and south, and Wenhan Road and the neighbouring Zhejiang Institute of Economics and Trade bound it to the west, with a dedicated access point onto the city road network. The centre was the handball venue for the Asian Games and comprises a main competition hall and an annexe warm-up hall across 19,149 square metres of floor area, seating 4,439 spectators during the Games. Its designed seating capacity is 5,415, made up of 4,765 fixed and 650 movable seats, and it is classified as a Class B, medium-sized sports building. The form is based on a sunflower, with movement, wave and arc motifs organising the facade and suggesting a turn towards the sun. Inside it is a general ball-games hall: the field of play can be configured for basketball, volleyball, handball, tennis, table tennis and gymnastics, and can also host large indoor performances and assemblies. The brief deliberately anticipated public use alongside campus needs. After the Games it converts into a comprehensive indoor sports hall, used mainly for teaching but also for competitions and events. It was designed by the Zhejiang Provincial Architectural Design and Research Institute on a 23,000 square metre site with three storeys and no basement; some 3,914 square metres of open ground-floor space account for the gap between its 15,236 square metre enclosed area and the 19,149 square metre total.

address: 杭州市拱墅区石祥路102号（北景园生态公园内）
intro_zh: 中国杭州电竞中心位于杭州市拱墅区石祥路102号，坐落在北景园生态公园内，留石高架以北、长滨路以东、杭宁铁路以南，是中国首座达到亚运会赛事标准的专业电子竞技场馆。场馆2020年9月28日开工，2022年3月31日竣工，同年5月31日启用；占地12838平方米，总建筑面积约8万平方米，其中地上1.9万平方米、地下6.1万平方米，建筑总高度23.9米，地下一层、地上三层。设计以“星际漩涡”为理念，三条主步道作骨架环绕核心旋转上升，形成双曲面异形结构，从空中俯瞰形似“星际战舰”；按甲级场馆标准和绿色建筑三星设计，采用“地源热泵+冷却塔”等系统可节能约30%，馆内布置6大智能化系统、63个子系统，覆盖5G网络、人脸识别与能耗管理。杭州亚运会期间设观众席位4087个，承办电子竞技项目比赛，另有资料按整体容量记为约5000座。2022年7月1日起惠民开放，参观时间为周一至周五9:00至17:30，可通过浙里办“亚运场馆在线”预约。咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: The China Hangzhou Esports Center stands at 102 Shixiang Road in Gongshu District, Hangzhou, inside Beijingen Ecological Park, north of the Liushi elevated road, east of Changbin Road and south of the Hangzhou-Nanjing railway. It is the first professional esports venue in China built to Asian Games competition standards. Work began on 28 September 2020, the building was completed on 31 March 2022 and it opened on 31 May that year. It occupies a 12,838 square metre site with about 80,000 square metres of floor area, of which 19,000 square metres are above ground and 61,000 below, and rises 23.9 metres over one basement and three above-ground levels. The design concept is an interstellar vortex: three main walkways form a skeleton that spirals upward around the core, producing a doubly curved shell that looks like a starship from the air. The hall was built to Class A venue standards and a three-star green building rating; ground-source heat pumps combined with cooling towers cut energy use by around 30 per cent, and six intelligent systems with 63 subsystems cover 5G connectivity, facial recognition and energy monitoring. It seated 4,087 spectators for the Asian Games, when it hosted the esports competitions; other sources quote a total capacity of about 5,000. Public opening began on 1 July 2022, with visits from 09:00 to 17:30 on weekdays by booking through the Zhejiang government service app. The centre anchors a wider esports district that Gongshu is promoting for tournaments, training and industry tenants, with NetEase titles among the events held there since the Games.

address: 杭州市桐庐县瑶琳镇林场路1号
area_text: 54,000㎡（总建筑面积；占地730余亩）
intro_zh: 桐庐马术中心位于杭州市桐庐县瑶琳镇林场路1号，地处瑶琳林场地块，南邻分水江、背靠天目山余脉，距离亚运村约100公里，是杭州亚运会马术项目主场馆，也是最后一批开工的新建亚运场馆之一。项目占地730余亩，另租150亩临时用地作越野赛道，总建筑面积约5.4万平方米（亚组委口径约5.2万平方米），按“奥运级主赛场”标准建造。场馆包括100米×120米主赛场（另有资料记80米×100米）、5000平方米室内训练场、60米×80米室外训练场与热身场、240间高标准马厩、近4000至5000米越野赛道，以及马僮村、马医院、饲料仓库、钉蹄间等配套，亚运会期间设观众席位3104个。桐庐因此建成中国大陆首个可供使用的无疫区马场，可承办盛装舞步、场地障碍和三项赛，亚运会期间产生6枚金牌。主场馆于2021年9月28日全面完工并通过预验收，2022年6月的桐庐马术三项赛邀请赛作为测试赛检验了场地与运行。赛后场馆转向“马术+文旅”，引入汗血马牧场、马文化博物馆、骑士酒店等项目，并承办长三角马术联赛等赛事。咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: The Tonglu Equestrian Centre stands at 1 Linchang Road in Yaolin Town, Tonglu County, Hangzhou, on the Yaolin forestry farm site, with the Fenshui River to the south and the Tianmu mountains behind it, about 100 kilometres from the Asian Games village. It was the main equestrian venue of the Games and one of the last new venues to start construction. The project covers more than 730 mu, roughly 49 hectares, plus 150 mu of rented land for the cross-country course, and has about 54,000 square metres of floor area, although the organising committee quoted some 52,000 square metres. It was built to Olympic-level main arena standards. Facilities include a main arena of about 100 by 120 metres, other accounts give 80 by 100 metres, a 5,000 square metre indoor training hall, 60 by 80 metre outdoor training and warm-up grounds, 240 high-standard stables, a cross-country course of nearly 4,000 to 5,000 metres, plus a grooms' village, equine hospital, feed store and farriery. Seating during the Games was 3,104. Tonglu thereby gained the first disease-free equestrian zone usable in mainland China, capable of hosting dressage, show jumping and eventing; six gold medals were decided there during the Games. Since then the site has moved towards equestrian tourism, adding an Akhal-Teke horse ranch, a horse culture museum and a rider hotel, and it stages events such as the Yangtze River Delta equestrian league. The main venue was completed and pre-accepted on 28 September 2021, and a three-day eventing invitation tournament in June 2022 served as the test event. The site is also used for equestrian tourism and riding lessons outside the competition calendar.

address: 杭州市萧山区临浦镇人民路22号
area_text: 24,040㎡（比赛馆及热身馆）
intro_zh: 萧山临浦体育馆位于杭州市萧山区临浦镇人民路22号，处在临浦镇核心位置，是萧山南部规模最大的体育馆，因承办柔道等赛事被称为“柔立方”。场馆2003年启建，2020年1月起为迎接亚运会实施全方位改造提升，总建筑面积24040平方米，含比赛馆及热身馆，亚运会期间设观众席位2733个；另有资料记固定座位2700余个、活动座位900余个。建筑呈长方形布局，整体方正，入口采用具中国古典建筑特色的斗拱构架，立面选用临浦本地文化特色的大理石，中式韵味浓厚。馆内布置两片柔术比赛场地，蓝、橙两色搭配，灯光、计时计分、转播与兴奋剂检查等赛时功能用房齐全。改造结合临浦厚重的文化积淀，把中式韵味渗透进立面与入口，从正门望去颇有庄重感。杭州亚运会期间承办柔道、柔术、克柔术项目，亚残运会期间亦有赛事安排。赛后以“柔立方”品牌向市民开放，纳入浙里办“亚运场馆在线”预约，是临浦镇全民健身和青少年培训的主要场地。咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Xiaoshan Linpu Gymnasium stands at 22 Renmin Road in Linpu Town, Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou, at the heart of the town and the largest indoor sports hall in southern Xiaoshan. It is nicknamed the Soft Cube after the judo-family events it staged. Construction began in 2003, and from January 2020 the hall underwent a full upgrade for the Asian Games. It has 24,040 square metres of floor area across a competition hall and a warm-up hall, and seated 2,733 spectators during the Games; other sources record more than 2,700 fixed seats and around 900 movable ones. The building is rectangular and firmly orthogonal in plan. Its entrance uses a dougong bracket frame drawn from classical Chinese architecture, and the facade is clad in marble characteristic of Linpu, giving the hall a pronounced Chinese character that has been compared to a museum entrance. Inside, two competition areas were laid out in blue and orange for ju-jitsu, supported by lighting, timing and scoring, broadcast and doping control rooms. The gymnasium hosted judo, ju-jitsu and kurash during the Asian Games, with further events during the Asian Para Games. It now operates under the Soft Cube name, taking bookings through the Zhejiang government service app. The renovation drew on Linpu's long cultural history, carrying Chinese motifs through the facade and entrance so that the approach reads as formal and ceremonial. Its position on Renmin Road places it inside the old town grid, close to the market and civic buildings, and it is now the town's main base for youth training. Local schools use the hall during the day and the town's sports association runs evening sessions.

address: 杭州市上城区四季青街道钱潮路12号
area_text: 体育场建筑面积16063平方米；中心总用地80424平方米、总建筑面积58058平方米
intro_zh: 上城体育中心体育场位于杭州市上城区钱潮路12号，是上城体育中心“一场两馆”中的体育场部分。中心总用地80424平方米，总建筑面积58058平方米，由体育场、综合馆与网球中心三部分组成；体育场本身建筑面积16063平方米，设13544个观众席，2009年正式投入使用。场地为天然草坪足球场配标准400米田径跑道，看台沿两侧展开，红蓝塑胶跑道与绿色草坪构成鲜明的色彩对比。2019年起，为迎接第19届杭州亚运会，体育场按国际赛事标准改造，更换卤素灯为LED照明、翻新看台与功能用房、重做草坪与排水，2022年6月重新开放；亚运会期间承办足球项目多场比赛，包括男子足球三四名决赛，是上城区唯一承担亚运足球比赛的场馆。赛后场馆转向惠民开放，跑道与草坪分时段免费或低价向市民开放，开放时间从早6点至晚9点，日均服务大量跑步与健身人群，成为“亚运遗产”日常化的样本。2027年亚足联U-20亚洲杯将在杭州举办，上城体育中心体育场是承办场地之一。配套上，中心有597个停车位与15个充电桩，周边为钱江新城二期居住区，地铁6号线、9号线三堡站较近。对活动主办方而言，这座场的优势是“城市型中型体育场”：1.3万座规模适合足球、田径、橄榄球与中型演唱会，草坪与跑道可切换，看台紧凑、视线好，市中心的区位降低了观众到达门槛；不足是看台无完整罩棚，雨季与高温时段的赛演排期需预留天气窗口。
intro_en: The Shangcheng Sports Centre Stadium stands at 12 Qianchao Road in the Sijiqing subdistrict of Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, and forms the stadium element of the centre's stadium, arena and tennis complex. The whole centre covers 80,424 square metres with 58,058 square metres of floor area across the stadium, the multi-purpose hall and the tennis centre. The stadium itself has 16,063 square metres of floor area and 13,544 seats, and entered service in 2009. It pairs a natural-turf football pitch with a standard 400-metre athletics track, the red and blue synthetic track setting off the green turf, with stands running along both sides. From 2019, in preparation for the 19th Asian Games, the stadium was renovated to international standards: halogen lamps were replaced with LED lighting, stands and functional rooms were refurbished, and the pitch and drainage were rebuilt, with reopening in June 2022. During the Asian Games it hosted several football matches, including the men's bronze medal match, and was the only venue in Shangcheng District to stage Asian Games football. After the Games it shifted to public use, with the track and pitch opened free or at low cost in time slots from 6 am to 9 pm, serving a large daily population of runners and fitness users and becoming an example of the Asian Games legacy absorbed into ordinary city life. Hangzhou will host the AFC U-20 Asian Cup in 2027, and this stadium is one of the venues. The centre provides 597 parking spaces and 15 charging points, sits within the second-phase residential area of Qianjiang New City, and is reachable by metro lines 9 and 19. For organisers the appeal is a medium-sized city stadium: 13,544 seats suit football, athletics, rugby and mid-sized concerts, the pitch and track can be alternated, the stands are compact with good sightlines, and the central location lowers the barrier to attendance; the weakness is the absence of a full roof, so schedules in the rainy season and the hottest months need a weather window.

name_zh: 杭州师范大学（仓前校区）体育场
address: 杭州市余杭区仓前街道余杭塘路2318号
area_text: 总建筑面积32188.5平方米（含体育场及热身场地）
intro_zh: 杭州师范大学（仓前校区）体育场位于杭州市余杭区仓前街道余杭塘路2318号，地处杭州师范大学仓前校区内、亚运村西北侧约23.5公里，是第19届杭州亚运会七人制橄榄球项目的比赛场地。场馆含一座体育场与一片热身场地，总建筑面积32188.5平方米，设12000个观众席位。为承办亚运，场地进行了约一年的改造提升，更换看台座椅、比赛灯光与LED显示屏，新建橄榄球热身场地草坪及配套用房；2022年，它成为全省亚运场馆中第一个通过工程竣工验收的场馆，被用作后续场馆建设的样板。草坪下方设置了雨水回收系统，透过草坪的雨水被收集起来用于周边绿化浇灌，是“绿色亚运”的具体做法之一；场地尺寸与球门按七人制橄榄球规则布置，也可切换为足球与田径使用。亚运期间这里承办七人制橄榄球男女组比赛，中国队在此获得女子金牌。赛后场馆回归校园，承担校运动会、体育教学、橄榄球与足球训练，并在非教学时段向公众预约开放，是余杭区仓前、未来科技城片区少有的万人级体育场。对活动主办方而言，这座场的价值在于“校园大型场地”：1.2万座看台、开阔的草坪与完整的配套用房，适合橄榄球、足球、田径赛事以及校庆、音乐节与品牌运动会；但校园管理严格，商业活动需与校方及属地报批，演出噪声与散场时间受周边高校与居民区约束。交通上，地铁5号线杭师大仓前站直达校区，场馆距地铁站步行可达。
intro_en: The Hangzhou Normal University Stadium on the Cangqian campus stands at 2318 Yuhangtang Road in Cangqian, Yuhang District, about 23.5 kilometres north-west of the Asian Games village, and was the rugby sevens venue of the 19th Asian Games. The facility comprises a stadium and a separate warm-up ground, with 32,188.5 square metres of floor area and 12,000 spectator seats. For the Games it underwent about a year of renovation: spectator seats, competition lighting and LED screens were replaced, and a new rugby warm-up pitch and support building were added. In 2022 it became the first Asian Games venue in the province to pass completion acceptance, and was used as a template for later venue works. Beneath the pitch a rainwater harvesting system collects what drains through the turf and reuses it for irrigating the surrounding landscaping, one of the concrete expressions of the green Games approach; the field dimensions and goal posts follow rugby sevens rules and can be switched to football or athletics. During the Asian Games it staged the men's and women's rugby sevens tournaments, where the Chinese women's team won gold. Afterwards the ground returned to the campus, carrying school sports days, physical education, rugby and football training, and opening to the public by booking outside teaching hours; it is one of the few 10,000-seat grounds in the Cangqian and Future Science City area of Yuhang. For event owners the value is a large campus ground: 12,000 seats, an open pitch and complete support rooms suit rugby, football and athletics as well as university anniversaries, music festivals and corporate sports days. Campus rules are strict, however, so commercial events need approval from the university and local authorities, and noise and dispersal times are constrained by neighbouring universities and housing. The campus is served directly by Hangzhou Normal University Cangqian station on metro line 5, within walking distance of the ground.

name_zh: 杭州棋院（智力大厦）棋类馆
address: 浙江省杭州市萧山区奥体博览城核心区，博奥路与利一路交叉口东南角（近杭州奥体中心“大莲花”）
area_text: 总建筑面积12.6万㎡（地上47层、地下2层，建筑高度199.8米）；亚运赛时用地1—14层，建筑面积26,633㎡
intro_zh: 杭州棋院（智力大厦）棋类馆位于杭州市萧山区奥体博览城核心区，处在博奥路与利一路交叉口的东南角，紧邻杭州奥体中心主体育场“大莲花”，与钱塘江对岸天元大厦的中国棋院杭州分院老院区隔江相望。智力大厦建筑高度199.8米，地上47层、地下2层，总建筑面积12.6万平方米，其中地上建筑面积85379平方米；亚运会棋牌类项目的比赛及训练场地位于大厦1至14层，赛时用地建筑面积26633平方米，2022年3月29日通过赛事功能及体育工艺验收。杭州亚运会期间，这里承担围棋、象棋、国际象棋和桥牌四个项目的比赛，共产生13枚金牌；杭州亚残运会期间承担围棋和国际象棋比赛。场馆以“兼容、创新、共享”为设计理念，把办公、比赛、交流、培训、教学、研究、博物馆、图书馆和文创等功能叠合在同一栋楼内，赛时可快速转换，赛后成为国内首个智力运动综合体，并向电子竞技等新兴智力运动项目延伸。中国棋院杭州分院成立于1986年，2023年初整体入驻智力大厦，形成以智力大厦为主、天元大厦为辅的“一主一副”格局。观众和参赛人员可乘杭州地铁6号线至博览中心站，从B1口出站步行约3分钟经西门进入；大厦周边为博奥路、利一路和飞虹路，距奥体中心主体育场步行可达。
intro_en: The Hangzhou Chess Academy venue occupies the southeast corner of the Bo'ao Road and Liyi Road junction in the Olympic Expo City core of Xiaoshan District, beside the Big Lotus main stadium and across the Qiantang River from the academy's older home in Tianyuan Tower. Zhili Tower rises 199.8 m with 47 floors above ground and two below, and a total floor area of 126,000 sqm, of which 85,379 sqm is above ground. Competition and training spaces for chess and card games occupy floors 1 to 14, with 26,633 sqm of Games-time floor area, handed over on 29 March 2022 after sports-function and technical acceptance. During the Hangzhou Asian Games the building staged go, xiangqi, chess and bridge, producing 13 gold medals, and it hosted go and chess at the Asian Para Games. Designed around the ideas of compatibility, innovation and sharing, the tower stacks offices, competition halls, exchange and training rooms, teaching space, research, a museum, a library and creative retail in one volume, so rooms convert quickly between uses. After the Games it became China's first integrated mind-sports complex and now reaches into esports and other emerging disciplines. The China Chess Academy's Hangzhou branch, founded in 1986, moved its main operations into the tower in early 2023, keeping Tianyuan Tower as a secondary base. Spectators and teams reach the venue on Metro Line 6 to Expo Centre station, about three minutes' walk from exit B1 to the west entrance; Bo'ao Road, Liyi Road and Feihong Road form the surrounding grid, and the main stadium of the Olympic Sports Centre is within walking distance.

name_zh: 淳安界首体育中心（公路自行车赛场）
address: 浙江省杭州市淳安县界首乡（起终点设于淳安界首体育中心，赛道借用环千岛湖公路）
area_text: 场地面积未公开；男子赛道207.7公里、女子赛道142公里，途经14个乡镇；界首体育中心场馆群总面积约8.4平方公里
intro_zh: 淳安界首体育中心公路自行车赛场位于杭州市淳安县界首乡，是淳安界首体育中心场馆群五个临建赛场之一，起终点均设在千岛湖畔的界首体育中心。赛道借用淳安县内环湖公路，男子组全程207.7公里，刚好环千岛湖一周，女子组142公里，沿线经过14个乡镇，串联起淳杨公路、淳开线等“最美农村路”，具有沿湖、沿村、沿山的特点。全程有37座桥梁、30个隧道和1071个路口，路面宽窄不一，有平路、上坡、下坡和急弯，最高点海拔约342米，对选手的体能和技术都是考验，因而被称为“公路自行车界的马拉松”，也是杭州亚运会所有项目中路线最长的一项。2023年10月3日至5日，亚运会公路自行车男子公路赛、男子个人计时赛、女子公路赛和女子个人计时赛在此举行，产生4枚金牌。淳安界首体育中心场馆群总面积约8.4平方公里，陆地与水域各占一半，除自行车馆为新建永久场馆外，其余五项室外赛事场地均为临建。赛后这条环湖赛道继续用于环千岛湖公路自行车赛、Hello100千岛湖站等赛事和大众骑游，沿线乡镇的民宿、果园和景区因赛事获得持续客流，赛道本身也成为千岛湖“体育+旅游”的主干线。
intro_en: The road cycling course of the Chunan Jieshou Sports Centre lies in Jieshou township, Chunan county, Hangzhou, one of five temporary outdoor competition venues in the cluster, with both the start and the finish at the lakeside sports centre. The race borrows the county's lakeside public roads: the men's route runs 207.7 km, almost exactly one lap of Qiandao Lake, and the women's route 142 km, passing through 14 townships and linking the Chunyang Highway and Chunkai Line, two roads officially rated among China's most beautiful rural routes. The course has 37 bridges, 30 tunnels and 1,071 junctions, varies in width, and mixes flat sections with climbs, descents and sharp bends; its highest point sits at about 342 m, which is why the event is called the marathon of road cycling and why it was the longest route at the Hangzhou Asian Games. From 3 to 5 October 2023 the venue staged the men's road race, men's time trial, women's road race and women's time trial, producing four gold medals. The whole Jieshou cluster covers about 8.4 sq km, split evenly between land and water, and apart from the permanent velodrome every outdoor venue was built as a temporary installation. After the Games the lakeside circuit continues to host the Tour of Qiandao Lake, the Hello100 series and mass rides, feeding steady traffic to guesthouses, orchards and scenic spots in the riverside townships and anchoring the lake's sports-tourism economy. In June 2023 the same roads hosted the national road championships as the Asian Games test event, and on race days the circuit is closed to traffic, with team buses and warm-up loops based at the sports centre beside the athletes' village.

name_zh: 淳安界首体育中心（小轮车赛场）
address: 浙江省杭州市淳安县界首乡严家村（环绕场地自行车馆布置，淳安亚运分村中心周围）
area_text: 场地面积未公开；BMX竞速赛道长约400米，含起始区、赛道、比赛场地及热身场地
intro_zh: 淳安界首体育中心小轮车赛场位于杭州市淳安县界首乡严家村，环绕场地自行车馆布置，是杭州亚运会淳安赛区五个临建赛场之一，场地包含起始区、赛道、比赛场地和热身场地。赛道按国际自行车联盟（UCI）BMX竞速标准建设，长约400米，设有起跑坡、跳台、波浪道和多个弯道，出发台的高度与坡度按世界大赛要求设置，选手从高台俯冲出发，在连续起伏的赛道上完成跳跃、压弯和超越，单轮比赛往往不到一分钟，节奏极快、对抗激烈。2023年10月1日，亚运会竞速小轮车男子、女子两个小项在这里决出2枚金牌，这也是淳安赛区最后一项自行车赛事。赛场依山傍水，赛道两侧设观赛区，观众可以近距离看到选手腾空的动作。亚运结束后，场地交由淳安界首体育中心统一运营，继续承办全国小轮车锦标赛、青少年训练营和大众体验活动，并与场地自行车馆、山地自行车赛道共同组成千岛湖自行车运动基地。从杭州城区经杭新景高速转入千岛湖环湖公路可直达界首乡，界首距千岛湖镇约半小时车程，亚运分村及周边配套可承接训练和赛事住宿。
intro_en: The BMX racing track at Chunan Jieshou Sports Centre sits in Yanjia village, Jieshou township, Chunan county, laid out around the velodrome as one of the five temporary venues of the Hangzhou Asian Games cluster, with a start area, the track itself, a competition zone and a warm-up area. Built to the UCI BMX racing standard, the course is about 400 m long and combines a starting ramp, jumps, rollers and several bends; the start hill's height and gradient follow world-championship practice, so riders launch from an elevated gate and spend well under a minute per run jumping, carving and overtaking on a constantly undulating surface. On 1 October 2023 the venue decided the men's and women's BMX racing events, two gold medals and the last cycling competition of the Chunan programme. The track is cut into the hillside above Qiandao Lake, with spectator areas along both sides that put the riders' airtime within close view. After the Games it passed to the Jieshou sports centre for unified operation and continues to stage national BMX championships, youth training camps and public taster sessions, forming a cycling base together with the velodrome and the mountain-bike course. Drivers reach Jieshou from Hangzhou via the Hangxinjing expressway and the lakeside ring road, and the township is about half an hour from Qiandao Lake town, with the Asian Games village and its supporting accommodation available for training camps and events. BMX racing has been an Olympic discipline since Beijing 2008, and the Chunan course is one of the few UCI-standard BMX tracks in Zhejiang, built with a permanent start hill so that it can be used outside the Games period.

name_zh: 淳安界首体育中心（山地自行车赛场）
address: 浙江省杭州市淳安县界首乡严家村（依山而建，环绕场地自行车馆）
area_text: 场地面积未公开；越野赛道约4.9公里，赛道所在山体海拔差约47米
intro_zh: 淳安界首体育中心山地自行车赛场位于杭州市淳安县界首乡严家村，依山而建，与场地自行车馆、小轮车赛场相邻，是杭州亚运会淳安赛区的临建赛场之一。赛道全长约4.9公里，相对千岛湖湖面的海拔差约47米，设计师利用这段起伏把陡坡、连续斜坡、岩石路段、圆木障碍和急弯等技术点串联起来，几乎囊括了山地自行车越野赛的所有障碍类型；部分路段可以直接望见千岛湖，因此被选手称为“湖山”赛道，也被赞为“千岛碧水画中赛”。2023年9月25日，亚运会山地自行车男子、女子越野赛在这里举行，产生2枚金牌，中国队包揽女子项目冠亚军。此前赛道已于2022年7月1日起逐步对外开放，2023年7月又承办了“韵味杭州”全国山地自行车锦标赛暨全国青年山地自行车锦标赛，14支代表队、100余名运动员参赛。亚运结束后，赛道保留并向骑行爱好者开放，成为千岛湖环湖骑行体系中的专业越野段，同时承担省队和国家队的冬训任务；界首乡距千岛湖镇约半小时车程，经环湖公路与淳安县城、千岛湖高铁站相连。
intro_en: The mountain-bike course at Chunan Jieshou Sports Centre climbs the hillside of Yanjia village in Jieshou township, Chunan county, next to the velodrome and the BMX track, and was built as a temporary venue for the Hangzhou Asian Games. The loop runs about 4.9 km with roughly 47 m of elevation difference relative to the lake surface, and the designers used that relief to string together steep climbs, consecutive slopes, rock gardens, log obstacles and tight turns, covering essentially every technical element of cross-country racing. Sections of the track look straight out over Qiandao Lake, which is why riders call it the lake-and-mountain course and describe the racing as taking place inside a landscape painting. On 25 September 2023 it hosted the men's and women's cross-country events, two gold medals, with Chinese riders taking first and second in the women's race. The course had already opened to the public in stages from 1 July 2022, and in July 2023 it staged the national mountain-bike championships together with the national youth championships, drawing 14 teams and more than 100 athletes. After the Games the track remains open to riders as the technical off-road section of the lake's cycling network and hosts winter training for provincial and national squads; Jieshou is about half an hour by road from Qiandao Lake town, connected to the county seat and the high-speed rail station by the lakeside ring road. The loop starts and finishes beside the velodrome, so team areas, mechanics' zones and warm-up space share the velodrome's facilities, and championship races are run over several laps of the circuit.

name_zh: 淳安界首体育中心（游泳赛场）
address: 浙江省杭州市淳安县界首乡（淳安亚运分村中心南侧，千岛湖公开水域）
area_text: 场地面积未公开；马拉松游泳赛道10公里，含比赛水域及热身水域
intro_zh: 淳安界首体育中心游泳赛场即杭州亚运会公开水域（马拉松游泳）赛场，位于杭州市淳安县界首乡，处在淳安亚运分村中心南侧，包含比赛水域和热身水域，是淳安赛区五个临建赛场之一。赛场直接使用千岛湖水域，湖区山地多、山体平缓、水域开阔、溪河纵横，水体属国家一级水体，被誉为“天下第一秀水”，能见度和水温条件都适合长距离公开水域比赛。2023年10月6日至7日，亚运会马拉松游泳男子、女子10公里比赛在这里举行，产生2枚金牌，中国选手张子扬以1小时55分45秒8夺得男子金牌，兰天辰以0.4秒之差获得银牌。淳安每年定期举办各类公开水域游泳比赛，2023年5月的千岛湖公开水域游泳公开赛吸引了171支队伍、3500余名选手参赛，带动8000余人前来观赛和旅游；2024年9月，千岛湖公开水域游泳公开赛继续在淳安举办。赛场为临建场地，赛时设置出发平台、浮标航线、计时计分和救生艇保障，赛后保留公开水域游泳和水上运动的开展功能，与铁人三项赛场共用岸线和水域资源，成为千岛湖水上运动季的核心水域。
intro_en: The swimming venue of Chunan Jieshou Sports Centre is the open-water course of the Hangzhou Asian Games, lying south of the centre of the Chunan Asian Games village in Jieshou township, Chunan county, with separate racing and warm-up water areas as one of the cluster's five temporary venues. It uses Qiandao Lake directly: the lake district is mountainous but gently sloped, the water is broad and fed by a dense river network, and the body is classed as national grade-one water, known as the finest water under heaven, with clarity and temperature well suited to long-distance open-water racing. On 6 and 7 October 2023 the venue staged the men's and women's 10 km marathon swims, two gold medals; Zhang Ziyang won the men's race in 1:55:45.8 and Lan Tianchen took silver 0.4 seconds behind. Chunan holds open-water events every year, and the May 2023 Qiandao Lake open-water swimming meet drew 171 teams and more than 3,500 swimmers, with over 8,000 visitors watching and travelling; the meet returned to Chunan in September 2024. The venue is a temporary installation with a start pontoon, buoyed course, timing systems and rescue boats, and after the Games it keeps its open-water and watersports function, sharing shoreline and water with the triathlon venue to anchor the lake's summer watersports season. The venue sits inside the 8.4 sq km Jieshou cluster, half land and half water, next to the triathlon course and the Asian Games village, and is reached from Qiandao Lake town along the lakeside ring road. Marathon swimming closed the Games' open-water programme on 6 and 7 October 2023, in the final week of the Hangzhou 2022 schedule.

name_zh: 淳安界首体育中心（自行车馆）
address: 浙江省杭州市淳安县界首乡（千岛湖畔，淳安亚运分村主体建筑）
area_text: 建筑面积24,282㎡，占地9,700㎡，建筑高度40米；屋盖长轴132米、短轴101米，罩棚高32米；内设250米标准室内赛道
intro_zh: 淳安界首体育中心自行车馆位于杭州市淳安县界首乡的千岛湖畔，是淳安亚运分村的主体建筑，也是整个场馆群中唯一新建的永久场馆。场馆以“朝阳鱼跃，千岛明珠”为设计理念，屋面与幕墙提取渔文化元素，远望像一颗藏在山水之间的明珠，又像跃出湖面的鱼儿荡开的层层涟漪。建筑占地9700平方米，建筑面积24282平方米，建筑高度40米；椭圆形屋盖长轴132米、短轴101米，罩棚高32米，采用带加强肋的单层网壳结构，施工时使用内环整体提升技术，是淳安历史上最大跨度的钢结构工程。馆内设一条周长250米的标准室内自行车赛道和3040个观众座位，配有比赛场地、热身场馆、运动员休息与媒体工作区。2023年9月26日至29日，杭州亚运会场地自行车12个小项在此举行，产生12枚金牌。亚运结束后，场馆继续承接全国场地自行车锦标赛、国家队和省队训练，并向公众开放体验和青少年培训，与室外的公路、山地、小轮车赛场共同构成完整的自行车运动基地；从淳安县城经环湖公路约半小时可达。
intro_en: The velodrome at Chunan Jieshou Sports Centre stands on the shore of Qiandao Lake in Jieshou township, Chunan county, the main building of the Chunan Asian Games village and the only permanent new venue in the cluster. Its design concept, sunrise, leaping fish and the pearl of a thousand islands, shapes the roof and facade with fishing-culture motifs, so the building reads from a distance as a pearl set in the landscape or as ripples spreading from a fish breaking the surface. It covers a 9,700 sqm footprint with 24,282 sqm of floor area and rises 40 m; the elliptical roof spans 132 m on its long axis and 101 m on its short axis, with a 32 m canopy over a stiffened single-layer lattice shell erected by inner-ring integral lifting, the longest steel span ever built in Chunan. Inside are a 250 m standard indoor track, 3,040 spectator seats, competition and warm-up areas, athletes' facilities and media workspace. From 26 to 29 September 2023 the venue staged the 12 track cycling events of the Hangzhou Asian Games, producing 12 gold medals. After the Games it continues to host national track championships, national and provincial squad training, public ride sessions and youth coaching, and together with the outdoor road, mountain-bike and BMX courses it forms a complete cycling base about half an hour by road from Chunan county town along the lakeside highway. As the main building of the Asian Games village it anchored the athletes' compound during the Games, and its 250 m track is the standard length for international track cycling. Across four days the track decided 12 medal events, among them team pursuit, madison, keirin and individual sprint.

name_zh: 淳安界首体育中心（铁人三项赛场）
address: 浙江省杭州市淳安县界首乡（淳安亚运分村中心南侧，含综合运营区及比赛线路）
area_text: 场地面积未公开；标准距离为游泳1.5公里、自行车40公里、跑步10公里，另设转换区与终点区
intro_zh: 淳安界首体育中心铁人三项赛场位于杭州市淳安县界首乡，处在淳安亚运分村中心南侧，是杭州亚运会淳安赛区的临建赛场之一，由综合运营区和铁人三项比赛线路组成。比赛采用标准距离：游泳1.5公里在千岛湖公开水域进行，自行车40公里借用环湖公路，跑步10公里沿湖岸与场馆周边道路折返，运动员在设于体育中心内的转换区完成换项，终点也设在中心。2023年9月29日至30日，亚运会铁人三项男子、女子个人赛在这里举行，10月2日进行混合接力赛，共产生3枚金牌。赛道把千岛湖的湖光山色与亚运分村、自行车馆串联起来，游泳段水质清澈、能见度高，自行车段起伏适中，跑步段平坦开阔，被认为是中国少有的景观型铁三赛道。2023年4月，这里先以“韵味杭州”全国铁人三项冠军杯系列赛暨U系列冠军杯赛完成亚运模拟考，半程赛总距离25.75公里（游泳0.75公里、自行车20公里、跑步5公里）；2025年7月又承办中国小铁人系列赛千岛湖（界首）站。赛后赛场继续用于铁人三项、公开水域游泳和青少年培训，是千岛湖铁三赛事的主要起终点。
intro_en: The triathlon venue at Chunan Jieshou Sports Centre lies south of the centre of the Chunan Asian Games village in Jieshou township, Chunan county, one of the cluster's temporary venues, made up of an operations compound and the race courses. Racing follows the standard distance: a 1.5 km swim in the open water of Qiandao Lake, a 40 km bike leg on the lakeside highway and a 10 km run out and back along the shore and the roads around the venue, with athletes changing in a transition area inside the sports centre and finishing there as well. From 29 to 30 September 2023 the venue hosted the men's and women's individual triathlons, followed on 2 October by the mixed relay, three gold medals in all. The courses link the lake scenery with the Asian Games village and the velodrome: clear, high-visibility water for the swim, moderate rolling terrain for the bike and a flat, open run, a combination that makes it one of China's few genuinely scenic triathlon courses. In April 2023 it served as the Asian Games test event through the national triathlon champion cup and U-series, run over a 25.75 km sprint distance of 0.75 km swim, 20 km bike and 5 km run, and in July 2025 it hosted the Qiandao Lake round of the China Junior Triathlon Series. After the Games it continues to serve triathlon, open-water swimming and youth training as the main start and finish for the lake's triathlon events, sitting in the same 8.4 sq km cluster as the velodrome, the BMX track and the marathon swim course.

address: 浙江省杭州市西湖区转塘街道之江路200号（之江板块，距西湖约10公里）
area_text: 用地面积约70万㎡（另有总占地1700余亩的报道口径），建筑面积1,300㎡；18洞，黑T总长7,039码
intro_zh: 西湖国际高尔夫球场位于杭州市西湖区转塘街道之江路200号，处在西湖以南的之江板块，距西湖约10公里，是杭州亚运会高尔夫项目的比赛及训练场地。球场用地面积约70万平方米，建筑面积1300平方米，共18洞，黑T（男子职业球员发球台）总长7039码，由美国高尔夫大师杰克·尼克劳斯设计，1997年开业，是浙江省最早、也是唯一经国务院批准立项建造的高尔夫球场。球场青山环抱，果岭与球道铺陈在湖泊、树林和小溪之间，随自然地势柔美起伏，最大程度保留了土地的原生状态；果岭选用本特草，球道为早熟禾，亚运前按高标准完成了草坪、喷灌和排水系统修缮，赛时果岭速度与平整度均达到职业赛事要求。2023年杭州亚运会期间，这里承办高尔夫男子个人、男子团体、女子个人和女子团体4个小项，产生4枚金牌。2023年5月，“韵味杭州”西湖国际高尔夫公开赛作为测试赛在此举行，来自8个国家和地区的126名运动员参赛。赛后球场继续作为浙江省高尔夫球训练基地和职业、业余赛事场地，并保留公众练习场与教学功能；球场经之江路连接杭州主城与转塘、富阳方向，周边为云栖小镇、铜鉴湖等景区。
intro_en: West Lake International Golf Course occupies 200 Zhijiang Road in Zhuangtang subdistrict, Xihu district, Hangzhou, on the Zhijiang belt south of West Lake and about 10 km from the lake itself. It served as the competition and training venue for golf at the Hangzhou Asian Games. The course covers roughly 700,000 sqm with 1,300 sqm of buildings, 18 holes and 7,039 yards from the black tees, the championship markers. Jack Nicklaus designed it, and it opened in 1997 as Zhejiang's earliest golf course and the only one approved by the State Council. Ringed by green hills, the fairways and greens are laid among lakes, woods and streams and follow the natural fall of the land, preserving as much of the original terrain as possible; bentgrass is used on the greens and Kentucky bluegrass on the fairways. Before the Games the turf, irrigation and drainage were rebuilt to a high standard so that green speed and smoothness met professional tournament requirements. During the 2023 Asian Games the course staged the men's individual, men's team, women's individual and women's team events, four gold medals. In May 2023 the West Lake International Open ran there as the test event, with 126 players from eight countries and regions. After the Games it remains Zhejiang's golf training base and a venue for professional and amateur tournaments, keeping its public practice facilities and coaching programmes; Zhijiang Road links the site to central Hangzhou, Zhuantang and Fuyang, with Yunqi Town and Tongjian Lake nearby. The club also keeps a practice range and practice greens, which the provincial squad uses for training camps.

address: 浙江省杭州市西湖区黄龙路1号（西起玉古路、东至黄龙路、北临天目山路、南至曙光路）
area_text: 占地约62公顷；体育场116,059㎡、体育馆22,271㎡、游泳跳水馆48,402㎡、室内训练馆18,606㎡、省老年体育活动中心10,449㎡、少儿体育馆（气膜）4,500㎡
intro_zh: 黄龙体育中心位于杭州市西湖区黄龙路1号，坐落在黄龙洞风景区以北，西起玉古路、东至黄龙路、北临天目山路、南至曙光路，占地约62公顷，是浙江省规模最大、使用率最高的城市中心体育场馆群。中心1994年启动建设，1997年6月动工，2000年10月主体育场落成，2003年9月体育馆竣工，此后“边建设、边运营”，陆续建成室内训练馆、省老年体育活动中心、少儿体育馆（气膜馆）、包玉刚游泳场、网球馆和室外笼式足球场、网球场、田径训练场。2019年12月至2021年12月，中心为杭州亚运会全面改造，改造总建筑面积约10.9万平方米，主体育场引进南方地区第一块锚固草坪，并成为全国第一座拥有上下两道环屏的体育场（上环约590米、下环约490米）。亚运会期间，体育场承办足球小组赛及决赛，体育馆承办竞技体操、艺术体操和蹦床，游泳跳水馆承办水球，亚残运会田径比赛也在体育场举行。赛后这里既是浙江队、浙江广厦男篮的主场，也是演唱会、展会与全民健身的主要场地，2024年起主体育场重新成为中超浙江队主场。中心内部以环形道路串联各馆，黄龙路、曙光路、天目山路三条城市主干道在此交汇，公交线路密集，步行即可到达黄龙洞景区与浙江大学玉泉校区。
intro_en: Yellow Dragon Sports Centre occupies No. 1 Huanglong Road in Xihu district, Hangzhou, north of the Huanglong Cave scenic area and bounded by Yugu Road to the west, Huanglong Road to the east, Tianmushan Road to the north and Shuguang Road to the south. Covering about 62 hectares, it is Zhejiang's largest and busiest downtown sports complex. Construction began in 1994 and work started on site in June 1997; the main stadium opened in October 2000 and the arena in September 2003, after which the centre kept building and operating at the same time, adding an indoor training hall, a senior citizens' sports centre, an air-supported children's hall, the Bao Yugang swimming pool, a tennis hall and outdoor caged football pitches, tennis courts and a training track. Between December 2019 and December 2021 the complex was rebuilt for the Hangzhou Asian Games, with about 109,000 sqm of floor area renovated: the stadium gained the first stitched hybrid pitch in southern China and became the country's first stadium with two full perimeter LED rings, about 590 m on the upper tier and 490 m on the lower. During the Games the stadium hosted football group matches and the final, the arena staged artistic and rhythmic gymnastics plus trampoline, and the aquatics hall hosted water polo; the stadium also held athletics at the Asian Para Games. Afterwards it remained the home of Zhejiang FC and the Zhejiang Guangsha basketball team and a main stage for concerts, exhibitions and public fitness, with the stadium returning to Chinese Super League duty in 2024. Ring roads link the halls inside the site, and Huanglong, Shuguang and Tianmushan roads meet here with dense bus services, within walking distance of Huanglong Cave and Zhejiang University's Yuquan campus.

address: 浙江省杭州市西湖区黄龙路1号（黄龙体育中心东北侧，东临黄龙路）
intro_zh: 黄龙体育中心体育馆位于杭州市西湖区黄龙路1号黄龙体育中心的东北侧，东临黄龙路，南接体育场主入口广场，西侧为体育中心30米宽的一环道和北大道，2003年9月建成投入使用，是中心“一场三馆”中的室内主馆。体育馆建筑面积22271平方米（亚运口径24489平方米），设观众席7922个（亚运口径8000个），比赛厅可布置篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球、体操、拳击、武术等项目的正式场地，也可转换为演唱会、晚会和展览空间。2019年至2021年亚运改造中，馆内更新了灯光、音响、斗屏与计时计分系统，增加无障碍座席和观众服务设施，满足体操比赛对场地平整度、器械吊点和背景光的要求。2023年杭州亚运会期间，这里承办竞技体操、艺术体操和蹦床三个分项，是亚运体操项目的主场馆。赛后体育馆成为CBA浙江广厦男篮的主场之一，同时承接国际篮球邀请赛、羽毛球公开赛、演唱会与品牌发布活动，与体育场、游泳跳水馆共享黄龙体育中心的停车、餐饮和商业配套；观众可经黄龙路、曙光路进入中心，公交黄龙体育中心站线路密集。
intro_en: The Yellow Dragon Sports Centre arena stands on the northeastern side of the complex at No. 1 Huanglong Road, Xihu district, Hangzhou, facing Huanglong Road to the east, the stadium's main entrance plaza to the south and the centre's 30 m inner ring road to the west, completed and opened in September 2003 as the main indoor hall of the one-stadium, three-halls group. It has 22,271 sqm of floor area, or 24,489 sqm under the Asian Games measurement, and 7,922 seats, 8,000 by the Games count. The competition hall can be set for basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, gymnastics, boxing and wushu, and converts into a concert, gala or exhibition space. During the 2019-2021 Asian Games renovation the lighting, sound, centre-hung screen and scoring systems were renewed and accessible seating and spectator services added, meeting gymnastics requirements for floor flatness, apparatus rigging points and background light. At the Hangzhou Asian Games the arena staged artistic gymnastics, rhythmic gymnastics and trampoline, the main gymnastics venue of the Games, and it also handled training during the Asian Para Games. Since then it has served as one of the home courts of the Zhejiang Guangsha team in the CBA and hosts international basketball invitation events, badminton opens, concerts and brand launches, sharing parking, catering and retail with the stadium and the aquatics hall. Spectators enter from Huanglong Road or Shuguang Road, with frequent buses at the Huanglong Sports Centre stop. The arena is one of the three competition halls in the complex, linked to the stadium and the aquatics hall by the centre's internal ring road.

address: 浙江省杭州市西湖区黄龙路1号（黄龙体育中心北端，紧邻包玉刚游泳场和体育馆）
area_text: 建筑面积48,402㎡（亚运口径48,442.9㎡）；泳池50米×25米，可转换为10道标准泳池，水深2米
intro_zh: 黄龙体育中心游跳馆（游泳跳水馆）位于杭州市西湖区黄龙路1号黄龙体育中心的北端，紧邻包玉刚游泳场和体育馆，2017年建成、2018年2月正式开馆，是中心场馆群里最年轻的大型室内馆。游跳馆总建筑面积48402平方米（亚运口径48442.9平方米），设观众席2250个（亚运口径2938个），馆内包含游泳比赛池、跳水比赛池和热身训练池，采用国际先进的拼装式泳池设计：比赛池长50米、宽25米，可通过池底板与内围板调整转换为10道标准泳池，水深2米、不设浅水区，池岸走道板、溢水槽和支架斜撑均为装配式构件，改造和转换效率高。2023年杭州亚运会期间，这里承办男女水球比赛，产生2枚金牌，赛时池岸加设水球球门、计时与转播设施。2022年7月10日起，游跳馆向市民开放，成为杭州夏季最受欢迎的公共泳池之一；2024年，二层游泳场地又改造为可打羽毛球、篮球的多功能运动场，实现“水上水下都能玩”。场馆与体育场、体育馆共享黄龙体育中心的环形道路、停车和商业配套，经黄龙路、曙光路均可进入。
intro_en: The aquatics hall of Yellow Dragon Sports Centre sits at the northern end of the complex at No. 1 Huanglong Road, Xihu district, Hangzhou, next to the Bao Yugang swimming pool and the arena. Completed in 2017 and opened in February 2018, it is the youngest large indoor hall in the group. It has 48,402 sqm of floor area, 48,442.9 sqm under the Asian Games measurement, and 2,250 seats, 2,938 by the Games count, with a competition pool, a diving pool and a warm-up pool. The pools use an advanced modular system: the racing pool measures 50 m by 25 m and can be reconfigured into a ten-lane standard course by adjusting floor panels and inner walls, with a constant 2 m depth and no shallow end, while deck plates, overflow gutters and bracing are all prefabricated for quick conversion. At the Hangzhou Asian Games the hall hosted the men's and women's water polo tournaments, two gold medals, with goals, timing and broadcast equipment added on the pool deck. From 10 July 2022 it opened to the public and became one of Hangzhou's most popular summer swimming venues; in 2024 the upper-floor pool area was converted into a multi-purpose court for badminton and basketball, so the building now works both in and out of the water. The hall shares the centre's ring road, parking and retail with the stadium and arena, reached from Huanglong Road or Shuguang Road. Its position at the northern edge of the site puts it closest to the Bao Yugang pool and the Tianmushan Road approach. The modular tanks were chosen so the hall could switch between competition, training and public swimming without rebuilding the pool structure.

address: 杭州市滨江区飞虹路3号
intro_zh: 杭州奥体中心体育场位于杭州市滨江区飞虹路3号，地处钱塘江南岸的奥体博览城，俗称“大莲花”，是杭州第19届亚运会、第4届亚残运会开闭幕式主会场，也是杭州从“西湖时代”迈向“钱塘江时代”的标志性工程。体育场占地430亩，建筑高度59.4米，总建筑面积21.6万平方米，地上六层、地下二层，固定座位80800个，是继“鸟巢”之后国内第二大体育场馆。看台首层为竞赛用房，二层设环形平台并与网球中心“小莲花”相连，五层有86个包厢，另有3000多平方米运动员热身馆和60米跑道；地下一层设杭州亚运会博物馆及非遗展示空间。建筑由28片大花瓣和27片小花瓣组成，花瓣间留白如中国传统景窗，立面采用穿孔铝镁锰板，孔径5毫米，兼顾采光与遮阳；钢结构用钢量约2.8万吨，比“鸟巢”少约1.4万吨；座椅自东向西由紫渐蓝，寓意“紫气东来”。交通方面，地铁6号线、7号线奥体中心站步行可达，周边公交、停车与慢行系统完善，场馆自2024年起全面向社会开放。体育场二层平台与“小莲花”网球中心、杭州亚运会博物馆及商业街区连通，形成可步行的一体化场馆群。
intro_en: Hangzhou Olympic Sports Center Stadium stands at 3 Feihong Road, Binjiang District, Hangzhou, on the south bank of the Qiantang River in the Olympic Sports Expo City. Known as the Big Lotus, it was the main venue for the opening and closing ceremonies of the 19th Asian Games and the 4th Asian Para Games, and it marks Hangzhou's shift from a West Lake-centred city to one oriented to the Qiantang. The stadium covers 430 mu, rises 59.4 m and has 216,000 sqm of gross floor area over six levels above ground and two below, with 80,800 fixed seats, making it the second-largest stadium in China after the Bird's Nest. The ground floor holds competition rooms, the second level forms a ring platform linked to the neighbouring Small Lotus tennis centre, the fifth level contains 86 boxes, and there is a 3,000 sqm warm-up hall with a 60 m track; the basement houses the Hangzhou Asian Games Museum and intangible heritage displays. The architecture is composed of 28 large and 27 small petals, with gaps between them like traditional Chinese window frames. The facade uses perforated aluminium-manganese panels with 5 mm holes for daylight and shading, and the steel structure weighs about 28,000 tonnes, some 14,000 tonnes less than the Bird's Nest. Seats shade from purple in the east to blue in the west, a motif meaning 'purple air coming from the east'. Metro Lines 6 and 7 stop at Olympic Sports Center, and the venue has been fully open to the public since 2024. A raised platform links the stadium with the Small Lotus tennis centre, the Hangzhou Asian Games Museum and the Linheli retail street, forming a walkable venue cluster.

address: 杭州市西湖区黄龙路1号
intro_zh: 黄龙体育中心体育场位于杭州市西湖区黄龙路1号，坐落在西子湖畔、黄龙体育中心西南侧，与浙江大学、浙江省图书馆、浙江世贸中心相邻，是杭州最知名的城市体育地标之一。体育场2000年10月建成，总建筑面积103338平方米，观众席位51971个，为亚运会足球项目决赛场地，也是中超浙江队的主场之一。场馆以巨大的悬挑钢罩棚覆盖东西看台，南北两端开敞，形成通透的碗形空间；2020年至2023年完成改造，更新草坪、跑道、灯光、音响与看台座椅，罩棚增设环屏与夜景照明，内场可承办足球、田径赛事，也可搭建舞台承接大型演唱会。黄龙体育中心整体还包含可容纳8000人的室内体育馆、游泳馆、网球馆及全民健身广场，是集比赛、演出、健身、商业于一体的场馆群。交通方面，地铁3号线、10号线黄龙体育中心站直达，周边有21路、23路、37路、82路、306路、307路等公交线路，紧邻黄龙路、曙光路城市主干道。体育场与体育馆、游泳馆、网球馆围合出中心广场，常年承接中超、演唱会与全民健身活动。
intro_en: Huanglong Sports Center Stadium is at 1 Huanglong Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, on the south-western side of the Huanglong sports complex beside West Lake and close to Zhejiang University, the Zhejiang Library and the Zhejiang World Trade Center. Completed in October 2000, it has 103,338 sqm of gross floor area and 51,971 seats, and served as the football final venue of the Asian Games; it is also one of the home grounds of Zhejiang FC in the Chinese Super League. A large cantilevered steel roof covers the east and west stands while the north and south ends stay open, creating a transparent bowl. Between 2020 and 2023 the stadium was renovated: the pitch, track, lighting, sound system and seats were renewed, ribbon screens and night lighting were added to the roof, and the field can now host football and athletics or be converted with a stage for concerts. The wider Huanglong Sports Center also includes an 8,000-seat indoor arena, a swimming hall, a tennis hall and a public fitness plaza, making it a mixed-use cluster for competition, performance, exercise and retail. Metro Lines 3 and 10 meet at Huanglong Sports Center station, and buses 21, 23, 37, 82, 306 and 307 serve the site, which sits on the Huanglong Road and Shuguang Road arterial roads with parking and good pedestrian access. The stadium, arena, swimming hall and tennis hall enclose a central plaza that stays busy with league matches, concerts and public fitness sessions through the year. Its position beside West Lake and the city centre makes it a hub for both sport and culture in Hangzhou.

address: 杭州市萧山区博奥路2657号（杭州奥体博览城内）
area_text: 占地22.79万㎡；体育馆与游泳馆“化蝶”双馆总建筑面积39.7万㎡，体育馆单体约7.45万㎡
intro_zh: 杭州奥体中心体育馆位于杭州市萧山区博奥路2657号，坐落在钱塘江南岸的杭州奥体博览城内，与主体育场“大莲花”、网球中心“小莲花”共同组成杭州亚运会的核心场馆群。体育馆与游泳馆连为一体，合称“化蝶”双馆，双馆占地22.79公顷，总建筑面积39.7万平方米，其中体育馆单体约7.45万平方米。馆内设1.8万个观众席，由1.5万个固定座位和3000个活动座位组成，是浙江省首个可实现“冰篮转换”的场馆，也是杭州唯一的室内万人体育馆。2023年杭州亚运会五人制篮球比赛在此举行；2023年至2026年，汇丰世界羽联世界巡回赛总决赛连续四届落户；CBA总决赛以及张学友、张惠妹、五月天等大型演唱会也在这里举办。建筑由北京市建筑设计研究院胡越工作室设计，外壳用钢2.5万吨、由2万多个钢构组成，靠钱塘江一侧的游泳馆高35米，靠城区一侧的体育馆高45米，流线形体量从空中看如蝴蝶展翅。亚运后场馆全面向市民开放，并引入商业运营，已转型为集赛演、运动、商业、生活于一体的城市文体综合体。交通方面，地铁6号线博览中心站B2口步行约220米即到，地铁6、7号线奥体中心站亦可到达，周边为博奥路、飞虹路路网。
intro_en: Hangzhou Olympic Sports Centre Gymnasium stands at 2657 Bo'ao Road in Xiaoshan District, inside the Hangzhou Olympic Expo City on the south bank of the Qiantang River, alongside the main stadium known as the Big Lotus and the tennis centre nicknamed the Little Lotus. The gymnasium and the aquatics centre are built as one connected structure, the pair called the Butterfly, occupying 22.79 hectares with a combined gross floor area of 397,000 sqm; the gymnasium alone accounts for about 74,500 sqm. It seats 18,000 spectators through 15,000 fixed and 3,000 retractable places, and was the first venue in Zhejiang able to switch between ice and basketball configurations, as well as the only indoor ten-thousand-seat arena in the city. Basketball at the 2023 Asian Games was played here, the BWF World Tour Finals have been staged here for four straight editions from 2023 to 2026, and CBA finals plus concerts by Jacky Cheung, A-Mei and Mayday have filled the hall. Designed by Hu Yue Studio of the Beijing Institute of Architectural Design, the shell consumed 25,000 tonnes of steel in more than 20,000 components; the aquatics wing by the river rises 35 m and the gymnasium 45 m, the streamlined mass reading as a pair of spreading wings from above. Since the Games the complex has opened fully to the public and added commercial operations, repositioning it as an urban sports, entertainment, retail and lifestyle destination. Metro Line 6 stops at Expo Centre station, about 220 m from exit B2, while Lines 6 and 7 serve Olympic Sports Centre station.

address: 湖北省武汉市硚口区解放大道612号（崇仁路路口）
area_text: 场地面积14,250㎡，建筑面积约1.45万㎡；馆外设足球场、篮球场、网球场，院内另有室内游泳馆和体操馆
intro_zh: 武汉体育馆位于武汉市硚口区解放大道612号、崇仁路路口，处在汉口解放大道沿线的核心地段，1956年建成投入使用，总投资160万元，是湖北省1949年以后首批兴建的大型综合体育馆，也是武汉最早的一座体育馆。场馆为苏式建筑风格，比赛厅设看台，可容纳3800名观众，场地面积14250平方米，建筑面积约1.45万平方米；馆内设有比赛厅、体操房、举重房、弹子房、舞蹈房、多种球类练习训练房和运动员休息室，馆外配套足球场、篮球场、网球场，院落中还有室内游泳馆和体操馆。1958年4月，毛泽东曾在馆内接见全国科技会议的与会人员；1985年10月，胡耀邦陪同齐奥塞斯库在此接见湖北省、武汉市党政领导干部。这里先后走出14位武汉籍奥运冠军和世界冠军，是武汉竞技体育的重要起点。2019年，武汉体育馆作为第七届世界军人运动会跆拳道比赛场馆完成维修改造；此前还承办过2015年全国青年击剑集训赛、2016年中国拳王争霸赛和2017—2018年中国乒乓球超级联赛。场馆2018年被列为武汉市优秀历史建筑，2023年12月被列为武汉市文物保护单位。观众可乘武汉地铁1号线至崇仁路站，或乘1路、79路、208路等公交至解放大道同济医院站。
intro_en: Wuhan Gymnasium stands at No. 612 Jiefang Avenue at the Chongren Road junction in Qiaokou district, Wuhan, on the city's main east-west artery in Hankou. Completed in 1956 at a cost of 1.6 million yuan, it was among the first large indoor sports halls built in Hubei after 1949 and the earliest in Wuhan. The building follows Soviet-era architectural conventions; its competition hall seats 3,800 spectators and covers 14,250 sqm of floor space within roughly 14,500 sqm of building area. Inside are the competition hall, gymnastics and weightlifting rooms, a billiards room, a dance studio, practice halls for several ball games and athletes' rooms; outside are football, basketball and tennis courts, plus an indoor swimming pool and a gymnastics hall in the compound. In April 1958 Mao Zedong met delegates to the national science conference here, and in October 1985 Hu Yaobang and Nicolae Ceausescu received Hubei and Wuhan officials in the hall. Fourteen Wuhan-born Olympic and world champions have come through its programmes, making it a starting point for the city's competitive sport. In 2019 the gymnasium was renovated as the taekwondo venue for the seventh CISM World Military Games, and it has also hosted the 2015 national youth fencing camp, the 2016 China boxing championship and the 2017-2018 China Table Tennis Super League. It was listed as a Wuhan outstanding historic building in 2018 and as a municipal cultural relic in December 2023. Metro Line 1 stops at Chongren Road, and buses on Jiefang Avenue serve the Tongji Hospital stop. The 14,250 sqm hall is large enough for basketball, volleyball, badminton and gymnastics, and it remains a public fitness and school-sport base for Qiaokou.

address: 武汉市武汉经济技术开发区（蔡甸区）车城北路58号
area_text: 总占地约1800亩（约120万㎡）；主体育场建筑面积8.04万㎡，体育馆建筑面积5.07万㎡
intro_zh: 武汉体育中心位于武汉市武汉经济技术开发区（蔡甸区）车城北路58号，处在沌口城市副中心的核心地带，是武汉对外文体交流的主要平台。中心总占地约1800亩，由“一场七馆一园三中心”构成，包括主体育场、体育馆、篮球馆、网球馆、游泳馆、击剑馆、全民健身中心南北两馆、武汉国际体育文化休闲园、国际体育文化交流中心、冰上运动中心和攀岩运动中心。主体育场建筑面积8.04万平方米，设56,201个座位，其中普通坐席54,289个、贵宾坐席466个、无障碍坐席120个、包厢1008个、媒体坐席318个，内场为带地下供热和自动喷灌的天然草坪，田径场为8条400米跑道加9条直道，面层采用意大利蒙多卷材。体育馆为1.3万座的综合馆，建筑面积5.07万平方米，内场两端各有一块59.61平方米的全彩LED屏，曾是华中地区最大单块屏。游泳馆设3,200余座，含10道标准比赛池、跳水池和5道恒温训练池。这里承办过2019年世界军人运动会开闭幕式、2007年女足世界杯、第六届全国城市运动会，也是武汉三镇队主场；2020年曾改造为方舱医院。交通上，地铁3号线与6号线在东风公司站换乘，出站步行可达，周边为东风大道与车城北路。
intro_en: Wuhan Sports Centre occupies 58 Checheng North Road in the Wuhan Economic and Technological Development Zone, at the heart of the Zhuankou sub-centre, and is the city's main platform for major sport and cultural events. The complex covers roughly 1,800 mu, about 1.2 million sqm, and is organised as one stadium, seven halls, a park and three centres: the main stadium, an indoor arena, basketball, tennis, swimming and fencing halls, two national fitness centres, an international sports culture and leisure park, an exchange centre, an ice sports centre and a climbing centre. The stadium has 80,445 sqm of floor area and 56,201 seats, split into 54,289 ordinary, 466 VIP, 120 accessible, 1,008 box and 318 media places, with a heated, automatically irrigated natural pitch and an eight-lane 400 m track plus nine sprint lanes surfaced in Italian Mondo rubber. The 13,000-seat arena covers 50,736 sqm and carries two 59.61 sqm full-colour LED screens, once the largest single screens in central China. The aquatics hall seats more than 3,200 around a ten-lane competition pool, a diving pool and a five-lane heated training pool. The centre hosted the opening and closing ceremonies of the 2019 Military World Games, matches of the 2007 Women's World Cup and the sixth National City Games, and is the home of Wuhan Three Towns; in 2020 it was converted into a makeshift hospital. Metro Lines 3 and 6 interchange at Dongfeng Company station, a short walk away. The centre reports more than 120 international and domestic events, some 50 conferences and exhibitions and over 200 ticketed concerts, drawing about five million visitors a year.

address: 武汉市东西湖区金山大道45号（临空港大道交会处）
area_text: 占地约207亩（约13.8万㎡）；总建筑面积约14.4万㎡，体育场单体4.01万㎡
intro_zh: 武汉五环体育中心位于武汉市东西湖区金山大道45号，处在临空港大道与金山大道的交会处，是为2019年第七届世界军人运动会新建的场馆群，旧称东西湖体育中心。中心占地约207亩，总建筑面积约14.4万平方米，由“一场两馆”加户外体育公园组成，整体呈飘带形，屋盖如展开双翅的凤凰，采用“中轴对称、一核两点”的品字形布局。体育场设3万个观众席，建筑面积4.01万平方米，内场草坪为天然草加人工草混播；体育馆7,559座，游泳馆1,090座。结构上首次在中国大陆体育场馆使用依自行车车轮原理研发的车辐式索承网格结构，同等规模下钢材用量最省。军运会期间承担足球、乒乓球和水上救生比赛，2019年至2022年为武汉长江足球俱乐部主场；赛后向市民开放，承办五月天连续四场、蔡依林、张韶涵、西城男孩等大型演出，并配套全民健身、文体培训等服务。交通方面，地铁6号线设五环体育中心站，D口出站步行约260米即达场馆，周边有金山大道、临空港大道两条城市主干道。
intro_en: Wuhan Five Rings Sports Centre sits at 45 Jinshan Avenue in Dongxihu District, where Jinshan Avenue meets Linkonggang Avenue. Built for the 7th Military World Games in 2019 and formerly called the Dongxihu Sports Centre, it covers about 207 mu, roughly 138,000 sqm, with some 144,000 sqm of floor space, arranged as a stadium, two indoor halls and an outdoor sports park. The complex reads as a flowing ribbon, its roof spreading like a phoenix in flight, laid out on a central axis with one core and two nodes in a triangular plan. The stadium seats 30,000 within 40,110 sqm and uses a mixed natural and artificial pitch; the arena holds 7,559 and the swimming hall 1,090. Structurally it was the first venue in mainland China to use a spoked-wheel cable-supported grid roof, developed from bicycle wheel geometry, which cuts steel consumption for a stadium of its size. During the Games it staged football, table tennis and water rescue; from 2019 to 2022 it was the home ground of Wuhan Yangtze River FC. Since then it has opened to the public and hosted four consecutive Mayday concerts plus shows by Jolin Tsai, Angela Chang and Westlife, alongside fitness programmes and sports training. Metro Line 6 has a Five Rings Sports Centre station about 260 m from exit D. The project cost about 1.99 billion yuan and was delivered as one of the newest venues of the Games, fitted with 5G and other new technology and surrounded by a public sports park that stays open to residents.

name_zh: 武汉光谷国际网球中心
address: 武汉市东湖新技术开发区佛祖岭一路2号（高新二路以南）
area_text: 占地约10.34万㎡（规划净用地13.6万㎡）
intro_zh: 武汉光谷国际网球中心位于武汉市东湖新技术开发区佛祖岭一路2号，在高新二路以南、武广高铁以东，毗邻二妃山，是武汉网球公开赛的举办地。中心2013年7月动工，2015年8月完工、9月启用，规划净用地约13.6万平方米，占地约10.34万平方米。场地由一座5层的15,000座中央球场、一座3层的5,000座1号球场、VIP服务楼、综合配套楼、4片室内备用场和6片标准室外硬地球场组成，中央球场配有可平移开启的屋顶，是国内平移式可开启屋顶面积最大的网球场馆。武汉网球公开赛自2014年起每年在此举行，属WTA巡回赛；2017年英雄联盟全球总决赛、2021年英雄联盟职业联赛春季赛总决赛也落地于此。非赛期场馆承接张学友、陈奕迅、林俊杰、刘若英等大型演唱会，是华中地区重要的演艺场地。建筑以流畅的白色屋面与开放式看台为特征，场馆灯光与声学按国际赛事标准配置。交通方面，场馆位于光谷南部，地铁2号线佛祖岭站为最近轨道交通站点，出站后可换乘公交或步行前往，周边为高新二路、佛祖岭一路路网。
intro_en: Wuhan Optics Valley International Tennis Centre stands at 2 Fozi Ling No.1 Road in the East Lake High-tech Development Zone, south of Gaoxin Second Road and east of the Wuhan-Guangzhou high-speed rail line, next to Erfei Hill. Construction began in July 2013, finished in August 2015 and the centre opened that September on a planned net site of about 136,000 sqm, with roughly 103,400 sqm occupied. It comprises a five-storey 15,000-seat centre court, a three-storey 5,000-seat No.1 court, a VIP building, a service building, four indoor backup courts and six standard outdoor hard courts. The centre court carries a sliding retractable roof, the largest of its kind among Chinese tennis venues. The Wuhan Open, part of the WTA Tour, has been held here every year since 2014; the 2017 League of Legends World Championship and the 2021 LPL Spring Final also used the venue. Outside the tennis season it hosts large concerts by artists such as Jacky Cheung, Eason Chan, JJ Lin and Rene Liu, making it a major performance site in central China. The architecture is defined by a flowing white roof and open stands, with competition-grade lighting and acoustics. The site lies in southern Optics Valley, with Metro Line 2 at Fozi Ling station as the nearest rail stop, from which buses or a short walk complete the trip. The Wuhan Open has become one of the leading hard-court stops on the WTA Tour in Asia, and the centre's courts, fitness areas and booking system are open to the public outside tournament weeks.

address: 广东省汕尾市红海湾经济开发区遮浪半岛（广东海上项目训练中心）
area_text: 占地约10万平方米（广东海上项目训练中心）
capacity_text: 公开资料未公布固定座位数（海上竞赛场地）
intro_zh: 广东海上运动场位于汕尾市红海湾经济开发区遮浪半岛，由广东海上项目训练中心（原广东红海湾国际海上运动俱乐部）管理运营。中心2007年9月经广东省机构编制委员会批准设立，2008年3月挂牌，隶属广东省体育局，同时负责潮阳海门帆板基地，职能是保障全省帆船帆板训练，并为国内外赛事提供场地与后勤服务。场地占地约10万平方米，拥有标准竞赛海域和陆上保障区，配套运动员公寓、可容纳500人的餐厅和会议室，2025年完成维修改造及信息化建设，并于3月通过验收。遮浪半岛东、西两侧常年一边波涛汹涌、一边风平浪静，全年都可开展帆船帆板训练比赛，是广东乃至全国著名的海上运动基地。这里举办过1996年亚太地区帆船帆板锦标赛暨奥运精英赛、广东省八运会帆板帆船赛、第九届全国运动会帆板帆船赛、2010年广州亚运会帆船比赛和2014年第14届亚洲帆船赛，2025年第十五届全国运动会帆船项目也于10月在此开赛。汕尾全市拥有455.2公里海岸线、2.39万平方公里海域和881个海岛，红海湾与品清湖构成优质水上运动水域，场馆因此成为城市“帆船之都”名片的核心载体。
intro_en: Guangdong Sea Sports Ground occupies the Zhelang peninsula in Honghai Bay, Shanwei, and is run by the Guangdong Sea Sports Training Center, formerly the Guangdong Honghai Bay International Sea Sports Club. The center was approved by the provincial staffing committee in September 2007, opened in March 2008 and reports to the Guangdong Provincial Sports Bureau; it also manages the Haimen windsurfing base in Chaoyang and is responsible for provincial sailing and windsurfing training as well as staging domestic and international regattas. The site covers about 100,000 square metres, with a standard race area offshore and a support zone on land that includes athletes' apartments, a dining hall for 500 people and meeting rooms; a renovation and digital upgrade was completed and accepted in March 2025. Zhelang is unusual in that one side of the peninsula is usually rough while the other stays calm, so sailing and windsurfing can run all year, which is why it became one of China's best-known sea sports bases. It has hosted the 1996 Asia-Pacific sailing and windsurfing championships and Olympic elite regatta, provincial and national games windsurfing events, the sailing competition of the 2010 Guangzhou Asian Games and the 14th Asian Sailing Championship in 2014. The sailing programme of the 15th National Games opened here in October 2025. Shanwei has 455.2 kilometres of coastline, 23,900 square kilometres of sea and 881 islands, and Honghai Bay together with Pinqing Lake gives the city the water it needs to promote itself as a sailing capital. In the off-season the center remains a training base for provincial sailing and windsurfing squads.

address: 辽宁省沈阳市铁西区重工北街66号
area_text: 占地14万平方米、建筑面积3.5万平方米（另有资料记占地约9万平方米）
intro_zh: 沈阳铁西体育场位于铁西区重工北街66号，2006年6月30日开工，2008年6月竣工，占地14万平方米、建筑面积3.5万平方米，投资约1.2亿元，最初是为2008年北京奥运会足球赛配套的备用比赛场，看台设28815个座位。它曾是辽宁足球俱乐部的主场（2008至2013年、2016至2019年），2019年11月打完中甲升降级附加赛后随辽足解散而闲置，一度不对外开放。2025年初，沈阳启动改扩建（媒体2月报道，百科记3月动工），向下开挖、重做基础配套，把跑道改为草地覆盖，更换彩色大屏和全部座椅，5月竣工，5月31日以辽宁铁人主场身份重开，首战1比0战胜石家庄功夫，现场涌入37589名球迷。改造后成为沈阳首座专业足球场，可容纳约4万人，看台紧贴球场，观赛视野与声浪都更接近欧洲专业球场。2025赛季辽宁铁人在这里提前两轮冲超成功，这座“主场福地”重新回到中国足球顶级联赛的版图；场地日常也承接训练、青少年赛事和全民健身活动，成为铁西老工业区更新中少有的大型公共空间。
intro_en: Shenyang Tiexi Stadium at 66 Zhonggong North Street was started on 30 June 2006 and completed in June 2008 at a cost of about 120 million yuan, covering 140,000 square metres with 35,000 square metres of building floor area. It was built as a backup match venue for the 2008 Beijing Olympic football tournament and originally held 28,815 seats. The stadium served as the home of Liaoning FC from 2008 to 2013 and again from 2016 to 2019; after a relegation play-off in November 2019 it fell idle as the club dissolved and was closed to the public for a period. In early 2025 Shenyang began a rebuild, excavating the bowl, renewing services, replacing the running track with grass and installing a colour screen and new seats. Work finished in May and the ground reopened on 31 May as the home of Liaoning Tieren, who beat Shijiazhuang Kungfu 1-0 in front of 37,589 spectators. It is now Shenyang's first football-specific stadium, seating about 40,000 with stands close to the pitch, giving the sightlines and noise of a European club ground. In the 2025 season Tieren clinched promotion to the Chinese Super League with two rounds to spare, bringing top-flight football back to the city. The venue also hosts training, youth matches and public fitness sessions, and stands as one of the few large public spaces created in the renewal of the Tiexi industrial district. Its reopening also restored public access to a ground that had been closed for several years.

address: 辽宁省沈阳市浑南区浑南中路32号
area_text: 占地约6.8万平方米
intro_zh: 辽宁体育馆位于浑南区浑南中路32号，是沈阳奥体中心的配套工程，2007年动工、2010年竣工，占地约6.8万平方米，由主馆综合体育馆和副馆多功能热身训练馆组成，可容纳约1.2万名观众，具备承办国际A级赛事的能力，现因冠名又称三生制药体育馆。老辽宁体育馆在和平区青年大街288号，1974年7月动工、1975年10月竣工，因体量庞大被市民叫作“大馆”，承载了上世纪八九十年代沈阳的大型赛事与演出记忆；因严重老化，2007年4月12日被爆破拆除，原址后来建成沈阳万象城。新馆2018年进行大规模改造以符合CBA联赛要求，同年辽宁男篮把主场迁回沈阳，此后这里成为球队主场，CBA的辽粤、辽京对决常在此上演，主场氛围以全场站立、统一助威著称。除篮球外，场馆也承办排球、乒乓球、羽毛球、体操等赛事和演唱会、发布会，副馆用于训练与群众健身，与一街之隔的奥体中心体育场共同构成浑南的赛事片区。
intro_en: Liaoning Gymnasium at 32 Hunnan Middle Road in Hunnan District was built as part of the Shenyang Olympic Sports Center, started in 2007 and completed in 2010. It covers about 68,000 square metres and consists of a main arena and a multi-purpose warm-up hall, seating roughly 12,000 and capable of hosting Grade A international events; a naming deal now brands it Sansheng Pharmaceutical Gymnasium. The original Liaoning Gymnasium stood at 288 Qingnian Avenue in Heping District, begun in July 1974 and finished in October 1975. Known to locals as the Big Hall, it carried the city's major indoor events and concerts through the 1980s and 1990s, but advanced deterioration led to its controlled demolition on 12 April 2007; the MixC shopping centre now occupies the site. The new arena was extensively refurbished in 2018 to meet CBA requirements, and Liaoning's men's basketball team moved its home games back to Shenyang that year. The hall is now the team's home court, where the Liaoning-Guangdong and Liaoning-Beijing fixtures regularly sell out and the crowd stands and chants throughout. Beyond basketball it stages volleyball, table tennis, badminton, gymnastics, concerts and product launches, while the warm-up hall serves training and public fitness. Together with the Olympic stadium across the road it forms the Hunnan events district. The club has won several CBA titles with this hall as its home, and the arena also stages national team warm-up games and youth tournaments, remaining the largest indoor venue in Shenyang for basketball and entertainment and a regular public fitness venue.

name_zh: 沈阳奥林匹克体育中心
address: 辽宁省沈阳市浑南区浑南中路30号
intro_zh: 沈阳奥林匹克体育中心位于沈阳市浑南区核心区，具体地址为浑南中路30号，东临天成街、西至天坛街、南临浑南大道、北至浑南四路，与沈阳故宫处在同一条城市景观轴线上。中心采用“一场三馆”布局：主体育场即五里河体育场，另有可容纳1万人的综合体育馆、4000人的游泳馆和4000人的网球馆。五里河体育场于2007年6月建成，占地25.33公顷，总建筑面积115562平方米，设两层观众看台，两层之间布置102个贵宾包厢，可容纳6万名观众，并配有残疾人坐席、专用电梯与通道；场地为国际足联、国际田联双标准的天然草坪足球场加400米塑胶跑道，南北两侧各有一块192.6平方米的全彩LED屏，东北、西北另设两片带灯光与看台的足球训练场。建筑以舒缓曲线的大屋顶为特征，屋面如自天空落于绿色山丘的轻盈翅膀，与周边水体、绿地相互呼应，工程先后获得鲁班奖和钢结构金刚奖，并创造多项国内第一。这里承办过2008年北京奥运会足球赛、2013年第十二届全运会开幕式与田径比赛、2024年世预赛亚洲区中泰之战，也常年承接大型演出并免费向公众开放园区。交通方面，地铁2号线、9号线在奥体中心站交汇，浑南大道、青年大街南延线构成立体路网。
intro_en: Shenyang Olympic Sports Center lies in the core of Hunnan District at No. 30 Hunnan Middle Road, bounded by Tiancheng Street to the east, Tiantan Street to the west, Hunnan Avenue to the south and Hunnan Fourth Road to the north, on the same ceremonial axis as the Shenyang Imperial Palace. The complex follows a one-stadium, three-halls plan: the Wulihe Stadium, a 10,000-seat arena, a 4,000-seat swimming hall and a 4,000-seat tennis hall. Wulihe Stadium was completed in June 2007 on a 25.33 ha site with 115,562 sqm of floor area, two spectator tiers separated by 102 VIP boxes, and 60,000 seats, with dedicated disabled seating, lifts and ramps. The pitch is natural turf with a 400 m synthetic track built to FIFA and World Athletics standards, two 192.6 sqm full-colour LED screens face the field, and two floodlit training pitches with stands sit to the northeast and northwest. The building is known for its softly curved roof, described as a light wing settling on green hills and tuned to the surrounding water and planting; the project won the Luban Prize and the national steel structure Jinguang Award and set several domestic firsts. It hosted football at the 2008 Beijing Olympics, the opening ceremony and athletics of the 12th National Games in 2013 and the China-Thailand World Cup qualifier in 2024, and regularly stages concerts while keeping its grounds free to the public. Metro Lines 2 and 9 meet at Olympic Sports Center station, with Hunnan Avenue and the southern extension of Qingnian Avenue forming the road network.

name_zh: 山东省体育中心体育场
address: 山东省济南市市中区经十路20286号
area_text: 省体育中心总占地约84.2公顷；体育场建筑面积未单独公布
intro_zh: 山东省体育中心体育场位于济南市市中区经十路20286号，1987年动工、1988年启用，是山东省体育中心场馆群的核心，济南人习惯称它“省体”。体育场设4万个座位（不同资料另有43700、55000等口径），场地110米×72米，铺天然草皮，建成时配有4座高55米、重60吨的照明灯塔，是当时亚洲最高、最重的体育场灯塔。1988年第一届全国城市运动会在这里开幕，2004年亚洲杯足球赛小组赛、2009年第十一届全国运动会部分足球比赛也在此进行；1994至2012年，这里是山东鲁能泰山队的主场，见证了甲A与中超的多个赛季，2024年济南兴洲解散前也以此为主场。除足球外，场地承办过上百场文艺演出，张惠妹等歌手都曾在此开唱。体育场常年对公众开放，早晨是周边居民跑步、打太极和放风筝的地方；它与相邻的体育馆、游泳馆、网球馆共同构成经十路沿线的全民健身带，也是济南举办大型赛事和演艺活动的传统选择。体育场周边聚集了省体育局等机构，训练、赛事与市民健身在同一片街区里交错进行。
intro_en: Shandong Provincial Stadium at 20,286 Jingshi Road in Shizhong District, Jinan, broke ground in 1987 and opened in 1988 as the centrepiece of the Shandong Provincial Sports Center, known locally simply as Shengti. It seats 40,000, though other sources give 43,700 or 55,000, and the pitch measures 110 by 72 metres on natural grass. When built it carried four floodlight towers 55 metres tall and weighing 60 tonnes each, the tallest and heaviest stadium lighting masts in Asia at the time. The stadium hosted the opening of the first National City Games in 1988, group matches of the 2004 AFC Asian Cup and part of the football programme of the 11th National Games in 2009. From 1994 to 2012 it was the home of Shandong Luneng Taishan through the Jia-A and Chinese Super League seasons, and Jinan Xingzhou played here until the club dissolved in 2024. Beyond football the ground has staged more than a hundred concerts and shows, including A-Mei. It stays open to the public all year and is a morning gathering place for runners, tai chi groups and kite flyers. Together with the neighbouring gymnasium, swimming hall and tennis centre it forms a fitness belt along Jingshi Road and remains the city's default venue for major sport and entertainment events, with provincial sports bodies clustered in the same block. The stadium is owned by the Shandong provincial government, and between 2002 and 2003 a further 83 million yuan was spent on renovation. Its capacity has been quoted differently over the years.

name_zh: 济南奥林匹克体育中心体育馆
address: 山东省济南市历下区经十东路（龙洞片区，济南奥体中心场馆区东部）
area_text: 体育馆占地3.1公顷、建筑面积5.9万平方米；奥体中心总占地81公顷、总建筑面积约35万平方米
intro_zh: 济南奥林匹克体育中心体育馆位于历下区经十东路龙洞片区，是第十一届全国运动会的主场馆之一，也是奥体中心“东荷西柳”布局中的“东荷”。奥体中心2006年5月28日奠基、2009年建成，占地81公顷、总建筑面积约35万平方米，包含6万座体育场、体育馆、网球馆和游泳馆。体育馆占地3.1公顷，楼高6层，建筑面积5.9万平方米，可容纳1万至1.2万名观众（维基百科记1万座，官网记1.2万座席），2009年4月20日竣工，两个月后承办全国体操锦标赛，这是馆内首场赛事；十一运期间它是体操、蹦床和闭幕式的主场馆。建筑以济南市花荷花为母题，由下向上层叠出花瓣状肌理，与西侧柳叶造型的体育场遥相呼应。体育馆由主馆和南北两个附属训练馆组成，主馆可布置体操、篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球和演出舞台，训练馆用于热身和群众健身。如今场馆09:00至21:00开放，接受场地预约，是济南东部城区赛事、演出和全民健身的主要室内场地，也是奥体片区“一场三馆”运营中最活跃的一馆。
intro_en: The gymnasium of Jinan Olympic Sports Center stands in the Longdong area of Jingshi East Road, Lixia District, and was one of the main venues of the 11th National Games. It is the eastern lotus of the center's East Lotus, West Willow layout. The Olympic center was founded on 28 May 2006 and completed in 2009, covering 81 hectares with about 350,000 square metres of floor space and comprising a 60,000-seat stadium, the gymnasium, a tennis hall and a swimming hall. The gymnasium occupies 3.1 hectares, rises six storeys and has 59,000 square metres of floor area, seating 10,000 to 12,000 spectators depending on the source, with the encyclopedia giving 10,000 and the operator's website 12,000. It was completed on 20 April 2009 and hosted the national gymnastics championships two months later as its first event; during the National Games it staged gymnastics, trampoline and the closing ceremony. The architecture takes the lotus, Jinan's city flower, as its motif, stacking petal-like layers upwards in dialogue with the willow-leaf stadium to the west. The building consists of a main hall and two attached training halls to the north and south; the main hall can be set up for gymnastics, basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis or a stage, while the training halls serve warm-ups and public fitness. Open from 09:00 to 21:00 and available for booking, it is the busiest indoor venue in Jinan's eastern district for sport, concerts and everyday exercise. The center is operated under the Jinan Culture and Tourism Development Group.

name_zh: 济南奥林匹克体育中心
address: 山东省济南市历下区经十东路（龙洞地区，燕山新区东部）
area_text: 占地81公顷（约81万㎡），总建筑面积约35万㎡；体育场建筑面积13.1万㎡
intro_zh: 济南奥林匹克体育中心位于济南市历下区经十东路，处在东部燕山新区龙洞地区，是第十一届全国运动会的主会场，也是济南投资规模最大、功能最完备的体育设施。项目总占地面积81公顷（约81万平方米），总建筑面积约35万平方米，总投资约35亿元，2006年5月奠基、2009年5月建成投用，由“一场三馆”构成：6万座席体育场、1.2万座席体育馆、4000座席网球馆和4000座席游泳馆，另设约6万平方米中心区平台广场。总体布局取“东荷西柳”的济南意象：西侧体育场呈柳叶造型，建筑面积13.1万平方米、占地6.6万平方米，看台罩棚以钢结构骨架撑起舒展的叶片曲面；东侧体育馆、网球馆与游泳馆组合为荷花形态，罩棚分瓣展开，夜间泛光如荷塘。三馆之间以平台与景观轴串联，赛时可分区疏散，赛后向市民开放游泳、羽毛球、网球、冰上等项目，并承接大型演唱会与展会。作为全运会主场馆，这里举办过开幕式、田径与足球赛事，也是山东泰山队曾经的主场之一，周边经十东路沿线聚集了政务、商务与居住功能，是济南东部的城市副中心。交通方面，场馆经经十东路、奥体中路进出，公交线路密集，规划地铁线路在奥体片区设站，自驾可快速接入经十路快速路与绕城高速。
intro_en: Jinan Olympic Sports Center runs along Jingshi East Road in Lixia District, in the Longdong area of the eastern Yanshan New District. It was the main venue of the 11th National Games and is Jinan's largest and most complete sports investment. The 81 ha site carries about 350,000 sqm of floor area for a cost of roughly 3.5 billion yuan; ground was broken in May 2006 and the complex opened in May 2009. Its one-stadium, three-halls programme comprises a 60,000-seat stadium, a 12,000-seat arena, a 4,000-seat tennis hall and a 4,000-seat swimming hall, plus a central podium plaza of some 60,000 sqm. The masterplan takes the local imagery of east lotus, west willow: the stadium on the west is shaped as a willow leaf, covering 131,000 sqm of floor area on a 66,000 sqm footprint, its roof lifted by a steel skeleton into a spreading blade-like surface, while the arena, tennis hall and swimming hall on the east form a lotus with petals opening around the concourse and glowing over the water gardens at night. Podiums and landscape axes tie the halls together, allowing separate event-day circulation and, after the Games, public access to swimming, badminton, tennis and ice sports alongside concerts and exhibitions. As the National Games main venue it staged the opening ceremony, athletics and football, and it served as a home ground for Shandong Taishan. The Jingshi East Road corridor around it has become an eastern civic and business sub-centre of Jinan, served by dense bus routes, planned metro stations in the Olympic district and quick links to the Jingshi expressway and the ring road.

address: 海南省海口市秀英区长秀片区长滨路东侧（五源河文体中心二期，长滨路与文体中心中路一带）
area_text: 总建筑面积78,179㎡；用地88.43亩（约5.9万㎡），建筑占地30,707㎡；地上6层、地下1层，建筑高度47.6米
capacity_text: 18,000（固定座椅约13,000、活动看台约4,000、可移动座椅500余）
intro_zh: 海口五源河体育馆位于海口市秀英区长秀片区，长滨路东侧，是五源河文体中心的二期工程，与一期五源河体育场共同组成海口西海岸的体育赛事中心。项目2019年6月12日开工，总投资约10.65亿元，总建筑面积78179平方米，用地88.43亩，建筑占地30707平方米，地上局部6层、地下1层，建筑高度47.6米。场馆造型取自海南传统船型屋和渔船，外立面以椰子叶形状组合，夜间泛光可变换多种颜色。馆内设1.8万个观众座席，分三层环绕布置，其中固定座椅约1.3万个、活动看台约4000个，另配500余个可移动座椅；场地采用活动地板，可在篮球、排球、手球、乒乓球、羽毛球、体操、举重、摔跤、拳击与冰球、花样滑冰、短道速滑之间转换，并设中央斗屏和环屏。2024年12月28日，WBO/WBC职业拳王争霸赛成为这里的第一场比赛；此后场馆承办2025年中国女篮热身赛、2026年国际篮联国际团结杯和2026年乒乓球亚洲杯等赛事。场馆与体育场共享长滨路、文体中心中路的交通与停车资源，周边配套近300个停车位，是海口举办国际单项赛事和大型演艺活动的主要室内场地。
intro_en: Wuyuanhe Gymnasium stands on the east side of Changbin Road in the Changxiu area of Xiuying district, Haikou, the second phase of the Wuyuanhe Cultural and Sports Centre and the indoor partner to the 41,506-seat stadium next door.
