Construction began on 12 June 2019 at a cost of about 1.065 billion yuan, and the building opened on 28 December 2024 with a WBO/WBC professional boxing card. It covers 78,179 sqm of floor area on an 88.43-mu site, with a 30,707 sqm footprint, one basement level and up to six storeys above ground, rising 47.6 m. The design borrows the curve of Hainan's traditional boat-shaped houses and fishing boats, with a facade composed of coconut-leaf forms and a night lighting scheme that changes colour. Inside, 18,000 spectators sit on three surrounding tiers: roughly 13,000 fixed seats, 4,000 retractable seats and more than 500 movable chairs. The playing floor is demountable, so the hall converts between basketball, volleyball, handball, table tennis, badminton, gymnastics, weightlifting, wrestling and boxing on the one hand, and ice hockey, figure skating and short-track speed skating on the other. A central four-sided scoreboard and a perimeter LED ring serve the upper tiers. Since opening it has staged the 2025 China women's basketball warm-up against Australia, the 2026 FIBA International Solidarity Cup and the 2026 ITTF-ATTU Asian Cup. Parking for about 300 cars is provided, and the gymnasium shares the Changbin Road and Wenti Zhongxin Middle Road access with the stadium, forming a combined events cluster on Haikou's west coast. The building has six exits, four at ground level and two platforms on the second floor, with lifts serving the upper tiers, and a separate VIP access route runs directly to the boxes.

address: 海南省海口市龙华区滨海大道36号（万绿园东侧、世纪大桥西侧）
intro_zh: 海口体育馆位于海口市龙华区滨海大道36号，东邻世纪大桥，西靠万绿园，处在海口湾沿线的城市核心地段。场馆1994年建成投入使用，占地约4.2万平方米，建筑面积15020平方米，主馆设3408个观众席，是海口较早建成并持续使用的大型综合体育馆，也是海口市标志性公共建筑之一。比赛厅可布置篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球、体操、拳击等室内项目，也可搭台举办文艺演出、展览和群众活动；馆外广场开阔、灯光充足，常年承担全民健身、文体集市和节庆活动。场馆地处滨海大道主干道，公交线路密集，步行可达万绿园、海口湾和世纪公园，周边酒店、餐饮和商业配套成熟。海口体育馆是滨海大道沿线重要的公共活动节点；近年场馆在保留体育功能的同时引入文化展示等业态，使这座老馆在市中心继续承担体育、文化和公共活动功能，并与西海岸的五源河文体中心形成新旧两代的场馆分工。
intro_en: Haikou Gymnasium occupies No. 36 Binhai Avenue in Longhua district, Haikou, between Century Bridge to the east and Evergreen Park to the west, on the city's seafront boulevard. Completed and opened in 1994, it covers about 42,000 sqm of land with 15,020 sqm of floor area, and its main hall seats 3,408 spectators. It is one of the earliest large indoor halls built in Haikou and has remained in continuous public use, a landmark of the city's central waterfront. The competition hall can be set for basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, gymnastics and boxing, and converts for stage performances, exhibitions and civic events; the forecourt is broad and floodlit and carries fitness sessions, sports markets and festival programmes through the year. The site sits on Binhai Avenue with dense bus services and is surrounded by hotels, restaurants and retail. In recent years the building has added cultural exhibition space alongside sport, so the hall continues to serve sport, culture and public events in the city centre while the newer Wuyuanhe complex on the west coast takes the largest international fixtures, giving Haikou two generations of venues with different roles. The hall and its forecourt form part of the Binhai Avenue civic and leisure belt with Evergreen Park and Haikou Bay, and the site remains a main indoor venue for mass sport and cultural events in the old city. It is used for sports competitions, performances and public exhibitions throughout the year, and its forecourt hosts community fitness in the mornings and evenings. Its 1994 opening predates the Wuyuanhe complex by more than two decades, so it carries the city's earlier generation of indoor sport.

name_zh: 五源河文体中心体育场
address: 海南省海口市秀英区长流新区长滨路东侧（五源河文化体育中心内）
area_text: 体育场用地约27万平方米、建筑面积约9万至10万平方米；文体中心整体用地406公顷、总建筑面积50.28万平方米
intro_zh: 五源河文体中心体育场位于海口市秀英区长流新区长滨路东侧，是海口五源河文化体育中心首批建成的项目，2017年3月开工、2018年4月28日启用，由德国gmp建筑师事务所与UDG联创国际联合设计，业主为绿地集团。体育场设41424个座位（维基百科记41506个），建筑面积约9万平方米，用地约27万平方米，是海南省第一座甲级体育场。看台采用西高东低的造型，主看台朝东北方向的大海与体育公园展开，把最有价值的西侧座位留给海景；半月形索膜屋面覆盖西看台，可呼吸式幕墙兼顾遮阳避雨与通风，适应海口强日照和台风气候，建成时达到绿色建筑二星标准。文体中心整体规划用地406公顷、总建筑面积50.28万平方米，除体育场外还布局体育馆、游泳跳水馆、网球馆、沙滩竞训中心、文化展览馆和音乐厅等“一场八馆”。这里既是2022年中超联赛海口赛区的比赛场地，也是海口演艺经济的主舞台：张学友2018年在此开唱，华晨宇2019年连开三天、观众超过10万人，周杰伦2023年四天吸引15.46万人次、带动旅游收入9.76亿元。
intro_en: Wuyuan River Sports Center Stadium stands on the east side of Changbin Road in Changliu New Area, Xiuying District, Haikou, as the first completed element of the Wuyuan River cultural and sports center. Construction began in March 2017 and the stadium opened on 28 April 2018; it was designed by gmp Architekten with UDG and built for Greentown Group. With 41,424 seats according to the architect and 41,506 according to the encyclopedia, about 90,000 square metres of floor area and a 270,000 square metre site, it is the first Grade A stadium in Hainan. The stands rise higher on the west than the east so that the best seats face the sea and the sports park to the northeast. A crescent-shaped cable-and-membrane roof covers the western stand, and a breathing facade provides shade and rain cover while admitting air, a response to Haikou's strong sun and typhoon climate that helped the project earn a two-star Chinese green building label. The wider center is planned over 406 hectares with 502,800 square metres of floor space and includes a gymnasium, diving and swimming hall, tennis hall, beach training center, exhibition hall and concert hall, the so-called one stadium and eight halls. The ground served as Haikou's hub for the 2022 Chinese Super League season and has become the city's main concert stage: Jacky Cheung performed in 2018, Hua Chenyu played three nights to more than 100,000 people in 2019, and Jay Chou's four shows in 2023 drew 154,600 spectators and 976 million yuan in tourism revenue.

address: 海南省海口市秀英区长滨路五源河文体中心内
area_text: 用地约27万平方米、建筑面积约10万平方米，开放场地面积约17万平方米
intro_zh: 海口五源河体育场即五源河体育中心体育场，位于海口市秀英区长滨路五源河文体中心内，2018年4月28日正式启用，是海南第一座甲级体育场，可举办全国性赛事、单项国际比赛和大型文化活动，填补了海南长期缺少大型综合体育设施的空白。体育场拥有约4.1万个座席，建筑面积约10万平方米，用地约27万平方米，西高东低的看台与半月形索膜屋面让观众在看球的同时望见海面。2022年它作为中超联赛海口赛区场馆投入使用；2024年9月台风“摩羯”过境，屋面在强风中受损，此后进入修复与运营调整。日常运营由海南体育之窗文化传播有限公司负责，2025年5月起向社会免费或低收费开放，全年开放不少于330天，开放面积约17万平方米，A广场、乒乓球室、体质检测室、健身中心、主场和训练场都在免费清单内，团队使用主场或训练场草坪须提前一天预约。作为海口西海岸的地标，它把赛事、演唱会和日常健身放在同一片场地：周杰伦、坎耶·维斯特等演唱会都曾在此举行，周边餐饮、酒店和商业体随之生长。
intro_en: Haikou Wuyuan River Stadium, formally the stadium of Wuyuan River Sports Center, opened on 28 April 2018 inside the Wuyuan River complex on Changbin Road, Xiuying District. It is Hainan's first Grade A stadium, able to host national competitions, single-sport international events and large cultural productions, and it filled a long-standing gap in the island's major sports infrastructure. The ground has about 41,000 seats, roughly 100,000 square metres of floor area and a site of about 270,000 square metres. Its stands are higher on the west, and the crescent cable-membrane roof leaves spectators with a view of the sea as well as the pitch. In 2022 it served as Haikou's venue for the Chinese Super League. In September 2024 Typhoon Yagi tore through the roof, and the stadium subsequently moved into repair and operational adjustment. Day-to-day management sits with Hainan Sports Window Culture Communication, which has opened the ground free of charge or at low cost since May 2025 for at least 330 days a year, with about 170,000 square metres of open space including Plaza A, a table tennis room, a fitness testing room, a gym, the main pitch and the training pitch; teams must book the grass a day ahead. As a west-coast landmark the stadium combines sport, concerts and daily exercise on one site, with Jay Chou and Kanye West among those who have performed there and restaurants, hotels and retail growing around it. Concerts alone have drawn tens of thousands of visitors to the west coast in a single weekend.

address: 浙江省温州市鹿城区民航路6号（温州体育中心内）
intro_zh: 温州体育中心体育场位于温州市鹿城区民航路6号，是温州体育中心的主体育场。温州体育中心1995年兴建，体育场1997年建成投入使用，占地57422.81平方米，建筑面积14843.52平方米，看台设15192个座席，场内为400米标准塑胶跑道和天然草坪足球场。为承办杭州第19届亚运会女足小组赛，体育场于2020年至2022年实施提升改造，工程总投资约6481.26万元，更新草坪、喷灌、排水、灯光和竞赛功能用房；草坪下安装18个传感器，可监测根部温度、湿度、酸碱度和氮磷钾含量，实现智能养草；场地四周设8根升降式灯杆，每根高53米、重19吨，共配296套LED体育照明灯具，满足亚运高清转播和日常全民健身的调光需求。2023年亚运会期间，这里与温州奥体中心体育场共同承担女足小组赛。赛后体育场恢复常态化运营，内场晨晚练、外围跑道和全民健身区域向市民开放，周边商铺及场内承租户恢复营业；依托市中心区位，场地继续承办足球赛、田径比赛、演唱会和展会，是温州使用频率最高的公共体育场之一。
intro_en: Wenzhou Sports Center Stadium stands at No. 6 Minhang Road in Lucheng district, Wenzhou, the main outdoor ground of the Wenzhou Sports Center. The centre was built from 1995 and the stadium opened in 1997, covering 57,422.81 sqm of land with 14,843.52 sqm of floor area and 15,192 seats. Its 400 m synthetic track surrounds a natural-turf football pitch. Ahead of the Hangzhou Asian Games the stadium was renovated between 2020 and 2022 at a cost of about 64.8 million yuan, with new turf, irrigation, drainage, lighting and competition facilities. Eighteen sensors buried in the pitch monitor root temperature, moisture, acidity and nutrient levels, an example of what the city calls smart turf management, and eight retractable floodlight masts, each 53 m tall and 19 tonnes, carry 296 LED sports luminaires that can be dimmed between broadcast, match and public-fitness modes. During the 2023 Asian Games the ground shared the women's football group matches with the Wenzhou Olympic Sports Center Stadium. Afterwards it returned to normal operation: the infield is open for morning and evening exercise, the perimeter track and public fitness areas are free to residents, and the shops and tenants around the concourse reopened. Thanks to its central location the stadium continues to host football and athletics meetings, concerts and exhibitions, and it is one of the most heavily used public sports grounds in Wenzhou. The sports centre around it also contains a 20,206 sqm gymnasium with 4,767 fixed seats and a 17,700 sqm diving and swimming hall with 2,000 seats, so the stadium works as part of a compact downtown cluster rather than a stand-alone ground. That central position, a short walk from the city's commercial spine, is why the city also uses it for concerts, exhibitions and school sports days.

address: 浙江省温州市龙湾区永定路1111号（S1线奥体中心站1号口步行约240米）
area_text: 二期占地342亩；体育场建筑面积70,500㎡，用地面积228,435㎡
intro_zh: 温州奥体中心体育场位于温州市龙湾区永定路1111号，处在龙湾行政中心区主轴南端，地铁S1线奥体中心站1号口步行约240米。体育场是温州奥体中心二期的主体建筑，二期占地342亩，总建筑面积7.05万平方米，设约5万个观众席，总投资约10亿元，2021年9月通过联合竣工验收，是温州首座5万座体育场。建筑取“瓯帆云影”立意，侧面看像扬帆的帆船，空中俯瞰像展翅的海鸥，罩棚曲线取自海鸥与丝绸的飘逸形态；钢结构工程获中国钢结构金奖，夜景照明以“光韵流转、梦幻飞鸥”为主题。场内为天然草坪足球场和400米标准田径训练场，采用“无影灯”布光，避免夜间比赛产生重影，地面停车位约900个。2023年杭州亚运会期间，这里承办女足小组赛；赛后承接足球赛事、演唱会与大型文体活动，与一期体育馆、游泳馆共同构成温州规模最大的体育场馆群。体育场西侧为大罗山，距温州龙湾国际机场约10分钟车程，B5快速公交和S1线可直达。
intro_en: Wenzhou Olympic Sports Center Stadium occupies No. 1111 Yongding Road in Longwan district, Wenzhou, at the southern end of the district's administrative axis and about 240 m from Exit 1 of Olympic Sports Center station on metro line S1. It is the centrepiece of phase two of the Wenzhou Olympic Sports Center: a 342-mu site with 70,500 sqm of floor area, about 50,000 seats and a cost of roughly 1 billion yuan, handed over in September 2021 as the city's first 50,000-seat stadium. The design, called sails and cloud shadows, reads as a sailing boat in side view and a gull in flight from above, the canopy curves drawing on the movement of gulls and silk. Its steel structure won a China Steel Structure Gold Award, and the night lighting scheme is built around the theme of flowing light and a dreamlike gull. The pitch is natural turf, with a 400 m training track to the west, shadow-free floodlighting for night matches and about 900 surface parking spaces. During the Hangzhou Asian Games in 2023 the stadium hosted women's football group matches; since then it has carried football fixtures, concerts and large cultural events, forming the largest sports venue cluster in Wenzhou together with the phase-one gymnasium and swimming hall. Daluo Mountain rises to the west, Longwan International Airport is about ten minutes away by road, and both the B5 express bus and metro line S1 serve the site. It is the anchor of the Wenzhou Olympic Sports Center and the largest football ground in the city. It is also used for mass fitness events and concerts outside the football season.

name_zh: 温州奥林匹克体育中心
address: 浙江省温州市龙湾区永定路1111号（龙湾行政中心区主轴南端，西侧为大罗山）
area_text: 总用地728亩，总建筑面积20.2万㎡；一期体育馆5,000座、游泳馆1,000座，二期体育场50,000座并配400米室外田径训练场
intro_zh: 温州奥林匹克体育中心位于温州市龙湾区永定路1111号，坐落在龙湾行政中心区主轴南端，西侧为大罗山，距温州龙湾国际机场约10分钟车程。中心总用地728亩，总建筑面积20.2万平方米，总投资约18亿元，由一期和二期组成：一期2017年建成，含5000座体育馆及训练馆、1000座游泳馆和可停1200余辆车的大型地下车库；二期2022年建成，含5万座主体育场和西侧400米标准室外田径训练场，二期占地342亩、建筑面积7.05万平方米、地面停车位900个。主体育场以“瓯帆云影”为设计立意，钢结构获中国钢结构金奖；体育馆可承办篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球等室内赛事，游泳馆设标准泳池，三者与室外训练场合为一体。中心由温州吉瑞体育场馆管理有限公司运营，功能覆盖竞技体育、业余训练、群众健身、文化娱乐和旅游休闲，2023年杭州亚运会女足小组赛在体育场举行；赛后各馆分时段向公众开放，并承接演唱会、展会和青少年培训，是浙南地区重要的综合性体育场馆群。
intro_en: Wenzhou Olympic Sports Center occupies No. 1111 Yongding Road in Longwan district, Wenzhou, at the southern end of the district's administrative axis, with Daluo Mountain to the west and Longwan International Airport about ten minutes away by car. The centre covers 728 mu with 202,000 sqm of floor area and a total investment of about 1.8 billion yuan, built in two phases. Phase one, completed in 2017, contains a 5,000-seat gymnasium and training hall, a 1,000-seat swimming hall and a large underground car park for more than 1,200 vehicles. Phase two, completed in 2022, added the 50,000-seat main stadium and a 400 m outdoor training track to its west, on a 342-mu site with 70,500 sqm of floor area and 900 surface parking spaces. The stadium's design concept, sails and cloud shadows, produced a steel structure that won a China Steel Structure Gold Award; the gymnasium handles basketball, volleyball, badminton and table tennis, and the swimming hall has a standard competition pool. Operated by Wenzhou Jirui Sports Venue Management, the centre spans elite competition, amateur training, public fitness, entertainment and tourism. The stadium hosted women's football group matches at the 2023 Asian Games, and afterwards the halls opened to the public in scheduled slots while continuing to stage concerts, exhibitions and youth training, making the complex a major multi-sport base in southern Zhejiang. The two phases share one address and are served by metro line S1 and the B5 express bus, with the airport about ten minutes away, which has helped the centre draw crowds for concerts, exhibitions and football. The gymnasium and swimming hall also run separate public sessions, so the site stays busy outside match days.

address: 浙江省温州市瓯海区娄桥街道商汇路999号（瓯海中心区南单元，龙舟湖畔）
area_text: 总用地532亩；总建筑面积23,713㎡（地上约1万㎡）；赛道长1,200米、宽130米、水深3.5米，6条主赛道+1条副赛道
capacity_text: 沿河两岸约10,500个室外站席（4个站席观赛区）
intro_zh: 温州龙舟运动中心位于温州市瓯海区娄桥街道商汇路999号，处在瓯海中心区南单元、龙舟湖畔，北侧毗邻瓯海奥体中心。项目2019年10月开工，2021年3月建成并投入试运行，总投资约15.57亿元，总用地532亩，总建筑面积23713平方米，其中地上约1万平方米，由龙舟赛道水域、运动员综合馆、潜龙阁、观龙台、终点塔及景观工程组成，地下一层设龙舟文化博物馆。赛道为全新开挖的人工河道，长1200米、宽130米、水深3.5米，设6条主赛道和1条副赛道，上下游共5座节制闸，水源引自泽雅水库。看台不设固定座席，沿河两岸设4个室外站席区，可容纳约1万人，保留了民间“站岸观赛”的传统。2023年10月4日至6日，杭州亚运会龙舟比赛在这里举行，产生6枚金牌；赛后场馆永久保留，成为全国最专业的龙舟竞赛基地。运营以来，这里承办国际龙舟公开赛、全运会龙舟赛、全国皮划艇静水锦标赛和温州乡村龙舟大赛，日常每天吸引两千余人健身休闲，带动龙舟湖片区成为城市水上运动中心。
intro_en: Wenzhou Dragon Boat Sports Center sits at No. 999 Shanghui Road in Louqiao subdistrict, Ouhai district, Wenzhou, on Dragon Boat Lake in the southern unit of the Ouhai central district, next to the Ouhai Olympic Sports Center. Work began in October 2019, the venue was completed and entered trial operation in March 2021, and the cost came to about 1.557 billion yuan. It covers 532 mu with 23,713 sqm of floor area, roughly 10,000 sqm above ground, and comprises the racing water, an athletes' hall, the Qianlong Pavilion, a viewing terrace, a finish tower and landscaped banks, with a dragon-boat culture museum in the basement. The course is a newly excavated artificial channel 1,200 m long, 130 m wide and 3.5 m deep, with six racing lanes and one reserve lane, five sluice gates upstream and downstream, and water drawn from the Zeya reservoir. There are no fixed seats: four standing areas along both banks hold about 10,000 spectators, preserving the local habit of watching races from the shore. From 4 to 6 October 2023 the venue staged the Asian Games dragon boat events, producing six gold medals, and it was kept permanently afterwards as the country's most specialised dragon boat racing base. Since then it has hosted the international dragon boat open, the National Games dragon boat regatta, the national canoe sprint championships and the Wenzhou village dragon boat tournament, drawing more than 2,000 people a day for exercise and making the lake area the city's watersports hub. The venue shares the Ouhai sporting district with the Olympic Sports Center, and its lake is also used for dragon boat festivals and public paddling sessions through the year.

address: 浙江省湖州市德清县武康街道德清大道（民乐小区北侧，德清县体育中心内）
area_text: 体育馆建筑面积18,296㎡；德清县体育中心总占地176亩、总建筑面积5万余㎡
intro_zh: 德清体育中心体育馆位于湖州市德清县武康街道德清大道，处在德清县体育中心东侧，建筑呈正圆形并配裙楼，从空中俯瞰简洁大气。德清县体育中心总占地176亩，总建筑面积5万余平方米，由体育场、体育馆、游泳馆和综合馆组成。体育馆为杭州第19届亚运会排球项目比赛场馆，总建筑面积18296平方米，设3000个观众席，含主比赛馆和热身馆，馆内分三层，一层为运动场及配套用房，二层为贵宾和观众看台。场馆曾举办2015—2019赛季中国职业排球联赛、2017年全运会男子排球预赛；为亚运会实施的改造工程获2022年度浙江省建设工程“钱江杯”。2023年亚运会期间，这里承办女排小组赛，亚洲排球联合会向德清赛区颁发“突出贡献奖”。赛后体育馆继续作为浙江德清男排的排超联赛主场，并承办“浙BA”篮球赛、青少年培训和全民健身活动，与体育场、游泳馆共享县体育中心的停车和商业配套。
intro_en: Deqing Sports Center Gymnasium stands on Deqing Avenue in Wukang subdistrict, Deqing county, Huzhou, on the eastern side of the county sports centre. The building is circular in plan with a podium, reading as a clean volume from the air. The wider Deqing Sports Center covers 176 mu with more than 50,000 sqm of floor area and comprises a stadium, the gymnasium, a swimming hall and a multi-purpose hall. The gymnasium served as a volleyball venue for the Hangzhou Asian Games, with 18,296 sqm of floor area, 3,000 seats, a main competition hall and a warm-up hall over three levels: the playing floor and support rooms at ground level, VIP and spectator seating on the second. It had already hosted the Chinese professional volleyball league from the 2015 to 2019 seasons and the men's volleyball qualifying tournament for the 2017 National Games. Its Asian Games renovation won the 2022 Qianjiang Cup, Zhejiang's construction quality award. During the 2023 Games it staged women's volleyball group matches, and the Asian Volleyball Confederation gave the Deqing organising team an award for outstanding contribution. Afterwards the hall continued as the home court of the Zhejiang Deqing men's team in the Chinese Volleyball Super League, and it also hosts Zhejiang's ZBA basketball league, youth coaching and public fitness sessions, sharing parking and retail with the stadium and swimming hall. The hall's three levels separate the playing floor from VIP and spectator circulation, a layout introduced in the Asian Games renovation. Deqing lies about 48 km northwest of the Asian Games village in Hangzhou, and the county centre also runs a 400 m track and a swimming hall alongside the gymnasium, so the site covers both competition and daily public use.

name_zh: 德清地理信息小镇篮球场
address: 浙江省湖州市德清县舞阳街道塔山街901号（地理信息小镇核心区，北邻城山街、南接凤栖湖）
area_text: 运动中心总用地36,330㎡，总建筑面积约5万㎡（另有5.17万㎡口径）；地下1层、地上2层
capacity_text: 设计1,009席（亚运赛时临时看台扩充至约1,500席）
intro_zh: 德清地理信息小镇篮球场位于湖州市德清县舞阳街道塔山街901号，坐落在德清地理信息小镇核心区，北邻城山街、南接凤栖湖，与联合国地理信息大会会址相邻。场馆是全球首个固定式三人制篮球专用场馆，2022年5月26日正式启用，由两层钢结构地景建筑构成，三人篮球场设在建筑屋顶，设计观众席1009个，亚运赛时通过临时看台扩充至约1500席。运动中心总用地36330平方米，总建筑面积约5万平方米，地下1层、地上2层，设48间运动员休息室、新闻发布厅、室内热身场和沿街商业。场内配置20只强指向性扬声器和82台体育建筑专用LED节能照明灯具，满足电视转播要求。2023年9月25日至10月1日，杭州亚运会三人篮球比赛在这里举行，产生男子、女子2枚金牌。赛后场馆成为国家队训练基地和全民健身场地，承办国际篮联三人篮球德清大师赛、德清“三人王”篮球赛和“浙川东西部协作杯”等赛事，是德清打造“赛事之城”的核心场馆。
intro_en: The Deqing Geographic Information Town Basketball Court stands at No. 901 Tashan Street in Wuyang subdistrict, Deqing county, Huzhou, in the core of the geographic information town, with Chengshan Street to the north and Qifeng Lake to the south, next to the venue of the UN World Geospatial Information Congress. It is the world's first permanent purpose-built 3x3 basketball venue, opened on 26 May 2022. The court sits on the roof of a two-storey steel landscape building, with 1,009 designed seats and temporary stands that raised capacity to about 1,500 during the Asian Games. The wider sports centre covers 36,330 sqm of land with about 50,000 sqm of floor area over one basement and two upper levels, including 48 team locker rooms, a press conference room, an indoor warm-up court and street-front retail. Twenty highly directional loudspeakers and 82 sports-grade LED luminaires support broadcast-quality lighting. From 25 September to 1 October 2023 the venue staged the Asian Games 3x3 basketball tournament, producing two gold medals, one for the men's and one for the women's event. Afterwards it became a national team training base and a public fitness facility, hosting the FIBA 3x3 World Tour Deqing Masters, the local Three-Person King tournament and the Zhejiang-Sichuan East-West Cooperation Cup, and it anchors Deqing's ambition to be a city of events. The building was assembled in a matter of months before the 2022 opening, and its roof-top position above the park makes the court visible from the surrounding promenade. The site is part of the geographic information town, a cluster of geospatial firms around the UN centre, so the venue sits in a working technology district rather than a traditional sports campus.

address: 浙江省湖州市吴兴区仁皇山街道金田路518号（南太湖湿地奥体公园东侧）
area_text: 占地31.3公顷（奥体公园整体74.3公顷）；总建筑面积11.42万㎡；体育场57,480㎡、游泳馆13,228㎡
intro_zh: 湖州奥体中心位于湖州市吴兴区仁皇山街道金田路518号，坐落在南太湖湿地奥体公园东侧，是湖州的城市新地标。项目占地31.3公顷，总建筑面积11.42万平方米，总投资约15亿元，2017年6月投入使用，由一场二馆组成，即主体育场、游泳馆和综合馆；建筑群形似一朵盛开的百合花，花瓣自中心向四周伸展，外立面采用钛合金板材。主体育场设4万个观众席，建筑面积57480平方米，建筑高度55.7米，场内为天然草坪足球场和400米标准田径场；2017年通过国际田联（IAAF）一级场地认证，是浙江首个获此认证的体育场，并获中国钢结构金奖、中国金属维护系统工程“金禹奖”。2018年浙江省第十六届运动会开幕式在这里举行；2022年至2023年，浙江队将中超和亚冠主场设在湖州奥体中心。游泳馆设1514个观众席，含标准比赛池、训练池和戏水池；综合馆可承办篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球等室内赛事。赛后场馆向市民开放，承接演唱会、展会和青少年培训，与南太湖湿地公园共同构成湖州的文体休闲片区。
intro_en: Huzhou Olympic Sports Center occupies No. 518 Jintian Road in Renhuangshan subdistrict, Wuxing district, Huzhou, on the eastern edge of the South Taihu Wetland Olympic Park, and is one of the city's new landmarks. The 31.3-hectare project has 114,200 sqm of floor area and cost about 1.5 billion yuan; it opened in June 2017 with a stadium, a swimming hall and a multi-purpose hall. The buildings are shaped like a lily in bloom, petals radiating from the centre, clad in titanium panels. The stadium seats 40,000, covers 57,480 sqm and rises 55.7 m, with a natural-turf football pitch inside a 400 m track. In 2017 it received IAAF Class One certification, the first stadium in Zhejiang to do so, and it has won a China Steel Structure Gold Award and the Jinyu Award for metal envelope engineering. The opening ceremony of the 16th Zhejiang Provincial Games was held there in 2018, and from 2022 to 2023 Zhejiang FC used the ground for its Chinese Super League and AFC Champions League home matches. The swimming hall has 1,514 seats and a competition pool, training pool and leisure pool; the multi-purpose hall handles basketball, badminton and table tennis. After the Games the complex opened to residents and now hosts concerts, exhibitions and youth training, forming a sports and leisure district with the wetland park. The swimming hall hosted the swimming competition of the 2018 provincial games, and the complex is managed by Huzhou Sports Industry Development alongside the city's other main venues. The whole complex stands inside the 74.3-hectare South Taihu Olympic Wetland Park, which adds training and leisure space around the venues.

address: 河北省石家庄市桥西区自强路117号（北门位于兴华街6号，南侧紧邻中山路商圈）
capacity_text: 官方未公布（以400米标准田径场为主，另设中山体育馆）
intro_zh: 石家庄市中山体育场位于石家庄市桥西区自强路117号，北门开在兴华街6号，南侧紧邻中山路商圈，是市中心少见的大型公共体育场。场地和中山少年业余体育学校始建于1955年，体育场1992年开工、1994年竣工，2002年交付石家庄市体育局管理使用；用地面积26640平方米，建筑面积12000平方米，其中室内场地1500平方米、室外场地19980平方米，拥有400米标准田径场和多功能室内体育馆（中山体育馆）。室外田径场自2002年起免费向公众开放，每天清晨5时至9时、晚间7时至10时开放，日均锻炼市民千余人；场馆同时是国家级高水平体育后备人才基地，承担田径、武术等项目的青少年训练和赛事任务。中山体育馆可进行篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球、武术、摔跤等室内项目，2025年中国足协五人制足球超级联赛揭幕战在此举行，现场观众超过3800人，刷新该赛事上座率纪录；同年河北省五人制足球超级联赛也在这里开幕。体育场看台座位数官方未公布，日常以田径场和室内馆的全民健身功能为主。
intro_en: Shijiazhuang Zhongshan Stadium stands at No. 117 Ziqiang Road in Qiaoxi district, Shijiazhuang, with its north gate at No. 6 Xinghua Street and the Zhongshan Road retail district immediately to the south, an unusual expanse of public sport in the city centre. The ground and the Zhongshan youth sports school date from 1955; the stadium was built between 1992 and 1994 and passed to the Shijiazhuang Sports Bureau in 2002. The site covers 26,640 sqm with 12,000 sqm of buildings, of which 1,500 sqm is indoor and 19,980 sqm outdoor, and comprises a 400 m standard athletics track and a multi-purpose indoor hall, the Zhongshan Gymnasium. The outdoor track has been free to the public since 2002, open from 5 to 9 in the morning and 7 to 10 in the evening, with more than a thousand residents using it daily; the venue is also a national high-level reserve talent base, training young athletes in athletics, wushu and other sports. The indoor hall handles basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, wushu and wrestling, and in 2025 it hosted the opening match of the Chinese Football Association Futsal Super League, where more than 3,800 spectators set a attendance record for the competition; the Hebei provincial futsal league opened there the same year. The stadium's stand capacity is not published; day to day the site works mainly as a free athletics ground and community sports hall. The stadium and the youth sports school share the same compound, so training sessions and public opening are scheduled around each other, and the site is one of the few open green spaces in a dense part of the city. The 400 m track is floodlit for evening use.

name_zh: 石家庄裕彤国际体育中心
address: 河北省石家庄市长安区中山东路与体育大街交叉口东南（城市中轴线商业带）
intro_zh: 石家庄市裕彤国际体育中心位于石家庄市长安区中山东路与体育大街交叉口东南，处在城市中轴线的商业带上，距老火车站（解放广场）约3.5公里、石家庄站约8公里、石家庄机场约30公里。项目1992年8月开工，1996年8月建成投用，总投资3.5亿元，占地110亩，建筑面积10.04万平方米（另有7.38万平方米口径），主体为两层框架结构，总高45.88米，由香港新世界发展（中国）有限公司持股55%、石家庄市体育局和华联物贸持股45%共同建设。中心把体育场建在二层，一层及周边为商业面积，形成“以商养体、以体促商”的商体结合模式，被称为全国唯一的悬空型大型体育场。二层体育场设标准草坪足球场和塑胶田径场，看台可容纳3.5万至3.8万名观众，看台下另设8条百米塑胶跑道、训练房、贵宾室和运动员休息室。中心2013年、2014年、2016年多次改造，引入体育零售、餐饮和培训业态，现由石家庄裕彤体育产业发展有限责任公司运营，是石家庄功夫足球俱乐部的主场，也是演唱会、展会和全民健身活动的常用场地。
intro_en: Shijiazhuang Yutong International Sports Center stands at the southeast corner of Zhongshan East Road and Tiyu Avenue in Chang'an district, Shijiazhuang, on the commercial spine of the city axis, about 3.5 km from the old railway station, 8 km from Shijiazhuang station and 30 km from the airport. Work began in August 1992 and the centre opened in August 1996 at a cost of 350 million yuan. It covers 110 mu with 100,400 sqm of floor area, or 73,800 sqm under another official count, in a two-storey frame 45.88 m high. Hong Kong's New World Development held 55 per cent, with the Shijiazhuang Sports Bureau and Hualian Trading holding 45 per cent. The stadium is built on the second level, with shops and commercial space on the ground floor and around the perimeter, a commercial-sport hybrid summed up as supporting sport through commerce and promoting commerce through sport; it is described as the country's only elevated large stadium. The upper level holds a standard grass football pitch and synthetic athletics track, with stands for 35,000 to 38,000 spectators and, beneath the seating, eight 100 m sprint lanes, training rooms, VIP rooms and athletes' facilities. The centre was renovated in 2013, 2014 and 2016 and now mixes sports retail, restaurants and coaching. Operated by Shijiazhuang Yutong Sports Industry Development, it is the home of Shijiazhuang Kungfu FC and a regular venue for concerts, exhibitions and public fitness. It is owned by the Shijiazhuang Sports Bureau and managed by the Yutong company, one of the city's state-owned venue operators. The name Yutong comes from Cheng Yu-tung, the New World executive whose company held the majority stake.

address: 河北省石家庄市长安区中山东路与体育大街交叉口东南（裕彤国际体育中心二层）
area_text: 总建筑面积100,400㎡；主体上下两层，总高45.88米；看台下设8条百米塑胶跑道及训练、贵宾、裁判、运动员用房
intro_zh: 裕彤体育场位于石家庄市长安区中山东路与体育大街交叉口东南，是裕彤国际体育中心的核心场地，因纪念香港新世界集团郑裕彤而得名，又称长安体育场。体育场建在20世纪50年代修建、1972年翻修的长安路体育场旧址上，1992年动工、1996年8月建成，总建筑面积10.04万平方米，主体上下两层、总高45.88米，看台可容纳3.8万余名观众。场内草坪足球场达到中国足协比赛要求，铺设塑胶跑道的标准田径场可承办田径赛事，配有240平方米大型彩色显示屏、飞利浦灯光、澳大利亚TCP音响和电子记分计时设备，看台下设8条百米塑胶跑道及训练、贵宾、裁判和运动员用房。这里举办过河北省第九届、第十届运动会，2004年全国田径锦标赛暨奥运会选拔赛，2008年北京奥运会田径预选赛；1997至1998赛季为八一足球队主场，此后先后成为河北中基、石家庄永昌、石家庄功夫的主场，2015年石家庄永昌征战中超时以场均近3万人的上座率被称为“魔鬼主场”。张学友、五月天、王力宏、陈奕迅等歌手也在此举办演唱会，体育场是石家庄体育与演出的共同地标。
intro_en: Yutong Stadium, also called Chang'an Stadium, occupies the southeast corner of Zhongshan East Road and Tiyu Avenue in Chang'an district, Shijiazhuang, and is the core ground of the Yutong International Sports Center; it takes its name from Cheng Yu-tung of Hong Kong's New World group. It was built on the site of the Chang'an Road stadium of the 1950s, which had been renovated in 1972. Work started in 1992 and the stadium opened in August 1996 with 100,400 sqm of floor area in a two-level structure 45.88 m high, its stands holding more than 38,000 spectators. The grass pitch meets Chinese Football Association requirements and the synthetic 400 m track can stage athletics; the ground is equipped with a 240 sqm colour screen, Philips floodlights, Australian TCP sound and electronic timing and scoring, while beneath the stands are eight 100 m sprint lanes and rooms for training, VIPs, referees and athletes. It has hosted the ninth and tenth Hebei provincial games, the 2004 national athletics championships and Olympic trials, and the 2008 Beijing Olympic athletics qualifier. From 1997 to 1998 it was the home of the Bayi football team, and it later hosted Hebei Zhongji, Shijiazhuang Yongchang and now Shijiazhuang Kungfu; when Yongchang played in the Chinese Super League in 2015, average crowds of nearly 30,000 earned it the nickname the devil's home ground. Jacky Cheung, Mayday, Wang Leehom and Eason Chan have all played concerts here, making the stadium a shared landmark for sport and entertainment in the city. The ground is reached from Zhongshan East Road and Tiyu Avenue, and its elevated position above the commercial podium gives the stands a clear view over the city centre.

name_zh: 河北奥林匹克体育中心
address: 河北省石家庄市正定新区恒阳路62号（东至奥体街、西至太行大街、南至河阳路、北至恒阳路）
area_text: 总占地916亩（规划占地1118亩，约61万㎡），总建筑面积36万㎡
intro_zh: 河北奥林匹克体育中心位于石家庄市正定新区起步区东南部，东至奥体街、西至太行大街、南至河阳路、北至恒阳路，门牌为恒阳路62号，处在正定古城与石家庄主城之间的城市北跨轴线上，是河北省体量最大、功能最全的体育基础设施。项目规划占地1118亩，总占地916亩，总建筑面积36万平方米，总投资30.532亿元，2017年7月30日正式投入使用。中心由一座6万人座席体育场和一组体育馆综合体构成“一场五馆”围合布局，体育馆综合体内含体育馆、篮球馆、田径馆、游泳跳水馆、网球中心和综合训练馆各一座，可满足田径、游泳、跳水、篮球、网球、体操等项目的训练与比赛，也可承接大型演出和会展。主体育场看台环抱标准草坪球场与400米跑道，罩棚沿看台轮廓起伏，外立面以浅色金属板与玻璃幕墙为主，与正定新区的开阔路网形成完整城市界面。建成以来，这里承接了河北省第十五届运动会、冰雪主题活动及多场商业演唱会，是石家庄北部全民健身与赛事经济的核心载体。交通方面，场馆经太行大街、恒阳路进出，公交177路、130路、143路可达正定南门及周边，自驾经太行大街直连石家庄绕城高速与正定机场方向。
intro_en: Hebei Olympic Sports Center stands in the southeastern part of the Zhengding New Area start-up zone in Shijiazhuang, bounded by Aoti Street to the east, Taihang Avenue to the west, Heyang Road to the south and Hengyang Road to the north, with its address at No. 62 Hengyang Road. Positioned on the northward urban axis between Zhengding's old town and central Shijiazhuang, it is Hebei's largest and most complete sports infrastructure project. Planned on 1,118 mu and built on 916 mu, it carries 360,000 sqm of floor area and represents an investment of 3.05 billion yuan, opening on 30 July 2017. The layout encloses a 60,000-seat stadium and a gymnasium cluster in a one-stadium, five-halls arrangement: an arena, a basketball hall, an athletics hall, a swimming and diving hall, a tennis centre and a multi-purpose training hall, covering training and competition for athletics, swimming, diving, basketball, tennis and gymnastics as well as concerts and exhibitions. The stadium bowl wraps a standard turf pitch and 400 m track under a roof that follows the seating contour, while pale metal panels and glass curtain walls form a coherent civic edge against the open street grid of the new district. Since opening it has hosted the 15th Hebei Provincial Games, winter sports programmes and a run of commercial concerts, and it anchors public fitness and event business in northern Shijiazhuang. Access runs via Taihang Avenue and Hengyang Road, bus routes 177, 130 and 143 serve the Zhengding south gate area, and the ring expressway and airport direction are reached directly from Taihang Avenue.

address: 福建省福州市台江区群众东路70号（群众东路北侧）
area_text: 占地约22.5亩（约1.5万㎡）；馆内比赛训练场地约1,400㎡
intro_zh: 福州市体育馆位于福州市台江区群众东路70号，处在群众东路北侧、台江老城与闽江之间，是福州中心城区的主要室内体育馆。场馆2000年落成并投入使用，占地约22.5亩，馆内设约1400平方米的比赛训练场地和约4000个观众座椅，整体建筑采用椭圆流线型外形，抽象模拟花的形态，寓意“体育之花”常开，是福州的标志性公共建筑之一。比赛厅可布置篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球、体操、拳击等室内项目，也可转换为文艺演出、展览和群众活动空间；场馆由福州文体产业开发运营有限公司负责日常运营，与海峡奥体中心等市属场馆统一管理。福州市体育馆地处台江核心区，周边为居民区、学校和商业街区，公交线路密集，步行可达闽江岸边；作为市属重点公共体育场馆，它常年承担全民健身开放、青少年培训、机关企事业单位运动会和商业赛事，是福州中心城区使用率较高的公共体育馆。
intro_en: Fuzhou Gymnasium stands at No. 70 Qunzhong East Road in Taijiang district, Fuzhou, on the northern side of the road between the old Taijiang quarter and the Min River, and is the main indoor arena in the city's central districts. Completed and opened in 2000, it covers about 22.5 mu, with roughly 1,400 sqm of competition and training floor and about 4,000 spectator seats. The building takes an elliptical, streamlined form abstracted from a flower, symbolising sport in perpetual bloom, and is one of Fuzhou's recognisable public buildings. The hall can be set for basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, gymnastics and boxing, and converts for performances, exhibitions and civic events. It is operated day to day by Fuzhou Culture and Sports Industry Development and Operation, which also manages the Haixia Olympic Sports Center and other municipal venues. The site sits in the Taijiang core, surrounded by housing, schools and shopping streets, with frequent buses and the Min River bank within walking distance. As a key municipal public venue it carries year-round fitness opening, youth coaching, institutional games and commercial events, and is one of the busiest public indoor halls in central Fuzhou. The plot is compact at 22.5 mu, with the whole hall contained in a single volume rather than a campus of separate buildings. The city promotes it as one of ten major sports venues for public use, and its central site makes it a convenient host for school and company tournaments. It appears in the municipal sports bureau's 2022 inventory of key public venues, which records it as normally open.

name_zh: 福建省奥林匹克体育中心
address: 福建省福州市鼓楼区五四路310号（华大街道）
intro_zh: 福建省奥林匹克体育中心位于福州市鼓楼区五四路310号，地处华大街道，是福建省体育局下属的公益二类事业单位，也是福建省规模最大的综合性体育场馆群之一。中心1986年开工建设，1989年投入使用，2009年为承办第五届全国特殊奥林匹克运动会进行改造；占地450亩，总建筑面积8.5万平方米，由体育场、体育馆、游泳馆、网球馆、户外健身广场和江厝路健身游泳馆组成。体育场在中心东南角，建筑面积3.6万平方米，可容纳2.4万名观众，设8道标准预制橡胶跑道、111米×72米天然草坪足球场和560米环形塑胶风雨跑道；体育馆建筑面积3万平方米，主馆场地1890平方米、可容纳8000人，训练馆场地1920平方米；游泳馆建筑面积1.4万平方米，设50米×25米10泳道恒温比赛池、跳水比赛池和热身池；网球馆建筑面积5720平方米，有2片室内场、1片带1500座看台的室外场和7片室外场。中心常年免费或低收费开放田径场、足球场、篮球场、羽毛球场、网球场和游泳馆，并设810米智能健身步道，是福州全民健身和专业队训练的主要基地。
intro_en: Fujian Provincial Olympic Sports Center occupies No. 310 Wusi Road in Gulou district, Fuzhou, in Huada subdistrict. A public institution under the Fujian Provincial Sports Bureau, it is one of the largest sports complexes in the province. Construction began in 1986, the centre opened in 1989, and it was renovated for the fifth National Special Olympics in 2009. It covers 450 mu with 85,000 sqm of floor area and comprises a stadium, gymnasium, swimming hall, tennis hall, outdoor fitness plaza and a training pool on Jiangcuo Road. The stadium, at the southeast corner, has 36,000 sqm of floor area and 24,000 seats, with an eight-lane prefabricated rubber track, a 111 m by 72 m natural-turf football pitch and a 560 m covered synthetic track. The gymnasium covers 30,000 sqm, with a 1,890 sqm main hall seating 8,000 and a 1,920 sqm training hall. The swimming hall has 14,000 sqm of floor area and a 50 m by 25 m ten-lane heated competition pool, a diving pool and a warm-up pool. The tennis hall covers 5,720 sqm with two indoor courts, a show court with 1,500 seats and seven outdoor courts. The centre keeps its track, football pitches, basketball and badminton courts, tennis courts and pool open free or at low cost, and an 810 m smart fitness trail runs through the grounds, making it Fuzhou's main base for public fitness and provincial team training. The outdoor plaza adds five-a-side and seven-a-side football pitches, plastic and covered basketball courts, a sports dance area and a children's fitness zone, all free or low-cost.

name_zh: 福州海峡奥林匹克体育中心
address: 福建省福州市仓山区东岭路333号
area_text: 总占地约1100亩（约73.3万㎡），总建筑面积约36万㎡
intro_zh: 福州海峡奥林匹克体育中心简称海峡奥体中心，位于福州市仓山区东岭路333号，处在南台岛东部、闽江南岸的城市新区，是第一届全国青年运动会的主赛场，也是福州承接国际单项赛事与大型演出的核心场馆群。项目总占地面积约1100亩（约73.3万平方米），总建筑面积约36万平方米，总造价约36亿元，按二星级绿色建筑标准建设，由“一场三馆”及相关配套设施组成：主体育场建筑面积119772平方米、看台约6万座；体育馆建筑面积约4.2万平方米、12980座；游泳馆建筑面积3.3万平方米、3978座；网球馆建筑面积约3万平方米、3152座。主体育场罩棚以多片弧形钢结构交错叠合，形似海上扬帆，与闽江口的海丝意象呼应，场芯为天然草坪足球场与400米跑道；三馆以连廊和平台串联，赛时可分流人群，赛后向市民开放游泳、羽毛球、网球等项目。作为特级特大型体育建筑，其钢结构与屋盖技术创新被认定为达到国际先进水平，并获多项国家级工程奖项。交通方面，场馆位于东岭路与南二环一带，公交与地铁接驳可达，自驾经南二环快速路、三环快速路可快速连接福州南站与长乐机场方向。
intro_en: Fuzhou Strait Olympic Sports Center, usually shortened to Strait Olympic Center, stands at No. 333 Dongling Road in Cangshan District, on the eastern part of Nantai Island south of the Min River. It was the main venue of the first National Youth Games and remains Fuzhou's principal complex for international single-sport events and large concerts. The site covers about 1,100 mu (roughly 733,000 sqm) with some 360,000 sqm of floor area and a cost of about 3.6 billion yuan, built to a two-star green building standard as one stadium and three halls: a 119,772 sqm stadium seating about 60,000, a 42,000 sqm arena with 12,980 seats, a 33,000 sqm swimming hall with 3,978 seats and a 30,000 sqm tennis hall with 3,152 seats. The stadium roof layers several curved steel shells that read as sails on the sea, echoing the maritime silk road imagery of the Min River estuary, over a natural-turf pitch and 400 m track; the open concourse beneath lets spectators circulate between the stands and the riverfront plazas. Linked concourses and decks let the three halls handle event-day crowds and then reopen to residents for swimming, badminton and tennis. As a special-grade, extra-large sports building, its steel structure and roof engineering were assessed as internationally advanced and recognised with national construction awards. Dongling Road and the South Second Ring Road frame the site, bus and metro connections serve the entrances, and the expressway network links it quickly to Fuzhou South railway station and the Changle airport direction. A broad landscaped esplanade on the river side doubles as public open space on non-event days.

name_zh: 中国轻纺城体育中心体育馆
address: 浙江省绍兴市柯桥区笛扬路2020号（笛扬路与纺都路交叉口西南侧）
intro_zh: 中国轻纺城体育中心体育馆位于绍兴市柯桥区笛扬路2020号，处在笛扬路与纺都路交叉口西南侧，是绍兴最大的体育场馆群——中国轻纺城体育中心的重要组成部分。体育中心总投资约18亿元，总建筑面积14万平方米，由体育场、体育馆、游泳馆和室外训练场组成，其中体育场可容纳4万人，设南北双侧滑移开闭式屋盖。体育馆2014年建成，占地28681平方米，建筑面积18513平方米，以“珠莲（联）璧盒（合）”为设计理念，外形像一颗明珠，与体育场、游泳馆成线性分布、河水相连，体现柯桥水乡特色。馆内设主比赛馆和热身馆，比赛区面积3100平方米、训练区1400平方米，观众席3666座，改造后媒体口径为5000余座。为承办杭州第19届亚运会排球小组赛，场馆2020年5月开工改造、2021年3月31日通过竣工验收，历时329天，保留原有运动木地板并复用扩声和升旗系统，节省建安费约1000万元。赛后场馆实行一馆多用，可开展青少年排球、篮球训练，承接大型单项赛事和本土品牌赛事，部分区域向公众免费开放。
intro_en: The China Textile City Sports Center Gymnasium stands at No. 2020 Diyang Road in Keqiao district, Shaoxing, at the southwest corner of Diyang Road and Fangdu Road, part of the China Textile City Sports Center, the largest sports complex in Shaoxing. The centre cost about 1.8 billion yuan and has 140,000 sqm of floor area, made up of a stadium, the gymnasium, a swimming hall and outdoor training grounds; the stadium seats 40,000 under a retractable roof that slides open from north and south. The gymnasium was completed in 2014 on a 28,681 sqm site with 18,513 sqm of floor area. Its design, a pearl-and-jade box joined together, gives it the look of a pearl set in a line with the stadium and swimming hall, linked by water in the manner of Keqiao's canal towns. Inside are a main competition hall and a warm-up hall, with 3,100 sqm of competition floor, 1,400 sqm of training floor and 3,666 seats, though local reports after the renovation put capacity at more than 5,000. To stage the Asian Games volleyball group matches the hall was renovated over 329 days from May 2020 and accepted on 31 March 2021; the original timber floor was kept and the sound and flag-raising systems reused, saving about 10 million yuan in construction cost. After the Games it runs as a multi-use hall for youth volleyball and basketball, major single-sport events and local competitions, with parts of the building open free to the public. The hall is a short walk from China Textile City station on Shaoxing metro line 1.

address: 浙江省绍兴市越城区洋江西路899号（镜湖新区，解放大道与洋江西路交叉口西北角）
area_text: 占地351亩（约23.4万平方米），总建筑面积约14.2万平方米
capacity_text: 体育会展馆9880座（含活动座席1700个）；游泳馆、射击射箭馆比赛区各3000座
intro_zh: 绍兴市奥体中心位于浙江省绍兴市越城区洋江西路899号，地处镜湖新区核心区、解放大道与洋江西路交叉口西北角，与镜湖国家城市湿地公园隔河相望，是绍兴承办大型赛事、会展和演出的主阵地。项目2010年5月开工、2014年建成投用，总投资约13亿元，占地351亩，总建筑面积约14.2万平方米，以河为界分为体育会展馆、游泳馆、射击射箭馆三座单体建筑，南北两区由跨河地面桥和高架桥连接。体育会展馆按甲级体育建筑、大型体育馆标准设计，内场长72米、宽46米、净高18米，设9880个座位（含1700个活动座席），并配置666个标准固定展位，可举办篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球、柔道、摔跤、拳击、击剑等比赛以及演唱会、会展；游泳馆设训练池、造浪池、戏水池、温泉SPA池各一座，比赛区可容纳3000名观众；射击射箭馆比赛区同样为3000座，场外还有一块150米×35米室外射箭场。建筑外壳呈椭圆形流线型，被市民昵称为“大河蚌”，杭州亚运会期间获官方个性化名称“最具水乡味场馆”。它还是浙江省首个使用地源热泵系统的公共建筑，地下埋设2150口100米深井，利用地热实现冬暖夏凉，节能约40%。2023年9月27日至10月3日，杭州亚运会女子篮球小组赛及四分之一决赛在此举行；场馆此前还承接过2018年、2019年女排世俱杯和大量商业演唱会。交通上，绍兴地铁1号线在中心南北两侧设奥体中心站，距杭州亚运村约38.8公里，经解放大道、洋江西路可快速接入杭甬高速。
intro_en: Shaoxing Olympic Sports Center stands at 899 Yangjiang West Road in the Yuecheng District of Shaoxing, at the north-western corner of the junction with Jiefang Avenue in the Jinghu New Area, facing the Jinghu National Urban Wetland Park across the river. It is the city's principal stage for major sport, exhibitions and concerts. Construction began in May 2010 and the complex opened in 2014 at a cost of about 1.3 billion yuan, covering 351 mu (roughly 23.4 hectares) with about 142,000 square metres of floor space. A river divides it into three separate buildings — the sports and exhibition hall, the swimming hall and the shooting and archery hall — linked by a road bridge and an elevated bridge. The sports and exhibition hall is designed to Class A sports-building standards, with a playing floor 72 metres long, 46 metres wide and 18 metres high, 9,880 seats including 1,700 movable ones, and 666 standard fixed exhibition booths; it hosts basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, judo, wrestling, boxing, fencing, concerts and trade fairs. The swimming hall contains a training pool, a wave pool, a leisure pool and a hot-spring spa pool, with 3,000 seats in the competition area, while the shooting and archery hall also seats 3,000 and is served by an outdoor 150 by 35 metre archery range. The elliptical, streamlined shell earned the nickname 'the great river mussel' and the official Asian Games name 'the venue with the strongest water-town flavour'. The centre was Zhejiang's first public building to use a ground-source heat-pump system, with 2,150 boreholes 100 metres deep delivering roughly 40 percent energy savings. From 27 September to 3 October 2023 it hosted the women's basketball group games and quarter-finals of the Hangzhou Asian Games, and it has also staged the 2018 and 2019 FIVB Women's Club World Championships and numerous concerts. Metro Line 1 serves Olympic Sports Center station on both the north and south sides, and the venue lies about 38.8 kilometres from the Asian Games Village.

address: 浙江省绍兴市越城区洋江西路899号（绍兴市奥体中心体育会展馆内）
area_text: 总建筑面积约7.2万平方米（亚运场馆口径）；比赛场地内场72米×46米、净高18米
capacity_text: 9552座（杭州亚运会口径）；场馆运营口径为9880座，含1700个活动座席
intro_zh: 绍兴奥体中心体育馆即绍兴市奥体中心内的体育会展馆，位于越城区洋江西路899号，是整座奥体中心单体面积最大、使用频率最高的建筑。它按甲级体育建筑和大型体育馆标准建设，总建筑面积约7.2万平方米，比赛场地内场长72米、宽46米、净高18米；座位数有两个公开口径——杭州亚运会官方场馆资料记为9552座，场馆运营方与百科资料记为9880座（含1700个活动座席），预订场地时以运营方公布为准。馆内可切换篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球、柔道、摔跤、拳击、击剑等多种比赛布置，也可承接演唱会；会展模式下设666个标准固定展位。为承办杭州亚运会篮球项目，场馆于2019年12月启动改造、2021年1月通过竣工验收，更换了悬浮式弹性基层运动木地板，改造灯光系统以实现比赛、进退场等多场景切换，并在场地中央加装重16吨的三层斗屏（上层八面屏、中层四面屏、下部环形屏），同时补齐媒体中心、运动员更衣室、无障碍通道与无障碍观赛座位。2023年9月27日至10月3日，这里完成亚运会女子篮球小组赛和四分之一决赛；此前承接过2018年、2019年女排世俱杯。场馆设主馆与副馆，日常向市民开放篮球、羽毛球等项目，并作为“阿里巴巴文娱体育馆”承接商业演出。交通依靠绍兴地铁1号线奥体中心站，南北两侧均有出入口。
intro_en: Shaoxing Olympic Sports Center Gymnasium is the sports and exhibition hall inside Shaoxing Olympic Sports Center at 899 Yangjiang West Road, Yuecheng District, and the largest single building in the complex. Built to Class A standards for large gymnasiums, it offers about 72,000 square metres of floor area and a playing floor 72 metres long, 46 metres wide and 18 metres high. Two public figures exist for capacity: the Hangzhou Asian Games venue list gives 9,552 seats, while the operator and encyclopaedic sources cite 9,880 including 1,700 movable seats, so visitors should follow the operator's published figure when booking. The hall can be reconfigured for basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, judo, wrestling, boxing and fencing, and also hosts concerts; in exhibition mode it provides 666 standard fixed booths. To stage the Asian Games basketball tournament, renovation began in December 2019 and passed completion inspection in January 2021. The original timber floor was replaced with a suspended elastic base system, the lighting was rebuilt for match, entry and exit modes, and a 16-tonne three-tier centre-hung video board was installed, with an eight-sided upper screen, a four-sided middle screen and a lower ring screen. Media facilities, team changing rooms, barrier-free routes and wheelchair viewing positions were added at the same time. From 27 September to 3 October 2023 the hall hosted the women's basketball group games and quarter-finals of the Hangzhou Asian Games, having previously staged the 2018 and 2019 FIVB Women's Club World Championships. A main hall and a secondary hall serve public basketball and badminton sessions, and the venue also trades commercially as the Alibaba Entertainment Gymnasium for concerts. Metro Line 1's Olympic Sports Center station has entrances on both sides of the complex.

name_zh: 绍兴柯桥羊山攀岩中心
address: 浙江省绍兴市柯桥区齐贤街道大越北路1688号（羊山石佛风景名胜区内）
area_text: 规划用地15826平方米，总建筑面积8950平方米（设计单位口径为8747平方米）
capacity_text: 2100座（固定950座、临时1150座；另有资料记固定座位762座）
intro_zh: 绍兴柯桥羊山攀岩中心位于浙江省绍兴市柯桥区齐贤街道大越北路1688号，紧贴羊山石佛风景名胜区，建在自隋唐时期开采石材留下的石宕遗址旁，是杭州第19届亚运会攀岩项目的比赛场馆。项目2021年4月1日开工，2022年2月26日通过竣工验收，规划用地15826平方米，总建筑面积8950平方米（设计单位按8747平方米计），主体建筑高度小于24米。场馆分南北两区：南区首层为比赛区和热身区，比赛区按国际标准布置速度道、难度道和攀石道三条赛道，岩壁朝北，高16.5米、总宽约68.5米、最大悬挑9米；热身区设三块与比赛场地同规格的岩壁。北区首层为观众区和媒体区，二层为贵宾区和观众看台，三层为安保区。看台共2100座，其中固定座位950个、临时座位1150个，另一种公开说法为固定座位762个，做活动布置时需以场馆确认为准。建筑以“蚕茧”为造型，外立面用UHPC超高性能混凝土拼接近2000个长方形和三角形块面，镂空率约55%，兼顾遮阳、节能和减少光污染；馆内设能源监测管理系统，竞赛区48盏灯可分区照明。这里产生杭州亚运会攀岩项目6枚金牌，2023年获AMP美国建筑大师奖最佳优胜奖。交通上可从绍兴北站乘815路、846路直达，或乘地铁1号线至镜水路站换乘831路；场馆自2022年7月起每周三开展惠民开放。
intro_en: Keqiao Yangshan Sport Climbing Centre stands at 1688 Dayue North Road, Qixian Subdistrict, Keqiao District, Shaoxing, beside the Yangshan Stone Buddha Scenic Area and among quarry pits worked since the Sui and Tang dynasties. It was the climbing venue for the 19th Hangzhou Asian Games. Work started on 1 April 2021 and the centre passed completion inspection on 26 February 2022 on a planned site of 15,826 square metres, with 8,950 square metres of floor area (the design team cites 8,747) and a main building under 24 metres high. The complex is split into two blocks. The southern block holds the competition and warm-up areas on its ground floor: three international-standard walls for speed, lead and bouldering face north, 16.5 metres high, about 68.5 metres wide in total, with a maximum overhang of nine metres, while the warm-up area has three walls of identical specification. The northern block contains spectator and media areas on the ground floor, VIP space and the stands above, and security facilities on the third level. The stands provide 2,100 seats, 950 fixed and 1,150 temporary, although one public source gives 762 fixed seats, so event layouts should be confirmed with the venue. The building is shaped as a cocoon: its UHPC ultra-high-performance concrete skin is assembled from nearly 2,000 rectangular and triangular panels, roughly 55 percent open, which cuts solar gain, saves energy and reduces light spill. An energy monitoring system tracks water, electricity and gas, and the 48 competition lights can be switched zone by zone. The centre produced six climbing gold medals at the Hangzhou Asian Games and won the Best of Best award at the 2023 AMP American Architecture Masters. It can be reached by buses 815 and 846 from Shaoxing North railway station, or by Metro Line 1 to Jingshui Road plus bus 831, and it has run public open days every Wednesday since July 2022.

name_zh: 绍兴棒（垒）球体育文化中心
address: 浙江省绍兴市越城区兴越路916号（柯桥区与镜湖新区交界，杭绍台高速镜湖互通附近）
area_text: 总用地245亩；棒球用地120666平方米、总建筑面积145000平方米（地上89200、地下55800）；垒球用地42666平方米、建筑面积8000平方米
capacity_text: 棒球主场5000座、副场2500座（固定1500+临时1000）；垒球主场2000座（固定1000+临时1000）、副场500座；合计约1万座
intro_zh: 绍兴棒（垒）球体育文化中心位于浙江省绍兴市越城区兴越路916号，处在柯桥区与镜湖新区的交界地带、杭绍台高速镜湖互通附近，是杭州第19届亚运会棒球和垒球项目的比赛场地，又名“云之翼”。项目2020年6月28日开工，2022年4月15日启用，总用地245亩，分两个地块建设。棒球地块用地120666平方米，总建筑面积145000平方米，其中地上89200平方米、地下55800平方米，布置棒球主场（5000座）、棒球副场（2500座，固定1500座加临时1000座）、集训中心和体能训练馆；垒球地块用地42666平方米，建筑面积8000平方米，含垒球主场（2000座，固定1000座加临时1000座）和垒球副场（500座临时看台）。全场可容纳观众约1万人，是国内规模最大、按国际赛事标准建造的棒垒球专业场地之一。建筑设计由浙江大学建筑设计研究院完成，以绍兴的丝绸与书卷为意象，立面用曲面穿孔铝板，球场钢结构膜顶既作屋顶又能为平台活动遮阴，膜面波纹呼应江南水乡的水光。杭州亚运会期间这里产生棒球、垒球各一枚金牌；2024年又承办U-23男子棒球世界杯。赛后场馆向城市开放，转换为城市体育场和社区体育公园，体能训练中心承担全民健身功能。交通上可乘绍兴地铁1号线至镜水路站，或经杭绍台高速镜湖互通自驾抵达。
intro_en: Shaoxing Baseball and Softball Sports Culture Center, also known as Wings of Cloud, occupies 916 Xingyue Road in Yuecheng District, Shaoxing, on the border between Keqiao District and Jinghu New Area near the Jinghu interchange of the Hangzhou-Shaoxing-Taizhou expressway. It was the baseball and softball venue for the 19th Hangzhou Asian Games. Construction started on 28 June 2020 and the centre opened on 15 April 2022 on 245 mu of land across two plots. The baseball plot covers 120,666 square metres with 145,000 square metres of floor area, 89,200 above ground and 55,800 below, and contains a 5,000-seat main baseball field, a 2,500-seat secondary field (1,500 fixed plus 1,000 temporary), a training centre and a physical conditioning hall. The softball plot covers 42,666 square metres with 8,000 square metres of building, comprising a 2,000-seat main softball field (1,000 fixed plus 1,000 temporary) and a 500-seat temporary secondary field. Total spectator capacity is about 10,000, making it one of China's largest baseball and softball complexes built to international competition standards. Zhejiang University Architectural Design and Research Institute designed the project around Shaoxing's silk and scroll motifs, with curved perforated aluminium panels on the facades and steel structure membrane roofs over the fields that also shade the surrounding terraces; the rippled membrane surfaces echo the shimmering water of the Jiangnan canal country. The venue awarded one baseball gold and one softball gold during the Hangzhou Asian Games and hosted the 2024 U-23 Baseball World Cup. After the Games it was opened to the city as a municipal sports ground and community sports park, with the conditioning hall serving public fitness. Metro Line 1 to Jingshui Road is the nearest rail stop, and drivers reach the site via the Jinghu interchange of the Hangzhou-Shaoxing-Taizhou expressway.

address: 青海省西宁市城中区长江路114号（南川河畔，近西门商圈）
area_text: 主馆内场面积3940平方米（总建筑面积公开资料未单列）
intro_zh: 西宁体育馆位于青海省西宁市城中区长江路114号，坐落在南川河畔、西门商圈附近，是西宁建成较早、市民记忆最深的大型室内场馆。体育馆1982年建成投用，2002年经过全面改扩建，功能由单一的比赛场馆扩展为集文艺演出、体育比赛、群众健身于一体的综合性场馆，并被国家体育总局命名为青少年体育俱乐部。场馆主馆内场面积3940平方米，看台可容纳约5000名观众，可承接篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球等赛事以及企业团建、青少年培训。2025年，西宁体育馆完成新一轮升级改造：一楼设羽毛球馆（6片场地，铺设专业地胶和减震地板）、舞蹈厅、共享健身房和运动促进健康中心；二楼设青少年体能馆与乒乓球馆（7张标准球台）；三楼为体育培训场馆；共享健身房按每人每次2元的公益价开放。2026年2月，青海首家多功能数字体育健身中心在体育馆西侧投运，引入智能射击、模拟射箭、数字网球、数字棒球、数字足球和数字拳击等沉浸式项目。体育馆地处老城核心，步行可达西门、水井巷商圈，公交线路密集，距西宁火车站约3公里，是城中区全民健身网络的主节点。
intro_en: Xining Gymnasium stands at 114 Changjiang Road in Chengzhong District, Xining, Qinghai, on the bank of the Nanchuan River near the Ximen commercial area. Completed in 1982 and comprehensively renovated in 2002, it is one of the city's oldest and best-known indoor venues, rebuilt from a single-purpose competition hall into a complex covering performances, sport and public fitness, and designated a youth sports club by the General Administration of Sport. Its main hall has 3,940 square metres of floor area and stands for about 5,000 spectators, suiting basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, corporate events and youth training. A further upgrade was completed in 2025: the ground floor now holds a six-court badminton hall with professional sports flooring and shock-absorbing underlay, a dance studio, a shared gym and a sports-and-health centre; the second floor has a youth conditioning hall and a table-tennis hall with seven standard tables; the third floor is given over to sports training. The shared gym charges a public-benefit rate of two yuan per visit. In February 2026 Qinghai's first multi-function digital sports centre opened on the western side of the gymnasium, adding immersive smart shooting, simulated archery, digital tennis, baseball, football and boxing. The site sits in the old city core within walking distance of the Ximen and Shuijingxiang shopping districts, is served by numerous bus routes and lies about three kilometres from Xining railway station, making it the main node of the Chengzhong District public fitness network. For decades it was the stage for Qinghai's major international and domestic events, and after the 2002 rebuilding its programme widened to badminton, table tennis, fitness, yoga, taekwondo, sanda and billiards, alongside its continuing role as a competition and performance hall.

name_zh: 西宁海湖体育中心体育场
address: 青海省西宁市城西区五四西路88号（海湖湿地公园南岸，青海体育中心院内）
area_text: 占地约5万平方米，平面为正圆形、直径约257米
intro_zh: 西宁海湖体育中心体育场位于青海省西宁市城西区五四西路88号，坐落在海湖湿地公园南岸，是海湖体育中心（即青海体育中心）“一场两馆”中的主体育场。体育场占地约5万平方米，平面呈正圆形，直径约257米，设4万个席位，是青藏高原上规模最大的体育场之一。它与7500座的综合体育馆、1500座的游泳馆呈“三位一体”布局：主体育场居西侧为核心，体育馆与游泳馆一南一北列于东侧，两条一正一反的“C”形弧线把三座建筑连成整体，场地道路与景观轴线均以体育场圆心为基点向外发散。建筑外部采用“菱星”空间网格结构体系，抽空传统立体桁架中的部分杆件，形成由菱形晶体组合而成的轻巧结构，外覆折叠表皮，夜间如水晶般透亮。场地采用下沉式设计，既化解南北地势高差，也让地下空间获得采光，除少量景观阶梯外，场内高差多用小于7%的缓坡处理。场内布置标准田径比赛场地、田径练习场和足球场，可承办田径、足球比赛及大型文艺演出；2024年6月薛之谦、张信哲演唱会先后在此举行，西宁公交为此开行400辆免费接驳车。交通以五四西路为主干，公交与自驾均可达，距海湖新区中心商圈约十分钟车程。
intro_en: Xining Haihu Sports Center Stadium stands at 88 Wusi West Road in Chengxi District, Xining, Qinghai, on the southern bank of Haihu Wetland Park. It is the main stadium of the Haihu Sports Center, also known as Qinghai Sports Center, a one-stadium, two-halls complex. The stadium covers about 50,000 square metres on a circular plan roughly 257 metres in diameter and seats 40,000, making it one of the largest stadiums on the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. It forms a three-part composition with a 7,500-seat indoor arena and a 1,500-seat swimming hall: the stadium occupies the western core, the two halls sit north and south on the eastern side, and a pair of opposing C-shaped arcs ties the three buildings together, with roads and landscape axes radiating from the stadium's centre. The exterior uses a diamond-star space-grid structure that removes redundant members from conventional space frames, producing a light lattice of diamond crystals clad in a folded skin that glows like crystal at night. The site is sunken to resolve the north-south level difference and to bring daylight into the basement, with gradients kept below seven percent except at a few landscape steps. Inside are a standard athletics track, a training track and a football pitch, supporting athletics, football and large-scale concerts; Xue Zhiqian and Jeff Chang both performed here in June 2024, when the city ran 400 free shuttle buses. Wusi West Road is the main approach, and the stadium is about ten minutes' drive from the central Haihu New Area commercial district. The stadium also anchors the city's New Year's Day round-the-city run, which drew more than 13,000 participants when the complex first opened.

address: 青海省西宁市城西区五四西路88号（海湖新区，海湖湿地公园南岸）
area_text: 占地367亩（约24.5万平方米），总建筑面积18.8万平方米（另有平台口径17.67万平方米）
capacity_text: 体育场40000座、综合馆7500座、游泳馆1500座
intro_zh: 青海体育中心位于青海省西宁市城西区五四西路88号，地处海湖新区、海湖湿地公园南岸，是青海省规模最大、功能最全的综合性体育场馆群。项目历经约五年建设，2013年11月25日建成，2014年1月1日正式投用，总投资约17亿元（另有14.16亿元、18亿元口径），占地367亩（约24.5万平方米），总建筑面积18.8万平方米；部分场馆平台按17.67万平方米、24.46万平方米口径统计，引用时需注明来源。中心以“三馆一场”构成：4万座的主体育场、7500座的综合体育馆、1500座的游泳馆，以及后来增设的气膜运动馆。综合体育馆建筑面积约2.1万平方米，平面为圆形，一层为赛事与设备用房，二、三层为观众服务与共享大厅，四层为声光及LED控制室；游泳馆设8泳道标准池；气膜馆占地2160平方米，内设8片羽毛球场、1片五人制足球场和1片篮球场，净高14米。三座圆形场馆由“菱星”空间网格与折叠表皮构成，夜色中如水晶发亮，是西宁海湖新区的城市地标。中心与多巴国家高原体育训练基地共同构成较完整的赛事服务体系，可承办省运会、城运会、民运会等综合性赛事，日常开放足球、篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球、台球、蹦床、游泳等项目。交通依托五四西路与通海路，公交可达，距西宁市区中心约二十分钟车程。
intro_en: Qinghai Sports Center at 88 Wusi West Road, Chengxi District, Xining, occupies the southern bank of Haihu Wetland Park in the Haihu New Area and is the largest and most complete sports complex in Qinghai. Built over about five years, the centre was completed on 25 November 2013 and opened on 1 January 2014 at a cost of about 1.7 billion yuan, though other sources cite 1.416 billion or 1.8 billion, covering 367 mu (roughly 245,000 square metres) with 188,000 square metres of floor area; some venue platforms quote 176,700 square metres of building and 244,600 square metres of site, so figures should be cited with their source. It comprises three halls and one stadium: a 40,000-seat main stadium, a 7,500-seat indoor arena, a 1,500-seat swimming hall and a later air-supported membrane hall. The arena has about 21,000 square metres on a circular plan, with competition and plant rooms on the ground floor, spectator services and a shared concourse above, and audio, lighting and LED control rooms on the fourth level. The swimming hall has an eight-lane standard pool, while the 2,160-square-metre membrane hall contains eight badminton courts, a five-a-side football pitch and a basketball court under a 14-metre clear height. The three round buildings use a diamond-star space grid and folded skin that glitters like crystal at night, forming a landmark of Xining's Haihu New Area. Together with the Duoba National Plateau Sports Training Base, the centre offers a fairly complete competition service system for provincial games, city games and national minority games, and day to day it opens football, basketball, badminton, table tennis, billiards, trampoline and swimming. Wusi West Road and Tonghai Road provide access, with bus services and a drive of about twenty minutes to central Xining.

address: 陕西省西安市新城区西五路26号（西五路与尚德路交汇处西南角，紧邻革命公园）
area_text: 总用地面积92,440㎡（139亩）；改造后改扩建总面积65,226.59㎡，其中新建游泳馆5,175㎡
intro_zh: 西安市人民体育场位于西安市新城区西五路26号，处在西五路与尚德路交汇处的西南角，紧邻革命公园，是西安城墙内唯一的大型综合性体育场。体育场建于1952年10月，是在原革命公园体育场的基础上建造的，曾是西北地区最大的综合性体育场，看台可容纳近2万名观众（约18000座）；这里举办过1953年西北区田径、体育、自行车运动大会，也曾举办甲A联赛，承载了几代西安人的城市记忆。由于跑道自1998年后未再整修、设施逐渐陈旧，2024年8月改造工程正式开工，按“留、改、拆、建”的思路推进：保留包括老观众席在内的绝大多数原有建筑和北门标志性门楼，对建筑结构加固并全面升级跑道，拆除危房训练馆、室外游泳池和老化室内游泳馆，新建一座拥有8条50米标准泳道的游泳馆（建筑面积5175平方米）。改造后总用地139亩，改扩建总面积65226.59平方米，2025年1月10日以“全龄运动综合体”重新开放，场外布置笼式球类区、智慧健身区、乒乓球健身区、康养健身区、飞盘健身区和门球健身区，一条长920米、宽3米的环形智慧健身步道串联各区，运动馆内可开展网球、羽毛球、乒乓球等10余个健身项目。场馆由西安城投集团运营，地铁1号线、4号线五路口站步行可达。
intro_en: Xi'an People's Stadium occupies No. 26 Xiwu Road in Xincheng district, Xi'an, at the southwestern corner of the Xiwu Road and Shangde Road junction next to Revolution Park, and is the only large comprehensive stadium inside the old city wall. Built in October 1952 on the site of the former Revolution Park ground, it was once the largest multi-sport stadium in northwest China and its stands hold close to 20,000 spectators, about 18,000 seats. It hosted the 1953 Northwest regional athletics, sports and cycling games and later hosted top-flight league football, carrying several generations of city memory. Because the running track had not been resurfaced since 1998 and the facilities had aged, a renovation began in August 2024 under a keep, repair, demolish and build strategy: most original structures were retained, including the old spectator stands and the landmark north gate, building structures were tested and strengthened, the track was fully rebuilt, a dangerous training hall, an outdoor pool and an ageing indoor pool were removed, and a new swimming hall with eight 50 m lanes was added, covering 5,175 sqm. The 139-mu site now carries 65,226.59 sqm of renovated and new floor area, and the stadium reopened on 10 January 2025 as an all-age sports complex. Outside are caged ball courts, smart fitness zones, table tennis and health and rehabilitation areas, a frisbee zone and a gateball area, linked by a 920 m long, 3 m wide smart walking loop; the sports hall supports tennis, badminton, table tennis and more than ten other activities. Xi'an City Investment Group operates the venue, and Wulukou station on Metro Lines 1 and 4 is within walking distance.

address: 陕西省西安市雁塔区公田四路555号（曲江电竞产业园内，春临四路以南、公田四路与公田五路之间）
area_text: 占地50.35亩；建筑面积7.76万㎡（地上44,500㎡、地下33,150㎡），建筑高度33.3米；由主馆、副馆组成
intro_zh: 西安曲江竞技中心位于西安市雁塔区公田四路555号，坐落在曲江电竞产业园内，春临四路以南、公田四路与公田五路之间，是西北地区首个以“电竞”为主题建成的综合智慧化甲级体育馆。场馆2020年开工建设，2022年竣工投入使用，占地50.35亩，由主馆和副馆组成，建筑面积7.76万平方米（地上4.45万平方米、地下3.315万平方米），建筑高度33.3米。主馆设10415个剧院式软包座椅，看台分四层：首层场心为竞赛层，二层为中区看台，三层为VIP包厢层，四层为高区看台，另设母婴室和可陪护无障碍座椅。建筑外形取自芙蓉花，以“涟漪之上，芙蓉花开”为设计理念，白色双曲面板配金属装饰，钢结构用量约9000吨、装配率100%，屋面与立面在夜间可整体泛光。馆内配置可视面积225平方米的高清斗形屏、两块双环屏、两块端屏、10组线阵列音响和4组场地音响，并有6000多个物联网设备支撑智慧运维。内场尺寸按奥运会体操标准设置，可在短时间内转换为篮球、手球、网球、击剑、武术、摔跤场地，也可承办演唱会、展览和电竞比赛；2024年世界斯诺克·西安大奖赛、男排奥运资格赛、英雄联盟12周年盛典、第九届丝绸之路国际电影节均在此举行。场馆获评陕西省体育场馆协会首个“甲级体育馆”，所属曲江电竞产业园场馆区获中国建设工程鲁班奖。
intro_en: Xi'an Qujiang Sports Centre stands at No. 555 Gongtian Fourth Road in Yanta district, Xi'an, inside the Qujiang Esports Industrial Park south of Chunlin Fourth Road and between Gongtian Fourth and Fifth roads. It is the first comprehensive smart arena in northwest China built around an esports theme and holds Class-A gymnasium status. Construction started in 2020 and the venue opened in 2022 on a 50.35-mu site made up of a main hall and a secondary hall, with 77,600 sqm of floor area, 44,500 sqm above ground and 33,150 sqm below, and a height of 33.3 m. The main hall has 10,415 theatre-style upholstered seats over four levels: the competition floor at ground level, a mid-tier stand on the second floor, VIP boxes on the third and an upper stand on the fourth, plus a nursing room and companion-accessible seats. The building takes the hibiscus flower as its form under the concept ripples rising, hibiscus blooming, with white double-curved panels and metal trim, roughly 9,000 tonnes of steel and a 100 per cent prefabrication rate, and its roof and facade can be lit as a single surface at night. Inside are a 225 sqm centre-hung high-definition screen, two double ring screens, two end screens, ten line-array speaker clusters and four floor speaker sets, supported by more than 6,000 IoT devices for smart operations. The floor is set to Olympic gymnastics dimensions and converts quickly for basketball, handball, tennis, fencing, wushu and wrestling, as well as concerts, exhibitions and esports; the 2024 World Snooker Xi'an Grand Prix, the men's volleyball Olympic qualifier, the League of Legends 12th anniversary event and the ninth Silk Road International Film Festival have all been held here. The arena was the first in Shaanxi to be rated Class-A by the provincial venues association, and its park won a Luban Prize for construction.

address: 西安市灞桥区奥体大道2020号（西安国际港务区）
area_text: 占地1089亩（约72.6万㎡），净用地862亩；总建筑面积52.05万㎡
intro_zh: 西安奥体中心位于西安市灞桥区奥体大道2020号，地处西安国际港务区、灞河东岸，是2021年第十四届全国运动会的主会场，也是中西部地区规模最大的体育场馆群。项目占地1089亩、净用地862亩，总建筑面积52.05万平方米，投资约79亿元，由“一场两馆”及室外配套运动场地组成：6万个座位的主体育场、1.8万个座位的体育馆和4000个座位的游泳跳水馆，三座建筑呈品字形排列。主体育场以西安市花石榴花为造型意象，28片花瓣状屋盖向外舒展，被誉为“石榴花”；场馆是国内首座“5G+智慧”体育场馆，5G网络、智慧照明、能耗管理等系统全覆盖。十四运会的开幕式、闭幕式和田径比赛在此举行，此后承办演唱会、商业赛事与全民健身开放，体育馆内设羽毛球、篮球等场地，游泳跳水馆对外开放。交通方面，西南侧为地铁14号线奥体中心站，东侧为地铁3号线与14号线的换乘站双寨站，周边有西安绕城高速等快速路网，距西安北站约十余公里。
intro_en: Xi'an Olympic Sports Centre stands at 2020 Aoti Avenue in Baqiao District, on the east bank of the Bahe River within the Xi'an International Trade and Logistics Park. Built as the main venue of the 14th National Games in 2021, it is the largest sports complex in central and western China. The project covers 1,089 mu, about 726,000 sqm, with 862 mu of net land and 520,500 sqm of floor area at a cost of roughly 7.9 billion yuan. It comprises a 60,000-seat main stadium, an 18,000-seat arena and a 4,000-seat swimming and diving hall, the three buildings arranged in a triangular plan with outdoor training grounds alongside. The stadium's roof is shaped after the pomegranate flower, the city flower of Xi'an, with 28 petal-like panels opening outwards. It was the first Chinese venue built as a 5G-plus smart stadium, with full 5G coverage, intelligent lighting and energy management. The National Games opening and closing ceremonies and the athletics programme were held here; since then the complex has hosted concerts, commercial events and public fitness sessions, with badminton and basketball courts in the arena and the aquatics hall open to swimmers. Metro Line 14 stops at Olympic Sports Centre station to the south-west, while Shuangzhai station to the east interchanges Lines 3 and 14; ring expressways are close by. Since the Games the arena's badminton courts and the swimming and diving hall have operated as public fitness facilities, while the stadium bowl and plaza are used for concerts, commercial events and community sport.

address: 西安市长安区复兴大道与科统三路交叉口东北角（西咸新区沣东新城）
area_text: 占地280亩（约18.7万㎡）；总建筑面积26.8万㎡（含配套运营3.2万㎡）
intro_zh: 西安国际足球中心位于西安市长安区复兴大道与科统三路交叉口东北角，行政区划上属西咸新区沣东新城，是西北地区第一座、也是唯一符合国际足联标准的专业足球场，被球迷称为“沣东足球场”或“阿房宫足球场”。项目占地280亩，总建筑面积26.8万平方米，其中配套运营面积3.2万平方米，设6万个固定座席，配两块国际标准室外训练场，另有四块标准训练场。球场2020年8月13日开工，2025年9月3日正式启用，由扎哈·哈迪德建筑事务所联合德国gmp及上海建筑设计研究院设计，陕西建工控股集团承建，造价约30亿元。建筑设计取“周秦圣殿、汉唐雄风”意象，以大跨度屋檐和通高立柱呼应高台建筑，屋盖为全球首创的双层索网膜结构。它是国内首个同时通过国际足联与亚足联双重认证的专业球场，可承接除世界杯开幕式外的国际A级赛事。2025年9月迎来U23亚洲杯预选赛首秀，2026年起成为陕西联合足球俱乐部主场，单场观众纪录43,937人。交通方面，地铁16号线设西安国际足球中心站，场馆紧邻复兴大道与科统三路。
intro_en: Xi'an International Football Centre occupies the north-east corner of the Fuxing Avenue and Ketong Third Road junction in Chang'an District, administratively within the Fengdong New Town of Xixian New Area. It is the first specialist football stadium in north-west China and the only one there built to FIFA standards, known locally as the Fengdong or Epang Palace stadium. The scheme covers 280 mu, about 187,000 sqm, with 268,000 sqm of floor area including 32,000 sqm of operating space, 60,000 fixed seats, two international-standard outdoor training pitches and further training grounds. Work began on 13 August 2020 and the stadium opened on 3 September 2025; it was designed by Zaha Hadid Architects with gmp and the Shanghai Architectural Design Institute, built by Shaanxi Construction Engineering Holding Group at a cost of about three billion yuan. The design draws on the platform architecture of the Zhou, Qin and Han dynasties through deep overhanging eaves and full-height columns, under a roof using the world's first double-layer cable-net membrane structure. It is the first Chinese stadium certified by both FIFA and the AFC, able to stage international A-level matches short of a World Cup opening. It opened with AFC U23 Asian Cup qualifiers in September 2025, became the home of Shaanxi United in 2026, and holds a crowd record of 43,937. Metro Line 16 serves a station named after the stadium. Two international-standard training pitches and further training grounds sit beside the main stadium, and in March 2026 the venue staged the CFA China Team youth tournament with under-23 sides from China, Thailand, Vietnam and North Korea.

address: 西安市碑林区长安北路14号
area_text: 占地3.63万㎡（初建）；1999年改造后建筑面积9.7万㎡
intro_zh: 陕西省体育场位于西安市碑林区长安北路14号，夹在长安北路与朱雀大街之间、紧邻南二环长安立交，因靠近朱雀大街而被称为“朱雀体育场”，球迷又叫它“圣朱雀”。体育场1952年12月建成，始称“西北人民体育场”，1971年改称陕西省人民体育场，1954年7月1日正式启用，是西安历史最久的公共体育场。1996年为承办第四届全国城市运动会，陕西省投资2.5亿元改造扩建，1999年落成，建筑面积9.7万平方米，为椭圆型钢筋混凝土框架结构，看台分A至H八个区域，场内设符合国际田联要求的塑胶跑道和标准草坪足球场。2020年7月完成新一轮改造后，座位数由50,100个调整为42,383个。这里长期是中国国家足球队的固定主场之一，也曾是陕西国力、浐灞、长安竞技等球队的主场，2021年承接第十四届全运会女子足球比赛。场外配套国际展览中心、大型停车场、商务写字楼、技术办公区和多功能健身区，是西安城南重要的赛事与演出场地。交通方面，地铁2号线设体育场站，出站即达。
intro_en: Shaanxi Provincial Stadium stands at 14 Chang'an North Road in Beilin District, wedged between Chang'an North Road and Zhuque Avenue beside the Chang'an interchange of the South Second Ring. Its proximity to Zhuque Avenue gives it the nickname Zhuque Stadium, while fans call it the Holy Zhuque. Completed in December 1952 as the North-west People's Stadium and renamed the Shaanxi People's Stadium in 1971, it opened officially on 1 July 1954 and is the oldest public stadium in Xi'an. In 1996 the province invested 250 million yuan to rebuild it for the fourth National City Games; the new structure opened in 1999 with 97,000 sqm of floor area, an elliptical reinforced-concrete frame and stands divided into sections A to H around a synthetic track meeting IAAF requirements and a standard grass pitch. A further renovation completed in July 2020 reduced capacity from 50,100 to 42,383. The ground has long been one of the fixed home venues of the Chinese national football team and has hosted Shaanxi Guoli, Chanba and Chang'an Athletic, as well as women's football at the 14th National Games in 2021. An exhibition centre, large car parks, offices and fitness areas surround it. Metro Line 2 stops at Stadium station at the gate. The 2020 renovation was carried out for the 14th National Games, at which the stadium staged the women's football tournament; outside match days it serves athletics training, fitness runs and large-scale events. The ground is owned by the Shaanxi provincial government and managed by the Xi'an Zhuque Square administration committee.
