address: 贵州省贵阳市贵州双龙航空港经济区游龙西路与小碧东路交汇处
area_text: 项目总建筑面积36514.99平方米；主馆（A馆）15235.23平方米、地上3层
capacity_text: 公开资料未公布固定看台座位数（以全民健身与训练功能为主）
intro_zh: 贵州省体育馆（新馆）位于贵州省贵阳市贵州双龙航空港经济区游龙西路与小碧东路交汇处，是原贵阳市遵义路贵州省体育馆2020年启动迁建后落成的新馆，现以“贵州省全民健身中心”的名义运营，管理机构为贵州省全民健身服务中心（贵州省体育馆）。项目一期建设用地66005.9平方米（约99亩），总建筑面积36514.99平方米，由室内A、B、C三馆和室外健身场地组成。A馆即主馆，建筑面积15235.23平方米、地上3层，是承接原省体育馆比赛、训练和文体活动功能的核心空间；B馆8555.23平方米、2层，C馆2460.02平方米、1层，与A馆共同布置篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球、气排球、网球、壁球、匹克球、攀岩、射击、射箭等项目。新馆没有公布固定看台座位数，公开资料只给到各馆面积，若需按赛事看台布置应向运营方确认。2025年7月28日一期试运营，室外场地除真草足球场外全部开放，室内场地多数时段9:00至17:00低收费，工作日上午羽毛球、乒乓球、网球、匹克球、气排球、篮球免费。原省体育馆1988年建成，拥有6000个观众座位，曾是西南地区规模较大的体育馆之一，迁建后其赛事与演出功能由新馆接续。交通可乘贵阳地铁2号线至见龙洞站换乘755路直达，自驾经游龙西路进入，距龙洞堡机场较近。
intro_en: The new Guizhou Provincial Gymnasium stands at the junction of Youlong West Road and Xiaobi East Road in the Shuanglong Airport Economic Zone of Guiyang. It is the replacement built after the original provincial gymnasium on Zunyi Road began its relocation in 2020, and it now operates under the name Guizhou Provincial Public Fitness Center, managed by the Guizhou Provincial Public Fitness Service Center, which also carries the provincial gymnasium name. Phase one covers 66,005.9 square metres of construction land, about 99 mu, with 36,514.99 square metres of floor area made up of three indoor halls, A, B and C, plus outdoor fitness areas. Hall A is the main hall: 15,235.23 square metres over three storeys, it carries forward the competition, training and cultural-event functions of the old gymnasium. Hall B offers 8,555.23 square metres over two storeys and Hall C 2,460.02 square metres on one level; together they accommodate basketball, badminton, table tennis, light volleyball, tennis, squash, pickleball, climbing, shooting and archery. No fixed grandstand capacity has been published for the new building, only the floor areas of each hall, so event seating layouts must be confirmed with the operator. Phase one began trial operation on 28 July 2025, with all outdoor courts except the natural-turf football pitch open to the public; indoor facilities are low-charge for most of the 9 am to 5 pm day, and badminton, table tennis, tennis, pickleball, light volleyball and basketball are free on weekday mornings. The original gymnasium, completed in 1988 with 6,000 spectator seats, was one of the larger indoor arenas in south-west China, and its competition and concert programme now continues here. Metro Line 2 to Jianlongdong station plus bus 755 provides public transport, and the site is a short drive from Longdongbao Airport.

name_zh: 贵州省全民健身中心（原贵州省体育馆）
address: 贵州省贵阳市贵州双龙航空港经济区游龙西路与小碧东路交汇处
capacity_text: 未设固定看台座位数（以全民健身场地为主）
intro_zh: 贵州省全民健身中心位于贵州省贵阳市贵州双龙航空港经济区核心区游龙西路与小碧东路交汇处，前身是1988年建成、位于南明区遵义路的贵州省体育馆，2020年随老城区规划调整启动迁建，2025年7月28日一期试运营，是全省唯一的省级全民健身中心。项目一期建设用地66005.9平方米（约99亩），总建筑面积36514.99平方米，总投资概算6.89亿元，由室内A、B、C三馆和室外篮球场、羽毛球场、乒乓球场、足球场、健身广场组成。A馆15235.23平方米、3层，B馆8555.23平方米、2层，C馆2460.02平方米、1层；项目覆盖篮球、足球、羽毛球、乒乓球、气排球、网球、健身跑、轮滑、攀岩、壁球、匹克球、射击、射箭、模拟飞碟、拳击、跆拳道、柔道、武术、击剑、瑜伽、舞蹈、棋类等近30个项目，并建有室外智慧健身房。中心定位不止于健身场地，还承担体育训练、赛事活动、培训教育、体育产业五项功能，可为机关、企事业单位和社会团体提供活动场地，承接青少年夏冬令营和学校体教融合赛事。惠民开放力度较大：室外场地除足球场外全天免费，工作日上午9点至11点室内羽毛球、乒乓球、网球、匹克球、气排球、篮球免费。交通可乘地铁2号线至见龙洞站换乘755路，自驾经游龙西路直达，停车位充足。
intro_en: Guizhou Provincial Public Fitness Center occupies the core of the Shuanglong Airport Economic Zone in Guiyang, at the junction of Youlong West Road and Xiaobi East Road. Its predecessor was the Guizhou Provincial Gymnasium, completed in 1988 on Zunyi Road in Nanming District; relocation began in 2020 as part of the old-city redevelopment plan, and phase one entered trial operation on 28 July 2025. It is the only provincial-level public fitness centre in Guizhou. Phase one covers 66,005.9 square metres of construction land, about 99 mu, with 36,514.99 square metres of floor area and an approved budget of 689 million yuan. It comprises indoor halls A, B and C plus outdoor basketball, badminton, table tennis and football courts and a fitness plaza. Hall A has 15,235.23 square metres over three storeys, Hall B 8,555.23 square metres over two, and Hall C 2,460.02 square metres on one level. Nearly thirty activities are accommodated, including basketball, football, badminton, table tennis, light volleyball, tennis, running, roller skating, climbing, squash, pickleball, shooting, archery, simulated clay-target shooting, boxing, taekwondo, judo, martial arts, fencing, yoga, dance and board games, alongside an outdoor smart gym. The centre is more than a fitness venue: it also carries responsibilities for sports training, competitions, education and the sports industry, offers space to government bodies, companies and social organisations, and runs youth camps and school-integration events. Public access is generous — outdoor facilities other than the football pitch are free all day, and indoor badminton, table tennis, tennis, pickleball, light volleyball and basketball are free from 9 to 11 am on weekdays. Metro Line 2 to Jianlongdong plus bus 755 serves the site, which has ample parking and direct access from Youlong West Road.

name_zh: 贵阳市奥林匹克体育中心
address: 贵州省贵阳市观山湖区云潭南路与石林东路交叉口
intro_zh: 贵阳市奥林匹克体育中心位于贵阳市观山湖区云潭南路与石林东路交叉口，处在观山湖区新城与喀斯特公园、观山湖公园之间的城市西部片区，是贵州省规模最大、功能最齐全的大型体育综合场馆，因主体育场造型被称为“贵阳鸟巢”。项目占地1715亩（约114.3万平方米），总建筑面积25.7万平方米，2006年动工、2010年落成，由主体育场、体育馆、游泳跳水馆、网球中心及新闻中心、训练中心、管理中心等组成。主体育场设51636个座位，建筑面积与场地规模可承办国际单项赛事和国内综合赛事，场芯为105米×68米标准足球场与400米跑道（直道10道）。建筑由中国航空规划设计研究总院设计，取贵州少数民族的水牛角符号，东西两片水牛角形金属罩棚扣在环形看台上，罩棚立面与屋顶一体成型，与周边山体曲线呼应；立面用穿孔率随高度递减的金属穿孔铝板，由虚到实过渡到屋面实体板，兼顾遮阳与造型，挑篷靠场一侧采用带红外涂层的聚碳酸酯板以减少阴影。这里曾是第九届全国少数民族传统体育运动会主体育场，现为贵州贵阳竞技足球俱乐部主场，2026年6月15日二期体育馆开馆。交通方面，场馆经云潭南路、石林东路进出，地铁2号线兴筑路站、金阳医院站步行可达，公交设奥体中心站。
intro_en: Guiyang Olympic Sports Center sits at the junction of Yuntan South Road and Shilin East Road in Guanshanhu District, between the new district, Guiyang Karst Park and Guanshanhu Park on the city's western side. It is Guizhou's largest and most complete multi-sport complex, nicknamed the Guiyang Bird's Nest after the form of its main stadium. The 1,715-mu site, about 1.143 million sqm, carries 257,000 sqm of floor area; work began in 2006 and the centre was completed in 2010, comprising a main stadium, an arena, a swimming and diving hall, a tennis centre, and press, training and management buildings. The stadium seats 51,636 around a 105 by 68 m standard football pitch and a ten-lane 400 m track, sized for international single-sport events and national multi-sport games. Designed by the China Aviation Planning and Design Institute, the complex borrows the water-buffalo horn symbol of Guizhou's ethnic minorities: two horn-shaped metal canopies clasp the circular stands, their facade and roof formed as one continuous surface that echoes the surrounding hills. Perforated aluminium panels thin out with height, shifting from open to solid towards the roof for shading, while infrared-coated polycarbonate panels near the pitch reduce shadows on the field. It served as the main stadium of the 9th National Traditional Games of Ethnic Minorities and is now the home of Guizhou Guiyang Athletic Football Club; the phase-two arena opened on 15 June 2026. Yuntan South Road and Shilin East Road serve the site, Metro Line 2 stops at Xingzhu Road and Jinyang Hospital within walking distance, and buses call at Olympic Sports Center station.

address: 郑州市惠济区长兴路38号
area_text: 占地980亩，建筑面积86588平方米
intro_zh: 河南省体育中心位于惠济区长兴路38号，三全路、金杯路与长兴路在此交汇，地处郑州市区西北部。1996年开始筹备，2002年9月建成投用，总投资4.59亿元，占地980亩，建筑面积86588平方米，是新中国成立后河南建设的大型综合体育中心。核心体育场设48000个座席，其中贵宾席900个、记者席360个，建筑面积46301平方米，南北长255米、东西长262米，罩棚为球穹形钢网架结构，纵向跨度273米、覆盖面积28590平方米；中心另配田径附场、足球训练场、田径馆与综合训练馆，2008年10月室内田径馆交付使用，2012年7月游泳跳水馆投用。这里承办过世界传统武术大会开幕式、河南省运动会、中国足球乙级联赛决赛，长期作为河南建业主场，并举办过多场大型演唱会；2022年与河南省体育馆、中原网球训练基地管理中心合并为河南省体育场馆中心。地铁3号线、4号线省体育中心站位于中心西南角，三全路、金杯路公交线路密集。
intro_en: Henan Provincial Sports Center stands at 38 Changxing Road, Huiji District, where Sanquan, Jinbei and Changxing roads meet in the north-west of Zhengzhou. Preparatory work began in 1996, the complex opened in September 2002 at a total cost of 459 million yuan, and it covers 980 mu with 86,588 sqm of floor area, the province's principal public sports complex built since 1949. Its main stadium has 48,000 seats, including 900 VIP seats and 360 press seats, and 46,301 sqm of floor area; it measures 255 m north to south and 262 m east to west, and its domed steel space-frame roof spans 273 m longitudinally and covers 28,590 sqm. A secondary athletics field, football training pitches, an athletics hall and a multi-purpose training hall support the stadium; the indoor athletics hall was handed over in October 2008 and the swimming and diving hall opened in July 2012. The centre has staged the opening ceremony of the World Traditional Wushu Festival, Henan provincial games and the Chinese Football Association League Two final, served for years as the home of Henan Jianye and hosted many large concerts. In 2022 it was merged with the Henan Provincial Gymnasium and the Central Plains Tennis Training Base into the Henan Provincial Sports Venue Center. Provincial Sports Center station on Metro lines 3 and 4 sits at the south-west corner, with frequent buses on Sanquan and Jinbei roads. The complex is owned by the provincial sports bureau and run as a public institution. It lies about 35 km from Zhengzhou Xinzheng International Airport and some 15 km from the main railway station.

address: 郑州市管城回族区朝凤路18号
area_text: 占地160亩，建筑面积35000平方米
intro_zh: 航海体育场位于管城回族区朝凤路18号，处郑州经济技术开发区内、航海路与机场高速立交东南侧，2002年9月竣工，最初用于承办河南省第九届运动会足球比赛。体育场占地160亩，建筑面积35000平方米，外包尺寸244米×216米，设26个看区、34个疏散口，全座席29860个，看台上方为全覆盖双飞尖顶膜结构，场内铺设天然草坪与全天候塑胶跑道，配专业灯光、扩声、通讯、消防报警与电子大屏幕，东西两侧各设约900平方米多功能厅，用于贵宾接待、新闻发布与商务开发。2003赛季河南建业将主场迁回郑州并定址于此，2009年12月29日建业集团以1.18亿元买下体育场，成为中国第一家拥有专属主场的足球俱乐部；球队更名河南足球俱乐部后仍以此为主场，中超赛事与演唱会交替使用。场馆北临航海路、东靠机场高速，多条公交线路可达，周边为经开区工业与物流片区。场内外交通与疏散组织按大型赛事标准设计，赛事日可分流数万观众进出。
intro_en: Hanghai Stadium stands at 18 Chaofeng Road, Guancheng Hui District, inside the Zhengzhou Economic and Technological Development Zone south-east of the Hanghai Road interchange with the airport expressway. Completed in September 2002 at a total investment of about 120 million yuan, it was first used for the football tournament of the 9th Henan Provincial Games. The ground covers 160 mu with 35,000 sqm of floor area and an outer footprint of 244 by 216 m. It has 26 spectator zones and 34 evacuation exits, all-seater capacity of 29,860, a full-cover twin-peaked membrane roof over the stands, a natural grass pitch and an all-weather synthetic track, plus professional lighting, sound reinforcement, communications, fire alarm and electronic scoreboard systems. Two multi-purpose side halls of 904.91 and 908.15 sqm handle VIP reception, press conferences and commercial use. Henan Jianye moved its home games back to Zhengzhou and settled here for the 2003 season; on 29 December 2009 the Jianye group bought the stadium for 118 million yuan, making the club the first in China to own its own ground. Now renamed Henan FC, the club still plays here, with Chinese Super League fixtures alternating with concerts. A listed historic building of Zhengzhou since 10 December 2018, the ground is bounded by Hanghai Road to the north and the airport expressway to the east, served by several bus routes in an industrial and logistics district. At the time of construction the membrane roof and the all-weather track were cited as advanced features among Chinese stadiums.

address: 河南省郑州市金水区郑东新区金水东路与明理路交叉口东南角（后贾东街）
area_text: 总占地300亩（约20万平方米），总建筑面积约6万平方米；二期占地10万平方米、建筑面积3.48万平方米
capacity_text: 中心球场5000座、副场馆2000座、预赛场1600座
intro_zh: 中原网球中心（中原网球训练基地管理中心）位于河南省郑州市金水区郑东新区金水东路与明理路交叉口东南角、后贾东街一侧，隶属河南省体育局，2022年与河南省体育中心、河南省体育馆整合组建河南省体育场馆中心，现为该中心的东区。中心总占地300亩（约20万平方米），总建筑面积约6万平方米，总投资约4亿元，分两期建设。一期2013年10月交付，共有24片场地：南、北两个室内馆2012年12月建成，含8片室内场（其中VIP场地4片），室外16片（含VIP 4片），另配套训练、康复与办公用房。二期2020年7月底竣工，占地10万平方米、建筑面积3.48万平方米，包括5000座主场馆、2000座副场馆、1600座预赛场和4片练习场，看台可满足WTA巡回赛的转播与观众组织要求。二期以“生命运动之树”为设计理念，主场馆形态取意树干与树冠，周边以樱花为主题打造郑东“樱花公园”，把比赛场地与市民休闲结合。这里是中原地区规格最高的专业网球场地之一，2019年首届郑州网球公开赛（WTA超五赛）和2023年郑州网球公开赛（WTA500）均在中心举行，赛事期间中心球场作为决赛场。日常室外场地自2019年起实行免费预约开放，并配备夜间照明和直饮水。交通可乘郑州地铁1号线至市体育中心站，或乘166路、170路公交；自驾走金水东路、明理路，京港澳高速郑州新区站下向西2公里。
intro_en: Zhongyuan Tennis Center, formally the Zhongyuan Tennis Training Base Management Center, sits at the south-east corner of Jinshui East Road and Mingli Road in the Zhengdong New Area of Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, on the Houjia East Street side. It belongs to the Henan Provincial Sports Bureau and in 2022 was merged with Henan Provincial Sports Center and Henan Provincial Gymnasium into the Henan Provincial Sports Venue Center, of which it now forms the eastern district. The centre covers 300 mu, about 200,000 square metres, with roughly 60,000 square metres of floor area and a total investment of about 400 million yuan, built in two phases. Phase one was handed over in October 2013 with 24 courts: two indoor halls completed in December 2012 hold eight indoor courts, four of them VIP, while sixteen outdoor courts include four VIP courts, supported by training, recovery and office space. Phase two was completed at the end of July 2020 on 100,000 square metres of land with 34,800 square metres of building, comprising a 5,000-seat main stadium court, a 2,000-seat secondary court, a 1,600-seat preliminary competition court and four practice courts, with stands designed for WTA broadcast and spectator requirements. The design concept is the tree of life, the main court taking the form of trunk and canopy, and the surrounding area is planted as a cherry-blossom park that combines competition with public leisure. It is one of the highest-standard tennis venues in central China: the first Zhengzhou Open, a WTA Premier Five event, was held here in 2019, and the Zhengzhou Open returned as a WTA 500 tournament in 2023, using the main court for finals. Outdoor courts have been free to book since 2019 and have night lighting and drinking water. Metro Line 1 to Municipal Sports Center station, or buses 166 and 170, provide access; drivers use Jinshui East Road and Mingli Road, two kilometres west of the Zhengzhou New Area exit of the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau expressway.

address: 河南省郑州市金水区健康路99号（文化路、健康路、优胜北路与优胜南路合围区域）
area_text: 占地49119平方米；主场馆建筑面积7800平方米，直径64米、高25.55米
intro_zh: 河南省体育馆位于河南省郑州市金水区健康路99号，处在文化路、健康路、优胜北路与优胜南路合围的市中心地带，因圆形外观被市民昵称为“大锅”。场馆1965年8月动工、1967年4月建成投用（另有资料记1966年建成），由中南工业建筑设计院设计、河南省第一建筑工程公司承建，是郑州现存年代最早的大型室内体育馆之一。主场馆为钢筋环屋顶圆形建筑，直径64米、高25.55米，建筑面积7800平方米，设观众席5521座；比赛大厅位于中央，直径37米，铺木地板，看台下布置准备室、灯光室、储藏室、加热室、运动员休息室和淋浴间。屋顶由36根混凝土柱支撑，面层为铝板，中央有高出屋面3米、直径11米的气楼用于通风采光。整个院区占地49119平方米，除主场馆外还有游泳馆、综合训练馆（乒乓球馆、网球场等）和大型室外“体彩”健身场地，常年举办青少年篮球、艺术体操培训、文艺演出和展览。主场馆2011年3月列入郑州市中心城区优秀近现代建筑保护名录，2018年12月入选郑州市第一批历史建筑；2022年，河南省体育馆与河南省体育中心、中原网球训练基地管理中心整合组建河南省体育场馆中心，这里成为该中心本部。交通便利，地铁5号线郑州人民医院站步行可达，周边有6路、21路、28路、205路等数十条公交线路。
intro_en: Henan Provincial Gymnasium stands at 99 Jiankang Road in Jinshui District, Zhengzhou, in the city-centre block bounded by Wenhua Road, Jiankang Road, Yousheng North Road and Yousheng South Road. Its round form earned it the local nickname 'the big wok'. Work began in August 1965 and the hall opened in April 1967, although some sources give 1966, designed by the Central-South Industrial Architectural Design Institute and built by Henan No.1 Construction Engineering Company; it is one of Zhengzhou's oldest surviving large indoor arenas. The main hall is a circular building with a reinforced-concrete ring roof, 64 metres in diameter and 25.55 metres high, with 7,800 square metres of floor area and 5,521 spectator seats. The competition floor in the centre is 37 metres across and laid in timber, with preparation rooms, lighting and storage rooms, a heating room, team changing rooms and showers beneath the stands. Thirty-six concrete columns carry the aluminium-clad roof, which has an 11-metre-diameter lantern three metres above the roof surface for ventilation and daylight. The walled compound covers 49,119 square metres and also contains a swimming hall, a multi-purpose training hall with table tennis and tennis courts, and a large outdoor sports-lottery fitness area; youth basketball and rhythmic gymnastics classes, performances and exhibitions run throughout the year. The main hall was listed in Zhengzhou's register of outstanding modern architecture in March 2011 and among the city's first batch of historic buildings in December 2018. In 2022 the gymnasium was merged with Henan Provincial Sports Center and the Zhongyuan Tennis Training Base Management Center to form the Henan Provincial Sports Venue Center, for which it serves as headquarters. Metro Line 5 to Zhengzhou People's Hospital station is a short walk away, and dozens of bus routes including 6, 21, 28 and 205 serve the surrounding streets.

address: 河南省郑州市管城回族区人民路1号（二七广场东北侧）
area_text: 占地2860平方米，建筑面积7380平方米；比赛大厅40米×25米，净高12.24米
intro_zh: 郑州体育馆位于河南省郑州市管城回族区人民路1号，紧邻二七广场，是郑州市为迎接1985年第一届全国青少年运动会而兴建的重点场馆。工程1984年8月1日破土、1985年8月30日竣工，占地2860平方米，建筑面积7380平方米，方形平面，主体为框架结构，屋顶为跨度41.5米的桁架结构，东西两面设4座观众大门。馆内分上下两层：上层为比赛大厅，纵轴南北向，木地板，内场40米×25米，净空高12.24米，观众席设在东西两侧，为悬挂式座椅，可容纳3038人，能举办篮球、排球、五人小足球、手球、乒乓球、羽毛球、体操、艺术体操、击剑、武术、举重、摔跤、柔道等比赛和文艺演出；下层为贵宾休息室、运动员与裁判员休息室、库房、配电房等。2019年为承办第十一届全国少数民族传统体育运动会，郑州市投入4000余万元全面改造，外墙改为灰色，内墙采用竹木纤维板，灯光、座椅更新，部分空间改为媒体中心、更衣室和裁判员休息室，音响提升到可办小型演唱会的水平。2023年5月，郑州体育馆与郑州航海体育场、郑州市网球中心整合组建郑州市体育场馆保障中心。场馆现以免费、低收费方式开放，时间为7:00至12:00、14:00至18:00，馆外东侧和南侧约500平方米的健身园配71件器材，24小时免费开放。交通可乘地铁1号线、3号线至二七广场站，或1号线人民路站。
intro_en: Zhengzhou Gymnasium at 1 Renmin Road in the Guancheng Hui District sits just north-east of Erqi Square and was built as a centrepiece for the first National Youth Games in 1985. Ground was broken on 1 August 1984 and the building was completed on 30 August 1985 on a 2,860-square-metre footprint with 7,380 square metres of floor area. It is square in plan with a frame structure and a 41.5-metre-span truss roof, and four spectator entrances open on the east and west sides. The interior has two levels. Above is the competition hall, laid out north-south with a timber floor 40 by 25 metres and a clear height of 12.24 metres; 3,038 suspended seats run along the east and west sides. It stages basketball, volleyball, five-a-side football, handball, table tennis, badminton, gymnastics, rhythmic gymnastics, fencing, martial arts, weightlifting, wrestling, judo and cultural performances. Below are VIP, team and referee rooms, stores and electrical plant. For the 11th National Traditional Games of Ethnic Minorities in 2019 the city spent more than 40 million yuan on a full renovation: the facade became grey, interior walls were finished in bamboo-wood fibre board, lighting and seating were renewed, some space was converted into a media centre, changing rooms and referee rooms, and the sound system was upgraded to concert standard. In May 2023 the gymnasium was merged with Zhengzhou Hanghai Stadium and Zhengzhou Tennis Center to form the Zhengzhou Sports Venue Support Center. It now opens free or at low charge from 7 am to noon and 2 pm to 6 pm, while a fitness garden of about 500 square metres with 71 pieces of equipment on the east and south sides is open around the clock. Metro Lines 1 and 3 stop at Erqi Square, with Line 1 also at Renmin Road.

address: 河南省郑州市管城回族区商城路230号（人民路与二七广场商圈东侧）
area_text: 场馆占地5000平方米，训练教学建筑面积2万平方米；场内为标准400米田径场与足球场
intro_zh: 郑州市体育场位于河南省郑州市管城回族区商城路230号，紧邻人民路和二七广场商圈，与郑州体育馆南北相邻，是1985年第一届全国青少年运动会的核心比赛场馆之一。体育场为露天设计，1985年建成投用，配有标准400米田径跑道和足球场，四周看台可容纳5000名观众。场馆占地5000平方米，训练教学建筑面积2万平方米，院内还承担业余体校训练功能，开展田径、排球、体操、跆拳道、武术、乒乓球等项目。青运会结束后，这里长期作为郑州市田径、足球单项赛事以及学校、企事业单位运动会的主会场，也是市民日常跑步和健身的重要公共场所，田径跑道及配套健身设施常年免费或低收费开放，免费时段为每日6:30至9:00和19:30至21:30。体育场与郑州体育馆同属郑州市体育场馆保障中心管理，2023年该中心由郑州体育馆、郑州航海体育场和郑州市网球中心整合组建。交通方面，地铁1号线人民路站、二七广场站（1号线、3号线）均在步行范围内，从郑州火车站乘101路、2路、33路等公交可直达商城路。
intro_en: Zhengzhou Municipal Stadium at 230 Shangcheng Road in the Guancheng Hui District lies beside the Renmin Road and Erqi Square commercial area, immediately south of Zhengzhou Gymnasium, and was one of the core venues of the first National Youth Games in 1985. The open-air stadium was completed that year with a standard 400-metre athletics track and a football pitch, and stands for 5,000 spectators around the perimeter. The site covers 5,000 square metres, with 20,000 square metres of training and teaching buildings, and also supports a spare-time sports school in athletics, volleyball, gymnastics, taekwondo, martial arts and table tennis. Since the Youth Games it has served as the main ground for Zhengzhou athletics and football fixtures and for school, company and government games, and as an important everyday running and fitness space for residents. The track and associated fitness facilities are free or low-charge all year, with free hours from 6:30 to 9:00 every morning and 19:30 to 21:30 in the evening. The stadium is managed, like Zhengzhou Gymnasium, by the Zhengzhou Sports Venue Support Center formed in 2023 from the gymnasium, Zhengzhou Hanghai Stadium and Zhengzhou Tennis Center. Metro Line 1 at Renmin Road and Lines 1 and 3 at Erqi Square are within walking distance, and buses 101, 2 and 33 run directly from Zhengzhou railway station to Shangcheng Road. The ground sits inside the old commercial core a few minutes' walk from the Erqi Memorial Tower, and its track is one of the best-known free training spots in the city centre. It remains a busy public ground, with school sports days, amateur football and morning running sharing the track and pitch through the week.

name_zh: 郑州奥林匹克体育中心
address: 河南省郑州市中原区西四环东50米（博体路，郑州中央文化区CCD，郑州植物园北侧）
area_text: 占地483亩（约32.2万㎡），总建筑面积58.4万㎡
intro_zh: 郑州奥林匹克体育中心地处郑州中央文化区CCD核心区域，紧邻郑州植物园，位于中原区西四环东侧，是河南省投资最高、体量最大、功能最全的大型综合体育场馆。项目占地483亩（约32.2万平方米），总建筑面积58.4万平方米，总投资约75.61亿元，由“一场两馆”及配套设施组成：6万座体育场一座、1.6万座甲级体育馆一座、3000座甲级游泳馆一座，另有悬挂式酒店、2000人会展中心、户外标准运动场、羽毛球中心、冰场训练场和篮球热身馆等。体育场看台座椅以红、橙、灰三色拼排，屋面采用金属屋面板与阳光板封闭，从外部看三座场馆如镶嵌在南水北调渠畔的巨型玻璃体，夜间整体泛光，是郑州西区最醒目的地标群。场馆可承办全国综合性运动会以及篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球、花样滑冰、速度滑冰、冰球、冰壶等27项国际单项赛事，2019年8月投用后已承接第十一届全国少数民族传统体育运动会、2019与2020两届国际乒联世界巡回赛总决赛等70余场大型活动，2020年入选全国49个体育服务综合体典型案例，为河南省唯一入选场馆。交通方面，场馆位于西四环与博体路一带，地铁14号线设体育中心站，多条公交线路可达，自驾经文博大道、西四环进出便利。
intro_en: Zhengzhou Olympic Sports Center sits in the heart of the city's Central Culture District (CCD) in Zhongyuan District, immediately north of Zhengzhou Botanical Garden and just east of the West Fourth Ring Road. It is Henan's largest single investment in sports infrastructure and its most complete multi-purpose venue. The 483-mu (about 322,000 sqm) site holds 584,000 sqm of floor area, built for roughly 7.56 billion yuan, and comprises a 60,000-seat stadium, a 16,000-seat Class-A arena and a 3,000-seat Class-A swimming hall, together with a suspended hotel, a 2,000-person exhibition centre, an outdoor standard pitch, a badminton centre, an ice training rink and a basketball warm-up hall. Stadium seats are arranged in red, orange and grey bands; metal roofing and translucent sheeting enclose the halls so that the three buildings read as giant glass volumes beside the South-to-North Water Diversion canal, and the ensemble is lit as a landmark for western Zhengzhou after dark. The complex can stage national multi-sport games and 27 international single-sport disciplines, including basketball, badminton, table tennis, figure and speed skating, ice hockey and curling. Since opening in August 2019 it has hosted more than 70 major events, among them the 11th National Traditional Games of Ethnic Minorities and the 2019 and 2020 ITTF World Tour Grand Finals, and in 2020 it was named one of 49 national model sports service complexes, the only one in Henan. Metro Line 14 stops at Sports Center station, with bus routes and the West Fourth Ring Road providing road access, and the linked plaza system lets spectators move between the three halls without crossing open roads.

address: 河南省郑州市二七区建中街街道庆丰街28号
area_text: 室内综合馆建筑面积7325平方米；室外为标准400米田径场与11人制天然草坪足球场（园区总用地面积未公布）
capacity_text: 室外露天看台4000席；室内馆固定观众席3300席
intro_zh: 郑铁体育中心全称郑州铁路局体育活动中心，旧称火车头体育场，位于郑州市二七区建中街街道庆丰街28号，隶属中国铁路郑州局集团有限公司，是郑州现存历史最久的综合性体育场馆之一。其前身可追溯到1933年陇海铁路局在郑州火车站西侧马砦村修建的陇海体育场，那是郑州第一座现代化标准运动场；抗战期间被炸毁，1952年铁路部门在铁路文化宫西南侧复建火车头体育场，1975年因原址被铁路线路合围、交通受限，整体迁到庆丰街现址。园区分室外场与室内馆两部分：室外为1975年建成的火车头体育场，设标准400米塑胶环形跑道、天然草皮11人制足球场和4000席露天看台，外围连片布置露天篮球场、网球场、门球场、乒乓球台与全民健身路径；室内为1985年建成的火车头体育馆，建筑面积7325平方米、固定观众席3300座，当时为承办首届全国青少年运动会而建，可打篮球、排球、乒乓球、羽毛球，也能承接举重、体操赛事和文艺汇演。这里长期承办郑州铁路局职工运动会与省市级业余球类、门球、田径赛事，室外跑道和健身器材每天5:30至22:00免费开放，室内馆优先保障铁路系统职工、对外低收费出租。交通上，郑州地铁6号线火车头体育场站2024年11月30日启用，出站即到；20路、40路、57路、210路、B60路等公交在庆丰街沿线设站，场馆就在郑州火车站西侧的老城片区。
intro_en: Zhengzhou Railway Sports Centre, formally the Sports Activity Centre of the Zhengzhou Railway Bureau and long known as Huochetou (Locomotive) Stadium, stands at 28 Qingfeng Street in Erqi District, Zhengzhou, and belongs to China Railway Zhengzhou Group. Its history reaches back to 1933, when the Longhai Railway administration built the Longhai Stadium west of Zhengzhou station, the city's first modern standard sports ground; that site was destroyed by bombing during the war. A replacement, Huochetou Stadium, opened in 1952 near the railway cultural palace and was moved wholesale to Qingfeng Street in 1975 after the old site became hemmed in by rail lines. The complex has two halves. Outdoors is the 1975 stadium with a standard 400-metre synthetic track, a natural-turf eleven-a-side football pitch and 4,000 open-stand seats, surrounded by outdoor basketball and tennis courts, a gateball lawn, table-tennis tables and fitness trails. Indoors is the 1985 Huochetou Gymnasium, built for the first National Youth Games: 7,325 square metres with 3,300 fixed seats, used for basketball, volleyball, table tennis and badminton as well as weightlifting, gymnastics and staff variety shows. The venue has hosted Zhengzhou Railway Bureau staff games and city and provincial amateur tournaments for decades. The outdoor track and fitness equipment are free to the public from 5:30 to 22:00 daily, while the indoor hall gives railway employees priority and is rented to outside users at low rates. Metro Line 6 opened a Huochetou Stadium station at the gate on 30 November 2024, and buses 20, 40, 57, 210 and B60 stop along Qingfeng Street, a short ride from Zhengzhou railway station.

address: 重庆市忠县复兴镇水坪社区（石垫路，长江南岸）
area_text: 占地110亩，总建筑面积11.4万平方米（电竞场馆7.9万平方米）
intro_zh: 三峡港湾电竞馆位于忠县复兴镇水坪社区、长江南岸，2017年5月开工、当年11月底建成投用，是国内较早以电子竞技为主题的专业化场馆，也是忠县“电竞小镇”的核心设施。项目占地110亩，总建筑面积11.4万平方米，其中电竞场馆7.9万平方米，由地下一层、地上四层结构及穹顶金属屋面组成，结构最大高度68.42米；主场馆呈圆形，内设5500个观众席位，连同主席台与工作席总计可容纳约6096人。馆内中央设八面形大型LED屏用于赛事直播，配1000兆专用光纤与1000兆备用网络，可满足比赛、转播、媒体报道与观众观赛需求。2017年CMEG全国移动电子竞技大赛总决赛在此举行，此后承接中韩电竞嘉年华、长江三峡网络音乐节、“武林风”等赛事与演出，并作为电竞产业孵化、数字产业人才培养的载体。场馆面朝长江，东、北两侧临城市干道，西靠山体，南侧为住宅用地，距忠县县城约十分钟车程，与《烽烟三国》实景演艺、天子山乡村旅游共同构成三峡港湾旅游度假区。
intro_en: Sanxia Gangwan E-sports Arena sits in Shuiping community, Fuxing town, Zhongxian county, on the southern bank of the Yangtze. Construction began in May 2017 and the arena opened at the end of November that year, making it one of China's earlier purpose-built e-sports venues and the centrepiece of Zhongxian's e-sports town. The project covers 110 mu with 114,000 sqm of floor area, of which the arena itself accounts for 79,000 sqm; it has one basement level, four storeys above ground and a domed metal roof, with a maximum structural height of 68.42 m. The main hall is circular and holds 5,500 spectator seats, or about 6,096 people including the main stand and working seats. An eight-sided LED screen at the centre of the hall carries live match feeds, and dedicated 1,000 Mbps fibre links with a 1,000 Mbps backup were installed for global broadcast, supporting competition, streaming, media work and spectators at the same time. The 2017 CMEG national mobile e-sports finals were staged here, followed by China-Korea e-sports carnivals, the Yangtze Three Gorges online music festival and Wulin Feng fight nights; the building also houses e-sports industry incubation and digital talent training. It faces the Yangtze, with planned city roads to the east and north, a hillside to the west and housing to the south, about ten minutes by car from Zhongxian town, and forms part of the Sanxia Gangwan resort area alongside the Fengyan Sanguo live show and Tianzi Mountain rural tourism. Its steel structure used nearly 40,000 tonnes of steel, approaching the quantity in the National Stadium in Beijing.

address: 重庆市渝中区两路口体育村34号
area_text: 占地91157平方米
intro_zh: 大田湾体育场位于渝中区两路口，1951年由贺龙主持筹建，1955年5月动工、1956年2月9日竣工，是新中国成立后修建的第一座甲级体育场。体育场占地约9.75万平方米（现测91157平方米），四周阶梯式看台围成椭圆形，西看台为主看台，设观礼台、司令台与广播设施，建成时可容纳4.5万名观众；内场为天然草坪足球场，外围400米跑道，长期作为重庆大型集会、体育比赛与文艺演出的主场地，也是重庆力帆等球队早期主场。2005年看台被鉴定为危房后仅开放内场，2019年底启动大田湾—贺龙广场—文化宫片区保护提升工程，2022年12月30日重新开放，看台重建后可容纳23200名观众，并新增800米智慧健身环道、地下停车库与全民健身广场。场馆地处两路口核心，轨道交通1号线、3号线两路口站步行约300米，紧邻重庆市体育馆与跳伞塔，周边为重庆老城的行政、医疗与商业街区。如今这里既是专业比赛场地，也是市民日常健身与城市公共活动的开放空间。
intro_en: Datianwan Stadium stands at Lianglukou in Yuzhong District. Planned under He Long from 1951, built from May 1955 and completed on 9 February 1956, it was the first Class-A stadium constructed in the People's Republic of China, and its opening was marked by the first Chongqing workers' sports meeting. The ground covers about 97,500 sqm, now surveyed at 91,157 sqm, with stepped terracing on all four sides enclosing an oval bowl. The west stand is the main stand, with a ceremonial platform, command platform and broadcast facilities, and the stadium held 45,000 spectators when new. A natural-turf football pitch and a 400 m track formed the field, and for decades the venue was Chongqing's principal site for mass rallies, sports fixtures and performances as well as an early home ground for the city's football clubs. After the terracing was classified as unsafe in 2005 only the field remained in use; the Datianwan-He Long Square-Wenhua Gong protection and upgrading project began at the end of 2019 and the stadium reopened on 30 December 2022 with rebuilt stands seating 23,200, an 800 m smart fitness loop, an underground car park and a public fitness plaza. Owned by the municipal government and managed by the Datianwan public fitness centre, which also runs the neighbouring Chongqing Gymnasium, it sits at the heart of Lianglukou, about 300 m on foot from Lianglukou station on Metro lines 1 and 3, next to the old parachute tower, surrounded by the administrative, medical and commercial streets of the old city.

address: 重庆市永川区中山路街道红河大道539号
area_text: 占地103555平方米，建筑面积34000平方米
intro_zh: 永川体育中心位于永川区中山路街道红河大道539号，2008年建成投用，是渝西地区较早完成“一场一池一馆”配置的区级体育中心。中心占地103555平方米，建筑面积34000平方米，核心为一座可容纳30000名观众的体育场，内场设天然草坪标准足球场与400米环形塑胶跑道，周边配套游泳馆、室外篮球场、门球场、网球场以及商业门面与停车场。2020年7月起实施升级改造，改造后可满足全运会、全国田径锦标赛等高规格赛事要求，2021年作为重庆市第六届运动会开幕式与主要比赛场地。这里还是中国女足国家队训练基地之一，2018年10月永川国际女足锦标赛中国对葡萄牙的比赛在此举行，平日由区文化和旅游发展委员会管理，免费或低收费向公众开放。场馆位于永川城区红河大道沿线，距重庆主城约60公里，成渝高速、九永高速可达，周边为职教园区与新建居住区，是渝西承办大型赛事的主要场地之一。工作日的场地主要由本地学校与俱乐部使用。
intro_en: Yongchuan Sports Center stands at 539 Honghe Avenue, Zhongshan Road subdistrict, Yongchuan District, in the west of Chongqing municipality. Completed and opened in 2008, it was one of the earlier district-level complexes in the region to provide a stadium, a swimming pool and an indoor arena, and it is one of the district's three public sports venues alongside Tangcheng Gymnasium and the district swimming pool. The site covers 103,555 sqm with 34,000 sqm of floor area. Its core is a stadium seating 30,000 spectators, with a natural-turf full-size football pitch and a 400 m synthetic running track, supported by a swimming hall, outdoor basketball courts, gateball and tennis courts, shop units and parking. An upgrading programme began in July 2020 and brought the venue up to the standard required for National Games and national athletics championships, and in 2021 it served as the opening-ceremony venue and main competition site of the 6th Chongqing Municipal Games. It is also one of the training bases of the Chinese women's national football team, and in October 2018 the Yongchuan International Women's Football Tournament match between China and Portugal was played here. Owned by the district state-owned assets service centre, the centre is managed day to day by the district culture and tourism development commission and opened to the public free of charge or at low cost. It lies about 60 km from central Chongqing, reached by the Chengdu-Chongqing and Jiuyong expressways, among vocational colleges and new residential districts. Local schools and clubs use the pitch and track on weekdays.

address: 重庆市江北区洋河北路6号
area_text: 占地约258亩（城市更新地块约2.45万平方米）
intro_zh: 重庆洋河体育场位于江北区洋河北路6号，处黄泥塝片区，毗邻观音桥商圈与九街。体育场由力帆集团于2001年投资8000万元修建，总占地约258亩，看台可容纳32000名观众，2005年改造后被称作全国第一个由俱乐部拥有产权、位于市区基地内的专用足球主场。这里曾是重庆力帆足球俱乐部的主场，2008年11月15日力帆在此以3比2击败南京有有完成冲超；2009年球队主场迁至重庆奥体中心后，场地主要承办预备队联赛与青少年比赛，2022年俱乐部解散后一度闲置。近年启动渝地洋河体育中心城市更新改造，项目占地约2.45万平方米，改造后建筑面积约6.89万平方米，以“洋河6号”为名打造体育、商业、文化复合体，一期预计2026年内开业。场馆距轨道交通3号线嘉州路站约1.2公里，141路、411路、879路等公交在“洋河体育场”站停靠，周边为黄泥塝成熟居住区与花卉市场。改造完成后，这一片区将重新承担足球赛事、全民健身与商业活动功能。
intro_en: Chongqing Yanghe Stadium stands at 6 Yanghe North Road in Jiangbei District, in the Huangnibang area next to the Guanyinqiao retail district and Jiujie. Built by the Lifan group in 2001 at a cost of 80 million yuan, the ground covers about 258 mu and its terracing holds 32,000 spectators; the site originally formed part of a Lifan training base with several pitches and a club building. After a 2005 refit it was described as the first dedicated football stadium in China owned by a club and located inside a city-centre training base. It served as the home of Chongqing Lifan, and on 15 November 2008 Lifan beat Nanjing Youyou 3-2 here to win promotion to the top flight. When the club moved its home games to the Chongqing Olympic Sports Center in 2009 the stadium was mainly used for reserve-league and youth matches, and it fell idle after the club was dissolved in 2022. An urban renewal project, Yudi Yanghe Sports Center, has since started on the site: about 24,500 sqm of land will carry roughly 68,900 sqm of floor area in a sports, retail and cultural complex branded Yanghe No. 6, with the first phase expected to open during 2026. The ground is now owned by Chongqing Yudi Vision City Operation Management, the vehicle for the renewal, about 1.2 km from Jiazhoulu station on Metro Line 3; buses 141, 411 and 879 stop at Yanghe Stadium, and the surrounding Huangnibang neighbourhood is a mature residential and flower-market district.

address: 重庆市两江新区龙盛新城怡园路与两江大道交叉口西南角（行政区属渝北区龙兴镇）
intro_zh: 重庆龙兴足球场位于重庆主城东部、长江以北的两江新区龙盛新城，怡园路与两江大道交叉口西南角，距中心城区约25公里、距江北国际机场约14公里，是重庆首座专业足球场，也是国内规模最大的专业足球场之一。项目占地约303亩（用地面积20.18万平方米），总建筑面积16.69万平方米，其中地上10.69万平方米、地下6万平方米，设置约6万个固定坐席，另配竞赛区、媒体与转播区、商业运营区和观众区。球场以“重庆气质的足球殿堂”为设计理念，外观取“火凤凰”“飞轮”“风车”意象，整体盘旋上升、螺旋向心，呼应龙兴古镇文脉；银白色外墙内嵌约46万颗灯珠，夜间可化作近8万平方米的LED展示面，俯瞰屋顶呈龙腾图案。看台座椅以红、橙两色铺陈，呼应火锅红汤与黄油的城市记忆，南看台设超过9000座的主队超级粉丝看台，是国内少见的整面死忠看台设计。场馆原为2023年亚洲杯承办场地，2022年12月竣工后转向赛事、演艺与全民健身复合运营，现为中超重庆铜梁龙主场之一，并承接国际A级热身赛、音乐节与城市马拉松活动。交通方面，用地东侧紧邻两江大道与轨道交通4号线，经绕城高速、两江大道可快速连接江北机场与主城。
intro_en: Chongqing Longxing Football Stadium occupies the southwestern corner of the Yiyuan Road and Liangjiang Avenue junction in Longsheng New Town, Liangjiang New Area, on the north bank of the Yangtze in eastern Chongqing. About 25 km from the city centre and 14 km from Jiangbei International Airport, it is Chongqing's first purpose-built football ground and one of the largest in China. The 303-mu (20.18 ha) site carries 166,900 sqm of floor area, 106,900 sqm above ground and 60,000 sqm below, with roughly 60,000 fixed seats plus competition, media and broadcast, commercial and spectator zones. Designed as a football temple with Chongqing character, the building takes the imagery of a fire phoenix, a flywheel and a windmill, spiralling upward around a central bowl in reference to nearby Longxing ancient town. Its silver-white skin embeds some 460,000 LED beads that turn the facade into an 80,000 sqm display at night, while the roof reads as a coiled dragon from above. Seats are finished in red and orange, a nod to the city's hotpot, and the south stand provides more than 9,000 places for home supporters, an unusually large single-tier ultra stand. Built for the 2023 AFC Asian Cup and completed in December 2022, the stadium now runs a mixed programme of football, concerts and public fitness, serving as one of two home grounds for Chongqing Tonglianglong in the Chinese Super League and hosting international A-class friendlies, music festivals and city running events. Liangjiang Avenue and Metro Line 4 run along the eastern edge, linking the site quickly to the airport and the urban core.

name_zh: 重庆市奥林匹克体育中心
address: 重庆市九龙坡区袁家岗（奥体三支路；东起长江路、南至袁茄路及谢陈路、西起陶家岩、北至重医附一院及渝州宾馆）
area_text: 占地1350亩（约90万㎡），东西长1.7公里、南北宽1.3公里
intro_zh: 重庆市奥林匹克体育中心位于重庆主城几何中心的九龙坡区袁家岗地区，东起长江路、南至袁茄路及谢陈路、西起陶家岩、北至重医附一院及渝州宾馆，东西长约1.7公里、南北宽约1.3公里，占地1350亩（约90万平方米），是重庆从五十年代起即着手规划、2004年前后建成投用的市级大型综合体育设施。中心以6万座主体育场为核心，配套综合体育馆、游泳跳水馆、室外训练场及商业、住宿等服务设施，看台沿椭圆环形展开，罩棚以大跨度钢结构覆盖，场芯为天然草坪足球场与400米塑胶跑道，可承办田径、足球等国际与国内赛事，也可转换用于大型演唱会与城市集会。作为西部规模较大、容纳人数较多的综合性体育场馆群，这里承办过亚洲田径锦标赛、中超联赛主场赛事以及大量商业演出，是重庆市民观赛、健身与文体消费的重要目的地，周边形成以奥体为中心的袁家岗商圈。交通方面，场馆地处主城几何中心，长江路、谢陈路、袁茄路在此交汇，轨道交通2号线袁家岗站紧邻场馆，多条公交线路停靠，从解放碑、观音桥等核心商圈均可快速到达。
intro_en: Chongqing Olympic Sports Center occupies the geometric centre of the main city in Jiulongpo District, at Yuanjiagang. Its boundaries run from Changjiang Road in the east to Yuanqie and Xiechen roads in the south, Taojiayan in the west and the First Affiliated Hospital of Chongqing Medical University and Yuzhou Hotel in the north, stretching about 1.7 km east to west and 1.3 km north to south across 1,350 mu, roughly 900,000 sqm. Planned as far back as the 1950s and completed in the mid-2000s, it is Chongqing's flagship municipal sports complex. A 60,000-seat stadium forms the core, supported by an indoor arena, a swimming and diving hall, outdoor training grounds and commercial and accommodation facilities. Seating wraps an oval bowl under a long-span steel roof, with a natural-turf football pitch and 400 m synthetic track that can stage international and domestic athletics and football as well as concerts and civic gatherings. As one of western China's largest and highest-capacity venue clusters, it has hosted the Asian Athletics Championships, Chinese Super League fixtures and a long list of commercial concerts, and it anchors the Yuanjiagang commercial district that has grown around it, with hotels, retail and offices layered along the stadium's outer ring. Sitting at the centre of the urban road network, the site meets Changjiang Road, Xiechen Road and Yuanqie Road, Metro Line 2 stops at Yuanjiagang immediately beside the complex, numerous bus routes serve the gates, and Jiefangbei and Guanyinqiao are both a short ride away. A wide outer plaza and underground parking handle event-day crowds without spilling onto the surrounding streets.

name_zh: 浙江师范大学东体育场
address: 浙江省金华市婺城区迎宾大道688号浙江师范大学校本部东侧
area_text: 总建筑面积8391平方米；400米标准田径场加天然草坪足球场，按一类田径场地配置投掷区
intro_zh: 浙江师范大学东体育场位于金华市婺城区迎宾大道688号浙江师范大学校本部东侧，是杭州第19届亚运会足球项目的比赛场馆之一，与金华市体育中心体育场共同承担金华赛区的足球小组赛。场馆总建筑面积8391平方米，观众席11349个，场地为400米标准田径场加天然草坪足球场；亚运改造时按一类田径场地标准补齐了标枪、铁饼、链球等田赛投掷区，除国际足球比赛外也能承接国内各级田径赛事。草坪铺设用卫星定位系统控制精度，草面刻意做成中间高、两侧低约千分之三的坡度，让雨季积水顺着坡向排走，这是转播镜头里看不出来的细节。改造之前，这里已经办过浙江省第12届大学生运动会、浙江省大学生田径精英赛、浙江省大学生足球锦标赛、浙江省中学生田径运动会等赛事；学校在北侧另设北体育场作为热身场地，亚运期间两场合用。浙师大校园内共有3座体育场，场馆配置在浙江高校中属于第一档；赛后东体育场在保障教学、训练和科研之外向社会开放，成为金华城区南部居民跑步、踢球的日常去处。交通上，场馆经迎宾大道进出，校外公交设浙师大站，金华站、金华南站可换乘公交到校；金华本部北依沪杭、南联闽粤，高铁到杭州约40分钟、到上海约100分钟。
intro_en: The East Stadium of Zhejiang Normal University sits on the eastern side of the university's main campus at 688 Yingbin Avenue, Wucheng District, Jinhua. It was one of the football venues of the 19th Asian Games in Hangzhou, sharing Jinhua's group-stage matches with the stadium at Jinhua Sports Centre. The building covers 8,391 square metres and holds 11,349 spectators. Its pitch is a 400-metre standard track around a natural-turf football field; for the Asian Games the infield was upgraded to Class I athletics standards, adding javelin, discus and hammer throwing areas so that it can stage domestic track and field meets as well as international football. The turf was laid with satellite positioning to control accuracy, and the surface is deliberately built about three millimetres per metre higher in the middle than at the sides, a crown that lets monsoon rain drain away — a detail no television camera catches. Before the Games the stadium had already hosted the 12th Zhejiang Provincial University Games, the provincial university athletics elite meet, the provincial university football championship and the provincial secondary-school athletics games. A second, North Stadium on campus served as the warm-up ground during the Games; the university owns three stadiums in all, an unusually rich provision among Chinese universities. After the Games the East Stadium reopened to the public outside teaching and training hours, becoming a place where residents of southern Jinhua run and play football. Access is via Yingbin Avenue, with a ZJNU bus stop outside the gate; the campus is about forty minutes from Hangzhou and one hundred minutes from Shanghai by high-speed rail, and buses connect both Jinhua railway stations to the campus.

address: 浙江省金华市婺城区双龙南街2688号
area_text: 体育场总建筑面积44064平方米；金华体育中心总用地26.67万平方米、总建筑面积99580平方米
capacity_text: 固定座席29800个（另有资料记3万座）
intro_zh: 金华体育中心体育场位于金华市婺城区双龙南街2688号，处在湖海塘公园以南、二环南路以北的体育中心地块内，是金华体育中心“一场两馆”中的场，2013年5月随中心一起建成投用。体育场总建筑面积44064平方米，固定座席29800个，另有资料记3万座；场地为国际标准400米田径场加天然草坪足球场，草坪通过国际足联认证，可承接大型足球赛事与万人级演出。看台沿椭圆场地环抱，东西两侧主看台带罩棚，场内设运动员休息室、裁判员休息室、新闻发布厅与兴奋剂检测室等功能用房。2023年这里作为杭州第19届亚运会足球小组赛场馆之一，与浙江师范大学东体育场分担金华赛区的比赛任务。赛后场馆转向“赛事+演艺”双线运营，五月天、周杰伦、张学友、林俊杰、张惠妹、谭咏麟等歌手的巡回演唱会先后在场内搭台，是浙中地区容量最大的户外演出场地之一。金华体育中心由浙江大学建筑设计研究院设计，体育场、体育馆、游泳馆以圆润曲线顺接湖海塘岸线，呈“品”字形围合出中心广场，把城市休闲与体育功能叠在一起。交通上，场馆北临二环南路、东靠双龙南街，公交在体育中心设站，从金华站可换乘公交前往；周边湖海塘公园、酒店与商业配套齐全，散场分流条件较好。
intro_en: Jinhua Sports Centre Stadium stands at 2688 Shuanglong South Street in Wucheng District, Jinhua, on the block south of Lake Haitang Park and north of the Second Ring Road South. It is the stadium of the centre's stadium-gymnasium-natatorium trio and opened with the rest of the complex in May 2013. The building covers 44,064 square metres and has 29,800 fixed seats, with some sources citing 30,000. Its field is a standard 400-metre track around a natural-turf football pitch, and the turf carries FIFA certification, allowing international football as well as concerts for tens of thousands. The stands wrap the oval pitch, the east and west main stands are roofed, and the interior includes athletes' and referees' rooms, a press conference hall and a doping control room. In 2023 the stadium served as one of the football group-stage venues of the 19th Asian Games in Hangzhou, sharing Jinhua's fixtures with the East Stadium of Zhejiang Normal University. Since the Games it has run on two tracks, sport and entertainment: Mayday, Jay Chou, Jacky Cheung, JJ Lin, A-Mei and Alan Tam have all built stages on the pitch, making it one of the largest open-air concert sites in the central Zhejiang region. The complex was designed by the Architectural Design and Research Institute of Zhejiang University; stadium, gymnasium and natatorium follow soft curves that tie into the Lake Haitang shoreline and form a triangular arrangement around a central plaza. The site is bounded by the Second Ring Road South to the north and Shuanglong South Street to the east, buses stop at the sports centre, and the surrounding park, hotels and retail make dispersal after big events manageable.

address: 浙江省金华市婺城区双龙南街2688号金华体育中心内
area_text: 总建筑面积26981平方米，占地面积1.68万平方米；内场长60米、宽30米、净高26米
capacity_text: 观众席约5800座（另有4570座、5900座等口径）
intro_zh: 金华体育中心体育馆位于金华市婺城区双龙南街2688号金华体育中心内，与主体育场、游泳馆呈“品”字布局，2013年启用。场馆占地1.68万平方米、总建筑面积26981平方米，内场长60米、宽30米、净高26米，观众席约5800座，另有4570座、5900座等不同口径。馆内铺设枫木地板，安装120盏专为藤球比赛设计的条带状灯具，可用平板电脑逐灯调光，在比赛、训练、演出模式之间切换，节能率约五成，并配LED高清屏与建筑声学吸音材料。2020年至2021年，场馆按“节俭办赛”原则做亚运改造，保留原有看台座椅，增加吸音构造、室内热身草坪和装配式临设篷房，2021年9月通过杭州亚组委赛事功能验收。2023年9月24日至10月7日，这里承接杭州第19届亚运会藤球全部比赛，产生6枚金牌，金华赛区首金也在此诞生；赛后国家藤球队训练中心于2023年6月在馆内揭牌，场馆继续承办亚洲藤球锦标赛、乒超联赛，并承接演唱会与商业活动，2025年12月31日胡彦斌跨年演唱会在此举行。作为金华市体育设施布局专项规划中的市级主中心核心载体，体育馆还承担省运会闭幕式等大型活动的功能房保障。交通与体育中心共用：双龙南街与二环南路交汇处，公交体育中心站下车步行即到，场馆东侧紧邻湖海塘公园。
intro_en: Jinhua Sports Centre Gymnasium sits inside the Jinhua Sports Centre at 2688 Shuanglong South Street, Wucheng District, forming the triangular trio with the stadium and the natatorium and opening in 2013. It occupies 16,800 square metres of land with 26,981 square metres of floor area; the competition hall measures 60 by 30 metres with a clear height of 26 metres and holds roughly 5,800 spectators, with other sources citing 4,570 or 5,900. The floor is maple, and 120 strip-shaped light fittings were designed specifically for sepak takraw, each dimmable from a tablet so the hall can switch between competition, training and concert modes while saving about half the usual energy; LED screens and acoustic absorption complete the fit-out. Between 2020 and 2021 the hall was refurbished for the Asian Games on a frugal brief that kept the existing seating and added acoustic treatment, an indoor warm-up lawn and demountable fabric structures; it passed the Hangzhou Asian Games organising committee's functional inspection in September 2021. From 24 September to 7 October 2023 it staged the entire sepak takraw programme of the 19th Asian Games, awarding six gold medals including Jinhua's first of the Games. In June 2023 the national sepak takraw training centre was inaugurated in the building. The hall has since hosted the Asian Sepak Takraw Championship, Chinese Table Tennis Super League fixtures and concerts, including Hu Yanbin's New Year show on 31 December 2025. It is listed as a core carrier of the municipal main centre in Jinhua's sports facility plan to 2035, and has supported provincial games closing ceremonies. Buses stop at the sports centre at the junction of Shuanglong South Street and the Second Ring Road South, with Lake Haitang Park immediately east.

address: 宁夏回族自治区银川市兴庆区公园街10号（光明广场西侧）
area_text: 总建筑面积17862平方米，由比赛馆和练习馆构成
capacity_text: 固定及活动坐席6200余座（1998年建成时报道为4900余名观众）
intro_zh: 宁夏体育馆位于银川市兴庆区公园街10号、光明广场西侧，1997年6月在原银川体育馆旧址上动工，1998年8月竣工并投入宁夏回族自治区成立四十周年庆典使用，1999年2月正式运营，是宁夏体育局直属事业单位，也是银川老城中心体量最大的室内场馆。场馆总建筑面积17862平方米，由比赛馆和练习馆组成，固定加活动坐席6200余座，1998年建成时的报道记可容纳4900余名观众；比赛馆可进行篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球、拳击、体操等赛事，也可承接文艺演出、商贸展览和群众集会。馆内日常布置27片羽毛球场地、3块标准篮球场和排球场、200平方米乒乓球区、约600平方米培训教室，另有跆拳道与散打专用馆，开设篮球、羽毛球、乒乓球、健美操、散打、瑜伽、形体、少儿舞蹈等19个健身培训项目，每年接待健身群众约50万人次。建筑外观取意展翅的凤凰，2020年3月列入银川市第三批历史建筑保护范围，同年6月挂牌“银川市历史建筑”；场馆曾被国家体育总局列为全国“以体为主”运营管理先进场馆，全民健身日与法定节日免费开放，妇女节、护士节、教师节等凭有效证件免费健身。交通上，馆址紧邻凤凰北街与湖滨西街路口，北侧是中山公园、西侧为自治区政府，公交在光明广场、公园街设站，从银川火车站方向可乘公交前往。
intro_en: Ningxia Gymnasium occupies 10 Gongyuan Street in Xingqing District, Yinchuan, on the west side of Guangming Square. Construction began in June 1997 on the site of the old Yinchuan Gymnasium, the building was completed in August 1998 in time for the fortieth anniversary of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, and it entered formal operation in February 1999. It belongs to the Ningxia Sports Bureau and remains the largest indoor venue in Yinchuan's old city centre. The 17,862 square metres of floor area comprise a competition hall and a practice hall, with more than 6,200 fixed and retractable seats; reporting at the 1998 opening cited capacity for over 4,900 spectators. The main hall stages basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, boxing and gymnastics as well as concerts, trade exhibitions and public gatherings. Day to day it lays out 27 badminton courts, three standard basketball and volleyball courts, a 200-square-metre table-tennis area and about 600 square metres of training rooms, plus dedicated taekwondo and sanda halls; nineteen fitness programmes run here, from basketball and badminton to yoga, body shaping and children's dance, and the venue receives around 500,000 fitness visits a year. The exterior is modelled on a phoenix spreading its wings. In March 2020 the building entered the third batch of Yinchuan's protected historic buildings and was formally plaqued that June. The General Administration of Sport has cited it as a national model for sport-led venue management. It opens free of charge on National Fitness Day and public holidays, and free again for nurses, teachers and other groups on their professional days. The site sits at the junction of Fenghuang North Street and Hubin West Street, with Zhongshan Park to the north and the regional government compound to the west; buses stop at Guangming Square and Gongyuan Street.

address: 宁夏回族自治区银川市西夏区贺兰山西路与金波北街交汇处
area_text: 占地约29.54万平方米，建筑面积10.63万平方米，建筑高度46米
capacity_text: 可容纳观众近4万人（俱乐部资料记39872席）
intro_zh: 贺兰山体育场位于银川市西夏区贺兰山西路与金波北街交汇处，处在银川市体育中心园区东北角、宁夏体育中心园区中部，2009年5月开工、2012年建成，占地约29.54万平方米，建筑面积10.63万平方米，建筑高度46米，总投资约7亿元，可容纳观众近4万人，俱乐部资料记为39872席，是宁夏第一座综合性甲级体育场。看台与罩棚以连续拱壳环抱场地，轮廓被当地人称作“小鸟巢”，立面带有伊斯兰建筑语汇。场内是国际标准400米田径场和天然草坪足球场，跑道采用意大利进口橡胶材质，足球场草坪面积近7800平方米，配498盏专业照明、30组进口音响和全彩LED屏，能满足国际单项与国内综合性赛事要求。2017年8月“南美VS欧洲”全明星赛在此举行，罗纳尔迪尼奥与菲戈同场竞技；2018年9月20日宁夏回族自治区成立60周年庆祝大会在场地内召开；2025年5月和9月两场大型演唱会分别吸引3万和2.5万名观众；2025年8月承办2026年亚足联U20女足亚洲杯预选赛E组比赛，赛前将7800平方米草坪和球门全部换新，中国队在此6:0胜叙利亚、8:0胜黎巴嫩。体育场由银川市体育中心运营，实行免费或低收费开放，室外乒乓球训练基地、轮滑冰球场地、全民健身滑冰场与游泳池等附属设施常年服务市民。交通上，公交101路、47路、48路、49路在贺兰山体育场设站，自驾可沿银川绕城高速北段经亲水街转贺兰山路抵达，大型活动期间周边道路实施临时管制并开通停车场接驳专线。
intro_en: Helan Mountain Stadium stands at the junction of Helan West Road and Jinbo North Street in Xixia District, Yinchuan, occupying the north-east corner of the Yinchuan Sports Centre campus and the middle of the Ningxia Sports Centre grounds. Work began in May 2009, the stadium was completed in 2012, and it covers about 295,400 square metres of land with 106,300 square metres of floor area, a height of 46 metres and a total investment of roughly 700 million yuan. Capacity is just under 40,000, with club records citing 39,872 seats; it is Ningxia's first comprehensive Class A stadium. Continuous arched shells wrap the bowl, giving a silhouette locals call the Little Bird's Nest, and the elevations carry Islamic architectural motifs. Inside are an international-standard 400-metre track and a natural-turf football pitch. The track surface is imported Italian rubber, the pitch covers nearly 7,800 square metres, and 498 floodlights, thirty sets of imported sound equipment and a full-colour LED screen meet international single-sport and domestic multi-sport requirements. In August 2017 the stadium hosted a South America versus Europe all-star match with Ronaldinho and Figo; on 20 September 2018 it held the celebration marking sixty years of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region; concerts in May and September 2025 drew 30,000 and 25,000 spectators. In August 2025 it staged Group E of the qualifying tournament for the 2026 AFC U-20 Women's Asian Cup, for which the 7,800 square metres of turf and the goals were replaced; China beat Syria 6-0 and Lebanon 8-0 here. Yinchuan Sports Centre operates the stadium on a free or low-fee basis, and its table-tennis training base, roller hockey rink, skating rink and swimming pool serve the public year round. Buses 101, 47, 48 and 49 stop at the stadium, drivers reach it from the northern ring expressway via Qinshui Street, and major events bring temporary road controls and shuttle services.

name_zh: 银川市体育中心（银川奥体中心）
address: 宁夏回族自治区银川市西夏区贺兰山路与金波北街交汇处
area_text: 园区以贺兰山体育场为核心：体育场占地约29.54万平方米、建筑面积10.63万平方米；银川体育馆分主馆与副馆，另有乒乓球训练基地及室外球场
capacity_text: 贺兰山体育场近4万座；银川体育馆固定座位数未公布（副馆可布置8片标准羽毛球场地）
intro_zh: 银川市体育中心是银川市体育局所属的公益二类事业单位，负责银川体育馆、贺兰山体育场等场馆的运营管理，园区位于西夏区贺兰山路与金波北街交汇处，本地人也把它叫作“银川奥体中心”。中心下辖“一场一馆”：贺兰山体育场占地约29.54万平方米、建筑面积10.63万平方米、可容纳近4万人，是宁夏的综合性甲级体育场；银川体育馆在主馆之外另设副馆，主馆承担羽毛球、篮球、网球、匹克球等室内项目，副馆可布置8片标准羽毛球场地。园区内还有乒乓球训练基地、室外笼式篮球场、笼式网球场、笼式足球场、轮滑场、全民健身滑冰场和游泳池，配停车位与健身步道，构成银川西部面积最大的公共体育组群。中心2021年9月被国家体育总局授予“2017—2020年度全国群众体育先进单位”，年均服务健身群众超过10万人次，2019年获得大型体育场馆开放补助资金318.8万元，承办过全国冰上龙舟邀请赛、贺兰山东麓半程马拉松、自治区运动会等赛事。场馆对市民实行免费或低收费开放，银川体育馆每天6:30至9:00为免费晨练时段，闭馆时间已延至22:00，场地通过“银川市体育中心场馆”微信服务号预约。交通上，园区处在贺兰山路与金波北街交叉口，公交47路、48路、49路、101路可达，从银川火车站可乘公交或自驾前往，距市中心约5公里以上，周边道路在大型活动期间会开通接驳专线。
intro_en: Yinchuan Sports Centre is a public-interest institution under the Yinchuan Sports Bureau that operates the Yinchuan Gymnasium, Helan Mountain Stadium and associated facilities. Its campus sits at the junction of Helanshan Road and Jinbo North Street in Xixia District, and residents also call it the Yinchuan Olympic Sports Centre. The centre runs one stadium and one gymnasium. Helan Mountain Stadium covers about 295,400 square metres of land, has 106,300 square metres of floor area and seats just under 40,000, making it Ningxia's comprehensive Class A stadium. Yinchuan Gymnasium has a main hall plus a secondary hall: the main hall hosts badminton, basketball, tennis and pickleball, while the secondary hall can be laid out with eight standard badminton courts. The grounds also contain a table-tennis training base, outdoor caged basketball, tennis and football courts, a roller-skating rink, a public skating rink and a swimming pool, together with parking and fitness trails, forming the largest public sports cluster in western Yinchuan. In September 2021 the General Administration of Sport named the centre a national advanced unit for mass sport for 2017-2020. It serves more than 100,000 fitness visits a year, received 3.188 million yuan in large-venue opening subsidies in 2019, and has hosted the national ice dragon boat invitational, the Helan Mountain eastern foothills half marathon and autonomous-region games. Venues open free or at low cost: the gymnasium has a free morning session from 6:30 to 9:00 and now closes at 22:00, with courts booked through the WeChat account Yinchuan Sports Centre Venues. Buses 47, 48, 49 and 101 serve the campus, which lies more than five kilometres from the old city centre and runs shuttle services during major events.

address: 宁夏回族自治区银川市西夏区贺兰山路与金波街交汇路口西南角
area_text: 公开资料未公布总建筑面积；场馆分主馆与副馆，副馆可布置8片标准羽毛球比赛场地
capacity_text: 公开资料未公布固定座位数
intro_zh: 银川市体育馆位于银川市西夏区贺兰山路与金波街交汇路口西南角，是银川市体育中心“一场一馆”中的馆，与贺兰山体育场隔路相望，主要服务西夏区及银川西部居民的日常健身。场馆分主馆与副馆：主馆为大空间室内馆，日常布置羽毛球、篮球、网球和匹克球场地，看台沿场地两侧展开；副馆可规划8片标准羽毛球比赛场地，2026年自治区第十七届运动会竞技体育成人组羽毛球比赛就在副馆举行，赛时按赛事标准重新铺设专业运动地胶，并划分检录区、热身区与媒体区。需要说明的是，兴庆区公园街10号的宁夏体育馆在旧资料里也被称作“银川市体育馆”，两者不是同一座建筑：宁夏体育馆1998年建成、6200余座，位于老城光明广场西侧；本条目指的是西夏区贺兰山路上的银川体育馆，隶属银川市体育中心，2012年起主馆每天设免费开放时段，全年健身人次约10万，配备全空调系统与智能监控设施。开放时间为6:30至22:00，6:30至9:00为免费晨练，羽毛球、网球场地需通过“银川市体育中心场馆”微信服务号线上预约，也可到前台咨询包场；国家法定节假日和8月8日全民健身日羽毛球场地免费。交通上，馆址在贺兰山路与金波街路口，公交47路、48路、49路、101路在贺兰山体育场站下车步行即到，自驾经贺兰山西路转入金波北街，场馆周边设停车场。
intro_en: Yinchuan Gymnasium stands on the south-west corner of the junction of Helanshan Road and Jinbo Street in Xixia District, Yinchuan. It is the gymnasium of the Yinchuan Sports Centre's stadium-and-gymnasium pair, facing Helan Mountain Stadium across the road, and it mainly serves residents of Xixia District and western Yinchuan. The building has a main hall and a secondary hall. The main hall is a large-span indoor space laid out day to day with badminton, basketball, tennis and pickleball courts, with seating along both sides of the playing area. The secondary hall can be configured with eight standard badminton courts; the adult badminton competition of the autonomous region's 17th Games in 2026 was held there, with new professional sports flooring laid to competition standard and separate call, warm-up and media zones. One point of clarification: the Ningxia Gymnasium at 10 Gongyuan Street in Xingqing District is also called the Yinchuan Gymnasium in older sources, but the two are different buildings. Ningxia Gymnasium was completed in 1998 with more than 6,200 seats beside Guangming Square in the old city; this entry covers the gymnasium on Helanshan Road in Xixia District, which belongs to Yinchuan Sports Centre. Since 2012 its main hall has offered a free daily session, it records about 100,000 fitness visits a year, and it has full air conditioning and smart surveillance. Opening hours are 6:30 to 22:00, with free morning exercise from 6:30 to 9:00; badminton and tennis courts are booked through the WeChat account Yinchuan Sports Centre Venues or at the front desk, and badminton is free on public holidays and on National Fitness Day, 8 August. Buses 47, 48, 49 and 101 stop at Helan Mountain Stadium a short walk away, and drivers turn off Helanshan West Road into Jinbo North Street, where parking is available.

address: 吉林省长春市南关区亚泰大街与自由大路交会处（长春动植物公园东侧）
area_text: 占地10.08公顷（俱乐部资料记6万平方米），总建筑面积42912平方米，场地面积12000平方米、其中草坪8000平方米
intro_zh: 长春体育场位于长春市南关区亚泰大街与自由大路交会处，东邻长春动植物公园，西接东北师范大学和文化科技区，因地处南岭片区被长春人称作“南岭体育场”，是长春亚泰足球俱乐部的主场。场馆1933年始建，1992年4月开工改造重建，1994年7月建成交付，由吉林省建筑设计院设计，造价1.3亿元；占地10.08公顷（俱乐部资料记6万平方米），总建筑面积42912平方米，场地面积12000平方米、其中草坪8000平方米，观众坐席42000个。场内由国际标准400米塑胶跑道和天然草坪足球场组成，跑道经国家体育总局和吉林省测绘局验收，符合国际大型田径比赛标准；看台下设贵宾休息室4间、中型会议室2间、新闻发布室1间，以及运动员休息室、裁判员休息室和兴奋剂检测室，另附80米室内跑道练习馆、室外足球练习场和环廊乒乓球活动室。长春亚泰在2009至2017年间曾把主场移到经开体育场，其余年份以长春体育场为主场，这里被视为长春足球的地标与青训摇篮。场馆隶属长春体育中心——该中心2001年由长春体育场与五环体育馆合并组建，是长春市体育局直属公益性事业单位，常年向市民开放田径跑道与健身场地。交通上，地铁1号线东北师大站B口出站，沿自由大路东行经吉顺街、体北路可到亚泰大街一侧入口，步行约两公里；公交6路、306路、160路在自由大路、动植物公园一带设站，亚泰大街快速路从场地西侧经过。
intro_en: Changchun Stadium stands at the junction of Yatai Avenue and Ziyou Road in Nanguan District, Changchun, with the Changchun Zoological and Botanical Park to the east and Northeast Normal University and the cultural and science district to the west. Locals call it Nanling Stadium after the surrounding district, and it is the home ground of Changchun Yatai Football Club. The ground dates from 1933; reconstruction began in April 1992, it was completed and handed over in July 1994, and it was designed by the Jilin Provincial Architectural Design Institute at a cost of 130 million yuan. It covers 10.08 hectares according to the municipal sports bureau, while club material cites 60,000 square metres; floor area is 42,912 square metres, the playing field 12,000 square metres including 8,000 square metres of turf, and seating capacity is 42,000. The field combines an international-standard 400-metre synthetic track with a natural-turf football pitch, and the track was inspected and accepted by the General Administration of Sport and the Jilin surveying authority as suitable for major international athletics. Under the stands are four VIP lounges, two medium meeting rooms and a press room, plus athletes' and referees' rooms and a doping control room; an 80-metre indoor training track, an outdoor football training pitch and table-tennis rooms along the concourse complete the provision. Changchun Yatai moved its home matches to the Economic Development Zone stadium between 2009 and 2017 and played at Changchun Stadium in other years, and the ground is regarded as the city's football landmark and youth academy birthplace. It belongs to Changchun Sports Centre, formed in 2001 by merging the stadium with the Wuhuan Gymnasium and run as a public-interest unit of the municipal sports bureau, and its track and fitness areas stay open to residents. Metro Line 1 stops at Dongbei Shida, about two kilometres away via Ziyou Road, while buses 6, 306 and 160 serve Ziyou Road and the park.

name_zh: 长春奥林匹克体育中心
address: 吉林省长春市长春新区北湖科技开发区（鑫盛大路以南、中科大街以东）
area_text: 总占地52.76万平方米，一期占地31.83万平方米、总建筑面积17万平方米（地上15.5万、地下1.5万）；体育场6.65万平方米、体育馆35640平方米、全民健身中心31946平方米
capacity_text: 体育场设计座席31684个（另有资料记3.43万座）；体育馆9197席；游泳馆3000余座
intro_zh: 长春奥林匹克体育中心即长春奥林匹克公园，位于长春新区北湖科技开发区，鑫盛大路以南、中科大街以东，总占地52.76万平方米，一期占地31.83万平方米、总建筑面积17万平方米（地上15.5万、地下1.5万），是长春市“十二五”期间投资体量最大的公共体育项目。园区以“一场三馆”组成：居中的体育场建筑面积6.65万平方米，设计座席31684个，其中贵宾席300个、包厢224个、无障碍坐席64个、普通观众席31096个，另有资料记3.43万座，场内是国际标准足球场与400米田径跑道；体育馆建筑面积35640平方米、观众席9197个，主场地可切换室内单项赛事与冰场，另设备用排球、篮球、手球场地各1个；游泳馆设3000多个座位、双面看台；全民健身中心建筑面积31946平方米，布置羽毛球、网球、乒乓球、射箭等场地。总体规划取“众星捧月”之意，一场三馆以体育场为核心辐射展开，俯瞰像一朵盛开的君子兰，建筑立意则取自“长白林海”。2018年9月11日吉林省第十八届运动会开幕式在此举行，2021年5月21日园区全面对外开放，由奥飞文体产业集团运营，游泳馆二楼设奥飞健身俱乐部。交通上，园区邻近高速出入口，轨道交通与公交均可接驳，配千余个停车位，距长春北湖国家湿地公园约十分钟车程。
intro_en: Changchun Olympic Sports Centre, also known as Changchun Olympic Park, lies in the Beihu science and technology development zone of Changchun New Area, bounded by Xinsheng Avenue to the south and Zhongke Street to the east. The park covers 527,600 square metres in total, with a first phase of 318,300 square metres and 170,000 square metres of floor area, 155,000 above ground and 15,000 below. It was the largest public sports investment of Changchun's twelfth five-year plan. The park comprises a stadium and three halls. The central stadium has 66,500 square metres of floor area and a design capacity of 31,684 seats, made up of 300 VIP seats, 224 box seats, 64 accessible seats and 31,096 ordinary seats, with other sources citing 34,300; its field is a standard football pitch inside a 400-metre track. The gymnasium covers 35,640 square metres with 9,197 seats, and its main floor converts between indoor single-sport events and an ice rink, with one backup court each for volleyball, basketball and handball. The natatorium has more than 3,000 seats on two sides. The fitness centre covers 31,946 square metres and contains badminton, tennis, table tennis and archery areas. The master plan follows a theme of stars around the moon, with the stadium at the centre and the other halls radiating outwards so that the layout reads from above as an open clivia flower, the city's emblem, while the architecture draws on the forests of the Changbai mountains. The opening ceremony of Jilin's 18th Provincial Games was held here on 11 September 2018, and the park opened fully to the public on 21 May 2021 under the operator Aofei Sports and Culture Group, with an Aofei fitness club on the natatorium's second floor. The site is close to an expressway entrance, reachable by rail transit and bus, has over a thousand parking spaces and is about ten minutes by car from Beihu national wetland park.

address: 吉林省长春市朝阳区人民大街2999号
area_text: 建筑面积13650平方米；比赛馆跨度42米、长60米、高26米，两侧各设500平方米练习馆
intro_zh: 长春市体育馆位于长春市朝阳区人民大街2999号，1955年由长春市委市政府决定兴建，1956年动工、1957年11月落成，由同济大学教授葛如亮设计——他曾参与人民大会堂和中国革命博物馆的方案设计，是中国体育建筑的重要开拓者。建筑坐西朝东，平面呈“工”字型，地上4层，建筑面积13650平方米，比赛馆跨度42米、长60米、高26米，设4299个座席，是新中国成立后吉林省最早建成的大型体育馆之一，也是建国初期“长春十大建筑”之一，2014年8月28日被列为吉林省文物保护单位。馆内以比赛馆为核心，两侧各设500平方米、净高8米的练习馆，后部二、三楼布置体操、武术、乒乓球等单项训练房间；比赛馆可进行篮球、排球、羽毛球、乒乓球、体操、技巧、武术、举重、拳击、摔跤等项目的比赛，也能举办音乐会和放映电影，两侧上端保留有老式电表与电波报分板。这里长期是吉林东北虎男篮的主场，CBA主场后来迁到五环体育馆，老馆转而承担训练、全民健身和中小型活动，在球迷心中仍是“长春永远的主场”。交通上，馆址在人民大街市区核心段，地铁1号线解放大路站、东北师大站均在步行范围，公交在人民大街沿线密集设站，从长春站乘地铁1号线可直达。
intro_en: Changchun Gymnasium stands at 2999 Renmin Avenue in Chaoyang District, Changchun. The municipal party committee and government decided to build it in 1955, construction started in 1956 and the building opened in November 1957. It was designed by Ge Ruliang, a Tongji University professor who had worked on the Great Hall of the People and the Museum of the Chinese Revolution and who ranks among the founders of Chinese sports architecture. The building faces east, is shaped in plan like the character gong, rises four storeys and covers 13,650 square metres. The competition hall spans 42 metres, is 60 metres long and 26 metres high, and seats 4,299. It is one of the earliest large gymnasiums completed in Jilin after 1949, one of the ten landmark Changchun buildings of the early People's Republic, and since 28 August 2014 a protected provincial cultural relic. The competition hall is flanked by two 500-square-metre practice halls with a clear height of eight metres, and the second and third floors at the rear hold rooms for gymnastics, wushu and table tennis. The main hall stages basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, gymnastics, acrobatics, wushu, weightlifting, boxing and wrestling, and has also hosted concerts and film screenings; the old electric meters and wave-score boards remain at the top of both sides. For decades it was the home court of the Jilin Northeast Tigers basketball team; after the CBA fixtures moved to the Wuhuan Gymnasium the old hall shifted to training, mass fitness and mid-sized events, yet fans still call it Changchun's permanent home court. It sits on the central stretch of Renmin Avenue, within walking distance of Jiefang Dalu and Dongbei Shida stations on Metro Line 1, with dense bus services along the avenue and a direct metro ride from Changchun railway station.

name_zh: 长春经济技术开发区体育场
address: 吉林省长春市经济技术开发区会展大街100号
area_text: 占地32218.93平方米；场内为1个足球场加1条田径比赛跑道
intro_zh: 长春经济技术开发区体育场简称经开体育场，位于长春市经济技术开发区会展大街100号，东临世纪广场，毗邻长春国际会展中心与净月潭国家森林公园，2002年竣工，总投资1.7亿元，占地32218.93平方米，观众席2.5万个。体育场主体南北通透、东西半屋面，采用塔柱钢桁架拉索结构，罩棚只覆盖东西两侧看台，南北两端敞开，形成通透的观赛视野；场内包括1个天然草坪足球场和1条田径比赛跑道，可满足田径、足球比赛及大型文艺演出的需要。2003年这里成为当时身处甲B联赛的长春亚泰队主场，2009至2017年亚泰征战中超期间继续以此为主场，经开体育场因此成为长春足球一个阶段的记忆；亚泰移回南岭后，场地转向全民健身、青少年训练和会展配套活动。场馆与长春国际会展中心同处会展大街，是“展馆+体育场”连片布局的一部分，展会与赛事可以共享停车、餐饮和住宿配套，周边酒店距体育场约1.3公里。交通上，轻轨3号线会展中心站步行可达，公交160路、115路、102路、103路、120路、125路在会展大街与会展中心一带设站，从长春站可乘轻轨3号线直达，龙嘉机场方向经高速客运站换乘也较便利。
intro_en: The Changchun Economic and Technological Development Zone Stadium, known locally as Jingkai Stadium, stands at 100 Huizhan Street in the city's economic and technological development zone, with Century Square to the east and close to the Changchun International Convention and Exhibition Centre and Jingyuetan national forest park. Completed in 2002 at a cost of 170 million yuan, it covers 32,218.93 square metres of land and seats 25,000. The structure is open north to south with half-roofs over the east and west stands, built on a tower-column steel-truss cable structure: the roof covers only the two side stands, leaving both ends open and giving the bowl a through-breeze and unobstructed sightlines. Inside are one natural-turf football pitch and an athletics track, sufficient for track and field, football and large-scale entertainment events. In 2003 it became the home of Changchun Yatai, then in the Jia-B league, and it remained the club's ground through its Chinese Super League years from 2009 to 2017, which makes Jingkai a marker of one period in the city's football history; after Yatai returned to Nanling the venue shifted towards mass fitness, youth training and exhibition support. Because it shares Huizhan Street with the Changchun International Convention and Exhibition Centre, the stadium is part of a combined exhibition-and-sport cluster where fairs and matches can share parking, catering and hotel capacity; the neighbouring convention hotel is about 1.3 kilometres away. Light rail Line 3 stops at Huizhan Zhongxin within walking distance, buses 160, 115, 102, 103, 120 and 125 serve Huizhan Street and the exhibition centre, and Line 3 runs directly from Changchun railway station, with connections from Longjia airport via the express coach station.

address: 长沙市开福区体育馆路1号
area_text: 占地87亩，建筑面积3万余平方米
intro_zh: 湖南省体育场位于开福区体育馆路1号，处芙蓉路与东风路、展览馆路与体育馆路交汇处，紧邻烈士公园西门。场地清末为协操坪，1949年11月省政府指令扩建为省立体育场，1951年改称省人民体育场，二十世纪六十年代一度更名东风广场，是湖南最早的多功能大型综合体育场，1959年湖南省第一届体育运动大会在此开幕。场地占地87亩，2002年3月与2015年12月两次改扩建，现有可容纳7000余名观众的标准看台、标准足球场、一栋7层全民健身中心、一栋2层综合训练馆及可停300台车的地下车库，建筑面积3万余平方米，室内场馆面积1.5万余平方米，设羽毛球馆、网球馆、室内篮球馆、乒乓球馆与健身房，田径场通过中国田径协会二类场地认证。场馆长期承担省队训练、城运会女足赛事与群众健身，是长沙中心城区使用率较高的公共体育场，并获国家体育总局授予全国体育场馆向公众开放先进单位称号。周边为开福区老城居住区与烈士公园，东风路、体育馆路公交线路密集。
intro_en: Hunan Provincial Stadium stands at 1 Tiyuguan Road, Kaifu District, at the junction of Furong and Dongfeng roads and Zhanlanguan and Tiyuguan roads, next to the west gate of Martyr's Park. The ground began as Xiecaoping, a Qing-era military drill field; after the war with Japan it was used as an airfield by the Nationalist air force, and in November 1949 the provincial government ordered it expanded into a provincial stadium. It was renamed the People's Stadium in 1951, was known for a period in the 1960s as Dongfeng Square, and is the earliest multi-purpose stadium in Hunan; the first Hunan Provincial Games opened here in 1959. Covering 87 mu, it was rebuilt and extended in March 2002 and again in December 2015. Today it has a standard grandstand seating more than 7,000, a full-size football pitch, a seven-storey public fitness centre, a two-storey training hall and an underground car park for 300 vehicles, with more than 30,000 sqm of floor area, over 15,000 sqm of it indoors. Badminton, tennis, indoor basketball and table tennis halls and a gym are available, and the athletics track holds a Class II certification from the Chinese Athletics Association. Owned by the provincial sports bureau, the stadium carries provincial team training, women's football fixtures from the City Games and everyday public exercise, making it one of the busiest public grounds in central Changsha, with the old Kaifu neighbourhood and Martyr's Park around it and frequent buses on Dongfeng and Tiyuguan roads. The provincial sports bureau notes that the national sports administration has recognised it as an advanced unit for opening venues to the public.

address: 长沙市天心区劳动西路299号
area_text: 占地11.5万平方米，建筑面积1.56万平方米
intro_zh: 贺龙体育馆位于天心区劳动西路299号侯家塘，南接劳动路、东临芙蓉路，西北与贺龙体育场毗邻，是湖南省“七五”计划重点工程。1987年12月9日动工，1991年11月建成投用，占地11.5万平方米，建筑面积1.56万平方米，总投资5400万元。馆内设6500个观众座席，其中活动座椅1090个，比赛大厅58米×30米，可进行体操、篮球、排球、手球、羽毛球、网球、室内足球、艺术体操等12个项目的比赛，也可承接文艺演出与群众集会；一层设贵宾休息室、运动员休息室与健身房，二层为观众休息大厅，三层布置计时记分与灯光控制等技术用房。作为继首都体育馆、上海体育馆之后建成的省属综合性室内馆，这里承办过亚洲体操锦标赛、CBA全明星赛、WCBA八一女篮主场、中美男篮对抗赛以及多场演唱会。2019年投入5500万元提质改造，主馆更新为6400个体育座椅，固定座席3000余个、活动座席2000余个，室外场地恢复约5700平方米，并改造空调系统与可移动伸缩看台。场馆距地铁1号线、3号线侯家塘站3号口约百米。
intro_en: He Long Gymnasium stands at 299 Laodong West Road in Houtangjia, Tianxin District, with Laodong Road to the south, Furong Road to the east and He Long Stadium immediately to the north-west; it was a key project of Hunan's seventh five-year plan. Construction began on 9 December 1987 and the hall opened in November 1991, covering 115,000 sqm of land with 15,600 sqm of floor area at a total investment of 54 million yuan. It seats 6,500 spectators, 1,090 of them on movable chairs, and the competition hall measures 58 by 30 m, large enough for twelve sports including gymnastics, basketball, volleyball, handball, badminton, tennis, indoor football and rhythmic gymnastics, as well as concerts and public gatherings. The first floor holds VIP and athlete lounges and a gym, the second a spectators' concourse and the third the timing, scoring and lighting control rooms. Built after the Capital Gymnasium and Shanghai Gymnasium, it became one of the country's best-known provincial indoor arenas and has hosted the Asian Gymnastics Championships, CBA All-Star games, WCBA home games of the Bayi women's team, China-USA men's basketball friendlies and numerous concerts. A 55 million yuan upgrade completed in 2019 replaced the seating with 6,400 sports seats, more than 3,000 fixed and over 2,000 movable, restored about 5,700 sqm of outdoor space and renewed the air conditioning and retractable stands. Houtangjia station on Metro lines 1 and 3 is about 100 m from exit 3. The hall is owned by the provincial government and operated by the Hunan provincial sports bureau.

address: 长沙市天心区芙蓉中路二段188号
area_text: 占地15万平方米，建筑面积约10万平方米
intro_zh: 长沙贺龙体育场位于天心区芙蓉中路二段188号，南接劳动路、北临城南路、东望芙蓉路、西靠白沙路，前身为1952年建成的长沙市体育场，1987年10月10日改扩建后以贺龙元帅之名命名为贺龙体育场，是中国第一座以国家领导人名字命名的大型综合性体育场。2000年为承办第五届全国城市运动会，长沙市政府对体育场及周边实施改造，2003年重建落成，现占地15万平方米，建筑面积约10万平方米，看台面积2.1万平方米、内场2.4万平方米，可容纳55000名观众，罩棚以芙蓉花瓣为造型，是长沙的城市地标。场内设标准草坪足球场与400米跑道，可承办足球、田径赛事及大型演唱会、展会，中超、足协杯、国家队赛事与商业演出常年排满，2017年3月23日中国男足在世界杯预选赛中1比0击败韩国队即在此进行。场馆地处侯家塘商圈，地铁1号线、3号线侯家塘站步行可达，劳动路与芙蓉路在此交汇，周边酒店、商业与餐饮密集。
intro_en: Changsha He Long Stadium stands at 188 Furong Middle Road, Section 2, in Tianxin District, with Laodong Road to the south, Chengnan Road to the north, Furong Road to the east and Baisha Road to the west. It grew out of the Changsha municipal stadium built in 1952 and was renamed He Long Stadium on 10 October 1987 after rebuilding, becoming the first large comprehensive stadium in China named after a national leader. To host the 5th National City Games, the municipal government rebuilt the stadium and its surroundings from 2000, and the present structure opened in 2003. It covers 150,000 sqm with about 100,000 sqm of floor area, a 21,000 sqm grandstand, a 37,000 sqm pitch area and a 24,000 sqm field, seating 55,000 spectators under a roof shaped like hibiscus petals, and it remains a symbol of the city. A standard grass football pitch and 400 m track allow football, athletics, concerts and exhibitions; Chinese Super League and FA Cup fixtures, national team matches and commercial shows fill the calendar, and on 23 March 2017 the Chinese men's team beat South Korea 1-0 here in a World Cup qualifier. Owned by the Changsha municipal government and managed as part of the He Long Sports Centre, which also includes the gymnasium and a swimming pool, the stadium sits in the Houtangjia commercial area, within walking distance of Houtangjia station on Metro lines 1 and 3, where Laodong and Furong roads meet, surrounded by hotels, shops and restaurants. It remains a regular venue for major international and domestic fixtures.

address: 湖南省长沙市天心区芙蓉中路二段188号
area_text: 占地100亩（约6.7万㎡），主场馆建筑面积13.09万㎡
intro_zh: 贺龙体育中心体育场位于长沙市天心区芙蓉中路二段188号，处在芙蓉路、劳动路、白沙路与城南路围合的城市中心地带，距地铁1号线侯家塘站3号口仅百余米，是全国第一座以国家领导人贺龙元帅名字命名的大型综合性体育场所。其前身为1951年始建的长沙劳动人民体育场，1987年10月10日经扩建后更名为贺龙体育场，2000年为迎接第五届全国城市运动会实施整体改扩建，2003年以贺龙体育中心之名全新亮相。改扩建后中心占地100亩（约6.7万平方米），主场馆建筑面积13.09万平方米，设98个贵宾包厢，可容纳42746名观众；看台沿椭圆环形两层布置，罩棚以钢结构桁架悬挑覆盖，场芯为天然草坪足球场与400米跑道，另配套副场、训练场与商业空间。这座体育场以“市井气”著称，长年混融赛事、演出与市民日常，被本地人视作长沙城市生活的一部分，曾承办第五届全国城市运动会开幕式、2018年世界杯亚洲区预选赛中韩足球赛等数十场大型赛事，也是众多演唱会的首选场地。2023年4月，中心入选全国公共体育场馆开放使用第一批典型案例示范场馆。交通方面，芙蓉中路与劳动路在此交汇，地铁1号线侯家塘站步行可达，公交线路密集。
intro_en: He Long Sports Center Stadium stands at No. 188, Section 2 of Furong Middle Road in Tianxin District, Changsha, inside the block bounded by Furong Road, Laodong Road, Baisha Road and Chengnan Road, little more than a hundred metres from Exit 3 of Metro Line 1's Houjiatang station. It is the first large comprehensive sports ground in China named after a national leader, Marshal He Long. Its predecessor, the Changsha Labour People's Stadium, opened in 1951; it was expanded and renamed He Long Stadium on 10 October 1987, rebuilt for the fifth National City Games in 2000, and reopened in 2003 under the present name. After the rebuild the centre covers 100 mu, about 67,000 sqm, with 130,900 sqm of main building area, 98 VIP boxes and 42,746 seats. Two seating tiers ring an oval bowl under a cantilevered steel truss roof, around a natural-turf pitch and 400 m track, with a secondary pitch, training ground and commercial space alongside. The stadium is known for its street-level vitality, blending matches, concerts and everyday public use, and locals treat it as part of the texture of the city. It has staged the opening ceremony of the fifth National City Games, the China-Korea qualifier for the 2018 World Cup and dozens of other major fixtures, and it is a favoured concert site. In April 2023 the centre was listed among the first national model venues for public sports facility operation. Furong Middle Road and Laodong Road meet at the site, with Metro Line 1 and dense bus routes serving it.

address: 上海市黄浦区中山南路505号（近复兴东路，另有外码头653号入口）
area_text: 占地约1.6万㎡；建筑面积约2万㎡；室内层高3—3.7米
intro_zh: 老码头创意园位于上海市黄浦区中山南路505号，近复兴东路，处在南外滩滨江带、外滩金融集聚带南延与老城厢—十六铺的交界处，西接豫园与BFC外滩金融中心，东向黄浦江正对陆家嘴。场地原为上海油脂厂，更早是十六铺码头的一部分，临江弄堂与老式石库门群落里留有黄金荣、杜月笙时代仓库的痕迹。园区占地约1.6万平方米，建筑面积约2万平方米，由多栋老建筑组成，室内层高3至3.7米，2007年中启动第一次改造并对外招租，2008年正式开业，同年获评上海十佳创意产业园，2009年获上海市工业旅游景点称号，现为国家AAA级景区。2018年启动第二轮整体更新，以“石库门”这一海派建筑符号为基本设计语汇做类型拓展，2019年4月重新开放，把城市文脉、商业空间与社区生活重新编织；改造后业态为创意办公、特色酒吧、休闲会所与个性零售，屋顶欧式露台可俯瞰黄浦江。2024年8月，上海国际邮轮节主题活动“乐享华夏”海派邮轮风情秀在此举办。园区适合品牌快闪、时尚发布、艺术展览、餐饮活动与影视取景，滨江步道与石库门巷道提供了室内外连贯的活动动线；地铁9号线小南门站步行可达，招商咨询请走园区公开渠道。
intro_en: Old Dock (Lao Matou) occupies 505 Zhongshan South Road in Huangpu District, near Fuxing East Road, where the South Bund waterfront, the southern extension of the Bund financial belt and the old town's Shiliupu district meet, with Yuyuan and BFC to the west and Lujiazui across the Huangpu River to the east. The site was the Shanghai Oil and Fat Factory and, earlier, part of the Shiliupu wharves; the riverside lanes and shikumen terraces still carry traces of the warehouses associated with Huang Jinrong and Du Yuesheng. The park covers about 16,000 square metres with roughly 20,000 square metres of floor area across several old buildings, interiors at 3 to 3.7 metres clear height. A first conversion began in mid-2007 with space released to tenants, and the park formally opened in 2008, winning that year's top-ten Shanghai creative park award, adding a Shanghai industrial tourism site designation in 2009 and now holding a national AAA rating. A second full renewal started in 2018, taking the shikumen as its basic design vocabulary and extending it typologically, and reopened in April 2019, reweaving urban memory, commercial space and community life. The mix is creative offices, bars, clubs and independent retail, with roof terraces looking over the river. In August 2024 the Shanghai International Cruise Festival's 'Enjoy Huaxia' cruise-themed show was staged here. The park suits brand pop-ups, fashion launches, art exhibitions, dining events and filming, with the waterfront promenade and shikumen lanes giving a continuous indoor-outdoor route; Xiaonanmen station on Line 9 is within walking distance and leasing enquiries go through the park's public channels.

address: 上海市徐汇区瑞宁路111号
area_text: 建筑面积1,777平方米（保留原仓库体量，檐高约12米）
intro_zh: START星美术馆位于上海市徐汇区瑞宁路111号，地处黄浦江西岸、西岸美术馆大道最北端。馆址原为1907年建成的日晖港货栈，是中国近现代历史上第一个海陆转运铁路平台，后长期作为南浦火车站18号线仓库使用。2014年，艺术研究学者何炬星受邀筹建美术馆，经12家国际建筑事务所比选，最终由普利兹克奖得主、法国建筑师让·努维尔主持设计；改造保留原90米长仓库的平面轮廓、坡屋顶与约12米檐高，并留下铁路轨道与车厢作为场地记忆，2022年12月30日正式开馆。美术馆建筑面积1,777平方米，除无柱通高展厅外，还设悬浮夹层展厅、屋顶展场与120米滨江观景平台，银灰色金属屋面与工业桁架使建筑与江岸景观连成一体。开馆展“开启START”汇集全球85名（组）艺术家的88件作品。机构以艺术史研究为线索，按年代与谱系策划长期系列展览，是西岸艺术走廊北端的学术型当代美术馆。观众可乘地铁11号线至云锦路站步行前往；开放时间为周二至周五10:00—18:00、周末及节假日10:00—19:00，周一闭馆。
intro_en: START Museum stands at 111 Ruining Road in Xuhui District, at the northern end of Shanghai's West Bund art corridor and close to the Huangpu River. Its site was the Rihui Port goods yard, built in 1907 as China's first rail-and-water transfer platform, and later a warehouse on the No. 18 line of Nanpu Railway Station. In 2014 the art researcher He Juxing was invited by the district government to create a museum here; twelve international practices were shortlisted and the commission went to Jean Nouvel. Nouvel kept the 90-metre warehouse footprint, the pitched roof and the roughly 12-metre height, retaining rails and a railway carriage as traces of the site, and the museum opened on 30 December 2022. The building has 1,777 square metres of floor area, with a column-free double-height hall, a suspended mezzanine gallery, a roof exhibition terrace and a 120-metre riverside viewing platform; its silver-grey metal roof and industrial trusses tie it to the waterfront. The opening exhibition, 'Opening START', brought together 88 works by 85 artists and collectives. The programme is built around art-historical research, with long serial exhibitions organised by period and genealogy, which makes it the scholarly anchor at the north end of West Bund. Metro Line 11, Yunjin Road station, is a short walk away; hours are 10:00-18:00 Tuesday to Friday and 10:00-19:00 at weekends, closed Monday.

address: 上海市黄浦区中山东一路1号
area_text: 所在亚细亚大楼建筑面积11,984平方米（占地1,739平方米），美术馆使用二、三层
intro_zh: 久事国际艺术中心位于上海市黄浦区中山东一路1号，即外滩1号亚细亚大楼。该楼由麦边洋行出资、英商马海洋行设计，1916年竣工，为7层钢筋混凝土框架、花岗岩基座的折中主义建筑，曾名麦边大楼，1917年由亚细亚火油公司购入后改称亚细亚大楼，因位置与体量被称为“外滩第一楼”；占地1,739平方米，建筑面积11,984平方米。1949年后大楼先后由上海市冶金设计院等单位使用，2019年起转型为集美术馆、拍卖行、艺术商店与文化沙龙于一体的复合艺术空间，东一美术馆时期曾举办莫奈《日出·印象》、波提切利与提香等特展。2026年3月31日，上海久事美术馆主馆由中山东一路27号6层迁入大楼二、三层，改造由德国gmp建筑师事务所主持，保留回字形动线、历史窗套与拼花实木地板，并重新打开临江窗景。新馆与外滩18号久事艺术空间、北京东路230号久事艺术沙龙联动，形成外滩艺术群落。参观咨询请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Jiushi International Art Centre occupies Bund No. 1, the Asia Building, at 1 Zhongshan East First Road in Huangpu District, Shanghai. The building was financed by the McBain interest, designed by the British firm Moorhead & Halse and completed in 1916: a seven-storey reinforced-concrete frame clad in granite, in an eclectic style mixing neoclassical and Anglo-American office elements.
