It was renamed the Asia Building in 1917 after the Asiatic Petroleum Company bought it, and its position and bulk earned it the name 'the first building on the Bund'. It covers 1,739 square metres of land with 11,984 square metres of floor area. After 1949 it housed state design institutes; from 2019 the building was turned into a composite art venue combining a museum, an auction house, art shops and a cultural salon, and in its Dongyi Art Museum phase it hosted blockbuster shows of Monet's Impression, Sunrise, Botticelli and Titian. On 31 March 2026 the Shanghai Jiushi Art Museum moved its main venue from the sixth floor of No. 27 to the second and third floors here, in a renovation by gmp that keeps the historic window surrounds, the rectangular circulation loop and the parquet floors while reopening river views. It now works with Jiushi's spaces at No. 18 and 230 Beijing East Road as a Bund museum cluster.

address: 上海市青浦区蟠鼎路123弄8号（2023年迁入蟠龙天地；原徐汇区丰谷路35号西岸馆区）
area_text: 现馆建筑面积1,868.5平方米；原西岸机库馆区总建筑面积9,000余平方米
intro_zh: 余德耀美术馆由印尼华人企业家、收藏家余德耀（Budi Tek）于2014年创立，是一家非营利当代艺术博物馆。原馆位于上海市徐汇区丰谷路35号西岸，由原龙华机场机库改造，2014年5月17日开放，总建筑面积9,000余平方米，保留了厂房超大无柱空间与高侧窗，适合大型装置与沉浸式展览；2015年《雨屋》与2016年贾科梅蒂回顾展让它进入国际视野。2023年5月17日，美术馆迁至青浦区蟠鼎路123弄8号蟠龙天地，新馆由山水秀建筑事务所祝晓峰设计，建筑面积1,868.5平方米，把江南民居的坡屋顶、檐廊与院落转译为当代展厅，参观动线沿水乡街巷与河道展开，室内外互为借景。馆藏以余德耀基金会约1,500件作品为基础，重点是中国20世纪80至90年代当代艺术与大型装置，兼及国际当代艺术。2024年，该馆入选上海市首批星级美术馆。现馆开放时间为周二至周日11:00—19:00、周一闭馆，地铁17号线蟠龙路站步行可达；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Yuz Museum Shanghai was founded in 2014 by the Chinese-Indonesian entrepreneur and collector Budi Tek as a non-profit museum of contemporary art. Its first home was a former Longhua airport hangar at 35 Fenggu Road in Xuhui District, on the West Bund. Opened on 17 May 2014, that building offered more than 9,000 square metres of floor area, with an enormous column-free hall and high clerestory windows that suited large installations and immersive exhibitions; Rain Room in 2015 and a Giacometti retrospective in 2016 brought the museum international attention. On 17 May 2023 it moved to 8, Lane 123, Panding Road in Qingpu District, within the Panlong Tiandi development. The new building, designed by Zhu Xiaofeng of Scenic Architecture Office, has 1,868.5 square metres and translates the pitched roofs, eaves galleries and courtyards of Jiangnan houses into contemporary galleries, with a route that follows lanes and waterways and views exchanged between inside and out. The collection is built on about 1,500 works held by the Yuz Foundation, centred on Chinese contemporary art of the 1980s and 1990s and large-scale installation, with international contemporary work alongside. In 2024 the museum was included in Shanghai's first batch of star-rated museums. It opens Tuesday to Sunday from 11:00 to 19:00 and closes on Mondays; Panlong Road station on Metro Line 17 is within walking distance. Telephone ; email

address: 上海市静安区永和东路436号
area_text: 占地3,500平方米（两层，内部净高15米）
intro_zh: 上海明当代美术馆位于上海市静安区永和东路436号，由明园集团资助设立，是一家非营利当代艺术机构，2015年9月开馆，开馆展为《实验剧场30年》。馆舍由上海造纸机械厂的车间改造而成，这座工厂曾被称为“花园工厂”；改造后内部呈U字形空间，形成完整的下沉式舞台架构，占地3,500平方米，分上下两层，内部净高15米，适合装置、影像与现场表演同时发生。美术馆由凌菲菲创办、邱志杰担任馆长，定位为以视觉表演为基础的当代艺术中心，特别关注实验剧场与多媒体展演，并把与表演概念相关的装置、绘画、雕塑、录像、声音、诗歌与舞蹈纳入节目。除展览外，馆方长期运营社区剧场、广场舞新编等公共艺术项目，并与高校合作，通过剧场艺术节、工作坊与奖励基金支持青年实验剧场创作。它位于苏州河北岸的居住片区，是上海少见的嵌入日常街区而非文化园区的美术馆。开放时间为周二至周日10:00—18:00、周一闭馆，咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道；地铁1号线汶水路站步行可达。
intro_en: Ming Contemporary Art Museum (McaM) stands at 436 Yonghe East Road in Jing'an District, Shanghai, funded by the Mingyuan Group as a non-profit contemporary art centre. It opened in September 2015 with the exhibition '30 Years of Experimental Theatre'. The building is a conversion of a workshop of the Shanghai Paper Machinery Plant, once known as the 'garden factory'; the interior is U-shaped and forms a complete sunken stage, covering 3,500 square metres over two levels with a 15-metre internal height, which lets installation, video and live performance share one space. It was founded by Ling Feifei with Qiu Zhijie as director, and defines itself as a centre for art based on visual performance, with a particular focus on experimental theatre and multimedia performance; installation, painting, sculpture, video, sound, poetry and dance linked to performance are all part of the programme. Beyond exhibitions, the museum runs long-term public projects such as community theatre and a rewritten 'square dance' programme, and works with universities to support young experimental theatre makers through festivals, workshops and production funds. Its position north of the Suzhou Creek, in a residential part of Jing'an, makes it a rare art institution embedded in an everyday neighbourhood rather than a cultural district. It opens 10:00-18:00 Tuesday to Sunday, closed Monday; tel .

address: 上海市宝山区长江西路685号
area_text: 博物馆园区20,220平方米（2019年口径）；2011年开馆时主馆约2,300平方米，现有20个主题展馆及公共服务设施
intro_zh: 上海玻璃博物馆位于上海市宝山区长江西路685号，建在原上海玻璃仪器一厂的厂址上，2011年5月18日正式开馆，是中国第一家以玻璃为主题的专业博物馆，也是国家4A级旅游景区。园区由Coordination Asia（Tilman Thürmer）主持设计，保留工业厂房的柱网与尺度，置入黑色金属、耐候钢与大面积玻璃，形成冷峻而明亮的工业设计气质。开馆初期只有主馆与热玻璃演示区，面积约2,300平方米；此后逐步扩展为拥有20个主题展馆及公共服务设施、共20,220平方米的博物馆园区（2019年口径）。主馆常设展从科学、历史、技术与艺术多条线索讲述玻璃，另设设计新馆、儿童玻璃博物馆（2021年开放）、热玻璃演示厅、DIY工坊、艺术家工作室、商店与餐厅。馆方以收藏、研究、展示与国际玻璃艺术交流为核心，连续举办国际玻璃艺术展与驻地创作，使旧工厂转化为持续运营的文化目的地；园区空间也可承接品牌活动、晚宴、婚礼与亲子项目。开放时间通常为周二至周日10:00—18:00、周一闭馆；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Shanghai Museum of Glass stands at 685 West Changjiang Road in Baoshan District, on the site of the former Shanghai No. 1 Glass Instrument Factory. It opened on 18 May 2011 as China's first museum devoted to glass and is now a national 4A-level attraction. Coordination Asia, led by Tilman Thürmer, designed the conversion, keeping the factory's structural grid and scale while inserting black metal, weathering steel and large glass surfaces, which gives the complex a cool, bright industrial character. At opening it consisted of a main hall and a hot-glass demonstration area of about 2,300 square metres; by 2019 it had grown into a museum campus of 20,220 square metres with twenty themed exhibition halls and public facilities. The permanent displays approach glass through science, history, technology and art, and are joined by a design wing, the Kids Museum of Glass, which opened in 2021, a hot-glass theatre, DIY workshops, artist studios, a shop and a restaurant. Collecting, research, display and international glass exchange form the core of the programme, which includes recurring international glass exhibitions and residencies and has turned an old factory into a working cultural destination. The campus also hosts brand events, dinners, weddings and family programmes. It generally opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 18:00 and closes on Mondays; telephone and email are not included in this public dataset.

address: 上海市徐汇区龙腾大道3398号
area_text: 建筑总面积约33,000㎡；展示面积16,000㎡
intro_zh: 龙美术馆（西岸馆）位于徐汇区龙腾大道3398号，地处黄浦江畔徐汇滨江“西岸文化走廊”的核心位置，由收藏家刘益谦、王薇夫妇创办，2014年3月正式开馆。场馆由建筑师柳亦春（大舍建筑设计事务所）设计，建筑总面积约3.3万平方米，展示面积达1.6万平方米，主体共四层。其结构以独特的“伞拱”为特征：地上一层、二层是清水混凝土浇灌的大尺度出挑拱形空间，与原北票码头的构筑物“煤漏斗”改造而成的“斗廊”形成视觉呼应，呈现理性冷静的工业感与原始的力量感；地下一层则回归传统“白盒子”式矩形展厅。功能上刻意打破封闭内向的美术馆模式：地上两层设江景餐厅、公共景观庭院、音乐厅、咖啡厅与艺术品商店，地下一层设儿童展厅、图书馆、艺术品修复室与艺术书店，地下二层为停车场，使看展与滨江休闲连成一体。龙美术馆以中国近现代及当代艺术收藏见长，藏品涵盖书画、油画、雕塑、装置与瓷器，常设与特展并行，是西岸美术馆群中体量最大的私立美术馆之一。交通方面，地铁7号线、12号线龙华中路站步行约10分钟，公交隧道八线至船厂路中山南二路站步行约5分钟，滨江步道可北接西岸艺术中心、南连油罐艺术中心。
intro_en: Long Museum West Bund stands at 3398 Longteng Avenue in Xuhui District, at the core of the West Bund cultural corridor along the Huangpu River. Founded by collectors Liu Yiqian and Wang Wei, it opened in March 2014 in a building designed by Liu Yichun of Atelier Deshaus. The total floor area is about 33,000 square metres, with 16,000 square metres of display space across four levels. Its structure is defined by a series of 'umbrella arches': the ground and first floors are large cantilevered vaulted spaces poured in fair-faced concrete, visually answering the 'hopper corridor' made from the coal hoppers of the former Beipiao wharf, and producing a coolly rational industrial presence with a raw sense of force. The basement returns to conventional white-cube rectangular galleries. The programme deliberately breaks with the closed, inward-looking museum model: the two upper levels add a river-view restaurant, landscaped courtyard, music hall, café and art shop, the first basement holds a children's gallery, library, conservation studio and art bookshop, and the second basement provides parking, so that exhibition-going connects with riverside leisure. The collection is strong in modern and contemporary Chinese art — painting, oil, sculpture, installation and porcelain — and temporary shows run alongside the permanent displays, making it one of the largest private museums in the West Bund cluster. Metro Lines 7 and 12 to Longhua Middle Road are about a ten-minute walk; the Tunnel Line 8 bus stops at Chuanchang Road/Zhongshan South No. 2 Road, about five minutes away, and the riverside promenade links north to the West Bund Art Center and south to Tank Shanghai.

address: 上海市浦东新区祖冲之路2277弄1号
area_text: 总面积约7,000平方米，其中展厅约5,000平方米，共三层
intro_zh: 昊美术馆（上海）位于上海市浦东新区祖冲之路2277弄1号，地处张江高科技园区，由收藏家郑好创办，2017年9月正式对外开放。美术馆共有三层展览与活动空间，总面积约7,000平方米，其中展厅约5,000平方米：一层与二层为展览空间，三层为昊设计中心，集展览、品牌整合与跨界合作于一体。馆藏以郑好十余年的收藏为基础，涵盖达明安·赫斯特、安迪·沃霍尔、约瑟夫·博伊斯、白南准、陈逸飞、赵无极、周春芽等中外艺术家作品；开馆后以“见者的书信：约瑟夫·博伊斯×白南准”等国际大展确立学术形象，并保持每年约十二个展览的输出节奏。空间设计强调黑盒子与白盒子的切换，适合影像、装置与新媒体作品；三层设计中心则把设计、时尚与商业品牌纳入当代艺术语境。美术馆位于张江科学城核心，周边聚集科技企业与研发机构，形成“艺术+科技”的区位特征，并曾推行夜间开放，方便园区上班族下班后观展。开放时间为周二至周五12:00—20:30、周六至周日10:00—20:30，周一闭馆；咨询电话未在本库列出。
intro_en: HOW Art Museum Shanghai is at No. 1, Lane 2277, Zuchongzhi Road in Pudong New Area, inside the Zhangjiang high-tech park. It was founded by collector Zheng Hao and opened in September 2017. The museum has three levels of exhibition and event space, about 7,000 square metres in total, of which roughly 5,000 square metres are galleries: the first and second floors hold exhibitions, while the third floor is the HOW Design Centre, which combines exhibitions with brand collaboration and cross-sector projects. The collection is built on Zheng Hao's holdings of more than a decade and includes works by Damien Hirst, Andy Warhol, Joseph Beuys, Nam June Paik, Chen Yifei, Zao Wou-Ki and Zhou Chunya. Early international shows such as The Message of the Seeing: Joseph Beuys and Nam June Paik established its academic profile, and the museum has kept a rhythm of about twelve exhibitions a year. The interiors shift between black-box and white-cube conditions, which suits video, installation and new media, while the design centre on the top floor brings design, fashion and commercial brands into a contemporary art context. Located in the core of Zhangjiang Science City, surrounded by technology firms and research institutes, the museum has cultivated an art-plus-technology identity and has run evening opening hours for local office workers. It opens Tuesday to Friday from 12:00 to 20:30 and weekends from 10:00 to 20:30, closed on Mondays; telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 上海市闵行区漕宝路3055号
area_text: 占地23,000平方米，建筑面积近19,000平方米
intro_zh: 宝龙美术馆位于上海市闵行区漕宝路3055号，近新镇路，由宝龙集团创办，2017年11月18日正式开馆，是宝龙集团在上海打造的大型民营美术馆。美术馆占地面积23,000平方米，建筑面积近19,000平方米，展厅面积从500至1,100平方米不等，可灵活组合，适合不同尺度的绘画、雕塑、装置与新媒体展览。开馆时推出“书藏楼珍藏展”与开馆展，书藏楼以近现代及当代中国书画收藏为核心，形成美术馆区别于其他民营馆的收藏特色；此后馆方持续引入国际现当代艺术大展，并兼顾在地公共教育。建筑以简洁的几何体量与浅色石材为主，内部围绕中庭组织参观动线，设艺术商店、咖啡厅与艺术西餐厅，观展与休憩动线完整，馆方常年开展讲座、工作坊与公众导览。美术馆地处七宝—漕宝路文化带，周边有宝龙城商业综合体，地铁9号线七宝站、10号线航中路站可达。开放时间为周二至周日10:00—18:00（17:00停止入场），周一闭馆；前台咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: The Shanghai Powerlong Museum stands at 3055 Caobao Road in Minhang District, near Xinzhen Road, and was founded by the Powerlong Group, opening on 18 November 2017. It is one of the largest privately funded museums in Shanghai: the site covers 23,000 square metres and the building about 19,000 square metres, with galleries ranging from 500 to 1,100 square metres that can be combined for different scales of painting, sculpture, installation and new media. The opening programme paired the 'Shucang Lou' collection display with a thematic inaugural exhibition; Shucang Lou, the group's collection of modern and contemporary Chinese painting and calligraphy, gives the museum a collecting identity distinct from purely contemporary institutions, while later programming has brought international modern and contemporary shows and a strong public-education strand. The building is composed of simple geometric volumes in light stone, with the visit organised around an internal court, and includes an art shop, cafe and art restaurant. It sits in the Qibao-Caobao cultural belt beside the Powerlong City complex, reachable from Metro Line 9 at Qibao and Line 10 at Hangzhong Road, and is part of the group's cultural investment alongside its commercial properties. Galleries open 10:00-18:00 Tuesday to Sunday, last entry 17:00, closed Monday. The group's first museum opened in Qingdao in 2014. Front desk

address: 上海市黄浦区淮海中路300号B3
area_text: 总面积约3,000平方米
intro_zh: chi K11美术馆位于上海市黄浦区淮海中路300号K11购物艺术中心B3层，2013年随上海K11开幕，是K11品牌创始人郑志刚推动“艺术×商业”模式的核心空间。美术馆总面积约3,000平方米，藏在商场地下三层，观众由购物中心中庭经扶梯进入展厅，形成“逛街即看展”的动线，是国内最早把当代美术馆嵌入高端零售综合体的案例之一。开馆以来已举办超过50场艺术展览，包括“印象派大师·莫奈特展”“跨界大师·鬼才达利”等大型引进展，以及张恩利、奥斯卡·穆里略等当代艺术家个展，并配套讲座、工作坊与艺术论坛逾200场。空间以可变的黑盒子与白盒子组合，适合绘画、装置、影像与沉浸式布展；馆方亦与巴黎、伦敦等地的艺术机构合作，把国际展览引入淮海中路商圈。美术馆位于淮海中路商业街核心，观展客群由购物中心客流与艺术爱好者共同构成。开放时间为周一至周日10:00—20:00（19:30停止入场），部分展览免费、特展另行售票；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道；地铁1号线、14号线黄陂南路站直达。
intro_en: chi K11 Art Museum occupies level B3 of the K11 Art Mall at 300 Huaihai Middle Road in Huangpu District, Shanghai, and opened with the mall in 2013. It is the core exhibition space of the 'art x commerce' model promoted by Adrian Cheng, founder of the K11 brand, and with about 3,000 square metres it is one of the earliest contemporary art museums embedded in a high-end retail complex in mainland China. Visitors enter from the mall atrium and descend by escalator into the galleries, so that shopping and exhibition-going become a single movement. Since opening it has staged more than fifty exhibitions, including large imported shows such as 'Master of Impressionism: Monet' and 'Dali: Genius of Surrealism', alongside solo presentations by Zhang Enli and Oscar Murillo, and has run over two hundred lectures, workshops and art forums. The space combines flexible black-box and white-cube galleries, suited to painting, installation, video and immersive staging, and the museum works with institutions in Paris and London to bring international exhibitions into the Huaihai Road shopping district. Its audience mixes mall visitors with dedicated art followers. It opens daily from 10:00 to 20:00, with last entry at 19:30; some displays are free and blockbuster shows are ticketed. ; Metro Lines 1 and 14, Huangpi South Road station.

address: 上海市徐汇区龙腾大道2600号
area_text: 总建筑面积约20,000平方米（ArchDaily记录22,000平方米）；三个展厅体量各高17米
intro_zh: 西岸美术馆位于上海市徐汇区龙腾大道2600号，处在黄浦江西岸、龙腾大道与江岸交汇的三角形地块上，是“西岸美术馆大道”的核心公共文化场馆。项目由英国建筑师戴卫·奇普菲尔德爵士设计，2013年启动设计、2017年开工建设，2019年11月8日正式向公众开放，总建筑面积约20,000平方米。建筑由三个高17米的展厅体量以风车状围绕中央双层通高大厅布置，各自可独立运营；上层为天光展厅，下层容纳多功能厅、艺术工作室与教育空间，半下沉的侧高窗把自然光引入。外立面使用半透明再生玻璃，白天呈乳白色、夜晚透出棱镜般的光泽；沿江一侧抬起公共步道，屋顶向江面悬挑，形成可看江景的露台与咖啡亭。开馆同期，美术馆与法国蓬皮杜中心启动为期五年的展陈合作，围绕视觉艺术、表演艺术、新媒体与当代设计四条主线展开，是中法高级别人文交流项目。场馆适合大型国际巡展、品牌发布、学术论坛与滨江酒会，展厅、书店、咖啡与公共空间可分区使用；开放时间为周二至周日10:00—17:00（16:00停止入场）；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: West Bund Museum stands at 2600 Longteng Avenue in Xuhui District, on a triangular site where Longteng Avenue meets the bank of the Huangpu River, and is a central public venue of Shanghai's West Bund art corridor. David Chipperfield Architects designed the building; design began in 2013, construction started in 2017 and the museum opened on 8 November 2019 with about 20,000 square metres of floor area, a figure ArchDaily records as 22,000 square metres. Three gallery volumes, each 17 metres high, are arranged in a pin-wheel around a central double-height lobby and can operate independently. Their upper levels hold top-lit galleries; the lower levels contain a multipurpose hall, art studio and education rooms, lit by clerestory windows and partly sunken. The facades are clad in translucent recycled glass that reads as opaline by day and prismatic at night, while a raised public esplanade runs along the river and the roof cantilevers toward the water, creating a terrace and a small café pavilion with river views. At opening, the museum began a five-year exhibition partnership with the Centre Pompidou, organised around visual art, performance, new media and contemporary design and presented as a flagship cultural exchange between France and China. The building suits large touring exhibitions, brand launches, academic forums and riverside receptions, with galleries, bookshop, café and public spaces able to be used separately. It opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 17:00, last entry at 16:00; telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 上海市黄浦区虎丘路20号
area_text: 馆舍共6层；2至5层为展厅，展示面积约834平方米，6层为咖啡与露台
intro_zh: 上海外滩美术馆位于上海市黄浦区虎丘路20号，坐落在外滩源片区，馆舍是始建于1932年的亚洲文会大楼（原上海博物院），由公和洋行设计，是一座融合中西元素的装饰艺术风格历史建筑，也是中国最早的公共博物馆之一。建筑由戴维·奇普菲尔德建筑师事务所完成修复与改造，2010年美术馆以非营利当代艺术机构身份开馆。馆舍共六层：一层为入口与接待大厅，二至五层为展厅，展示面积约834平方米，六层设咖啡厅与露台，可俯瞰苏州河与黄浦江交汇一带的屋顶景观。美术馆以策展创新著称，提出“群岛思维”，通过连接亚洲及其他地区的艺术网络，推动研究、委任创作、表演与公共教育；其展览常以整层为单位展开，适合影像、装置、声音与现场艺术。2025年5月2日起，美术馆实行全馆展览免费开放，并启动艺术家伊莲娜·海杜克设计的“努拉经济”实验，把观众的时间与参与纳入交换。场馆位于外滩历史街区，步行可达南京东路地铁站，适合展览、学术活动、品牌酒会与小型发布；开放时间为周三至周日11:00—18:00（17:30停止入场），周二为会员日；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Rockbund Art Museum occupies the former Royal Asiatic Society building at 20 Huqiu Road in Huangpu District, in the Bund area of Shanghai. The 1932 Art Deco building, designed by Palmer and Turner, combines Chinese and Western details and once housed one of China's earliest public museums, the Shanghai Museum. David Chipperfield Architects restored and adapted it, and the museum opened as a non-profit contemporary art institution in 2010. The building has six levels: the ground floor holds the entrance and reception, floors two to five are galleries with about 834 square metres of display space, and the sixth floor has a café and terrace looking over the roofs where Suzhou Creek meets the Huangpu River. The museum is known for experimental curating and for what it calls archipelago thinking, connecting art networks across Asia and beyond through research, commissions, performance and public programmes. Exhibitions often take a whole floor, which suits video, installation, sound and live art. From 2 May 2025 all exhibitions became free to enter, alongside Nula Economy, an experimental project by artist Irena Haiduk that treats visitors' time and participation as a form of exchange. Set in the Bund historic district and within walking distance of East Nanjing Road station, the museum suits exhibitions, seminars, brand receptions and small launches. It opens Wednesday to Sunday from 11:00 to 18:00, last entry at 17:30, with Tuesday reserved for members; telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 上海市静安区永和东路436号
area_text: 占地3,500平方米，上下两层，内部净高15米
intro_zh: 上海明当代美术馆位于上海市静安区永和东路436号，由明园集团资助设立，是一家非营利当代艺术机构。它的前身是上海造纸机械厂的车间，这座工厂当年因厂区绿化好而被称为“花园工厂”；改造后保留了工业建筑的框架与高敞尺度，内部呈U字形，形成完整的下沉式舞台架构，占地3,500平方米，分上下两层，内部净高15米，适合装置、影像、声音与现场表演同时发生。美术馆于2015年9月开馆，开馆展为《实验剧场30年》，由凌菲菲创办、邱志杰担任馆长，定位为以视觉表演为基础的当代艺术中心，特别关注实验剧场与多媒体展演，并把与表演概念相连的绘画、雕塑、录像、诗歌与舞蹈纳入节目。除展览外，馆方长期运营社区剧场、广场舞新编等公共艺术项目，与高校合作举办剧场艺术节、工作坊，并以奖励基金支持青年实验剧场创作。场馆位于苏州河北岸的居住片区，嵌入日常街区而非封闭文化园区，观众从地铁1号线汶水路站步行可达；开放时间为周二至周日10:00—18:00（17:30停止入场），周一闭馆；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Ming Contemporary Art Museum (McaM) is at 436 East Yonghe Road in Jing'an District, Shanghai, and is a non-profit contemporary art institution funded by the Mingyuan Group. Its building is a former workshop of the Shanghai Paper Machinery Factory, once known as the Garden Factory because of its planted grounds. The conversion kept the industrial frame and generous height: the interior forms a U-shaped plan around a sunken stage, covers 3,500 square metres over two levels and rises 15 metres, so installation, video, sound and live performance can share the same room. The museum opened in September 2015 with the exhibition 30 Years of Experimental Theatre. It was founded by Ling Feifei and is directed by Qiu Zhijie, and its programme is built around visual performance, with particular attention to experimental theatre and multimedia production, drawing painting, sculpture, video, poetry and dance into that field. Beyond exhibitions, McaM runs community theatre projects, a rewritten square-dance programme and university partnerships, including theatre festivals, workshops and a fund that supports young experimental theatre makers. The museum sits in a residential quarter north of Suzhou Creek, embedded in everyday street life rather than in a gated cultural campus, and is a short walk from Wenshui Road station on Metro Line 1. It opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 18:00, last entry at 17:30, and closes on Mondays; telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 上海市浦东新区陆家嘴富城路99号（震旦国际大楼）
area_text: 馆区共六层，面积6,316平方米
intro_zh: 震旦博物馆位于上海市浦东新区陆家嘴富城路99号震旦国际大楼内，是陆家嘴地区第一座非国有博物馆，2013年10月正式对外开放。博物馆由震旦集团创办人陈永泰推动设立，以“保护、传承、奉献”中华文化为理念，馆区共六层，面积6,316平方米。建筑由普利兹克奖得主、日本建筑师安藤忠雄规划设计，是他在中国完成的第一座博物馆项目；外观以珠宝盒为灵感，用玻璃帷幕包覆简洁的几何体，夜间像一只沉静的蓝色宝盒。内部高五层的圆形空间中置入旋转楼梯，清水混凝土、玻璃与光影共同构成展陈背景。藏品以中国古代器物为主，涵盖佛教造像、青花瓷器、历代玉器与汉唐陶俑，分常设展与专题特展两部分陈列，并设古器物学研究中心，倡导以“料、工、形、纹”为核心的研究方法，与北京大学考古文博学院等机构合作。场馆位于陆家嘴金融区，面向外滩建筑群，适合展览、学术活动、品牌发布与小型晚宴；开放时间为周二至周日10:00—17:00、周五延长至21:00，周一休馆；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Aurora Museum occupies six floors of the Aurora International Building at 99 Fucheng Road in Lujiazui, Pudong New Area, Shanghai. It was the first non-state museum in Lujiazui and opened to the public in October 2013. Promoted by Chen Yongtai, founder of the Aurora Group, it is run as a cultural commitment to protect, transmit and share Chinese art. The museum covers 6,316 square metres across six levels. Tadao Ando, the Pritzker laureate, planned and designed the building, his first completed museum project in China; the exterior takes the form of a jewellery box, a simple geometric volume wrapped in a glass curtain wall that at night reads as a deep blue case. Inside, a circular void five storeys high contains a spiral stair, with fair-faced concrete, glass and changing light forming the backdrop to the displays. The collection concentrates on ancient Chinese objects, including Buddhist sculpture, blue-and-white porcelain, jade through the dynasties and Han and Tang pottery figures. It is presented in permanent and temporary sections, supported by a research centre for the study of antiquities that promotes a method based on material, craft, form and decoration, and by partnerships with Peking University's School of Archaeology and Museology. Facing the Bund across the river in the Lujiazui financial district, the museum suits exhibitions, academic events, brand launches and small dinners. It opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 17:00, until 21:00 on Fridays, and is closed on Mondays; telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 上海市虹口区海平路58号2楼（北外滩；另有东大名路888弄19号门牌记录）
area_text: 馆内总面积约1,700㎡；另有约6,400㎡户外露台花园
intro_zh: 上海抱朴美术馆位于虹口区海平路58号二楼，处在北外滩滨江核心段，与东方明珠、上海中心隔江相望，是北外滩近年成型的民营美术馆之一。美术馆以收藏、研究、展示中国现当代艺术为重点，自2008年起系统积累，馆藏逾千件，涵盖钱币、邮票、景泰蓝、瓷器、书画、玉器、苏绣、象牙与紫砂壶等数十个品类；馆内还复原了漫画家丁聪在北京居所的画室原貌，以“书天书地”的方式陈列其1.2万册藏书，其中660余册为文化界人士题赠的签名本。馆舍总面积约1,700平方米，由空间设计师胡武豪与法国设计师William联合设计，以黑白为基调；一楼接待区约200平方米，一部贯穿一至三楼的白色旋转楼梯是全馆最具辨识度的视觉焦点，二层为主要展厅，挑高空间与大面玻璃墙把江面天光引入室内。馆外另有约6,400平方米的露天花园露台，可直视北外滩沿江绿地与陆家嘴天际线，常用于冷餐会与after party。场馆免费开放，周二至周日9:00—17:30，周六设夜间场至22:00，需通过官方公众号预约；周边为北外滩来福士、白玉兰广场等新建商业体，步行可至北外滩滨江步道。
intro_en: Baopu Art Museum occupies the second floor of 58 Haiping Road in Hongkou District, on the North Bund waterfront directly across the Huangpu River from the Oriental Pearl Tower and Shanghai Tower. It is a private museum focused on collecting, researching and showing modern and contemporary Chinese art. Collecting began in 2008 and now exceeds a thousand works, ranging across coins, stamps, cloisonne, porcelain, painting and calligraphy, jade, Suzhou embroidery, ivory and Yixing teapots. The museum also reconstructs the Beijing studio of the cartoonist Ding Cong and displays his 12,000-volume library, including more than 660 signed copies given by cultural figures. The 1,700 sq m interior was designed by Hu Wuhao with the French designer William in a black-and-white palette. A white spiral staircase linking all three levels is the building's signature gesture, while the second floor holds the main galleries, where high ceilings and full-height glazing bring in river light. A 6,400 sq m roof terrace faces the North Bund green belt and the Lujiazui skyline and is used for receptions and evening events. Admission is free, Tuesday to Sunday 9:00-17:30 with a Saturday night session until 22:00, by reservation through the museum's official WeChat account. The surrounding blocks include North Bund Raffles City and White Magnolia Plaza, with the riverside promenade a short walk away.

address: 上海市长宁区淮海西路570号（上海A.F.A／融侨中心内）
area_text: ROJO艺文空间约6,000㎡；A.F.A整体含约5万㎡商业、10万㎡办公
intro_zh: A.F.A ROJO艺术文化空间位于长宁区淮海西路570号上海A.F.A（融侨中心）内，地处新华路历史文化风貌区，前身为1956年建厂的上海第十钢铁厂，后为红坊文创园与上海城市雕塑艺术中心所在地，是上海西区工业遗存更新最具代表性的段落之一。ROJO艺文空间建筑面积约6,000平方米，由2022年普利兹克建筑奖得主、日本建筑师西泽立卫担纲设计，以“自然流动”为概念，把老厂房的结构尺度与新建的通透界面叠合，形成可容纳驻场演出、大型装置、品牌发布与展览的复合空间；项目南侧的历史保护建筑与公共空间同样交由西泽立卫团队处理，延续红坊时期的梧桐林荫与城市记忆。2024年7月18日，ROJO随上海·蓝人秀亚洲限定驻场演出正式对公众开放，成为A.F.A的核心文化引擎。A.F.A整体于2023年竣工，由约5万平方米购物中心、10万平方米办公楼、ROJO艺文空间及1,000个停车位组成，以历史、艺术、自然为背景组织业态。交通上，地铁3、4、10号线虹桥路站步行可达，延安高架与内环高架在侧，距虹桥机场约20分钟车程。
intro_en: ROJO Art and Culture Space is the cultural core of Shanghai A.F.A at 570 West Huaihai Road in Changning District, on the edge of the Xinhua Road historic conservation area. The site belonged to the Shanghai No.10 Steel Works, founded in 1956, and later to the Red Town art district and the Shanghai City Sculpture Art Centre, making it one of the clearest examples of industrial heritage conversion in western Shanghai. ROJO covers about 6,000 sq m and was designed by the Pritzker laureate Ryue Nishizawa, whose scheme sets flowing new volumes against the retained factory structure to create a flexible house for residencies, large-scale installations, brand launches and exhibitions. The historic buildings and public realm on the southern part of the site were also handled by his studio, keeping the plane-tree-lined street edge and the memory of Red Town. ROJO opened to the public on 18 July 2024 alongside the Asian limited run of Blue Man Group and now acts as the complex's cultural engine. The wider A.F.A, completed in 2023, combines a 50,000 sq m shopping centre, 100,000 sq m of offices, the ROJO space and 1,000 parking spaces, arranged around history, art and nature. Metro lines 3, 4 and 10 at Hongqiao Road are within walking distance, the Yan'an and Inner Ring elevated roads are close by, and Hongqiao Airport is about 20 minutes away.

address: 上海市静安区常德路800号（近昌平路）
area_text: 总建筑面积约2.2万㎡，15幢建筑；核心秀场由1,600余㎡、净高12米的苏式厂房改造
intro_zh: 800秀创意园位于静安区常德路800号，地处静安寺—南京西路商圈北侧，前身为1946年周馥家族创办的新安电机厂，解放后为上海人民电机厂，全国第一台深水泵即产于此，曹禺《雷雨》的背景亦取自这一家族往事。2008年起，静工集团与上海电气集团合作推进改造，德国罗昂（logon）建筑设计公司承担概念规划与设计，2009年底正式开园。园区总建筑面积约2.2万平方米，由15幢不同年代的建筑组成——20世纪二三十年代的花园别墅、五六十年代的苏式厂房与石库门里弄交错——各栋以架空连廊相连，形成有分有合的院落群，绿化率约30%。核心资产是一座净高12米、宽14米、进深逾115米、建筑面积1,600余平方米的单层苏式车间，改造后成为上海市中心罕见的无柱长向秀场，可容纳时装走秀、品牌发布、汽车展示与大型晚宴；木质屋架被完整保留，夜间以灯光强化结构美感。园区以时尚发布、创意设计、广告传媒为主导业态，是静安区唯一的市级示范文创园区。地铁7号线昌平路站距园区约150米，至南京西路约900米，交通与商务配套成熟。
intro_en: 800 Show Creative Park occupies 800 Changde Road in Jing'an District, about 900 metres north of the Nanjing West Road retail spine. The site began as the Xin'an Electric Motor Factory, founded in 1946 by the Zhou Fu family, and after 1949 became the Shanghai People's Electric Motor Factory, where China's first deep-well pump was produced; the family history also supplied the background for Cao Yu's play Thunderstorm. From 2008 the Jinggong Group and Shanghai Electric partnered on a conversion designed by the German office logon, and the park opened at the end of 2009. It contains about 22,000 sq m across fifteen buildings of different eras — 1920s and 1930s villas, 1950s and 1960s Soviet-influenced workshops and shikumen lanes — linked by elevated corridors to form a sequence of courtyards, with roughly 30 per cent green cover. Its centrepiece is a single-storey workshop 12 metres high, 14 metres wide and more than 115 metres deep, with about 1,600 sq m of column-free floor; stripped back to its timber roof trusses, it is now one of central Shanghai's few long-run fashion show venues, used for catwalk shows, car launches and banquets. Fashion, design and media tenants dominate, and it is Jing'an's only municipal-level demonstration creative park. Changping Road station on metro line 7 is roughly 150 metres away.

address: 上海市静安区北京西路510号（静安雕塑公园内）
area_text: 建筑面积45,257㎡，展览教育服务面积32,200㎡
intro_zh: 上海自然博物馆（上海科技馆分馆）位于静安区北京西路510号静安雕塑公园内，2015年4月18日新馆开馆，4月19日起对公众售票开放。其历史可追溯至1868年法国神父韩伯禄创办的徐家汇博物院与1874年的亚洲文会上海博物院，1956年在两馆基础上正式成立上海自然博物馆，2001年撤销建制并入上海科技馆。新馆由美国帕金斯威尔（Perkins&Will）与同济大学建筑设计研究院联合设计，造型取意鹦鹉螺壳，被称为“绿螺”；建筑面积45,257平方米，展览教育服务面积32,200平方米，总投资13亿元。馆内以“起源之谜”“生命长河”“演化之道”“大地探珍”“缤纷生命”“生态万象”等常设展区串联自然史叙事，另有临展厅、4D影院、探索中心与两座剧场；藏品超过31万件，2021年完成24米长须鲸标本的搭建。建筑东侧绿化屋面与地铁13号线自然博物馆站出入口相接，另可乘1号线新闸路站、2号线南京西路站抵达；馆内不设公众停车场，建议公共交通前往。周二至周日9:00—17:00开放，周一闭馆（法定节假日除外）。
intro_en: The Shanghai Natural History Museum, a branch of the Shanghai Science and Technology Museum, stands at 510 Beijing West Road in Jing'an District, inside Jing'an Sculpture Park. The new building opened on 18 April 2015 and began selling public tickets the following day. Its lineage reaches back to the Xujiahui Museum founded by the French priest Pierre Heude in 1868 and the 1874 Shanghai Museum of the Royal Asiatic Society; the museum itself was established in 1956 and merged into the science and technology museum in 2001. Designed by Perkins&Will with the Tongji Architectural Design Institute, the building takes the nautilus shell as its form and is known locally as the Green Snail. It offers 45,257 sq m of floor area and 32,200 sq m of exhibition and education space, representing an investment of 1.3 billion yuan. Permanent galleries such as Origins of the Universe, Pageant of Life, Path of Evolution and Treasures of the Earth trace natural history from the Big Bang to the present, supported by temporary galleries, a 4D cinema, an exploration centre and two theatres. The collection exceeds 310,000 objects, and a 24-metre fin whale skeleton was installed in 2021. The green roof connects to Natural History Museum station on line 13, with Xinzha Road on line 1 and Nanjing West Road on line 2 also nearby.

address: 上海市黄浦区中山东一路1号2—3层（亚细亚大楼／久事国际艺术中心内；展览入口延安东路2号）
area_text: 展厅位于亚细亚大楼二、三层，面积未公开
intro_zh: 东一美术馆（Bund One Art Museum）位于黄浦区中山东一路1号亚细亚大楼二、三层，地处外滩万国建筑博览群南端起点，展览入口设在延安东路2号。亚细亚大楼建于1916年，为全国重点文物保护单位，是外滩现存最早的钢框架建筑之一；2019年10月1日，久事国际艺术中心在此开放，东一美术馆同期成立，首展为“世世太平——齐白石精品大展”。场馆以引进海外博物馆级真迹展为核心策略：2020年9月，“日出·光明——莫奈《日出·印象》”特展在此开幕，这是莫奈代表作首次来华；此后陆续举办日本浮世绘版画展、意大利贝加莫卡拉拉学院“文艺复兴至十九世纪”绘画展、法国现代艺术展、乌菲齐馆藏大师自画像展、意大利国家现当代美术馆“现代艺术100年”，以及2024年里尔现代艺术博物馆馆藏毕加索、莫迪利亚尼展。2021年“莫奈与印象派大师展”吸引26万人次观众。展厅保留了历史建筑的窗洞与层高，观展动线紧凑，适合单一大展的沉浸式布陈；馆内设无障碍通道，需提前电话预约。每日10:00—18:00开放（17:30停止入场），地铁2号线、10号线南京东路站步行可达。
intro_en: Bund One Art Museum occupies the second and third floors of the Asia Building at No.1 Zhongshan East 1st Road, at the southern start of the Bund's historic frontage, with its exhibition entrance at No.2 Yan'an East Road. The Asia Building dates from 1916 and is a nationally protected heritage structure, one of the Bund's earliest steel-framed buildings. The Jiushi International Art Centre opened here on 1 October 2019, and the museum was founded at the same time, opening with a Qi Baishi retrospective. Its programme is built on museum-grade loans from abroad: in September 2020 it showed Monet's Impression, Sunrise, the painting's first visit to China, followed by Japanese ukiyo-e prints, Renaissance to nineteenth-century paintings from the Carrara Academy in Bergamo, French modern art, the Uffizi self-portrait exhibition, 100 Years of Modern Art from the Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Moderna in Rome, and in 2024 Picasso and Modigliani from the Lille Museum of Modern Art. Its 2021 Monet and the Impressionists show drew 260,000 visitors. Galleries on two floors keep the original window bays and ceiling heights, giving a compact, focused route suited to a single blockbuster; step-free access is available on request. Opening hours are 10:00-18:00 daily, last entry 17:30, with Nanjing East Road station on lines 2 and 10 a short walk away.

address: 上海市杨浦区杨树浦路2800号（杨树浦电厂遗迹公园内；部分报道写作2866号）
area_text: 改造面积约3,840㎡
intro_zh: 灰仓艺术空间（又称灰仓美术馆）位于杨浦区杨树浦路2800号杨树浦电厂遗迹公园内，处在黄浦江杨浦滨江贯通段的最东端码头。场地前身为1913年英商投资建成的杨树浦发电厂——曾经的“远东第一火力发电厂”，留有105米烟囱、鹤嘴吊、输煤栈桥、传送带、清水池与湿灰、干灰储灰罐等完整作业设施。灰仓由电厂干灰储灰罐改造而成，同济大学原作设计工作室（章明、张姿团队）自2015年起承担方案设计，2019年建成开放，改造面积约3,840平方米。设计保留储灰罐黄灰相间的金属立面与圆筒形空间特征，在南侧临江开口新置入螺旋钢梯与多层交通体系，把原本封闭的生产容器转为可登临、可环视江面的展示空间；圆筒的尺度与回声效果使其特别适合大型装置、影像与声音艺术。作为杨浦“生活秀带”国家文物保护利用示范区的节点，它与皂梦空间、泵坑艺术空间等共同构成工业遗产群。需注意：2025年4月的报道显示场馆因暂无展览处于暂闭状态，仅可外围观看，前往前应确认开放信息。
intro_en: The Ash Gallery, also called the Ash Warehouse Art Space, stands at 2800 Yangshupu Road in Yangpu District, at the eastern tip of the Yangshupu Power Plant heritage park on the Huangpu River. The site was the Yangshupu Power Plant, built with British capital in 1913 and once the largest thermal plant in the Far East; it retains a 105-metre chimney, a grab crane, a coal conveyor bridge, settling tanks and wet and dry ash silos. The gallery is the converted dry-ash silo, designed from 2015 by Zhang Ming and Zhang Zi of the Tongji Original Design Studio and completed in 2019, with about 3,840 sq m of converted floor area. The design keeps the yellow-grey metal skin and the cylindrical volumes and inserts a spiral steel stair and a new circulation system on the river side, turning a closed production vessel into a climbable viewing space. The cylindrical rooms and their acoustics suit large installations, video and sound work. It is a node in Yangpu's national demonstration zone for industrial heritage, alongside the Soap Dream Space and the Pump Pit. Note that a report in April 2025 found the venue temporarily closed between exhibitions and visible only from outside, so opening should be confirmed before a visit.

name_zh: 荣威·上海儿童艺术剧场
address: 上海市黄浦区苗江路800号（近西藏南路、龙华东路）
intro_zh: 荣威·上海儿童艺术剧场位于上海市黄浦区苗江路800号，处在黄浦江西岸的世博园区内，近西藏南路与龙华东路。其前身是2010年上海世博会的上汽集团—通用汽车馆，世博会后由中国福利会改造为儿童剧场，2013年6月1日正式启用，同时挂牌“上汽荣威儿童文化中心”。剧场占地10,529平方米，建筑面积15,148平方米，地上四层、高28米，最大观众席1,088座。建筑因流线型银色外壳被称作“大鲸鱼”，外墙设有“天使眼”显示屏；内部包含两个专业剧场，以及剧场大堂、270度江景观景平台、贵宾室、艺术教室、训练室、录音室、电影放映厅和艺术展示长廊，室外配大面积停车场。剧场以16岁以下青少年及亲子家庭为主要服务对象，引进国内外儿童剧、音乐、舞蹈与多媒体演出，2015年率先在国内推出面向3岁以下婴幼儿的演出，2017年起为特殊需求儿童提供专场，并长期开展“海星之愿”特殊儿童艺术启发项目，年接待观众超过10万人次。交通方面，可乘地铁4号线、8号线至西藏南路站，出站沿龙华东路步行约15分钟；也可乘地铁13号线至世博会博物馆站换乘公交，周边公交线路与停车位较为完善。
intro_en: The Roewe Shanghai Children's Art Theatre stands at 800 Miaojiang Road in Huangpu District, on the west bank of the Huangpu River inside the former Expo 2010 site, close to South Xizang Road and East Longhua Road. It occupies the former SAIC-GM pavilion of Expo 2010, which the China Welfare Institute converted into a children's theatre; it opened on 1 June 2013 and is also known as the SAIC Roewe Children's Culture Centre. The theatre covers a site of 10,529 sqm with 15,148 sqm of floor area, four storeys and a height of 28 m, and seats up to 1,088. Its streamlined silver envelope has earned it the nickname "Big Whale", and an "Angel Eye" LED screen wraps part of the facade. Inside are two professional auditoria plus a large lobby, a 270-degree riverside viewing platform, VIP rooms, art classrooms, rehearsal rooms, a recording studio, a cinema and an art corridor; a large outdoor car park serves visitors. Programming is aimed at children under 16 and their families, mixing theatre, music, dance and multimedia work from China and abroad. The venue pioneered performances for children under three in 2015, introduced dedicated shows for children with special needs in 2017, and runs the long-term Haixing Zhiyuan (Starfish Wish) arts programme for children with special needs; annual attendance exceeds 100,000. Metro Lines 4 and 8 stop at South Xizang Road, about a fifteen-minute walk away, while Line 13's Expo Museum station and several bus routes serve the surrounding Expo area.

address: 上海市黄浦区南苏州路1247号（新闸路桥与乌镇路桥之间，苏州河南岸）
area_text: 建筑面积2,000余㎡，共三层
intro_zh: 八号桥艺术空间·1908粮仓位于上海市黄浦区南苏州路1247号，夹在新闸路桥与乌镇路桥之间的苏州河南岸，与四行仓库隔河相望。建筑始建于1908年，原为中国通商银行第二仓库，后成为民国时期杜月笙的私家粮仓，百余年里一直作为仓储使用，是苏州河沿岸工业遗产带的典型样本。外立面为红砖清水墙、以青砖嵌饰，仓库的窗与门大量采用木纹形式并配精细细部，屋顶为歇山式；室内地板与立柱裸露粗糙木纹，墙面陈年白灰遮不住砖缝，古朴与前卫并置。2017年，设计师汪昶行在遇到这栋荒废多年的老房子后主持改造，用48天完成修复与功能更新，坚持“修旧如旧”，保留“仓、河、桥、砖、木”五种场地元素，随后以“八号桥艺术空间·1908粮仓”之名重新开放。空间建筑面积2,000多平方米，共三层：一层为互动休闲空间，引入精酿啤酒吧“啤酒阿姨”、体验书店等；二层为文化艺术空间，承接艺术展览与培训；三层为时尚演出空间，可做话剧演出与影视拍摄。运营方八号桥集团同时在此举办展览展示、文化交流、艺术活动、时尚发布与品牌快闪。场馆周二至周日9:30—17:00开放，周一闭馆，地铁1号线新闸路站1号口步行可达，适合中小型展览、品牌发布、影视取景与沙龙。
intro_en: Bridge 8 Art Space · 1908 Granary occupies 1247 Nan Suzhou Road in Huangpu District, on the south bank of Suzhou Creek between Xinzha Road Bridge and Wuzhen Road Bridge, facing the Sihang Warehouse across the water. The building dates from 1908, when it served as the second warehouse of the Chinese Commercial Bank and later as the private granary of the Shanghai magnate Du Yuesheng; it remained in storage use for more than a century and is a textbook piece of the creek's industrial heritage belt. Its facade is fair-faced red brick with grey-brick insets, the warehouse windows and doors are largely timber-grained with fine detailing, and the roof is a hipped, gable-and-hip form; inside, floors and columns show rough grain and old whitewash cannot hide the cracks between bricks, so the archaic and the avant-garde sit together. In 2017 the designer Wang Changxing came across the long-abandoned house and led a 48-day restoration and reprogramming, keeping the fabric as found and preserving the five site elements of warehouse, river, bridge, brick and timber before reopening it as Bridge 8 Art Space. The building has just over 2,000 square metres over three floors: the ground floor is an interactive leisure level with the Beer Lady craft taproom and a bookshop; the second floor is a cultural and art level for exhibitions and training; the third is a performance level for theatre, film and fashion shoots. Operator Bridge 8 Group also runs exhibitions, cultural exchanges, art events, fashion releases and brand pop-ups here. It opens Tuesday to Sunday, 9:30 to 17:00, closed Monday, a short walk from Xinzha Road station on Line 1, and suits small and mid-sized exhibitions, launches, filming and salons.

address: 上海市徐汇区淮海中路1329号云海大厦3层（近宝庆路）
area_text: 约1,800㎡（云海大厦三层整层）
status_note: 2025年1月12日结束云海大厦场地运营并闭店，现仅以promoter身份在沪上其他场地做快闪派对，原址不再作为在营场地
intro_zh: SYSTEM（系统）位于上海市徐汇区淮海中路1329号云海大厦三层，近宝庆路，距地铁1、7、11号线常熟路站步行约五分钟。它2021年10月开业，由郭濮源创办，是上海地下电子乐场景里辨识度最高的空间之一：入口藏在普通办公楼的电梯口，没有任何临街标识，推门进去是一整层约1,800平方米的黑盒子，以techno与house为主，由多个房间组成，不做卡座与香槟服务，票价与门禁政策随当晚阵容变化，观众以设计专业学生、创意行业从业者与本地俱乐部常客为主。除日常派对，SYSTEM也承接跨媒介项目：2021年它与UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心合作“唤醒巴特西”上海站，把来自陈维、丰江舟、王长存、徐程、殷漪等的十位声音艺术家作品放进俱乐部空间，观众在舞池与装置之间穿行。2025年1月12日，SYSTEM以“testing complete”为告别语结束了在云海大厦的最后一场活动，场馆随之关闭；创办人向NOWNESS解释，市中心1,800平方米空间的租金成本与夜间消费的下滑是主因。此后SYSTEM转为promoter身份，在上海其他场地做快闪派对，2026年仍在巨鹿路一带的地下空间举办三房间活动。对活动方而言，这个地址记录的是2021至2025年间上海最具代表性的地下音乐空间样本，现状需按promoter档期另行确认。
intro_en: SYSTEM occupied the third floor of Yunhai Mansion at 1329 Huaihai Middle Road in Xuhui District, near Baoqing Road and about a five-minute walk from Changshu Road station on metro lines 1, 7 and 11. Opening in October 2021 and founded by Guo Puyuan, it became one of the most recognisable rooms in Shanghai's underground electronic scene: the entrance sat at an ordinary office lift lobby with no street signage, and inside was a roughly 1,800 square metre black box of several rooms, built around techno and house rather than table service, with door policy and pricing set by each night's line-up. Its crowd mixed design students, creative-industry workers and regulars of the local club circuit. Beyond parties, SYSTEM hosted cross-disciplinary projects: in 2021 it partnered with UCCA Center for Contemporary Art on the Shanghai edition of 'Wakening Battersea', placing sound works by Chen Wei, Feng Jiangzhou, Wang Changcun, Xu Cheng, Yin Yi and others inside the club so that visitors moved between dance floor and installation. On 12 January 2025 SYSTEM closed the venue with the sign-off 'testing complete'; its founder told NOWNESS that the cost of an 1,800 square metre space in central Shanghai, against falling nightlife spending, drove the decision. SYSTEM continues as a promoter, running pop-up parties at other addresses, including three-room events in the Julu Road basement cluster in 2026. For event planners, this address documents the defining underground music venue of Shanghai between 2021 and 2025; current availability must be confirmed through the promoter's schedule.

address: 上海市徐汇区龙腾大道2555号（近丰谷路）
area_text: 总建筑面积约10,800㎡；主展厅约8,000㎡大空间（A馆）
intro_zh: 西岸艺术中心位于上海市徐汇区龙腾大道2555号，处在黄浦江西岸“西岸文化走廊”的核心段，与龙美术馆、油罐艺术中心、西岸美术馆等共同构成上海当代艺术机构密度最高的滨水片区之一。A馆前身为上海飞机制造厂冲压车间，2014年由大舍建筑设计事务所柳亦春主持改造，总建筑面积约1.08万平方米；设计保留厂房原有的大跨度工业空间与屋架尺度，把设备与辅助用房收进夹层，主展厅形成约8,000平方米、可灵活划分的大空间，适合大型艺博会、装置作品与品牌发布。2014年9月首届西岸艺术与设计博览会在此举办，此后这里长期作为该博览会的主场馆之一，也承接时尚、科技、设计类活动与商业租赁。场馆由A、B两馆组成，可整馆或分馆使用，室外广场与滨江绿地可延展做公共艺术、排队集散和户外活动。交通方面，地铁11号线云锦路站步行约10分钟，公交734、933、1222路至云锦路丰谷路站步行约5分钟；场馆北侧为西岸文化艺术示范区（龙腾大道2555号园区），适合与龙美术馆、油罐艺术中心串成半日观展动线。
intro_en: West Bund Art Center occupies 2555 Longteng Avenue in Xuhui District, at the heart of Shanghai's West Bund cultural corridor on the west bank of the Huangpu River. Together with the Long Museum, Tank Shanghai and the West Bund Museum, it anchors one of the densest clusters of contemporary art institutions in the city. Its Hall A began life as the stamping workshop of the Shanghai Aircraft Manufacturing Factory and was converted in 2014 by Liu Yichun of Atelier Deshaus. The 10,800-square-metre building keeps the original long-span industrial shell and roof structure, tucking plant and support rooms into mezzanines so that the main gallery reads as a roughly 8,000-square-metre hall that can be subdivided for art fairs, large installations and brand launches. In September 2014 the first West Bund Art & Design fair opened here, and the venue has remained one of the fair's principal homes while also hosting fashion, technology and design events and commercial rentals. The complex comprises Halls A and B, which can be booked together or separately, with an outdoor plaza and riverside lawn available for public art, queueing and open-air programming. Transport is straightforward: Metro Line 11 to Yunjin Road station, about a ten-minute walk, or buses 734, 933 and 1222 to Yunjin Road/Fenggu Road, about five minutes on foot. The West Bund culture and art demonstration district lies immediately north, making the centre an easy stop on a half-day route with the Long Museum and Tank Shanghai.

address: 上海市徐汇区龙腾大道2380号
intro_zh: 上海油罐艺术中心（Tank Shanghai）位于徐汇区龙腾大道2380号，坐落在黄浦江西岸、中国最早的机场——龙华机场原址，是西岸滨江艺术带中辨识度最高的工业遗存改造项目之一。项目由OPEN建筑事务所李虎、黄文菁主持设计，2013年至2019年完成，2019年3月23日正式对公众开放。基地上五个废弃航油罐被一条Z字形“超级地面”连接：地面之上是起伏草坡与两个广场、一片都市森林，地面之下是连通的室内展览与服务空间；五个罐体分别被改造为一个音乐表演空间、一个餐厅和三个尺度各异的展厅，总建筑面积10,845平方米，用地47,448平方米。油罐原有的圆形混凝土壳体被最大限度保留，新功能以轻介入方式置入，形成“公园+美术馆”的开放格局，观众可以在草坪、水景与展厅之间自由穿行。开馆展包括teamLab《油罐中的水粒子世界》与阿德里安·比利亚尔·罗哈斯个展，此后持续呈现国际当代艺术项目。交通方面，地铁11号线龙耀路站步行约5分钟，公交1222路至云锦路龙耀路站步行约5分钟；周边可与西岸艺术中心、龙美术馆、西岸美术馆串联参观。
intro_en: Tank Shanghai sits at 2380 Longteng Avenue in Xuhui District, on the west bank of the Huangpu River and on the site of Longhua Airport, China's earliest airfield. Five disused aviation fuel tanks were kept and reworked by OPEN Architecture, led by Li Hu and Huang Wenjing, between 2013 and 2019; the centre opened to the public on 23 March 2019. A Z-shaped 'Super-Surface' links the tanks: above it rise grassy slopes, two open plazas and a pocket urban forest, while below it run connected indoor exhibition and service spaces. The five cylinders were assigned different roles, becoming a music performance space, a restaurant and three galleries of contrasting character. The total building area is 10,845 square metres on a 47,448-square-metre site, and the original circular concrete shells were retained wherever possible, with new functions inserted lightly to create an open 'park plus museum' arrangement in which visitors move freely between lawn, water, trees and galleries. The opening programme included teamLab's 'Water Particles in the Tank' and a solo exhibition by Adrián Villar Rojas, and the venue has continued to stage international contemporary art. Metro Line 11 to Longyao Road station is about a five-minute walk away, and bus 1222 stops at Yunjin Road/Longyao Road, also roughly five minutes on foot. The centre pairs naturally with the West Bund Art Center, the Long Museum and the West Bund Museum for a full day along the river.

address: 上海市黄浦区淮海中路300号
area_text: 商场部分约40,000㎡（地下三层至地上六层）；chi K11美术馆约3,000㎡；塔楼总建筑面积136,833㎡
intro_zh: 上海K11购物艺术中心位于黄浦区淮海中路300号，地处淮海中路—新天地商圈，是内地较早把“购物+艺术”做成固定运营模式的商业体。项目由新世界发展打造，2013年6月28日正式开业，商场部分为地下三层至地上六层、面积约4万平方米，其上为高278.3米、59层的香港新世界大厦（1998—2004年建成，B+H事务所设计），塔楼总建筑面积136,833平方米。K11的核心艺术空间是位于地下三层的chi K11美术馆，约3,000平方米，另在商场各层散布当代艺术装置与“艺术村”式展示空间，形成“看展—购物—餐饮”一体化动线；2014年莫奈特展在此举办，截至5月中旬观展人数已超过26万人次，主办方预计展期结束可达40万，成为国内商业空间办大展的样本。建筑本身是既有写字楼裙房的整体改造，立面以金色塔楼与流线玻璃顶棚为标志，商场内部空间适合品牌快闪、发布与艺术装置。交通方面，地铁1号线一大会址·黄陂南路站2号口、13号线淮海中路站均可步行到达，周边公交线路密集，地处上海核心商圈，夜间与周末人流稳定。
intro_en: Shanghai K11 Art Mall stands at 300 Middle Huaihai Road in Huangpu District, in the Huaihai Road–Xintiandi retail district, and was an early mainland complex to make 'retail plus art' a permanent operating model. Developed by New World Development, it opened on 28 June 2013. The mall occupies three basement and six above-ground levels, with roughly 40,000 square metres of retail space, and sits beneath the 278.3-metre, 59-storey Hong Kong New World Tower, completed between 1998 and 2004 to a design by B+H Architects; the tower's total floor area is 136,833 square metres. K11's artistic core is the chi K11 art museum on basement level three, about 3,000 square metres, supplemented by contemporary installations and art-village display areas scattered through the shopping floors, so that exhibitions, retail and dining form a single route. Its 2014 Monet exhibition had drawn more than 260,000 visitors by mid-May, with organisers projecting 400,000 by the close, and became a reference case for staging major art shows inside commercial space. The building is a comprehensive reworking of an existing office podium, marked by the golden tower and a streamlined glass canopy, whose interior suits brand pop-ups, launches and installations. Metro Line 1 to the Site of the First CPC Congress·Huangpi South Road station (Exit 2) or Line 13 to Middle Huaihai Road station puts visitors at the door, and dense bus routes serve the surrounding commercial core, which stays busy at weekends and in the evening.

address: 上海市徐汇区龙腾大道2350号（龙腾大道龙耀路口）
area_text: 建筑面积8,949㎡；活动容量约2,500人
intro_zh: 西岸穹顶艺术中心位于徐汇区龙腾大道2350号、龙腾大道与龙耀路交汇处，处在西岸梦中心片区，是西岸滨江“美术馆大道”上的新节点。其前身是始建于1920年的上海水泥厂预均化库——当年库内有一台昼夜运转的机器，把石灰石与矿料混合成化学成分稳定的生料；水泥厂2009年停产后，这座带有钢筋穹顶的圆形工业构筑物被保留下来，由丹麦Schmidt Hammer Lassen（SHL）建筑事务所与华建集团上海院合作改造，2023年9月正式对外开放，建筑面积8,949平方米。改造保留了极具辨识度的穹顶构架与圆形平面，室内形成圆形、可灵活布置的大空间，可容纳约2,500人，适合艺术展览、音乐会、舞剧、体育赛事与品牌活动；自开放以来，这里做过上海城市空间艺术季开幕式、第十届西岸艺术与设计博览会主场馆之一，以及沈伟的浸入式作品《融》。它与相邻的西岸大剧院共同构成原水泥厂片区的“双剧院”，把工业锈带转成可全天候使用的文化街区。交通方面，地铁11号线龙耀路站或云锦路站步行可达，西岸滨江内部有滨江1路、1222路等公交与连续步道串联。
intro_en: West Bund Dome Art Center stands at 2350 Longteng Avenue, at the corner of Longyao Road in Xuhui District, within the West Bund Dream Center and on the riverside 'museum avenue'. Its shell is the pre-homogenisation dome of the Shanghai Cement Plant, founded in 1920, where a machine once rotated day and night to blend limestone and minerals into a chemically stable raw meal. After the plant closed in 2009 the circular structure with its reinforced-concrete dome was kept, and Danish practice Schmidt Hammer Lassen, working with Huajian Group Shanghai Institute, converted it into a performing and exhibition venue that opened in September 2023. The 8,949-square-metre building retains the dome frame and circular plan, producing a flexible interior that can be configured for around 2,500 people and used for exhibitions, concerts, dance, sports events and brand activations. Since opening it has hosted the launch of the Shanghai Urban Space Art Season, served as one of the main venues of the tenth West Bund Art & Design fair, and provided the setting for Shen Wei's immersive work 'Rong'. Together with the neighbouring West Bund Grand Theatre it forms a twin-theatre cluster on the former cement works site, turning an industrial riverbank into an all-weather cultural district. Metro Line 11 to Longyao Road or Yunjin Road is within walking distance, and riverside buses and a continuous promenade connect the site to the rest of West Bund.

address: 上海市浦东新区滨江大道1777号（近即墨路）
intro_zh: 1862时尚艺术中心位于浦东新区滨江大道1777号、陆家嘴滨江东岸，前身是始建于1862年的上海船厂（祥生船厂）造机车间，是中国近代造船工业的重要遗存。2005年船厂整体搬离后，这座紧邻黄浦江的老厂房被保留，2014年10月起由日本建筑师隈研吾主持改造，2017年竣工，2018年5月以“船厂1862”综合体对外开放：总规模约2.6万平方米，东翼为800座的中型剧场，西翼是约1.6万平方米的沉浸式艺术商业空间，中间以贯通五层的采光中庭串联。改造坚持“修旧如旧”，保留锈蚀铁管、风化混凝土柱、砖墙与生产标语，同时置入伸缩式活动座椅、升降舞台和面向江面的电动玻璃隔音门，观众在看戏时能直接望见黄浦江船行。剧场以先锋戏剧、驻场演出、室内乐、现代舞、时尚发布与艺术展览为主，曾长期驻演《法医秦明—尸语者》，并推出“1B62星球”原创孵化厂牌。交通方面，地铁4号线或14号线浦东大道站步行约10分钟，公交85、779、774路至银城路日照路站；滨江步道可步行连接陆家嘴与民生码头。
intro_en: 1862 Fashion Art Center stands at 1777 Binjiang Avenue in Pudong New Area, on the east bank of the Huangpu in Lujiazui, in the machine workshop of the Shanghai Shipyard founded in 1862. The yard, one of the birthplaces of modern Chinese shipbuilding, moved out in 2005 and the riverside workshop was retained; from October 2014 it was converted by Japanese architect Kengo Kuma, completed in 2017 and opened in May 2018 as the Shipyard 1862 complex. The scheme totals about 26,000 square metres: the east wing holds an 800-seat mid-sized theatre, the west wing about 16,000 square metres of immersive art-and-retail space, and a five-storey daylit atrium links the two. The renovation follows a 'repair as found' approach, keeping rusted pipes, weathered concrete columns, brick walls and surviving production slogans while inserting retractable seating, a lift stage and motorised glass acoustic doors that open onto the river, so audiences can watch the barges pass during a performance. Programming centres on avant-garde theatre, long-run shows, chamber music, contemporary dance, fashion launches and exhibitions; the venue hosted a long run of 'Forensic Qin Ming: The Bone Whisperer' and launched the '1B62 Planet' original-work incubator. Metro Lines 4 and 14 to Pudong Avenue station are about a ten-minute walk away, buses 85, 779 and 774 stop at Yincheng Road/Rizhao Road, and the riverside promenade connects the site with Lujiazui and Minsheng Wharf.

address: 上海市黄浦区苗江路678号
area_text: 建筑面积约41,200㎡；展厅面积15,000㎡，12个展厅
intro_zh: 上海当代艺术博物馆（PSA）位于黄浦区苗江路678号、黄浦江畔的原南市发电厂地块，2012年10月1日开馆，是中国大陆第一家国有当代艺术博物馆，也是上海双年展的永久主场馆。建筑由始建于1897年的南市发电厂主厂房改造而来，2010年上海世博会期间曾作为“城市未来馆”；改造后建筑面积由31,088平方米增至约41,200平方米，展厅面积1.5万平方米，共12个展厅，主厂房长128米、宽70米、高50米，内部最高悬挑达27米，165米高的钢筋混凝土烟囱被完整保留，既是城市地标，也被用作独立展览空间。PSA以“生产车间”自居，聚焦中国与国际当代艺术的展览、研究、收藏与公共教育，除双年展外还设“青年策展人计划”、psD设计中心与儿童艺术教育项目；场馆一层设售票大厅与服务空间，顶层与江边平台可看浦东天际线。交通方面，地铁4号线、8号线西藏南路站2号口步行约15分钟，周边有花园港路、苗江路公交站，滨江步道可连通当代艺术博物馆与世博园区。
intro_en: The Power Station of Art (PSA) occupies 678 Miaojiang Road in Huangpu District, on the Huangpu River, in the converted main hall of the former Nanshi Power Plant. It opened on 1 October 2012 as the first state-run contemporary art museum in mainland China and serves as the permanent home of the Shanghai Biennale. The plant dates from 1897 and was used as the Urban Future Pavilion during Expo 2010; after conversion the floor area rose from 31,088 to about 41,200 square metres, with 15,000 square metres of galleries across 12 halls. The main building measures 128 metres long, 70 metres wide and 50 metres high, with a maximum internal cantilever of 27 metres, and the 165-metre reinforced-concrete chimney has been kept intact as both a city landmark and a standalone exhibition space. PSA describes itself as a 'production workshop', concentrating on exhibitions, research, collecting and public programmes in Chinese and international contemporary art; beyond the biennale it runs the Emerging Curators Project, the psD design centre and children's art education. The ground floor holds the ticket hall and visitor services, while upper terraces and the riverside deck frame views of the Pudong skyline. Metro Lines 4 and 8 to Xizang South Road (Exit 2) are about a 15-minute walk, local buses serve Huayuangang Road and Miaojiang Road, and the riverside promenade links the museum with the Expo site.

address: 上海市黄浦区中山东二路600号（BFC外滩金融中心）
area_text: 地上四层、地下三层；展厅面积约1,330㎡（一层360㎡、二层570㎡、三层400㎡），四层为观景露台
intro_zh: 复星艺术中心位于黄浦区中山东二路600号的外滩金融中心（BFC），处在外滩建筑群南端、老城厢东侧，是外滩滨江带里少见的当代艺术机构。建筑由英国福斯特建筑事务所（Foster + Partners）与 Heatherwick Studio 联合设计，2016年10月完工、同年年底开馆，地上四层、地下三层。它最著名的特征是三层金色可转动帘幕：675根独立金属“流苏”分挂三条轨道，单根长2至16米，每天按整点、每隔两小时随音乐移动，立面在开合之间改变透明度，被称为“会跳舞的房子”。馆内一层360平方米、二层570平方米、三层400平方米的展厅合计约1,330平方米，二层挑高6.5米，适合大型装置；四层为观景露台，设有宫岛达男永久公共艺术《数字空中花园》，300盏LED灯按300位上海居民的故事闪烁。运营上偏向当代、国际、强互动的展览，兼做讲座、放映、工作坊、品牌发布与小剧场演出。艺术中心也把部分项目延伸到馆外的外滩与老城厢公共空间，参与举办外滩艺术季等城市艺术活动。交通方面，地铁9号线小南门站3号口，或10号线、14号线豫园站1号口/7号口步行可达，公交33、55、64、65、147、736路可到。
intro_en: Fosun Foundation (Shanghai) occupies 600 East Zhongshan No. 2 Road in Huangpu District, inside the Bund Finance Center at the southern end of the Bund and east of the old Chinese city. It is one of the few contemporary art institutions on the Bund waterfront. The building was designed jointly by Foster + Partners and Heatherwick Studio, completed in October 2016 and opened at the end of that year, with four levels above ground and three below. Its signature is a golden, movable curtain on the third floor: 675 separate metal tassels run on three tracks, each between two and sixteen metres long, shifting with music every two hours on the hour so that the facade opens, closes and changes transparency — hence the nickname 'the dancing building'. Inside, galleries of 360 square metres on level one, 570 on level two and 400 on level three total about 1,330 square metres, with a 6.5-metre ceiling on the second floor that suits large installations. The fourth floor is a viewing terrace holding Tatsuo Miyajima's permanent public work 'Counter Sky Garden', 300 LED counters pulsing according to the stories of 300 Shanghai residents. Programming leans towards contemporary, international and highly interactive exhibitions, alongside talks, screenings, workshops, brand events and small performances. Metro Line 9 to Xiaonanmen (Exit 3), or Lines 10 and 14 to Yuyuan Garden (Exits 1 and 7), are within walking distance; buses 33, 55, 64, 65, 147 and 736 also stop nearby.

address: 上海市浦东新区滨江大道4777号（近浦电路浦明路口）
area_text: 建筑面积近7,000㎡；5个展厅
intro_zh: 艺仓美术馆（Modern Art Museum Shanghai）位于浦东新区滨江大道4777号，坐落在黄浦江东岸的老白渡煤运码头，前身是20世纪80年代建造的煤仓。2015年第一届上海城市空间艺术季曾把这里作为案例展分展场，以“重新装载”为题让业界看到煤仓粗粝空间与展览结合的可能，随后由大舍建筑设计事务所柳亦春与同济大学建筑设计研究院合作改造，2016年正式开馆。美术馆建筑面积近7,000平方米，共5个展厅，保留了煤仓的高大尺度与工业结构痕迹，并配套艺术商店、咖啡馆、酒吧和天台；主楼之外，沿江向北1.2公里还有15个长廊单元和一条高架步道，原是运煤通道，现作为“艺仓快闪魔盒”等灵活展演空间。定位上强调“多元、开放、交流、学习”，兼顾东西方经典艺术、现代设计与生活美学、新科技与多元媒体，并以“艺术在发生”为理念做公共教育；2019年起被评为浦东夜间经济示范点，每周五晚举办“艺仓音乐夜”。交通方面，地铁4号线塘桥站4号口步行约15分钟，公交795、1019路至浦电路站，或01、82、314、607、789、818、981、985、992路至浦东南路浦电路站。
intro_en: Modern Art Museum Shanghai (MAM) stands at 4777 Binjiang Avenue in Pudong New Area, on the east bank of the Huangpu at the old Laobaidu coal wharf, in a coal bunker built in the 1980s. The first Shanghai Urban Space Art Season used the partly dismantled bunker in 2015 as a case-study venue, with an exhibition titled 'Reload' that demonstrated how its rough industrial spaces could hold art; Atelier Deshaus (Liu Yichun) then worked with Tongji Architectural Design Group on the conversion, and the museum opened in 2016. The building offers close to 7,000 square metres across five galleries, retaining the bunker's tall volumes and industrial structure, and is completed by an art shop, café, bar and roof terrace. Beyond the main block, 15 corridor units and an elevated walkway run 1.2 kilometres north along the river — formerly the coal route and now used as flexible pop-up exhibition and performance spaces. The programme stresses diversity, openness, exchange and learning, spanning classical and contemporary art from East and West, modern design and everyday aesthetics, and new technology and media, with public education organised under the idea that 'art is happening'. It has been a Pudong night-economy demonstration site since 2019 and hosts a Friday-evening music night. Metro Line 4 to Tangqiao (Exit 4) is about a 15-minute walk; buses 795 and 1019 stop at Pudian Road, and routes 01, 82, 314, 607, 789, 818, 981, 985 and 992 serve Pudong South Road/Pudian Road.

address: 上海市静安区光复路127号（四行仓库光三分库/百空间）
area_text: 建筑面积4,637㎡
intro_zh: Fotografiska影像艺术中心位于静安区光复路127号、苏州河北岸的苏河湾片区，毗邻四行仓库，是瑞典摄影博物馆Fotografiska在亚洲的第一家、也是其全球第五家分馆，2023年10月21日正式开放。场馆由始建于1931年的四行仓库光三分库（百空间）改造而成：这幢三层砖混框架建筑原为福康、福源钱庄及仓库，后成为金城、中南、大陆、盐业四家银行的联合仓库，即四行仓库的“分库”，立面为现代主义风格并带简洁Art Deco装饰，历经“四行仓库保卫战”炮火，2015年被列入上海市第五批优秀历史建筑，2019年启动修缮。改造由AIM Architecture（Wendy Saunders、Vincent de Graaf）负责室内与外立面设计，建筑面积4,637平方米，保留巨大黑色铁门、平缓坡道与面向苏州河的落地玻璃，展览分布于二、三层，另设咖啡馆、冰淇淋店、露天酒吧和餐厅，营业至深夜。定位上以影像艺术为核心、强调社交与夜经济，开馆展汇集爱德华·伯汀斯基、冯立、范西、杨嘉辉四位艺术家。交通方面，地铁8号线、12号线曲阜路站步行约3分钟，1号线新闸路站1号口步行约370米。
intro_en: Fotografiska Shanghai occupies 127 Guangfu Road in Jing'an District, on the north bank of the Suzhou River in the Suhe Bay area beside the Sihang Warehouse. It is the first Asian outpost and fifth global venue of the Swedish photography museum, opened on 21 October 2023. The building is the Guang Third Warehouse of the Sihang group, built in 1931 and now part of the Bai Space creative cluster: a three-storey brick-and-concrete frame structure that originally housed the Fukang and Fuyuan qianzhuang banks and warehouses and later served as the joint warehouse of the Jincheng, Zhongnan, Dalu and Yanye banks — a subsidiary depot to the Sihang Warehouse across the road. Its facade is modernist with restrained Art Deco detail; it survived the 1937 Battle of Sihang Warehouse, was listed among Shanghai's fifth batch of outstanding historic buildings in 2015, and restoration began in 2019. AIM Architecture (Wendy Saunders and Vincent de Graaf) designed the interior and facade, keeping the huge black iron doors, gentle ramps and floor-to-ceiling glass facing the river. The 4,637-square-metre venue places galleries on the second and third floors and adds a café, ice-cream counter, open-air bar and restaurant, staying open late. Its programme centres on photography while emphasising social use and night-time activity; the opening shows featured Edward Burtynsky, Feng Li, Fan Xi and Samson Young. Metro Lines 8 and 12 to Qufu Road are about three minutes on foot, and Line 1 to Xinzha Road (Exit 1) about 370 metres.

address: 上海市浦东新区滨江大道2777号（富城路近明珠塔路口进）
area_text: 总建筑面积40,000㎡；可展览面积超过10,000㎡，13个固定展厅及开放式展厅
intro_zh: 浦东美术馆（MAP）位于浦东新区滨江大道2777号，处在小陆家嘴滨江核心区、东方明珠塔脚下，与隔江的外滩万国建筑群相对，是陆家嘴集团投资、建设并运营的公共美术馆。项目2017年9月26日启动建设，由法国让·努维尔事务所（AJN）设计，2021年7月8日正式向公众开放；占地1.3万平方米，总建筑面积4万平方米，设13个固定展厅及开放式展厅，可展览面积超过1万平方米，可同时容纳三到四个大型展览，并配置6个不同尺寸的藏品库和全馆24小时恒温恒湿系统。建筑体量沿江展开，展厅与公共空间交替布置，多处可眺望黄浦江与外滩。开馆之年即与泰特美术馆、米罗美术馆及蔡国强合作推出“光：泰特美术馆珍藏展”“蔡国强：远行与归来”“胡安·米罗：女人·小鸟·星星”等大展，定位为国际艺术展示交流为主、兼顾国内艺术，突出展览、美育、文创、国际交流四大功能。交通方面，地铁2号线陆家嘴站2号口出站步行可达；馆内不设停车场，可停富都滨江、上海国际会议中心或正大广场停车场。
intro_en: Museum of Art Pudong (MAP) stands at 2777 Binjiang Avenue in Pudong New Area, in the core riverside area of small Lujiazui at the foot of the Oriental Pearl Tower, facing the Bund's historic waterfront across the river. It was invested in, built and is operated by Lujiazui Group, with construction starting on 26 September 2017 to a design by Ateliers Jean Nouvel and opening to the public on 8 July 2021. The site covers 13,000 square metres and the total floor area is 40,000 square metres, containing 13 permanent galleries plus open-plan display areas; more than 10,000 square metres can be used for exhibitions, allowing three or four large shows at once, supported by six storage rooms of different sizes and a 24-hour temperature-and-humidity control system throughout. Public spaces alternate with the galleries and repeatedly open onto the Huangpu and the Bund. In its opening year MAP worked with Tate, the Joan Miró Foundation and Cai Guo-Qiang on 'Light: Works from Tate's Collection', 'Cai Guo-Qiang: Odyssey and Homecoming' and 'Joan Miró: Women, Birds, Stars', positioning itself primarily for international exchange while also showing Chinese art, with exhibition, education, cultural products and international dialogue as its four functions. Metro Line 2 to Lujiazui (Exit 2) is a short walk away; there is no on-site parking, but Fudu Riverside, Shanghai International Convention Centre and Super Brand Mall car parks are nearby.

address: 上海市黄浦区南京西路231号人民公园内（7号门）
area_text: 总建筑面积约4,000㎡；一、二层展厅合计约1,800㎡
intro_zh: 上海当代艺术馆（MoCA Shanghai）位于黄浦区南京西路231号人民公园7号门内，处在上海博物馆、上海大剧院、上海市政厅与城市规划展示馆围合的市中心文化区，2005年开馆，是中国最早的独立非营利当代艺术机构之一。场馆由龚明光基金会出资两千多万元建造，建筑原为人民公园内的一座玻璃花房，经建筑师刘宇扬改造为玻璃盒子式的艺术馆，总面积约4,000平方米；一层与二层展厅合计近1,800平方米，配备恒温恒湿系统，二层保留原玻璃花房结构并可看到公园景观，另设可容纳约80人的多功能厅，三层为MoCA on the Park艺术空间与餐厅。MoCA以“艺术生活化”为方向，早期以时尚品牌大展著称（如梵克雅宝、菲拉格慕、香奈儿、迪奥等），后拓展至当代艺术、设计与科技交叉项目，2007年创办动漫美学双年展，并设MoCA Pavilion与“无墙美术馆”社区公共项目。交通方面，地铁1、2、8号线人民广场站步行可达，公交18、20、37、46、49、123、201、531、574、921路至人民广场站或西藏中路站。
intro_en: Museum of Contemporary Art Shanghai (MoCA) sits inside Gate 7 of People's Park at 231 West Nanjing Road, Huangpu District, within the downtown cultural quarter formed by the Shanghai Museum, Shanghai Grand Theatre, the former Municipal Council building and the Urban Planning Exhibition Centre. Opened in 2005, it is one of China's earliest independent non-profit contemporary art institutions. The Gong Mingguang Foundation funded its construction with more than 20 million yuan, converting a glass greenhouse in the park into a glass-box museum under architect Liu Yuyang. The total area is about 4,000 square metres, with roughly 1,800 square metres of galleries on the first and second floors served by temperature and humidity control; the second floor retains the original greenhouse structure and looks out into the park, and there is a multi-function room for about 80 people plus MoCA on the Park and a restaurant on the third floor. MoCA has pursued 'art into life', becoming known for major fashion-brand exhibitions (Van Cleef & Arpels, Salvatore Ferragamo, Chanel, Dior) before widening into contemporary art, design and technology crossovers; it founded the Animamix Biennial in 2007 and runs MoCA Pavilion and 'museum without walls' community programmes. Metro Lines 1, 2 and 8 to People's Square are within walking distance, and buses 18, 20, 37, 46, 49, 123, 201, 531, 574 and 921 serve People's Square and Xizang Middle Road.

address: 上海市闵行区漕宝路3055号（漕宝路与新镇路东南交口）
intro_zh: 宝龙美术馆位于闵行区漕宝路3055号、漕宝路与新镇路东南交口，是宝龙集团创办的民营非营利美术馆，2017年11月18日正式开馆。场馆占地面积2.3万平方米，拥有500至1,100平方米的大小展厅共十个：其中三个为馆藏精品常设展厅，系统展示中国近百年各地区、各流派的代表性艺术家作品；另外七个为临时展厅，含四个博物馆级国际标准的恒温恒湿展厅，现当代艺术展场挑高5至9米，可满足不同体量与形式的展览。馆内另设可容纳近两百人的演出厅、大小会议室、开放性讲坛、多功能厅、艺术商店、咖啡厅与艺术餐厅，适合学术论坛、小型演出、品牌发布与教育项目。定位上兼顾传统与现代、东方与西方，强调学术研究、公共教育与会员服务，是上海西南片区规模最大的民营美术馆之一。交通方面，地铁9号线七宝站、10号线航中路站均可换乘公交或步行到达，公交92、92路b线、186、198、709、735路至漕宝路新镇路站；自驾可停宝龙艾美酒店或七宝宝龙城停车场。
intro_en: Powerlong Museum stands at 3055 Caobao Road in Minhang District, at the south-east corner of Caobao Road and Xinzhen Road. Founded by the Powerlong Group as a private, non-profit museum, it opened on 18 November 2017. The site covers 23,000 square metres and contains ten galleries ranging from 500 to 1,100 square metres. Three are permanent collection galleries showing representative artists from different regions and schools of the past century of Chinese art; the other seven are temporary spaces, four of them museum-grade climate-controlled rooms, with clear heights of five to nine metres that accommodate widely different scales and formats. There is also an auditorium for nearly 200 people, meeting rooms of various sizes, an open lecture forum, a multi-function hall, an art shop, café and art restaurant, making the building suitable for academic forums, small performances, brand launches and education programmes. Its programme spans tradition and modernity, East and West, with an emphasis on research, public education and membership services, and it is one of the largest private museums in south-west Shanghai. Metro Line 9 to Qibao or Line 10 to Hangzhong Road connects by bus or on foot; buses 92, 92B, 186, 198, 709 and 735 stop at Caobao Road/Xinzhen Road, and drivers can use the Le Méridien or Qibao Powerlong City car parks.

address: 广东省佛山市顺德区北滘新城怡兴路6号
area_text: 总建筑面积约1.6万㎡，展厅面积约8000㎡
intro_zh: 和美术馆（HEM）位于广东省佛山市顺德区北滘新城怡兴路6号，由美的集团何氏家族发起创办、和的慈善基金会提供运营资金，是一座非营利民营美术馆，2020年10月试运营开放。建筑由日本建筑师、普利兹克奖得主安藤忠雄设计，总面积约1.6万平方米，展厅面积约8000平方米，以清水混凝土、光、水、风为基本语汇，把“天圆地方”的几何关系转译为叠加的圆形体量：中庭核心筒五层挑空，世界首座清水混凝土双螺旋楼梯盘旋而下，顶部天窗的自然光沿阶梯移动，是馆内最具辨识度的空间。馆藏逾800件，涵盖中国近现代与西方现当代艺术，展览通过合作邀请、自主选题与外部引进三种方式组织，并按作品定制空间。开馆展为“世间风物”，此后举办“超越：安藤忠雄的艺术人生”、贝纳·维内“单义游戏”、罗尼·霍恩“非梦亦梦”等。美术馆位于粤港澳大湾区腹地的北滘新城，紧邻美的总部，地铁7号线美的站可达，适合大型当代艺术展、品牌发布、晚宴与跨界合作；开放时间周二至周日10:00-18:00（17:30停止入场），周一闭馆。
intro_en: He Art Museum (HEM) stands at 6 Yixing Road, Beijiao New Town, Shunde District, Foshan, Guangdong. Initiated by the He family behind Midea Group and funded for operations by the He Foundation, it is a non-profit private museum that opened in October 2020. The building was designed by Japanese architect and Pritzker laureate Tadao Ando and covers about 16,000 square metres, with roughly 8,000 square metres of galleries. Fair-faced concrete, light, water and air are its basic vocabulary, and the classical “round heaven, square earth” geometry is translated into stacked circular volumes: the five-storey atrium is hollowed out, with the world’s first fair-faced concrete double-helix staircase spiralling down it, and daylight from the oculus travels across the steps, making it the museum’s most recognisable space. The collection of more than 800 works spans modern and contemporary Chinese art and Western modern and contemporary art; exhibitions are developed through invitations, in-house research and external touring, with each show tailored to the architecture. Its opening exhibition was “Things of the World”, followed by “Beyond: Tadao Ando’s Art Life”, Bernar Venet’s “Single-Meaning Game” and Roni Horn’s “a dream dreamt in a dream”. Located in Beijiao New Town at the heart of the Greater Bay Area beside Midea’s headquarters and reachable from Midea station on metro line 7, it suits large contemporary exhibitions, brand launches, dinners and cross-sector collaborations; open Tuesday to Sunday 10:00-18:00, last entry 17:30, closed Mondays; telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 北京市朝阳区酒仙桥路4号798艺术区
intro_zh: UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心位于北京市朝阳区酒仙桥路4号798艺术区核心地带，主馆设在1950年代国营第七九八厂的老厂房中，厂房由德绍设计学院（原包豪斯）的东德建筑师设计。2007年，建筑由让-米歇尔·维勒莫特与马清运全面翻新，保留工业痕迹；2019年再由荷兰OMA重新设计，完成空间升级。主馆占地约一万平方米，除标志性大展厅外还有多个大小不一的展厅、一间报告厅，以及用于教育、学术与聚会的公共空间。UCCA于2007年开馆，开馆展为“’85新潮：中国第一次当代艺术运动”，由费大为策划，被视为国内首个系统梳理中国前卫艺术的机构展览；此后举办超过200场展览，包括“中坚”“ON|OFF”“例外状态”等群展，以及曹斐、黄永砅、耿建翌等艺术家的个展。2017年机构完成重组，2018年获北京市文化局认证的非营利美术馆资质。除北京主馆外，UCCA还运营北戴河沙丘美术馆与宜兴陶美术馆，形成跨城市的馆群网络。
intro_en: UCCA Center for Contemporary Art stands at No. 4 Jiuxianqiao Road in the 798 Art District, Chaoyang District, Beijing. Its main building is a 1950s factory hall of the former State-run 798 Factory, designed by East German architects from the Dessau school that had been the Bauhaus. In 2007 the building was comprehensively renovated by Jean-Michel Wilmotte and Ma Qingyun, keeping traces of its industrial past; in 2019 OMA redesigned the interiors and upgraded the entire space. The main venue covers about 10,000 square metres and contains a signature large gallery, several smaller halls, a lecture theatre and public spaces for education, research and gatherings. UCCA opened in 2007 with "'85 New Wave: The Birth of Chinese Contemporary Art", curated by Fei Dawei, now regarded as the first museum exhibition to survey China's avant-garde. It has since staged more than 200 exhibitions, including group shows such as "Breaking Forecast", "ON | OFF" and "The New Normal", and solo shows by Cao Fei, Huang Yong Ping and Geng Jianyi. The institution was restructured in 2017 with an international board and received non-profit art museum status from the Beijing Cultural Bureau in 2018. UCCA also operates the UCCA Dune museum in Beidaihe and UCCA Clay in Yixing, forming a multi-city network.

address: 北京市朝阳区酒仙桥路2号798艺术区D-06
area_text: 空间总面积逾2,500㎡，主体建筑3层
intro_zh: 木木美术馆798馆位于北京市朝阳区酒仙桥路2号798艺术区D-06，坐落在798艺术区核心区域，建筑前身为1950年代的军工厂厂房。美术馆由收藏家林瀚、雷宛萤（晚晚）夫妇于2014年共同创立，主体建筑共3层，包含展厅、公共服务与教育空间，以及咖啡厅和书店等配套业态，2015年获得民办非营利艺术机构资质，2020年由国家文物局授予博物馆资质。木木以“全球性”为导向，既收藏和展出国内外当代艺术家的新近创作，也收藏15至18世纪欧洲绘画大师作品，曾举办坂本龙一、大卫·霍克尼、乔治·莫兰迪、曼·雷、布鲁斯·瑙曼、理查德·塔特尔、保罗·麦卡锡、马丁·马吉拉等艺术家在中国的首次机构个展，并与泰特现代美术馆、大英博物馆等机构合作。798馆的入口在2018年由直向建筑做过一次轻量改造，以极薄的表皮回应工业厂房界面；馆内展览常与表演、音乐、讲座等公共项目并行，是798艺术区最具代表性的民营当代美术馆之一。
intro_en: M WOODS 798 occupies D-06 in the 798 Art District, No. 2 Jiuxianqiao Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing, in the core of the district. The building was originally a 1950s military factory. The museum was founded in 2014 by collectors Lin Han and Lei Wanwan (Wanwan) and has three floors containing galleries, public and education spaces, a cafe and a bookshop. It received non-profit art institution status in 2015 and museum accreditation from the National Cultural Heritage Administration in 2020. M WOODS programmes both new work by contemporary artists and historical material; its collection also includes European Old Master paintings from the fifteenth to eighteenth centuries. It has given artists such as Ryuichi Sakamoto, David Hockney, Giorgio Morandi, Man Ray, Bruce Nauman, Richard Tuttle, Paul McCarthy and Martin Margiela their first institutional solo exhibitions in China, and has collaborated with Tate Modern and the British Museum. In 2018 Vector Architects made a lightweight renovation of the entrance, wrapping the industrial facade in a thin new skin. Exhibitions are regularly accompanied by performances, music, talks and other public programmes. M WOODS 798 is one of the most closely watched private contemporary art museums in Beijing and an anchor of the 798 district. The interior is deliberately flexible, allowing large installations and varied layouts.

address: 北京市东城区隆福寺街95号钱粮胡同38号15号楼
area_text: 共4层；改造工程建筑面积2,820㎡（地上2,070㎡＋地下750㎡），另有媒体口径称逾4,000㎡
intro_zh: 木木美术馆隆福寺馆（木木艺术社区）位于北京市东城区隆福寺街95号、钱粮胡同38号15号楼，毗邻景山、北海、中国美术馆与人艺剧场。场地原为隆福寺职工食堂，结构简单、内部开敞；2019年1月至8月，由青山周平主持的B.L.U.E.建筑事务所完成改造，建筑地上2,070平方米、地下750平方米，共四层。设计以0.3毫米厚的镀锌钢板手工折出五种折痕，形成褶皱立面，在控制造价的同时回应胡同肌理。内部被分为展览空间、屋顶露台、一层咖啡商店与地下一层Live House四部分；展厅跨高从2.2米到7米不等，地下保留原人防工程的粗糙混凝土与狭窄走廊，七个相连房间构成迷宫式体验，观众由此上行至一层、二层、三层，空间与光线逐步打开，西侧新开的小窗与露台则把老城胡同生活引入观展动线。2019年8月开馆，首展为与泰特美术馆合作的大卫·霍克尼回顾展，此后持续呈现当代艺术展览、演出与公共活动，是隆福寺街区更新中的核心文化节点。
intro_en: M WOODS Longfusi, also known as the M WOODS Art Community, occupies Building 15 at No. 38 Qianliang Hutong, off No. 95 Longfusi Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing, close to Jingshan, Beihai, the National Art Museum of China and the Capital Theatre. The site was formerly the canteen of the Longfusi staff. Between January and August 2019 it was converted by B.L.U.E. Architecture Studio, led by Shuhei Aoyama, into a four-storey art building with 2,070 square metres above ground and 750 square metres below. The facade is made of 0.3-millimetre galvanised steel sheets folded by hand into five different crease patterns, a low-cost response to the hutong grain. The programme is divided into exhibition space, a roof terrace, a ground-floor cafe and shop, and a basement live house. Gallery ceiling heights range from 2.2 to 7 metres. The basement keeps the rough concrete and narrow corridors of the original civil-defence shelter, where seven interconnected rooms form a maze; visitors then climb to the ground, second and third floors as space, light and views of the old neighbourhood gradually open up. The museum opened in August 2019 with a David Hockney retrospective organised with Tate, and continues to stage exhibitions, performances and public programmes as a cultural anchor of the Longfusi regeneration.

address: 北京市朝阳区崔各庄乡何各庄村顺白路马泉营西路路口西100米路北
intro_zh: 红砖美术馆位于北京市朝阳区崔各庄乡何各庄村，顺白路与马泉营西路路口西100米路北，地处一号地国际艺术区。美术馆由收藏家、企业家闫士杰与夫人曹梅于2007年开始筹建，邀请北京大学教授、建筑师董豫赣担纲设计，投资近4亿元，历时八年，2012年12月主体竣工并试运营，2014年5月23日正式开馆。场馆占地约22亩，建筑面积约9,720平方米，展馆与园林各约1万平方米，包括9个展览空间、2个公共休闲空间、1个艺术衍生品空间，并配有多功能厅、儿童活动室与艺术家驻地工作室。建筑与园林以红砖为基本语汇，通过拱券、漏窗、庭院与水体组织游走路径，形成“怀拥自然”的园林式美术馆。红砖以国际交流见长：2016年起持续引进法国“杜尚奖”，2017年参与“德国8”项目，2018年举办奥拉维尔·埃利亚松“道隐无名”大展，2019年与法国大使馆合作“中法文化之春”。美术馆提出“生态体验美术馆”与“艺术湿地”的运营理念，是北京重要的当代艺术地标。
intro_en: Red Brick Art Museum is at Hegezhuang village, Cuigezhuang township, Chaoyang District, Beijing, on the north side of the junction of Shunbai Road and Maquanying West Road, in the No. 1 Art District. It was initiated in 2007 by collector and entrepreneur Yan Shijie and his wife Cao Mei, designed by Dong Yugan, a professor at Peking University, and built over eight years with an investment of nearly 400 million yuan. The main building was completed in December 2012 and opened for trial operation; the museum formally opened on 23 May 2014. The site covers about 22 mu (1.5 hectares) with roughly 9,720 square metres of floor area, and the galleries and garden each account for about 10,000 square metres. It contains nine exhibition spaces, two public lounges, one art-derivative shop, a multi-function hall, a children's room and artist residency studios. Red brick is the basic architectural language: arches, lattice windows, courtyards and water organise a sequence of walks, producing a garden-like museum "embracing nature". Red Brick is known for international exchange. It has presented the French Marcel Duchamp Prize since 2016, took part in "Germany 8" in 2017, staged Olafur Eliasson's "The Unspeakable Openness of Things" in 2018 and cooperated with the French embassy on the 2019 Croisements festival. It promotes an "ecological experience museum" and "art wetland" model and is one of Beijing's key contemporary art landmarks.

address: 北京市海淀区杏石口路50号（西山文化创意大道西端）
area_text: 总面积2,600㎡，三层展厅
open_year: 2008（前身成立；2011年注册，2012年9月现馆启用）
intro_zh: 中间美术馆位于北京市海淀区杏石口路50号，地处西山文化创意大道西端，靠近西四环与高校聚集区。机构前身成立于2008年，自2007年起开始举办展览与文化活动，2011年经北京市民政局注册为民营美术公益机构；现馆于2012年9月正式投入使用，建筑由中国建筑设计研究院总建筑师崔愷团队设计，室内由纽约奥布兰建筑事务所完成。美术馆总面积2,600平方米，共三层展厅，配备专业美术馆的恒温恒湿、灯光与安防设施，并设有艺术家驻留工作室。与许多以流量展为主的民营馆不同，中间美术馆把研究重心放在中国20世纪下半叶的艺术与思想现场，试图通过档案、文献与策展重新梳理中国当代艺术的历史进程，同时保持对全球艺术语境的开放。馆内常年举办研究型群展、个展、讲座与出版项目，也支持实验性的创作与策展实践。其所在的中间艺术区还聚集了小剧场、艺术影院与教育空间，形成西山一带少见的复合文化聚落。
intro_en: Inside-Out Art Museum is at No. 50 Xingshikou Road, Haidian District, Beijing, at the western end of the Xishan Cultural and Creative Avenue, close to the West Fourth Ring Road and the city's university cluster. The institution's predecessor was established in 2008 and had been organising exhibitions and cultural programmes since 2007; in 2011 it was registered with the Beijing Civil Affairs Bureau as a private, non-profit art institution. The present building opened in September 2012, designed by a team led by Cui Kai of the China Architecture Design and Research Group, with interiors by the New York office Obra Architects. It has 2,600 square metres of gallery space on three floors, professional climate, lighting and security systems, and studios for artists in residence. Rather than chasing blockbuster shows, Inside-Out focuses its research on the art and thought of the second half of twentieth-century China, using archives, documents and curatorial work to re-examine the history of Chinese contemporary art while remaining open to global debates. It regularly produces research-driven group shows, solo exhibitions, lectures and publications, and supports experimental making and curating. The wider Inside-Out art district also contains a theatre, an art-house cinema and education spaces, forming an unusually mixed cultural cluster in western Beijing.

address: 北京市朝阳区酒仙桥北路9号恒通国际创新园-C7
area_text: 建筑面积32,910平方米
intro_zh: 北京民生现代美术馆位于北京市朝阳区酒仙桥北路9号恒通国际创新园C7，与798艺术区一街之隔。馆舍由建筑师朱锫设计，2011至2012年完成设计、2015年建成，是在上世纪80年代北京松下彩管厂厂房基础上改造而成——该厂是改革开放之初中国内地首家外资企业，厂房本身承载了典型的工业遗产肌理。美术馆由中国民生银行捐资设立，2012年2月注册为非营利艺术机构，2015年6月25日开馆，开馆展为“民间的力量”。建筑面积32,910平方米，内部没有采用单一白盒子，而是组织出5米净高的经典展厅以及大盒子、中盒子、小盒子、院落展厅与黑盒子多功能空间，围绕一个充满张力的中心空间展开；室外另设装置公园与屋顶展览平台，可同时容纳绘画、雕塑、装置、影像与表演。作为民生艺术机构（MSMS）在北京的旗舰，它与上海民生现代美术馆南北呼应，长期以中国当代艺术的文献性大展、机构收藏与公共教育为特色。馆址紧邻酒仙桥北路，地铁14号线将台站步行可达。
intro_en: The Beijing Minsheng Art Museum occupies Building C7 of the Hengtong International Innovation Park at 9 Jiuxianqiao North Road in Chaoyang District, across the street from the 798 Art District. The building was designed by architect Zhu Pei in 2011-12 and completed in 2015, converted from a 1980s Beijing Matsushita colour picture-tube plant - the first foreign-invested enterprise in mainland China after reform and opening - so the industrial fabric is part of the exhibit. Funded by China Minsheng Bank, the museum was registered as a non-profit art institution in February 2012 and opened on 25 June 2015 with the exhibition 'The Power of the People'. It has 32,910 square metres of floor area, but instead of one white box it is organised as a family of rooms: a classic gallery with 5-metre clear height, large, medium and small 'boxes', courtyard galleries and a black box for performance, meetings and exhibitions, all grouped around a charged central space. Outdoors there is an installation park and a roof exhibition terrace, so painting, sculpture, installation, video and performance can run at the same time. As the Beijing flagship of the Minsheng art platform (MSMS), which also runs the Shanghai Minsheng Art Museum, it is known for documentary-scale surveys of Chinese contemporary art, institutional collecting and public education. Metro Line 14, Jiangtai station, is within walking distance.

address: 北京市朝阳区百子湾路32号苹果社区4号楼
area_text: 室内展示面积2,500平方米（主馆5层，长40米、宽32米、高30米）
intro_zh: 今日美术馆位于北京市朝阳区百子湾路32号苹果社区4号楼，处在东三环CBD核心区边缘。美术馆于2002年由张宝全创建，是中国第一家民营非企业公益性美术馆，2006年7月正式转型为非营利机构。主馆由建筑师王晖主持改造，前身为北京啤酒厂锅炉房，保留了工业建筑的梯形金属框架与高挑空间：主馆为5层中顶钢架梁建筑，长40米、宽32米、高30米，室内总展示面积2,500平方米，二层主展区1,000平方米、挑高13.5米，既适合大型架上绘画，也适合体量较大的装置与雕塑，影像与声音艺术同样能获得充分呈现。顶楼保留汪建伟的永久户外装置《看展览》，把建筑本身变成作品的一部分。今日美术馆以“立足今天，展望未来”为理念，在关注中国当代艺术关键人物的同时长期扶持青年艺术家，形成展览、学术研究、公共教育、馆藏与出版并行的体系。开放时间为每日10:00—18:00、周一闭馆，参观咨询；地铁7号线九龙山站、10号线双井站步行可达。
intro_en: Today Art Museum stands at Building 4, Apple Community, 32 Baiziwan Road in Chaoyang District, on the edge of the CBD in eastern Beijing. It was founded in 2002 by Zhang Baoquan and describes itself as China's first private, non-enterprise public-interest art museum; in July 2006 it converted into a full non-profit institution. The main building was remodelled by architect Wang Hui from the boiler house of the former Beijing Brewery, and the industrial frame and tall volumes were kept: five storeys under a steel-frame roof, 40 metres long, 32 metres wide and 30 metres high, with 2,500 square metres of interior exhibition space. The second-floor main gallery of 1,000 square metres has a 13.5-metre clear height, which suits large paintings as well as bulky installations and sculpture, while blackout and acoustics allow video and sound art. On the roof, Wang Jianwei's permanent outdoor installation 'Watching the Exhibition' turns the building itself into part of the work.
