The programme follows the motto 'rooted in today, looking to the future': it tracks established figures in Chinese contemporary art while deliberately cultivating younger artists, and runs exhibitions, research, public education, a collection and publishing. A bookshop and education spaces support that programme. It opens daily from 10:00 to 18:00 and closes on Mondays; the visitor line is not included in this public dataset.

address: 北京市顺义区天竺镇格拉斯路（楼台村南，黑骑士球员俱乐部西南侧）
area_text: 占地约22,000平方米（约69亩）；西区主馆12个展厅共约2,200平方米，东区一号、二号馆各约500平方米
intro_zh: 松美术馆位于北京市顺义区天竺镇格拉斯路，坐落在温榆河畔，由华谊兄弟创始人、当代艺术家与收藏家王中军创办，2017年9月27日正式向公众开放。园区占地约22,000平方米（约69亩），庭院内种有199棵松树，净白的维多利亚式主馆由设计师周光明主持改造，去掉原有建筑的多余装饰，把形体收敛为几何白墙，让松树、草地与建筑互为背景，这也是“松”之名的由来。展陈集中在西区主馆，共12个展厅、室内展览面积约2,200平方米，分地上与地下两层；东区另有一号、二号两个展馆，各约500平方米，多用于专题展与品牌活动。馆内同时配置艺术衍生品店、公共教育阳光房、活动接待厅和咖啡厅，可承接展览、发布、酒会与小型演出。开馆展“从梵高到中国当代艺术”以王中军的个人收藏为基础，此后持续引入西方现代艺术与中国当代艺术的双线展览；2021年丁泽华出任馆长，进一步把馆务推向国际化与年轻化。场馆位于温榆河畔、首都机场附近，周一闭馆，周二至周日10:00—18:00开放（17:30停止入场）；票务咨询请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Song Art Museum sits on Gelasi Road in Tianzhu Town, Shunyi District, on the banks of the Wenyu River in north-east Beijing. It was founded by Wang Zhongjun, co-founder of Huayi Brothers and a painter and collector, and opened to the public on 27 September 2017. The grounds cover about 22,000 square metres, roughly 69 mu, and 199 pine trees are planted around the galleries; the white, Victorian-style main building was reworked by designer Zhou Guangming, who stripped away later additions and reduced the architecture to plain geometric volumes so that the pines, lawns and white walls frame one another. The name Song, meaning pine, comes from that landscape. Exhibition space is concentrated in the west building, where twelve galleries offer about 2,200 square metres over two levels, above and below ground; in the east zone, Halls One and Two add roughly 500 square metres each and are used for focused exhibitions and brand events. A design shop, an education sunroom, a reception hall and a café support the programme, and the museum can host openings, press launches, dinners and small performances. Its inaugural show, From Van Gogh to Chinese Contemporary Art, drew on Wang's private collection, and later seasons have paired modern Western art with Chinese contemporary work. Ding Zehua became director in 2021. The museum is about twenty minutes by car from Capital Airport, opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 18:00 and closes on Mondays; ticketing enquiries go through the museum's public channels.

address: 北京市海淀区复兴路69号华熙LIVE·五棵松
intro_zh: 北京时代美术馆位于北京市海淀区复兴路69号华熙LIVE·五棵松商业区内，由华熙国际投资集团全资创办，2008年5月成立，最初馆址在朝阳区建国门外大街，2016年10月随五棵松新馆落成迁入现址。新馆建筑面积约6,000平方米，主体由多个不规则空间拼合，形成自由、开放的当代展陈气质；馆内设四个当代馆：1号馆354平方米、层高7.9米，2号馆308平方米、层高4.5米，3号馆583平方米、层高4.5米，4号馆327平方米、层高3.5米，固定展线与流动展线合计约672米，可同时容纳绘画、雕塑、装置、影像与沉浸式项目。除展厅外，馆内还有艺术概念店、恒温恒湿藏品库房、专业展厅照明、投影音响与安防系统，并配有可承接讲座、论坛、放映和品牌公关活动的公共空间。美术馆依托华熙LIVE的体育、商业与夜间经济场景，开放至22:00，适合展览、首发、快闪与会后社交联动；其展览长期关注中国当代艺术、艺术与科技、潮流文化及青年艺术家，是京西重要的民营公益美术馆。客服电话未在本库列出。
intro_en: Beijing Times Art Museum occupies a site inside the Huaxi LIVE Wukesong complex at 69 Fuxing Road in Haidian District, western Beijing. It was founded in May 2008 by Huaxi International Investment Group and first operated on Jianguomenwai Avenue; the present building opened in October 2016 as part of the Wukesong development. The museum has about 6,000 square metres of floor area, assembled from several irregular volumes that give the interior a free, contemporary character. Four galleries make up the core: Hall 1 covers 354 square metres with a 7.9-metre ceiling, Hall 2 covers 308 square metres at 4.5 metres, Hall 3 covers 583 square metres at 4.5 metres, and Hall 4 covers 327 square metres at 3.5 metres. Fixed and flexible hanging lines total roughly 672 metres, enough for painting, sculpture, installation, video and immersive projects to run at the same time. An art concept store, climate-controlled storage, professional lighting, projection and sound systems and security infrastructure support the programme, and public areas can be adapted for talks, forums, screenings and brand events. Because it sits within a sports, retail and nightlife district, the museum stays open until 22:00, which suits exhibitions, product launches, pop-ups and after-hours receptions. Its programme focuses on Chinese contemporary art, art and technology, street culture and younger artists. The service line and email are not included in this public dataset.

address: 北京市东城区王府井大街1号
area_text: 总建筑面积约56,000平方米（地上约29,255平方米、地下约26,733平方米）；展览与拍卖空间约4,000平方米，中央无柱展厅约1,700平方米
intro_zh: 嘉德艺术中心坐落于北京市东城区王府井大街1号，处在王府井商业街与五四大街的交界处，北邻中国美术馆，西望故宫，2017年5月试营业、同年10月正式投入运营。项目由中国嘉德投资，德国建筑师奥雷·舍人（Ole Scheeren）设计，总建筑面积约56,000平方米，地上八层、地下五层，建筑高33.6米。整座建筑把拍卖行总部、艺术展览、艺术教育、书店、艺术品保管库与璞瑄酒店叠合在一起：一层与二层为专业展厅，中央是一个约1,700平方米的无柱展览空间，二层展厅可灵活分隔；地下一层设两座大型多功能厅，可满足展览、拍卖与宴会等不同布置；上部悬浮的玻璃体量是拥有120间客房的酒店，底部像素化圆孔在夜间投映出《富春山居图》。全馆展览与拍卖空间约4,000平方米，既能承接大型艺术展、双年展与艺博会单元，也能为品牌发布、晚宴、拍卖预展和私人洽购提供分区独立的动线。作为王府井—五四大街艺术带的核心节点，嘉德艺术中心把艺术品交易、学术展览与城市公共文化放在同一栋楼内，是北京少数可以同时办展、拍卖与高端宴会的复合文化场馆。咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Guardian Art Center stands at No. 1 Wangfujing Street in Dongcheng District, at the junction of Wangfujing shopping street and Wusi Dajie, with the National Art Museum of China next door and the Forbidden City a short walk west. China Guardian commissioned the building from German architect Ole Scheeren; it opened for trial operation in May 2017 and formally in October that year. The complex contains about 56,000 square metres of construction area across eight levels above ground and five below, reaching 33.6 metres in height. It stacks an auction-house headquarters, exhibition galleries, art education, a bookshop, a climate-controlled art storage and restoration facility and the 120-room PuXuan Hotel into one volume. The first and second floors hold professional galleries, with a central column-free hall of about 1,700 square metres and further flexible galleries above; two large multipurpose halls in the basement can be arranged for exhibitions, auctions or banquets. The upper glass volume, which houses the hotel, floats above the base, while the pixel-like circular openings at street level project an image of the classical painting Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains at night. Exhibition and auction space totals roughly 4,000 square metres, allowing major art exhibitions, biennale sections, fair presentations, auction previews, brand launches, dinners and private sales to run on separate routes. As an anchor of the Wangfujing art cluster, it is one of the few Beijing venues that can stage an exhibition, an auction and a formal banquet under one roof. Telephone ; email

address: 北京市朝阳区半截塔路53号郎园Station E1栋（10号库）
area_text: 现址建筑面积约3,000平方米（老仓库改造，含展厅、艺术商店、咖啡厅与餐厅）
intro_zh: X美术馆由收藏家黄勖夫与谢其润于2020年创立，2020年5月29日在朝阳区崔各庄国际艺术金融示范区开馆，首届展览为“终端>_How Do We Begin?”暨第一届X美术馆三年展。2023年5月27日，美术馆迁入朝阳区半截塔路53号郎园Station E1栋（10号库），把一座旧纺织仓库改造成约3,000平方米的新馆，设计由不也设计工作室（Studio NOR）完成：外立面保留历次改造的痕迹，内部以灰色之字形展墙、通高展厅和可开合的空间组织展览，同时嵌入可独立运营的艺术商店、咖啡厅与餐厅，使美术馆在闭馆后仍能作为生活方式场所使用。X美术馆以研究、推动中国当代文化和国际交流为使命，关注多元媒介与跨学科背景的创作者，重点支持新生代艺术家，馆内项目包括X美术馆三年展、X收藏展、X Virtual数字平台，以及2024年在上海前滩太古里开设的The Pool by X Museum。场馆位于坝河与亮马河之间的郎园Station园区，周边为设计、传媒与餐饮业态，适合展览、品牌快闪、发布与派对；开放时间为周一至周日10:00—18:00（17:30停止入场）；团体预约电话未在本库列出。
intro_en: X Museum was founded in 2020 by collectors Michael Xufu Huang and Xie Qirun and opened on 29 May 2020 in the Cuigezhuang international art and finance district of Chaoyang District, Beijing, with the inaugural X Triennial, Terminal >_How Do We Begin?. On 27 May 2023 it moved into Hall E1, Warehouse 10, at Langyuan Station, 53 Banjie Tower Road, converting an old textile warehouse into a museum of about 3,000 square metres. Studio NOR designed the new venue, keeping traces of earlier alterations on the facade and introducing grey zigzag gallery walls, a double-height hall and flexible rooms, with an art shop, café and restaurant that can operate independently of exhibition hours. That mix is deliberate: the founders describe the building as a lifestyle space that can hold many kinds of activity, not only exhibitions. The programme studies and promotes Chinese contemporary culture and international exchange, with an emphasis on young and cross-disciplinary artists; it includes the X Triennial, collection shows, the X Virtual digital platform and The Pool by X Museum, opened at Qiantan Taikoo Li in Shanghai in 2024. The site lies between the Ba River and Liangma River inside Langyuan Station, a campus of design, media and food businesses, and suits exhibitions, pop-ups, launches and parties. Opening hours are 10:00 to 18:00 daily, with last entry at 17:30; group bookings go through the museum's public channels.

address: 北京市朝阳区崔各庄乡草场地艺术区红一号院B2
website: http://www.taikangspace.com（原站，已随机构转型停更）
area_text: 整馆面积官方未公布；公开资料仅见“51平米”系列所用的51平方米项目展厅，另有主展厅与办公研究空间
status_note: 2021年9月落幕，2023年8月转型为泰康美术馆（北京CBD），草场地原址已不开放
intro_zh: 泰康空间位于北京市朝阳区崔各庄乡草场地艺术区红一号院B2，是泰康保险集团于2003年创办的非营利艺术机构，也是国内金融机构创办的第一家同类机构。它最初设在复兴门，2009年10月迁入草场地，从此把一处工业院落改造成以研究为导向的当代艺术空间。泰康空间不以常规美术馆的体量取胜，而以“追溯与激励”为方法：一方面整理20世纪40年代以来的中国艺术史材料，另一方面支持尚未成名的年轻艺术家与策展人。2009至2010年的“51平米”系列在仅51平方米的展厅里连续推出年轻艺术家个展，成为北京艺术生态中影响深远的项目；此后机构又启动“绘画问题”“建筑问题”等研究线索，并系统建设泰康收藏。2021年9月，运营二十年的泰康空间以“机构实践与生产2003—2021”作为落幕展，随后于2023年8月转型为泰康美术馆，迁入北京CBD的泰康集团大厦，面向更广泛的公众。原草场地空间不再对外开放，但它在企业收藏、非营利机构运营与艺术史研究上的实践，仍是理解中国民营艺术机构的重要样本。原官网taikangspace.com已停更，参观需以泰康美术馆现址公告为准。
intro_en: Taikang Space occupied Courtyard B2 of Red No. 1 in the Caochangdi art district, Cuigezhuang, Chaoyang District, Beijing. Founded in 2003 by Taikang Insurance Group, it was the first non-profit art institution set up by a Chinese financial company. It began near Fuxingmen and moved to Caochangdi in October 2009, turning an industrial courtyard into a research-led contemporary art space. Rather than relying on the scale of a conventional museum, Taikang Space worked through a method it called tracing and encouraging: examining Chinese art-historical material from the 1940s onward while supporting young artists and curators who had not yet become established. Its 51 Square Metres series, staged in a gallery of only 51 square metres between 2009 and 2010, gave successive solo shows to emerging artists and became one of the most influential programmes in Beijing's art ecology. Later research strands addressed painting and architecture, and the institution built the Taikang collection into a systematic holding. In September 2021, after twenty years, it closed with the exhibition Institutional Practice and Production 2003-2021, and in August 2023 it was transformed into the Taikang Art Museum in the Taikang Group tower in Beijing's CBD. The Caochangdi space is no longer open to the public, but its record in corporate collecting, non-profit management and art-historical research remains a key case for understanding private art institutions in China. The original website, taikangspace.com, is no longer updated.

address: 北京市朝阳区酒仙桥北路乙10号院（星地中心园区内，798艺术区东侧）
area_text: 艺术中心3个展演场地共约5,000㎡，挑高15米；星地艺术大厦3万㎡；园区总建筑面积约15万㎡
intro_zh: 星地艺术中心（FairyLand Center，简称FLC）位于朝阳区酒仙桥北路乙10号院星地中心园区内，紧邻798艺术区东侧，是2022年3月竣工的星地中心的艺术板块。园区由法国建筑师、国家大剧院设计者保罗·安德鲁担任概念设计，以“方圆”为母题，主体为白色全釉面点玻璃幕墙的流线形体，总建筑面积约15万平方米，集办公、商业与创意会展于一体，是北京市首个“一绿试点”集体产业项目。星地艺术中心建筑形似巨鲸，设有3个展演展示场地，艺术展览空间合计约5,000平方米，挑高15米，可承接大型装置、沉浸式展览与品牌发布；入口处的环形草坪阶梯广场把室内外动线连成一体，也为户外演出提供场地。相邻的星地艺术大厦建筑面积3万平方米、高60米、共13层，顶层设约2,000平方米共享艺术会客厅，展览陈列空间超过5,000平方米，定位为聚集画廊、拍卖行、艺术媒体与艺术科技公司的“垂直艺术综合体”。两栋建筑均由星地艺术基金会运营，基金会已收藏国内外当代艺术作品约1,000件。地铁12号线酒仙桥站步行约200—250米，西望798、北接望京、东邻首都机场高速。
intro_en: FairyLand Center (FLC), known in Chinese as Xingdi Art Center, stands at No.10B Jiuxianqiao North Road in Chaoyang District, immediately east of the 798 Art District. It is the art component of the Xingdi Centre, a 150,000 sq m complex completed in March 2022 that mixes offices, retail and creative exhibition space and was Beijing's first collective-land pilot project of its kind. The masterplan was conceived by the French architect Paul Andreu, designer of the National Centre for the Performing Arts, around a square-within-circle motif and clad in white glazed dot-patterned glass. The art centre itself is shaped like a whale, with three performance and exhibition halls totalling about 5,000 sq m and a 15-metre clear height, able to take large installations, immersive shows and product launches; a circular grass-stepped plaza ties the interior to the park and provides an outdoor stage. The adjoining 13-storey, 60-metre Xingdi Art Tower offers 30,000 sq m, with a 2,000 sq m shared art salon on the top floor and more than 5,000 sq m of gallery space, positioned as a vertical cluster for galleries, auction houses, art media and art-tech firms. Both buildings are run by the Xingdi Art Foundation, which holds around 1,000 contemporary works. Jiuxianqiao station on metro line 12 is 200-250 metres away, with 798 to the west and Wangjing to the north.

address: 北京市西城区西直门外大街135号
area_text: 占地约13.2万㎡，主馆建筑面积5.04万㎡；12个室内展厅，展览面积2.2万㎡，展厅层高8—19米
intro_zh: 北京展览馆位于北京市西城区西直门外大街135号，西邻北京动物园与动物园交通枢纽，东侧为西直门地铁站与北京北站，是新中国第一座大型综合性展览馆。项目为苏联援建重点工程之一，1953年10月15日开工，由二十多个省、一万多名工人和六千多名解放军战士参与建设，1954年9月10日竣工，最初名为“苏联展览馆”，毛泽东题写馆名，周恩来主持剪彩，1958年正式更名为北京展览馆。建筑为俄式新古典主义风格，主馆呈“山”字形对称布局，中央鎏金尖塔顶端立有直径2.5米的红色五角星，内部为高大穹顶、雕花拱廊与巨型吊灯，属20世纪中国建筑遗产与北京优秀近现代保护建筑。全馆占地约13.2万平方米，主要建筑占地8.85万平方米，主馆建筑面积5.04万平方米；室内共设12个展厅，展览面积2.2万平方米，展厅层高8至19米，可承接大型艺术展、文博展、动漫展与科普展，另配报告厅与多功能会议厅。馆内四家经营单位构成完整配套：展览中心、北展剧场（约2700座，北京容量最大的专业剧场之一）、莫斯科餐厅（北京西餐的“鼻祖”之一）与北展宾馆，形成展览、演出、餐饮、住宿一体的综合体。2000年完成场馆改造，建馆以来承接国内外大型展览千余个。
intro_en: Beijing Exhibition Center stands at 135 Xizhimenwai Street in Xicheng District, next to the Beijing Zoo transport hub to the west and Xizhimen metro and Beijing North railway stations to the east. It is the first large comprehensive exhibition venue built in the People's Republic, a Soviet-aided project that broke ground on 15 October 1953 with more than 10,000 workers from over twenty provinces and some 6,000 PLA soldiers, and was completed on 10 September 1954. Originally named the Soviet Exhibition Center, with its name inscribed by Mao Zedong and opened by Zhou Enlai, it was renamed Beijing Exhibition Center in 1958. The building is Russian neoclassical in style, symmetrically laid out in a mountain-shaped plan, with a gilded central spire topped by a 2.5-metre red star, high domes, carved arcades and large chandeliers; it is listed as a 20th-century Chinese architectural heritage site and a protected modern building in Beijing. The site covers about 132,000 square metres, with 88,500 square metres built on, and the main building has 50,400 square metres of floor area. Twelve indoor halls provide 22,000 square metres of exhibition space with clear heights of 8 to 19 metres, suited to large art, museum, animation and science exhibitions, plus a lecture hall and multi-function meeting rooms. Four operating units complete the complex: the exhibition centre, the 2,700-seat Beizhan Theatre, the Moskva Restaurant and the Beizhan Hotel, so exhibitions, performances, dining and accommodation sit on one site. The venue was renovated in 2000 and has hosted more than a thousand large domestic and international exhibitions.

address: 北京市朝阳区三里屯西五街5号F座（北信京谊大厦，三里屯使馆区内）
area_text: 画廊空间，面积未公开（所在院落提供5个停车位）
intro_zh: 西五艺术中心（C5ART）位于北京市朝阳区三里屯西五街5号院F座，处在三里屯使馆区内部，周边是幸福三村、新源南路与东直门外大街一带的老院落与使馆建筑群。画廊于2005年11月16日开业，由合伙人共同经营，艺术总监为董菁，定位是推介年轻当代艺术家，签约艺术家多为七十年代以后出生、有明确个人线索的创作者，如梁硕、韩磊等。空间以白盒子展厅为主，面积不大但层高完整，适合绘画、装置、雕塑、综合材料、版画、多媒体与摄影等媒介的中小型个展与群展；自开幕以来已举办一百多个艺术展览，推介数百位年轻艺术家，展览以东方文化美学为线索，尝试以当代视角连接历史与当下。画廊周二至周日10:00—18:00开放（节假日除外），免费参观，院内可提供5个停车位，2021年1月做过一次整体装修。除三里屯本址外，团队2019年在798艺术区七星东街E03栋开设了实验性空间C5CNM——一个长宽4.75×5.25米、挑高3.5米的“小盒子”，以扫码取电子锁密码的方式24小时开放，用于更小体量、更强观念性的项目。西五适合小型品牌发布、艺术晚宴、私洽展与媒体预览，三里屯的客流与使馆区环境是其区位的核心价值。
intro_en: C5ART sits in Block F of No. 5 Courtyard, Sanlitun West Fifth Street, in Chaoyang District, inside Beijing's Sanlitun embassy area and among the older courtyards and legations between Xindong Road and Dongzhimenwai Street. The gallery opened on 16 November 2005 as a partnership, with Dong Jing as art director, and built its programme around young contemporary artists, most born after the 1970s and chosen for a clear individual position, among them Liang Shuo and Han Lei. The space is a compact white-cube hall with a full clear height, suited to small and medium solo and group shows across painting, installation, sculpture, mixed media, printmaking, video and photography. More than a hundred exhibitions and several hundred younger artists have passed through since opening, with shows framed around Eastern aesthetics and a contemporary reading of the link between history and the present. It opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10:00 to 18:00, free of charge, with five parking spaces in the courtyard, and was refurbished in January 2021. Beyond Sanlitun, the team opened C5CNM in 2019 at Building E03, Qixing East Street in the 798 Art District: a 4.75 by 5.25 metre room with a 3.5 metre ceiling, open around the clock and entered with a code obtained by scanning a QR code, used for smaller and more conceptual projects. For events, C5ART suits intimate launches, art dinners, private viewings and press previews, with Sanlitun footfall and the embassy setting as its main locational assets.

address: 北京市朝阳区崔各庄乡吉祥寺桥北，奶东公园西侧（京承高速奶东公园西南侧约70米），北京艺术金融国际创新园区内
area_text: 建筑面积2,285㎡（单层，含室外庭院、画廊大厅与办公）
intro_zh: 云·艺术中心位于北京市朝阳区崔各庄乡吉祥寺桥北、奶东公园西侧，处在北京艺术金融国际创新园区内部，被温榆河、奶西湿地与奶东公园三片绿地环抱。园区所在地原为奶东村老旧厂房与物流仓库聚集区，2015年启动集体产业升级与疏解腾退，一期建筑面积约28万平方米，规划艺术创作中心、国际艺术金融中心与科技文化创新中心三个板块，2021年3月正式投入运营，已开业的十栋建筑中包括标志性的X美术馆与云·艺术中心。云·艺术中心由TEMP建筑设计事务所设计，主创建筑师为金智虎（Howard Jiho Kim），2020年建成，建筑面积2,285平方米，是一座单层建筑，功能包括室外庭院、画廊大厅与办公。设计把场地上未被充分利用的庭院空间抬升为一片绿洲：层层相扣的庭院环绕经过改造的画廊，观众可以从花园直接走进展厅；街道入口立着一块巨大的杏仁形岩石，其后的木质走廊微微抬升，形成带仪式感的动线；镜面水池、枫树、竹林与随风摆动的谷莠子把光线、倒影与声音引入室内。主画廊以整齐白墙保证展陈的纯粹，墙上不同高度与尺度的开口把庭院、人流与作品互相框取，大量落地玻璃把自然景致带入室内。单层、低矮、以庭院串联的空间，适合中型当代艺术展、品牌展览、私密发布会与艺术晚宴，也可与园区内的X美术馆联动。
intro_en: Yun Art Center (Cloud Art Center) stands north of Jixiang Temple Bridge in Cuigezhuang Township, Chaoyang District, on the west side of Naidong Park and inside the Beijing Art and Finance International Innovation Park, a site wrapped by the Wenyu River, the Naixi wetlands and Naidong Park. The land was previously a cluster of low factories and logistics warehouses in Naidong village; collective industrial upgrading began in 2015, and the first phase of about 280,000 square metres is organised around three centres for art creation, international art finance, and technology and cultural innovation. The park opened in March 2021, and among its ten operating buildings are the landmark X Museum and Yun Art Center. Designed by TEMP, with Howard Jiho Kim as principal architect, the centre was completed in 2020 with 2,285 square metres on a single storey, comprising outdoor courtyards, a gallery hall and offices. The design lifts underused courtyard ground into a green oasis: interlocking courtyards wrap the renovated gallery so visitors can step from garden into exhibition space. A large almond-shaped rock marks the street entrance, followed by a slightly raised timber walkway that gives the approach a ceremonial pace, while a mirror pool, maples, bamboo and swaying grass bring light, reflection and sound indoors. The main gallery keeps clean white walls for the art, with openings at different heights and sizes framing the courtyards, visitors and works, and full-height glazing pulls the landscape inside. The low, single-level, courtyard-linked plan suits medium-scale contemporary exhibitions, brand shows, intimate launches and art dinners, and can be programmed with the neighbouring X Museum.

address: 北京市朝阳区酒仙桥路2号（798·751园区）
area_text: 园区规模约253,800㎡，其中包豪斯建筑超过70,000㎡
open_year: 2002（艺术家大规模进驻）；2006（首批北京市文化创意产业集聚区）
intro_zh: 798艺术区位于北京市朝阳区酒仙桥路2号，坐落在新中国“一五”期间建设的华北无线电器材联合厂（718联合厂）原址，是北京东北部大山子—酒仙桥片区最具代表性的文化艺术地标。园区保留了20世纪50年代建成的包豪斯风格锯齿形厂房，2000年底工厂生产设备外迁后，因租金低廉、层高高大、采光独特且毗邻中央美术学院，自2002年起大批艺术家与画廊进驻，逐步形成画廊、艺术中心、设计工作室、书店与餐饮混合的当代艺术生态；2005年末更名为“798艺术区”，2006年被认定为首批北京市文化创意产业集聚区。目前园区规模约25.38万平方米，其中包豪斯建筑面积超过7万平方米，入驻机构中文化艺术及创意类占近八成，涵盖来自19个国家和地区的文化交流机构、国际艺术机构与近百个艺术家工作室，UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心、木木美术馆等均在此。园区每年举办数千场展览与活动，2024年到访者约1,257万人次，是中国规模最大的以艺术为核心的文化产业集聚区之一。798全天开放、进入园区不收费，各机构展览通常10:00—18:00/19:00开放；交通可乘地铁14号线至将台站C口换乘公交两站至大山子，或至望京南站步行约15分钟。
intro_en: 798 Art District occupies No. 2 Jiuxianqiao Road in Chaoyang District, Beijing, on the site of the North China Radio Equipment Joint Factory (the 718 Joint Factory) built during China's First Five-Year Plan. It is the best-known cultural and artistic landmark in the Dashanzi–Jiuxianqiao area of north-east Beijing. The district preserves the saw-tooth Bauhaus workshops built in the 1950s; after production moved out at the end of 2000, low rents, generous ceiling heights, distinctive daylight and proximity to the Central Academy of Fine Arts drew artists and galleries from 2002 onwards. A mixed ecology of galleries, art centres, design studios, bookshops and restaurants followed, the name '798 Art District' was adopted at the end of 2005, and in 2006 it was designated one of Beijing's first cultural and creative industry clusters. The park now covers about 253,800 square metres, including more than 70,000 square metres of Bauhaus buildings. Cultural and creative tenants make up nearly 80 percent of occupants, including cultural exchange bodies and art institutions from 19 countries and territories and close to a hundred artist studios; UCCA Center for Contemporary Art and M WOODS are both here. Thousands of exhibitions and events are staged each year, and the district recorded about 12.57 million visits in 2024, making it one of China's largest art-centred cultural industry clusters. The park is open all day with no admission charge, while individual venues generally open 10:00–18:00 or 19:00. Take Metro Line 14 to Jiangtai (Exit C) and transfer to a bus for two stops to Dashanzi, or to Wangjing South and walk about 15 minutes.

address: 江苏省南京市玄武区中山路18号德基广场二期8F
area_text: 约9000平方米
intro_zh: 德基美术馆（现名德基艺术博物馆）位于南京市玄武区中山路18号德基广场二期8层，2017年9月26日正式对公众开放，是德基集团创办的非营利艺术机构，馆舍面积约9000平方米。博物馆地处南京“博物馆大道”与新街口商圈交汇处，馆藏体系基于近三十年的有序收藏，涵盖中国古代陶瓷、书画、佛教造像、明式家具以及中国与国际现当代艺术。常设展“金陵图数字艺术展”以馆藏冯宁《仿宋院本金陵图》为基础，用超宽带与实时跟随技术让观众以第一人称“入画”宋代金陵；另有馆藏花卉主题展、Beeple数字艺术展等。博物馆以开放至午夜零点的超长开放时间著称，周一至周日10:00-24:00开放，并推进“一城多馆”格局，河西馆与仙林馆在建。客服电话未在本库列出；地铁一号线、二号线新街口站7号出口可达。馆内另设艺术商店、咖啡与公共休息区，夜间观展成为其城市生活的特色，展览兼顾学术研究与公众体验。
intro_en: Deji Art Museum, accredited as a museum in 2023, occupies the eighth floor of Deji Plaza Phase II at 18 Zhongshan Road, Xuanwu District, Nanjing. It opened to the public on 26 September 2017 as a non-profit art institution founded by the Deji Group and covers about 9,000 square metres. Its position at the crossing of Nanjing's “museum avenue” and the Xinjiekou retail district anchors a collection built over nearly three decades, spanning ancient Chinese ceramics, painting and calligraphy, Buddhist sculpture, Ming furniture, and modern and contemporary art from China and abroad. The permanent “Jinling Scroll” digital exhibition is based on Feng Ning's Qing-dynasty copy of a Song-era view of Nanjing and uses ultra-wideband tracking so visitors can enter the painting in first person; other displays draw on the flower-themed collection and digital art by Beeple. The museum is known for staying open until midnight, seven days a week from 10:00 to 24:00, and is developing a multi-venue network with Hexi and Xianlin buildings under construction. Telephone and email are not included in this public dataset; Xinjiekou metro station (lines 1 and 2), Exit 7. A shop, café and public lounges support late-night visits, which have become part of Nanjing's city life. Its exhibitions balance scholarly research with a strongly public-facing tone, from blockbuster loan shows to collection displays.

address: 南京市浦口区珍七路9号（四方当代艺术湖区）
area_text: 主馆建筑面积约1860平方米（2万平方英尺）；三处馆舍展览面积合计近8000平方米
intro_zh: 四方当代美术馆成立于2005年8月，馆舍分设南京玄武区、浦口区与江宁区，展览面积合计近8000平方米，是面向中国当代艺术的复合型民间艺术机构。浦口主馆位于珍七路9号四方当代艺术湖区，由美国建筑师史蒂文·霍尔设计，2011年落成开放，建筑面积约2万平方英尺（约1860平方米），以悬浮的平行透视空间、竹模混凝土墙面与庭院式观景著称；江宁馆由奥地利建筑师赖纳·皮尔克设计。美术馆以展览、收藏、研究、教育为主要功能，关注中国当代艺术的生存环境与公众认知，并以每五年一届的当代艺术大型文献展为长期计划，依托湖区二十余座建筑师别墅形成建筑与艺术互文的现场。机构另设玄武区中央路6号办公与展示空间。开放时间通常为周二至周日10:00-17:00；电话与邮箱未在本库列出，官网www.sg-art.org。美术馆长期支持中国当代艺术的文献整理与青年艺术家项目，并定期举办讲座、工作坊与公共教育活动。
intro_en: Sifang Art Museum was founded in August 2005 and maintains venues in Xuanwu, Pukou and Jiangning districts of Nanjing, with close to 8,000 square metres of exhibition space in total; it is an independent, composite art institution focused on Chinese contemporary art. The main Pukou building stands at 9 Zhenqi Road in the Sifang Contemporary Art Lake District. Designed by American architect Steven Holl and completed in 2011, it has about 20,000 square feet (roughly 1,860 square metres) of floor area and is known for its suspended, parallel-perspective spaces, bamboo-formed concrete walls and framed views into the landscape. The Jiangning venue was designed by Austrian architect Rainer Pirker. Exhibition, collection, research and education form the core programme, which aims to improve the conditions for contemporary art in China and broaden public understanding; it plans a large contemporary art survey every five years and works with the lake district's two dozen architect-designed villas as a wider site of architecture and art. It also keeps an office and display space at 6 Zhongyang Road, Xuanwu District. It generally opens Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00-17:00; telephone and email are not included in this public dataset; website www.sg-art.org. The museum has long supported documentary research on Chinese contemporary art and projects for younger artists, with regular lectures, workshops and public programmes.

address: 南京市秦淮区剪子巷50号
area_text: 建筑面积6000平方米（“一院两馆”总建筑面积15625平方米）
intro_zh: 金陵美术馆位于南京市秦淮区剪子巷50号，即原南京色织厂旧址，属南京市委市政府批准的“一院两馆”旧厂改造项目（南京书画院、金陵美术馆、老城南记忆馆），2013年9月正式开馆，是南京市第一座集展示、收藏、研究于一体的市级美术馆。项目总建筑面积15625平方米，其中金陵美术馆6000平方米，设5个展厅，并配报告厅、书店、艺术商店、画廊、资料室与咖啡厅。美术馆由旧厂房改造而来，保留工业遗构并植入当代展陈空间，地处老门东—夫子庙历史文化街区边缘，与明城墙、秦淮河构成步行可达的文化动线。机构隶属南京市文化主管部门，承担市级美术收藏、展览策划与公共教育职能，关注江苏及南京本地艺术创作，也引进国内外交流展。开放时间通常为周二至周日9:00-17:00，周一闭馆；电话与邮箱未在本库列出，官网jinlingartmuseum.com。三处空间共享同一旧厂院落，观众可在一次到访中串联美术馆、画院与城市记忆展。
intro_en: Jinling Art Museum occupies 50 Jianzi Lane, Qinhuai District, Nanjing, on the site of the former Nanjing Yarn-Dyed Fabric Factory. It is the main element of the “one academy, two museums” industrial conversion approved by the municipal government, together with the Nanjing Painting and Calligraphy Academy and the Old South City Memory Museum, and opened in September 2013 as Nanjing's first municipal art museum combining exhibition, collection and research. The whole project has 15,625 square metres of floor area, of which the museum takes 6,000 square metres with five galleries plus a lecture hall, bookshop, art shop, gallery, reference room and café. The building reuses the old factory structure while inserting contemporary exhibition spaces, and sits at the edge of the Laomendong-Fuzimiao historic district, within walking distance of the Ming city wall and the Qinhuai River. It is administered by the Nanjing culture and publishing bureau and handles municipal collecting, exhibition programming and public education, with a focus on Jiangsu and Nanjing artists alongside touring shows from elsewhere. It generally opens Tuesday to Sunday, 9:00-17:00, closed Mondays; telephone or ; website jinlingartmuseum.com. The three spaces share one former factory compound, so a single visit can link the museum, the academy and the city-memory displays for visitors.

address: 福建省厦门市思明区体育路95号（厦门文化艺术中心内）
area_text: 建筑面积近2万㎡（另有资料记为2.8万㎡）；两层7个展厅，展厅面积约1万㎡；现代艺术展厅近4,000㎡、层高近10米
intro_zh: 厦门市美术馆位于厦门市思明区体育路95号厦门文化艺术中心内，与市图书馆、文化馆、博物馆、科技馆共同组成厦门岛内最重要的公共文化建筑群，是闽南地区以现代艺术收藏与展示为主轴的公立美术馆。美术馆于2006年试开馆、2007年正式开放。建筑面积近2万平方米（另有资料记为2.8万平方米，口径不一）。馆舍展区共两层、设7个展厅，展厅面积约1万平方米：一层为主展厅、珍品展厅与多媒体展厅，二层为平面艺术展厅；其中大型现代艺术展厅面积近4,000平方米、层高近10米，是馆内承接大型装置、影像与沉浸式展览的主力空间。美术馆以漆画、刻字艺术为收藏与研究强项，同时覆盖油画、国画、水彩水粉、书法与当代艺术，长期打造“漆画牌、海峡牌、当代牌”展览品牌，曾举办全国漆画展、全国工笔画双年展及馆藏漆画精品展等。馆内配套典藏库房、周转库房、会议室、接待室与公共教育空间，可承办开幕式、学术研讨与小型发布活动。交通方面，地铁2号线、3号线体育中心站步行约10分钟，公交可至文化艺术中心站。开放时间9:00—17:00，周一闭馆（节假日除外），免费参观。
intro_en: The Xiamen Art Museum occupies No. 95 Tiyu Road in Siming District, inside the Xiamen Culture and Arts Centre, a complex it shares with the city library, cultural centre, museum and science centre — the densest public-cultural cluster on Xiamen Island. It opened for trial operation in 2006 and formally opened in 2007. Published figures differ: one source gives about 28,000 sqm of floor area, another close to 20,000 sqm. The galleries are arranged on two levels in seven halls with roughly 10,000 sqm of exhibition space. The ground floor holds the main hall, a treasures hall and a multimedia hall; the upper floor holds the graphic-arts hall. The modern-art hall alone covers nearly 4,000 sqm with a ceiling close to ten metres, making it the museum's engine for large installations and immersive shows. The collection focuses on modern and contemporary art with a regional speciality in lacquer painting and seal-carving, alongside oil painting, ink, watercolour, calligraphy and new media; the museum has built exhibition brands around lacquer, the Taiwan Strait and contemporary art, and has hosted the National Lacquer Painting Exhibition, the National Gongbi Biennale and shows drawn from its own lacquer collection. Storage, transit stores, meeting rooms, reception rooms and education spaces support openings, seminars and small launches. Metro Lines 2 and 3 meet at Sports Centre station, about ten minutes on foot, and buses stop at the Culture and Arts Centre. Opening hours are 9:00-17:00, closed Mondays except public holidays, with free admission.

address: 福建省厦门市集美区杏林湾路502号诚毅国际商务中心主楼南侧裙楼二至四层
area_text: 总面积约10,350㎡（建筑设计口径8,000㎡）；净展览空间超4,000㎡；5个独立展厅
intro_zh: 红点设计博物馆·厦门位于厦门市集美区杏林湾路502号诚毅国际商务中心主楼南侧裙楼二至四层，处在集美新城杏林湾商务营运中心的核心地段，是德国红点设计大奖在全球设立的第三座、中国境内唯一的红点设计博物馆。博物馆2018年11月3日首馆落地厦门高崎国际机场原T2航站楼，面积约1万平方米，曾是全球面积最大的机场博物馆；2021年8月因机场改造，临展馆迁至厦门佰翔会展中心；2023年11月28日新馆在集美杏林湾正式开放。新馆总面积约10,350平方米，由STEPS大台阶建筑与协作派对改造设计，净展览空间超过4,000平方米，设5个独立展厅及设计商店、设计学院、咖啡馆等配套，常设展汇集红点产品设计、品牌与传达设计、设计概念三大奖项及当代好设计奖作品，常年展出来自70多个国家和地区的逾千件展品。设计以安迪·沃霍尔“购物中心与博物馆互相转化”的预言为起点，打通博物馆与商业裙楼的边界，通高中庭内拆除原自动扶梯、置入巨型双螺旋红色楼梯作为视觉核心，一段设LED展示屏，形成“没有墙的博物馆”的漫游动线。博物馆每年引进10余个国际设计展，可承接品牌发布、设计论坛与教育活动。交通方面，地铁1号线诚毅广场站出站后步行或换乘公交约1公里可达，自驾可停杏林湾营运中心12号楼停车场；开放时间周二至周日10:00—18:00，17:00停止入场，周一闭馆，需购票入场。
intro_en: The Red Dot Design Museum Xiamen occupies the second to fourth floors of the southern podium of the Chengyi International Business Centre, No. 502 Xinglinwan Road, Jimei District, in the Xinglin Bay business district of Jimei New Town. It is the third Red Dot Design Museum worldwide and the only one in China, run by Germany's Red Dot Design Award with the Xiamen Cultural Broadcasting Media Group. The first Xiamen site opened on 3 November 2018 in the former Terminal 2 of Xiamen Gaoqi International Airport, some 10,000 sqm and then the largest airport museum in the world; the temporary galleries moved to the Xiang'an Banquet and Exhibition Centre in August 2021 when the airport was rebuilt, and the present museum opened on 28 November 2023. The new building totals about 10,350 sqm, with more than 4,000 sqm of net exhibition space, five independent galleries, a design shop, a design academy and a cafe. It displays more than 1,000 award-winning products from over 70 countries across the Red Dot product, brand and communication, and design concept awards plus the Contemporary Good Design Award. STEPS Architecture and Network Party converted the vacant retail podium, taking Andy Warhol's prediction that museums and shopping malls would merge as a brief: the escalators were removed and a huge double-spiral red staircase inserted into the full-height atrium, one flight carrying an LED display, the other climbing to the upper floors — a "museum without walls" that visitors wander like a mall. It stages more than ten international design exhibitions a year and hosts launches, design forums and workshops. Metro Line 1 to Chengyi Plaza station, then a walk or short bus ride of about one kilometre, serves the site; the museum opens Tuesday to Sunday 10:00-18:00, last entry 17:00, closed Mondays, ticketed.

address: 天津市河西区平江道60号（天津文化中心内，临湖）
area_text: 总建筑面积40,815.23㎡（部分资料记2.8万㎡）；地上5层、高29.70米；展厅总面积约9,000㎡，二层展厅1,800㎡、净高8米
intro_zh: 天津美术馆位于天津市河西区平江道60号，坐落在天津文化中心园区内，与天津博物馆、天津大剧院、天津图书馆、天津自然博物馆共同围合出天津最大的城市文化建筑群，馆舍临湖而建，从亲水平台、室外雕塑广场到一层公共空间形成连续的室内外过渡。美术馆前身为1929年筹建的天津市立美术馆，现馆于2012年5月19日正式对外开放，由德国KSP尤根恩格尔建筑师事务所与天津市建筑设计院联合设计。馆舍总建筑面积40,815.23平方米（部分资料记为2.8万平方米，口径不一），建筑层数5层、建筑高度29.70米，展厅总面积约9,000平方米：一层为临时展厅兼开幕式大厅，二、三层为敞开式特展厅，四层为恒温恒湿封闭展柜的基本陈列厅；其中二层展厅面积1,800平方米、净高8米，建筑规格在国内同类展厅中居前。馆藏文物1,106件/套，以近现代与当代中国画、油画、雕塑、版画及工艺美术为重点，依托天津博物馆的收藏基础，开馆初期即具相当规模。公共区与服务区合计约7,000平方米，配报告厅、研讨室、美术图书资料中心、创作室、装裱与油画修复室、艺术书店、艺术品商店、咖啡与茶艺空间，可承接展览开幕、学术论坛与品牌活动。交通方面，地铁5号线、6号线文化中心站步行可达，周边设银河广场地下停车场；开放时间9:00—16:30，16:00停止入馆，周一闭馆，免费参观。
intro_en: Tianjin Art Museum stands at No. 60 Pingjiang Road, Hexi District, Tianjin, in the Tianjin Cultural Centre, a campus it shares with the Tianjin Museum, Grand Theatre, Library and Natural History Museum around a lake and Yinhe Plaza. Its predecessor, the Tianjin Municipal Art Museum, was planned in 1929; the present building opened on 19 May 2012 and was designed jointly by KSP Jürgen Engel Architekten of Germany and the Tianjin Architectural Design Institute. The building has 40,815.23 sqm of gross floor area (some sources cite 28,000 sqm), five storeys and a height of 29.70 m. Exhibition space totals about 9,000 sqm: a temporary hall and opening-event space on the ground floor, open-plan special exhibition halls on levels two and three, and a climate-controlled permanent collection floor with sealed display cases on level four. The level-two hall, 1,800 sqm with an 8 m clear height, is among the largest of its kind in China. The collection of 1,106 objects and sets concentrates on modern and contemporary Chinese painting, oil painting, sculpture, printmaking and decorative arts, built on the Tianjin Museum's holdings. Public and service areas cover about 7,000 sqm and include a lecture theatre, seminar rooms, an art library, studios, mounting and painting-conservation workshops, an art bookshop, a gallery shop, cafes and tea rooms, so the museum can host openings, academic forums and brand events. Metro Lines 5 and 6 stop at Cultural Centre station within walking distance. It opens 9:00-16:30, last entry 16:00, closed Mondays, free of charge.

name_zh: 广东美术馆白鹅潭馆区
address: 广州市荔湾区白鹅潭南路19号（白鹅潭大湾区艺术中心内，东侧馆区）
area_text: 建筑面积6.5万㎡（不含公共区域），展陈面积2.5万㎡，地上11层，21个展厅
intro_zh: 广东美术馆白鹅潭馆区位于广州市荔湾区白鹅潭南路19号，是白鹅潭大湾区艺术中心三馆合一体量中的东侧馆区。艺术中心坐落在白鹅潭畔三江交汇处，由中国工程院院士何镜堂领衔团队设计，总建筑面积约14.5万平方米，展陈面积超4万平方米，共享公共区域3.5万平方米，外形酷似一艘停泊在珠江岸边的巨轮，寓意满载岭南文化艺术宝盒；2024年2月被选为“广州十大文化地标”，4月28日正式启用，5月1日向公众开放。广东美术馆本馆1997年建成于二沙岛，是首批国家重点美术馆之一，藏品四万余件（套），以中国近现代美术、广东与沿海近现代美术、国际美术及当代艺术为收藏研究方向。白鹅潭馆区地上建筑11层，建筑面积6.5万平方米（不含公共区域），展陈面积2.5万平方米，拥有21个展厅和广阔的公共艺术区域，聚焦中国当代艺术与国际当代艺术生态研究，与二沙岛馆区（2.2万平方米、12个展厅）形成“一馆两区、错位发展”的格局；开馆推出“新时代·新跨越”等系列大展。开放时间为周二至周日9:00—17:00（16:30停止入馆），周一闭馆，法定节假日除外，两馆区均实行个人免预约入馆；咨询、（白鹅潭馆区），二沙岛本馆区。作为湾区级别的公立美术馆，它适合大型艺术展、学术论坛、品牌文化项目与开幕活动，展厅层高与荷载按美术馆标准配置。
intro_en: The Bai'etan venue of the Guangdong Museum of Art occupies 19 Bai'etan South Road in Liwan District, Guangzhou, forming the eastern wing of the Bai'etan Greater Bay Area Art Center, a three-in-one complex that also houses the Guangdong Intangible Cultural Heritage Museum and the Guangdong Literature Museum. The centre stands where three rivers meet at Bai'etan, designed by the team led by Academician He Jingtang, with about 145,000 square metres of floor area, more than 40,000 square metres of exhibition space and 35,000 square metres of shared public area; its form reads as an ocean liner moored on the Pearl River, carrying a cargo of Lingnan culture. It was named one of Guangzhou's ten cultural landmarks in February 2024, inaugurated on 28 April 2024 and opened to the public on 1 May. The museum's original building on Ersha Island dates from 1997 and is one of China's first key national art museums, holding more than 40,000 works and collecting modern and contemporary Chinese art, modern art of Guangdong and the coast, international art and contemporary practice. The Bai'etan building rises eleven storeys with 65,000 square metres excluding shared areas, 25,000 square metres of display space, twenty-one galleries and extensive public art areas, focused on Chinese and international contemporary art, while Ersha Island (22,000 square metres, twelve galleries) concentrates on modern Guangdong art, together forming a two-venue, differentiated programme. Opening shows included 'New Era, New Leap'. Hours are 9:00 to 17:00 Tuesday to Sunday, last entry 16:30, closed Monday except public holidays, and individual visitors no longer need to book; enquiries on or for Bai'etan and for Ersha Island. As a regional public museum it suits large exhibitions, academic forums, cultural brand projects and opening events, with gallery heights and floor loadings built to museum standards.

name_zh: 珠江琶醍啤酒文化创意艺术区
address: 广州市海珠区阅江西路磨碟沙大街118号
area_text: 园区用地约6.9万㎡
intro_zh: 珠江琶醍啤酒文化创意艺术区位于广州市海珠区阅江西路磨碟沙大街118号，坐落在珠江南岸琶洲段，前身是1985年建成投产的珠江啤酒厂——中国第一个引入国外全套设备与生产技术的啤酒工厂。2010年，为配合广州亚运会“一江两岸”景观整治，珠江啤酒启动厂区改造，由竖梁社等团队设计，把货运码头改造成可停靠游艇与观光游船的水上码头，把煤棚、麦芽筒仓等工业构筑物转化为演艺与展览空间，形成今天的啤酒文化创意艺术区。园区用地约6.9万平方米，保留了大量工业肌理，麦芽筒仓被用作城中建筑艺术展览场地，煤棚则改造为新型演艺空间。2016年珠江啤酒产能搬迁至南沙后，原厂址以“旧改+新建”方式继续更新，实施“啤酒厂1985”项目，聚集创意艺术、青年潮玩、时尚买手店、餐饮酒吧与网红打卡点，常年举办“超爱琶醍音乐派”“啤酒厂·潮流文化节”等主题活动。园区为国家AAA级旅游景区，7处核心物项列入首批广州市工业遗产名单，是广州夜经济与工业遗产活化的代表性场地。
intro_en: Zhujiang Party Pier Beer Culture and Art Zone occupies No. 118 Modisha Street, Yuejiang West Road, Haizhu District, Guangzhou, on the south bank of the Pearl River. Its predecessor is the Zhujiang Brewery, completed in 1985 as the first Chinese brewery to import a complete foreign production line and technology. In 2010, as Guangzhou prepared for the Asian Games and the city re-landscaped both riverbanks, the brewery began converting its old plant. The freight wharf became a water terminal for yachts and sightseeing boats, while the coal shed and malt silos were turned into performance and exhibition spaces. The zone covers about 69,000 square metres and keeps much of its industrial fabric: the malt silos now serve as a venue for urban and architectural art exhibitions, and the coal shed has become a new performing-arts space. After brewing moved to Nansha in 2016, the site continued to be redeveloped under the "Brewery 1985" project, mixing creative studios, youth fashion, buyer stores, bars and restaurants. It hosts recurring events such as the Party Pier music season and the Brewery Trend Culture Festival. A national AAA scenic area, the park has seven core structures listed in Guangzhou's first industrial heritage register and is a benchmark for nightlife-driven industrial regeneration.

address: 广州市白云区黄边北路时代玫瑰园三期（地铁2号线黄边站C出口）
area_text: 建筑面积约8,000平方米（第三方口径）；展厅位于住宅楼19层，主展厅屋顶75米×12米
intro_zh: 广东时代美术馆位于广州市白云区黄边北路时代玫瑰园三期，由时代中国（原时代地产）创办并持续资助，是华南地区第一座社区型美术馆。2003年，时代地产与广东美术馆合作设立广东美术馆时代分馆；2005年在“广州三年展”框架下，时任馆长王璜生与策展人侯瀚如、汉斯·乌尔里希·奥布里斯特邀请建筑师雷姆·库哈斯与阿兰·弗劳克斯参与“三角洲实验室”，为新馆设计永久空间；2010年12月31日，新馆落成并以独立机构身份向公众开放，建筑面积约8,000平方米。美术馆的功能分散在住宅楼的不同楼层：首层入口面向街道，设榕树头项目空间、咖啡厅与7.8米高的公共多功能厅；14层为办公区，由三个住宅单元改造；专用电梯穿过居民楼直达19层展厅，主展厅由75米×12米的轻质大屋顶覆盖，天窗引入天光，露台与玻璃房俯瞰广州北部的城乡结合部景观。2018年，时代中国资助在柏林设立平行机构时代艺术中心。美术馆以社区介入、委任创作与公共项目见长，2024年在资金调整后重新开放。开放时间为周二至周日10:30—18:30；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: Guangdong Times Museum is at Times Rose Garden Phase III on Huangbian North Road, Baiyun District, Guangzhou, founded and sustained by Times China, formerly Times Property. It is the first community-based art museum in southern China. In 2003 Times Property and the Guangdong Museum of Art set up a branch gallery in the residential estate; in 2005, within the Guangzhou Triennial, curator Hou Hanru and Hans Ulrich Obrist invited Rem Koolhaas and Alain Fouraux to design a permanent home through the Delta Laboratory project. The new building was completed and opened as an independent institution on 31 December 2010, with about 8,000 square metres of floor area reported by third parties. Its functions are dispersed through a residential tower: the street-level entrance holds the Banyan Tree project space, a café and a 7.8-metre-high multipurpose hall; the 14th floor contains offices converted from three flats; and a dedicated lift passes through the apartments to the 19th-floor galleries, where a lightweight roof of 75 by 12 metres covers the main hall, skylights bring in daylight and terraces and glass rooms look over Guangzhou's northern urban fringe. In 2018 Times China funded a parallel institution, Times Art Center Berlin. The museum is known for community engagement, commissions and public programmes, and reopened in 2024 after a funding adjustment. It opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10:30 to 18:30; telephone details are not included in this public dataset; public programmes are announced through the museum's public channels.

address: 广州市天河区员村四横路128号
area_text: 占地约17万平方米
status_note: 2019年11月闭园，建筑保留待活化，不可作为在营场地推荐
intro_zh: 红专厂艺术区位于广州市天河区员村四横路128号，前身为1956年筹建、1958年投产的广东罐头厂（鹰金钱罐头厂），是前苏联与中国经济合作的165个重点项目之一，也是当时亚洲最大的罐头厂，风靡亚洲的豆豉鲮鱼罐头最早在此生产。2008年，罐头厂响应“退二进三”政策迁往从化；2009年，天河区政府、鹰金钱集团与艺术家群体协商，由集美组将这片苏式红砖厂房、工业装置与旧铁路站台改造为广州首个非企业、非房地产驱动的国际化创意艺术区，取名“红专厂”（Redtory），一度有“北有798，南有红专厂”之誉，占地约17万平方米。园区聚集画廊、设计工作室、艺术空间与特色商业，红专厂当代艺术馆（RMCA）是其中核心机构。2019年11月21日，因广州国际金融城建设与十年租期到期，红专厂当代艺术馆及整个艺术园区关闭；按工业遗产保护利用方案，园区内54栋历史建筑予以保留，将活化为工业遗产公园。原官网redtory.com.cn已停止访问，所列电话为园区运营时期号码。该处已不再作为艺术区运营，收录与对外表述均须注明现状。
intro_en: Redtory occupied 128 Yuancun Siheng Road in Tianhe District, Guangzhou, on the site of the Guangdong Canned Food Factory, planned in 1956 and in production from 1958. The plant was one of 165 key Soviet-Chinese cooperation projects and became the largest cannery in Asia; the canned dace in black bean sauce that spread across Asia was first made here. In 2008 the factory moved to Conghua under the city's 'retreat secondary industry, advance tertiary industry' policy. In 2009 the district government, the Yiqianjin group and a group of artists agreed a ten-year lease, and the Jimei Group converted the Soviet-era red-brick workshops, industrial machinery and old railway platform into Redtory, Guangzhou's first creative art district not driven by developers, covering about 170,000 square metres. It gathered galleries, design studios, art spaces and cafes, with the Redtory Museum of Contemporary Art (RMCA) at its core, and was often described as '798 in the north, Redtory in the south'. On 21 November 2019, with the ten-year lease expiring and the Guangzhou International Financial City plan advancing, RMCA and the whole art park closed. Under the industrial heritage plan, 54 historic buildings are retained and are to be adaptively reused as a heritage park; the former official website is no longer reachable and the listed telephone number dates from the park's operating years. It should be listed as closed, not as an operating venue.

address: 广州市天河区珠江东路6号（周大福金融中心裙楼）
area_text: 总建筑面积约7万㎡，10层商业空间（地下2层、地上8层），艺术空间约800㎡
intro_zh: 广州K11购物艺术中心位于天河区珠江东路6号，坐落于530米高的周大福金融中心（广州东塔）裙楼，2018年3月31日开业，是继香港、上海、武汉之后K11在内地的第四座购物艺术中心。项目总建筑面积约7万平方米，商业部分共10层，地下2层、地上8层，自下而上按“食艺盛会、都会风行、设计变奏、活现风潮、穿在风尚、空间艺术、玩乐尽情、环亚食汇、景醉珍膳、匠心美馔”十个主题分层组织业态。艺术是这座商场的骨架：位于低层与四层的艺术空间合计约800平方米，长期陈列K11当代艺术收藏并轮换特展，西门入口的《梵高的耳朵》装置是开业以来的城市记忆点；室内设计提取岭南榕树气生根的意象，中庭与动线由此展开，建筑曾获A'Design设计奖铜奖。开业时引入20余家全国首店、30余家华南首店、50余家广州首店；2024年完成品牌升级，成为广州第二家重奢商场。地下连廊连通包括地铁3号线、5号线珠江新城站在内的三条轨道线路，天河CBD核心区内步行可达花城广场、广州图书馆与广东省博物馆。
intro_en: Guangzhou K11 Art Mall occupies the podium of the 530-metre Chow Tai Fook Finance Centre at 6 Zhujiang East Road in Tianhe District. It opened on 31 March 2018 as the fourth K11 in mainland China after Hong Kong, Shanghai and Wuhan. The scheme totals about 70,000 sq m over ten retail levels, two below ground and eight above, each given its own theme, from food halls and city fashion to design, sport, children's play, Asian dining and fine dining. Art is built into the structure: about 800 sq m of gallery space on the lower and fourth floors shows the K11 collection and rotating exhibitions, and the Van Gogh's Ear installation at the west entrance has become a local landmark since opening. The interior borrows the aerial roots of the banyan tree as its organising motif, and the building won a bronze at the A'Design Awards. At opening it brought more than 20 national firsts, over 30 firsts for South China and more than 50 for Guangzhou; a 2024 repositioning made it the city's second luxury-led mall. Underground passages connect three metro lines, including Line 3 and Line 5 at Zhujiang New Town, and Huacheng Square, the Guangzhou Library and the Guangdong Museum are all within walking distance in the CBD.

address: 广州市海珠区新港中路397号
area_text: 占地约9万㎡（另有资料称10万㎡）
intro_zh: TIT创意园位于海珠区新港中路397号，前身为1956年由20多家私营纺织机械厂公私合营组建、1969年迁至赤岗的广州纺织机械厂，园区占地约9万平方米，是广州旧厂房微改造的“元老”样本，2008年作为广州市和海珠区重点建设项目完成首期改造并开园。改造坚持“修旧如旧、建新如故”，保留红砖厂房、锯齿形屋架、铸造车间冲天炉鼓风机与退火炉旧址、老铁轨与原生古树，把纺织机械拆件翻新为景观小品与座椅；2021年，“广州纺织机械厂旧址”的装配车间、木模车间、布配和机械车间、机装车间、铆杆开料车间、退火炉6栋建筑列入广州市第七批历史建筑。园区以服装设计与时尚产业起步，后由科技互联网主导，微信全球总部即设于此，形成“文创+科创”的混合生态，年均入园打卡人次逾百万，是国家级优秀工业遗产保护利用示范案例。园区紧邻广州塔与新中轴线南段，与广州塔南广场连为一体，地铁3号线、8号线客村站步行数分钟可达，是市中心少见的园林式低密度园区。
intro_en: T.I.T Creative Park occupies 397 Xingang Middle Road in Haizhu District, on the site of the Guangzhou Textile Machinery Factory, formed in 1956 through a public-private merger of more than twenty small works and relocated to Chigang in 1969. The park covers roughly 90,000 sq m and is regarded as the elder statesman of Guangzhou's factory-conversion projects; it was a municipal and district priority project whose first phase was completed and opened in 2008. The renovation followed a repair-as-found approach, keeping red-brick workshops, sawtooth roofs, the cupola blower and annealing furnace of the casting shop, old rails and mature trees, and turning retired textile machinery into landscape pieces and benches. In 2021 six buildings — assembly, pattern, cloth and machinery, machine-fitting, riveting and the annealing furnace — were listed in the seventh batch of Guangzhou historic buildings. Apparel and fashion design started the park, but technology now leads it: WeChat's global headquarters sits inside, giving the site a mixed creative-tech ecosystem and more than a million visits a year, and it is a national demonstration case for industrial heritage reuse. The park adjoins Guangzhou Tower and the southern stretch of the new city axis, a few minutes' walk from Kecun station on metro lines 3 and 8, and remains one of the few low-density, garden-like campuses in the central city.

address: 广州市越秀区东湖路123号东山湖公园中岛湖1号
area_text: 官方未公布
intro_zh: 溯·榭映美术馆位于广州市越秀区东湖路123号东山湖公园中岛湖1号，四面环水，从公园拱桥进入。场馆于2021年12月28日正式开馆，依托公园中岛的既有建筑改造而成，设计保留岛上两棵大树，以“溯”为水、以“榭”为木、以“映”为光，建筑临水展开，廊道、露台与湖面视线相互穿插。整体由艺术空间、儿童艺术与娱乐区、餐饮轻食和文化沙龙几部分组成，既做当代艺术展览，也承接讲座、工作坊、小型演出与亲子活动，是东山湖公园更新中引入社会力量运营的文化节点。展厅为多层立体空间，白墙与大面积开窗并用，展线随楼梯和平台转折，观众在室内看展时可不断看到湖景与树冠；馆内曾举办“亲爱的‘野’小孩”自然保护公益艺术展、“给蝴蝶的情书”系列等展览，并常与广州本地美术馆、公益机构合作。场馆免费开放，展览期间通常需线上预约，部分展期延长至夜间。交通方面，可乘地铁6号线至东湖站B2口，出站即进入东山湖公园，步行经园内步道约十分钟到中岛；也可乘公交至东湖路站、东山湖公园站，周边停车位有限，建议公共交通前往。
intro_en: Su Xie Ying Art Museum occupies Island No. 1 in the middle of Dongshan Lake Park, at 123 Donghu Road in Yuexiu District, Guangzhou. The museum opened on 28 December 2021 in a converted park building and is reached by a bridge from the park shore. Its name plays on water, pavilion and light, and the design keeps two mature trees that grow through the site; galleries, corridors and terraces open directly onto the lake, so that visitors see water and canopy between works. The complex combines art galleries, a children's art and play area, a cafe and light-dining space, and a cultural salon, making it both an exhibition venue and a community cultural living room within one of Guangzhou's oldest public parks. The multi-level display spaces use white walls, large windows and changing floor levels; exhibitions have ranged from contemporary painting and installation to the nature-themed 'Wild Child' show and the 'Love Letters to Butterflies' series, often accompanied by talks, workshops and programmes for children and people with special needs. Admission is free, with online reservation usually required during exhibitions, and the museum sometimes stays open into the evening. Metro Line 6 stops at Donghu station, from where Exit B2 leads straight into Dongshan Lake Park and a ten-minute walk to the island; several bus routes stop nearby, but parking is limited.

address: 广州市海珠区沥滘路2号（振兴大街2号入口，瑞宝路与沥滘路交叉口，原大干围码头）
area_text: 总建筑面积约3.5万㎡（海珠区政府园区清单口径；建筑事务所口径3.2万㎡），由8栋厂房组成，占地约38亩
intro_zh: B.I.G海珠湾艺术园区位于广州市海珠区沥滘路2号，处在广州城市发展中轴线南端、珠江后航道的大干围码头一带，紧靠江岸，园区南侧拥有约200米宽的江景界面。场地前身是中化集团广州大干围仓库区，原为大型国有化工企业的原料储备与生产基地；企业搬迁后，八栋上世纪50年代典型的红砖结构工厂仓库被整体保留并改造，由cnS建筑事务所主持设计，2017年8月动工、2018年建成开园，业主为邦华地产。园区总建筑面积约3.5万平方米（海珠区政府2024年园区清单口径，建筑事务所公布为3.2万平方米），由8栋不同结构的厂房组成，具备独栋、平层与小高层等多种形态，定位为“临江艺术生态＋型动办公＋众创孵化”，业态包括创意办公、主题商业、精品公寓、多功能展厅与主题布展空间。空间组织上，设计打通园区内部首层、分离动静流线，形成三纵两横的街道与南面超大河景广场；主入口以炫彩玻璃包裹电梯井的“彩虹步梯”成为标志物，园区内还有树池电影大台阶、滑板宣讲台、拼贴篮球场、彩色玻璃拍照点等互动装置，并配套易建联篮球训练中心、五人足球场与环形慢跑道。交通上临近东晓南路、工业大道与环城高速，门口设公交总站与直通南洲、东晓南、沥滘地铁站的穿梭巴士。适合品牌快闪、潮流发布、艺术展览与滨水户外活动。
intro_en: B.I.G Haizhuwan Art Park occupies 2 Lijiao Road in Haizhu District, at the southern end of Guangzhou's main urban axis, on the Daganwei wharf stretch of the Pearl River's rear channel. The site was formerly the Guangzhou Daganwei warehouse yard of Sinochem Group, a raw-material reserve and production base for a large state-owned chemical enterprise; after the company relocated, eight 1950s red-brick factory warehouses were kept and converted by cnS Architects, with work running from August 2017 to completion in 2018 for developer Bravo Group. The park covers roughly 35,000 square metres of floor area by the Haizhu district government's 2024 park list (the architects publish 32,000 square metres) across eight buildings of differing structure, offering stand-alone blocks, flat floors and low-rise volumes. Its positioning combines riverside art ecology, active office space and incubation, with creative offices, themed retail, serviced apartments, a multi-purpose exhibition hall and event floors. The plan opens the ground floors, separates pedestrian and service flows and creates three vertical and two horizontal streets plus a large river-view plaza on the south side; the rainbow glass stair wrapping the lift shaft marks the main entrance, and the grounds include stepped cinema seating around tree pits, a skate podium, a patchwork basketball court and coloured-glass photo points, alongside a Yi Jianlian basketball training centre, a five-a-side pitch and a running loop. East Xiaonan Road, Gongye Avenue and the ring expressway are close by, and a shuttle links the gate to Nanzhou, Dongxiaonan and Lijiao metro stations, making the park workable for brand pop-ups, fashion launches and waterfront events.

address: 广州市荔湾区沿江西路43号（西堤，近粤海关旧址与南方大厦）
area_text: 建筑面积1,740㎡；展陈面积约1,500㎡，设三大展厅
status_note: 2024年11月起围蔽修缮，2026年3月进场施工，计划年底完工，期间不开放
intro_zh: 广州邮政博物馆（广州邮政博览馆）位于广州市荔湾区沿江西路43号，坐落在西堤一带、珠江东岸，与粤海关旧址（大钟楼）、南方大厦、塔影楼共同构成广州最集中的近代公共建筑群。大楼所在地在清光绪二十三年（1897年）即为大清邮局，原建筑1912年11月9日毁于火灾；1913年广东国税厅筹备处将该址拨给粤海关扩建邮政新局，由英国工程师设计，1916年建成开业，邮政业务最初由粤海关兼管，1918年由广东邮务管理局接管。1938年广州沦陷时西堤大火，楼内门窗、地板全部焚毁，1939年由杨永堂主持，在保持原结构与外轮廓不变的前提下修复，1942年1月完工；1945年10月黎仪桑出任局长，结束了外国人主管中国邮政的历史。建筑坐北向南，平面呈梯形，古典欧式风格，南面主楼三层半（半层为地下室）、高18米，北楼为副楼，建筑面积1,740平方米，黄褐色花岗岩基座与巨大廊柱是西堤天际线的标志。1999年列为广州市文物保护单位，2002年5月13日辟为邮政博览馆对外开放，同年7月晋升第四批广东省文物保护单位（编号4-103）。展陈面积约1,500平方米，一楼为集邮展销中心，二楼展示中国邮政通信发展与广州邮政历史变迁，三楼展示广州邮政发展历程与未来。2023年4月曾举办卡地亚“寻踪豹影”猎豹主题展；2024年11月起启动修缮，计划活化为展陈、演出、发布空间，重启时间以业主公告为准。
intro_en: The Guangzhou Postal Museum occupies 43 Yanjiang West Road in Liwan District, on the Xidi stretch of the Pearl River waterfront, alongside the old Canton Customs House with its clock tower, the Nanfang Building and Taying Lou, forming the densest cluster of modern public buildings in the city. The site was already the Great Qing post office in 1897; the original building burned down on 9 November 1912, and in 1913 the premises were assigned to Canton Customs to build a new postal headquarters, designed by a British engineer, completed and opened in 1916. Postal business was first managed by Customs and taken over by the Guangdong Postal Administration in 1918. During the fall of Guangzhou in 1938 a fire on Xidi destroyed doors, windows and floors; Yang Yongtang led a restoration from 1939 that kept the structure and external appearance, finished in January 1942, and in October 1945 Li Yisang became director, ending foreign management of Chinese postal services. The building faces south on a trapezoidal plan in classical European style: the main south block is three and a half storeys (half a level below ground) at 18 metres, with a two-storey north annex, and 1,740 square metres of floor area, its yellow-brown granite base and giant colonnade a fixture of the Xidi skyline. Listed as a municipal heritage site in 1999, it opened as a postal museum on 13 May 2002 and became a provincial protected site (4-103) that July. About 1,500 square metres of display area holds three halls: stamp retail on the ground floor, China's postal communications and Guangzhou's postal history on the second, and the service's development on the third. Cartier's Panthère exhibition ran here in April 2023; renovation began in November 2024 to convert the building for exhibitions, performances and launches, and reopening should be confirmed with the owner.

address: 成都市天府新区麓山大道二段18号麓镇山顶广场
area_text: 总面积约4200平方米；另有A4X艺术中心（麓湖艺展中心）
intro_zh: A4美术馆位于成都市天府新区麓山大道二段18号麓镇山顶广场，2008年由成都万华投资集团创办，2016年7月正式注册为民办非营利美术馆，2023年主馆从麓湖迁至麓镇并完成由天仝建筑主持的改造，场馆总面积约4200平方米，坐落于具有托斯卡纳风格的麓镇山顶广场。美术馆另设A4X艺术中心，位于天府大道麓湖生态城艺展中心，由美国建筑师安托内·普雷多克设计。A4以“用艺术连接人与人，激活创造力”为理念，聚焦国际与在地艺术交流、新媒介艺术与社区艺术，形成A4美术馆、A4儿童馆、A4国际驻留艺术中心与A4X艺术中心四个品牌；创办iSTART儿童艺术节、青年艺术家实验季、青年策展人计划、社区艺术季等项目，与近500位艺术家、40余位策展人及28个机构合作，举办80余场展览和近2000场活动。开放时间通常为周二至周日10:00-18:00。A4美术馆同时是成都当代艺术生态的重要节点，持续支持西南青年艺术家创作与策展实践。
intro_en: A4 Art Museum is at the hilltop plaza of Luzhen, 18 Section 2 of Lushan Avenue, Tianfu New Area, Chengdu. Founded in 2008 by Chengdu Wanhua Investment Group, it registered in July 2016 as a non-profit private museum and moved its main venue from Luhu to Luzhen in 2023 after a renovation led by TianTong Architecture; the museum covers about 4,200 square metres in a Tuscan-style hilltop setting. A second venue, A4X Art Center, occupies the Luhu Eco-City exhibition centre on Tianfu Avenue, designed by American architect Antoine Predock. A4's mission is to connect people and activate creativity through art, with a programme focused on international and local exchange, new media and community art. It now operates four brands: A4 Art Museum, A4 Kids, the A4 International Residency Art Center and A4X Art Center, and runs the iSTART Children's Art Festival, the Young Artists Experimental Season, the Young Curators Programme and community art seasons. It has worked with nearly 500 artists, more than 40 curators and 28 institutions, staging over 80 exhibitions and close to 2,000 events. It generally opens Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00-18:00; telephone . It is also a key node in Chengdu's contemporary art ecology, backing younger southwest artists and curators. The move to Luzhen marked a new phase in its community-based work.

address: 成都市金牛区中环路金府路段府河摄影公园东侧
area_text: 建筑面积7500平方米，6个专业展厅
intro_zh: 成都当代影像馆位于成都市金牛区中环路金府路段府河摄影公园东侧，2019年4月27日正式开馆，是专注于当代摄影与影像艺术的美术馆。影像馆坐落于国内首个以摄影为主题的公园——府河摄影公园核心位置，公园占地150亩，馆舍建筑面积7500平方米，设6个专业展厅、1个学术报告厅、1个专业影像图书馆及多个公共教育空间。机构与全球影像艺术机构合作，围绕高品质展览、学术研究、公共教育与视觉素养展开工作，并设立威廉·克莱因摄影奖，持续推动中国影像状态观测与国际对话。馆藏与档案侧重摄影史与当代影像实践，影像图书馆对公众开放。开放时间为周二至周日10:00-18:00（17:00停止入场），周一闭馆，法定节假日正常开馆。场馆位于北三环内、府河河畔，可经中环路金府路段抵达。影像馆举办成都国际影像艺术大展等公共项目，并开展导览、工作坊与讲座。
intro_en: Chengdu Contemporary Image Museum stands on the eastern side of Fuhe Photography Park, Jinfu Road section of the Middle Ring Road, Jinniu District, Chengdu. It opened on 27 April 2019 as a museum devoted to contemporary photography and moving image. The museum occupies the core of Fuhe Photography Park, the first park in China themed around photography, which covers 150 mu; the building has 7,500 square metres of floor area, six dedicated galleries, a lecture theatre, a specialist image library and several public education spaces. It works with leading photographic institutions internationally on exhibitions, academic research and public programmes, and awards the William Klein Prize, positioning itself as a place to observe the state of Chinese photography and to foster dialogue at home and abroad. Its collection and archive focus on the history of photography and contemporary image practice, and the library is open to visitors. Opening hours are Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00-18:00, with last entry at 17:00; it closes on Mondays but opens on public holidays. Telephone and email are not included in this public dataset. The site lies inside the North Third Ring Road beside the Fuhe River. Its Chengdu International Image Art Exhibition, together with tours, workshops and talks, brings photography to wider audiences. The riverside park setting also allows outdoor installations alongside the indoor galleries.

address: 成都市天府新区新兴镇蓝顶艺术新村蓝顶3号坡地（新馆）；锦江区三圣乡荷塘月色A区蓝顶2号坡地（老馆）
area_text: 总建筑面积6000余平方米，4个展厅，展厅面积约2000平方米
intro_zh: 成都蓝顶美术馆坐落于成都市天府新区、锦江区与龙泉驿区交界处的蓝顶当代艺术园区，2009年1月随蓝顶艺术区二号坡地落成而开馆，2012年新馆启用。美术馆依托2003年形成的蓝顶艺术家群落，是一家民营非营利机构，新馆由中国建筑师刘家琨设计，总建筑面积6000余平方米，含4个独立展厅，展厅面积约2000平方米，另有广场、多媒体放映厅、多功能厅、书吧与雕塑展示区。馆藏以中国西南当代艺术家的绘画、装置与新媒体作品为特色，藏有罗中立、何多苓、周春芽等艺术家作品。美术馆承办一年一度的成都蓝顶艺术节，并推出青年艺术家驻村与公共教育项目。老馆位于锦江区三圣乡荷塘月色A区蓝顶2号坡地，新馆位于天府新区新兴镇蓝顶艺术新村蓝顶3号坡地，两馆步行约7分钟；开放时间周二至周日10:00-17:00。美术馆所在的蓝顶艺术区聚集上百位艺术家工作室，形成创作、展示与交易一体的群落。
intro_en: Blue Roof Museum of Chengdu sits in the Blue Roof contemporary art park where Tianfu New Area, Jinjiang District and Longquanyi District meet. It opened in January 2009 as the second hillside phase of the Blue Roof art district was completed, and a new building followed in 2012. The museum grew out of the Blue Roof artists' colony that formed in 2003 and is a private, non-profit institution. The new building was designed by Chinese architect Liu Jiakun and has more than 6,000 square metres of floor area with four independent galleries totalling about 2,000 square metres, plus a plaza, screening room, multi-function hall, book bar and sculpture grounds. The collection focuses on painting, installation and new media by artists from southwest China, including works by Luo Zhongli, He Duoling and Zhou Chunya. The museum hosts the annual Chengdu Blue Roof Art Festival and runs residencies for young artists and public education programmes. The old venue is at Blue Roof Slope 2, Hetang Yuese Area A, Sansheng Township, Jinjiang District; the new venue is at Blue Roof Slope 3, Blue Roof Art New Village, Xinxing Township, Tianfu New Area, about seven minutes' walk apart. It opens Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00-17:00; telephone . The surrounding Blue Roof art district gathers more than a hundred artist studios, linking production, exhibition and the art trade.

address: 四川省成都市新津区君山路1号
area_text: 总建筑面积2353平方米，地上3层、地下1层
intro_zh: 知美术馆位于四川省成都市新津区君山路1号、老君山脚下，由日本建筑师隈研吾设计，总建筑面积2353平方米，地上三层、地下一层。建筑以“光与水”为主题，外立面用当地传统工艺烧制的瓦片以不锈钢丝固定成通透瓦屏，配合浅水面与庭院，使建筑像从山体中生长出来；视觉识别系统由原研哉设计，瓦片纹理化为水波纹样。美术馆2013年由知·艺术馆更名，2014年举办首个展览，2016年成为成都市民政局认证的民办非企业单位，2018年4月以“开”展重新开馆，2022年开放附空间“知美山谷”。机构以“万物、见解、常新”为理念，在当代艺术国际语境中探讨东方美学的过去、现在与未来，关注新媒体艺术与跨学科实践。开放时间周二至周日10:00-17:00，票务咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道，官网www.zhiartmuseum.com。馆内展厅围绕中庭展开，参观动线随坡地起伏，瓦屏过滤的光线本身成为展览的一部分。美术馆亦与国内外机构合作办展，并开展驻留与公共教育。
intro_en: ZHI Art Museum is at 1 Junshan Road, Xinjin District, Chengdu, at the foot of Laojun Mountain, a Taoist site. Designed by Japanese architect Kengo Kuma, it has 2,353 square metres of floor area over three storeys above ground and one below. The theme is light and water: locally made tiles, fixed with stainless steel wire into a permeable screen, wrap the façade, while shallow water and courtyards let the building appear to grow from the hillside. The visual identity was designed by Kenya Hara, who turned the tile pattern into rippling water lines. The institution was renamed from Zhi Art Gallery in 2013, held its first exhibition in 2014, registered as a non-enterprise private unit with the Chengdu civil affairs authorities in 2016 and reopened in April 2018 with the exhibition “Open”; a subsidiary space, Zhi Mei Valley, opened in 2022. Its philosophy of “all things, insight, constant renewal” frames an exploration of Eastern aesthetics past, present and future within international contemporary art, with a focus on new media and interdisciplinary practice. It opens Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00-17:00; ticket enquiries on or ; website www.zhiartmuseum.com. Galleries unfold around a central court, the route following the slope, with light filtered through the tile screen becoming part of the display. The museum also co-organises exhibitions with institutions at home and abroad and runs residencies and public programmes.

address: 四川省成都市锦江区二环路东五段299号（东湖公园内）
area_text: 场馆面积未公开；配套成都艺术品保税仓库建筑面积3,300㎡
intro_zh: 红美术馆位于成都市锦江区二环路东五段299号东湖公园内，是锦江区以“休闲旅游业+文化阵地”思路引入民间资本打造的公共文化空间。2014年，锦江区在东湖公园内建成西部唯一的艺术品保税仓库，并配套建设展示交流中心——红美术馆；运营主体成都市锦江区红石美术馆于2015年6月登记设立，因此场馆的对外服务自2014至2015年间陆续展开。保税仓库建筑面积3,300平方米，设保税仓储区、保税展览区、海关监管办公区与艺术家交流中心四大功能区，使境外艺术品可在“境内关外”状态下完成保税展示与交易，红美术馆则承担面向公众的展览与美育职能。场馆临东湖水面，展厅以白墙与自然采光为主，尺度适合中型绘画、影像与装置展。开馆以来承办“东湖跨年艺术季”系列展览，包括2016年“新映像——中国光影艺术展映”、“原乡”双廊白族农民画展等，并配套讲座、市集、现场写生与艺术沙龙；锦江区每年依托包括红美术馆在内的场馆举办百余场公益艺术活动。周边为东湖公园绿道与锦华路商圈，公交可达，园内步行可串联域上和美艺术馆等机构。
intro_en: The Red Art Museum stands at 299, Section 5, Second Ring Road East in Jinjiang District, Chengdu, on the edge of Donghu Park. It is a public cultural space created by the district through its policy of pairing leisure tourism with cultural facilities and bringing private capital into a municipal park. In 2014 Jinjiang built western China's first bonded art warehouse in the park and added an exhibition and exchange centre beside it, the Red Art Museum. The operating entity, Chengdu Jinjiang Red Stone Art Museum, was registered in June 2015, so public programmes began across 2014 and 2015. The bonded warehouse covers 3,300 sq m with four zones, namely bonded storage, bonded exhibition, customs supervision and an artists' exchange centre, allowing overseas works to be shown and traded under an "inside the border, outside customs" regime, while the museum handles exhibitions and public education. Galleries are white-walled and daylit, scaled for mid-sized painting, video and installation shows. The museum has hosted the Donghu New Year Art Season, including the 2016 light-and-image exhibition and a Bai ethnic folk painting show from Shuanglang, plus talks, markets and sketching events; the district runs more than a hundred public art events a year across its venues. Donghu Park's greenway and the Jinhua Road commercial area are close by.

name_zh: 西村大院及西村艺术空间
address: 成都市青羊区贝森北路1号
area_text: 西村大院总建筑面积135,552㎡（街廓237m×178m，限高24m，5—6层）；西村艺术空间为院内多功能艺术空间
intro_zh: 西村大院位于成都市青羊区贝森北路1号，是建筑师刘家琨主持、家琨建筑设计事务所设计的一座非传统城市综合体，业主为四川迈伦实业有限责任公司。项目用地为东西长237米、南北长178米的完整街廓，四面临街、住宅环绕，用地性质为社区体育服务用地，容积率2.0、覆盖率40%、限高24米；2010年4月动工，2015年1月建成，总建筑面积135,552平方米，5至6层，高24米。设计一反中心体量集合的常规，采用“外环内空”的布局：建筑沿街廓边缘围合，中间留出公园般的超大院落，大、中、小竹林院落层层相套并向公众开放，延续成都人竹下休闲的生活方式。一条架空休闲跑道绕大院一圈并攀升至屋顶，跑步与骑行的人可以连续绕行，跑道也成为建筑最具辨识度的动态形象。功能上混合运动休闲、文化艺术与时尚创意：中庭是球场与综合景观，环形建筑内是餐饮、零售、办公与工作室，北侧保留的原有建筑被改造为多功能艺术空间——西村艺术空间。西村艺术空间自2010年起持续办展，首届西南地区高等院校毕业生艺术作品联展展出9所院校近80名毕业生的200多件作品，此后举办“跨界—颠覆”艺术家与设计师邀请展、2023年“星光国潮文创展”等。西村大院2016年入选第15届威尼斯建筑双年展主题馆，2025年刘家琨获普利兹克建筑奖后成为建筑参观热点；大院获首批“四川省五星级体育服务综合体”；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: West Village (Xicun) occupies 1 Beisen North Road in Qingyang District, Chengdu: an unconventional urban complex designed by Liu Jiakun and his office Jiakun Architects for Sichuan Mailun Industrial. The site is a complete block 237 metres east to west and 178 metres north to south, ringed by streets and mature housing, zoned for community sports use with a plot ratio of 2.0, 40 per cent coverage and a 24 metre height limit; construction ran from April 2010 to January 2015, producing 135,552 square metres over five and six storeys at 24 metres. Instead of the usual central mass, the design rings the block and leaves the middle open as a park-like courtyard: large, medium and small bamboo courtyards nest inside one another and stay open to the public, continuing Chengdu's habit of leisure under bamboo. An elevated running track loops the complex and climbs to the roof to circle it, giving runners and cyclists a continuous route and the building its most recognisable dynamic form. Programmes mix sport and leisure with culture and creative industry: the central court holds pitches and landscape, the ring holds food, retail, offices and studios, and the existing building kept on the north edge was converted into a multi-purpose art space, Xicun Art Space. That space has shown continuously since 2010, when the first Southwest Graduates Art Exhibition brought over 200 works by nearly 80 graduates of nine colleges; later shows include the 'Crossover–Subversion' artists-and-designers invitational and the 2023 Starlight Guochao cultural-creative exhibition. West Village was selected for the main exhibition of the 15th Venice Architecture Biennale in 2016, became an architecture pilgrimage after Liu Jiakun won the Pritzker Prize in 2025, and holds Sichuan's first five-star sports service complex rating. Enquiries go through the venue's public channels.

address: 成都市锦江区南纱帽街77号盈嘉大厦（盈嘉·赢家）5—6楼，太古里商圈
area_text: 总面积约2,400㎡；5楼室内展览约1,000㎡、室外坡道约400㎡，6楼约280㎡
intro_zh: 月涌艺术中心（HMAC，Harvest Moon Art Centre）位于成都市锦江区南纱帽街77号盈嘉大厦5至6楼，处在春熙路与太古里两大商圈的交界处，正对IFS、面朝太古里，脚下就是那块面积888平方米、常年上热搜的裸眼3D大屏。场馆由布道空间设计，2023年设计、2024年完成5至6楼的改造（此前场地已作为艺术空间运营），业主为四川川发瑞丰投资有限公司，艺术总监为谢晓影。它的前身是一座位处五层停车楼里的车库：设计把原本一位难求的车位改成当代艺术馆，尽可能以低成本、小动作满足展览与时尚创意活动的多样需求；原来的车行坡道被保留为“序廊”，成为进入艺术馆的必经通道，坡道左侧是老城住区的日常烟火，右侧是白盒子展厅，新旧快慢并置。场馆总面积约2,400平方米，包含展览空间、室外公共艺术平台、艺术商店与VIP室：5楼室内展览面积约1,000平方米，配VIP室、盥洗室与办公室，可办展览、发布会、文化沙龙与论坛；室外坡道约400平方米，高柱投下的光影随时段变化；6楼约280平方米，设专业展厅，适合主题展览与品牌活动。运营上强调“浪潮、多变、融合”，把商业与艺术放在同一个空间逻辑里，品牌活动可搭配太古里裸眼3D大屏使用。2024年6月5日世界环境日，中国银联“低头捡星光”环保艺术展在此开幕。咨询与预约请经所在盈嘉·赢家大厦的公开渠道。
intro_en: Harvest Moon Art Centre (HMAC) occupies the fifth and sixth floors of Yingjia Mansion at 77 Nan Shaomao Street in Jinjiang District, Chengdu, where the Chunxi Road and Taikoo Li retail districts meet, facing IFS and Taikoo Li and sitting directly above the 888 square metre naked-eye 3D screen that regularly trends on Chinese social media. Redesigned by Budao Space Design in 2023 and completed in 2024 for Sichuan Chuanfa Ruifeng Investment, with Xie Xiaoying as art director, on levels that had already been used as an art space, the venue began as a five-storey car park: the design turned hard-to-find parking bays into a contemporary art museum with minimal cost and intervention, keeping the original vehicle ramp as a processional corridor into the galleries. Along that ramp, everyday life in the old neighbourhood sits on one side and white-cube exhibition space on the other, staging the collision of old and new, slow and fast. The centre totals about 2,400 square metres, including exhibition space, an outdoor public art platform, an art shop and a VIP room. On level five, roughly 1,000 square metres of indoor exhibition area comes with a VIP room, washrooms and offices for exhibitions, launches, salons and forums; outside, a 400 square metre ramp terrace is animated by shifting light between tall columns; level six adds about 280 square metres of dedicated gallery for themed shows and brand events. The programme is framed as tide, change and fusion, treating commerce and art within one spatial logic, and brand events can pair the venue with the Taikoo Li 3D screen. On World Environment Day, 5 June 2024, China UnionPay opened its 'Bend Down for Starlight' environmental art exhibition here. Enquiries go through Yingjia Mansion's public channels.

address: 杭州市西湖区天目山路398号天目里1号楼
area_text: 位于天目里园区（总建筑面积约23万平方米）中心1号楼，馆舍面积未公开
intro_zh: BY ART MATTERS 天目里美术馆位于杭州市西湖区天目山路398号天目里园区1号楼，2021年12月25日正式向公众开放，是杭州第一家当代艺术馆。天目里由普利兹克奖得主伦佐·皮亚诺及其建筑工作室设计，园区总建筑面积约23万平方米，17栋单体建筑围合出中央广场、水镜广场与花园；美术馆占据园区中心位置，由皮亚诺团队按世界美术馆标准打造。开馆展“从无到有”由馆长弗朗切斯科·博纳米策划，汇集三十余位中外艺术家。美术馆以展览、驻留、公共活动与公共艺术为四条主线，馆外散落理查德·朗、里克力·提拉瓦尼等艺术家的永久委任作品，并把活动延伸到露台、桥下与街区。馆内设展厅、图书馆、档案馆与驻留空间，关注艺术在生产与生活之间的连接。开放时间为周二至周日12:00-20:00（19:30停止入馆），周一闭馆，法定节假日照常开放；参观需购票，可乘公交至天目山路古墩路口站或府苑新村站。
intro_en: BY ART MATTERS is the contemporary art museum inside the OōEli complex at 398 Tianmushan Road, Xihu District, Hangzhou, in Building No. 1 at the centre of the site. It opened to the public on 25 December 2021 and is described as Hangzhou's first contemporary art museum. OōEli was designed by Pritzker laureate Renzo Piano and his Building Workshop; the 230,000-square-metre complex consists of 17 buildings arranged around a central plaza, a water-mirror square and gardens. The museum occupies the central building, built to international gallery standards, and its inaugural exhibition, “A Show About Nothing”, was curated by director Francesco Bonami with more than thirty Chinese and international artists. Its programme runs across exhibitions, residencies, public events and public art: permanent commissions by Richard Long and Rirkrit Tiravanija sit in the landscape and on the roof terrace, and activities spill into the bridges, streets and public spaces of the complex. Inside are galleries, a library, an archive and residency spaces, with an emphasis on the relationship between art, work and daily life. Opening hours are Tuesday to Sunday, 12:00-20:00, with last entry at 19:30; it closes on Mondays but opens on public holidays. Tickets are required, and buses stop at Tianmushan Road Gudun Road Junction and Fuyuan Xincun.

address: 浙江省杭州市南山路138号
area_text: 占地3.5万平方米，建筑面积3.2万平方米，展厅面积7000平方米
intro_zh: 浙江美术馆坐落于杭州市南山路138号、西子湖畔，毗邻万松岭，占地3.5万平方米，建筑面积3.2万平方米。美术馆由习近平同志在浙江工作时亲自选址、参加奠基并按下开工按钮，2009年8月正式向公众开放。馆内设14个不同规格展厅，其中5个为恒温恒湿展厅，展厅面积7000平方米，库房区3000平方米，另配中央大厅、国际学术报告厅、多功能厅、鉴赏厅、美术图书文献中心、儿童美术天地、美术书店、咖啡吧等。美术馆以“重在当代、兼顾历史，立足浙江、面向世界”为方向，围绕浙江近现代美术史展开收藏、研究与陈列。2009年成为全国美术馆专业委员会首批会员馆，2011年加入国际现当代美术馆协会，2015年成为国家重点美术馆，2022年成为国家4A级旅游景区。开放时间周二至周日9:00-17:00，周一休馆，法定节假日照常开放。馆内围绕浙江近现代美术史组织馆藏陈列，并逐年推出学术专题展与国内外交流展。
intro_en: Zhejiang Art Museum stands at 138 Nanshan Road, Hangzhou, on the shore of West Lake beside Wansongling. The site covers 35,000 square metres and the building 32,000 square metres. The museum was sited personally by Xi Jinping during his work in Zhejiang, who attended the foundation ceremony and pressed the button to start construction; it opened to the public in August 2009. Inside are 14 galleries of different sizes, five of them climate-controlled, giving 7,000 square metres of exhibition space, alongside a 3,000-square-metre storage area, a central hall, an international lecture theatre, a multi-function room, a connoisseurship room, an art library and document centre, a children's art area, a bookshop and a café. Its direction is “contemporary first, history included; rooted in Zhejiang, facing the world”, and its research and collection programme centres on modern and contemporary art in Zhejiang. It became a founding member of the national art museum committee in 2009, joined CIMAM in 2011, was designated a national key art museum in 2015 and became a national 4A scenic area in 2022. It opens Tuesday to Sunday, 9:00-17:00, closed Mondays except public holidays; telephone . Displays drawn from the collection trace modern Zhejiang art history, while the annual programme mixes research exhibitions with international loans. The lakeside site is a short walk from the China Academy of Art and the West Lake scenic area.

address: 浙江省杭州市上城区南山路216号（中国美术学院南山校区）
area_text: 建筑面积约8700平方米，共5层（含地下一层）
intro_zh: 中国美术学院美术馆位于杭州市上城区南山路216号中国美术学院南山校区，毗邻西湖，其前身国立艺术院陈列馆于1935年由蔡元培先生发起、林风眠先生亲自督建，是中国美术教育与艺术运动的重要现场。美术馆现为5层（含地下一层）、建筑面积约8700平方米的场馆，2022年9月完成改造提升，展厅实现恒温恒湿，并配套报告厅、藏品库、公共教育与文创空间。2015年获批文化部“国家重点美术馆”（全国共13家），2017年成为首批文化创意产品开发试点单位，并为国际现当代美术馆联盟（CIMAM）成员。美术馆以“培养艺术人才、倡导艺术运动、促进社会美育”为宗旨，收藏以国立艺术院以来师生作品、近现代中国美术与设计文献为特色，展览强调历史调查与当下学术议题的双向连接。开放时间9:00-17:00，前台，参观需预约，具体以官网公告为准。美术馆围绕校史与藏品持续开展研究性展览与公共教育，兼及设计、影视与跨媒介创作。
intro_en: The Art Museum of China Academy of Art occupies the Nanshan campus at 216 Nanshan Road, Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, beside West Lake. Its predecessor, the National Academy of Art exhibition hall, was initiated by Cai Yuanpei in 1935 and built under the supervision of Lin Fengmian, making the site a key location in Chinese art education and the modern art movement. The museum now has five levels including one basement and about 8,700 square metres of floor area; a renovation completed in September 2022 added climate control to the galleries and renewed the lecture hall, storage, public education and design retail spaces. It was designated a national key art museum by the Ministry of Culture in 2015, one of thirteen nationwide, became one of the first pilot units for cultural and creative product development in 2017, and is a member of CIMAM. Its mission is to train artists, advocate art movements and promote public art education, with collections built around works by teachers and students since the National Academy of Art, modern and contemporary Chinese art and design archives. Exhibitions are framed around historical research and current academic questions. It opens 9:00-17:00; reception telephone ; advance booking is required, with details on the official website. Research exhibitions and public programmes draw on the academy's history and collection, and extend to design, film and interdisciplinary work.

address: 杭州市余杭区滨河南路与玉鸟路交叉口西北150米（良渚文化村）
area_text: 占地2万余平方米，巨大屋顶下分展示、教育、文化三栋
intro_zh: 良渚文化艺术中心位于杭州市余杭区良渚文化村，滨河南路与玉鸟路交叉口西北侧，占地2万余平方米，由普利兹克奖得主、日本建筑师安藤忠雄设计，2016年6月5日正式开馆，被村民昵称为“大屋顶”。建筑以一整片巨大屋顶覆盖三个功能区块：南侧为具备美术馆功能的展示区，中部为小剧场、书店与咖啡馆，北侧为文化互动空间；三栋建筑在屋顶下呈“三”字布局。清水混凝土、三角形天窗与浅水面是主要建筑语汇，四周种植樱花林，光影随时间在室内变化。2018年3月，高晓松发起的公益图书馆“晓书馆”在中心内开放，使它从社区文化设施扩展为城市级文化平台；“大屋顶文化”品牌也由此起步，运营展览、戏剧、电影、音乐与讲座。中心开放时间10:00-21:00（20:30停止入场），参观免费，周边有良渚博物院与良渚古城遗址公园。中心同时承接良渚文化村的社区活动，是周边居民日常阅读、观展与观演的场所。
intro_en: Liangzhu Culture and Art Center sits in Liangzhu Culture Village, Yuhang District, Hangzhou, at the north-west corner of the Binhe South Road and Yuniao Road junction. Covering more than 20,000 square metres, it was designed by Pritzker laureate Tadao Ando and opened on 5 June 2016; villagers call it the “Big Roof”. A single vast roof shelters three functional blocks: an exhibition wing with museum functions to the south, a small theatre, bookshop and café in the middle, and cultural interaction space to the north, the three volumes arranged in a zigzag under the canopy. Fair-faced concrete, triangular skylights and shallow water define the architecture, with a cherry grove around the building and changing light patterns inside through the day. In March 2018 the Xiao Shu Library, a public library initiated by Gao Xiaosong, opened inside, helping the centre grow from a community facility into a city-wide cultural platform; the “Big Roof” cultural brand that began here now runs exhibitions, theatre, film, music and talks. It is open 10:00-21:00 with last entry at 20:30, admission is free. The Liangzhu Museum and the Liangzhu Ancient City archaeological park are nearby. It also serves as the everyday cultural living room for Liangzhu Culture Village, hosting readings, screenings and community events alongside its city-wide programme.

address: 浙江省杭州市上城区玉皇山路73-1号（西子湖畔、玉皇山北麓）
intro_zh: 中国丝绸博物馆位于杭州市上城区玉皇山路73-1号，西子湖畔、玉皇山北麓，1992年2月26日建成开放，是第一座全国性丝绸专业博物馆，也是世界上规模最大的丝绸专题博物馆，现为国家一级博物馆、浙江省省属事业单位。馆区占地42,286平方米，建筑面积22,999平方米（1992年建馆初期为8,000平方米，陈列面积3,000平方米，2015—2016年改扩建后形成现有规模），2004年1月1日起对公众免费开放。基本陈列以丝绸五千年为主线，设序厅、历史文物厅、蚕丝厅、染织厅、现代成就厅，并逐步扩展出时装馆、织造馆、修复馆与锦绣广场；藏品覆盖新石器时代的织机部件、汉唐织锦、宋元绫罗、明清补服到当代设计师作品。博物馆同时是纺织品文物保护的重镇：2000年成立中国纺织品鉴定保护中心，2010年获批纺织品文物保护国家文物局重点科研基地，具备实验室考古与丝蛋白分析能力。建筑群依山就势，白墙灰瓦与江南园林穿插，社教区设有蚕桑体验与手工织造课程。地铁7号线吴山广场站转31、42、314路公交可达，距西湖景区南线约十分钟车程。
intro_en: The China National Silk Museum stands at 73-1 Yuhuangshan Road in Shangcheng District, Hangzhou, beside West Lake at the northern foot of Yuhuang Hill. It opened on 26 February 1992 as the first national silk museum and is the largest silk museum in the world; it is now a Grade One national museum. The site covers 42,286 sq m with 22,999 sq m of buildings — the original 1992 building offered 8,000 sq m, including 3,000 sq m of display space, before the 2015-2016 expansion — and admission has been free since 1 January 2004. The permanent displays follow five thousand years of silk through a prologue hall, historical relics, sericulture, dyeing and weaving, and modern achievements, extended over time by a fashion gallery, weaving gallery, conservation studio and the Jinxiu plaza. Holdings range from Neolithic loom parts and Han and Tang brocades to Song and Yuan damasks, Qing court badges and work by contemporary designers. Conservation is a second mission: the China Textile Identification and Conservation Centre was set up in 2000, and in 2010 the museum became the State Administration of Cultural Heritage's key research base for textile conservation, with laboratory archaeology and silk-protein analysis. The buildings step up the hillside, mixing white walls, grey tiles and Jiangnan gardens, with silkworm-rearing and hand-weaving workshops for visitors. Wu Shan Square station on line 7 connects by bus 31, 42 or 314, about ten minutes from the southern West Lake area.

address: 武汉市硚口区解放大道628号（解放大道与利济北路交汇处）
area_text: 商业部分约43,000㎡（Hassell口径），另含K11 ATELIER写字楼等
intro_zh: 武汉K11购物艺术中心位于硚口区解放大道628号，解放大道与利济北路交汇处，是K11在华中地区的旗舰项目。项目由一座运营约20年的老百货改造而来，Hassell负责商业空间与景观设计，2020年12月12日II馆及AVENUE 11率先开业，2021年4月30日I馆开幕，标志着项目全面运营。商业部分建筑面积约43,000平方米，另含K11 ATELIER写字楼，整体以“音乐”为主题，从入口广场到中庭装置贯穿乐谱、乐器与声波元素。设计上以三座相互连通的圆形中庭为骨架——粉色配饰厅、五层通高的黄色玩具厅与科幻感的蓝色科技厅——店铺环绕中庭布置，把人流向上牵引，并通过天桥连接相邻物业；室外景观与国内外艺术家作品散布各层，使商场本身成为展场。项目引入chi K11美术馆、K11 Art House等艺术空间，开业时35%的品牌为首进武汉或华中。地铁1号线利济北路站步行可达，距汉口火车站约十分钟车程，周边为汉口核心商圈与武广、恒隆等项目。
intro_en: Wuhan K11 Art Mall stands at 628 Jiefang Avenue in Qiaokou District, at the junction with Liji North Road, and is K11's flagship for central China. The scheme reworks a department store that had traded for about twenty years; Hassell designed the retail interiors and landscape. Hall II and Avenue 11 opened on 12 December 2020, and Hall I followed on 30 April 2021, completing the project. The retail area is about 43,000 sq m, with K11 Atelier offices above, and music is the unifying theme, from the entrance plaza to the atrium installations. Three interconnected circular chambers organise the plan — a pink accessories hall, a five-storey yellow toy hall and a sci-fi blue technology hall — with shops wrapped around the voids so that visitors are drawn upward, and a footbridge links the neighbouring block. Art is distributed throughout the mall rather than confined to a gallery, alongside chi K11 art museum and K11 Art House; 35 per cent of tenants were new to Wuhan or central China at opening. Liji North Road station on metro line 1 is a short walk away, Hankou railway station about ten minutes by car, and the wider area includes the Wuhan Plaza and Henglong retail clusters.

address: 武汉市东湖新技术开发区关山大道355号
area_text: 商业面积约5.4万㎡
intro_zh: 武汉K11 Select位于东湖新技术开发区关山大道355号，地处“中国光谷”核心，2017年11月2日开业，是继香港K11、上海K11之后全国第三座、华中首座K11购物艺术中心，也是K11 Select产品线的首次落地。项目商业面积约5.4万平方米，开业时引进150家精品店铺，其中25%为华中首店、30%为武汉首店、首进光谷品牌占比达70%，以艺术、人文、自然三大元素组织业态，面向光谷的年轻高知客群。空间尺度较标准K11更紧凑，动线短、停留感强，中庭与公共区域长期布置当代艺术收藏与快闪展览，配合艺术市集、工作坊与音乐活动，形成“小而美”的社区型艺术商业样本。运营七年后，项目进入品牌调整期，仍保持稳定的客流与租金表现，并与2020年开业的武汉K11购物艺术中心形成“一城双馆”协同。区位上，关山大道是光谷的商务与研发主轴，周边聚集高校、科研院所与科技企业，常住人口平均年龄约32岁；地铁2号线光谷广场站转公交或有轨电车可达。
intro_en: Wuhan K11 Select stands at 355 Guanshan Avenue in the East Lake High-Tech Development Zone, the core of the Optics Valley, and opened on 2 November 2017.
