It was the third K11 art mall in mainland China after Hong Kong and Shanghai, the first in central China, and the debut of the smaller K11 Select format. With about 54,000 sq m of retail, it opened with 150 stores, of which 25 per cent were firsts for central China, 30 per cent firsts for Wuhan and 70 per cent firsts for Optics Valley, organised around art, humanity and nature for the area's young, highly educated workforce. The plan is more compact than a standard K11, with short routes and spaces that encourage people to linger; atriums and public areas carry contemporary art from the collection, pop-up shows, art markets, workshops and music events, making it a small-but-fine model of community-scale art retail. After seven years the tenant mix is being refreshed while footfall and rents hold steady, and it works alongside the larger Wuhan K11 that opened in 2020. Guanshan Avenue is the valley's business and R&D spine, surrounded by universities and tech firms, with a resident population averaging about 32 years old. Metro line 2 at Optics Valley Square connects by bus or tram.

address: 武汉市硚口区解放大道628号
area_text: 总体量约24.7万㎡；购物艺术中心约8.6万㎡
intro_zh: 武汉K11购物艺术中心位于武汉市硚口区解放大道628号，处在解放大道与利济北路交汇的内环核心，是K11品牌在华中布局的首个重资产项目。项目总体量约24.7万平方米，其中购物艺术中心约8.6万平方米、K11 ATELIER办公楼约5.6万平方米，并配有K11旗下首个室外慢生活街区AVENUE 11。2020年12月12日，II馆及AVENUE 11率先启幕；2021年4月30日I馆全面开幕，两馆通过连廊与街区连通。建筑与室内由Hassell等团队设计，I馆以“音乐盒”为叙事线索：入口天花取钥匙与齿轮造型，中庭做成高约30米的管风琴造型，扶梯底部为齿轮，楼层之间布置“前奏—高潮—回响”的空间节奏；三个相互连通的圆形中庭分别以粉色配饰、黄色玩具和蓝色科技为主题，屋顶设“空中樱园”，室外陈列9米高的《梵高的耳朵》雕塑。场内设chi K11 art space、设计师品牌、米其林餐厅与都市农庄，开业时引入大批华中、武汉首店。交通方面，可乘地铁1号线至利济北路站步行到达，或乘2号线至中山公园站后步行约十五分钟；周边解放大道、利济北路公交线路密集，项目配地下停车位。
intro_en: K11 Art Mall Wuhan occupies 628 Jiefang Avenue in Qiaokou District, at the intersection with Liji North Road in the city's inner ring. It is K11's first major project in central China and one of the brand's largest. The complex has about 247,000 sqm in total, including an 86,000 sqm art mall, a 56,000 sqm K11 ATELIER office tower and AVENUE 11, K11's first open-air lifestyle street. Mall II and AVENUE 11 opened on 12 December 2020; Mall I followed on 30 April 2021, connected by bridges and the street. Hassell led the architecture and interiors, organising Mall I around the idea of a music box: a key-and-cog ceiling at the entrance, a 30-metre organ-shaped atrium rising through the floors, cog details under the escalators and a sequence of prelude, climax and echo. Three interlocking circular chambers are themed in pink accessories, yellow toys and blue technology, while the roof holds a cherry-blossom garden and a nine-metre sculpture, Van Gogh's Ear, stands outside. chi K11 art space, designer labels, Michelin-starred dining and an urban farm sit alongside stores making their first appearance in Wuhan or central China. Metro Line 1 stops at Liji North Road within walking distance; Line 2's Zhongshan Park station is about fifteen minutes on foot, and buses run along Jiefang Avenue.

address: 武汉市洪山区关山大道355号
area_text: 商业面积5.4万㎡
intro_zh: 武汉K11 Select位于武汉市洪山区关山大道355号，地处光谷核心、关山大道沿线，是全国第一座K11 Select，也是继香港K11、上海K11之后K11在内地的第三座购物艺术中心。项目于2017年11月2日开业，商业面积5.4万平方米，地上五层、地下一层，B1至L3为核心经营区，L4、L5分别规划为花园漫步与天空泳池营地。整体由日本Nomura（乃村工艺社）担纲商业设计，以“水·生命·循环”为主题，在中庭置入“云、湖泊、瀑布”等科技互动装置，墙面如树枝向上生长；全馆设置367块LED屏，三成以上为互动屏，是当时全国首个全馆LED屏覆盖的商业项目。场内长期陈列“午夜美术馆”“重力B立方体”“四十万公里”等艺术装置，并借武汉K11艺术村资源举办展览与艺术节；开业时引入150家精品店铺，25%首进华中、70%首进光谷。项目配3300个地下停车位，其中“怪兽停车场”以涂鸦和霓虹灯改造，兼作派对空间。交通方面，可乘地铁2号线至光谷广场站换乘公交或有轨电车L1线至关山大道站，亦可乘11号线至光谷火车站后打车前往。
intro_en: K11 Select Wuhan stands at 355 Guanshan Avenue in Hongshan District, in the heart of the Optics Valley technology and university district. Opened on 2 November 2017, it was the first K11 Select in China and the third K11 art mall on the mainland after Hong Kong and Shanghai. The mall has 54,000 sqm of retail over five levels above ground and one below, with B1 to L3 as the main trading floors and L4 and L5 given over to a garden walk and a sky pool camp. Japanese practice Nomura designed the interiors around water, life and circulation, installing interactive cloud, lake and waterfall installations and a tree-like atrium wall. Its 367 LED screens, more than thirty percent of them interactive, made it the first mall in China to cover every floor with LED displays. Art is built into the circulation: works such as Midnight Art Museum, Gravity B Cube and 40,000 Kilometres are placed on different levels, and the mall draws on the nearby Wuhan K11 Art Village for exhibitions and festivals. At opening it brought in 150 shops, a quarter of them firsts for central China and seventy percent firsts for Optics Valley. There are 3,300 underground parking spaces, including a graffiti-covered Monster car park used for parties. Metro Line 2's Guanggu Square station connects by bus or tram L1 to Guanshan Avenue.

address: 武汉市洪山区野芷湖西路16号（马湖地铁站B口步行约120米）
area_text: 建筑面积约1万㎡，共四层、9个展厅，馆方另给出实际使用面积约3000㎡
intro_zh: 合美术馆位于武汉市洪山区野芷湖西路16号，毗邻马湖地铁站，2015年正式对外开放。美术馆由中电光谷联合控股有限公司（光谷联合集团）创办，受湖北省文化和旅游厅业务指导，具有独立法人资格，属公益性民营美术馆，以“学术性、国际性、开创性”为办馆理念，主张“让当代艺术走向大众”。建筑为纯白石面、悬浮水上的方体，建筑面积约1万平方米，共四层，设9个展厅，馆方另给出实际使用面积约3000平方米；雕塑与装置广场在前后伸展，中庭、侧庭形成多维视线。学术上以艺术家个案研究为主线，曾举办王广义、方力钧、徐冰等艺术家的手稿展与研究展；同时通过“创意天地青年艺术计划”“联合·6个展”扶持青年艺术家，并持续开展少儿艺术与公共教育，至2020年已与全国20所高校共建教学实践基地。2022年武汉双年展的“开放姿态”专题在此展出。场馆位于光谷南片创意天地园区，周边办公与文创企业密集，适合当代艺术展、品牌发布、论坛与晚宴；参观时间以馆方公告为准。
intro_en: United Art Museum stands at 16 Yezhihu West Road in Hongshan District, Wuhan, about 120 metres from Mahu metro station, and opened to the public in 2015. It was founded by China Electronics Optics Valley Union Holding (Optics Valley United Group) under the professional guidance of the Hubei Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism, and operates as an independent, non-profit private museum with a stated ethos of academic rigour, international outlook and experimentation, summed up in its aim of bringing contemporary art to a broad public. The building is a white stone volume floating above water, with about 10,000 square metres of gross floor area over four levels, nine galleries and, by the museum’s own figure, roughly 3,000 square metres of actual usable space; sculpture and installation plazas extend front and back, while the atrium and side courts create layered sightlines. Its programme centres on monographic research, with drawing and research exhibitions by Wang Guangyi, Fang Lijun and Xu Bing, alongside support for younger artists through the Creative City Young Artist Project and the “United · Six Solo Exhibitions” series; public education and children’s art are long-running strands, and by 2020 it had established teaching practice bases with 20 universities. It hosted the “Open Attitude” section of the 2022 Wuhan Biennale. Set inside the Creative City campus in southern Optics Valley, surrounded by offices and creative firms, it suits contemporary art shows, brand launches, forums and dinners; visiting hours should be confirmed with the museum; telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 武汉市武昌区东湖路三官殿1号
area_text: 占地15318㎡，建筑面积约2.5万㎡，10个展厅，展区约5000㎡，展线1200余米
intro_zh: 湖北美术馆位于武汉市武昌区东湖路三官殿1号，东湖之滨，与湖北省博物馆隔街相望。场馆由政府投资建设管理，2007年11月6日开馆，2008年10月30日起免费开放，是国内首家免费开放的省级美术馆；2010年7月由“湖北省艺术馆”更名为湖北美术馆，2011年被评为首批国家重点美术馆。馆区占地面积15318平方米，主体建筑地上四层、地下一层，建筑面积约2.5万平方米，设10个展厅，另有特展厅与影像展厅，展区面积约5000平方米，展线总长1200余米，并设典藏画库、艺术交流中心、漆艺交流中心与艺术图书馆。藏品以湖北近现代及当代美术为主，涵盖国画、油画、版画、雕塑、水彩、漆艺、摄影与书法，2020年前后公开口径约3700件。品牌展览包括湖北国际漆艺三年展、美术文献展、中国工业版画三年展与“三官殿1号”艺术展。场馆毗邻省博与东湖景区，地铁8号线省博湖北日报站可达，适合大型艺术展、学术论坛、开幕式与品牌文化合作；开放时间周二至周日9:00-17:00（16:30停止入馆），周一闭馆。
intro_en: Hubei Museum of Art stands at 1 Sanguandian, Donghu Road, Wuchang District, Wuhan, on the shore of East Lake and across the road from the Hubei Provincial Museum. Government-built and government-run, it opened on 6 November 2007 and became free to the public on 30 October 2008, the first provincial art museum in China to do so; it was renamed from Hubei Provincial Art Gallery in July 2010 and was named one of the first batch of national key art museums in 2011. The site covers 15,318 square metres, with a main building of about 25,000 square metres over four levels above ground and one below, containing ten galleries plus a special exhibition room and a video gallery, roughly 5,000 square metres of exhibition area and more than 1,200 metres of hanging line, together with a collection store, art exchange centre, lacquer art centre and art library. The collection, around 3,700 works by public counts from about 2020, concentrates on modern and contemporary Hubei art across ink painting, oil painting, printmaking, sculpture, watercolour, lacquer, photography and calligraphy. Its signature programmes include the Hubei International Lacquer Triennial, the Art Documents Exhibition, the China Industrial Print Triennial and the Sanguandian No.1 Art Exhibition. Next to the provincial museum and East Lake, and reached by metro line 8 at Shengbo Hubei Daily station, it suits large exhibitions, academic forums, opening ceremonies and cultural brand collaborations; open Tuesday to Sunday 9:00-17:00, last entry 16:30, closed Mondays.

address: 汉口馆：武汉市江岸区中山大道保华街2号；琴台馆：武汉市汉阳区知音大道77号
area_text: 两馆总建筑面积约5.5万㎡、12个展厅、展厅面积约1.4万㎡（汉口馆12139㎡/7厅；琴台馆约4.3万㎡）
intro_zh: 武汉美术馆为武汉市属公立美术馆，1986年成立，2015年被列为国家重点美术馆，现由横跨长江的汉口馆与琴台馆组成。汉口馆位于江岸区中山大道保华街2号，前身为1930年建成的金城银行大楼，由中国建筑师庄俊设计，属欧式古典复兴风格，2008年12月26日作为新馆开放；建筑面积12139平方米，设7个展厅，展厅面积约2600平方米，展线长1100余米，其中二层三号展厅净高8.4米、面积约600平方米，适合大型绘画与装置。琴台馆位于汉阳区知音大道77号、月湖西北岸，2022年12月28日开馆，由柳亦春主持设计，建筑面积约4.3万平方米，是国内规模最大的清水混凝土单体建筑，外形如银色梯田。两馆合计建筑面积约5.5万平方米、12个展厅、展厅面积约1.4万平方米，配套中央大厅、国际学术报告厅、多功能厅、藏品库、美术图书文献中心与儿童美育空间。2022武汉双年展主展场设于两馆及合美术馆。场馆分处汉口历史风貌区与琴台中央文化艺术区，适合大型双年展、品牌艺术项目、开幕酒会与学术论坛；（汉口馆）、（琴台馆）。
intro_en: Wuhan Art Museum is a municipal public art museum founded in 1986 and listed as a national key art museum in 2015, now operating two venues on opposite banks of the Yangtze. The Hankou venue at 2 Baohua Street, Zhongshan Avenue, Jiang’an District, occupies the former Jincheng Bank building of 1930, designed by Chinese architect Zhuang Jun in a classical revival style, and opened as the new museum on 26 December 2008; it has 12,139 square metres of floor area, seven galleries and about 2,600 square metres of exhibition space along more than 1,100 metres of hanging line, with Gallery 3 on the second floor offering 8.4 metres of clear height across roughly 600 square metres, useful for large paintings and installations. The Qintai venue at 77 Zhiyin Avenue, Hanyang District, on the northwest shore of Moon Lake, opened on 28 December 2022; designed by Liu Yichun, it covers about 43,000 square metres and is described as the largest single fair-faced concrete building in China, its stacked form reading as silver terraces. Together the two buildings provide about 55,000 square metres, 12 galleries and some 14,000 square metres of exhibition space, with a central hall, international lecture theatre, multi-purpose rooms, collection stores, an art library and children’s education areas. The 2022 Wuhan Biennale was centred on the two venues and the United Art Museum. Sitting in the Hankou historic district and the Qintai cultural quarter respectively, they suit large biennials, brand art projects, opening receptions and academic forums; telephone (Hankou) and (Qintai).

address: 辽宁省沈阳市和平区博览路2号甲1号（青年大街与浑河大桥交汇处，浑河北岸）
area_text: 商业面积约26万㎡，共6层（含地下一层）；所属新世界中心总建筑面积约130万㎡
intro_zh: 沈阳K11购物艺术中心位于沈阳市和平区博览路2号甲1号，青年大街与浑河大桥交汇处、浑河北岸，属于沈阳新世界中心综合体。新世界中心占地约19.6万平方米、总建筑面积约130万平方米，集合博览馆、五星级酒店、写字楼、服务式公寓与K11商业，其中新世界博览馆于2017年3月试业。K11部分商业面积约26万平方米，2018年5月26日试营业并正式开放，是K11品牌旗下商业面积最大的一座，以“艺术·人文·自然”与“博物馆零售”为定位。场内共6层（含地下一层），规划400余家品牌店、全国首个室内“曼哈顿街区”、都市农庄、大面积空中花园、全球首座国家地理探险家中心（约4,000余平方米）以及东北首座乐高探索中心与海洋探索中心，并设chi K11艺术空间，持续引入当代艺术展览、艺术家项目与公共艺术。开业期间以“沈阳我在WOW”艺术节集结百位国内外艺术家，核心展览《在集结》由鲁明军、张涵露策划，汇集31位国内外艺术家与6个东北当代艺术小组，沿商业动线布置约30件大型装置与雕塑。建筑由新世界方面统筹、中建铁投东北公司总承包，裙楼会展区“大鹏展翅”多曲面金属屋面南北最大跨度102米、东西最大跨度261米，是浑河沿岸的标志性天际线。交通方面，地铁2号线五里河站B1口步行约120米，青年大街、浑河大桥联通主城与浑南；营业时间10:00—22:00。
intro_en: K11 Art Mall Shenyang stands at No. 2-1 Bolan Road, Heping District, Shenyang, at the junction of Qingnian Avenue and the Hun River Bridge on the north bank of the Hun, inside the New World Centre complex. That complex covers about 196,000 sqm of land with 1.3 million sqm of floor area and combines the New World Expo Centre — which began trial operation in March 2017 — with a five-star hotel, offices, serviced apartments and the K11 mall. K11 itself has about 260,000 sqm of retail area, the largest in the K11 network, and opened on 26 May 2018 after construction by the Northeast branch of China Construction Railway Investment. It follows K11's "art, humanity, nature" and "museum retail" formula. Six levels including one basement house more than 400 brands, China's first indoor "Manhattan block", an urban farm, a large sky garden, the world's first National Geographic Ultimate Explorer centre of some 4,000 sqm, and northeast China's first Legoland Discovery Centre with a Sea Life centre. A chi K11 art space stages contemporary exhibitions, artist projects and public art; the opening "Shenyang WoW" festival gathered a hundred artists, and its core exhibition "In Assembly", curated by Lu Mingjun and Zhang Hanlu, brought together 31 artists and six northeast collectives with about 30 large installations placed along the shopping routes. The podium's "spreading wings" curved metal roof spans 102 m north-south and 261 m east-west, a landmark on the Hun River skyline. Metro Line 2 Wulihe station, Exit B1, is about 120 m away; the mall trades 10:00-22:00.

address: 深圳市南山区华侨城深南大道9013号
area_text: 建筑面积5000余平方米，主体三层
intro_zh: 何香凝美术馆位于深圳南山华侨城深南大道9013号，1995年5月经中央批准兴建，1997年4月18日建成开馆，是中国第一个以个人名字命名的国家级美术馆，现为中央统战部直属公益一类事业单位。馆舍建筑面积5000余平方米，主体三层，外立面以灰、白两色为主，设主展厅、副展厅、多功能报告厅、公教活动区、咖啡书吧、藏品库、文献库、图书馆与裱画室等。美术馆以收藏、陈列和研究何香凝的艺术创作及艺术文献为基本宗旨，同时策划展示传统艺术、海外华人艺术与女性艺术，关注中外当代艺术交流。馆址处于华侨城文化片区，地铁华侨城站C出口步行可达，周边有锦绣中华、世界之窗等设施，参观动线成熟。开放时间为周二至周日9:30-17:00（16:30停止入馆），周一闭馆（节假日除外），20人以上团体需提前预约。作为深圳较早建立的公立美术馆，它既承担国家级美术收藏与研究职能，也是华侨城片区重要的公共文化空间。馆名由江泽民题写。馆内以何香凝艺术陈列为常设主线，配合专题研究展、讲座、工作坊与导览，面向学校与社区开展美育活动。
intro_en: He Xiangning Art Museum stands at 9013 Shennan Avenue in the OCT cultural district of Nanshan District, Shenzhen. Approved by the central government in May 1995 and opened on 18 April 1997, it is China's first national-level art museum named after an individual and now operates as a public institution under the United Front Work Department. The three-storey building covers more than 5,000 square metres, finished in grey and white, and contains a main gallery, secondary galleries, a lecture hall, education areas, a café-bookshop, collection and archive stores, a library and a mounting studio. Its core mandate is to collect, display and research He Xiangning's art and documentary legacy, while its programme also covers traditional Chinese art, overseas Chinese art, women's art and international contemporary practice. The museum sits within the OCT cultural quarter, a short walk from OCT metro station (Exit C) and close to Splendid China and Window of the World, making it easy to combine with other visits. It opens Tuesday to Sunday from 9:30 to 17:00, closes on Mondays except public holidays, and asks groups of 20 or more to book ahead through the museum's public channels. As one of Shenzhen's earliest public art museums, it combines a national collection and research role with a busy public programme. The museum's name was inscribed by Jiang Zemin. A permanent He Xiangning display is complemented by research exhibitions, lectures, workshops and guided tours for schools and community groups.

address: 深圳市福田区红荔路6026号
area_text: 占地8000平方米，建筑面积15100平方米，展厅总面积3600平方米
intro_zh: 关山月美术馆位于深圳市福田中心区红荔路6026号，北依莲花山、南临市政广场，1995年1月奠基，1997年6月25日香港回归前夕落成开馆。美术馆以岭南画派大师关山月命名，是深圳市政府全额拨款的公益性文化事业单位；关山月生前将813件各时期代表作品及生活、艺术、教育资料捐赠深圳，市政府斥资6700万元建馆永久珍藏。馆舍占地8000平方米，建筑面积15100平方米，展厅总面积3600平方米，另有户外展览面积2000平方米，设1个圆形中央展厅、5个室内标准展厅和2个关山月艺术常设陈列厅，固定展线与活动展线各约500米。馆藏5600余件，学术定位为关山月与20世纪中后期中国美术、当代设计艺术研究。2011年被评为首批国家重点美术馆。美术馆与深圳音乐厅、中心图书馆、少年宫等共同构成福田中心区文化设施群，地铁少年宫站步行可达，交通与配套便利。美术馆同时承担国家大型美术展览项目的策划与承办，并围绕关山月艺术与岭南画派持续开展研究、出版与公共教育。
intro_en: Guan Shanyue Art Museum occupies 6026 Hongli Road in Futian's civic centre, with Lianhua Mountain behind it and the municipal plaza in front. Ground was broken in January 1995 and the museum opened on 25 June 1997, on the eve of Hong Kong's return to China. Named after the Lingnan School master Guan Shanyue, it is a fully government-funded public cultural institution. Guan donated 813 representative works spanning his career together with personal, artistic and teaching papers, and the Shenzhen government spent RMB 67 million on the building to preserve them. The site covers 8,000 square metres with 15,100 square metres of floor area; galleries total 3,600 square metres indoors plus 2,000 square metres of outdoor display space, arranged as a circular central hall, five standard galleries and two permanent Guan Shanyue rooms, with roughly 500 metres each of fixed and temporary hanging space. The collection holds more than 5,600 works, and the academic focus is Guan Shanyue, mid- and late-20th-century Chinese art and contemporary design. It was named one of the first nine national key art museums in 2011. The museum forms part of Futian's cultural cluster with the Shenzhen Concert Hall, central library and Children's Palace, a short walk from Children's Palace metro station. It also plans and hosts large national art exhibitions and runs a continuing programme of research, publishing and public education around Guan Shanyue and the Lingnan School.

address: 深圳市龙华区民治街道大岭社区腾龙路30号1栋
area_text: 建筑面积6.6万平方米，设18个展厅，半室外雕塑展场3900平方米
intro_zh: 深圳美术馆（新馆）位于深圳市龙华区民治街道大岭社区腾龙路30号1栋，地处深圳北站商务中心区，2023年9月28日试运行、11月6日正式开馆，是深圳“新时代重大文化设施”中首个开工并完工的项目。深圳美术馆前身为1976年始建的深圳展览馆，1987年更名为深圳美术馆。新馆由德国KSP Jürgen Engel Architekten设计，建筑面积6.6万平方米，设18个艺术展厅，展览面积约1.6万至2万平方米，另有3900平方米半室外雕塑展场，并配置学术报告厅、艺术图书馆与艺术衍生品店。一层展厅净高13.9米并配液压活动展墙，适合大型装置与综合展；二层半室外展场面向雕塑与户外作品；三层采用专业采光膜；四层设恒温恒湿展柜。馆藏约9000件（套），涵盖中国画、油画、版画、雕塑、书法与摄影。新馆紧邻深圳图书馆北馆，地铁4号线、6号线红山站A1出口步行约300米，观众免费参观、主题活动需在小程序预约。新馆另设约6200平方米典藏画库，并以艺术科技融合作为学术方向之一。
intro_en: The new venue of Shenzhen Art Museum stands at Building 1, 30 Tenglong Road, Daling Community, Minzhi Subdistrict, Longhua District, in the Shenzhen North Railway Station business district. It began trial operation on 28 September 2023 and opened officially on 6 November 2023, the first project in the city's major cultural facilities programme to start and finish construction. The museum traces its origins to the Shenzhen Exhibition Hall of 1976, renamed Shenzhen Art Museum in 1987. Designed by KSP Jürgen Engel Architekten of Germany, the building has 66,000 square metres of floor area and 18 galleries, with exhibition space of about 16,000 to 20,000 square metres, a 3,900-square-metre semi-outdoor sculpture court, lecture halls, an art library and a shop. The ground-floor galleries are 13.9 metres high and fitted with hydraulic movable walls for large installations; the second floor opens onto the sculpture court, the third uses professional diffusing film for daylight, and the fourth has climate-controlled display cases. The collection numbers about 9,000 works across Chinese painting, oil painting, printmaking, sculpture, calligraphy and photography. It faces the Shenzhen Library North Division and is about 300 metres from Hongshan metro station (Exit A1) on lines 4 and 6; admission is free and themed events are booked through the museum's mini-programme. A 6,200-square-metre art storage facility and a research interest in art-and-technology collaboration support the exhibition programme.

address: 深圳市南山区深南大道9005号（华侨城洲际大酒店东侧，毗邻何香凝美术馆、华·美术馆）
area_text: 占地6,000㎡，独栋两层；艺术展厅挑高5米，自有停车场约2,000㎡
intro_zh: EPC艺术文化中心（EPC艺术中心）位于深圳市南山区深南大道9005号，在华侨城洲际大酒店东侧，紧邻何香凝美术馆、华·美术馆与锦绣中华·民俗村，处在华侨城文化场馆带的核心位置。机构自称“国内首家空间美术馆”，EPC代表Excellent Partner Cooperation，2008年创建于华侨城创意文化园，最初以探索艺术家居模式起步，逐步长成集规划、建筑、室内、陈设、家具与艺术品设计于一体的空间集成服务体系，2013年扩大场地并正式成立EPC艺术中心。场馆是一栋有三十多年历史的独栋两层白色建筑，占地6,000平方米，室内艺术展厅挑高5米，既有艺术博物馆级的展陈条件，也能承接星级酒店式的商务活动；场馆自有约2,000平方米停车场，可同时满足展览布展车辆与宾客停车。2014年这里举办了数十场艺术展览与品牌时尚活动，形成“设计＋艺术＋商业”的混合运营模式。空间适合艺术展、书画展、珠宝与时尚发布、汽车静态展示、品牌发布会、主题沙龙与艺术品鉴，也可与一路之隔的何香凝美术馆、华·美术馆、OCAT深圳馆串成华侨城半日艺术动线。交通上深南大道主干道直达，公交锦绣中华、华侨城站步行可达，地铁1号线华侨城站出站后步行约十分钟；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: EPC Art and Culture Center sits at 9005 Shennan Boulevard in Nanshan District, Shenzhen, on the east side of the InterContinental Shenzhen in OCT and next door to the He Xiangning Art Museum, the OCT Art & Design Gallery and Splendid China folk village, at the heart of the OCT cultural venue belt. The organisation describes itself as China's first 'space art museum'; EPC stands for Excellent Partner Cooperation, and it began in 2008 inside the OCT Loft creative park by exploring artist-led home furnishing, growing into an integrated space service covering planning, architecture, interiors, furnishing, furniture and art, before expanding in 2013 and formally establishing the art centre. The venue is a detached two-storey white building more than thirty years old, occupying a 6,000 square metre site with a five-metre clear height in the main gallery, able to host museum-grade exhibitions as well as hotel-standard corporate functions. Around 2,000 square metres of its own parking serves both installation vehicles and guests. In 2014 it ran dozens of art exhibitions and brand fashion events, establishing a hybrid design-art-commerce model. The space suits art and calligraphy shows, jewellery and fashion launches, static car displays, brand presentations, themed salons and art appreciation dinners, and can be combined with the He Xiangning Art Museum, OCT Art & Design Gallery and OCAT Shenzhen across the road for a half-day art route. Shennan Boulevard runs past the door, buses stop at Splendid China and OCT, and OCT station on Line 1 is about a ten-minute walk; enquiries go through the venue's public channels.

address: 深圳市南山区恩平街华侨城创意文化园南区F2栋（另设北区B10馆）
area_text: B10馆建筑面积6,109平方米（用地6,899平方米）；南区F2栋为项目空间
intro_zh: OCAT深圳馆位于深圳市南山区恩平街华侨城创意文化园南区F2栋，是OCAT馆群中成立最早的总馆。其前身为OCT当代艺术中心，2005年1月28日成立，最初在行政上隶属何香凝美术馆，由华侨城集团全资赞助，2012年注册为独立的非营利艺术机构。深圳馆以当代综合艺术为专业方向，长期通过展览、研究、出版、公共教育与国际艺术家工作室计划推动中国当代艺术与国际的对话，也是深圳雕塑双年展、OCAT双年展等项目的发起地。2022年9月，位于创意园北区、由原磁碟生产厂房B10改造的新展馆落成，由都市实践（孟岩）设计，建筑面积6,109平方米，保留两层厂房结构并置入图书馆、报告厅、艺术商店与办公仓储，成为OCAT深圳馆的主展馆；南区F2栋继续承担项目空间功能。馆区位于华侨城创意文化园步行主轴上，周边聚集画廊、设计工作室与书店，形成深圳最具规模的艺术生态片区。展览以免票开放为主，开放时间10:00—17:30、周一闭馆；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: OCAT Shenzhen occupies Building F2 in the south area of OCT-LOFT, Enping Street, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, and is the oldest and headquarters venue of the OCAT group. It began on 28 January 2005 as the OCT Contemporary Art Terminal, then administratively part of the He Xiangning Art Museum and fully funded by OCT Group; in 2012 it registered as an independent non-profit art institution. Its field is contemporary art across media, pursued through exhibitions, research, publishing, public education and an international artist studio programme, and it initiated projects including the Shenzhen Sculpture Biennale and the OCAT Biennale. In September 2022 a new building opened in the north area of OCT-LOFT: Hall B10, a former magnetic-disk factory converted by URBANUS, led by Meng Yan, with 6,109 square metres of floor area on a 6,899-square-metre site. The design keeps the two-storey factory structure and inserts a library, auditorium, art shop, offices and storage, making B10 the main exhibition venue, while F2 in the south area continues as a project space. The campus sits on the pedestrian spine of OCT-LOFT, surrounded by galleries, design studios and bookshops, forming Shenzhen's densest art ecology. Admission is generally free; the museum opens 10:00 to 17:30 and closes on Mondays. Telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

name_zh: 深圳当代艺术与城市规划馆
address: 深圳市福田区福中路184号
area_text: 总建筑面积88,185平方米，用地面积29,688平方米
intro_zh: 深圳市当代艺术与城市规划馆（简称“两馆”）位于深圳市福田区福中路184号，处在福田中心区中轴线北端、莲花山下、市民中心北侧，2017年12月29日正式对外开放。建筑由奥地利蓝天组（Coop Himmelb(l)au）设计，用地面积29,688平方米，总建筑面积88,185平方米，以钢结构与玻璃幕墙构成如被雕琢过的“城市巨石”，使用面积约80,000平方米，内部由当代艺术馆与城市规划展览馆两个独立机构共享一个大厅与公共平台，是深圳“文化立市”时期的标志性文化建筑。当代艺术馆以先锋艺术、设计、建筑与跨媒介展览为主，曾承办深港城市\建筑双城双年展等大型项目；城市规划展览馆的常设展由Atelier Brückner设计，在约8,500平方米空间内以模型、影像与互动装置讲述深圳的城市史与规划。两馆地处少年宫地铁站旁，与深圳图书馆、音乐厅、莲花山公园共同构成城市文化客厅。开放时间为周二至周日10:00—18:00（17:30停止入场），周一闭馆；参观咨询请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: The Shenzhen Museum of Contemporary Art and Urban Planning, known locally as the 'Two Museums', stands at 184 Fuzhong Road in Futian District, at the northern end of the Futian central axis below Lianhua Hill and north of the Civic Centre, and opened on 29 December 2017. Coop Himmelb(l)au designed the building on a 29,688 square metre site with 88,185 square metres of floor area; steel structure and glass facades give it the look of a carved urban boulder, with about 80,000 square metres of usable area. Inside, two independent institutions - the Museum of Contemporary Art and the Urban Planning Exhibition Hall - share one lobby and public platform, a device that made the building a symbol of Shenzhen's cultural investment, and the expressionist steel form drew wide international architectural coverage. The art museum programmes pioneering art, design, architecture and cross-media exhibitions and has hosted the Bi-City Biennale of Urbanism/Architecture; the planning exhibition, designed by Atelier Brückner, uses about 8,500 square metres of models, film and interactive displays to tell the story of Shenzhen's growth and planning. The pair sit beside Children's Palace metro station, together with the Shenzhen Library, Concert Hall and Lianhua Mountain Park, forming the city's cultural living room. It opens 10:00-18:00 Tuesday to Sunday, last entry 17:30, closed Monday; tel .

address: 深圳市南山区南头古城中山南街71号
area_text: 四层综合空间（2023年改造后），面积未公开
intro_zh: 阿哩哩艺术馆（ALILI ART）位于深圳市南山区南头古城中山南街71号，处在有近1700年历史的南头古城主街深处。南头古城是深圳、香港城市历史的共同源头，也是明清时期宝安县政府所在地，经过近年整体活化后成为深圳最密集的文创与艺术街区之一，同源馆、南头古城博物馆、南头1820数字展厅与各类小店、展览空间集中在步行范围内。阿哩哩艺术馆是古城内以插画为主线的艺术机构，2020年南头古城南北街示范段开街后投入运营（2020年11月已有公开展览记录），与深圳市插画协会关系紧密：2021年3月至4月，世界插画大奖WIA2020获奖作品展在此举办，是该奖首次在中国官方呈现；同期二楼推出“插画里的中国——十九世纪欧洲古籍版画插图展”；2022年11月举办24节气主题插画展，2023年2月举办芬兰插画展“Moi! Shenzhen”。2023年7月8日，艺术馆完成整体改造后以“四层超大综合空间”重新开放，首展为日本插画师近藤达弥的中国首展“兔先生的奇幻物语”，展出其24年间创作的50余件原创作品，涵盖森林、海洋、动物、树灵、都市五个主题。空间以白墙与色彩装置结合，适合插画与平面设计展、IP主题展、品牌联名快闪与亲子活动。开放时间为周二至周五10:30—21:00、周六至周日10:30—21:30，周一闭馆；地铁12号线南头古城站D口出站步行可达，场馆。
intro_en: ALILI ART occupies 71 Zhongshan South Street inside Nantou Ancient Town, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, deep in the main lane of a settlement with nearly 1,700 years of history. Nantou is the shared origin of Shenzhen's and Hong Kong's urban history and was the seat of Bao'an county government in the Ming and Qing dynasties; after recent wholesale revitalisation it has become one of the densest creative districts in the city, with the Tongyuan pavilions, the Nantou Ancient Town Museum, the Nantou 1820 digital gallery and numerous small shops and exhibition rooms within walking distance. ALILI ART is the district's illustration-led art institution, opening after the revitalised north-south street reopened in 2020 and already staging public exhibitions by November that year, and it works closely with the Shenzhen Illustration Association: from March to April 2021 it hosted the World Illustration Awards 2020 touring show, the award's first official presentation in China, with an exhibition of nineteenth-century European book plates on the second floor at the same time. A 24 solar terms illustration show followed in November 2022 and the Finnish illustration exhibition 'Moi! Shenzhen' in February 2023. On 8 July 2023 the gallery reopened after a full renovation as a four-storey composite space, with the first China solo show of Japanese illustrator Tatsuya Kondo, 'Mr Rabbit's Fantastic Tale', presenting more than fifty works from twenty-four years across forest, ocean, animal, tree spirit and city themes. White walls paired with colour installations suit illustration and graphic design shows, IP exhibitions, co-branded pop-ups and family programmes. Hours are 10:30 to 21:00 Tuesday to Friday and 10:30 to 21:30 at weekends, closed Monday; Nantou Ancient Town station on Line 12, exit D, is a short walk away, and the gallery can be reached through its public channels.

name_zh: 深圳海上世界文化艺术中心
address: 深圳市南山区蛇口望海路1187号
area_text: 总建筑面积约73,918㎡；用地面积26,162㎡
intro_zh: 海上世界文化艺术中心（SWCAC）位于深圳市南山区蛇口望海路1187号，处在海上世界片区、蛇口滨海带，背靠南山、面朝深圳湾，是招商蛇口投资建设、由设计互联运营的综合文化平台，2017年12月正式开放。建筑由普利兹克奖得主、日本建筑师槙文彦（Fumihiko Maki）领衔的槙综合计画事务所设计，是其在中国内地的首个建成项目，总建筑面积约7.39万平方米，用地面积约2.62万平方米；造型以三层“平台”承托三座铝面“楼阁”，分别朝向山、海、城三个方向，白色石造外墙与简洁几何体量延续了槙氏一贯的克制手法。馆内主要包括设计互联主展馆（五个画廊，主展厅挑高9.5米、由天窗采光）、V&A展馆（与英国维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆合作）、园景展厅、800平方米的视界厅、三层与四层的境山剧场（304座，阶梯式山景室内乐厅，租赁面积约350平方米）、多功能厅、设计商店与滨海餐饮；屋顶花园与三层平台可看海景，建筑前广场常做市集与公共活动。定位上以设计为核心，连接艺术、设计、科技与产业，常年举办设计展、论坛、演出与教育项目。交通方面，地铁2号线海上世界站步行可达，蛇口邮轮母港约5分钟车程，可乘船往返港珠澳。
intro_en: Sea World Culture and Arts Center (SWCAC) stands at 1187 Wanghai Road in Shekou, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, in the Sea World district on the Shekou waterfront, with Nanshan behind it and Shenzhen Bay in front. Invested in and built by China Merchants Shekou and operated by Design Society, it opened in December 2017. The building was designed by Pritzker laureate Fumihiko Maki and Maki and Associates — the practice's first completed project in mainland China — and has a total floor area of about 73,918 square metres on a site of some 26,162 square metres. Its form sets a three-storey podium beneath three aluminium-clad pavilions facing mountain, sea and city respectively, with white stone facades and restrained geometric volumes characteristic of Maki. Inside are the Design Society main gallery (five galleries, the largest a 9.5-metre-high skylit hall), the V&A Gallery (a partnership with the Victoria and Albert Museum), the Park View Gallery, the 304-seat Mountain View Theater on the third and fourth floors (a stepped, wood-lined chamber-music hall with about 350 square metres of rentable front- and back-of-house space), plus a multi-function hall, design shop and waterfront dining. Roof gardens and third-floor terraces open onto the sea, and the forecourt regularly hosts markets and public events. Programming centres on design and connects art, design, technology and industry through exhibitions, forums, performances and education. Metro Line 2 to Sea World station is within walking distance, and Shekou Cruise Home Port, with ferries to Hong Kong, Macau and Zhuhai, is about five minutes away by car.

address: 江苏省苏州市姑苏区东北街204号
area_text: 占地面积约10700平方米，建筑面积1.9万余平方米
intro_zh: 苏州博物馆位于江苏省苏州市姑苏区东北街204号，成立于1960年元旦，馆址由太平天国忠王府旧址与新馆两部分组成。新馆由建筑师贝聿铭设计，2006年10月6日正式开放，占地面积约10700平方米，建筑面积1.9万余平方米，以“中而新、苏而新”为设计原则，把几何形体、白墙灰瓦与苏州园林的片石假山、水院、紫藤嫁接在一起，成为古城北部的文化地标。馆藏文物2.4万余件（套），其中珍贵文物9600余件、一级文物222件（套），以苏州出土文物、明清文人书画与江南民间工艺品为主；基本陈列分吴地遗珍、吴塔国宝、吴中风雅、吴门书画四个系列。苏州博物馆2008年成为首批国家一级博物馆并向公众免费开放，2018年在全国一级博物馆评估中获“优秀”。本馆周二至周日9:00-17:00开放（16:00停止入馆），周一闭馆，实行实名分时段预约；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。西馆位于高新区长江路399号，2021年开放。新馆与忠王府、拙政园、狮子林相邻，形成古城东北部集中成片的文化遗产参观区。
intro_en: Suzhou Museum stands at 204 Dongbei Street, Gusu District, Suzhou, Jiangsu. Founded on New Year's Day 1960, it occupies two parts of the site: the historic Mansion of Prince Zhong of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom and the new building designed by I. M. Pei, which opened on 6 October 2006. The new museum covers about 10,700 square metres of land with more than 19,000 square metres of floor area. Pei's design follows a principle of being modern yet Suzhou-like, combining geometric volumes and white walls with grey tiles, a rockery of sliced stones, water courts and a wisteria transplanted from the old garden, and it has become a cultural landmark in the north of the old city. The collection holds 24,729 objects and sets, 9,647 of them graded as valuable and 222 as first-grade national treasures, chiefly archaeological finds from Suzhou, Ming and Qing literati painting and calligraphy, and Jiangnan folk crafts; the permanent displays are organised as Treasures of Wu, Pagoda Treasures, Elegance of Wu and Wu School Painting. Suzhou Museum became one of the first national first-level museums in 2008 and has been free to the public since then, and it was rated “excellent” in the 2014-2016 national evaluation. The main site opens Tuesday to Sunday, 9:00-17:00 with last entry at 16:00, closed Mondays, by timed real-name reservation; telephone . The West Branch at 399 Changjiang Road opened in 2021. The new building adjoins the Mansion of Prince Zhong, the Humble Administrator's Garden and the Lion Grove, forming a concentrated heritage quarter in the north-east of the old city.

address: 苏州工业园区观枫街1号苏州文化艺术中心二楼
area_text: 建筑面积3180㎡，展览场地面积2000㎡，共4个展厅
intro_zh: 金鸡湖美术馆位于苏州工业园区观枫街1号的苏州文化艺术中心二层，坐落在金鸡湖东岸，2012年5月正式开馆。美术馆由苏州文化艺术中心建设，是一座非营利、免费向公众开放的公益性美术馆，侧重当代艺术并兼顾传统艺术研究。建筑面积3180平方米，展览场地面积2000平方米，设4个展厅，空间以白墙与可移动展墙为主，适合绘画、摄影、装置与小型雕塑展。开馆展“记忆的穿越”邀请大陆及港澳台地区49位当代艺术家参展，此后持续引入国际交流项目；2014年获“国家美术金星奖”年度十大艺术机构，2019年“自·沧浪亭”当代艺术展获文化和旅游部2018年度全国美术馆优秀展览项目，2024年“虹—来自桥的世界”再获全国美术馆优秀项目展览提名。场馆与苏州文化艺术中心大剧院、金鸡湖音乐厅、电影城同处一座综合体，该中心由法国建筑师保罗·安德鲁设计，观展人流与演出人流可以共享；周边为金鸡湖景区与环湖商业，适合品牌快闪、艺术发布、商务酒会与小型论坛。开放时间为周二至周日10:00-20:00，周一闭馆。
intro_en: Jinji Lake Art Museum occupies the second floor of the Suzhou Culture and Arts Centre at 1 Guanfeng Street in the Suzhou Industrial Park, on the eastern shore of Jinji Lake, and opened in May 2012. Built by the Suzhou Culture and Arts Centre, it is a non-profit public art museum with free admission that focuses on contemporary art while also supporting research into traditional practice. It covers 3,180 square metres of floor area with 2,000 square metres of exhibition space in four galleries, using white walls and movable partitions that suit painting, photography, installation and small sculpture. Its opening show, “Memory Crossing”, brought together 49 contemporary artists from the mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, and the programme has continued with international exchanges; it won the National Art Venus Award as one of the year’s ten leading art institutions in 2014, while “Zi · Canglang Pavilion” received the Ministry of Culture and Tourism’s 2018 national outstanding exhibition award and “Rainbow — From the World of Bridges” was nominated in 2024. The museum shares a complex designed by French architect Paul Andreu with the centre’s theatre, Jinji Lake concert hall and cinema, so exhibition and performance audiences overlap; the surrounding lakefront park and retail make it workable for brand pop-ups, art launches, cocktail receptions and small forums. It opens Tuesday to Sunday, 10:00-20:00, closed Mondays; telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 西安市莲湖区北院门街道西仓南巷146号
intro_zh: 西仓市集文创公园位于西安市莲湖区北院门街道西仓南巷146号，处在北院门历史文化街区核心地带。西仓又称永丰仓，隋唐时期即为永丰官仓，明清迁至现址，是官府粮仓；新中国成立后一度作为部队被服厂使用，后来停产闲置，周边逐渐演变为西安人熟悉的“档子”——花鸟鱼虫、古玩旧货与市井小吃的自发集市。2024年1月21日，经过“微更新、轻改造”的文创公园正式对外开放，项目由Local本地团队参与操刀，保留了一座清末民初的粮仓以及红砖墙、木梁结构等历史肌理，其余不同时期的近现代建筑则被整理为展馆、市集与工作室。园区占地35亩（约2.3万平方米），规划“三馆十集”功能，包含西安城市记忆博物馆、西仓市集博物馆、艺术中心，以及新二手市集、非遗体验、咖啡烘焙、手作小铺等业态。2024年，西仓建筑群被列为西安市第二批历史建筑；改造后单日客流可达三千至五千人，成为老城更新与青年文化消费结合的样本。
intro_en: Xicang Market Cultural and Creative Park occupies No. 146 Xicang South Lane, Beiyuanmen subdistrict, Lianhu District, Xi'an, in the heart of the historic Beiyuanmen neighbourhood. Xicang, also known as Yongfeng Granary, served as an official granary in the Sui and Tang dynasties and was moved to its present site in the Ming and Qing. In the twentieth century it became a military clothing factory and later fell idle, while the surrounding lanes turned into the "dangzi" — Xi'an's much-loved informal market for flowers, birds, antiques, second-hand goods and street food. The cultural park opened on 21 January 2024 after a "micro-renewal" approach led by the Local team. One late-Qing/early-Republican granary survives, together with red-brick walls and timber roof structures; other buildings from different periods have been adapted into galleries, market halls and studios. The site covers 35 mu (about 23,000 square metres) and is planned around "three museums and ten markets", including the Xi'an City Memory Museum, the Xicang Market Museum and an art centre, alongside a new second-hand market, intangible-heritage workshops, coffee roasters and craft stalls. The complex was listed among Xi'an's second batch of historic buildings in 2024 and now attracts 3,000-5,000 visitors on a busy day. The team kept the market's self-organised order outside the walls while introducing curated programming inside.

address: 西咸新区沣东新城沣河东路，西咸沣东文化中心（望周）
area_text: 总建筑面积2875㎡（占地1632.5㎡），高13.25米，地上二层，展厅位于二层
intro_zh: OCAT西安馆位于西咸新区沣东新城沣河东路，坐落于西咸沣东文化中心先导区“望周”内，是华侨城集团支持的OCAT馆群成员。2013年11月在西安雁塔区北池头一路南段首次开馆，是西安第一家专注当代艺术的美术馆；2020年9月17日随望周先导区落成迁入现址。“望周”取《诗经》“行归于周，万民所望”之意，由澳大利亚IAPA设计，占地1632.5平方米，总建筑面积2875平方米，整体高13.25米，一层为多功能报告厅，二层为OCAT西安馆主体展览空间，并通过三个自然庭院串联展厅，室内外空间互相渗透。西安馆以国际化水准推介中国当代艺术，关注回望历史、面向未来以及丝路沿线文化多样性的实践，展览全部免费开放；开馆以来举办过多场个案研究与主题群展，并与本地机构、院校合作开展讲座与公共项目。2021年12月13日曾因展厅设备维护闭馆，2022年12月27日恢复开放。场馆位于沣东华侨城文旅融合示范区，周边有昆明池、诗经里等文旅项目，适合当代艺术展、品牌快闪、小型发布会与文化论坛；开放时间周二至周日10:00-17:30（17:00停止入场），周一闭馆。
intro_en: OCAT Xi’an occupies the Wangzhou building, the pilot phase of the Xixian Fengdong Cultural Centre on Fenghe East Road in Fengdong New Town, part of the Xixian New Area. It belongs to the OCAT group supported by China Overseas Chinese Town (OCT), first opening in November 2013 on the southern stretch of Beichitou First Road in Yanta District as the first museum in Xi’an devoted to contemporary art, and moving to the present site when Wangzhou was completed on 17 September 2020. The name Wangzhou comes from a line in the Book of Songs meaning “returning to Zhou, watched by all the people”; designed by Australian practice IAPA, it sits on a 1,632.5-square-metre plot with 2,875 square metres of floor area and a height of 13.25 metres, the ground floor holding a multi-purpose auditorium and the upper floor the main OCAT Xi’an galleries, with three natural courtyards threading the spaces so that inside and outside permeate each other. The museum presents Chinese contemporary art to an international standard, with an interest in looking back at history, forward to the future and across the cultural diversity of the Silk Road, all with free admission; its programme has combined solo research shows and thematic group exhibitions with lectures and public projects developed with local institutions and universities. It closed for gallery equipment maintenance on 13 December 2021 and reopened on 27 December 2022. Set within the Fengdong OCT cultural and tourism demonstration zone near Kunming Pool and Shijingli, it suits contemporary exhibitions, brand pop-ups, small launches and cultural forums; open Tuesday to Sunday 10:00-17:30, last entry 17:00, closed Mondays.

address: 西安市雁塔区雁南一路与雁塔南路交叉口西南角（曲江新区大唐不夜城壹区）
area_text: 建筑面积1.7万㎡，展厅总面积约2500㎡，展线494米，学术报告厅373㎡/282座
intro_zh: 西安美术馆坐落于西安曲江新区大唐不夜城壹区，北依大雁塔、南望终南山，2009年9月28日开馆，是西安曲江新区管委会投资建设、采用“国有民营”体制运营的大型公益性美术馆。场馆建筑面积1.7万平方米，共两层，展厅总面积约2500平方米，展线总长494米，学术报告厅373平方米、可容纳282人就座，另配艺术客厅、艺术书吧、艺术商店、咖啡馆与餐厅。建筑为仿唐风格，大量使用仿古灰砖，与大唐不夜城的唐风街区相呼应。美术馆以立足传统、推动当代为方向，每年举办20余场国内外展览及30余场讲座、论坛与公共教育活动，品牌项目包括“城墙之外——西安当代艺术展”（2017年起每年一届）、西安青年绘画双年展（油画、水墨）、青年艺术家计划与西安少儿艺术双年展，另设艺术影院定期放映艺术影像。场馆位于大唐不夜城步行街核心段，夜间客流大，周边商业与酒店密集，适合当代艺术展、品牌快闪、发布酒会与夜间文化活动；开放时间10:00-22:00（21:30停止入场），周一闭馆（节假日除外）。
intro_en: Xi’an Art Museum stands in Zone 1 of the Great Tang All Day Mall in Qujiang New District, Xi’an, with the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda to the north and the Zhongnan Mountains to the south. It opened on 28 September 2009, built by the Qujiang New District administration and run under a state-owned, privately-operated model as a large public-interest art museum. The building covers 17,000 square metres over two floors, with about 2,500 square metres of gallery space and 494 metres of hanging line, a 373-square-metre lecture theatre seating 282, and an art lounge, book bar, shop, café and restaurant. Its architecture follows Tang precedents and uses reclaimed grey bricks, tying it to the Tang-themed mall outside. The programme is positioned between tradition and contemporary practice, with more than 20 exhibitions and over 30 lectures, forums and public education events a year; signature projects include “Beyond the City Wall — Xi’an Contemporary Art Exhibition”, held annually since 2017, the Xi’an Youth Painting Biennale in oil and ink, the Young Artist Project and the Xi’an Children’s Art Biennale, alongside a regular art cinema. Sitting on the busiest stretch of a pedestrian night-time district with dense retail and hotels around it, the museum suits contemporary exhibitions, brand pop-ups, launch receptions and evening cultural programming; open 10:00-22:00, last entry 21:30, closed Mondays except public holidays, telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 河南省郑州市中原区文澜街10号（丹水大道与长椿路交叉口东南角，常西湖新区郑州中央文化区）
area_text: 美术馆部分地上建筑面积2.3万㎡，共4层；7个展厅共7,000㎡，最大展厅1,700㎡，总展线1,800米
intro_zh: 郑州美术馆新馆位于郑州市中原区文澜街10号，丹水大道与长椿路交叉口东南角，处在常西湖新区郑州中央文化区（CCD）的文博组团内，与郑州博物馆、郑州大剧院、郑州科技馆新馆共同构成郑州西部的公共文化建筑群。郑州美术馆成立于1997年，瑞达馆位于高新区瑞达路83号；新馆2016年动工，2020年10月25日正式开馆，总投资5.3亿元。新馆与郑州档案史志馆同处一个地块，美术馆部分地上建筑面积2.3万平方米，共4层，设7个展厅、展厅面积7,000平方米，最大展厅1,700平方米，总展线1,800米。展厅配置国际专业照明、中央空调、恒温恒湿与全天候安防消防系统，可承接国画、油画、雕塑、版画、影像与大型装置等不同类型展览。建筑设计由同济大学建筑设计研究院（TJAD）曾群建筑研究室承担、中建七局施工，取中华艺术共同的“斗”形为建筑母体，外立面采用浅灰色预制混凝土装饰挂板（仿石材），并以参数化表皮转译石窟元素，白天浑然一体、夜晚透光灵动。交通方面，地铁14号线奥体中心站F口出站可达，地铁10号线市委党校站可换乘14号线；开放时间周二至周日9:00—17:00，16:30停止入馆，周一闭馆，个人凭身份证入馆、团队需提前预约。
intro_en: Zhengzhou Art Museum's new hall occupies No. 10 Wenlan Street, Zhongyuan District, Zhengzhou, at the southeast corner of Danshui Avenue and Changchun Road in the Changxihu Central Cultural District, where it forms a cultural cluster with the Zhengzhou Museum, Grand Theatre and new Science and Technology Museum. The museum was founded in 1997 with its Ruida hall on Ruida Road; the new hall broke ground in 2016 and opened on 25 October 2020 with an investment of RMB 530 million. Sharing a plot with the Zhengzhou Archives and Local Chronicles Hall, the museum itself has 23,000 sqm above ground over four floors, seven galleries totalling 7,000 sqm, a largest hall of 1,700 sqm and 1,800 metres of hanging line. Technical systems include professional gallery lighting, central air-conditioning, constant temperature and humidity control and round-the-clock security and fire monitoring, allowing painting, sculpture, print, photography, video and large installation shows. The building was designed by the Zeng Qun studio of Tongji Architectural Design (TJAD) and built by China Construction Seventh Engineering Bureau; it takes the ancient "dou" grain-measure form as its parent shape, clad in light-grey precast concrete panels imitating stone, with a parametric skin that translates grotto motifs, solid by day and softly lit at night. Metro Line 14 to Olympic Sports Centre station (Exit F) serves the site, with Line 10 connecting at the Party School station. It opens Tuesday to Sunday 9:00-17:00, last entry 16:30, closed Mondays; individuals enter with ID and groups book ahead.

address: 重庆市两江新区大竹林 金开大道西段玉竹路2号（重庆融创壹号院北侧约200米）
area_text: 约5,000㎡（场地资料口径，官方未公布），主展厅挑高7.2米，设三个展区与双庭院连廊
intro_zh: 重庆壹方艺术馆位于重庆市两江新区大竹林板块，金开大道西段玉竹路2号，在重庆融创壹号院北侧约200米，处在嘉陵江畔的浅丘台地上。它最初是融创壹号院的示范区，由融创团队历时91天、约450人推敲打磨，采用解构主义手法，把三角形、正方形不断重组，形成带坡顶的几何体量，窗外片状板式龙骨如千纸鹤展开；项目曾获国际设计奖项，后作为“城市艺术馆”长期向公众开放，是重庆主城少见的由住宅示范区转化而来的艺术空间。场馆分三个展区（A、B、C），室内外空间贯通，双庭院连廊把水景、植物与造景串起来，主展厅挑高约7.2米，场地开阔且私密性较好，配有12个私人停车位以及水电、灯源、空调、音响与投影设施。2020年8月28日，2020巴黎时装周儿童单元·重庆站DIOR大秀在此举行，被称为重庆首个顶级国际奢侈品大秀。2021年6月27日，“重庆艺术大市场·开放的六月”三大主题展在此开展，A区为“城的是：川美10画家作品展”，B区为邱正伦版《红楼梦》抄本手稿展（三年小楷抄录八十余万字），C区为120名融创小业主的“我的城·我的家”画展，近300件作品展出至7月25日。场馆适合当代艺术展、品牌发布、设计沙龙、音乐会与私宴；2025年9月科沃斯与《家居廊》的设计师沙龙亦在此举办。开放时间约10:00—18:00，具体以场馆公告为准。
intro_en: Yifang Art Museum sits in the Dazhulin area of Chongqing's Liangjiang New Area at 2 Yuzhu Road on the western section of Jinkai Avenue, about 200 metres north of Chongqing Sunac One Sino Park, on terraced ground above the Jialing River. It began as the sales pavilion for the Sunac development, refined over 91 days by roughly 450 people, and is built in a deconstructivist manner in which triangles and squares are repeatedly recomposed into pitched geometric volumes, with blade-like louvres outside reading as a flock of paper cranes; the project won international design awards and later opened permanently as an urban art museum, a rare case in Chongqing of a residential showpiece converted into public gallery space. The museum is organised in three zones, A, B and C, with indoor and outdoor areas linked by twin courtyard corridors that thread water, planting and landscape together; the main hall has a clear height of about 7.2 metres, the site is both open and private, and there are twelve dedicated parking bays plus power, lighting, air conditioning, audio and projection. On 28 August 2020 the Chongqing leg of the 2020 Paris Fashion Week children's unit staged a Dior show here, billed as the city's first top-tier international luxury runway event. On 27 June 2021 the 'Open June' programme of Chongqing Art Market opened three exhibitions here: ten Sichuan Fine Arts Institute painters in zone A, Qiu Zhenglun's hand-copied manuscript of Dream of the Red Chamber running to more than 800,000 characters in small regular script in zone B, and paintings by 120 young residents of Sunac communities in zone C, close to 300 works in all, on view to 25 July. The venue suits contemporary exhibitions, launches, design salons, concerts and private dinners; in September 2025 Ecovacs and Elle Decoration held a designer salon here. Opening hours are around 10:00 to 18:00, subject to the venue's notices.

address: 重庆市江北区江北嘴聚贤岩广场9号国华金融中心一至三层
area_text: 占地约1.2万㎡（另有资料记建筑面积约1万㎡）；三层共3个展厅；主展厅跃层挑高7米
intro_zh: 龙美术馆（重庆馆）位于重庆市江北区江北嘴聚贤岩广场9号国华金融中心一至三层，处在江北嘴中央商务区核心，隔江与渝中半岛、洪崖洞相望，是龙美术馆在上海浦东馆、西岸馆之后设立的第三座场馆，也是馆方所称的重庆首家国际级藏品展示与交流中心。场馆2016年5月26日正式开馆，由收藏家刘益谦、王薇夫妇创办，馆长王薇兼任总策展人。馆舍嵌入国华金融中心双子座裙楼，占地约1.2万平方米（另有资料记建筑面积约1万平方米），共三层、设三个展厅：主展厅采用跃层结构、挑高7米，分别聚焦中国传统艺术、革命主题绘画与现当代艺术，可容纳大幅油画、雕塑与装置。馆内另设艺术衍生品区、儿童教育空间、阅览室与多功能厅，把展览、公共教育与商务楼宇的日常动线结合，常办面向商务人士的艺术讲座与亲子工作坊。开馆展《百年艺程》从馆藏中选出1911至2011年间133件作品，按“西学东渐、艺术礼赞、十年颂歌、万象更新、多元格局”五部分梳理中国百年艺术历程。交通方面，地铁6号线重庆大剧院站步行约10分钟，经千厮门大桥、黄花园大桥可快速连接渝中；开放时间周二至周日9:30—17:30，17:00停止入场，周一闭馆，免费领票参观。
intro_en: The Long Museum's Chongqing branch occupies the first to third floors of the Guohua Financial Centre, No. 9 Juxianyan Square, Jiangbeizui, Jiangbei District, Chongqing, on the tip of the Jiangbeizui central business district facing the Yuzhong peninsula across the rivers. It is the third Long Museum after the Pudong and West Bund venues in Shanghai, and by the museum's own account the city's first international-standard collection display and exchange centre, founded by the collectors Liu Yiqian and Wang Wei and opened on 26 May 2016, with Wang Wei as director and chief curator. The museum is built into the podium of the Guohua twin towers and covers about 12,000 sqm (another account gives about 10,000 sqm of floor area) over three levels with three galleries. The main gallery uses a duplex structure with a 7 m clear height and focuses respectively on traditional Chinese art, revolutionary-themed painting and modern and contemporary art, suiting large canvases, sculpture and installation. Ancillary spaces include an art-derivative shop, a children's education area, a reading room and a multi-function hall, and the programme deliberately mixes art into the working day of the office towers through lectures for business audiences and family workshops. The opening exhibition, "A Century of Art", selected 133 works from 1911 to 2011 and arranged them in five sections tracing a hundred years of Chinese art. Metro Line 6 to Chongqing Grand Theatre station is about ten minutes on foot, and the Qiansimen and Huanghuayuan bridges link the site to Yuzhong. It opens Tuesday to Sunday 9:30-17:30, last entry 17:00, closed Mondays, with free admission by ticket.

address: 重庆市南岸区南滨路80号东原1891（时光道二期，长江南岸）
area_text: 面积近2000㎡，含临江高空露台
intro_zh: 原·美术馆位于重庆市南岸区南滨路80号东原1891商业群落，地处长江南岸滨江地带，2016年12月16日开馆。美术馆由东银控股总裁兼东原地产董事长罗韶颖发起创办，联合策展人梁克刚共同推动，是一座民营非营利艺术机构；因主体为临江球体建筑，被称为“重庆眼”。场馆面积近2000平方米，内部为圆形展场，附设临江高空露台，可俯瞰渝中半岛天际线，适合装置、影像与沉浸式展览，也可承办品牌发布与小型晚宴。开馆展“物相·心相·世相——中国当代艺术新常态”汇集25位艺术家的37件雕塑、装置与新媒体作品；同期启动“2016重庆大开眼界艺术季”，包含首届公共艺术与城市空间高端论坛及“公共艺术介入计划”，持续至2017年2月。此后举办肖全“时代肖像”摄影展、叶锦添“迷宫”艺术展、“抽象+”抽象绘画展等。馆藏两百余件，涵盖油画、版画、国画、雕塑、摄影、装置与影像。场馆嵌于东原1891时光道商业体内，周边餐饮、影院、书店集中，夜间人流稳定，适合艺术展览、时尚活动、品牌快闪与跨界合作；开放时间10:00-21:00（20:30停止入场）。
intro_en: Yuan Art Museum occupies the riverside spherical building within the Dongyuan 1891 complex at 80 Nanbin Road, Nan’an District, Chongqing, on the south bank of the Yangtze, and opened on 16 December 2016. Initiated by Luo Shaoying, chairwoman of Dongyuan Property under Dongyin Holding, together with curator Liang Kegang, it is a non-profit private art institution; its globe-like form has earned it the nickname “Chongqing Eye”. The museum covers nearly 2,000 square metres, with a circular hall and a high riverside terrace looking across to the Yuzhong peninsula skyline, a configuration that suits installation, video and immersive shows as well as brand launches and small dinners. Its opening exhibition, “Object, Mind, World — The New Normal of Chinese Contemporary Art”, gathered 37 sculptures, installations and new media works by 25 artists, and launched the 2016 Chongqing Wide-Open Art Season, which included the first public art and urban space forum and a public art intervention programme and ran until February 2017; it was followed by Xiao Quan’s “Portraits of an Era”, Tim Yip’s “Labyrinth” and the group show “Abstract Plus”. The collection of more than 200 works spans oil painting, printmaking, Chinese painting, sculpture, photography, installation and video. Embedded in the Dongyuan 1891 lifestyle complex with restaurants, a cinema and a bookshop around it, the museum draws steady evening footfall and suits exhibitions, fashion events, pop-ups and cross-sector collaborations; open 10:00-21:00, last entry 20:30, telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 重庆市高新区（沙坪坝区）大学城南路56号，四川美术学院虎溪校区内
area_text: 建筑面积23700㎡，展厅面积12000㎡，9个临时展厅+2个常设展厅（另有资料记12个展厅）
intro_zh: 四川美术学院美术馆又名罗中立美术馆，位于重庆市高新区（沙坪坝区）大学城南路56号四川美术学院虎溪校区内，2015年10月14日建成开馆，是重庆兼具公共美术馆与大学美术馆属性的省级美术馆。场馆建筑面积23700平方米，展厅面积12000平方米，设9个临时展厅和2个常设展厅，另有大厅、中庭、广场、贵宾室、会议室与媒体播放厅，可同时举办开幕式、讲座、论坛与沙龙。建筑由艺术家罗中立、郝大鹏等设计，整体呈围合布局，体量自由组合；外立面以收购来的废弃碎瓷砖拼贴出巨幅人物、树木与花卉图案，被称为世界上最大的彩色瓷砖图案覆盖建筑体，材料与人工成本低廉却极具辨识度。美术馆依托四川美术学院的教学与创作资源，关注中国当代艺术前沿与重要学术议题，是青年艺术家展览与校级交流的平台；同一机构还运营黄桷坪校区的重庆当代美术馆（九龙坡区黄桷坪正街108号）。场馆位于大学城核心，周边高校与文创园区密集，适合大型艺术展、毕业季、学术论坛与品牌青年文化活动；开放时间9:00-17:00（16:30停止入馆），周一闭馆；咨询电话未在本库列出。
intro_en: Sichuan Fine Arts Institute Art Museum, also known as Luo Zhongli Art Museum, sits inside the Huxi campus of Sichuan Fine Arts Institute at 56 Daxuecheng South Road in Chongqing’s High-tech Zone (Shapingba District). Completed and opened on 14 October 2015, it is a provincial-level museum combining the roles of public art museum and university museum. It covers 23,700 square metres with 12,000 square metres of gallery space, organised as nine temporary galleries and two permanent ones, plus a lobby, atrium, plaza, VIP room, meeting rooms and media screening room that allow openings, lectures, forums and salons to run alongside exhibitions. The building was designed by artists Luo Zhongli and Hao Dapeng among others, arranged as an enclosed cluster of freely composed volumes; its facades are clad in a giant mosaic of waste ceramic tiles bought from factories, forming figures, trees and flowers and described as the world’s largest architectural surface covered by a coloured tile pattern — a low-cost but highly recognisable skin. The museum draws on the institute’s teaching and studio resources, focuses on the forefront of Chinese contemporary art and significant academic questions, and serves as a platform for young artists and inter-school exchange; the same organisation also runs the Chongqing Contemporary Art Museum at 108 Huangjueping Main Street in Jiulongpo District. Set in the middle of the university town with campuses and creative parks nearby, it suits large exhibitions, graduation shows, academic forums and youth-oriented brand culture projects; open 9:00-17:00, last entry 16:30, closed Mondays, enquiry telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 湖南省长沙市长沙县远大三路1号 远大城·微笑金字塔
area_text: 展览空间约4,000㎡，分布于金字塔内四层（整座金字塔共7层）
intro_zh: MoW無用博物馆（Museum of Waste）位于湖南省长沙市长沙县远大三路1号的远大城园区内，载体是园区标志性的“微笑金字塔”。远大城是远大科技集团总部，1994年4月始建，占地约1平方公里，距长沙市中心16公里、机场12公里，1997年被命名为“远大科技园”，是中国第一个以企业名字命名的科技园区，园内建筑面积33.49万平方米，配套剧场、运动馆、瑜伽馆、图书馆、精品酒店与数十座伟人铜像。微笑金字塔1998年用一年时间建成，高约40米，内部共7层，最初用于陈列与接待。2020年，成立五年的P8星球以这座金字塔为空间载体发起“無用博物馆”项目，把原本用于储存物资的废弃仓库改造成艺术空间，重新讨论“什么是浪费”，将问题与挑战转译为艺术；空间承担艺术驻留展、自策展与合作展三类功能，2019年至2022年6月共策划6个国际艺术驻留项目。2020年12月19日，首展“Digital Humanity数字人文”P8星球线上驻留艺术家群展在此开幕，在约4,000平方米、四层递进的空间里呈现来自6个国家11位艺术家的作品，媒介从油画、雕塑延伸到影像与AR，观众沿旋转楼梯上行，灯光逐层转暗。金字塔的异形结构、无柱空间与企业园区的封闭感，使它适合装置展、沉浸式演出、品牌内容拍摄与实验性驻留项目；联络可经远大科技集团总机。
intro_en: MoW, the Museum of Waste, sits inside the Broad Town campus at 1 Yuanda San Road in Changsha County, Hunan, housed in the estate's landmark Smiling Pyramid. Broad Town is the headquarters of Broad Group, begun in April 1994 on about one square kilometre, sixteen kilometres from central Changsha and twelve from the airport; named Broad Tech Park in 1997, it was the first Chinese science park named after a company, with 334,900 square metres of buildings plus a theatre, sports hall, yoga studio, library, boutique hotel and dozens of bronze statues of historical figures. The Smiling Pyramid was built in a single year in 1998, roughly forty metres tall with seven internal levels, originally used for display and reception. In 2020 P8 Planet, then five years old, took the pyramid as the vehicle for the Museum of Waste project, converting a disused materials warehouse into an art space that reopens the question of what waste is and translates problems into art. It now carries artist-residency exhibitions, self-curated shows and cooperative exhibitions, and between 2019 and June 2022 it produced six international residency programmes. On 19 December 2020 the opening exhibition, 'Digital Humanity', presented eleven artists from six countries across roughly 4,000 square metres on four ascending levels, moving from painting and sculpture to video and AR, with visitors climbing a spiral stair as the lighting dims floor by floor. The pyramid's odd geometry, column-free volume and the enclosed feel of a corporate campus suit installations, immersive performances, brand content shoots and experimental residencies; contact is via the Broad Group switchboard, whose number is not included in this public dataset.

address: 长沙市岳麓区岳麓街道后湖村杜家塘15号（后湖路87号一带）
area_text: 规划面积2,110亩（141公顷），其中水面约600亩（40公顷）
intro_zh: 后湖国际艺术区位于长沙市岳麓区岳麓街道后湖村杜家塘15号（后湖路87号一带），夹在岳麓山与湘江之间，东起潇湘大道、西至后湖路、南临新江路、北抵阜埠河路，被中南大学、湖南大学、湖南师范大学三所高校环绕。后湖水面约600亩（40公顷），整个艺术区规划面积2,110亩（141公顷）。这里1958年前后由渔民围堰成渔场，1990年代中期成为中南地区最大的艺术培训聚集地，此后一度因污水与城中村问题沉寂。2017年5月起，岳麓区启动后湖片区综合整治，拆迁拆违、截污治水，并把沿湖民房改造为白墙黛瓦的工作室与展馆；2018年12月9日，后湖国际艺术园全面开园。园区以“脚手架艺术馆”、大师岛、后湖设计创意园等空间为核心，吸引朱训德、王跃文等百余位艺术家与设计师入驻，形成集原创绘画、设计、展览、交易、餐饮与休闲于一体的开放式艺术街区，也被称为长沙的“小鼓浪屿”。园区呈开放式布局，展馆、工作室、咖啡馆与餐厅沿湖分布，游客可步行串游。
intro_en: Houhu Lake International Art Zone lies in Yuelu District, Changsha, at No. 15 Du Jiatang in Houhu village, between Yuelu Mountain and the Xiang River. It is bounded by Xiaoxiang Avenue to the east, Houhu Road to the west, Xinjiang Road to the south and Fubuhe Road to the north, and is surrounded by Central South University, Hunan University and Hunan Normal University. The lake covers about 600 mu (40 hectares) within a planned art zone of 2,110 mu (141 hectares). The site was enclosed as a fishery in the late 1950s and by the mid-1990s had become central China's largest cluster of art-training schools; pollution and village sprawl later pushed artists away. From May 2017 the district carried out a comprehensive clean-up: demolishing illegal structures, intercepting sewage and treating the lake, while lakeside houses were renovated into white-walled studios and galleries. The park fully opened on 9 December 2018. Its core spaces include the Scaffold Art Museum, the Masters' Island and the Houhu Design and Creative Park. More than a hundred artists and designers, among them Zhu Xunde and Wang Yuewen, have settled here, creating an open district that combines original painting, design, exhibition, trading, dining and leisure. It is often called Changsha's "little Gulangyu".

address: 长沙市岳麓区湘江西岸滨江文化园（BOSMIA波西米亚文化艺术综合体内，地宝大厦西北侧裙楼2—3层）
area_text: 所在综合体建筑面积约1.8万㎡；美术馆位于2—3层
intro_zh: 田·当代美术馆（TIAN Contemporary Art Museum）位于长沙市岳麓区湘江西岸的滨江文化园，落在BOSMIA波西米亚文化艺术综合体内，具体位于地宝大厦西北侧裙楼2至3层。综合体由婚纱影像品牌波西米亚（BOSMIA）打造，总体量约1.8万平方米，是其首个文化艺术综合体；美术馆部分由品界设计（Scope Design）梁剑峰、翁德团队操刀，2021年7月启动设计，2022年6月竣工。设计以“田”与“乡土记忆”为线索：观众由独立入口经“序厅”拾级而上，城市噪音被隔绝，一道斜墙从平面生长出来，打破中轴对称，重建非对称的平衡；上到三层，“泥土盒子”与“泥土立面”在不同场域蔓延，把抽象的乡愁转译为可触摸的材料与光线。展陈空间以白墙、微水泥与自然采光为主，适合绘画、摄影、影像与小型装置展览。作为民营艺术空间，它与楼下的影像基地共享客流，试图把美术馆的学术性与影像消费的日常性放在同一栋楼里。品界设计把这次改造描述为从古典法则中析出抽象几何的尝试，用秩序感统摄材料、结构与光线。
intro_en: TIAN Contemporary Art Museum sits on the west bank of the Xiang River in Changsha, inside the BOSMIA Bohemia Culture and Art Complex in the Binjiang cultural park, on the second and third floors of the podium north-west of Dibao Tower. The complex was built by BOSMIA, a bridal-photography brand, as its first culture-and-art development, with a total floor area of about 18,000 square metres. The museum was designed by Scope Design, led by Liang Jianfeng and Weng De; design began in July 2021 and the building was completed in June 2022. The design takes "field" and rural memory as its themes. Visitors enter through a separate doorway and climb into a preface hall, where the noise of the street gives way to a still, dim space. A slanted wall grows out of the floor plan to break the conventional central axis, establishing an asymmetrical balance and resolving an awkward lift layout. On the third floor, "earth boxes" and a flowing "earth facade" carry the idea of soil as a carrier of abstract memory. Galleries use white walls, micro-cement and natural light and are suited to painting, photography, video and small installations. The museum shares its building with a photography production base, deliberately placing academic exhibition-making alongside the everyday consumption of images.

address: 长沙市望城区铜官街道彩陶源村（长沙铜官窑国家考古遗址公园西北角）
intro_zh: 长沙铜官窑遗址博物馆位于长沙市望城区铜官街道彩陶源村，坐落在长沙铜官窑国家考古遗址公园西北角，背靠觉华山，面朝湘江。铜官窑始于东汉，兴于中晚唐，是与浙江越窑、河北邢窑齐名的唐代三大出口瓷窑之一，首创釉下多彩与诗文题记装饰，产品经“黑石号”等沉船远销西亚与北非。窑址1956年被发现，1988年列为第三批全国重点文物保护单位，2012年6月国家考古遗址公园正式开园，2013年获国家考古遗址公园称号，园内已发现龙窑77处。博物馆以“诗意的彩瓷”为主题，建筑面积11,436.5平方米，布展面积6,272平方米，建筑以褐色为主调，由罗劲工作室设计，外形取意窑包与龙窑，与遗址地貌相互叠合。2018年5月15日正式对外开放，开馆展首次集中展出“黑石号”沉船出水的162件（套）长沙窑瓷器。馆内常设展梳理铜官窑的制瓷工艺、外销网络与湖湘陶瓷史，是理解唐代海上陶瓷之路的重要窗口。
intro_en: The Changsha Tongguan Kiln Site Museum stands at Caitaoyuan village, Tongguan subdistrict, Wangcheng District, Changsha, at the north-western corner of the Tongguan Kiln National Archaeological Site Park, with Juehua Mountain behind it and the Xiang River in front. Tongguan kilns began in the Eastern Han, flourished in the mid-to-late Tang and were one of the three great export kilns of the Tang, alongside Yue kilns in Zhejiang and Xing kilns in Hebei. They pioneered underglaze polychrome decoration and inscribed poems, and their wares reached West Asia and North Africa aboard ships such as the Belitung (Black Stone) wreck. The site was identified in 1956, listed as a national key cultural relic in 1988, opened as an archaeological park in June 2012 and was designated a national archaeological site park in 2013; 77 dragon kilns have been recorded. The museum, designed by Luo Jin Studio, takes "poetic painted porcelain" as its theme. It has a floor area of 11,436.5 square metres and 6,272 square metres of display space, and its brown-toned massing echoes the kiln mounds and dragon kilns of the landscape. It opened to the public on 15 May 2018, when 162 sets of Changsha ware recovered from the Belitung wreck went on show for the first time. Permanent displays trace the kiln's techniques, export networks and place in Hunan's ceramic history.

address: 湖南省长沙市岳麓区潇湘南路一段385号（洋湖湿地公园片区，湘江西岸）
area_text: 建筑占地15.3亩；建筑面积2.5万余平方米；四大专属展厅逾6,000㎡，五大临展展厅近5,000㎡
intro_zh: 李自健美术馆位于湖南省长沙市岳麓区潇湘南路一段385号，处在湖南湘江新区洋湖湿地公园片区的湘江之滨，与谢子龙影像艺术馆相邻，是长沙河西滨江文化带上的重要民营公益美术馆。美术馆由湘籍旅美画家李自健、丹慧夫妇独资创建，2015年1月1日破土动工，2016年10月1日正式开馆，总投资约2.2亿元；2017年7月获世界纪录认证机构（WRCA）认证为“全球最大的艺术家个人美术馆”，同年11月李自健夫妇将美术馆附义务赠予湖南湘江新区，馆名与公益性质不变，永久免费开放。馆舍建筑占地面积15.3亩，建筑面积2.5万余平方米，周围湖面与绿地约180亩。展陈以“人性与爱”为主题，长期陈列李自健17个系列、300余幅油画原作；A区设四大专属展厅逾6,000平方米，另有史料厅；B座及一层C展区设近5,000平方米的五大临展展厅。馆内还有星云大师书法馆与书屋、“心灵空间”多功能厅、水上音乐厅、国际艺术书店、艺咖啡、禅茶雅叙、文创超市与艺餐厅，可承接音乐演出、发布会、婚宴与商务活动。建筑由湖南大学设计研究院地方工作室魏春雨团队设计，体量天圆地方、临水而筑。交通方面，地铁3号线洋湖湿地站2号口骑行约10分钟，公交26路、318路至洋湖湿地公园站，222路至湘府路大桥西。开放时间周二至周日9:30—17:30，周一闭馆。
intro_en: Lizijian Art Museum stands at No. 385, Section 1 of Xiaoxiang South Road, Yuelu District, Changsha, on the Xiang River bank inside the Yanghu Wetland Park area of the Xiangjiang New Area, next to the Xie Zilong Image Art Museum. It was founded and funded by the Chinese-American painter Li Zijian and his wife Dan Hui, broke ground on 1 January 2015 and opened on 1 October 2016 at a cost of about RMB 220 million. In July 2017 the World Record Certification agency recognised it as the world's largest single-artist museum, and in November 2017 the couple donated the building to the Xiangjiang New Area on condition that its name and non-profit status never change; admission remains free. The building covers 15.3 mu (about 10,200 sqm) with more than 25,000 sqm of floor area, surrounded by roughly 180 mu of lake and lawn. The collection displays 17 series and more than 300 original oil paintings by Li Zijian under the theme "Humanity and Love"; Zone A holds four dedicated galleries of over 6,000 sqm plus a historical archive hall, while Zone B and the ground-floor C area provide nearly 5,000 sqm in five temporary galleries. Facilities include the Venerable Master Hsing Yun calligraphy hall and library, the multi-purpose "Soul Space", a waterside concert hall, an international art bookshop, cafes, a creative-goods shop and a lakeside restaurant that hosts banquets. The building was designed by Wei Chunyu's local studio at Hunan University's Design Institute. Metro Line 3 Yanghu Wetland station is about a ten-minute cycle away, with buses 26, 318 and 222 nearby. It opens Tuesday to Sunday 9:30-17:30 and closes on Mondays.

address: 长沙市岳麓区潇湘南路一段387号洋湖湿地公园D区
area_text: 占地约10亩，建筑面积约1.06万㎡，二三层展厅约4000㎡，展线约1000米
intro_zh: 谢子龙影像艺术馆位于长沙市岳麓区潇湘南路一段387号洋湖湿地公园D区，湘江西岸，2017年9月16日开馆。艺术馆由摄影家、老百姓大药房董事长谢子龙出资1.5亿元创建，占地约10亩，建筑面积约1.06万平方米，由湖南大学建筑学院魏春雨主持的地方工作室设计，整体为白色清水混凝土，混凝土白度经改良达到88%以上，是国内最白的清水混凝土建筑之一，2019年获亚洲建筑师协会建筑奖公共设施—文化及机构建筑类金奖。馆体四层：首层设艺术品商店、咖啡厅、多功能厅、亲水展示区与特展厅；二、三层共同构成约4000平方米的专业展厅，展线长约1000米；顶层为藏家俱乐部、图书馆、摄影棚与画廊。馆藏逾万件，以晚清、民国历史影像为核心，包括费利斯·比托、约翰·汤姆逊、赖阿芳、托马斯·查尔德、威廉·桑德斯等人的蛋白照片原作，并设馆藏展、典藏中国、当代综合展、湖湘在地文化项目与青年艺术计划五类常设展览。2019年5月升级为“谢子龙摄影博物馆”，归湖南省文物局主管。场馆位于洋湖湿地公园内，与李自健美术馆、湘江新区规划展示馆共同构成洋湖文化客厅，适合影像大展、品牌发布、颁奖礼与夜间活动；开放时间以馆方公告为准。
intro_en: Xie Zilong Photography Museum stands at 387 Xiaoxiang South Road, Section 1, in Zone D of Yanghu Wetland Park, Yuelu District, Changsha, on the west bank of the Xiang River, and opened on 16 September 2017. Founded with 150 million yuan from photographer Xie Zilong, chairman of Laobaixing Pharmacy, it occupies about ten mu of land with roughly 10,600 square metres of floor area. Designed by Wei Chunyu’s Regional Studio at Hunan University’s School of Architecture, it is built entirely in white fair-faced concrete whose whiteness was improved to over 88 percent, among the whitest such buildings in China, and it won the 2019 ARCASIA Award for Architecture in the public facilities, cultural and institutional category. The four levels place a shop, café, multi-purpose hall, waterside display area and special exhibition room on the ground floor; the second and third floors form about 4,000 square metres of professional galleries along a roughly 1,000-metre route; the top floor holds a collectors’ club, library, studio and gallery. The collection of more than 10,000 items centres on late Qing and Republican-era historical photography, including original albumen prints by Felice Beato, John Thomson, Lai Afong, Thomas Child and William Saunders, and the programme runs five standing strands: collection shows, “Collecting China”, contemporary group exhibitions, Hunan local culture projects and a young artist plan. In May 2019 it was upgraded to the Xie Zilong Photography Museum under the Hunan Provincial Bureau of Cultural Relics. Set inside Yanghu Wetland Park alongside the Li Zijian Art Museum and the Xiangjiang New Area planning exhibition hall, it suits large photography shows, brand launches, award ceremonies and evening events; opening hours should be confirmed with the museum, telephone and email are not included in this public dataset.

address: 青岛市西海岸新区银沙滩路1111号（唐岛湾南岸，西海艺术湾内）
area_text: 占地5837.5㎡，主体建筑1.7万㎡，12间展厅，另约8万㎡户外花园
status_note: 2025年7月1日闭馆，恢复时间未定，不可按在营场地排活动
intro_zh: 西海美术馆（TAG Art Museum）位于青岛市西海岸新区银沙滩路1111号，唐岛湾南岸，面朝黄海，是西海艺术湾艺术社区的核心场馆，2021年8月12日正式开放。美术馆由法国建筑师、普利兹克奖得主让·努维尔设计，占地5837.5平方米，主体建筑面积1.7万平方米，由12间相互连通又相对独立的展厅组成，沿海岸线展开；外立面使用阳极氧化铝板与巨型玻璃幕墙，反射海面天光，室内以可调节的自然光与深色展墙组织观展动线，另配约8万平方米户外花园，法国景观设计师吉尔·克莱芒参与景观设计。开馆展“超越”由范迪安、张子康策展，汇集徐冰、隋建国、大卫·霍克尼等14位国内外艺术家，多为首次在中国展出的新作。场馆定位为非营利艺术机构，兼具经典与当代、时尚与设计、音乐与表演等内容；运营期间曾承接路易威登、万国表等品牌活动，并作为电影《流浪地球2》的实景取景地。需要说明的是，馆方于2025年6月28日发布公告，自2025年7月1日起闭馆，开放时间另行通知，未核销门票可退，场地目前不宜按在营场馆安排活动，接洽前须向馆方确认状态。。
intro_en: TAG Art Museum stands at 1111 Yinshatan Road in Qingdao’s West Coast New Area, on the southern bank of Tangdao Bay facing the Yellow Sea, and is the core venue of the TAG Art Bay arts community; it opened to the public on 12 August 2021. Designed by French architect and Pritzker laureate Jean Nouvel, it occupies a 5,837.5-square-metre site with a 17,000-square-metre main building made up of twelve interconnected yet relatively independent galleries arranged along the coastline. Anodised aluminium panels and giant glass curtain walls reflect the sea and sky, while inside, adjustable daylight and dark exhibition walls shape the route; an outdoor garden of about 80,000 square metres was designed with French landscape architect Gilles Clément. The opening exhibition, “Beyond”, curated by Fan Dian and Zhang Zikang, brought together fourteen Chinese and international artists including Xu Bing, Sui Jianguo and David Hockney, most with works shown in China for the first time. The institution is non-profit and programmes classical and contemporary art alongside fashion, design, music and performance; while operating it hosted brand events for Louis Vuitton and IWC and served as a live-action location for the film The Wandering Earth II. It should be noted that the museum announced on 28 June 2025 that it would close from 1 July 2025 until further notice, with refunds for unused tickets, so the venue should not currently be programmed as an operating museum without confirming its status; telephone details are not included in this public dataset.

address: 上海市徐汇区龙腾大道2380号
intro_zh: 上海油罐艺术中心（Tank Shanghai）位于徐汇区龙腾大道2380号，坐落在黄浦江西岸、中国最早的机场——龙华机场原址，是西岸滨江艺术带中辨识度最高的工业遗存改造项目之一。项目由OPEN建筑事务所李虎、黄文菁主持设计，2013年至2019年完成，2019年3月23日正式对公众开放。基地上五个废弃航油罐被一条Z字形“超级地面”连接：地面之上是起伏草坡与两个广场、一片都市森林，地面之下是连通的室内展览与服务空间；五个罐体分别被改造为一个音乐表演空间、一个餐厅和三个尺度各异的展厅，总建筑面积10,845平方米，用地47,448平方米。油罐原有的圆形混凝土壳体被最大限度保留，新功能以轻介入方式置入，形成“公园+美术馆”的开放格局，观众可以在草坪、水景与展厅之间自由穿行。开馆展包括teamLab《油罐中的水粒子世界》与阿德里安·比利亚尔·罗哈斯个展，此后持续呈现国际当代艺术项目。交通方面，地铁11号线龙耀路站步行约5分钟，公交1222路至云锦路龙耀路站步行约5分钟；周边可与西岸艺术中心、龙美术馆、西岸美术馆串联参观。
intro_en: Tank Shanghai sits at 2380 Longteng Avenue in Xuhui District, on the west bank of the Huangpu River and on the site of Longhua Airport, China's earliest airfield. Five disused aviation fuel tanks were kept and reworked by OPEN Architecture, led by Li Hu and Huang Wenjing, between 2013 and 2019; the centre opened to the public on 23 March 2019. A Z-shaped 'Super-Surface' links the tanks: above it rise grassy slopes, two open plazas and a pocket urban forest, while below it run connected indoor exhibition and service spaces. The five cylinders were assigned different roles, becoming a music performance space, a restaurant and three galleries of contrasting character. The total building area is 10,845 square metres on a 47,448-square-metre site, and the original circular concrete shells were retained wherever possible, with new functions inserted lightly to create an open 'park plus museum' arrangement in which visitors move freely between lawn, water, trees and galleries. The opening programme included teamLab's 'Water Particles in the Tank' and a solo exhibition by Adrián Villar Rojas, and the venue has continued to stage international contemporary art. Metro Line 11 to Longyao Road station is about a five-minute walk away, and bus 1222 stops at Yunjin Road/Longyao Road, also roughly five minutes on foot. The centre pairs naturally with the West Bund Art Center, the Long Museum and the West Bund Museum for a full day along the river.

address: 上海市浦东新区滨江大道4777号（近浦电路浦明路口）
intro_zh: 艺仓美术馆（Modern Art Museum Shanghai）位于浦东新区滨江大道4777号，坐落在黄浦江东岸的老白渡煤运码头，前身是20世纪80年代建造的煤仓。2015年第一届上海城市空间艺术季曾把这里作为案例展分展场，以“重新装载”为题让业界看到煤仓粗粝空间与展览结合的可能，随后由大舍建筑设计事务所柳亦春与同济大学建筑设计研究院合作改造，2016年正式开馆。美术馆建筑面积近7,000平方米，共5个展厅，保留了煤仓的高大尺度与工业结构痕迹，并配套艺术商店、咖啡馆、酒吧和天台；主楼之外，沿江向北1.2公里还有15个长廊单元和一条高架步道，原是运煤通道，现作为“艺仓快闪魔盒”等灵活展演空间。定位上强调“多元、开放、交流、学习”，兼顾东西方经典艺术、现代设计与生活美学、新科技与多元媒体，并以“艺术在发生”为理念做公共教育；2019年起被评为浦东夜间经济示范点，每周五晚举办“艺仓音乐夜”。交通方面，地铁4号线塘桥站4号口步行约15分钟，公交795、1019路至浦电路站，或01、82、314、607、789、818、981、985、992路至浦东南路浦电路站。
intro_en: Modern Art Museum Shanghai (MAM) stands at 4777 Binjiang Avenue in Pudong New Area, on the east bank of the Huangpu at the old Laobaidu coal wharf, in a coal bunker built in the 1980s. The first Shanghai Urban Space Art Season used the partly dismantled bunker in 2015 as a case-study venue, with an exhibition titled 'Reload' that demonstrated how its rough industrial spaces could hold art; Atelier Deshaus (Liu Yichun) then worked with Tongji Architectural Design Group on the conversion, and the museum opened in 2016. The building offers close to 7,000 square metres across five galleries, retaining the bunker's tall volumes and industrial structure, and is completed by an art shop, café, bar and roof terrace. Beyond the main block, 15 corridor units and an elevated walkway run 1.2 kilometres north along the river — formerly the coal route and now used as flexible pop-up exhibition and performance spaces. The programme stresses diversity, openness, exchange and learning, spanning classical and contemporary art from East and West, modern design and everyday aesthetics, and new technology and media, with public education organised under the idea that 'art is happening'. It has been a Pudong night-economy demonstration site since 2019 and hosts a Friday-evening music night. Metro Line 4 to Tangqiao (Exit 4) is about a 15-minute walk; buses 795 and 1019 stop at Pudian Road, and routes 01, 82, 314, 607, 789, 818, 981, 985 and 992 serve Pudong South Road/Pudian Road.

name_zh: 海上世界文化艺术中心
address: 深圳市南山区蛇口望海路1187号
intro_zh: 海上世界文化艺术中心（SWCAC）位于深圳市南山区蛇口望海路1187号，处在海上世界片区、蛇口滨海带，背靠南山、面朝深圳湾，是招商蛇口投资建设、由设计互联运营的综合文化平台，2017年12月正式开放。建筑由普利兹克奖得主、日本建筑师槙文彦（Fumihiko Maki）领衔的槙综合计画事务所设计，是其在中国内地的首个建成项目，总建筑面积约7.39万平方米，用地面积约2.62万平方米；造型以三层“平台”承托三座铝面“楼阁”，分别朝向山、海、城三个方向，白色石造外墙与简洁几何体量延续了槙氏一贯的克制手法。馆内主要包括设计互联主展馆（五个画廊，主展厅挑高9.5米、由天窗采光）、V&A展馆（与英国维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆合作）、园景展厅、800平方米的视界厅、三层与四层的境山剧场（304座，阶梯式山景室内乐厅，租赁面积约350平方米）、多功能厅、设计商店与滨海餐饮；屋顶花园与三层平台可看海景，建筑前广场常做市集与公共活动。定位上以设计为核心，连接艺术、设计、科技与产业，常年举办设计展、论坛、演出与教育项目。交通方面，地铁2号线海上世界站步行可达，蛇口邮轮母港约5分钟车程，可乘船往返港珠澳。
intro_en: Sea World Culture and Arts Center (SWCAC) stands at 1187 Wanghai Road in Shekou, Nanshan District, Shenzhen, in the Sea World district on the Shekou waterfront, with Nanshan behind it and Shenzhen Bay in front. Invested in and built by China Merchants Shekou and operated by Design Society, it opened in December 2017. The building was designed by Pritzker laureate Fumihiko Maki and Maki and Associates — the practice's first completed project in mainland China — and has a total floor area of about 73,918 square metres on a site of some 26,162 square metres. Its form sets a three-storey podium beneath three aluminium-clad pavilions facing mountain, sea and city respectively, with white stone facades and restrained geometric volumes characteristic of Maki. Inside are the Design Society main gallery (five galleries, the largest a 9.5-metre-high skylit hall), the V&A Gallery (a partnership with the Victoria and Albert Museum), the Park View Gallery, the 304-seat Mountain View Theater on the third and fourth floors (a stepped, wood-lined chamber-music hall with about 350 square metres of rentable front- and back-of-house space), plus a multi-function hall, design shop and waterfront dining. Roof gardens and third-floor terraces open onto the sea, and the forecourt regularly hosts markets and public events. Programming centres on design and connects art, design, technology and industry through exhibitions, forums, performances and education. Metro Line 2 to Sea World station is within walking distance, and Shekou Cruise Home Port, with ferries to Hong Kong, Macau and Zhuhai, is about five minutes away by car.

address: 上海市浦东新区滨江大道2777号（富城路近明珠塔路口进）
intro_zh: 浦东美术馆（MAP）位于浦东新区滨江大道2777号，处在小陆家嘴滨江核心区、东方明珠塔脚下，与隔江的外滩万国建筑群相对，是陆家嘴集团投资、建设并运营的公共美术馆。项目2017年9月26日启动建设，由法国让·努维尔事务所（AJN）设计，2021年7月8日正式向公众开放；占地1.3万平方米，总建筑面积4万平方米，设13个固定展厅及开放式展厅，可展览面积超过1万平方米，可同时容纳三到四个大型展览，并配置6个不同尺寸的藏品库和全馆24小时恒温恒湿系统。建筑体量沿江展开，展厅与公共空间交替布置，多处可眺望黄浦江与外滩。开馆之年即与泰特美术馆、米罗美术馆及蔡国强合作推出“光：泰特美术馆珍藏展”“蔡国强：远行与归来”“胡安·米罗：女人·小鸟·星星”等大展，定位为国际艺术展示交流为主、兼顾国内艺术，突出展览、美育、文创、国际交流四大功能。交通方面，地铁2号线陆家嘴站2号口出站步行可达；馆内不设停车场，可停富都滨江、上海国际会议中心或正大广场停车场。
intro_en: Museum of Art Pudong (MAP) stands at 2777 Binjiang Avenue in Pudong New Area, in the core riverside area of small Lujiazui at the foot of the Oriental Pearl Tower, facing the Bund's historic waterfront across the river. It was invested in, built and is operated by Lujiazui Group, with construction starting on 26 September 2017 to a design by Ateliers Jean Nouvel and opening to the public on 8 July 2021. The site covers 13,000 square metres and the total floor area is 40,000 square metres, containing 13 permanent galleries plus open-plan display areas; more than 10,000 square metres can be used for exhibitions, allowing three or four large shows at once, supported by six storage rooms of different sizes and a 24-hour temperature-and-humidity control system throughout. Public spaces alternate with the galleries and repeatedly open onto the Huangpu and the Bund. In its opening year MAP worked with Tate, the Joan Miró Foundation and Cai Guo-Qiang on 'Light: Works from Tate's Collection', 'Cai Guo-Qiang: Odyssey and Homecoming' and 'Joan Miró: Women, Birds, Stars', positioning itself primarily for international exchange while also showing Chinese art, with exhibition, education, cultural products and international dialogue as its four functions. Metro Line 2 to Lujiazui (Exit 2) is a short walk away; there is no on-site parking, but Fudu Riverside, Shanghai International Convention Centre and Super Brand Mall car parks are nearby.

address: 上海市黄浦区南京西路231号人民公园内（7号门）
intro_zh: 上海当代艺术馆（MoCA Shanghai）位于黄浦区南京西路231号人民公园7号门内，处在上海博物馆、上海大剧院、上海市政厅与城市规划展示馆围合的市中心文化区，2005年开馆，是中国最早的独立非营利当代艺术机构之一。场馆由龚明光基金会出资两千多万元建造，建筑原为人民公园内的一座玻璃花房，经建筑师刘宇扬改造为玻璃盒子式的艺术馆，总面积约4,000平方米；一层与二层展厅合计近1,800平方米，配备恒温恒湿系统，二层保留原玻璃花房结构并可看到公园景观，另设可容纳约80人的多功能厅，三层为MoCA on the Park艺术空间与餐厅。MoCA以“艺术生活化”为方向，早期以时尚品牌大展著称（如梵克雅宝、菲拉格慕、香奈儿、迪奥等），后拓展至当代艺术、设计与科技交叉项目，2007年创办动漫美学双年展，并设MoCA Pavilion与“无墙美术馆”社区公共项目。交通方面，地铁1、2、8号线人民广场站步行可达，公交18、20、37、46、49、123、201、531、574、921路至人民广场站或西藏中路站。
intro_en: Museum of Contemporary Art Shanghai (MoCA) sits inside Gate 7 of People's Park at 231 West Nanjing Road, Huangpu District, within the downtown cultural quarter formed by the Shanghai Museum, Shanghai Grand Theatre, the former Municipal Council building and the Urban Planning Exhibition Centre. Opened in 2005, it is one of China's earliest independent non-profit contemporary art institutions. The Gong Mingguang Foundation funded its construction with more than 20 million yuan, converting a glass greenhouse in the park into a glass-box museum under architect Liu Yuyang. The total area is about 4,000 square metres, with roughly 1,800 square metres of galleries on the first and second floors served by temperature and humidity control; the second floor retains the original greenhouse structure and looks out into the park, and there is a multi-function room for about 80 people plus MoCA on the Park and a restaurant on the third floor. MoCA has pursued 'art into life', becoming known for major fashion-brand exhibitions (Van Cleef & Arpels, Salvatore Ferragamo, Chanel, Dior) before widening into contemporary art, design and technology crossovers; it founded the Animamix Biennial in 2007 and runs MoCA Pavilion and 'museum without walls' community programmes. Metro Lines 1, 2 and 8 to People's Square are within walking distance, and buses 18, 20, 37, 46, 49, 123, 201, 531, 574 and 921 serve People's Square and Xizang Middle Road.

intro_zh: 灰仓艺术中心（又称灰仓美术馆、灰仓艺术空间）位于上海市杨浦区杨树浦路2800号杨树浦电厂遗迹公园内，处在黄浦江杨浦滨江东段尽头的旧码头，是杨浦“生活秀带”国家文物保护利用示范区中由工业遗存改造的展览与活动场地。场地前身是1913年英商投资建成的杨树浦发电厂，曾被称为“远东第一火力发电厂”，园内至今保留105米烟囱、鹤嘴吊、输煤栈桥以及湿灰、干灰储灰罐等作业设施。灰仓由三座干灰储灰罐改造而成，同济原作设计工作室（章明、张姿、秦曙）自2015年起设计、2019年建成，改造面积约3840平方米：两片景观平台把原本独立的三个罐体连为一体，原15米通高的封闭罐壁换成水平条带构成的“朦胧界面”，一条公共漫游路径从底部混凝土框架盘旋至屋顶观景平台，六个功能未定的空间连同折跑楼梯以“插件”方式插入罐体，屋顶另加装光伏板为园区供电。2019年上海城市空间艺术季期间，它作为东段驿站由吉马良斯、高桥启祐、韩家英、章明四位创作者共同打造；2023年又成为该艺术季杨浦展区的展场。onsiteclub案例库收录其2个案例：2022年11月宝马XM“狂想奇境”晚宴把车展与晚宴置于高空场景，2026年7月Nike TOMA街头足球全国总决赛沿滨江筒仓肌理做开放式模块化搭建，划分竞赛球场、体验球场、打卡通道、潮流市集与舞台。圆筒空间的尺度与回声、外露的钢构与直面浦江的天际线，适合汽车发布、奢品晚宴、运动潮流赛事、时装秀、声音与影像装置及品牌派对。交通可乘地铁12号线至隆昌路站3号口，步行约1.9公里（建议骑行），或乘公交至杨树浦路沿线；平日无展时内部暂不开放，屋顶平台与外围可参观，前往前宜确认展期。
intro_en: The Ash Gallery — also known as Huicang Art Centre or Huicang Art Space — stands at 2800 Yangshupu Road in Yangpu District, Shanghai, on the old wharf at the eastern end of the Yangpu waterfront. It is one of the converted industrial buildings inside the “Life Showbelt” national demonstration zone for heritage protection and use, a stretch of former factories and docks turned into a continuous riverside park. The site was the Yangshupu Power Plant, built with British capital in 1913 and once described as the largest thermal power station in the Far East; the park still holds its 105-metre chimney, grab crane, coal conveyor bridge and the wet and dry ash silos. The gallery itself is the dry-ash silo group, converted between 2015 and 2019 by Zhang Ming, Zhang Zi and Qin Shu of Tongji Original Design Studio, with about 3,840 sq m of floor area. Two new viewing platforms tie the three formerly separate silos into one volume; the closed 15-metre-high steel skin is replaced by horizontal bands that read as a hazy screen, and a continuous public promenade spirals from the concrete frame at ground level to a roof terrace. Six undetermined boxes and a switchback stair are plugged into the cylinders, and photovoltaic panels on the roof now help power neighbouring facilities. In the 2019 Shanghai Urban Space Art Season it served as the eastern rest station, with works by José de Guimarães, Keisuke Takahashi, Han Jiaying and Zhang Ming, and it was again an exhibition venue for the 2023 edition. The onsiteclub case library holds two events here: BMW's XM “Fantasy Wonderland” gala dinner in November 2022, which staged the car display and dinner high above the river, and the Nike TOMA national street-football finals in July 2026, built as open modular courts, experience zones, a market and a stage against the silos. The cylindrical rooms, exposed steel and river skyline suit car launches, luxury dinners, street-sport and fashion events, sound and video installations and brand parties.
