Metro Line 12 to Longchang Road, exit 3, leaves a 1.9 km walk or a short bike ride; buses serve Yangshupu Road. The interior closes between exhibitions while the roof and exterior stay open, so opening dates should be checked before a visit.

address: 上海市黄浦区淮海中路300号
intro_zh: 上海K11购物艺术中心位于黄浦区淮海中路300号，地处淮海中路—新天地商圈，是内地较早把“购物+艺术”做成固定运营模式的商业体。项目由新世界发展打造，2013年6月28日正式开业，商场部分为地下三层至地上六层、面积约4万平方米，其上为高278.3米、59层的香港新世界大厦（1998—2004年建成，B+H事务所设计），塔楼总建筑面积136,833平方米。K11的核心艺术空间是位于地下三层的chi K11美术馆，约3,000平方米，另在商场各层散布当代艺术装置与“艺术村”式展示空间，形成“看展—购物—餐饮”一体化动线；2014年莫奈特展在此举办，截至5月中旬观展人数已超过26万人次，主办方预计展期结束可达40万，成为国内商业空间办大展的样本。建筑本身是既有写字楼裙房的整体改造，立面以金色塔楼与流线玻璃顶棚为标志，商场内部空间适合品牌快闪、发布与艺术装置。交通方面，地铁1号线一大会址·黄陂南路站2号口、13号线淮海中路站均可步行到达，周边公交线路密集，地处上海核心商圈，夜间与周末人流稳定。
intro_en: Shanghai K11 Art Mall stands at 300 Middle Huaihai Road in Huangpu District, in the Huaihai Road–Xintiandi retail district, and was an early mainland complex to make 'retail plus art' a permanent operating model. Developed by New World Development, it opened on 28 June 2013. The mall occupies three basement and six above-ground levels, with roughly 40,000 square metres of retail space, and sits beneath the 278.3-metre, 59-storey Hong Kong New World Tower, completed between 1998 and 2004 to a design by B+H Architects; the tower's total floor area is 136,833 square metres. K11's artistic core is the chi K11 art museum on basement level three, about 3,000 square metres, supplemented by contemporary installations and art-village display areas scattered through the shopping floors, so that exhibitions, retail and dining form a single route. Its 2014 Monet exhibition had drawn more than 260,000 visitors by mid-May, with organisers projecting 400,000 by the close, and became a reference case for staging major art shows inside commercial space. The building is a comprehensive reworking of an existing office podium, marked by the golden tower and a streamlined glass canopy, whose interior suits brand pop-ups, launches and installations. Metro Line 1 to the Site of the First CPC Congress·Huangpi South Road station (Exit 2) or Line 13 to Middle Huaihai Road station puts visitors at the door, and dense bus routes serve the surrounding commercial core, which stays busy at weekends and in the evening.

name_zh: K11购物艺术中心 K11 Select
intro_zh: 武汉K11 Select（光谷K11）位于武汉市东湖新技术开发区关山大道355号，处在“中国光谷”核心的关山大道与雄楚大道交汇片区，2017年11月2日开业，是继香港、上海之后全国第三座、华中首座K11购物艺术中心，也是K11 Select产品线的首个落地项目。项目商业面积约5.4万平方米，地上五层、地下一层，开业时引进150家店铺，其中25%首进华中、30%首进武汉、首进光谷品牌占比达70%，早期以“时髦、雅致、轻奢”立身，近年转向“潮&趣”生活主场，餐饮占比约三成。空间由株式会社乃村工艺社担纲设计，以“水·生命·循环”为主题，中庭墙面如枝干向上伸展，馆内布置“云、湖泊、瀑布”等科技互动装置，并以367块LED屏做到全馆覆盖，其中三成以上为互动屏。艺术在这里是动线的一部分：入口有9米高的蒲公英新媒体装置，各层分布《午夜美术馆》《重力B立方体》《四十万公里》《邻窗·英伦风》与由1500片等边三角形灯片组成的《问候》，背后有武汉K11艺术村的资源支撑，开业两周年时已举办近百场主题活动与36场艺术展，KAWS《WHAT PARTY》雕塑华中首展曾在此落地；L4为花园漫步、L5为天空泳池营地，3300个地下车位中的“怪兽停车场”也被用作派对空间。onsiteclub案例库收录其2个案例：2025年4月19日宏基“新轻年 轻而不凡”快闪在B1中庭搭出巨型笔记本场景，做互动游戏、一日店长与新品发布；同年4月11日至20日《战双帕弥什》主题快闪落在L1中庭，以屏幕打卡、周边领取与COSER走秀聚拢二次元客群。项目因此适合3C数码、游戏与电竞、潮玩IP、美妆与服饰品牌的快闪店、新品发布、市集、粉丝应援与中小型赛事。交通上，地铁11号线关山大道站（2024年12月开通，位于雄楚大道与关山大道交叉口东侧）步行可达，另有光谷有轨电车T1线与多条公交接驳，自驾可经雄楚大道高架、关山大道与光谷大道进入。
intro_en: Wuhan K11 Select, locally known as Optics Valley K11, occupies 355 Guanshan Avenue in the East Lake High-Tech Development Zone, at the junction with Xiongchu Avenue in the heart of the Optics Valley. It opened on 2 November 2017 as the third K11 art mall in China after Hong Kong and Shanghai, the first in central China and the debut of the smaller K11 Select format. The scheme has about 54,000 sq m of retail over five levels above ground and one below, and opened with 150 stores, of which 25 per cent were new to central China, 30 per cent new to Wuhan and 70 per cent new to the valley. Originally pitched at the smart-casual luxury segment, it has shifted towards a younger “trend and fun” mix, with food and beverage taking roughly 30 per cent. Nomura of Japan designed the interiors around the theme of water, life and circulation: atrium walls rise like tree branches, cloud, lake and waterfall installations respond to visitors, and 367 LED screens — more than 30 per cent of them interactive — cover the whole mall, making it the first shopping centre in China to be screened throughout. Art is part of the circulation rather than a separate room, from the nine-metre dandelion installation at the entrance to works on each floor including Midnight Museum, Gravity B Cube, Forty Thousand Kilometres, the British Window and Greeting, a 35-metre wave of 1,500 triangular light panels. The K11 Art Village supports the programme; by its second anniversary the mall had hosted nearly 100 events and 36 art exhibitions, and KAWS's WHAT PARTY sculpture had its central-China premiere here. Levels four and five hold a garden walk and a rooftop pool camp, and the 3,300-space basement car park includes the graffiti-covered Monster car park used for parties. The onsiteclub library holds two cases: Acer's “New Youth, Light but Extraordinary” pop-up in the B1 atrium on 19 April 2025, built around a giant laptop with games, a guest shop manager and a product launch, and Punishing: Gray Raven's theme pop-up in the L1 atrium from 11 to 20 April 2025, with screen check-ins, merchandise and cosplay catwalks. The venue suits consumer electronics, gaming and esports, designer-toy IP, beauty and fashion pop-ups, launches, markets and fan events. Metro Line 11's Guanshan Avenue station, opened in December 2024 at the Xiongchu–Guanshan junction, is within walking distance, with the Optics Valley tram T1 and buses nearby and the Xiongchu Avenue elevated road for drivers.

address: 上海市黄浦区南苏州路1247号（新闸路桥与乌镇路桥之间，苏州河南岸）
intro_zh: 八号桥艺术空间·1908粮仓位于上海市黄浦区南苏州路1247号，夹在新闸路桥与乌镇路桥之间的苏州河南岸，与四行仓库隔河相望。建筑始建于1908年，原为中国通商银行第二仓库，后成为民国时期杜月笙的私家粮仓，百余年里一直作为仓储使用，是苏州河沿岸工业遗产带的典型样本。外立面为红砖清水墙、以青砖嵌饰，仓库的窗与门大量采用木纹形式并配精细细部，屋顶为歇山式；室内地板与立柱裸露粗糙木纹，墙面陈年白灰遮不住砖缝，古朴与前卫并置。2017年，设计师汪昶行在遇到这栋荒废多年的老房子后主持改造，用48天完成修复与功能更新，坚持“修旧如旧”，保留“仓、河、桥、砖、木”五种场地元素，随后以“八号桥艺术空间·1908粮仓”之名重新开放。空间建筑面积2,000多平方米，共三层：一层为互动休闲空间，引入精酿啤酒吧“啤酒阿姨”、体验书店等；二层为文化艺术空间，承接艺术展览与培训；三层为时尚演出空间，可做话剧演出与影视拍摄。运营方八号桥集团同时在此举办展览展示、文化交流、艺术活动、时尚发布与品牌快闪。场馆周二至周日9:30—17:00开放，周一闭馆，地铁1号线新闸路站1号口步行可达，适合中小型展览、品牌发布、影视取景与沙龙。
intro_en: Bridge 8 Art Space · 1908 Granary occupies 1247 Nan Suzhou Road in Huangpu District, on the south bank of Suzhou Creek between Xinzha Road Bridge and Wuzhen Road Bridge, facing the Sihang Warehouse across the water. The building dates from 1908, when it served as the second warehouse of the Chinese Commercial Bank and later as the private granary of the Shanghai magnate Du Yuesheng; it remained in storage use for more than a century and is a textbook piece of the creek's industrial heritage belt. Its facade is fair-faced red brick with grey-brick insets, the warehouse windows and doors are largely timber-grained with fine detailing, and the roof is a hipped, gable-and-hip form; inside, floors and columns show rough grain and old whitewash cannot hide the cracks between bricks, so the archaic and the avant-garde sit together. In 2017 the designer Wang Changxing came across the long-abandoned house and led a 48-day restoration and reprogramming, keeping the fabric as found and preserving the five site elements of warehouse, river, bridge, brick and timber before reopening it as Bridge 8 Art Space. The building has just over 2,000 square metres over three floors: the ground floor is an interactive leisure level with the Beer Lady craft taproom and a bookshop; the second floor is a cultural and art level for exhibitions and training; the third is a performance level for theatre, film and fashion shoots. Operator Bridge 8 Group also runs exhibitions, cultural exchanges, art events, fashion releases and brand pop-ups here. It opens Tuesday to Sunday, 9:30 to 17:00, closed Monday, a short walk from Xinzha Road station on Line 1, and suits small and mid-sized exhibitions, launches, filming and salons.

address: 成都市青羊区贝森北路1号
intro_zh: 西村大院位于成都市青羊区贝森北路1号，是建筑师刘家琨主持、家琨建筑设计事务所设计的一座非传统城市综合体，业主为四川迈伦实业有限责任公司。项目用地为东西长237米、南北长178米的完整街廓，四面临街、住宅环绕，用地性质为社区体育服务用地，容积率2.0、覆盖率40%、限高24米；2010年4月动工，2015年1月建成，总建筑面积135,552平方米，5至6层，高24米。设计一反中心体量集合的常规，采用“外环内空”的布局：建筑沿街廓边缘围合，中间留出公园般的超大院落，大、中、小竹林院落层层相套并向公众开放，延续成都人竹下休闲的生活方式。一条架空休闲跑道绕大院一圈并攀升至屋顶，跑步与骑行的人可以连续绕行，跑道也成为建筑最具辨识度的动态形象。功能上混合运动休闲、文化艺术与时尚创意：中庭是球场与综合景观，环形建筑内是餐饮、零售、办公与工作室，北侧保留的原有建筑被改造为多功能艺术空间——西村艺术空间。西村艺术空间自2010年起持续办展，首届西南地区高等院校毕业生艺术作品联展展出9所院校近80名毕业生的200多件作品，此后举办“跨界—颠覆”艺术家与设计师邀请展、2023年“星光国潮文创展”等。西村大院2016年入选第15届威尼斯建筑双年展主题馆，2025年刘家琨获普利兹克建筑奖后成为建筑参观热点；大院获首批“四川省五星级体育服务综合体”；咨询与预约请走场馆公开渠道。
intro_en: West Village (Xicun) occupies 1 Beisen North Road in Qingyang District, Chengdu: an unconventional urban complex designed by Liu Jiakun and his office Jiakun Architects for Sichuan Mailun Industrial. The site is a complete block 237 metres east to west and 178 metres north to south, ringed by streets and mature housing, zoned for community sports use with a plot ratio of 2.0, 40 per cent coverage and a 24 metre height limit; construction ran from April 2010 to January 2015, producing 135,552 square metres over five and six storeys at 24 metres. Instead of the usual central mass, the design rings the block and leaves the middle open as a park-like courtyard: large, medium and small bamboo courtyards nest inside one another and stay open to the public, continuing Chengdu's habit of leisure under bamboo. An elevated running track loops the complex and climbs to the roof to circle it, giving runners and cyclists a continuous route and the building its most recognisable dynamic form. Programmes mix sport and leisure with culture and creative industry: the central court holds pitches and landscape, the ring holds food, retail, offices and studios, and the existing building kept on the north edge was converted into a multi-purpose art space, Xicun Art Space. That space has shown continuously since 2010, when the first Southwest Graduates Art Exhibition brought over 200 works by nearly 80 graduates of nine colleges; later shows include the 'Crossover–Subversion' artists-and-designers invitational and the 2023 Starlight Guochao cultural-creative exhibition. West Village was selected for the main exhibition of the 15th Venice Architecture Biennale in 2016, became an architecture pilgrimage after Liu Jiakun won the Pritzker Prize in 2025, and holds Sichuan's first five-star sports service complex rating. Enquiries go through the venue's public channels.

intro_zh: ALILI ART艺术馆（阿哩哩艺术馆）位于深圳市南山区南头古城中山南街71号，坐落在有约1700年城市史的南头古城街区。南头古城被视为深圳、香港的历史之根，经整体更新后成为开放式文创街区，古城内聚集插画博物馆（筹）、if工厂、超级黑胶工厂等展场与工作室，艺术馆正处在步行主街的节点上。ALILI ART于2020年8月正式对外开放，由深圳市插画协会提供专业支持筹备成立，是一家以插画为核心的美术馆型空间；2023年改造升级后以四层综合空间重新开放，早期展览集中在1至2层，现设有展厅、露台、原创周边商店，并承接插画师论坛、艺术工作坊与跨界体验活动。据馆方介绍，开馆以来已举办20余场主题展览、50余场跨界活动，累计客流超过70万人次。其内容线索集中在插画与平面设计：承办过世界插画大奖WIA2020中国巡展首站、“岁律·二十四节气插画展”、芬兰插画展“Moi! Shenzhen”、ILLUSBOOM插画艺术节，以及日本插画师近藤达弥中国首展、插画师欧阳鹏杰个展等，并为深圳市插画协会会员展、OPPO乐划锁屏插画大赏提供场地，展览与公共活动都围绕插画展开。onsiteclub案例库收录其1个案例：2023年11月4日至30日，ALILI与真不二合作把“新中式医馆”POP店搬进馆内，用诊台、药柜与书法视觉组成沉浸式零售场景。这样的空间尺度适合插画与设计类展览、IP首发与联名快闪、国潮与新中式品牌店、文创零售、品牌内容拍摄以及工作坊和沙龙。交通方面，地铁12号线南头古城站D口出站步行可达古城街区，地铁1号线桃园站B口步行约20分钟，公交可至南山公安分局站或南头②站。
intro_en: ALILI ART, also called Alili Art Gallery, stands at 71 Zhongshan South Street inside Nantou Ancient Town in Nanshan District, Shenzhen. Nantou is the historic core of the city, with roughly 1,700 years of urban history, and after a comprehensive regeneration it has become an open, walkable cultural quarter where the gallery sits on the main pedestrian street alongside the Illustration Museum (in preparation), IF Factory and the Super Vinyl Factory. ALILI opened in August 2020, set up with professional support from the Shenzhen Illustration Association, and its exhibitions and public programme are devoted to illustration. A 2023 refurbishment reopened it as a four-storey complex — earlier shows occupied the first two floors — with exhibition rooms, a terrace, an original-goods shop and space for illustrator talks, workshops and crossover events. The gallery reports more than 20 themed exhibitions and 50 crossover events since opening, with cumulative visitors above 700,000. Its programme follows illustration and graphic design: it hosted the China leg of the World Illustration Awards 2020 tour, the 24 Solar Terms illustration exhibition, the Finnish show Moi! Shenzhen, the ILLUSBOOM illustration festival, the first China solo show of Japanese illustrator Tatsuya Kondo and a solo exhibition by Ouyang Pengjie, and it provides a venue for the Shenzhen Illustration Association's member shows and the OPPO Lock Screen Illustration Awards. The onsiteclub library holds one case: from 4 to 30 November 2023, ALILI and Zhenbuer turned the gallery into a “New Chinese-style clinic” pop-up, with consultation desks, medicine cabinets and calligraphic graphics forming an immersive retail set. The scale suits illustration and design exhibitions, IP launches and collaboration pop-ups, guochao and new-Chinese brands, design retail, content shoots, workshops and salons. Metro Line 12 stops at Nantou Ancient Town station, exit D, at the edge of the quarter; Line 1's Taoyuan station, exit B, is about a 20-minute walk, and buses serve Nanshan Public Security Bureau and Nantou stops.

address: 三亚市吉阳区迎宾路233号（三亚中央商务区东岸单元）
area_text: 商业面积10万平方米
intro_zh: 三亚大悦城位于三亚市吉阳区迎宾路233号，处在三亚中央商务区东岸单元核心位置，2024年10月1日开业，商业面积10万平方米，由购物中心、写字楼与住宅组成；购物中心地上5层、局部6层，地下3层，配2000个停车位，是全国首个“热带大悦城”，也是大悦城体系内面向国际旅游消费的项目。项目定位“国际友好MALL”，把热带气候转化为空间策略：大量半室外空间与遮阳界面、层层退台的露台与绿化，让商业动线在自然通风与树荫下展开，回应三亚全年高温高湿的气候；室内以海岛色系与自然材质塑造轻松的度假氛围。业态兼顾本地家庭与游客，主力店包括优衣库、UR、博纳国际影城、旺豪超市、KKV、HUAWEI、SALOMON，餐饮有喜庭、西塔老太太、达美乐比萨等，并配置外币兑换等旅游友好服务。项目获2024 GBE商业与办公建筑大奖最佳商业综合体奖，2025年取得LEED铂金级认证。交通依托迎宾路主干道与三亚有轨电车T1线迎宾路站，距三亚站与凤凰国际机场均在快速路可达范围。
intro_en: Sanya Joy City stands at 233 Yingbin Road in Jiyang District, in the core of the Dong'an unit of Sanya's Central Business District. Opened on 1 October 2024, it provides 100,000 square metres of retail space together with offices and housing; the mall rises five storeys above ground, six in places, over three basement levels, and has 2,000 parking spaces. It is billed as China's first “tropical Joy City” and the group's project aimed squarely at international tourism consumption. Positioned as an “international-friendly mall”, it turns the tropical climate into a spatial strategy: generous semi-outdoor areas and shaded interfaces, cascading terraces and planting let circulation unfold under natural ventilation and tree canopy, a response to Sanya's year-round heat and humidity, while the interior uses island colours and natural materials to create a relaxed resort mood. The tenant mix serves both local families and visitors, with anchors including UNIQLO, UR, a Bona cinema, Wanghao supermarket, KKV, HUAWEI and SALOMON, restaurants such as Xiting, Xita Laotaitai and Domino's Pizza, and tourist-friendly services including foreign-currency exchange. The project won Best Commercial Complex at the 2024 GBE Commercial and Office Architecture Awards and achieved LEED Platinum certification in 2025. Yingbin Road and the Yingbin Road stop on Sanya's T1 tram line provide access, with Sanya railway station and Phoenix International Airport both within a short expressway drive.

address: 上海市普陀区大渡河路196号（长风公园湖畔）
area_text: 约12万平方米（商业面积）
intro_zh: 上海长风大悦城位于普陀区长风生态商务区大渡河路196号，紧邻长风公园与苏州河湾，处在苏州河沿岸城市更新带的关键节点，是大悦城在上海的第二座购物中心。项目由存量商业改造而来，商业面积约12万平方米，地上六层、地下两层，配套600个车位，2018年5月1日正式开业；与静安大悦城的“爱情地标”定位不同，它锁定周边白领女性与亲子家庭的“都市时尚女主AB面”客群。业态覆盖时尚零售、餐饮、儿童亲子、运动休闲与生活服务，主力店有上海乐高探索中心、MUJI、优衣库、盒马鲜生、西西弗书店等。建筑上采用临湖非封闭的景观式布局，室内外动线相互渗透；屋顶打造国内首个购物中心综合性潮流运动空间Sky Park高登公园，粉色星空跑道Starry Runway串联玻璃盒子和球场，并设Herstory艺术体验空间，改造项目获ICSC中国区设计改造类银奖。交通上距地铁15号线长风公园站步行可达，经大渡河路、中江路衔接内环与中环，周边公交线路密集。
intro_en: Shanghai Changfeng Joy City occupies a regenerated retail block at 196 Daduhe Road in Putuo District, beside Changfeng Park and the Suzhou Creek, a key node in the city's riverside renewal belt and Joy City's second shopping centre in Shanghai. The existing building was reworked into about 120,000 square metres of commercial space over six levels above ground and two below, with 600 parking spaces, opening on 1 May 2018. Instead of repeating the romance-landmark positioning of Jing'an Joy City, it targets professional women and families in the surrounding districts, addressing what the operator calls the two sides of the urban woman's lifestyle. The tenant mix spans fashion retail, dining, children's education, sport and lifestyle services, anchored by the Shanghai Legoland Discovery Centre together with MUJI, Uniqlo, Freshippo and Sisyphe Books. Architecturally the scheme is deliberately open and landscape-led rather than a sealed box, so indoor circulation spills out towards the lake. Its roof carries Sky Park, described as the first comprehensive rooftop sports and social space in a Chinese shopping centre, with the pink Starry Runway linking glass pavilions, tennis courts and viewing decks, plus the Herstory art space; the renovation won a silver award for design and refurbishment from ICSC China. Transport is straightforward: Line 15's Changfeng Park station is a short walk away, Daduhe Road connects to the Inner and Middle Ring roads, and numerous bus routes serve the area.

address: 上海市静安区西藏北路166号
area_text: 商业面积约16.3万平方米
intro_zh: 上海静安大悦城位于上海市静安区西藏北路166号，地处苏河湾商圈，毗邻人民广场、外滩与南京东路步行街，南座2010年12月开业、北座2015年12月开业，商业面积约16.3万平方米，由南座（B1至B3、1至11层）与北座（B1至B3、1至9层）两栋组成，配2400个停车位，是全国首批五星级购物中心之一。项目以“魔都爱情地标”为定位，最著名的空间是架在屋顶的悬臂式摩天轮SKY RING，轮高约98米，30个白色轿舱可360度俯瞰静安与浦东天际线；北座屋顶还有上海首家屋顶轻艺术主题街区“摩坊 MOREFUN 166”，以手作人街、霓虹街、未央街三条街道组织后工业风格的手作、餐饮与夜生活业态，把屋顶做成目的地。业态包括得力旗舰店、四季民福、誉八仙、海底捞、KKV、LOFT、GIGO旗舰店等，餐饮与体验占比高，夜间经营活跃。交通依托地铁8号线与12号线换乘的曲阜路站，1号口步行数分钟即达，西藏北路、天目中路、河南北路与南北高架构成立体路网，距上海站不足1公里。
intro_en: Shanghai Jing'an Joy City occupies 166 Xizang North Road in Jing'an District, in the Suhe Bay commercial area and within reach of People's Square, the Bund and the Nanjing East Road pedestrian street. The south block opened in December 2010 and the north block in December 2015; together they provide about 163,000 square metres of retail space, with the south block running from B1–B3 and levels 1–11 and the north block from B1–B3 and levels 1–9, plus 2,400 parking spaces. It is one of the first batch of five-star shopping centres in China. Positioned as Shanghai's “romantic landmark”, its best-known feature is SKY RING, a cantilevered Ferris wheel mounted on the roof about 98 metres above ground, whose 30 white capsules give a 360-degree view over Jing'an and the Pudong skyline. The roof of the north block also holds MOREFUN 166, Shanghai's first rooftop light-art themed district, laid out as three streets — Handcraft Street, Neon Street and Weiyang Street — in a post-industrial style that mixes craft workshops, dining and nightlife, turning the roof into a destination in its own right. Tenants include a Deli flagship, Siji Minfu, Yubaxian, Haidilao, KKV, LOFT and a GIGO flagship, with a high proportion of food and experience uses and lively late-hour trading. Metro Lines 8 and 12 interchange at Qufu Road station, a few minutes' walk from exit 1.

address: 北京市西城区西单北大街131号
area_text: 商业面积10.5万平方米，总建筑面积约20.5万平方米
intro_zh: 西单大悦城位于北京市西城区西单商圈核心，西单北大街131号，是中粮集团商业地产的首个项目，2007年12月28日开业，被称作“国际化青年城”。项目总建筑面积约20.5万平方米，其中购物中心商业面积10.5万平方米，与酒店、甲级写字楼共同组成城市综合体；购物中心地上11层、地下4层，南北长约150米、东西宽约110米，东侧高45米、西侧高60米，外观以充满未来感的雕塑性立面著称，被视为西单商圈整体升级的标志性建筑。业态以年轻时尚为主线，聚集APPLE、ZARA、UNIQLO、MUJI、lululemon、Salomon、LEGO华北首家标杆店、Burberry Beauty北京首家旗舰店与Chanel Beauty形象店，餐饮有SHAKE SHACK、FIVE GUYS、寿司郎等，影院与餐饮集中在高区。建筑内部最出名的是贯通中庭、可直达六层的“飞天梯”，开业时被称为“亚洲第一飞天梯”，成为项目的空间记忆点，旋转楼梯与楼层主题装置也是常被打卡的场景。交通方面，项目紧邻地铁1号线与4号线换乘的西单站，多条公交线路在此交汇，步行可达西单文化广场与金融街方向，是北京西城最繁忙的轨道客流入口之一。项目设723个停车位，招商。
intro_en: Xidan Joy City occupies the core of the Xidan commercial district at 131 Xidan North Street in Xicheng District, Beijing. Opened on 28 December 2007, it was COFCO's first commercial property project and is still marketed as an “international youth city”. The complex covers about 205,000 square metres in total, of which the shopping mall accounts for 105,000 square metres of retail space, sharing the site with a hotel and Grade A offices. The mall rises 11 storeys above ground with four basement levels; the block measures roughly 150 metres north to south and 110 metres east to west, with a 45-metre frontage on the east side and 60 metres on the west. Its sculptural, futuristic facade is credited with lifting the whole Xidan retail area. The tenant mix is aimed at young fashion shoppers: Apple, ZARA, UNIQLO, MUJI, lululemon, Salomon, LEGO's first benchmark store in North China, Burberry Beauty's first Beijing flagship and a Chanel Beauty boutique, alongside dining names such as Shake Shack, Five Guys and Sushiro, with restaurants and cinema clustered on the upper floors. Inside, the best-known feature is the express escalator that runs through the atrium straight to the sixth floor, billed at opening as Asia's first “flying escalator”; the spiral staircases and floor installations are equally popular photo spots. The mall sits on the interchange of Metro Lines 1 and 4 at Xidan station, with numerous bus routes nearby, and offers 723 parking spaces. Leasing enquiries go through the mall's public channels.

address: 北京市朝阳区朝阳北路与青年路交汇口东北角
area_text: 商业面积23万平方米
intro_zh: 朝阳大悦城位于北京市朝阳区朝阳北路与青年路交汇口东北角，地处朝青板块核心，2010年5月28日开业，商业面积23万平方米，由购物中心与酒店式公寓组成：商业部分是B3至11层的单体建筑，公寓为28层的南北联体双塔，配2000余个停车位。项目定位“城市青年文化地标”，是北京东部最具青年影响力的购物中心之一，2025年全年客流突破2600万人次，创开业以来最高纪录。业态聚集Apple、ZARA、SEPHORA、MUJI、Olé精品超市、CHANEL、Dior、LANCÔME、lululemon、COACH、Victoria's Secret、UNIQLO等零售品牌，餐饮有荣小馆、提督·TIDU、Tomacado花厨，体验业态包括teamLab无相艺术空间与冠军冰场。最具辨识度的是自2015年起陆续打造的五条主题街区：悦界主打生活方式，拾间倡导匠心慢食，伍台混搭市集与青年消费，UNI_JOY提供潮流生活方式方案，度刻关注青年自我成长，把垂直楼层做成可逛的街道，成为行业主题街区运营的样本；2025年户外城市公园AFTER PARK开园，又把商业空间延伸到室外。交通依托地铁6号线青年路站，朝阳北路、朝阳路与姚家园路共同构成立体路网。
intro_en: Chaoyang Joy City stands at the north-east corner of the junction of Chaoyang North Road and Qingnian Road in Chaoyang District, the heart of the Chao-Qing residential and office belt in eastern Beijing. It opened on 28 May 2010 with 230,000 square metres of retail space, comprising a shopping mall and serviced apartments: the retail block runs from B3 to the 11th floor, while the apartments form twin 28-storey towers, and the site provides more than 2,000 parking spaces. Positioned as an “urban youth culture landmark”, it is one of the most influential malls for young consumers in the capital, drawing more than 26 million visits in 2025, its highest figure since opening. Retail includes Apple, ZARA, SEPHORA, MUJI, an Olé premium supermarket, CHANEL, Dior, LANCÔME, lululemon, COACH, Victoria's Secret and UNIQLO; dining includes Rong Xiaoguan, Tidu and Tomacado, and experience anchors include teamLab's Borderless art space and a Champion ice rink. Its signature move is a series of five themed districts built from 2015 onwards: Yuejie for lifestyle, Shijian for slow dining, Wutai mixing markets with youth retail, UNI_JOY for streetwear culture and Dukes for self-development, turning stacked floors into walkable streets and setting a benchmark for themed-zone operation in China. The outdoor AFTER PARK opened in 2025, pushing the programme beyond the building envelope. Metro Line 6 stops at Qingnian Road station beside the mall, and Chaoyang North Road, Chaoyang Road and Yaojiayuan Road form a dense road network.

address: 北京市石景山区阜石路173号院1号楼
area_text: 商业面积11万平方米
intro_zh: 京西大悦城位于北京市石景山区阜石路173号院1号楼，2023年6月18日开业，商业面积11万平方米，由购物中心与写字楼组成：购物中心地上7层、地下4层，配1300个停车位。项目处在京西传统工业区向“站城融合”新城转型的关键节点，紧邻苹果园综合交通枢纽，是石景山近年来最重要的商业补位，定位服务京西家庭与年轻客群的城市型购物中心，也是北京市“商文旅体”融合发展示范商场。业态以生活方式与运动户外为重点，主力店包括MUJI、KKV、fudi+精选超市、寰映影城、lululemon、SALOMON、AIR JORDAN、THE NORTH FACE、HOKA、NEW BALANCE，以及13K KTV、FLOW&GROW健身、PolarPink瑜伽等体验品牌，形成“零售+运动+社交”的组合。建筑呼应西山与首钢工业遗产的在地气质，以大体量商业盒体加多层退台组织动线，把地铁换乘客流从枢纽层直接引入商业层。交通是其最大优势：地铁6号线与S1线在苹果园站换乘，站厅与商业综合体直接连通，1号线苹果园站改造完成后将形成三线换乘；苹果园综合交通枢纽开通后更集聚26条公交线路与2000余个车位，使项目成为京西的门户型商业节点。
intro_en: Jingxi Joy City is located at Building 1, Yard 173, Fushi Road, Shijingshan District, Beijing. It opened on 18 June 2023 with 110,000 square metres of retail space, combining a shopping mall with offices; the mall has seven floors above ground and four basement levels, and the site provides 1,300 parking spaces. The project sits at the point where western Beijing's old industrial belt is being rebuilt as a station-integrated urban district, immediately beside the Pingguoyuan transport hub. It is Shijingshan's most significant retail addition in years, aimed at families and younger shoppers in the west of the city, and is officially recognised as a demonstration mall for the integration of commerce, culture, tourism and sport. The tenant mix leans towards lifestyle and outdoor sport: MUJI, KKV, a fudi+ premium supermarket, a Huanying cinema, lululemon, SALOMON, AIR JORDAN, THE NORTH FACE, HOKA and NEW BALANCE, together with 13K KTV, FLOW&GROW fitness and PolarPink yoga, producing a retail-sport-social combination. The architecture responds to the nearby Western Hills and the Shougang industrial heritage, using a large retail box with stepped terraces to organise circulation and pulling interchange passengers straight from the hub level into the mall. Its greatest strength is access: Metro Lines 6 and the S1 maglev line interchange at Pingguoyuan station, whose concourse connects directly to the complex, and Line 1 will complete the three-line interchange once its station refurbishment finishes; the newly opened Pingguoyuan hub adds 26 bus routes and more than 2,000 parking spaces.

address: 南昌市西湖区抚生南路666号
area_text: 商业面积12.5万平方米（开业口径13万平方米）
intro_zh: 南昌大悦城位于南昌市西湖区朝阳新城中心生活区，抚生南路666号，紧邻观洲地铁站，2025年5月31日开业，是江西首座大悦城，商业面积12.5万平方米（开业口径13万平方米），由购物中心、公寓与写字楼组成；购物中心地上6层、地下1层，配1200个停车位。项目定位“城市沸腾青年主场”，围绕潮流社交圈、次元年轻力与品质生活家三条线组织业态，引入超220家品牌，其中区域首店超140家、占比逾60%，城市级及以上首店近40家；主力店有博纳国际影城、盒马鲜生全省首家3.0形象店，另有哈尼兔、村口二叔家等独家品牌与番茄口袋、ARIA LEISURE等特色店。建筑以“沸腾”为概念，用通透玻璃界面与多层中庭把自然光引入室内，首层与地铁接驳形成开放的城市客厅；开业期间落地“小黄人·萌力沸腾”华中首展，并推出融合江西在地文化的“辣人计划”。交通依托地铁4号线观洲站，2号口出站即达，抚生南路与朝阳洲路网连接老城与红谷滩；开业首日客流突破24万人次、销售额超过1630万元。
intro_en: Nanchang Joy City is located at 666 Fusheng South Road in the Chaoyang New Town residential district of Xihu District, Nanchang, beside Guanzhou metro station. Opened on 31 May 2025, it is the first Joy City in Jiangxi province and provides 125,000 square metres of retail space (13,000 square metres under the opening announcement figure), together with apartments and offices; the mall has six floors above ground and one basement level, with 1,200 parking spaces. Positioned as the city's “boiling youth home ground”, it is organised around three themes — trend-driven socialising, youth subculture and quality family life — and opened with more than 220 brands, over 140 of them first-in-region names (more than 60 per cent) and nearly 40 first-in-city or higher. Anchor tenants include a Bona cinema and the province's first Freshippo 3.0 store, alongside exclusive brands such as Hanitu and Cunkou Ershujia and concept stores including Tomato Pocket and ARIA LEISURE. The architecture takes “boiling” as its concept, using transparent glass interfaces and stacked atria to pull daylight deep into the plan, while the ground floor connects to the metro to form an open city living room. The opening programme featured the Central China premiere of a Minions exhibition and a “Spicy People Project” rooted in Jiangxi's local culture. Metro Line 4 stops at Guanzhou station, exit 2, directly beside the mall; Fusheng South Road links the old city with Honggutan, and the first day drew more than 240,000 visits and over RMB 16.3 million in sales.

address: 福建省厦门市集美区杏林湾路与诚毅中路交叉口（地铁1号线官任站上盖）
area_text: 10万平方米（商业面积，不含停车场；总建筑面积15.83万平方米）
intro_zh: 厦门大悦城位于集美区杏林湾路与诚毅中路交叉口，处在集美新城中央活力区（CAZ）的杏林湾CBD核心，是厦门跨岛发展中集美新城的商业地标，也是大悦城控股布局福建的首座、全国第27座大悦城。项目商业面积10万平方米（不含停车场），总建筑面积15.83万平方米，购物中心地上六层、地下三层，配套1200个车位，2024年9月30日开业，招商率约99%，首日客流超过17万人次。定位滨海文艺浪漫地标，聚焦年轻中产与文艺青年，围绕城市首发、新潮时尚、文艺浪漫、品质社交四个标签，引入200余个品牌，其中首店比例约70%，主力店有超级安踏、骆驼户外、adidas Originals、滨寿司、蔡澜点心等。建筑以海岛伊甸园为理念，把闽南文化与嘉庚建筑语汇同大悦城的时尚元素结合，形成层层退台与半室外通廊。交通上地铁1号线官任站上盖，6号线在建，杏林湾路、诚毅中路连接集美大桥与厦门大桥。
intro_en: Xiamen Joy City occupies the junction of Xinglin Bay Road and Chengyi Middle Road in Jimei District, at the heart of the Xinglin Bay CBD within Jimei New City's central activity zone. It is the commercial landmark of Jimei's cross-island expansion and the first Joy City in Fujian, the 27th in China. The mall provides 100,000 square metres of retail excluding parking, within a total build of 158,300 square metres, arranged over six levels above ground and three below with 1,200 parking spaces; it opened on 30 September 2024 at roughly 99 per cent let, drawing more than 170,000 visits on day one. Positioned as a coastal literary and romantic landmark, it targets young middle-class shoppers and culture-minded youth through four themes: city firsts, new fashion, romance and quality socialising. More than 200 brands signed, around 70 per cent of them first entries, including Super Anta, Camel Outdoor, Adidas Originals, Bin Sushi and Chua Lam's Dim Sum. The architecture takes an island-garden concept, weaving Minnan culture and Jiageng-style colonnades and roofs into Joy City's fashion vocabulary, expressed as stepped terraces and semi-outdoor passages. Line 1's Guanren station sits directly beneath the scheme, Line 6 is under construction, and Xinglin Bay and Chengyi roads link to the Jimei and Xiamen bridges.

address: 天津市南开区南门外大街2号（与南马路交口）
area_text: 16.8万平方米（商业面积，综合体总建筑面积约53万平方米）
intro_zh: 天津南开大悦城（通常称天津大悦城）位于南开区南门外大街2号，处在和平与南开两区交汇的内环核心，紧邻南门外大街、南马路两条城市主干道，比邻古文化街、食品街与鼓楼商业街，是天津老城厢商圈中商业体量最大、业态最全的城市综合体之一。项目商业面积16.8万平方米，综合体总建筑面积约53万平方米，包含一站式购物中心、写字楼与高端公寓，配置1904个车位，2011年12月25日开业。建筑分北区潮流风尚馆与南区活力体验馆，两区之间以悬空16米连廊连接，均为地下一层、地上四层、局部五层。项目是国内主题街区运营的样板，五层的骑鹅公社被视为全国首个室内创意文化主题街区，此后又陆续推出5号车库、神兽寺街、0618街、悦界等产品线，把不良面积转化为高坪效的社交场景。交通上地处地铁1、2、7号线交汇区域，与2号线鼓楼站衔接，周边汇集约49条公交线路。
intro_en: Tianjin Nankai Joy City, usually simply Tianjin Joy City, stands at 2 Nanmenwai Avenue in Nankai District, on the inner-ring seam between the Heping and Nankai districts. It faces the Nanmenwai and Nanma road arteries and sits beside the Ancient Culture Street, Food Street and Gulou commercial street, making it one of the largest and most varied mixed-use schemes in Tianjin's old-city quarter. The retail component covers 168,000 square metres within a total development of about 530,000 square metres that also includes offices and serviced apartments, with 1,904 parking spaces; it opened on 25 December 2011. The building is split into a northern fashion hall and a southern experience hall, joined by a 16-metre-high suspended bridge, each with one basement level and four storeys above, rising to five in places. The project became a national reference for themed indoor districts: its fifth-floor Goose Commune is widely credited as China's first indoor creative-culture theme street, followed by Garage No.5, Shenshou Temple Street, 0618 Street and Yuejie, turning dead space into high-yielding social settings. Three metro lines, 1, 2 and 7, converge nearby, with direct access to Gulou station on Line 2, and around 49 bus routes pass the site. Alongside the mall, a 37-storey Grade A office tower and apartments give the site a weekday population beyond shopping.

address: 天津市和平区南京路与营口道交口（南京路189号）
area_text: 约6.8万平方米（商业面积）
intro_zh: 天津和平大悦城位于和平区南京路与营口道交口，坐落在天津最繁华的滨江道与南京路商圈，周边写字楼、酒店与公寓密集，是和平区的精致版大悦城，也是大悦城控股首个轻资产项目。项目由新加坡GIC出资、大悦城输出品牌与管理，对原津汇广场百货整体改造，改造周期约一年，商业面积约6.8万平方米，地上六层、地下一层，2016年12月24日开业，开业当天客流超过10万人次。定位聚焦22至35岁、在南京路一带工作的白领女性，做工作日一到两小时消费的精致生意。建筑改造的核心是打通原百货楼层，植入通高六层的中央共享中庭，把自然光引入内部，各层共享空间逐层放大；同时布局超级工廠、南岸里、Hi内、复古街区等主题街区，并落地O2O会员体验中心良食局。交通上地下即地铁1号线与3号线换乘站营口道站，与商场直接连通。
intro_en: Tianjin Heping Joy City occupies the corner of Nanjing Road and Yingkou Road in Heping District, in the heart of the Binjiang Avenue and Nanjing Road retail district, surrounded by offices, hotels and apartments. It is the compact, refined edition of Joy City in Tianjin and the group's first light-asset project: Singapore's GIC provided the capital while Grandjoy supplied the brand and management, refurbishing the former Jinhui Plaza department store over roughly a year. The mall offers about 68,000 square metres over six levels above ground and one below, opened on 24 December 2016, and drew more than 100,000 visits on its first day. Its positioning targets women aged 22 to 35 working along Nanjing Road, a crowd the operator characterises as one-to-two-hour weekday shoppers. The renovation's central move was to open up the old department-store floors around a six-storey atrium that pulls daylight deep into the plan, with each level's shared space widening as it rises; themed districts such as Super Factory, Nan'an Li, Hi Nei and a retro street were inserted, together with Liangsiju, an online-to-offline membership experience centre. Yingkou Road station, the interchange of metro lines 1 and 3, lies directly beneath and connects into the mall. The project is now regarded as the template for the group's later light-asset output.

address: 成都市武侯区大悦路518号
area_text: 商业面积20万平方米，总建筑面积约40万平方米
intro_zh: 成都大悦城位于成都市武侯区大悦路518号，地处双楠商圈，2015年12月开业，总建筑面积约40万平方米、商业面积20万平方米，由购物中心、主题街区与甲级写字楼组成；商业部分地下1层、地上3层、局部4至6层，办公地上6层，地下2层为车库，配约2000个停车位。项目按国家AAA级旅游景区标准打造，是成都最早把“公园”作为核心场景的购物中心之一，五大户外主题广场把绿地、水景与商业界面连成一片，形成可逛可停的城市公共空间。业态覆盖Polo Ralph Lauren、DESCENTE、lululemon、SALOMON、Wilson、HOKA、CHANEL、LANCÔME、DIOR、YSL、优衣库、泡泡玛特、迪卡侬、华为旗舰店、博纳国际影城、盒马鲜生与世纪星滑冰场，餐饮有小大董、烤匠、上井精致料理、海底捞。特色空间包括西南首个“MALL中MALL”主题街区悦街JOY STREET，半室外垂直社交绿洲“公园里 PARKMORE+”，以及奇悦森林与2025年亮相的3500平方米智能生活空间“悦圈”，以嵌入式更新持续改造场景。交通方面，地铁3号线川藏立交站A口步行约1公里可达，大悦路与太平园中三路等主干道在此交汇。
intro_en: Chengdu Joy City is located at 518 Dayue Road in Wuhou District, Chengdu, in the Shuangnan commercial area. Opened in December 2015, it has a total floor area of about 400,000 square metres, of which 200,000 square metres is retail, and combines a shopping mall, themed streets and Grade A offices; the retail element has one basement level and three floors above ground, rising to four to six floors in places, with two levels of underground parking and around 2,000 spaces. The project was built to China's national AAA tourist-attraction standard and was among the first malls in the city to make “park” the organising idea, with five outdoor theme plazas stitching lawns, water features and shopfronts into a public realm where visitors can linger. Brands include Polo Ralph Lauren, DESCENTE, lululemon, SALOMON, Wilson, HOKA, CHANEL, LANCÔME, DIOR, YSL, UNIQLO, Pop Mart, Decathlon, a Huawei flagship store, a Bona cinema, Freshippo and an Century Star ice rink, with restaurants such as Xiao Dadong, Kaojiang, Shangjing and Haidilao. Signature spaces include JOY STREET, the first “mall within a mall” themed district in south-west China, the semi-outdoor vertical social oasis PARKMORE+, Qiyue Forest, and the 3,500 square metre smart-living space “Yuequan” unveiled in 2025, part of a continuous programme of embedded renewal. Metro Line 3 stops at Chuanzang Overpass, about a kilometre's walk from the entrance.

address: 成都市双流区天府新区中央商务区（夔州大道与兴康三街交界处东侧）
area_text: 商业面积14.4万平方米，总建筑面积30万平方米
intro_zh: 成都天府大悦城位于四川天府新区天府总部商务区，夔州大道与兴康三街交界处东侧，2023年12月30日开业，总建筑面积30万平方米，其中购物中心商业面积14.4万平方米（建筑口径15万平方米），由购物中心、办公与公寓组成；购物中心地上7层、地下3层、局部4层，配约1800个停车位，开业率超过93%，是天府总部商务区首个超大型商业综合体。项目定位“立体美学购物公园”，以“秘境峡谷”为设计灵感，把8000平方米开放式空中花园与800米空中绿廊叠进楼层，种植135种植物，让商业动线在绿化与露台之间穿行，回应成都“公园城市”的城市气质。业态引入近400个品牌店铺，覆盖零售、餐饮、亲子与娱乐，服务天府新区总部办公人群与新兴住区家庭，开业三天客流超过50万人次、销售额超过5000万元。交通依托地铁6号线与19号线换乘的天府商务区站，夔州大道全线通车后与高新区、天府中央法务区及西博城快速连通，是新区“职住商”一体的核心节点。
intro_en: Tianfu Joy City sits in the Tianfu headquarters business district of Sichuan's Tianfu New Area, on the eastern side of the junction between Kuizhou Avenue and Xingkang Third Street. It opened on 30 December 2023 with a total floor area of 300,000 square metres, of which the mall contributes 144,000 square metres of retail space (150,000 square metres under the construction figure), alongside offices and apartments. The mall has seven floors above ground and three basement levels, four in places, with about 1,800 parking spaces and an opening rate above 93 per cent, making it the first super-regional retail complex in the district. Positioned as a “three-dimensional aesthetic shopping park”, it takes the idea of a hidden canyon and stacks an 8,000 square metre open-air sky garden and an 800-metre elevated green walkway through the floors, planted with 135 species so that circulation runs between greenery and terraces — a direct response to Chengdu's identity as a park city. Around 400 brands cover retail, dining, children's and entertainment uses, serving both the office population of the new headquarters district and families in the emerging residential neighbourhoods; more than 500,000 visits and over RMB 50 million in sales were recorded in the first three days. Metro Lines 6 and 19 interchange at Tianfu Commercial District station, and the opening of Kuizhou Avenue links the site quickly to the high-tech zone, the central legal district and the Western China Expo Centre.

address: 江苏省无锡市滨湖区蠡湖大道与高浪路交叉口西北侧
area_text: 13万平方米（商业建筑面积）
intro_zh: 无锡江南大悦城位于滨湖区蠡湖大道与高浪路交叉口西北侧，处在太湖新城经济技术开发区核心，紧邻蠡湖与江南大学，是无锡南部的区域型商业中心，也是大悦城控股在苏南的首个轻资产项目。项目由原博大假日广场（博大摩登1930）改造升级而来，商业建筑面积13万平方米，楼层为B1至5F，配套1396个车位，2023年4月28日开业，整体围绕多元青年能量场组织业态，覆盖潮流零售、餐饮、影院、亲子与生活服务，主力店包括超盒算NB、大世界影城、奈尔宝、大渝火锅、新白鹿、华为体验店、名创优品旗舰店与KKV。空间上最大的特色是位于地下层、由A+DESIGN新珈设计的无锡首个港风主题街区港野街，以室外场景室内化的手法还原旺角至尖沙咀的街景氛围，餐饮街区、网红小巷与特色步道构成三大亮点。交通上地铁1号线江南大学站就在项目一侧，蠡湖大道与高浪路两条快速路在此交汇，辐射太湖新城与蠡湖片区。
intro_en: Wuxi Jiangnan Joy City occupies the north-west corner of the Lihu Avenue and Gaolang Road junction in Binhu District, at the core of the Taihu New City economic development zone and close to Lake Lihu and Jiangnan University. It serves as the regional retail centre of southern Wuxi and was Grandjoy's first light-asset project in the Suzhou-Wuxi region. The scheme is a conversion of the former Boda Holiday Plaza, also known as Boda Modern 1930, delivering 130,000 square metres of retail across basement level one to level five, with 1,396 parking spaces; it opened on 28 April 2023. The tenant mix is organised around a multi-generational youth energy field, combining fashion retail, dining, cinema, children's facilities and lifestyle services, with anchors including Chaosuan NB, Dashiijie Cinema, Neobio, Dayu Hotpot, New White Deer, a Huawei experience store, a Miniso flagship and KKV. Its signature space is Gangye Street, Wuxi's first Hong Kong-style themed district, designed by A+DESIGN on the lower level, which turns an indoor food hall into an outdoor-street illusion running from Mong Kok to Tsim Sha Tsui, supported by a dining street, social-media-friendly lanes and a feature walk. Line 1's Jiangnan University station sits beside the site, and the Lihu Avenue and Gaolang Road expressways meet here.

address: 昆明市西山区环城南路618号
area_text: 商业建筑面积32万平方米
intro_zh: 昆明大悦城位于昆明市西山区环城南路与南坝路交汇处，门牌为环城南路618号，建在老螺蛳湾原址之上，2018年12月1日开业，商业建筑面积32万平方米，共B1至12层，是西南地区单体体量最大的购物中心之一；开业当天客流26万人次、销售额1012万元，创下云南商业纪录，2019年10月二期开业后体量进一步完整。项目由大悦城控股以轻资产方式运营，定位城市级潮流生活中心，引入800余个品牌，其中约四成是随大悦城布局首次进入昆明的首店与旗舰店，近100家为定制特色店，涵盖零售、餐饮、娱乐、亲子与生活方式。空间上以超大室内中庭和两条特色街区、四个主题空间组织动线，并把非物质文化遗产与文旅元素引进商场，按旅游景区式场景打造，是全国室内中庭面积最大的购物中心之一。建筑以盒体加街区的复合体量覆盖整个街区，地下与地面多层车库配近3000个车位，服务昆明主城与火车站片区。交通方面，地铁1号线、2号线共用的环城南路站步行可达，环城南路、南坝路与北京路构成立体路网，距昆明火车站约1公里。需说明：2024年9月项目更名“好悦天地”，大悦城商管团队退出。
intro_en: Kunming Joy City stands at the corner of Huancheng South Road and Nanba Road in Xishan District, at 618 Huancheng South Road, on the site of the old Luosiwan wholesale market. It opened on 1 December 2018 with 320,000 square metres of retail floor area across levels B1 to 12, making it one of the largest single shopping centres in south-west China; the opening day drew 260,000 visits and RMB 10.12 million in sales, a record for Yunnan retail, and a second phase opened in October 2019. Operated by Joy City Holdings under an asset-light agreement, it is positioned as a city-level fashion and lifestyle centre with more than 800 brands, around 40 per cent of them first-in-Kunming stores or flagships introduced with the Joy City roll-out, and nearly 100 custom-designed concept stores spanning retail, dining, entertainment, children's and lifestyle. The layout is organised around an exceptionally large indoor atrium, two themed streets and four theme zones, and the mall was among the first in China to bring intangible cultural heritage and tourism elements into a shopping centre, staged like a visitor attraction. The building covers the block as a hybrid of box and streets, with multi-level parking for nearly 3,000 cars serving the city centre and the railway station district. Metro Lines 1 and 2 share Huancheng South Road station within walking distance. Note: in September 2024 the project was renamed Haoyue Tiandi as the Joy City management team exited.

address: 杭州市拱墅区隐秀路1号（莫干山路与隐秀路交汇处）
area_text: 商业面积14.5万平方米，总建筑面积约50万平方米
intro_zh: 杭州大悦城位于杭州市拱墅区莫干山路与隐秀路交汇处，门牌为隐秀路1号，处在武林、城西、运河、城北四大商圈之间，2018年8月开业，总建筑面积约50万平方米，商业面积14.5万平方米，由购物中心、悦街、艺术中心、写字楼、公寓与住宅组成；购物中心为B3至8层，配约2400个停车位。项目以热电厂工业遗产的保护利用为主题，把烟囱、厂房的大尺度转译为商业空间语言，是杭州城北工业区更新的代表作，定位中高端、面向家庭与年轻客群的城市型购物中心。业态聚集SEPHORA、优衣库、MUJI、UR、HUAWEI、小米、JNBY、THE NORTH FACE、MLB、宝可梦道馆、KKV、POP MART、西西弗书店，餐饮有三出山、阿毛饭店、费大厨、左庭右院、牛New寿喜烧，体验业态包括18米高室内风洞飞行、30米沿街面室内恒温潜水馆、36米滑道滑雪场与博纳影城，形成“运动+社交”的差异点。交通依托地铁5号线和睦站与10号线隐秀路站，项目内设运河水上巴士站点，20余条公交线路与上塘高架、德胜高架快速连接全城。
intro_en: Hangzhou Joy City stands at the junction of Moganshan Road and Yinxiu Road in Gongshu District — its address is 1 Yinxiu Road — between the Wulin, Chengxi, Grand Canal and Chengbei commercial areas. Opened in August 2018, it has a total floor area of about 500,000 square metres, of which 145,000 square metres is retail, comprising a shopping mall, the Yuejie street, an art centre, offices, apartments and housing; the mall runs from B3 to the eighth floor and provides about 2,400 parking spaces. The project takes the protection and reuse of a former thermal power plant as its theme, translating the scale of chimneys and turbine halls into retail space, and is a benchmark for the regeneration of Hangzhou's northern industrial belt. It is positioned in the upper-mid market for families and younger shoppers. Brands include SEPHORA, UNIQLO, MUJI, UR, HUAWEI, Xiaomi, JNBY, THE NORTH FACE, MLB, a Pokémon gym, KKV, POP MART and Sisyphe Books; restaurants include Sanchushan, Amao Restaurant, Fei Dahu, Zuoting Youyuan and Gyu New Sukiyaki; and experience tenants include an 18-metre indoor wind tunnel, a 30-metre indoor constant-temperature diving pool facing the street, a 36-metre ski slope and a Bona cinema, giving the scheme a sport-plus-social edge. Metro Line 5 at Hemu station and Line 10 at Yinxiu Road station serve the site, there is a canal water-bus stop inside the development, and more than 20 bus routes plus the Shangtang and Desheng elevated roads connect it to the rest of the city.

address: 武汉市洪山区高新大道718号（光谷中心城核心）
area_text: 14万平方米（购物中心商业面积）
intro_zh: 武汉大悦城位于洪山区高新大道718号，处在东湖高新区光谷中心城核心，紧邻东湖高新区政务服务中心，坐落在高新大道科技廊道与豹子溪生态廊道交会处，是光谷首个大型城市商业综合体，服务周边万亿级光电子产业集群与数十所高校带来的年轻人口。购物中心商业面积14万平方米，地上五层、地下三层，配套3700个车位，2022年1月15日开业；整个综合体总建筑面积近70万平方米，还包含甲级写字楼、住宅、公寓与室外商业街。业态覆盖零售、餐饮、影院、亲子与运动娱乐，引入多家区域首店。空间上以约6000平方米的室外中庭喜悦公园为核心，集演艺、休憩与社交于一体；B1层打造融入武汉本地元素的谷里食巷美食街区。建筑由Benoy设计，商业体量沿街展开并以多层退台回应城市界面。交通上地铁11号线光谷四路站与项目直接接驳，可换乘19号线及光谷空轨光子号，高新大道快速路直达。
intro_en: Wuhan Joy City stands at 718 Gaoxin Avenue in Hongshan District, at the heart of Guanggu Central City in the East Lake High-tech Zone, facing the district government service centre where the Gaoxin Avenue technology corridor meets the Baozi Creek green corridor. It was the first large urban complex in Guanggu, serving a trillion-yuan optoelectronics cluster and the large young population of the surrounding universities. The mall provides 140,000 square metres over five levels above ground and three below, with 3,700 parking spaces, and opened on 15 January 2022; the wider complex approaches 700,000 square metres and adds Grade A offices, housing, apartments and an outdoor retail street. Retail, dining, cinema, family and sport sit alongside several regional first stores. The social heart is Joy Park, a roughly 6,000-square-metre outdoor courtyard used for performances, relaxation and gatherings, while basement level one holds Guli Shixiang, a food street threaded with Wuhan motifs. Benoy designed the scheme, which opens along the street and steps down in terraces towards the city. Line 11's Guanggu Fourth Road station connects directly, with transfers to Line 19 and the Guanggu sky train, and the Gaoxin Avenue expressway runs past the site. The mall logged about 23.5 million visits in 2024, and it anchors the Guanggu East commercial cluster that the district promotes as Wuhan's new city centre.

address: 辽宁省沈阳市大东区小东路（中街商圈东端，地铁1号线东中街站）
area_text: 35万平方米（商业面积）
intro_zh: 沈阳大悦城位于大东区小东路，处在有东北第一步行街之称的中街商圈东端，毗邻沈阳故宫与张氏帅府，是老城中街向东延伸、带动东中街板块成型的核心项目，也是大悦城品牌在全国的第二座购物中心。项目商业面积35万平方米，由A、B、C、D、E五馆组成，一条全长600米的商业步行街贯穿其间，配套约1800个车位，2009年5月开业，年均客流量超过3000万人次，连续多年位居沈阳商业市场客流第一。业态覆盖潮流零售、餐饮、影院、KTV、书店与运动户外，主力店包括优衣库、ZARA、MUJI、丝芙兰、华为、小米、POP MART、华谊影院等。建筑上以五馆加步行街的街区式布局区别于封闭盒子，E馆由伍兹贝格设计，2022年底投用，以跨度约40米、宽25米的三层连桥接入B馆，完成五馆闭环；项目2025年入选辽宁省省级旅游休闲街区。交通上地铁1号线东中街站与项目连通，中街站亦在步行范围内。
intro_en: Shenyang Joy City occupies Xiaodong Road in Dadong District, at the eastern end of Zhongjie, the self-styled first pedestrian street of Northeast China, next to the Shenyang Imperial Palace and the Marshal Zhang Mansion. It was the second Joy City in the country and the project that extended the old city's retail axis eastwards and shaped the Dongzhongjie district. The mall offers 350,000 square metres of commercial space in five blocks, A to E, threaded by a 600-metre pedestrian street, with about 1,800 parking spaces. It opened in May 2009 and now draws more than 30 million visits a year, ranking first in footfall among Shenyang's retail properties for years. Retail, dining, cinema, KTV, bookstores and sportswear sit alongside anchors such as Uniqlo, Zara, MUJI, Sephora, Huawei, Xiaomi, Pop Mart and Huayi Cinema. Its architecture departs from the sealed mall model: five linked buildings open onto a public street, and the E block by Woods Bagot, completed at the end of 2022, closes the loop with a three-storey bridge 40 metres in span and 25 metres wide. In 2025 the complex was named a provincial-level tourism and leisure district. Line 1's Dongzhongjie station connects directly, with Zhongjie station also within walking distance. The E block also adds a 17-storey apartment tower above its retail podium.

address: 深圳市宝安区新安街道创业二路与前进一路交汇处
area_text: 约25万平方米（购物中心建筑面积，项目总建筑面积超73万平方米）
intro_zh: 深圳宝安大悦城位于宝安区新安街道创业二路与前进一路交汇处，地处宝安中心区与灵芝片区交界，是宝安25区城市更新项目中体量最大的商业部分，也是深圳首座大悦城。项目从2010年签署框架协议到2025年7月12日开业历时十五年，购物中心建筑面积约25万平方米，整体总建筑面积超过73万平方米，涵盖商业、办公与住宅，地上六层、地下四层，配近2500个车位。招商率约99%，引入近400家品牌，首店及定制店占比超过50%，主力店包括PARTYDAY MEGA、寰映影城、Hamleys、盒马鲜生、覔书店、优衣库、MUJI等。空间上以连里式的空中连廊组织各功能区块，设置潮流T台十字街、约4000平方米的屋顶生态公园星厨花园，以及B1层超过3万平方米的25青年时区；空山基七米高机械姬与汤杰直径约七米的动态雕塑流金-波构成艺术动线。开业首日客流42万人次。交通上地铁5号线、12号线灵芝站E、F口直达。
intro_en: Shenzhen Bao'an Joy City stands where Chuangye Second Road meets Qianjin First Road in Xin'an Subdistrict, Bao'an District, on the seam between the Bao'an civic centre and Lingzhi. It is the largest commercial component of the district's No.25 urban renewal zone and the first Joy City in Shenzhen. From a framework agreement signed in 2010 to its opening on 12 July 2025, the scheme took fifteen years to deliver. The mall itself measures about 250,000 square metres, within a total development of more than 730,000 square metres that also contains offices and housing, arranged over six levels above ground and four below with close to 2,500 parking bays. It opened around 99 per cent let with nearly 400 brands, over half of them first entries or customised stores, including PARTYDAY MEGA, Huanying Cinema, Hamleys, Freshippo, MIS Bookstore, Uniqlo and MUJI. Sky bridges tie the blocks together in what the designers call a linked-neighbourhood form. Three non-standard spaces define the experience: a catwalk-like crossroads, a 4,000-square-metre roof garden called Xingchu Garden, and a 30,000-square-metre youth zone on basement level one. Art includes a seven-metre Sorayama robot figure and Tang Jie's seven-metre suspended kinetic sculpture. Opening day drew 420,000 visitors; Lines 5 and 12 at Lingzhi station surface directly at the entrances.

address: 山东省烟台市芝罘区北马路150号
area_text: 15万平方米（商业面积，总建筑面积约22万平方米）
intro_zh: 烟台大悦城位于芝罘区北马路150号，处在烟台传统商业中心南大街与海港路商圈，南邻海港路中心商贸区，北面直望烟台山与海湾，是烟台商业中心唯一临海地块，被本地称为皇冠上的明珠。项目商业面积15万平方米，总建筑面积约22万平方米，地下三层、地上六层、局部七层，配套1300个车位，2014年7月6日开业，是大悦城控股在准二线城市布局的首个项目，也是国内首个海湾主题购物中心。定位趣活欢聚场，面向年轻客群与品质家庭，开业时首进烟台品牌占比约60%，主力店包括幸福蓝海影院、盒马鲜生、NIKE 1200、MUJI、优衣库、UR、海底捞、KKV与玩具反斗城。建筑以简约线条塑造虚实相间的滨海立面，把一线海景引入商业动线，设1F至4F、4F至6F两组飞天梯，并打造三大主题街区与烟台山最佳观景平台，项目获ICSC购物中心大奖金奖、银奖。交通上北马路、海港路在此交汇，烟台火车站与客运码头近在咫尺。
intro_en: Yantai Joy City stands at 150 Beima Road in Zhifu District, within the city's traditional Nandajie and Haigang Road retail centre. It faces the harbour and Yantai Hill, occupying the only seafront plot in the downtown retail core, a site local observers nicknamed the jewel in the crown. The mall covers 150,000 square metres of commercial space within a total build of about 220,000 square metres, with three basement levels, six storeys above ground rising to seven in places and 1,300 parking spaces. It opened on 6 July 2014 as Grandjoy's first project in a quasi-second-tier city and the country's first bay-themed shopping centre. Positioned as a playful gathering place for young shoppers and quality-minded families, it opened with about 60 per cent of brands new to Yantai, including Happy Blue Sea Cinema, Freshippo, Nike 1200, MUJI, Uniqlo, UR, Haidilao, KKV and Toys R Us. The architecture uses restrained lines to build a layered waterfront facade that pulls sea views into the circulation, with two express escalator runs linking levels one to four and four to six, three themed districts and a viewing deck towards Yantai Hill; the project has won ICSC gold and silver awards. Beima and Haigang roads meet here, with the railway station and ferry terminal close by.

address: 浙江省绍兴市越城区东街57号（近地铁1号线城市广场站）
area_text: 约13万平方米（建筑面积），商业面积约8万平方米
intro_zh: 绍兴国金大悦城位于越城区东街57号，坐落在绍兴古城核心的解放路商圈，即本地所称的解放路黄金800米，紧邻解放路、中兴路、东街等城市主干道和传统商业街区，是古城商业更新中体量最大、品牌最集中的购物中心之一。项目由大悦城控股与绍兴国周集团合作，以轻资产输出品牌与管理，是浙江首座、全国第六个轻资产大悦城，建筑面积约13万平方米，商业面积约7.8万至8万平方米，地上四层、地下一层，另设地下二层停车场，共约1200个车位，2022年11月25日开业。定位古越潮流新C位，开业率超过90%，首进品牌占比超过45%，引入盒马鲜生、寰映影城、奈尔宝、KKV、UR等，并结合江南古镇文化打造绍兴首个情景式、主题式、互动式美食街区茴香小镇。建筑以现代商业体量嵌入古城肌理，中庭与街区穿插组织人流。交通上距地铁1号线城市广场站约100米，周边公交与古城步行系统衔接紧密。
intro_en: Shaoxing Guojin Joy City sits at 57 East Street in Yuecheng District, inside the historic core's Jiefang Road retail spine, a stretch locally known as the golden 800 metres. It is bordered by Jiefang Road, Zhongxing Road and East Street, the main arteries and traditional shopping streets of the old city, and is one of the largest and most brand-dense malls in Shaoxing's urban renewal. Grandjoy Holdings provides the brand and management under a light-asset arrangement with the local Guozhou Group, making it the first such Joy City in Zhejiang and the sixth in China. The building measures about 130,000 square metres gross and roughly 78,000 to 80,000 square metres of retail over four levels above ground and one below, with two basement parking levels providing about 1,200 bays; it opened on 25 November 2022. Positioned as a new fashionable anchor for the ancient Yue city, it opened more than 90 per cent let, with over 45 per cent of brands new to the market, including Freshippo, Huanying Cinema, Neobio, KKV and UR. A food street called Huixiang Xiaozhen draws on the region's water-town culture and is billed as Shaoxing's first immersive, themed dining quarter. The modern volume is threaded into the historic grain through courts and lanes, and Line 1's City Square station is roughly 100 metres away.

address: 江苏省苏州市相城区御窑路1999号
area_text: 18万平方米（商业面积，总建筑面积33万平方米）
intro_zh: 苏州大悦城（大悦春风里产品线）位于相城区御窑路1999号，处在苏州着力打造的市域新中心相城中央公园板块，紧邻约21.7平方公里的城市中央公园，是相城从产业新城转向宜居城区过程中补位的高端商业综合体，也是大悦城控股在苏南区域的首个商业项目。项目总建筑面积33万平方米，其中商业面积18万平方米，可租赁面积约10万平方米，设3000个停车位，2021年9月25日开业。业态按零售约35%、餐饮约40%、娱乐服务约25%配比，开业时苏州及区域首进品牌占比约40%，首进北苏州品牌达123个，旗舰及定制店142家。建筑由Benoy、AECOM、GARDE联合设计，采用公园加街区加盒子的半开放式形态，地上局部六层、地下两层，退台与室内空间交融；外立面打造国内最大风动幕墙，面积6116平方米、装载6.8万片风铃片，是项目最醒目的城市界面。交通上地铁4号线终点站龙道浜站与项目直接连通，北侧靠近中环快速路，辐射相城及苏州北部客群。
intro_en: Suzhou Joy City, developed under the Grand Joy Breeze product line, stands at 1999 Yuyao Road in Xiangcheng District, the new civic centre of Suzhou, beside a 21.7-square-kilometre central park. It was the first commercial project of Grandjoy Holdings in the Suzhou-Wuxi region and arrived as Xiangcheng shifted from an industrial district towards a liveable urban quarter. The whole development covers 330,000 square metres, of which 180,000 square metres is retail and about 100,000 square metres is leasable, with 3,000 parking spaces; it opened on 25 September 2021. The mix is weighted towards dining at roughly 40 per cent, with retail at 35 per cent and leisure and services making up the remainder. At opening about 40 per cent of brands were new to Suzhou or the region, including 123 first entries for northern Suzhou and 142 flagship or customised stores. Benoy, AECOM and GARDE designed a semi-open composition of park, street and box, with six partial upper levels over two basement levels and terraces folding into the interior. Its best-known architectural feature is a kinetic wind facade of 6,116 square metres carrying 68,000 wind-bell panels, the largest of its kind in China. Line 4 terminates at Longdaobang station, which connects directly to the mall, and the Middle Ring expressway lies just to the north.

address: 陕西省西安市雁塔区慈恩路与慈恩西路交汇处（大雁塔南广场西侧）
area_text: 约14.6万平方米（商业面积）
intro_zh: 西安曲江大悦城位于雁塔区慈恩路与慈恩西路交汇处，紧邻大雁塔南广场，坐落在曲江新区大雁塔与大唐不夜城文旅商圈的核心，是曲江把观光客流转化为消费客流的关键商业载体，也是中粮集团进入西北市场的首个商业项目。项目商业面积约14.6万平方米，地上四层、地下两层，配套1300个车位，2018年12月16日开业，定位十三潮主场，面向年轻潮流客群与到访大雁塔的文旅客群。业态以时尚零售、餐饮、影院、儿童亲子为主，主力店包括Victoria's Secret、博纳国际影城、ZARA、lululemon、Sandro、CHANEL美妆、Estée Lauder、西西弗书店、优衣库与无印良品。建筑上以大面积玻璃幕墙构成简洁的城市界面，入夜后幕墙转为LED光幕，与亮灯后的大雁塔相互映衬，成为曲江夜景的一部分；项目获美国绿色建筑委员会LEED V4.1既有建筑铂金级认证。交通上地铁3号线、4号线大雁塔站步行可达，慈恩路、雁塔南路连接南二环与曲江大道。
intro_en: Xi'an Qujiang Joy City stands where Ci'en Road meets Ci'en West Road, immediately beside the Great Wild Goose Pagoda's south plaza in the Qujiang New District, the heart of the pagoda and Grand Tang Mall tourism and retail district. It is the commercial anchor that converts sightseeing traffic into spending, and the first Grandjoy project in northwest China. The mall offers about 146,000 square metres over four levels above ground and two below, with 1,300 parking spaces, opening on 16 December 2018 under the slogan of a home ground for the city's trends. It targets younger fashion shoppers as well as visitors to the pagoda, mixing fashion retail, dining, cinema and children's offers, anchored by Victoria's Secret, Bona International Cinema, Zara, Lululemon, Sandro, Chanel beauty, Estée Lauder, Sisyphe Books, Uniqlo and MUJI. The architecture presents a calm glass curtain wall to the city that turns into a programmable LED light screen after dark, playing against the illuminated pagoda and becoming part of Qujiang's nightscape; the building holds LEED v4.1 O+M platinum certification from the US Green Building Council. Lines 3 and 4 at Dayanta station are a short walk away, with Ci'en and Yanta South roads linking to the South Second Ring and Qujiang Avenue.

intro_zh: 重庆大悦城位于重庆市渝北区（两江新区）中央公园片区，秋成大道99号，同茂大道南侧，2021年12月31日开业，总建筑面积约50万平方米，商业面积约20万平方米，由购物中心、时尚公寓与甲级写字楼组成；购物中心经营楼层地上7层、地下1层，配3000余个停车位。项目处在两江国际商务中心核心，紧邻中央公园、国博中心与江北国际机场，定位“全国首个生态峡谷潮玩购物公园”，是重庆年轻潮流消费的地标之一，开业即引入230余个品牌，其中首入重庆及首进区域品牌130家，旗舰店与特色定制店近50家。建筑由姚仁喜团队设计，从重庆山地地貌取材：南侧利用天然峡谷做出百米高差的层叠退台“渝悦峡谷”，嵌入户外剧场、滑板公园与萌宠乐园；北侧以摩登重庆为意象塑造艺术化立面；横跨南北的巨型空间“红馆 Red Tube”是项目最具辨识度的建筑符号，室内南中庭以“天外飞石”装置形成视觉焦点。交通依托轨道交通10号线中央公园西站，5号线在此换乘，多条公交线路与秋成大道、同茂大道快速连接机场与主城。
intro_en: Chongqing Joy City is located at 99 Qiucheng Avenue in the Central Park area of Yubei District, part of Liangjiang New Area, on the southern side of Tongmao Avenue. It opened on 31 December 2021 with a total floor area of about 500,000 square metres, of which roughly 200,000 square metres is retail, alongside serviced apartments and Grade A offices; the trading floors run seven levels above ground with one basement level, and there are more than 3,000 parking spaces. The project occupies the core of the Liangjiang international business centre, close to Central Park, the International Expo Centre and Jiangbei International Airport. Billed as China's first “ecological canyon trend-shopping park”, it is one of Chongqing's landmarks for young fashion retail and opened with more than 230 brands, including 130 first-in-Chongqing or first-in-region names and nearly 50 flagships or custom stores. The architecture, by Kris Yao's studio, draws on the city's mountainous terrain: on the south side a natural ravine is used to create the Yuyue Canyon, a series of terraces with a hundred-metre level difference that accommodates an outdoor theatre, a skate park and a pet playground; on the north side an artistic facade evokes modern Chongqing; and the giant Red Tube hall spanning both halves is the project's most recognisable symbol, while the south atrium centres on a “falling rock from outer space” installation. Metro Line 10 stops at Central Park West station, interchanging with Line 5, and Qiucheng and Tongmao avenues link the site quickly to the airport and the inner city.

intro_zh: 长沙大悦城即长沙北辰三角洲大悦城，位于开福区北辰三角洲，湘江北路1500号，处湘江与浏阳河交汇处，紧邻长沙“三馆一厅”文化地标，2021年9月30日开业，商业建筑面积约14万平方米。项目由北辰集团开发、大悦城控股运营，是长沙首座滨江商业综合体，也是北辰三角洲520万平方米滨江综合体的商业核心，定位“江畔青年时尚生活绿洲”，承担长沙大城北商圈的消费升级。业态以高街潮牌、美妆旗舰、网红餐饮与夜经济为主，累计引入200余个品牌，含多家城市首店；滨江界面与屋顶组织餐饮外摆和观景空间，夜间经营是其主要特征，带动北辰商圈入选省级夜间消费集聚区。建筑由原空置商业体整体改造而来，设计以“重塑岩谷、迸发星光”为概念，通过立面材料的戏剧性对比与商业动线重构，把原本封闭的盒体打开为面向湘江的城市界面。交通方面，地铁1号线北辰三角洲站直达，湘江北路、黄兴北路与浏阳河隧道构成立体路网。需说明：2025年9月20日起项目由业主北辰集团独立运营并更名“长沙北辰荟”，大悦城商管团队撤出。
intro_en: Changsha Joy City, formally Changsha Beichen Delta Joy City, stands at 1500 Xiangjiang North Road in the Beichen Delta area of Kaifu District, where the Xiang River meets the Liuyang River and next to the city's “three halls and one theatre” cultural complex. It opened on 30 September 2021 with about 140,000 square metres of retail floor space. Developed by Beichen Group and operated by Joy City Holdings, it was Changsha's first riverside shopping complex and forms the commercial core of the 5.2 million square metre Beichen Delta waterfront development. Positioned as a “riverside oasis of youthful fashion”, it anchors the retail upgrading of the city's northern districts. The mix leans on streetwear, beauty flagships, social-media-driven restaurants and night-time economy, with more than 200 brands accumulated since opening, including several city-first stores; the riverside frontage and roof terraces host outdoor dining and viewing decks, and late-hour trading helped the Beichen area win provincial recognition as a night-time consumption cluster. The building is a full renovation of a vacant retail block: the design concept, “reshaping the rock valley, bursting with starlight”, uses dramatic contrasts of facade material and a rebuilt circulation route to open a formerly closed box towards the river. Metro Line 1 stops at Beichen Delta station. Note: from 20 September 2025 the owner Beichen Group took over direct operation and renamed the project Changsha Beichen Hui, with the Joy City management team withdrawing.

intro_zh: 西岸梦中心（Gate M）位于上海市徐汇区龙腾大道2266号，处在徐汇滨江“西岸文化走廊”的南段，前身是有百年历史的上海水泥厂，曾被称为亚洲规模最大的水泥厂，2024年8月31日作为城市更新项目开场。项目总体量约16.2万平方米，其中商业面积约10万平方米，沿黄浦江展开800多米岸线，由12栋独栋建筑组成，划分演艺文化区、可持续时尚区、梦工场、微度假休闲区和现象级城市户外区五大分区，并与西岸大剧院、西岸穹顶艺术中心、油罐艺术中心等共同构成上海滨水文化消费带。空间形态是开放式的滨水街区：厂房改造的独栋店铺、筒仓、梦船坞码头、剧院广场与滑板公园串成可自由穿行的户外动线，品牌既能租整栋做主题空间，也能在广场与码头做大型装置、市集和演出。我方案例库收录该空间快闪案例65条，代表案例包括《崩坏：星穹铁道》角色星期日线下快闪、PUMA“速命不凡”沉浸式赛车游艺街区（上海）、“天猫祝你被爱包裹”装置。适合游戏与二次元IP的大型沉浸式快闪和主题街区、运动与户外品牌体验、公共艺术装置、市集与音乐演出，以及需要滨江景观的汽车试驾与发布。交通方面，地铁11号线龙耀路站步行约10分钟，项目5栋、7栋二楼有天桥直连车站。
intro_en: Gate M West Bund Dream Center stands at 2266 Longteng Avenue in Xuhui District, in the southern stretch of Shanghai's West Bund cultural corridor. Its site is the century-old Shanghai Cement Factory, once described as Asia's largest, and the complex opened as an urban-renewal project on 31 August 2024. It covers about 162,000 square metres in total, roughly 100,000 of them commercial, with more than 800 metres of Huangpu River frontage and twelve separate buildings organised into five zones: performing arts, sustainable fashion, the Dream Works, micro-holiday leisure and a large-scale outdoor zone. Together with the West Bund Grand Theatre, the West Bund Dome and Tank Shanghai, it forms part of the city's riverside cultural and consumer belt. The spatial form is an open waterfront block: converted factory buildings, silos, the Dream Dock, a theatre plaza and a skate park create a walkable outdoor route, so a brand can lease an entire building for a themed space or use the plazas and dock for large installations, markets and performances. Our case library holds 65 pop-up cases here, including the Honkai: Star Rail character Sunday offline pop-up, PUMA's "Speed is Extraordinary" immersive racing playground and the Tmall "wrapped in love" installation. It suits large immersive game and anime IP pop-ups and themed districts, sport and outdoor brand experiences, public art, markets and live music, and car test-drive or launch events that benefit from a riverfront setting. Metro Line 11 to Longyao Road station is about a ten-minute walk, with footbridges linking the station to the second floors of Buildings 5 and 7.

intro_zh: 张园位于上海市静安区威海路590弄，地处南京西路商圈南侧、石门一路与茂名北路之间，是上海现存规模最大、保存最完整、种类最多的石库门建筑群，始建于1882年，旧有“海上第一名园”之称。2018年静安区启动保护性征收，2022年11月西区以保护性更新方式重新开放，迅速成为南京西路商圈“首店、首秀、首发”的首选地，日均客流约3万人次、峰值达8万人次；目前开放的西区只占全园约三分之一，东区预计2026年底整体开放，地下三层将与地铁2、12、13号线无缝连通。空间形态是开放式的石库门里弄街区：清水砖墙、弄堂、天井与沿街立面构成“建筑即展场”的条件，品牌可整栋租下做限时精品店，用庭院做装置与点灯仪式，把弄堂变成排队动线与街拍场景。我方案例库收录该空间快闪案例73条，代表案例包括迪奥上海张园限时精品店启幕暨圣诞点灯仪式、酩悦香槟璀璨星愿限定店、DIOR2023春季男装ERL限定系列限时精品店。适合奢侈品牌限时精品店与新品首发、香氛美妆与腕表珠宝展陈、节日点灯与艺术装置，以及需要历史建筑叙事感的IP沉浸式快闪。交通方面，地铁2、12、13号线南京西路站步行可达，12号线14号口与2号线4号口最近，东区建成后地下可直接换乘三条线路。
intro_en: Zhangyuan occupies Lane 590 Weihai Road in Jing'an District, on the southern edge of the West Nanjing Road retail district between Shimen No.1 Road and Maoming North Road. Begun in 1882 and once known as Shanghai's "first garden", it is the largest, most complete and most varied surviving shikumen lane-house quarter in the city. After a preservation-led resettlement began in 2018, its western section reopened in November 2022 and quickly became the district's preferred address for first stores, first shows and product debuts, drawing around 30,000 visitors a day and up to 80,000 at peak. Only about a third of the site is open so far; the eastern section is expected to complete around the end of 2026, when three basement levels will connect directly to Metro Lines 2, 12 and 13. The form is an open lane-house block: brick facades, alleys, courtyards and street fronts allow a brand to take a whole building as a temporary boutique, use a courtyard for installations and Christmas light-ups, and turn the lanes into queueing and photo routes. Our case library holds 73 pop-up cases here, including Dior's Zhangyuan temporary boutique and Christmas light-up, Moët & Chandon's festive limited store and Dior's Spring 2023 ERL menswear pop-up. It suits luxury temporary boutiques and launches, fragrance, beauty, watch and jewellery presentations, festive lighting and art installations, and IP pop-ups that need a heritage setting. Metro Lines 2, 12 and 13 at West Nanjing Road station serve the site, with Exit 14 on Line 12 and Exit 4 on Line 2 closest.

intro_zh: TX淮海｜年轻力中心位于上海市黄浦区淮海中路523号，坐落在淮海中路商圈中段、成都南路口，前身是1990年代上海时髦人士聚集的华亭伊势丹，2019年12月31日以“策展型零售”（CURETAIL）的定位重新开业，由百联集团、锦江集团与盈展文化共同打造。它把淮海中路中段重新拉回年轻人的动线，与东端的新天地、西端的环贸iapm形成淮海路“三段式”商业格局，是上海潮流文化与首发活动密度最高的商场之一。空间形态以商场室内空间为主：垂直楼层、楼层中庭、沿街橱窗与可整层改造的展陈空间，品牌常把低层做成限时店、把中庭做成装置与舞台、把高层做成沉浸式展览，形成“看展+购物+演出”的复合动线。我方案例库收录该空间快闪案例60条，代表案例包括Tinylure小引力“我的袜控朋友”POP UP上海、BYFAR爱的进行时限时体验店、【店装空间】沸寂数字时尚皮囊商店。适合潮流服饰与球鞋、设计师品牌首发、二次元与游戏IP、美妆与香氛、艺术展与论坛，以及需要强内容运营的策展型快闪。交通方面，地铁13号线淮海中路站步行约5分钟，1号线黄陂南路站步行约8分钟，1、10、12号线陕西南路站步行约12分钟。
intro_en: TX Huaihai Youth Energy Center occupies 523 Middle Huaihai Road in Huangpu District, at the Chengdu South Road corner in the middle section of the Huaihai Road retail district. It took over the site of the Huating Isetan department store, a 1990s Shanghai fashion landmark, and reopened on 31 December 2019 around the idea of "curated retail" (CURETAIL), developed by Bailian Group, Jinjiang Group and Yingzhan Culture. The project pulled the middle stretch of Huaihai Road back into the itineraries of younger shoppers and now forms a three-part retail axis with Xintiandi to the east and iapm to the west; it is one of the city's densest venues for streetwear culture and launch events. The spatial form is essentially indoor mall space: stacked floors, floor-level atriums, street-facing windows and exhibition areas that can be rebuilt floor by floor, so brands commonly put temporary stores on the lower levels, installations and stages in the atrium, and immersive exhibitions on the upper floors, creating a combined "exhibition, shopping, performance" route. Our case library holds 60 pop-up cases here, including Tinylure's "my sock-loving friends" pop-up, BYFAR's limited-time experience store and the Feiji digital fashion skin store. It suits streetwear and sneakers, designer debuts, anime and game IP, beauty and fragrance, art exhibitions and talks, and curated pop-ups that depend on strong content programming. Metro Line 13 at Huaihai Road station is about a five-minute walk, Line 1 at Huangpi South Road about eight minutes, and Lines 1, 10 and 12 at South Shaanxi Road about twelve minutes.

address: 上海市浦东新区东育路500号
intro_zh: 前滩太古里位于上海市浦东新区东育路500号，地处浦东前滩国际商务区核心，是太古地产在上海的首个“太古里”项目，由陆家嘴集团与太古地产联合开发，2021年9月30日正式开业。前滩被称为“新陆家嘴”，是后世博时期上海重点发展的总部商务区，项目以约12万平方米的街区式商业补上了这片区域的高端零售与生活方式配套，与东方体育中心、滨江生态空间共同构成浦东新的城市生活中心。空间形态是开放式里巷街区：南北两区分别以石材“石区”和木材“木区”为立面语言，中间是8000平方米中央公园，80米长的悦目桥横跨上方，屋顶更首次以“双层开放空间”做出街区形态，450米Sky Loop天空环道串联屋顶绿化与店铺，形成“地面里巷+屋顶街区”的立体动线。我方案例库收录该空间快闪案例55条，代表案例包括DIOR迪奥二零二二秋季男装系列限时精品店、【店装空间】Delvaux全新精品店及玛格利特主题限时精品店、Jimmy Choo点亮七夕“心”意。适合奢侈与轻奢品牌限时精品店、运动户外与生活方式体验、IP主题街区与快闪市集、屋顶跑团与社群活动，以及需要开放街区氛围的发布与拍摄。交通方面，地铁6、8、11号线东方体育中心站步行约5分钟。
intro_en: Taikoo Li Qiantan sits at 500 Dongyu Road in Pudong, at the heart of the Qiantan international business district and the first "Taikoo Li" project in Shanghai. Jointly developed by Swire Properties and Lujiazui Group, it opened on 30 September 2021. Qiantan is often called the "new Lujiazui", a headquarters-led district built after the 2010 World Expo, and the roughly 120,000-square-metre open-air scheme supplies the high-end retail and lifestyle offer that the area previously lacked, sitting alongside the Oriental Sports Center and the riverside parkland. The spatial form is an open lane-and-alley district: the south "Stone" zone and north "Wood" zone are clad in natural stone and timber respectively, separated by an 8,000-square-metre central park and crossed by the 80-metre Yue Mu bridge, while the roof becomes a second layer of open blocks linked by the 450-metre Sky Loop running track, producing a three-dimensional route of ground-level lanes and rooftop streets. Our case library holds 55 pop-up cases here, including Dior's Autumn 2022 menswear temporary boutique, Delvaux's new boutique with a Magritte-themed pop-up and Jimmy Choo's Qixi activation. It suits luxury and premium temporary boutiques, sport, outdoor and lifestyle experiences, IP-themed districts and pop-up markets, rooftop running clubs and community events, and launches or shoots that need an open-block backdrop. Metro Lines 6, 8 and 11 at Oriental Sports Center station are about a five-minute walk away.

address: 上海市徐汇区虹桥路1号
intro_zh: 港汇恒隆广场位于上海市徐汇区虹桥路1号、华山路口，坐落在徐家汇商圈核心，1999年12月28日开业，是恒隆地产在内地的首个商业地产项目，2011年由“港汇广场”更名为现名。项目总建筑面积约40万平方米，由购物中心、两座262米的双塔写字楼和服务式公寓组成，购物中心共7个楼面，拥有玻璃穹顶与约1200个停车位；2017年至2020年完成资产优化，北座于2018年9月重开、南座于2020年完成改造，两座之间加建连廊，临街界面打开为露天广场。它见证了徐家汇从传统百货商圈向城市副中心的转型，也是上海西南片区高端美妆、服饰与餐饮最集中的商场之一。空间形态以商场中庭为主，配合南北座连廊、临街橱窗与改造后的一层外广场：中庭适合搭大型装置与限时店，外广场适合做外摆、快闪车与排队集散。我方案例库收录该空间快闪案例46条，代表案例包括始祖鸟焕然新“申”限时POPUP、ABH眼绎眉力美妆快闪店、【店装空间】Buccellati布契拉提限时精品店。适合高端服饰与户外品牌、美妆香氛、珠宝腕表、生活方式体验，以及依托徐家汇地铁换乘客流的短期促销型快闪。交通方面，地铁1、9、11号线徐家汇站上盖，商场与车站直接连通。
intro_en: Grand Gateway 66 stands at 1 Hongqiao Road at the Huashan Road corner in Xuhui District, at the core of the Xujiahui retail district. Opened on 28 December 1999, it was Hang Lung Properties' first commercial project on the mainland and was renamed from "Grand Gateway" in 2011. The complex totals about 400,000 square metres and comprises a shopping mall, two 262-metre towers and serviced apartments; the mall has seven levels, a glazed dome and around 1,200 parking spaces. An asset-optimisation programme ran from 2017 to 2020, reopening the north block in September 2018 and completing the south block in 2020, adding a link bridge between the two and opening the street frontage into an outdoor plaza. It has tracked Xujiahui's shift from a traditional department-store district to a sub-centre of the city, and remains one of the densest concentrations of premium beauty, fashion and dining in south-west Shanghai. The spatial form is primarily the mall atrium, supported by the north-south link bridge, street-facing windows and the new ground-level plaza: the atrium takes large installations and temporary stores, while the plaza works for outdoor seating, pop-up trucks and queue management. Our case library holds 46 pop-up cases here, including Arc'teryx's "renewed Shanghai" pop-up, ABH's brow-focused beauty pop-up and Buccellati's temporary boutique. It suits premium fashion and outdoor brands, beauty and fragrance, watches and jewellery, lifestyle experiences, and short promotional pop-ups that rely on Xujiahui's metro interchange traffic. Metro Lines 1, 9 and 11 meet at Xujiahui station directly beneath the mall.

address: 上海市黄浦区马当路245号
intro_zh: 新天地时尚购物中心位于上海市黄浦区马当路245号，地处新天地太平桥板块，2010年开出、2011年正式投入运营，是太平桥项目中唯一的大型室内购物商场，建筑面积约2.95万平方米，地上地下各两层。它最初以“中国设计力量集聚中心”为定位，引入设计师品牌、买手店与明星潮店，并与上海时装周长期合作；2021年更名为“新天地时尚II”并启动焕新，2023年1月12日重新开业，改造后打开封闭盒体、沿街做出双层旗舰店，以天桥长廊与新天地时尚I连通，首店与旗舰店占比达五成、品牌数量约200个，成为新天地的“年轻潮流社交主场”。空间形态是商场盒体加沿街街区：室内中庭与楼层空间适合展陈型快闪，沿街双层店面适合橱窗式限时店，出门即是石库门里弄与太平湖绿地，室内外动线可以连成一条。我方案例库收录该空间快闪案例46条，代表案例包括Rémy Martin人头马特设邑想专列、CREED恺芮得新香限时快闪、波司登舒适户外新天地快闪店（上海）。适合设计师品牌与中国创艺、香氛美妆、潮流运动、时装周期间的订货会与发布，以及偏年轻社群的IP快闪。交通方面，地铁10、13号线新天地站步行约3分钟，1号线黄陂南路站步行约10分钟。
intro_en: Xintiandi Style occupies 245 Madang Road in Huangpu District, in the Taipingqiao quarter of Xintiandi. It opened in 2010 and began full operation in 2011 as the only large indoor shopping mall in the Taipingqiao scheme, with about 29,500 square metres over two levels above ground and two below. It was originally positioned as a platform for Chinese design, mixing designer labels, multi-brand stores and celebrity boutiques, and built a long partnership with Shanghai Fashion Week. Renamed Xintiandi Style II in 2021, it reopened on 12 January 2023 after a renovation that opened up the former sealed box, added double-height street-front flagship stores, connected to Xintiandi Style I by a covered bridge, and lifted first stores and flagships to half the tenant mix across roughly 200 brands, positioning it as Xintiandi's youth-oriented social and fashion hub. The spatial form is a mall volume plus a street edge: indoor atria and floor plates suit exhibition-style pop-ups, the two-level street frontage suits window-led temporary stores, and the shikumen lanes and Taiping Lake park are immediately outside, so indoor and outdoor routes can be joined. Our case library holds 46 pop-up cases here, including Rémy Martin's "Yixiang" special train, CREED's new-fragrance pop-up and Bosideng's outdoor pop-up at Xintiandi. It suits designer and Chinese creative brands, fragrance and beauty, streetwear and sport, showroom and launch programmes during Fashion Week, and IP pop-ups aimed at younger communities. Metro Lines 10 and 13 at Xintiandi station are about a three-minute walk; Line 1 at Huangpi South Road is about ten minutes.

address: 上海市南京西路1266号
intro_zh: 上海恒隆广场位于上海市静安区南京西路1266号，介于陕西北路与西康路之间，是南京西路商圈的核心地标。项目2001年7月14日开业，主楼66层、高288米，建成时是浦西第一高楼并保持该纪录至2006年，裙房为五层商场、面积约5.5万平方米，由KPF建筑事务所设计。商场以“HOME TO LUXURY”为定位，汇聚逾百个一线国际品牌，爱马仕、迪奥、路易威登、香奈儿、卡地亚等均在此设旗舰店；所在南京西路商圈的零售总额已突破1010亿元，成为国内首个千亿级商圈，恒隆广场是其中最集中的硬奢目的地，目前还在推进三期开放式街区。空间形态以商场中庭为核心：五层裙房围绕中庭展开，中庭与楼层边厅是品牌做限时店、艺术装置与发布的主要场地，临街入口与门前广场可承接外摆与排队动线。我方案例库收录该空间快闪案例41条，代表案例包括LoroPiana七夕限定系列限时快闪店、江诗丹顿全新限时体验店（上海恒隆广场）、CHAUMET限时巡展概念店。适合顶级奢侈品牌与硬奢珠宝腕表、高级成衣与皮具、香氛美妆、艺术与工艺展，以及需要高净值客群与私密体验的邀约制快闪。交通方面，地铁2、12、13号线南京西路站步行约10分钟，延安高架与南北高架在附近交汇。
intro_en: Plaza 66 occupies 1266 West Nanjing Road in Jing'an District, between North Shaanxi Road and Xikang Road, and is the anchor landmark of the West Nanjing Road retail district. It opened on 14 July 2001 with a 66-storey, 288-metre tower that was the tallest building in Puxi at the time and held that title until 2006; the five-level podium contains about 55,000 square metres of retail, designed by KPF. The mall positions itself as "Home to Luxury" and gathers more than a hundred international brands, with flagship stores for Hermes, Dior, Louis Vuitton, Chanel and Cartier. Retail sales across the West Nanjing Road district have passed 101 billion yuan, making it the first trillion-yuan-level retail district in China, and Plaza 66 is its densest concentration of hard luxury; a third-phase open block is also being developed. The spatial form centres on the mall atrium: five levels open onto it, and the atrium and floor-edge spaces are the main settings for temporary stores, art installations and launches, while the street entrances and forecourt can handle outdoor seating and queueing. Our case library holds 41 pop-up cases here, including Loro Piana's Qixi limited-collection pop-up, Vacheron Constantin's new experience store and Chaumet's travelling concept store. It suits top-tier luxury and hard-luxury watches and jewellery, couture and leather goods, fragrance and beauty, art and craft exhibitions, and invitation-only pop-ups for high-net-worth clients. Metro Lines 2, 12 and 13 at West Nanjing Road station are about a ten-minute walk, with the Yan'an and North-South elevated roads meeting nearby.

address: 上海市静安区南京西路1515号
intro_zh: 静安嘉里中心位于上海市静安区南京西路1515号，处在静安寺商圈与南京西路商圈西段的接合部，东邻恒隆广场、西接静安寺与静安公园、正对上海展览中心，2013年开业。项目由嘉里建设与香格里拉（亚洲）共同投资，总建筑面积约45万平方米，其中零售约8.6万平方米、办公约15.2万平方米，由KPF建筑事务所设计，包含商场、甲级办公楼与静安香格里拉大酒店，是静安区首个大型综合体，也是国内较早主打“轻奢”路线的商业项目，长期是国际品牌首店与旗舰店的首选地之一。空间形态是商场中庭加街区外摆：南北两区围合出室内中庭与多个花园式节点，安义路从两区之间穿过，周末与节假日封街做成限时步行街“安义夜巷”——全长264米（常德路至铜仁路），沿街摆开花市、餐饮、市集与舞台，是静安区第一条限时步行街。我方案例库收录该空间快闪案例37条，代表案例包括【店装空间】I.T限时店（上海静安嘉里中心）、lululemon限时快闪chargefeel女士运动鞋体验店、Pet Inn Here POP UP。适合轻奢与设计师品牌、运动户外、美妆香氛、宠物与亲子、生活方式市集，以及需要“室内展陈+户外街区”联动的社群型快闪。交通方面，地铁2、7号线静安寺站步行约8分钟，2、12、13号线南京西路站步行约10分钟。
intro_en: Jing An Kerry Centre occupies 1515 West Nanjing Road in Jing'an District, where the Jing'an Temple commercial area meets the western end of the West Nanjing Road district: Plaza 66 lies to the east, Jing'an Temple and Jing'an Park to the west, and the Shanghai Exhibition Center directly opposite. Opened in 2013, it was developed by Kerry Properties with Shangri-La Asia, totals about 450,000 square metres, and contains roughly 86,000 square metres of retail and 152,000 square metres of offices, designed by KPF together with the Jing An Shangri-La hotel. It was Jing'an District's first large mixed-use complex and one of the earlier mainland projects built around accessible luxury, and it remains a preferred address for international brands' first stores and flagships. The spatial form is a mall atrium plus street-side outdoor space: the north and south blocks enclose indoor atria and garden-like nodes, and Anyi Road runs between them, closing on weekends and holidays to become the "Anyi Night Lane" limited-time pedestrian street — 264 metres from Changde to Tongren Road, lined with flower stalls, food, markets and a stage, the first such street in the district. Our case library holds 37 pop-up cases here, including the I.T temporary store, lululemon's chargefeel women's running shoe experience store and the Pet Inn Here pop-up. It suits premium and designer brands, sport and outdoor, beauty and fragrance, pets and families, lifestyle markets, and community pop-ups that combine indoor display with an outdoor street. Metro Lines 2 and 7 at Jing'an Temple station are about an eight-minute walk; Lines 2, 12 and 13 at West Nanjing Road about ten minutes.

address: 上海市浦东新区世纪大道8号
intro_zh: 上海ifc商场位于上海市浦东新区世纪大道8号，坐落在小陆家嘴金融城核心，与东方明珠隔街相望、紧邻陆家嘴中心绿地，是上海国金中心（Shanghai IFC）的商场部分，由新鸿基地产开发。商场一期于2010年4月开业、二期于2013年7月开业，商业面积约11万平方米，上方是249.9米与259.9米的双塔，分别进驻丽思卡尔顿酒店与汇丰银行中国总部；首层聚集路易威登、香奈儿、爱马仕、古驰、普拉达、卡地亚等旗舰店，开业时近半数品牌为首次进入上海，长期是小陆家嘴高端零售的核心地标。空间形态以商场中庭与下沉广场为主：LG1与L1的中庭是品牌做限时店、艺术展与发布的主场，下沉式前广场以苹果店的玻璃圆柱天窗为中心，可做外摆与装置，室内连廊还可接通周边写字楼与国金中心其他业态，工作日白领客流稳定。我方案例库收录该空间快闪案例30条，代表案例包括【店装空间】mu关爱月限时绿色快闪、帕尔玛之水限时艺术香氛展、路易威登七夕限时活动。适合奢侈品牌限时精品店、香氛美妆与腕表珠宝、艺术与设计展、金融城白领向的生活方式体验，以及需要高端商务客群的邀约活动。交通方面，地铁2号线陆家嘴站地下直连商场，步行无需出地面。
intro_en: Shanghai IFC mall occupies 8 Century Avenue in Pudong, at the core of the Lujiazui financial district, diagonally across from the Oriental Pearl Tower and beside Lujiazui Central Green. It is the retail component of Shanghai IFC, developed by Sun Hung Kai Properties. Phase one opened in April 2010 and phase two in July 2013, giving about 110,000 square metres of retail beneath twin towers of 249.9 and 259.9 metres that house the Ritz-Carlton hotel and HSBC's China headquarters. The ground floor brings together flagship stores for Louis Vuitton, Chanel, Hermes, Gucci, Prada and Cartier; at opening nearly half of the brands were entering Shanghai for the first time, and the mall has remained the core high-end retail landmark of the Lujiazui peninsula. The spatial form centres on the mall atria and the sunken forecourt: the LG1 and L1 atria host temporary stores, art exhibitions and launches, the sunken plaza around the Apple Store's glass cylinder can take outdoor seating and installations, and indoor bridges connect to surrounding office towers and other parts of the complex, keeping weekday white-collar footfall steady. Our case library holds 30 pop-up cases here, including the mu "care month" green pop-up, Acqua di Parma's artistic fragrance exhibition and Louis Vuitton's Qixi activation. It suits luxury temporary boutiques, fragrance, beauty, watches and jewellery, art and design exhibitions, lifestyle experiences for the financial-district workforce, and invitation events that need a premium business audience. Metro Line 2 at Lujiazui station connects directly to the mall underground, so visitors never need to surface.

address: 上海市静安区西藏北路166号
intro_zh: 上海静安大悦城位于上海市静安区西藏北路166号、曲阜路口，处在苏河湾板块与西藏北路商圈，南座2010年12月开业、北座2015年12月开业，两座由连廊相接，商业面积合计约16.3万平方米，配约2400个停车位，是中粮大悦城体系在上海的旗舰项目。项目最鲜明的标签是屋顶的SKY RING摩天轮——国内首个悬臂式屋顶摩天轮，30个白色轿舱，轮顶离地约98米，可360度俯瞰苏州河与静安天际线；配合商场内的“摩坊166”主题街区和密集的二次元、潮玩、盲盒品牌，静安大悦城成为上海年轻客群与IP粉丝的聚集地，也是人民广场—南京东路客流外溢的第一站。空间形态是商场中庭加屋顶广场：南座、北座的中庭与楼层边厅适合做主题展与限时店，屋顶摩天轮广场与夜食天台适合做户外市集、灯光装置与品牌快闪，室内外可通过扶梯串联成完整体验动线。我方案例库收录该空间快闪案例30条，代表案例包括巴黎欧莱雅X海鸥计划「她守护」美力守护号、万代魂快闪店、TSUMTSUM“装”可爱2.0主题快闪店。适合二次元与游戏IP、潮玩盲盒与卡牌、美妆与快消、亲子与萌系IP、主题展与粉丝见面会。交通方面，地铁8、12号线曲阜路站1号口出站步行数分钟即到，属地铁上盖项目。
intro_en: Shanghai Jing'an Joy City occupies 166 North Xizang Road at the Qufu Road corner in Jing'an District, between the Suhe Creek area and the North Xizang Road commercial zone. The south block opened in December 2010 and the north block in December 2015, linked by bridges, with about 163,000 square metres of retail and some 2,400 parking spaces; it is COFCO Joy City's flagship in Shanghai.
