Its signature is the SKY RING ferris wheel on the roof, the first cantilevered rooftop wheel in China, with 30 white cabins and a top height of about 98 metres above ground, giving a 360-degree view over Suhe Creek and the Jing'an skyline. Combined with the "Mofang 166" themed zone inside and a dense cluster of anime, designer toy and blind-box brands, the mall has become a gathering point for younger shoppers and IP fans and the first stop for footfall spilling over from People's Square and East Nanjing Road. The spatial form is mall atria plus a rooftop plaza: the atria and floor-edge spaces in both blocks suit themed exhibitions and temporary stores, while the rooftop wheel plaza and night-food terrace suit outdoor markets, lighting installations and brand pop-ups, with escalators linking indoor and outdoor routes into one experience. Our case library holds 30 pop-up cases here, including L'Oreal Paris and the Seagull Project's "She Protects" beauty pop-up, the Bandai Spirits pop-up store and the TSUMTSUM 2.0 themed pop-up. It suits anime and game IP, designer toys, blind boxes and cards, beauty and FMCG, family and character IP, themed exhibitions and fan meet-ups. Metro Lines 8 and 12 at Qufu Road station, Exit 1, are a few minutes' walk; the mall sits directly above the station.

address: 上海市静安区南京西路789号
intro_zh: 兴业太古汇位于上海市静安区南京西路789号，处在南京西路商圈东段、石门一路口，2017年11月3日正式开业，被称为南京西路商圈的“最后一块大型拼图”。项目由香港兴业国际与太古地产合作开发，总楼面面积约32.2万平方米，包含一座10万多平方米的购物中心、两座分别约250米与170米的甲级办公楼，以及镛舍酒店与服务式公寓；商场内引入星巴克臻选上海烘焙工坊（约2700平方米，2017年12月开业，全球第二家），路易威登全球首座航海主题地标“路易号”亦落地于此，进一步坐实其“首发经济”地标的位置。空间形态是商场中庭加北广场：室内中庭与楼层边厅适合做品牌限时店与艺术展，北广场是大型装置、快闪车与开幕活动的常用场地。我方案例库收录该空间快闪案例29条，代表案例包括PUMA自定义夏天巡回快闪主题空间（上海、北京）、漫威潮玩限时空间、G-SHOCK女性POP-UP快闪店。适合运动潮流与户外品牌、IP潮玩与动漫、美妆香氛、生活方式与咖啡文化，以及需要大广场做装置与排队动线的大型快闪。交通方面，地铁2、12、13号线南京西路站直连，商场与车站出入口相接，另有延安高架与南北高架邻近。
intro_en: HKRI Taikoo Hui occupies 789 West Nanjing Road in Jing'an District, at the Shimen No.1 Road corner in the eastern part of the West Nanjing Road retail district. It opened on 3 November 2017 and has been described as the last large piece of the West Nanjing Road puzzle. Developed by Hong Kong Resort International and Swire Properties, it has about 322,000 square metres of gross floor area: a shopping mall of more than 100,000 square metres, two grade-A office towers of roughly 250 and 170 metres, and the Middle House hotel and serviced apartments. The mall houses the Starbucks Reserve Shanghai Roastery, about 2,700 square metres and the second such roastery in the world, which opened in December 2017, and Louis Vuitton's "Louis, the boat" — the brand's first nautical-themed global landmark — also landed here, reinforcing the project's position as a launch-economy landmark. The spatial form is the mall atrium plus the north plaza: indoor atria and floor-edge spaces suit brand temporary stores and art exhibitions, while the north plaza is the usual setting for large installations, pop-up trucks and opening events. Our case library holds 29 pop-up cases here, including PUMA's custom-summer touring pop-up (Shanghai and Beijing), a Marvel designer-toy pop-up and the G-SHOCK women's pop-up. It suits sportswear and outdoor brands, IP and anime merchandise, beauty and fragrance, lifestyle and coffee culture, and large pop-ups that need a plaza for installations and queueing. Metro Lines 2, 12 and 13 connect directly at West Nanjing Road station, with the mall entrances adjoining the station exits, and the Yan'an and North-South elevated roads run nearby.

address: 上海市长宁区长宁路1139号
intro_zh: 长宁来福士位于上海市长宁区长宁路1139号、凯旋路口，地处中山公园商圈核心，2017年6月30日开业，是凯德集团在上海的第二座来福士，总建筑面积约36万平方米，由东西两座商场与三栋甲级写字楼组成，其中商业面积约12.8万平方米。项目建在圣玛利亚女中旧址上——这所由美国圣公会于1881年创办的女子教会学校曾培养出张爱玲等校友，凯德在开发中保留并修复了“四堂一楼”（思孙堂、思卜堂、膳堂、格致堂与钟楼）以及约1000平方米中央大草坪，绿化率超过40%，商场围绕历史建筑与草坪围合展开，是上海少见的“商业+校园遗址”组合。空间形态是商场加中央草坪广场：东西两座商场的室内中庭适合做主题展与限时店，钟楼前的大草坪与历史建筑群适合做户外市集、露营、宠物活动与品牌外摆，室内外动线自然连通。我方案例库收录该空间快闪案例28条，代表案例包括奥佳华X唐妞驾到国风养生馆主题品牌展、【长宁来福士】迪士尼绒冬奇遇引力场、MUJI无印良品宠物友好限时概念店。适合亲子家庭与萌系IP、宠物友好品牌、国风与文创、生活方式与户外露营，以及需要草坪与历史建筑背景的发布和市集。交通方面，地铁2、3、4号线中山公园站上盖，B1与B2层与车站无缝连通，虹桥机场车程约20分钟。
intro_en: Raffles City Changning stands at 1139 Changning Road at the Kaixuan Road corner in Changning District, at the heart of the Zhongshan Park commercial area. Opened on 30 June 2017, it is CapitaLand's second Raffles City in Shanghai and totals about 360,000 square metres, made up of two retail blocks, three grade-A office towers and roughly 128,000 square metres of shops. It is built on the former campus of St. Mary's Hall, an Anglican girls' school founded in 1881 that counted the writer Eileen Chang among its alumnae; CapitaLand retained and restored the "four halls and one tower" — Sishun Hall, Sibu Hall, the refectory, the science hall and the clock tower — together with a central lawn of about 1,000 square metres, and kept greenery above 40 percent. The mall wraps around the historic buildings and lawn, a rare combination of retail and preserved school campus in Shanghai. The spatial form is a mall plus a central lawn plaza: the indoor atria of the east and west blocks suit themed exhibitions and temporary stores, while the lawn in front of the clock tower and the historic buildings suit outdoor markets, camping, pet events and brand activations, with indoor and outdoor routes flowing naturally into each other. Our case library holds 28 pop-up cases here, including OGAWA and Tang Niu's Chinese-style wellness house brand exhibition, the Disney winter wonderland installation and MUJI's pet-friendly temporary concept store. It suits families and character IP, pet-friendly brands, Chinese heritage and cultural products, lifestyle and outdoor camping themes, and launches or markets that benefit from a lawn and historic architecture. Metro Lines 2, 3 and 4 meet at Zhongshan Park station directly above, with B1 and B2 connected seamlessly to the station; Hongqiao Airport is about 20 minutes by car.

address: 上海市普陀区中山北路3300号
intro_zh: 上海环球港位于普陀区中山北路3300号，处在普陀、长宁、静安三区交界的内环高架与轨交3、4号线之间，是一处不依赖既有商圈、靠自身体量做成的“目的地型”商业综合体。项目由月星集团开发、查普门泰勒（Chapman Taylor）设计，2007年开工，2013年9月开业，总建筑面积48万平方米，其中购物中心约27万平方米、办公约12万平方米、酒店约4万平方米；四层裙房为新古典风格的室内商场，上盖两栋245米塔楼，地下三层中两层为商业、一层为停车场，地下车位2000余个。商场由南向北串起太阳大厅、中央广场与花园中庭三个中庭，分别取希腊罗马古典、威尼斯与自然绿植主题，中廊宽阔，可承载大型美陈与路演；场内另设金色演艺大厅，长期举办音乐会与展演。据上观新闻2023年报道，其日均客流10万人次以上、年客流超过3500万人次，2019年以来一直位居“上海购物中心人气榜”首位。库内以“环球港”名义收录快闪案例26起，代表案例包括HUAWEI nova 10系列限时快闪、moody 彩瞳情绪空间站、EF 首家快闪店-反卷当铺。空间条件适合3C数码、美妆、潮玩与亲子类快闪，也适合需要大客流曝光的中庭路演与主题展陈。交通方面，地铁3、4、13号线金沙江路站与商场直接连通，13号线站点位于裙房“前甲板”下方，3、4号线可经换乘平台进入。
intro_en: Global Harbor occupies 3300 Zhongshan North Road in Putuo District, on a long, narrow site wedged between the Inner Ring elevated road and Metro lines 3 and 4, where Putuo, Changning and Jing'an meet. Developed by Moonstar Group and designed by Chapman Taylor, it broke ground in 2007 and opened in September 2013. The complex totals about 480,000 sqm: a mall of roughly 270,000 sqm, some 120,000 sqm of offices and a 40,000 sqm hotel, with a four-storey neoclassical podium beneath two 245-metre towers and three basement levels, two for retail and one for parking with more than 2,000 spaces. Three atria run from south to north — the Sun Hall in Graeco-Roman style, the Central Plaza with Venetian detailing and the Garden Atrium with planting motifs — giving brands long, wide circulation routes for large installations and roadshows; a golden performance hall stages concerts and events. Shangguan News reported in 2023 that daily footfall exceeds 100,000 and annual footfall 35 million, and that the mall has held first place on Shanghai's shopping-centre popularity ranking since 2019. The popup library records 26 cases here, among them HUAWEI's nova 10 limited popup, moody's contact-lens emotion station and EF's first popup, the anti-grind pawnshop. The scale and footfall suit consumer-tech, beauty, designer-toy and family popups, as well as atrium roadshows that need mass exposure. Metro lines 3, 4 and 13 meet at Jinshajiang Road station, which runs directly into the podium.

address: 上海市徐汇区淮海中路999号
intro_zh: 环贸iapm商场位于徐汇区淮海中路999号，处在淮海中路商业街西段、陕西南路口，是淮海路沿线代表性的高端购物中心之一，与南京西路、静安寺两个商圈形成错位。项目由新鸿基地产开发、Benoy 负责建筑设计，2013年8月正式营业，前身为襄阳路小商品市场；商场共地上6层、地下2层，汇聚逾238个潮流品牌，其中约一成首次进入中国市场、一成半首进上海。沿淮海中路一侧设逾220米长的临街复式旗舰店界面，包含全中国最大的Prada旗舰店以及Gucci、Miu Miu、Dolce & Gabbana、Valentino等品牌；场内另有Apple Store、citysuper超市、无印良品与百丽宫IMAX影城，餐厅集中在LG2层与5、6层。上盖为两座甲级写字楼及住宅“上海天玺”，商场设两层停车场、近800个车位。空间形态是典型的“盒子型”高端商场：临街复式店面负责街面曝光，室内中庭与扶梯动线承担体验型展陈与排队集散，适合做“橱窗+中庭”联动的双层快闪。库内收录快闪案例23起，代表案例包括Coach Tabby 快闪店（上海）、Canada Goose 加拿大鹅沉浸式体验空间、COACH 酒神包冰淇淋快闪店 上海。适合轻奢与设计师品牌首发、美妆香氛、时尚IP联名与需要街面可见度的品牌活动。交通方面，地铁1、10、12号线陕西南路站直达商场。
intro_en: iAPM Mall stands at 999 Huaihai Middle Road in Xuhui District, at the western stretch of the Huaihai Road shopping street by Shaanxi South Road — one of the street's flagship premium malls, positioned apart from the Nanjing West Road and Jing'an Temple retail areas. Developed by Sun Hung Kai Properties and designed by Benoy, it opened in August 2013 on the site of the former Xiangyang Road market. The mall has six levels above ground and two below, with more than 238 fashion brands, roughly ten per cent entering China for the first time and fifteen per cent new to Shanghai. A frontage of over 220 metres along Huaihai Road is given to duplex flagship stores, including Prada's largest store in China plus Gucci, Miu Miu, Dolce & Gabbana and Valentino; inside are an Apple Store, a citysuper supermarket, MUJI and the Palace IMAX cinema, with restaurants concentrated on LG2 and levels five and six. Two grade-A office towers and the Shanghai Tianxi residences rise above, and two basement parking levels provide nearly 800 spaces. The form is a classic box mall: street-level duplex units deliver street exposure while the interior atria and escalator routes absorb experiential displays and queues, making it well suited to two-level popups that pair a window with an atrium. The popup library holds 23 cases, including Coach's Tabby popup, Canada Goose's immersive experience space and COACH's Dionysus ice-cream popup. It suits accessible-luxury and designer launches, beauty and fragrance, fashion IP collaborations and campaigns that need street visibility. Metro lines 1, 10 and 12 connect directly at Shaanxi South Road station.

name_zh: 新世界新丸中心（原新世界大丸百货）
address: 上海市黄浦区南京东路228号
intro_zh: 新世界新丸中心位于黄浦区南京东路228号，处在南京东路步行街东段与河南中路交汇处，毗邻外滩，紧邻外滩方向的步行街入口。项目由上海新世界集团与日本大丸松坂屋百货合作打造，2015年5月15日以“新世界大丸百货”开业，整体规模约12万平方米、商业空间约6万平方米；2026年1月1日日方合约到期、停用“大丸”商标，正式更名为“新世界新丸中心 NEW ONE”，并启动不停业改造，转向“百货+购物中心+空间运营”三合一模式。据上观新闻报道，商场2024年销售额突破23亿元、全年客流突破1700万人次。空间形态上，商场以“海之文化”为主题逐层设计，拥有12部龙形“升龙”旋转电梯、可开合的玻璃穹顶、屋顶巨型LED屏与带水池的超大中庭，垂直动线本身就是打卡点，适合把品牌装置做到中庭与屋顶。库内收录快闪案例22起，代表案例包括资生堂SHISEIDO X 茑屋书店快闪店（上海）、Koradior珂莱蒂尔15周年快闪店、世界杯泰普尔能量睡感站。适合美妆香氛、珠宝腕表、书店与文化跨界、IP联名等快闪，中庭加穹顶LED的组合也适合夜间灯光秀式的品牌大事件。交通方面，地铁2、10号线南京东路站步行可达，紧邻步行街东段人流入口。
intro_en: New World New One Center occupies 228 Nanjing East Road in Huangpu District, at the junction of the eastern end of the Nanjing Road pedestrian street and Henan Middle Road, next to the Bund, at the pedestrian street's eastern gateway toward the waterfront. Built by Shanghai New World Group with Japan's Daimaru Matsuzakaya, it opened on 15 May 2015 as New World Daimaru, with a total scale of about 120,000 sqm and roughly 60,000 sqm of trading space. On 1 January 2026, with the Japanese contract expired, it dropped the Daimaru trademark, became New World New One Center (NEW ONE) and began a renovation that keeps the store trading, shifting to a three-in-one model of department store, shopping centre and space operator. Shangguan News reported 2024 sales of RMB 2.3 billion and 17 million visitors. The interior is themed on maritime culture floor by floor, with twelve dragon-shaped spiral escalators, an openable glass roof, a huge rooftop LED screen and a large atrium with water features, so the vertical circulation is itself an attraction and brand installations can climb from atrium to roof. The library records 22 popup cases, including Shiseido x Tsutaya Books, Koradior's 15th-anniversary popup and Tempur's World Cup sleep station. It suits beauty and fragrance, jewellery and watches, bookstore and cultural crossovers and IP collaborations; the atrium-and-LED combination also supports evening light-show events. Metro lines 2 and 10 stop at Nanjing East Road station, a short walk away.

address: 上海市黄浦区中山东二路600号
intro_zh: BFC外滩金融中心位于黄浦区中山东二路600号，处在外滩金融集聚带核心段：北望外滩万国建筑群，东隔黄浦江对望陆家嘴，西邻豫园，南望世博园区一带，是外滩沿线少见的“新建大体量+滨江开放空间”组合。项目由复星打造，英国 Heatherwick Studio 与 Foster + Partners 联合设计，2019年12月12日正式开业，总建筑面积约42万平方米，包含办公约18.2万平方米、商业约9.6万平方米、酒店约3万平方米及复星艺术中心；两栋180米双子塔刷新外滩天际线，临江界面长418米。空间分为南区与北区：南区以购物中心中庭和复星艺术中心为核心，北区以临江办公、广场与滨江步道为主；另设文创主题区，含「阅外滩」书店与博纳影院「博悦汇」。项目自营“外滩枫径”周末市集与“外滩艺术季”两个IP，广场与滨江界面可承接户外装置、市集与品牌快闪。库内收录快闪案例21起，代表案例包括STAFFONLY x ON/OFF限时快闪POP-UP社恐庇护所、TRACK TRUCK 自由着陆计划、高原骑士「生于桀骜 丰于融合」限时野营快闪。适合设计师品牌、艺术展览型快闪、酒类与户外露营主题，以及需要江景背景的传播型活动。交通方面，地铁10、14号线豫园站步行约10分钟可达。
intro_en: BFC Bund Finance Center occupies 600 Zhongshan East Second Road in Huangpu District, in the core of the Bund financial belt: the Bund's historic facades to the north, Lujiazui across the Huangpu to the east, Yu Garden to the west and the Expo site to the south. It is one of the few Bund addresses that combines a large new-build complex with open riverside space. Developed by Fosun and designed jointly by Heatherwick Studio and Foster + Partners, it opened on 12 December 2019 and totals about 420,000 sqm, including some 182,000 sqm of offices, 96,000 sqm of retail, a 30,000 sqm hotel and the Fosun Foundation art centre. Twin 180-metre towers reset the Bund skyline and the river frontage runs 418 metres. The site splits into a south zone organised around the mall atrium and the art centre, and a north zone of riverside offices, a plaza and a waterfront walk; a creative and cultural zone houses the Yuwai Bund bookstore and a Bona cinema. Two self-owned IPs, the Bund Fengjing weekend market and the Bund Art Season, use the plazas and river edge, which also take outdoor installations, markets and brand popups. The library records 21 cases, among them STAFFONLY x ON/OFF's 'social-anxiety shelter', TRACK TRUCK's free-landing project and Highland Park's wilderness camping popup. It suits designer labels, exhibition-style popups, spirits and outdoor themes, and campaigns that need a river backdrop. Metro lines 10 and 14 stop at Yu Garden, about ten minutes' walk away.

address: 上海市徐汇区安福路322号
intro_zh: 永乐汇322位于徐汇区安福路322号，在武康路—安福路街区、衡山路复兴路历史文化风貌区之内，是上海近年由电影工业遗存转型的街区型文创园区。主体建筑为1932年建成的西班牙式三层花园住宅“巨泼来斯公寓”，属上海市第四批优秀历史建筑，原为孔令侃产业；20世纪50年代起上海市电影发行放映公司入驻，这里见证了永乐宫影院与上海联和电影院线的历史。此后在上影集团旗下永乐汇与徐汇区湖南街道的统筹下完成微更新，转型为以“电影+休闲”为主题的园区，并成为武安电影街区的核心载体。院内一层是2020年开业的FILM电影时光书店，陈列600多种电影相关图书，是上海唯一的电影垂类主题书店；据2025年报道，园区出租率常年保持100%，聚集adidas上海旗舰店（2025年5月揭幕，品牌称全球首家三叶草旗舰店）、wigglewiggle中国首店等一批“首店、首发、首秀”。空间是“沿街店面+院内动线”的街区形态，尺度小、氛围强，适合做需排队与打卡的潮流事件。库内收录快闪案例19起，代表案例包括FiSN x HYPEBEAST「Bodega 商店」、cosme粉色主题快闪、Heir赫艾迩 Heir Meta Halloween寻宝快闪。适合潮牌drop、美妆、电影文化联名与小体量精品快闪。交通方面，地铁10、11号线交通大学站与1、7号线常熟路站均可步行到达。
intro_en: Yongle Hui 322 sits at 322 Anfu Road in Xuhui District, inside the Wukang Road–Anfu Road block of the Hengshan–Fuxing historic conservation area, and is one of Shanghai's newer street-scale creative parks converted from film-industry heritage. Its main building is Jupolaisi Apartments, a Spanish-style three-storey garden villa built in 1932 and listed in Shanghai's fourth batch of outstanding historic buildings; it was originally the property of Kong Lingkan, and from the 1950s housed the Shanghai film distribution and projection company, witnessing both the Yongle Palace cinema and the Shanghai Lianhe cinema circuit. A micro-renewal led by Yongle Hui, a Shangying Group subsidiary, together with Hunan Road Subdistrict, turned it into a film-and-leisure park and the retail core of the Wu'an film block. On the ground floor, FILM Movie Time Bookstore opened in 2020 with more than 600 film titles, the city's only film-specialist bookshop. A 2025 report put occupancy at a constant 100 per cent, with adidas' Shanghai flagship — unveiled in May 2025 and described by the brand as its first global Originals flagship — Wiggle Wiggle's first China store and a run of other debuts. The layout is a street of shopfronts opening onto internal lanes: small in scale, strong in atmosphere, and suited to trend events that expect queues and photography. The library records 19 cases, including FiSN x HYPEBEAST's Bodega store, a cosme pink-themed popup and Heir's Halloween treasure-hunt popup. It fits streetwear drops, beauty, film-culture collaborations and small-format boutiques. Metro lines 10 and 11 stop at Jiaotong University, and lines 1 and 7 at Changshu Road, both within walking distance.

address: 上海市静安区南京西路1618号
intro_zh: 上海久光百货位于静安区南京西路1618号，南临南京西路，处在静安寺商圈的核心位置，与静安嘉里中心、芮欧百货、CP静安共同构成静安寺站周边的商业集群。项目由香港利福国际集团旗下香港崇光百货与上海九百（集团）有限公司合资成立，2004年开业，是上海日式百货的代表；全馆营业楼层自地下一层至七层，总建筑面积约9.2万平方米，汇聚500多家国际品牌。楼层分工清晰：B1为约6500平方米的食品超市“鲜品馆”，一层是世界名牌精品与化妆品，二层高级女装及配饰，三层时尚女装与品牌内衣，四层青春便服及运动装，五层男士服装与高尔夫用品，六层运动用品及儿童天地，七层居家生活用品。空间是典型的垂直百货：单层面积不大、扶梯动线紧凑，品牌以“店中店”形式沿通道排布，适合把快闪嵌进楼层中庭或化妆品区主通道。据和君咨询2022年文章，其销售额长期稳定在25亿元以上，位居上海百货前三。库内收录快闪案例19起，代表案例包括Qeelin Bo Bo 环球主题展（上海）、HGENTEEL荷高 高能磁场限时快闪、黛珂肌源永动主题展。适合高端美妆、珠宝腕表、日系生活方式与食品伴手礼类快闪。交通方面，地铁2、7、14号线静安寺站步行可达，2号口与商场地下一层直接相连。
intro_en: Shanghai Jiuguang Department Store stands at 1618 Nanjing West Road in Jing'an District, facing Nanjing West Road at the heart of the Jing'an Temple retail area, where it forms a cluster with Jing'an Kerry Centre, Réel and CP Jing'an around the metro station. A joint venture between Hong Kong Sogo, part of Lifestyle International, and Shanghai 900 Group, it opened in 2004 and is the city's reference point for Japanese-style department-store retail. Trading runs from B1 to the seventh floor, with about 92,000 sqm of floor area and more than 500 international brands. The stack is precise: a 6,500 sqm food supermarket on B1, luxury and cosmetics on the ground floor, premium womenswear and accessories on two, fashion and lingerie on three, youth casual and sport on four, menswear and golf on five, sport and children on six, and homeware on seven. The form is a classic vertical department store — modest floor plates, tight escalator circulation and shop-in-shop units along the aisles — which makes it easy to drop a popup into a floor atrium or the main cosmetics corridor. A 2022 Hejun Consulting article put sales consistently above RMB 2.5 billion, among Shanghai's top three department stores. The library records 19 cases, including Qeelin's Bo Bo world tour exhibition, HGENTEEL's high-energy-field popup and Decorté's skin-source exhibition. It suits premium beauty, jewellery and watches, Japanese lifestyle and food-gift popups. Metro lines 2, 7 and 14 stop at Jing'an Temple, and exit 2 connects directly to the store's B1 level.

address: 上海市长宁区愚园路1107号
intro_zh: 创邑SPACE弘基位于长宁区愚园路1107号、近凤冈路，处在愚园路历史风貌街区的东段，是弘基集团与创邑品牌在城市更新中较早落地的一处园区。项目2007年12月竣工，由上海长征制药厂的老厂房与几栋老洋房改造而成，园区共9栋各具特色的独栋办公楼，总建筑面积约2.3万平方米，地上5层、层高3.8米；1号楼3至4层为联合办公空间。空间气质是“花园洋房+工业元素”：红砖与黑钢立面、LOFT挑高、独栋招商，内部以创意、设计、广告传媒与IT类企业为主。临愚园路一侧保留了一块户外大草坪，是愚园路街区公共艺术装置最常用的落点之一——2025年长宁区政府报道中，创邑在此落地原创IP“小狗蛇点点”艺术装置，成为热门打卡点。这种“园区+街区+草坪”的复合场景，适合把室内展陈与户外装置串成一条动线。库内收录快闪案例19起，代表案例包括【伊丽莎白雅顿】百年红门智性街区、2023 蝙蝠侠日主题快闪、bose节日快闪。适合美妆香氛、运动户外、IP主题展与市集型活动，工作日可吃到园区办公客群、周末承接愚园路漫步人流。交通方面，地铁2、11号线江苏路站步行约5分钟，园区资料给出的距离是距11号线江苏路站约333米。
intro_en: CREATER SPACE Hongji occupies 1107 Yuyuan Road in Changning District, near Fenggang Road at the eastern end of the Yuyuan Road historic block — one of the earlier city-renewal projects of the Hongji Group and its Creater brand. Completed in December 2007, it was converted from the former Shanghai Long March Pharmaceutical factory workshops and several old villas into nine distinct standalone buildings totalling about 23,000 sqm, five storeys high with 3.8-metre floor heights; the third and fourth floors of Building 1 are co-working space. The character is garden villa plus industrial detailing: red brick and black steel facades, lofted volumes and building-by-building leasing, tenanted mainly by creative, design, advertising and IT firms. A large lawn along Yuyuan Road is one of the block's most-used settings for public art; a 2025 Changning District government report described Creater installing an original IP piece there as a popular photo spot. This park-street-lawn combination lets an indoor display connect to an outdoor installation along one route. The library records 19 cases, including Elizabeth Arden's century-red-gate intellectual block, a 2023 Batman Day popup and a Bose holiday popup. It suits beauty and fragrance, sport and outdoor, IP exhibitions and market-format events, reaching office workers on weekdays and Yuyuan Road strollers at weekends. Metro lines 2 and 11 stop at Jiangsu Road, about five minutes' walk away; the park's own material puts it some 333 metres from the line 11 entrance.

address: 上海市静安区南京西路1601号
intro_zh: Réel芮欧百货位于静安区南京西路1601号、近常德路，处在静安寺商圈，与久光百货、静安嘉里中心、CP静安同处静安寺站步行范围。商场2012年开业，建筑由久米设计负责，外观取“雪花球”意象，是南京西路沿线辨识度较高的当代商业立面。定位上以国际高端设计师品牌与潮流品牌为主，Acne Studios、Maison Margiela、C.P.Company、American Vintage、Studio Nicholson、UNICA 等均在此设店，顶楼露台可俯瞰静安寺。空间为垂直型百货：B2层做过“白领食堂”式餐饮升级，B1层经2022年整层调改后以美妆护理和女装为主、约30个品牌，开出亚太首家PRADA香水店、上海首家Achmique集合店以及 Matiere Premiere、Hourglass 等，并同步重做整层空间设计；场内另有自营买手店 Assemble by Réel，五层设餐饮。楼层少、单层完整，适合做“整层主题”或“店中店”式快闪。库内收录快闪案例16起，代表案例包括AMIRI x ASSEMBLE BY RÉEL 限时快闪、DIESEL限时闪现Assemble、Maison Kitsuné限时快闪店。适合设计师品牌与潮牌联名drop、美妆香氛、艺术跨界等小体量快闪。交通方面，地铁2、7、14号线静安寺站步行可达，4号口出站即达商场。
intro_en: Réel occupies 1601 Nanjing West Road in Jing'an District, near Changde Road, in the Jing'an Temple retail area and within walking distance of Jiuguang, Jing'an Kerry Centre and CP Jing'an from the same metro station. The mall opened in 2012 in a building designed by Kume Sekkei, its facade derived from the image of a snow globe — one of the more distinctive contemporary elevations along Nanjing West Road. It is positioned around international designer and fashion labels, with Acne Studios, Maison Margiela, C.P. Company, American Vintage, Studio Nicholson and UNICA among its tenants, and a top-floor terrace looking onto Jing'an Temple. The format is a vertical department store: B2 received a canteen-style dining upgrade, and B1 was reworked in 2022 into a beauty and womenswear level of about 30 brands, bringing in Asia-Pacific's first Prada perfume store, Shanghai's first Achmique concept store, Matiere Premiere and Hourglass, with the whole floor redesigned. The store also runs its own buyer concept, Assemble by Réel, and has restaurants on the fifth floor. With few, complete floor plates it works well for whole-floor themed popups or shop-in-shop formats. The library records 16 cases, including AMIRI x Assemble by Réel, Diesel's Assemble flash appearance and Maison Kitsuné's popup store. It suits designer and streetwear drops, beauty and fragrance, and small-format art crossovers. Metro lines 2, 7 and 14 stop at Jing'an Temple, and exit 4 opens directly onto the mall.

address: 上海市长宁区愚园路1018号
intro_zh: 愚园百货商店位于长宁区愚园路1018号，在愚园路历史风貌街区内、毗邻江苏路站，是一栋建于1930年代的三层小楼，建筑面积640平方米。这里原是现代文坛“三剑客”之一施蛰存的旧居，后来一楼改为上海邮政江苏路邮局物流中心兼长宁区邮电（投递）支局；邮政迁出后由创邑改建，2018年10月18日开业，取名“愚园百货公司”，是上海较早以“路名”做IP的潮流百货。空间保留老式壁炉、陡峭木质楼梯等原有细节，文创店、咖啡、画廊与潮牌集合店之间没有明显分隔，主张“所见即可购”；二楼整层被留作限定店（pop-up）空间，开业首期引入本土香氛品牌，此后长期作为新品牌试水与首发场地。场内曾聚集P.O.BOX潮流集合店、SMFK首家最全品类实体店与Akimbo Cafe为愚园路定制的“艾肯博咖啡实验室”。体量小、楼层低、临街面窄，属于典型的“街角精品快闪”场地。库内收录快闪案例16起，代表案例包括兰蔻 X BERBRICK跨界打造CALL ME HAPPY「潮妆快闪店」、Levi's® x 飞利浦我们兜很酷、GROWN ALCHEMIST「肌肤美学实验室」。适合美妆护肤、咖啡与香氛、本土设计师品牌首发等小体量快闪。交通方面，地铁2、11号线江苏路站步行约5分钟。
intro_en: Yuyuan Department Store stands at 1018 Yuyuan Road in Changning District, inside the Yuyuan Road historic block and next to Jiangsu Road station. The building is a three-storey house of 640 sqm built in the 1930s. It was originally the residence of the writer Shi Zhecun, one of the three modernist literary figures of his generation, and its ground floor later became a China Post logistics depot and delivery office. After the post office moved out, Creater converted the building and opened it on 18 October 2018 as Yuyuan Department Store, one of Shanghai's earlier trend retailers to build an identity around a street name. The interior keeps the old fireplace and the steep timber stair, and there are no hard divisions between the design shop, café, gallery and streetwear selection — everything on show is for sale. The entire second floor is given over to pop-up tenants; the first was a local fragrance label, and it has remained a try-out and launch space for new brands. Tenants have included the P.O.BOX streetwear collective, SMFK's first full-category store and Akimbo Cafe's Shanghai flagship laboratory. Small, low-rise and with a narrow street frontage, it is a classic corner boutique popup venue. The library records 16 cases, including Lancôme x BERBRICK's CALL ME HAPPY make-up popup, Levi's x Philips and GROWN ALCHEMIST's skin-science lab. It suits beauty and skincare, coffee and fragrance, and first launches by local designers. Metro lines 2 and 11 stop at Jiangsu Road, about five minutes' walk away.

address: 上海市黄浦区南京东路829号
intro_zh: 上海世茂广场位于黄浦区南京东路829号、近西藏中路，处在南京东路步行街西段起点，与人民广场隔西藏中路相望，是步行街西端的主要入口之一。项目前身为“上海百联世茂国际广场”，2017年5月世茂集团收回经营管理权并更名，2018年9月28日完成改造开业；综合体总建筑面积17万平方米，主塔楼60层、高333.3米，裙楼10层，商场体量约5.8万平方米（改造设计方 Kokaistudios 口径为6.17万平方米），并设近2000平方米开放式广场。改造以“剧院”为设计概念，室内走工业与先锋风格，前后场动线被重新组织；租户以旗舰店与主题店为主，包括NIKE全球旗舰店、M&M's巧克力世界亚洲唯一旗舰店、SEPHORA亚洲首家概念店、乐高亚洲首家城市中心旗舰店、世茂Hello Kitty上海滩时光之旅、星巴克臻选，以及“感光全球首家环球旅行快闪空间”等。空间条件适合“旗舰店级”大店与快闪混合使用，开放式广场可承接户外装置与排队集散。库内收录快闪案例15起，代表案例包括中华铅笔“文明变铅”首家快闪店、美宝莲 X M&M 跨界联名快闪、玩潮宇宙主题快闪店。适合潮流IP、运动品牌、美妆联名与首发型快闪。交通方面，地铁1、2、8号线人民广场站步行可达。
intro_en: Shanghai Shimao Festival City occupies 829 Nanjing East Road in Huangpu District, near Xizang Middle Road, at the western start of the Nanjing Road pedestrian street, facing People's Square across the road — one of the main gateways into the street. Formerly Bailian Shimao International Plaza, it was taken back under Shimao Group's management in May 2017, renamed, and reopened on 28 September 2018 after a renovation. The complex totals 170,000 sqm: a 60-storey main tower 333.3 metres tall, a 10-storey podium, a retail volume of about 58,000 sqm (61,700 sqm in the renovation architect Kokaistudios' figures) and an open plaza of nearly 2,000 sqm. Kokaistudios designed the interiors around a theatre concept, with industrial, avant-garde detailing and a reworked front-of-house and back-of-house circulation. Tenants are weighted towards flagships and concept stores: Nike's global flagship, the only M&M's World in Asia, Sephora's first concept store in Asia, Lego's first city-centre flagship in Asia, Hello Kitty Shanghai Times, a Starbucks Reserve, and 'Ganguang', billed as the world's first around-the-world travel popup. The format mixes flagship-scale stores with popups, and the open plaza takes outdoor installations and queues. The library records 15 cases, including China Pencil's first popup, Maybelline x M&M's crossover and the Play Trend Universe popup. It suits trend IP, sportswear, beauty collaborations and launch-led popups. Metro lines 1, 2 and 8 stop at People's Square, within walking distance.

address: 上海市虹口区东大名路358号（国客中心园区；客运码头位于东大名路500号、800号）
intro_zh: 北外滩国客中心位于虹口区东大名路358号一带，是上海港国际客运中心（简称“国客中心”）所在的滨江园区，客运码头位于东大名路500号、800号。项目由上港集团全资子公司上海港国际客运中心开发有限公司（2002年成立）开发运营，2004年开工，2009年7月1日全面建成试运行，总建筑面积约40万平方米、共13个项目，拥有1.2公里黄金沿江岸线和5个可供邮轮、游览船靠泊的泊位，是中国母港邮轮的发源地之一。空间以“码头+亲水平台+开放式广场+滨江绿地”为主，2021年7月1日亲水平台全面贯通，公众开放时间为6:00—22:00；背靠北外滩办公楼群，隔江对望陆家嘴，与外滩万国建筑群共同构成上海的“黄金三角”。这种开敞的临江界面适合做需要地标背景的大型装置与户外事件，也适合把市集、快闪街区沿江铺开。库内收录快闪案例12起，代表案例包括祖·玛珑 x Paddington「橘子果酱」主题联名快闪（上海）、【石头科技】石头洗衣机巨型装置、【Leather在现场】喜茶X草间弥生 制作现场。适合大型户外装置、品牌事件、市集与快闪街区、邮轮与城市文化主题活动。交通方面，地铁12号线国际客运中心站2号口步行可达，另有22、37、135、330、868、934路等公交至东大名路旅顺路站。
intro_en: North Bund International Cruise Terminal occupies the waterfront park around 358 East Daming Road in Hongkou District, with the passenger terminal itself at 500 and 800 East Daming Road. It is developed and operated by Shanghai Port International Cruise Terminal Development Co., a wholly owned subsidiary of Shanghai International Port Group set up in 2002; construction began in 2004 and the terminal was completed and soft-opened on 1 July 2009. The project totals about 400,000 sqm across 13 components and holds some 1.2 kilometres of prime river frontage with five berths for cruise ships and tour boats — one of the birthplaces of China's home-port cruising. The space is essentially a working terminal combined with a waterfront promenade, open plazas and riverside parkland; the promenade was fully connected on 1 July 2021 and is open to the public from 06:00 to 22:00. Backed by North Bund office towers, it faces Lujiazui across the Huangpu and, with the Bund's historic frontage, forms Shanghai's 'golden triangle'. That open river edge suits large installations and outdoor events that need a landmark backdrop, and allows markets or popup streets to be laid out along the water. The library records 12 cases, including Jo Malone x Paddington's marmalade-themed collaboration, Roborock's giant washing-machine installation and the Heytea x Yayoi Kusama making-of scene. It fits large outdoor installations, brand events, markets and popup streets, and cruise or city-culture programming. Metro line 12 stops at International Cruise Terminal, exit 2 within walking distance, with buses 22, 37, 135, 330, 868 and 934 stopping nearby.

address: 上海市黄浦区淮海中路300号
intro_zh: 上海K11购物艺术中心位于黄浦区淮海中路300号，处在淮海中路商圈、淮海路商业街与新天地之间，是淮海路上最高的建筑之一，也是上海“艺术加商业”模式的开创者。项目由新世界发展旗下K11品牌运营，2013年6月28日开业，商业面积约3.8万平方米、办公约7万平方米，建筑由Kokaistudios改造设计；其核心是把美术馆放进商场——B3层的chi K11美术馆常年做当代艺术展，公共空间散布艺术藏品与驻场创作，商场因此形成“看展顺便购物”的独特动线。空间形态是垂直艺术商城：地下三层的美术馆与商场中庭连通，中庭挑高，白盒子式展区与商业界面交错，适合做有策展逻辑的品牌叙事；一层临街与B2中庭是快闪的主要位置。库内收录该空间快闪案例11条，代表项目有LINE FRIENDS minini携手国漫IP《时光代理人》联名限时快闪、提摩西小队暖冬物语快闪、ANTONIA 「春日便利店」。案例说明它适合艺术联名与国潮IP的策展型快闪、设计师品牌与买手店的首发、需要美术馆语境的奢侈品牌项目，以及面向年轻女性与文艺客群的内容型活动。交通：地铁1号线黄陂南路站步行约2分钟，13号线淮海中路站亦近。
intro_en: Shanghai K11 Art Mall occupies 300 Middle Huaihai Road in Huangpu District, between the Huaihai Road shopping street and Xintiandi; it is one of the tallest buildings on Huaihai Road and the originator of Shanghai's art-plus-commerce model. Operated by New World Development's K11 brand and opened on 28 June 2013, it has about 38,000 sqm of retail and 70,000 sqm of offices, redesigned by Kokaistudios. Its defining move is putting a museum inside a mall: the chi K11 art museum on B3 stages contemporary exhibitions year-round, artworks and artists' commissions are distributed through the public areas, and the result is an unusual route in which visitors see a show and shop in the same trip. The form is a vertical art mall: the basement museum connects to the atrium, and white-cube exhibition zones interleave with retail frontage, which supports brand storytelling with curatorial logic; the street level and the B2 atrium are the main pop-up positions. Our library holds 11 cases here, including LINE FRIENDS minini with Link Click, the Forbidden City Shang Xin store, Team Timothy's winter story and ANTONIA's Spring Convenience Store. It suits curatorial pop-ups around art collaborations and Chinese IP, designer and multi-brand launches, luxury projects that want a museum context, and content-led activations aimed at young women and arts audiences. Metro Line 1 at South Huangpi Road is about two minutes' walk, with Line 13 at Middle Huaihai Road also nearby.

address: 上海市闵行区吴中路1599号
intro_zh: 上海万象城位于闵行区吴中路1599号，地处吴中路与虹莘路交汇处，是华润置地在上海的首个万象城，也是大虹桥商圈的核心商业体。项目为轨交10号线紫藤路站上盖的TOD综合体，总体量约53万平方米，其中购物中心约24万平方米、超A级写字楼14万平方米，另含酒店与上海地铁博物馆，2017年9月23日开业，开业率高达92%；约400家品牌覆盖潮奢精品、城市与区域首店、亲子与餐饮，是西上海品质消费的标杆。空间形态是超大平层商场加户外街区：室内以多个中庭串联长动线，层高与柱网规整、搭建条件好；室外“有街”是一片约1000平方米的沿街绿地社交场，连续多年做主题场景更新，适合户外装置与市集。库内收录该空间快闪案例11条，代表项目有EP 雅莹「东方之蓝，纹起八方」蓝标当代民族系列限时快闪、HAZZYS｜HAZZYS POLO LOOP 快闪空间（上海）、Lafuma「乐在进行时」95周年快闪。案例说明它适合服饰与户外品牌的主题快闪、亲子与家庭客群的IP活动、区域首店与新品首发，以及可结合户外街区做双场景联动的品牌campaign。交通：地铁10号线紫藤路站上盖，1号口步行约210米、约3分钟。
intro_en: Shanghai MixC occupies 1599 Wuzhong Road in Minhang District, at the junction with Hongxin Road — China Resources Land's first MixC in Shanghai and the anchor of the Greater Hongqiao retail district. It is a TOD complex built above Metro Line 10's Ziteng Road station, totalling about 530,000 sqm: roughly 240,000 sqm of shopping centre, 140,000 sqm of grade-A offices, plus a hotel and the Shanghai Metro Museum. It opened on 23 September 2017 with a 92 per cent opening rate, and some 400 brands span premium fashion, city and regional first stores, family and dining, making it the quality-consumption benchmark for western Shanghai. The form is an oversized single-level mall plus an outdoor street: several atria string together a long circulation, floor heights and column grids are regular and build-friendly, and outside, You Jie is a roughly 1,000 sqm green social strip that has been re-themed year after year and suits installations and markets. Our library holds 11 pop-up cases, including EP Yaying's Blue Label series, HAZZYS Polo Loop, Lafuma's 95th-anniversary joy-in-motion space and JNBY's Terminal pop-up. It suits apparel and outdoor brand pop-ups, family and kids IP events, regional first stores and launches, and campaigns that can pair indoor and outdoor scenes. Metro Line 10's Ziteng Road station is directly beneath, about 210 metres from Exit 1.

address: 上海市杨浦区翔殷路1099号
intro_zh: 合生汇购物中心位于杨浦区翔殷路1099号，处在五角场商圈的核心、黄兴路与翔殷路交汇处，是上海东北片区的商业地标，也是杨浦、虹口、宝山三区客流的主要出口。项目由合生创展开发、美国Callison建筑事务所设计，2016年亮相，综合体体量约36万平方米，其中购物中心约16万平方米，地上六层、地下四层，汇聚超过400家品牌，与地铁10号线五角场站无缝对接；开业十年间稳居上海购物中心热门榜前列，节假日日均客流可达18至20万人次，2024、2025年销售额分别突破63亿元和66亿元，客群以大学生、年轻家庭与周边白领为主。空间形态是垂直大型商场：中庭挑高、楼层环通，B1与地铁站厅直接相连形成“到站即逛”的动线，中庭与各层边厅适合多点位联动的快闪布局。库内收录该空间快闪案例10条，代表项目有POP JOY X  奇先生妙小姐「五彩农场」主题快闪项目、UHA悠哈「城市甜蜜加油站」限时活动、San-X pop-up store。案例说明它适合卡通与治愈系IP的主题店、学生与年轻家庭客群的互动活动、区域首展与巡展站点，以及依靠高客流做转化而非高客单的快消与餐饮联名。交通：地铁10号线五角场站步行约350米、约5分钟，18号线国权路站约1.4公里、约18分钟。
intro_en: Hopson One occupies 1099 Xiangyin Road in Yangpu District, at the heart of the Wujiaochang retail district where Huangxing and Xiangyin roads meet — the commercial landmark of Shanghai's northeast and the main destination for shoppers from Yangpu, Hongkou and Baoshan. Developed by Hopson and designed by Callison, it opened in 2016 as a complex of about 360,000 sqm including roughly 160,000 sqm of mall over six above-ground and four basement levels, with more than 400 brands and a seamless link to Metro Line 10's Wujiaochang station. In its first decade it has stayed near the top of Shanghai mall popularity rankings, drawing 180,000 to 200,000 visitors a day at holiday peaks, with sales passing RMB 6.3 billion in 2024 and 6.6 billion in 2025; its audience is students, young families and nearby office workers. The form is a large vertical mall: tall atria and interconnected floors, with B1 joined directly to the metro concourse so visitors shop the moment they arrive, and atria plus floor-edge halls allow multi-point pop-up layouts. Our library holds 10 cases here, including POP JOY with Mr. Men and Little Miss, a San-X pop-up store, YuY's East China premiere and Miniso's Zootopia 2 pop-up. It suits cartoon and comfort-character IP stores, interactive events for students and young families, regional premieres and tour stops, and FMCG or dining collaborations that rely on volume rather than ticket size. Metro Line 10 at Wujiaochang is about 350 metres away, with Line 18 at Guoquan Road roughly 1.4 kilometres off.

address: 上海市浦东新区世纪大道1192号
intro_zh: 世纪汇广场位于浦东新区世纪大道1192号，处在竹园商贸区、世纪大道商圈核心，东至福山路、南至潍坊路、西至东方路、北至张杨路，世纪大道从南北两个地块之间穿过，是浦东“陆家嘴—世纪大道”黄金走廊上的重要节点。项目由长江实业地产开发，总占地约8.9万平方米、总建筑面积约36万平方米，商场部分2018年6月15日试营业、同年12月8日正式开业；最大优势是交通——世纪大道站2、4、6、9号线四线换乘，工作日日均客流约48万人次，商场通过地下通道与站厅相连，是浦东少有的“通勤客流直接导入”的商业体。空间形态是室内商场加下沉式露天广场：LG层与地铁连通，中庭与多层挑空适合大型装置，室外下沉广场是标志性的开放式空间，可做市集、快闪与演出，形成室内外双场景。库内收录该空间快闪案例10条，代表项目有Handspupu 漫人游园会、韩束&WOW Colour 王嘉尔主题痛楼痛店、泡泡玛特POPMART｜【世纪汇广场】Zsiga慢游世纪汇。案例说明它适合快消与餐饮的联名快闪、粉丝经济与明星主题店、潮玩IP的巡展，以及依赖通勤与家庭客流的体验型活动。交通：地铁2、4、6、9号线世纪大道站11、12号口直达，步行约3分钟。
intro_en: Century Link occupies 1192 Century Avenue in Pudong New Area, in the Zhuyuan business district bounded by Fushan Road to the east, Weifang Road to the south, Dongfang Road to the west and Zhangyang Road to the north, with Century Avenue running between its north and south plots — a key node on Pudong's Lujiazui–Century Avenue corridor. Developed by CK Asset Holdings, it covers about 89,000 sqm with roughly 360,000 sqm of floor area; the mall trial-opened on 15 June 2018 and opened formally on 8 December that year. Its greatest advantage is transport: Metro Century Avenue station interchanges Lines 2, 4, 6 and 9 and handles around 480,000 passengers on a working day, and the mall links to the concourse underground — one of the few Pudong schemes with commuter traffic funnelled directly inside. The form is an indoor mall with a sunken open plaza: the LG level connects to the metro, atria and multi-level voids take large installations, and the outdoor sunken plaza, the project's signature open space, hosts markets, pop-ups and performances, giving two scenes in one site. Our library holds 10 cases here, including McDonald's x Crocs Happy House, Kans and WOW Colour's Jackson Wang-themed store, Pop Mart's Zsiga tour and Proya's Infinite Space. It suits FMCG and dining collaboration pop-ups, fandom and celebrity-themed stores, designer-toy IP tours, and experiential events that draw on commuter and family traffic. Exits 11 and 12 of Century Avenue station on Lines 2, 4, 6 and 9 lead directly in.

address: 上海市长宁区愚园路1208号
intro_zh: sômthin’else另有奇物位于长宁区愚园路1208号，处在愚园路历史风貌街区的西段、靠近定西路，是这条“全球新品首发新地标”街区里最年轻的策展型零售空间之一。作为上海首店，它把买手型百货零售、咖啡与酒、策展式跨界放进同一栋小楼：室内以大面积三原色与高饱和色块营造童话感，室外做出橱窗式的露天座区，并明确宠物友好，营业至22时，日常就有稳定的街区客流与社媒打卡。空间形态是“小而密”的两层店铺加户外院子：单层面积有限，但室内外两个空间可以分别承载陈列与活动，门口巨型扑克牌兔子是天然识别物，适合做需要强视觉记忆点的品牌装置。库内收录该空间快闪案例10条，代表项目有Rockit 乐淇「乐淇时刻，宠爱有礼」限时快闪、森马 SEMIR｜“森马是个什么马” 新年快闪、亚马逊海外购黑五快闪。案例说明它适合快消与零售品牌的联名主题店、生活方式与咖啡酒饮的体验活动、宠物友好与年轻客群的社交型快闪，以及需要街区话题度而非大面积的IP首发。交通：地铁2、11号线江苏路站步行约10分钟，2、3、4号线中山公园站亦在步行范围。
intro_en: sômthin'else occupies 1208 Yuyuan Road in Changning District, in the western stretch of the Yuyuan Road historic streetscape near Dingxi Road — one of the youngest curatorial retail spaces in a block now promoted as a launchpad for new products. As its Shanghai debut, it combines buyer-led department retail, coffee and drinks, and curatorial collaborations in a single small building: inside, broad primary colours and saturated blocks create a storybook feel; outside, window-like open seating faces the street, pets are explicitly welcome, and trading runs to 22:00, so there is steady neighbourhood traffic and social-media attention even on ordinary days. The form is a small, dense two-level shop with a yard: floor plates are limited, but the indoor and outdoor spaces can separately carry display and events, and the oversized playing-card rabbit at the entrance is an instant identifier — useful for brand installations that need a strong visual hook. Our library holds 10 cases here, including Semir's "what horse is Semir" New Year pop-up, Amazon Global Store's Black Friday pop-up, CeraVe x ChaPanda's milk-tea shop, Uniqlo's weave party and Rockit's limited pop-up. It suits co-branded theme stores for FMCG and retail, lifestyle and coffee or drinks experiences, pet-friendly and youth-oriented social pop-ups, and IP debuts that need street buzz rather than floor area. Metro Lines 2 and 11 at Jiangsu Road are about ten minutes' walk, with Lines 2, 3 and 4 at Zhongshan Park also within walking distance.

address: 北京市朝阳区三里屯路19号
intro_zh: 三里屯太古里位于朝阳区三里屯路19号，处在三里屯—工体商圈核心，是太古地产在中国内地首个以零售为主导的综合发展项目，2008年投入运营。项目为开放式街区形态，占地约6万平方米，由多座低层单体建筑组成，分为南区、北区与西区，其中西区由原有雅秀市场改造而来。里巷、连廊和小广场把店铺、外摆与公共艺术串联起来，全天可以步行穿行，夜间氛围尤其突出。周边是工人体育场、使馆区与酒吧街，客群以年轻潮流消费者、外籍人士和到访北京的游客为主，周末与节假日客流集中。本站场地库收录该空间快闪案例107个，代表案例包括52TOYS收藏玩具馆全球首站、Cabana与Maison Margiela限时快闪店、X移动美术馆首站。空间适合潮流服饰与联名首发、潮玩与IP主题展、美妆香氛体验、艺术装置，以及需要街区人流和外摆面积的品牌活动。交通方面，地铁3号线、10号线团结湖站与3号线、17号线工人体育场站均在步行范围内，工人体育场站还设有地下通道连接项目西区。
intro_en: Taikoo Li Sanlitun stands at 19 Sanlitun Road in Chaoyang District, at the centre of the Sanlitun–Workers' Stadium commercial area. It is Swire Properties' first retail-led mixed-use development in mainland China and opened in 2008. The scheme is an open-air district of low-rise buildings on a site of about 60,000 square metres, divided into South, North and West zones, the last converted from the former Yaxiu market. Lanes, covered walkways and small plazas link shops, terraces and public art, so the whole area can be walked through at any hour, with the liveliest atmosphere after dark. It sits beside the Workers' Stadium, the embassy area and the bar street, and its audience is made up of young trend-led shoppers, expatriates and visitors to Beijing, with peaks at weekends and on public holidays. Our venue library records 107 pop-up cases at this location, including the global first stop of the 52TOYS collector toy hall, the Cabana × Maison Margiela pop-up store and the first stop of the X Mobile Art Museum. The space suits fashion drops and collaboration launches, designer toy and IP exhibitions, beauty and fragrance experiences, art installations, and brand activations that need street footfall and outdoor footprint. On transport, Tuanjiehu station on Lines 3 and 10 and Workers' Stadium station on Lines 3 and 17 are both within walking distance, and the latter has an underground passage into the West Zone.

address: 北京市朝阳区建国路87号
intro_zh: 北京SKP位于朝阳区建国路87号，属大望路商圈，处在长安街东延线上，紧邻CBD，坐落在华贸中心建筑群内。商场为高层百货形态，零售楼层垂直分布，国际一线品牌旗舰店与精品店高度集中，公共中庭、楼层通道与主入口广场是品牌做短期呈现的主要位置，橱窗与楼层活动可以串成连续动线。项目与相邻的SKP-S同属华贸片区，两处物业可以形成联动动线。客群以高净值家庭、商务人士和跨城购物客为主，工作日与周末客流都较为稳定。本站场地库收录该空间快闪案例60个，代表案例包括Prada Group Symbole Pop-Up Space、瑞士斯沃琪BIOCERAMIC MoonSwatch系列快闪店、Stuart Weitzman与Disney合作的耀动奇履妙趣放映活动。空间适合奢侈品牌限量首发与新品预览、腕表珠宝巡展、香氛美妆体验、设计师联名系列，也适合需要高端客群与私密接待的品牌活动。交通方面，地铁1号线、14号线大望路站步行可达，周边有华贸中心写字楼、丽思卡尔顿酒店与JW万豪酒店，便于承接商务与媒体场次。
intro_en: Beijing SKP occupies 87 Jianguo Road in Chaoyang District, in the Dawanglu commercial area on the eastern extension of Chang'an Avenue, next to the CBD and within the Huamao Centre complex. The store is a high-rise department store with retail arranged vertically over many floors, and it concentrates flagship and boutique stores of international fashion houses. Its public atriums, floor passages and main entrance plaza are the usual positions for short-term brand presentations, and window displays can be linked with floor-level events into one continuous route. The audience is dominated by affluent families, business people and shoppers who travel across the city, and footfall is fairly steady on both weekdays and weekends. Our venue library records 60 pop-up cases here, including the Prada Group Symbole Pop-Up Space, the Swatch BIOCERAMIC MoonSwatch pop-up store and the Stuart Weitzman × Disney screening event. The space suits limited-edition launches and new-season previews for luxury brands, watch and jewellery travelling exhibitions, fragrance and beauty experiences, designer collaboration collections, and brand activities that rely on a high-end audience and private hospitality. On transport, Dawanglu station on Lines 1 and 14 is within walking distance, and the surrounding Huamao Centre offices, the Ritz-Carlton and the JW Marriott make it convenient to host business and media sessions.

address: 北京市东城区王府井大街269号
intro_zh: 王府中環位于东城区王府井大街269号，坐落于王府井商圈，由香港置地开发，总建筑面积约15万平方米，其中零售面积约5万平方米，并配有74间客房的文华东方酒店。项目东起王府井大街，西至晨光街，北临大阮府胡同，建筑形态沿街展开，室内为多层零售动线，临街立面、内部中庭与连廊构成主要的展示界面，石材立面与周边的胡同肌理相衔接。业态以奢侈品牌、餐饮和文化艺术为主，客群是高端本地消费者、商务客与游客。本站场地库收录该空间快闪案例22个，代表案例包括宝玑Marine航海系列全国巡展北京站、Giorgio Armani la Prima手袋限时店、LIUWEN刘雯与ERDOS联名系列共享工作室限时展。空间适合高级腕表与珠宝巡展、奢侈品牌手袋与成衣限时店、设计师联名与艺术跨界展，也适合配合酒店和餐饮的高端私享活动。交通方面，地铁8号线金鱼胡同站与1号线、8号线王府井站均在步行范围内。
intro_en: WF Central is located at 269 Wangfujing Street in Dongcheng District, inside the Wangfujing commercial area. Developed by Hongkong Land, it has a total floor area of about 150,000 square metres, of which roughly 50,000 square metres is retail, together with a Mandarin Oriental hotel of 74 rooms. The site runs from Wangfujing Street in the east to Chenguang Street in the west and borders Da Ruanfu Hutong to the north. The building follows the street, with multi-level retail inside, while the street-facing elevations, internal atria and connecting galleries form the main display surfaces; the stone facades tie into the surrounding hutong grain. The tenant mix focuses on luxury brands, restaurants and culture, and the audience is made up of affluent local shoppers, business visitors and tourists. Our venue library records 22 pop-up cases here, including the Beijing stop of Breguet's Marine collection national tour, the Giorgio Armani la Prima handbag pop-up store and the LIUWEN × ERDOS collaboration studio exhibition. The space suits fine watch and jewellery tours, luxury handbag and ready-to-wear pop-ups, designer collaborations and art crossover exhibitions, as well as high-end private events that use the hotel and restaurants. On transport, Jinyu Hutong station on Line 8 and Wangfujing station on Lines 1 and 8 are both within walking distance.

address: 北京市朝阳区建国门外大街1号
intro_zh: 国贸商城位于朝阳区建国门外大街1号，地处北京CBD核心，属国贸商圈，是中国国际贸易中心建筑群的商业部分，与国贸写字楼、酒店和公寓连成一体。商城为室内多层形态，由多个楼座组成，楼层之间由中庭、连廊与扶梯串联，品牌店铺沿主动线分布，公共中庭和通道节点适合设置短期展位，形成从入口到中庭的连续曝光。客群以周边金融机构与跨国公司白领、商务差旅人士和高端家庭为主，工作日午间与傍晚下班时段人流明显。本站场地库收录该空间快闪案例14个，代表案例包括Boucheron宝诗龙限时体验空间、1436与JUJUWANG合作的万物有声限时概念展、FENDI 2022冬季胶囊系列限时店。空间适合奢侈珠宝与腕表展示、商务礼品与生活方式品牌、汽车与金融类高端展示，也适合承接工作日白领客流活动。交通方面，地铁1号线与10号线国贸站与商城连通，周边为国贸桥与东三环主干道，出租车与专车落客便利。
intro_en: China World Mall is at 1 Jianguomenwai Avenue in Chaoyang District, at the core of Beijing's CBD. It is the retail component of the China World Trade Center complex and is physically linked to the offices, hotels and apartments there. The mall is an indoor, multi-level scheme made up of several blocks, in which atria, galleries and escalators connect the floors, brand stores line the main circulation routes, and the public atria and passage nodes can take short-term stands, giving continuous exposure from entrance to atrium. Its audience is mainly employees of nearby financial institutions and multinationals, business travellers and affluent families, with clear peaks at lunchtime and after work on weekdays. Our venue library records 14 pop-up cases here, including the Boucheron experience space, the 1436 × JUJUWANG 'All Things Have a Voice' concept exhibition and the FENDI winter 2022 capsule collection pop-up store. The space suits luxury jewellery and watch presentations, corporate gifting and lifestyle brands, high-end automotive and financial displays, and activations aimed at white-collar footfall. The mall also serves guests of the hotels and residents of the apartments within the complex. On transport, Guomao station on Lines 1 and 10 connects with the mall, and the Guomao interchange and East Third Ring Road give easy taxi and chauffeur drop-off.

address: 北京市朝阳区朝阳门外大街12号
intro_zh: THE BOX朝外年轻力中心位于朝阳区朝阳门外大街12号，属朝外商圈，东接CBD、北邻三里屯，由朝阳区政府、URF盈展与昆泰集团合作，以昆泰商城等存量物业改造而成，2023年5月试营业。项目占地约4138平方米，总建筑面积约4.69万平方米，空间形态上体量小而垂直，室内外空间混合，包含开放式广场、屋顶和运动场地，滑板、篮球、音乐等社群活动常在公共区域发生。项目也是朝外大街升级改造一期工程的一部分，沿街公共空间同步更新。开业后项目举办了大量展览、品牌与社群活动，开业首日客流接近八万人次，客群以年轻消费者为主。本站场地库收录该空间快闪案例12个，代表案例包括轩尼诗与NBA合作的限时体验空间、Badmarket「BM大澡堂子」北京站。空间适合潮流服饰与球鞋、运动户外社群、电竞与音乐类IP、青年文化展演，也适合需要广场和户外场地的品牌事件。交通方面，项目位于朝外大街沿线，地铁6号线东大桥站与2号线、6号线朝阳门站分列东西两侧。
intro_en: THE BOX Chaowai Youth Energy Centre is at 12 Chaowai Avenue in Chaoyang District, in the Chaowai commercial area, with the CBD to the east and Sanlitun to the north. It was created by the Chaoyang district government, URF and Kuntai Group through the conversion of existing properties including the Kuntai mall, and began trial operation in May 2023. The site covers about 4,138 square metres with a total floor area of about 46,900 square metres, so the building is small but vertical, mixing indoor and outdoor space and including an open plaza, roofs and sports areas where skateboarding, basketball and music communities regularly gather. After opening, the project hosted a large number of exhibitions, brand and community events, and drew close to 80,000 visitors on its first day; its audience is mainly young consumers. Our venue library records 12 pop-up cases here, including the Hennessy × NBA limited-time experience space and the Beijing stop of Badmarket's 'BM Bathhouse'. The space suits streetwear and sneakers, sports and outdoor communities, esports and music IP, youth culture performances, and brand events that need a plaza or outdoor ground. On transport, the project sits along Chaowai Avenue, with Dongdaqiao station on Line 6 to the west and Chaoyangmen station on Lines 2 and 6 to the east.

address: 北京市朝阳区西大望路21号
intro_zh: 朝阳合生汇位于朝阳区西大望路21号，处在西大望路与广渠路交汇一带，紧邻国贸与华贸，属双井、大望路商圈，是CBD东侧体量较大的购物中心之一。项目总建筑面积约31.7万平方米，商业面积近20万平方米，定位为集购物、餐饮、娱乐、休闲与儿童体验于一体的生活体验型购物中心，空间形态以室内为主，中庭开阔，楼层动线围绕主力店与主题街区展开，公共中庭和通道适合搭建临时展位与装置。客群以周边居住家庭、CBD白领和年轻消费者为主，周末家庭客流明显。本站场地库收录该空间快闪案例10个，代表案例包括怡达「酸甜相遇」限时快闪店、快手磁力引擎「好市来了」新春快闪店、M.latin马拉丁与芝麻街联名限时快闪。空间适合食品饮料促销、互联网平台线下活动、亲子与儿童IP、大众消费品路演，也适合需要大面积室内场地的品牌活动。交通方面，地铁7号线与14号线九龙山站与商场直接连通，西大望路、广渠路两条主干道在附近交汇。
intro_en: Chaoyang Hopson One is at 21 West Dawang Road in Chaoyang District, near the junction of West Dawang Road and Guangqu Road, close to Guomao and Huamao in the Shuangjing–Dawanglu commercial area, and is one of the larger malls on the eastern side of the CBD. The project has a total floor area of about 317,000 square metres, of which close to 200,000 square metres is commercial, and it is positioned as a lifestyle mall combining shopping, dining, entertainment, leisure and children's experiences. It is mainly indoor, with generous atria, and the floor routes are organised around anchor stores and themed zones, while the public atria and passages can take temporary stands and installations. Its audience is mainly local families, CBD office workers and younger shoppers, with clear family traffic at weekends. Our venue library records 10 pop-up cases here, including the Yida 'Sour Meets Sweet' pop-up store, Kuaishou's 'Good Market Is Here' Chinese New Year pop-up and the M.latin × Sesame Street pop-up. The space suits food and beverage promotions, offline campaigns for internet platforms, family and children's IP, mass-market consumer roadshows, and brand events that need a large indoor floor. On transport, Jiulongshan station on Lines 7 and 14 is directly connected to the mall, and West Dawang Road and Guangqu Road meet nearby.

address: 广东省广州市天河区林和街道华新社区天河路383号
intro_zh: 广州太古汇位于广州市天河区天河路383号，地处天河中央商务区与天河路商圈的核心，与汇坊一街相望，是广州高端商业的代表项目。项目由太古地产开发并管理（太古地产持股97%、广州日报报业集团3%），2011年9月23日开业，总楼面面积约35.8万平方米，其中购物商场约13.8万平方米，另有超过16万平方米的两座甲级写字楼、约6万平方米的广州文华东方酒店与约5.8万平方米的文化中心，由Arquitectonica设计。商场为多层室内空间，中庭、螺旋楼梯、空中花园与方所书店构成多个可搭建的节点；2024年太古汇投得相连的天河路387号101房（广州文化中心），翻新后将成为商场新增部分，预计2026年完成。本库收录该空间快闪案例38条，案例以时装鞋履（23条）为主，酒精饮品（5条）与珠宝腕表（3条）为辅，轩尼诗、CURIEL、泡泡玛特、Roger Vivier、卡诗、宇舶表、罗意威、TOD'S、浪琴、HOKA、FILA、索康尼等品牌均有记录，代表案例包括梵克雅宝「Perlée」限时体验空间、MISS SIXTY 35周年「波普之心」与轩尼诗新春快闪空间。空间适合高级时装与珠宝腕表、酒类与新春礼赠、运动户外，以及艺术装置与品牌首展。交通方面，地铁3号线石牌桥站M层与商场无缝连通。
intro_en: Taikoo Hui Guangzhou occupies 383 Tianhe Road in Tianhe District, at the heart of the Tianhe CBD and the Tianhe Road retail district, across the street from Hui Fang. It is Guangzhou's benchmark premium commercial address. Developed and managed by Swire Properties (97%, with Guangzhou Daily Group holding 3%), it opened on 23 September 2011 with about 358,000 sqm of gross floor area. That comprises roughly 138,000 sqm of shopping mall, more than 160,000 sqm in two grade-A office towers, about 60,000 sqm for the Mandarin Oriental Guangzhou and some 58,000 sqm of cultural centre, designed by Arquitectonica. The mall is a multi-level indoor space where the atrium, spiral staircase, sky garden and Fang Suo bookstore create several buildable nodes. In 2024 Taikoo Hui acquired the adjoining unit at 387 Tianhe Road (Guangzhou Cultural Centre); after renovation it will extend the mall, with completion expected in 2026. Our library holds 38 pop-up cases here, led by apparel and footwear (23), followed by alcoholic drinks (5) and jewellery and watches (3). Hennessy, CURIEL, Pop Mart, Roger Vivier, Kérastase, Hublot, Loewe, TOD'S, Longines, HOKA, FILA and Saucony all appear. Representative cases include Van Cleef & Arpels' “Perlée” experience space, MISS SIXTY's 35th-anniversary “Pop Heart” and Hennessy's Chinese New Year pop-up. It suits couture and jewellery, drinks and festive gifting, outdoor sportswear, and art installations or brand premieres. Metro Line 3 connects directly to the mall at Shipaiqiao station via level M.

address: 广州市天河区天河路218号天环广场
intro_zh: 天环广场位于广州市天河区天河路218号，坐落在天河路商圈核心、天河中央商务区中轴，与正佳广场、天河城相邻，是广州少见的低层公园式购物中心。项目由新鸿基地产开发，2016年3月26日开业，总楼面面积约11万平方米，其中地上建筑面积约2万平方米、地下约9万平方米，地上2层、地下3层，建筑高度约24米；设计以中国文化中象征和谐与财富的鲤鱼为概念，不锈钢硬壳屋顶形似两条游动的鱼，双鱼体量环绕中央花园展开，主要商业面积置于地下，地面留出绿化、广场与开放空间。本库收录该空间快闪案例32条，案例以服装鞋履（8条）、护肤（7条）与彩妆（7条）为主，亚瑟士、资生堂、希思黎、Valentino、YSL、NARS、兰蔻、娇兰、海蓝之谜、宝格丽、无畏契约、喜茶等品牌均有记录，代表案例包括YSL BEAUTY 610冰室限时快闪、EVELOM「植愈谧境」艺术快闪与潮宏基IP联盟星球快闪。空间适合美妆护肤与彩妆首发、潮流运动、艺术联名展，以及中央花园与下沉广场的户外活动。交通方面，地铁1号线、3号线体育西路站与APM线天河南站均可连接，天河路BRT亦在步行范围。
intro_en: Parc Central occupies 218 Tianhe Road in Tianhe District, at the core of the Tianhe Road retail district and on the central axis of the Tianhe CBD, next to Grandview Mall and Teemall. It is one of Guangzhou's rare low-rise, park-style shopping centres. Developed by Sun Hung Kai Properties and opened on 26 March 2016, it has about 110,000 sqm of gross floor area — roughly 20,000 sqm above ground and 90,000 sqm below — arranged over two above-ground and three basement levels, with a height of about 24 metres. The design takes the carp, a Chinese symbol of harmony and wealth, as its concept: a stainless-steel shell roof resembles two swimming fish, and the twin volumes wrap around a central garden, with most retail placed underground and the surface left as planting, plazas and open space. Our library holds 32 pop-up cases here, led by apparel and footwear (8), skincare (7) and colour cosmetics (7). ASICS, Shiseido, Sisley, Valentino, YSL, NARS, Lancôme, Guerlain, La Mer, Bvlgari, Valorant and Heytea all appear. Representative cases include YSL Beauty's 610 Ice Parlour, EVELOM's “Plant Healing Sanctuary” art pop-up and CHJ's IP Golo Land. It suits beauty and cosmetics launches, trend sports, art collaborations, and outdoor events in the central garden and sunken plaza. Metro Lines 1 and 3 at Tiyu Xilu station and the APM line at Tianhe South station both connect, with the Tianhe Road BRT within walking distance.

address: 广州市越秀区中山一路附近
intro_zh: 东山口位于广州市越秀区中山一路一带，属东山口商圈，核心是广州首批历史文化保护区之一的新河浦历史文化街区，这里保留约493栋民国时期的中西合璧红砖洋楼，曾是华侨、富商与政要的聚居地，也是“东山少爷”文化的发源地。它不是单一商场，而是一片开放的街区：庙前西街、启明社区、龟岗社区与一方东山文创园串联起买手店、独立咖啡、艺术空间与民宿；一方东山由原广东省商业厅办公楼改造，2024年入选广州市首批32个首发空间，KANGOL、UNDEFEATED、观夏葵园等品牌进驻，街区也获评省级特色步行街。快闪在这里通常落在洋房首层、骑楼转角、园区中庭或街角空地，尺度小、叙事强、与社区动线共融。本库收录该空间快闪案例19条，案例以服装鞋履（5条）、护肤（4条）与快消（3条）为主，汽车与3C跨界案例是特色，抖音、屈臣氏、Vans、华为、比亚迪、Levi's、梅赛德斯-奔驰、The Ordinary等品牌均有记录，代表案例包括The Ordinary Playground功效护肤游乐场、奔驰纯电CLA「星动城市派对」与周生生 x 庙前冰室「圆满正当时」。空间适合街区型快闪与慢闪、洋房与骑楼空间改造、汽车与3C跨界体验、潮牌与咖啡联名。交通方面，地铁1号线、6号线东山口站出站即进入街区。
intro_en: Dongshankou lies around Zhongshan First Road in Yuexiu District, Guangzhou. Its core is the Xinhepu historic and cultural quarter, one of the city's first protected historic areas, where about 493 Republican-era red-brick villas blend Chinese and Western styles. It was home to overseas Chinese, merchants and officials, and is the birthplace of the “Dongshan young masters” culture. This is not a single mall but an open block: Miaoqian West Street, Qiming and Guigang neighbourhoods, and the Yifang Dongshan creative park link concept stores, independent cafés, art spaces and guesthouses. Yifang Dongshan, converted from the former Guangdong Department of Commerce office building, was named one of Guangzhou's first 32 launch spaces in 2024 and hosts brands such as KANGOL, UNDEFEATED and Guanxia's Kuiyuan store; the district has also been designated a provincial-level characteristic pedestrian street. Pop-ups here usually occupy a villa's ground floor, a colonnade corner, a park courtyard or a street-side lot — small in scale, strong in narrative and woven into the neighbourhood's daily flows. Our library holds 19 pop-up cases here, led by apparel and footwear (5), skincare (4) and FMCG (3), with notable crossovers from automotive and consumer tech. Douyin, Watsons, Vans, Huawei, BYD, Levi's, Mercedes-Benz and The Ordinary all appear. Representative cases include The Ordinary Playground, Mercedes-Benz's all-electric CLA “Star City Party” and Chow Sang Sang with Hope & Sesame. It suits block-level pop-ups and slow pop-ups, villa and colonnade conversions, automotive and tech crossover experiences, and streetwear or coffee collaborations. Metro Lines 1 and 6 surface at Dongshankou station directly into the district.

address: 广州市天河区天河路228号正佳广场
intro_zh: 正佳广场位于广州市天河区天河路228号，处在天河路与体育东路交汇处，是天河路商圈体量最大的单体项目之一，毗邻天环广场与天河城。项目由正佳集团开发，2005年1月15日开业，总建筑面积42万平方米，其中购物中心约30万平方米，地上7层、地下2层半，另含酒店与写字楼；它也是全国少数坐落于商场内的国家AAAA级旅游景区，场内垂直分布极地海洋世界、正佳大剧院、自然博物馆等文旅业态，年客流超过5500万人次，形成“商业+文旅”的复合客群。空间为大进深、多层室内mall，中庭与各层公共区域可承载大型美陈与路演，文旅场馆自带停留时长。本库收录该空间快闪案例16条，案例以快速消费品（5条）与护肤护理（4条）为主，娱乐文化、餐饮与汽车各有点位，卡诗、雷克萨斯、妮维雅等品牌均有记录，代表案例包括卡诗「鱼子秀发浓愈之旅」限时快闪、敷尔佳「春日循光 Yi键臻白」巡回快闪店与万威客「美味灵感 不止一味」美食派对。空间适合家庭亲子与文旅型快闪、美妆快消、餐饮体验与中庭大型路演。交通方面，地铁1号线体育中心站有地下行人隧道连接正佳广场，体育西路站亦在步行范围。
intro_en: Grandview Mall occupies 228 Tianhe Road in Tianhe District, at the junction with Tiyu East Road, one of the largest single schemes in the Tianhe Road retail district and next to Parc Central and Teemall. Developed by Grandview Group and opened on 15 January 2005, it has 420,000 sqm of gross floor area, of which about 300,000 sqm is retail over seven above-ground and two-and-a-half basement levels, plus a hotel and offices. It is one of the few national AAAA-rated tourist attractions located inside a shopping mall, with the Polar Ocean World, Grandview Theatre and a natural history museum stacked vertically through the building. Annual footfall exceeds 55 million, creating a mixed retail-and-tourism audience. The form is a deep, multi-level indoor mall whose atria and public floors can carry large-scale festive displays and roadshows, while the attractions extend dwell time. Our library holds 16 pop-up cases here, led by FMCG (5) and skincare (4), with entertainment and culture, dining and automotive also represented. Kérastase, Lexus and Nivea all appear. Representative cases include Kérastase's “Caviar Hair Healing Journey”, Voolga's “Spring Light” touring pop-up and Maverick's “More Than One Taste” food party. It suits family and tourism-led pop-ups, beauty and FMCG, food experiences and large atrium roadshows. Metro Line 1 connects to Grandview Mall via an underground pedestrian tunnel from Tianhe Sports Center station, with Tiyu Xilu station also within walking distance.

address: 四川省成都市锦江区中纱帽街8号
intro_zh: 成都太古里位于锦江区中纱帽街8号，处在大慈寺路、纱帽街、东大街与春熙路合围的街区，是春熙路—大慈寺商圈的核心。项目2014年10月31日开放体验、2015年4月24日正式开业，由太古地产与远洋地产合作开发，2023年更名为成都太古里，总楼面面积逾12万平方米，布局30座2至3层独栋商铺，以“快里”“慢里”两组街巷围绕千年古刹大慈寺展开，保留广东会馆、欣庐、字库塔等六处历史建筑，并布置21处公共艺术装置。空间为开放式、低密度街区，街巷宽7至13米、建筑限高18米，二层连廊与下沉广场把室内外连成一体，适合搭建户外快闪、品牌限时精品店、艺术装置与发布活动；单栋店铺与广场也便于做封闭式沉浸空间。本库收录该空间101个快闪案例，为成都最多，代表案例包括BOSS X PEANUTS联名系列限时体验店、Nike x Jacquemus成都远洋太古里快闪店、Burberry TB夏季专属标识系列限时精品店。交通方面，综合体与地铁2号线、3号线换乘站春熙路站直接连通，地下设有停车位。
intro_en: Taikoo Li Chengdu occupies a full block at 8 Zhongshamao Street in Jinjiang District, bounded by Daci Temple Road, Shamao Street, Dongda Street and Chunxi Road, at the heart of the Chunxi Road–Daci Temple retail district. Developed by Swire Properties with Sino-Ocean and renamed Taikoo Li Chengdu in 2023, it opened for trial in October 2014 and officially in April 2015. The scheme has more than 120,000 sqm of gross floor area arranged as 30 low-rise buildings of two to three storeys, split into the “Fast Lane” and “Slow Lane” around the 1,400-year-old Daci Temple. Six heritage buildings, including the Guangdong Guild Hall, Xinlu and the Ziku Pagoda, are retained, and 21 public artworks are placed through the lanes. The open, low-density form — lanes 7–13 m wide, buildings capped at 18 m, with upper-level walkways and sunken plazas, and the underground mall draws daylight through skylights — suits outdoor pop-ups, brand concept stores, installations and launch events, while individual houses can be closed for immersive builds. Our library holds 101 pop-up cases here, the most in Chengdu, including BOSS x PEANUTS, Nike x Jacquemus and Burberry's TB summer monogram boutique. Metro Lines 2 and 3 connect directly to Chunxi Road station, and parking is available underground.

address: 成都市成华区双庆路8号
intro_zh: 成都万象城位于成华区双庆路8号，处在双庆路与二环路东三段交汇处，属成华区“万象城商圈”，距市中心约4.5公里，是成都城东体量最大的商业综合体。项目为华润二十四城的商业部分，一期于2012年5月11日开业，二期于2020年12月5日开业，总占地160亩、总建筑面积约72万平方米，由四座购物中心、一座酒店、两栋写字楼和一个中心广场组成，引入超过620家品牌。空间采用美国Callison事务所设计的退台式布局，盒子式购物中心之间以连廊、中庭和中心广场串联，室内中庭开阔，室外广场可承载大型装置与路演，适合美妆香氛、汽车、时装、运动潮流与生活方式品牌做大型快闪、主题展和首发活动。本库收录该空间75个快闪案例，代表案例包括凯旋1664 L’ATELIER巴黎艺墅（成都站）、竹编文化X时装秀场“无界·竹迹”秋冬文化时装周、RE'VAN时空社区POP-UP。交通方面，地铁4号线万年场站位于双福二路与双成三路交叉口，出站步行即达；二环路快速公交与双庆路公交构成地面到达网络。
intro_en: Chengdu MixC is at 8 Shuangqing Road in Chenghua District, at the junction with the East 3rd Section of the Second Ring Road, in the district's “MixC retail zone” about 4.5 km from the city centre; it is the largest commercial complex in eastern Chengdu. The retail component of China Resources' Twenty-Four City, it opened in two phases — phase one on 11 May 2012 and phase two on 5 December 2020 — on a 160-mu site with about 720,000 sqm of gross floor area, comprising four shopping centres, a hotel, two office towers and a central plaza, with more than 620 brands. Callison designed the terraced layout; the box malls are linked by bridges, atriums and the central plaza, giving tall indoor volumes and generous outdoor space that can carry large installations and roadshows. It suits large-format pop-ups, themed exhibitions and launch events for beauty and fragrance, automotive, fashion, sportswear and lifestyle brands. Our library holds 75 pop-up cases here, including Kronenbourg 1664 L'Atelier, the “Boundless Bamboo” autumn/winter culture fashion show and RE'VAN's Time-Space Community pop-up. Metro Line 4 Wannianchang station, at Shuangfu 2nd Road and Shuangcheng 3rd Road, is a short walk away, with bus access along the Second Ring Road and Shuangqing Road.

name_zh: 红星路广场春熙路步行街
address: 成都市锦江区春熙路（红星路广场）
intro_zh: 红星路广场与春熙路步行街位于锦江区春熙路片区，是成都历史最久、客流最集中的城市级商圈核心。春熙路于1924年由四川督理杨森主持修建，由春熙东、西、南、北四条步行街组成，交叉口的中山广场面积近10亩，立有孙中山铜像；广义的春熙路商圈指总府路以南、上东大街以北、红星路以西、盐市口以东约0.4平方公里的范围。红星路广场是红星路三段下穿隧道上盖的步行广场，与IFS、太古里隔街相望，形成“广场+步行街”的连续开放空间，无顶棚、进深大、可视面广，适合搭建大型户外快闪店、汽车路演、装置艺术与城市级事件营销，但落地需按城管与商圈管理方要求报批。本库收录该空间53个快闪案例，代表案例有MG5天蝎座×小红书REDay限时快闪店、梅赛德斯-EQ全新EQE极感唤醒空间、植村秀“炙烈舞台”限时快闪。交通上，地铁2号线、3号线在春熙路站换乘，站点位于红星路步行街地下，出站即达广场与步行街。
intro_en: Hongxing Road Plaza and the Chunxi Road pedestrian street form the core of Chengdu's oldest and busiest city-level retail district in Jinjiang District. Chunxi Road was laid out in 1924 under warlord Yang Sen as four pedestrian streets — east, west, south and north — meeting at Zhongshan Square, a plaza of nearly one hectare with a bronze statue of Sun Yat-sen. The wider Chunxi Road district covers about 0.4 square kilometres bounded by Zongfu Road to the north, Shangdong Street to the south, Hongxing Road to the west and Yanshikou to the east. Hongxing Road Plaza is the pedestrian deck built over the Hongxing Road Section 3 underpass, facing IFS and Taikoo Li across the street. Together they form a continuous open “plaza plus pedestrian street” space: no roof, deep frontage and long sight lines, suited to large outdoor pop-up stores, car roadshows, installations and city-scale events, subject to municipal approvals, and the IFS and Taikoo Li facades often serve as a backdrop for seasonal installations. Our library records 53 pop-up cases here, including the MG5 Scorpio x Xiaohongshu REDay pop-up, the Mercedes-EQ EQE sensory space and Shu Uemura's “Blazing Stage” pop-up. Metro Lines 2 and 3 interchange at Chunxi Road station, whose entrances open directly onto the plaza and the pedestrian streets.

address: 成都市锦江区红星路三段1号
intro_zh: 成都IFS国际金融中心位于锦江区红星路三段1号，处在春熙路—红星路商圈核心，与太古里隔街相望，是九龙仓集团在成都的旗舰城市综合体。项目总建筑面积76万平方米，由两座248米、50层的超甲级写字楼、一座8层、21万平方米的购物中心、尼依格罗酒店和服务式公寓组成，购物中心于2014年1月14日开业，造价约170亿元，设约1700个停车位。空间为盒子式高端购物中心，商业裙楼沿红星路形成530米长的临街界面，主入口以跨三层扶梯把客流引向高层，7层有超过1万平方米的开放屋顶花园，外墙上劳伦斯·阿金特创作的13米高熊猫雕塑“I am Here”是成都地标。室内中庭、主入口与屋顶花园适合奢侈品限时店、美妆香氛快闪、艺术展与品牌发布。本库收录该空间42个快闪案例，代表案例包括TEAM WANG design“MUDANCE”限时概念空间、CLOT X CONVERSE期间快闪店、成都IFS神秘站台快闪。交通方面，购物中心地下一层与二层之间的夹层直接通往地铁2号线、3号线换乘站春熙路站。
intro_en: Chengdu IFS stands at 1 Hongxing Road Section 3 in Jinjiang District, at the core of the Chunxi Road–Hongxing Road district and across the street from Taikoo Li; it is Wharf Holdings' flagship complex in the city. Total gross floor area is 760,000 sqm, made up of two 248-metre, 50-storey grade-A office towers, an eight-level, 210,000 sqm shopping mall, the Niccolo hotel and serviced apartments. The mall opened on 14 January 2014 at a cost of about RMB 17 billion and provides some 1,700 parking spaces. The podium forms a 530-metre luxury frontage along Hongxing Road; the main entrance uses escalators spanning three levels to draw visitors upward, level 7 holds more than 10,000 sqm of open roof garden, and Lawrence Argent's 13-metre panda sculpture “I am Here” on the facade has become a city landmark. The atriums, main entrance and roof garden suit luxury pop-ups, beauty and fragrance activations, art exhibitions and brand launches. Our library records 42 pop-up cases, including TEAM WANG design's “MUDANCE” concept space, the CLOT x Converse pop-up and the IFS “Mystery Platform” pop-up. The mall houses nearly 300 shops, anchored by Lane Crawford. A mezzanine between basement levels 1 and 2 connects directly to Chunxi Road station on Metro Lines 2 and 3.

address: 成都市成华区建设南支路4号
intro_zh: 东郊记忆位于成华区建设南支路4号，处在成都东郊老工业区、今天的建设路—东郊文创板块。园区前身是1958年始建的成都国营红光电子管厂，我国第一支黑白显像管在此研制成功，工厂于2001年关停；2009年成都传媒集团按“修旧如旧、旧房新用”改造，2011年开园运营，建筑面积约20万平方米，保留70余米高的烟囱、管道、红砖厂房与高大树木，建有近30个大小演艺空间，是国家音乐产业基地、国家文化产业示范基地和国家4A级旅游景区，也以成都国际时尚产业园的名义运营，夜间有光影秀投在老厂房外立面上。空间为开放式工业遗存园区，中央大道、火车头广场与厂房形成大尺度室内外组合，适合大型装置、品牌主题展、音乐演出、潮流市集与沉浸式快闪。本库收录该空间30个快闪案例，代表案例包括instax博物馆（成都）、MAC“大子弹头”全新快闪空间、阿里巴巴1688“穷开心乐园”品牌升级快闪。交通方面，地铁8号线东郊记忆站B1口出站步行约500米可达园区。
intro_en: Dongjiao Memory stands at 4 Jianshe Nanzhi Road in Chenghua District, in Chengdu's former eastern industrial belt and today's Jianshe Road–Dongjiao creative quarter. The site was the state-run Hongguang Electron Tube Factory, founded in 1958, where China's first black-and-white picture tube was developed; production stopped in 2001. Chengdu Media Group began the “repair as before, reuse the old buildings” conversion in 2009 and the park opened in 2011. It offers about 200,000 sqm of floor area, a chimney more than 70 metres tall, pipes, red-brick workshops and mature trees, and contains nearly 30 performance venues of different sizes. It is a National Music Industry Base, a National Cultural Industry Demonstration Base and a national 4A tourist attraction, and also operates as the Chengdu International Fashion Industrial Park, projecting light shows onto the old facades at night. The open industrial layout — Central Avenue, the locomotive plaza and the old workshops — supports large installations, themed brand exhibitions, concerts, markets and immersive pop-ups. Our library holds 30 pop-up cases here, including the instax museum, MAC's “Big Bullet” pop-up and Alibaba 1688's “Poor Happy Land” brand-upgrade pop-up. Metro Line 8 Dongjiao Memory station, exit B1, is about 500 metres on foot from the main gate.

address: 成都市锦江区大业路6号
intro_zh: COSMO成都位于锦江区大业路6号，处在盐市口商圈、紧邻春熙路商圈西侧，是成都市中心年轻潮流消费的代表项目。项目前身为2007年开业的上普财富中心，历经三年改造后于2022年底亮相，商业体量约5万平方米，共4层，按体验区与商业区6:4的比例组织，一层为L型动线以最大化店铺展示面；室内保留粗粝裸露的钢筋水泥、黑白灰基调与大面积涂鸦喷绘，灯光带有科幻感，公共空间留白较多，形成类地下通道的开阔场域。定位以“品牌+主理人”为核心，聚集青年文化、生活美学、潮流时尚与艺术超市，首店和城市旗舰店比例高，适合潮牌与设计师品牌快闪、二次元与社群活动、艺术展览、新品发布及市集。本库收录该空间18个快闪案例，代表案例有凡德罗·Etwo机库城市会客厅快闪店、YVMIN X CLAP_Chengdu合作限时POP-UP“乐园Paradise”、Ocai X Ann Andelman粉色概念空间。交通上，地铁1号线锦江宾馆站与1、2号线天府广场站均在步行范围内，大业路连接东大街与人民南路。
intro_en: COSMO Chengdu at 6 Daye Road, Jinjiang District, sits in the Yanshikou retail area immediately west of the Chunxi Road district, and is one of central Chengdu's defining youth-culture malls. It occupies the former Shangpu Wealth Centre, which opened in 2007; after a three-year conversion it relaunched at the end of 2022 with about 50,000 sqm of commercial space over four floors, arranged at a 6:4 ratio of experience to retail. The ground floor uses an L-shaped circulation to maximise shop frontage, while the interior keeps exposed concrete and steel, a black-white-grey palette, large graffiti murals and sci-fi-inflected lighting, with generous blank space that reads like an open underground passage. Its “brands plus owner-designers” positioning brings together youth culture, lifestyle, street fashion and an art supermarket, with a high share of first stores and city flagships — well suited to streetwear and designer pop-ups, anime and community events, art shows, launches and markets. Our library records 18 pop-up cases, including Vandro's Etwo hangar city lounge, YVMIN x CLAP_Chengdu's “Paradise” pop-up and Ocai x Ann Andelman's pink concept space. At about 50,000 sqm it is one of the larger conversion projects in the old city core. Metro Line 1 Jinjiang Hotel station and Lines 1/2 Tianfu Square station are both within walking distance.

address: 成都市锦江区南糠市街与东大街下东大街段交叉路口往北约50米（晶融汇购物中心）
intro_zh: 晶融汇购物中心位于锦江区南糠市街与东大街下东大街段交叉口以北，处在春熙路—大慈寺商圈东南侧，北接成都太古里、西北方向即成都IFS，是商圈内体量中等、更偏年轻潮流的存量改造项目。项目2007年开业、2012年整体竣工，总建筑面积约17万平方米，由购物中心、甲级办公楼、住宅与商务公寓组成；2020年9月至12月完成改造，同年12月18日以“倒拐，还有”为主题重开，带来100多个全新品牌和20余家西南及成都首店，并开放川西文化美食街区“蓉巷子”。空间为多层盒子式购物中心，改造后把部分外立面交给品牌与设计师共同打造，中庭与临街界面成为快闪的主要载体，适合设计师品牌、美妆香氛、生活方式与餐饮跨界的限时店、展览和社群活动。本库收录该空间11个快闪案例，代表案例包括delicates“热浪计划双城记”、Rouje x LOOKNOW盛夏南法假日快闪店、养生堂 X 泉源堂“母亲节”限定映画馆。交通方面，地铁2号线、3号线春熙路站步行约300米可达，东大街一侧公交线路密集。
intro_en: Jingronghui Shopping Centre stands north of the junction of Nankangshi Street and Xia Dongda Street in Jinjiang District, on the south-eastern edge of the Chunxi Road–Daci Temple district, next to Taikoo Li and a short walk from IFS. Opened in 2007 and completed as a complex in 2012, it has about 170,000 sqm of gross floor area combining retail, grade-A offices, residences and serviced apartments. A renovation carried out between September and December 2020 reopened on 18 December 2020 under the slogan “Turn the corner, there's more”, bringing more than 100 new brands, over 20 first stores for Chengdu and south-west China, and the “Rong Xiangzi” Sichuan food lane. The offices and apartments above the mall also bring steady weekday footfall beyond shopping. The multi-level box mall hands parts of its facade to brands and designers, while its atrium and street frontage host most activations — suitable for designer labels, beauty and fragrance, lifestyle and food-collaboration pop-ups, exhibitions and community events. Our library holds 11 pop-up cases, including delicates' “Heatwave Plan”, Rouje x LOOKNOW's French Riviera summer pop-up and the Health&Tang x Quanyuantang Mother's Day picture house. Chunxi Road station on Metro Lines 2 and 3 is about 300 metres away.

address: 广东省深圳市南山区粤海街道大冲社区深南大道9668号
intro_zh: 万象天地位于深圳市南山区深南大道9668号，坐落在南山科技园商圈、华润城城市综合体之内，前身是大冲村旧改项目，由华润置地开发，2017年9月27日开业，是华润在深圳打造的第二座万象系商业。项目总体量约23万平方米，由室内购物中心与开放式街区两部分组成，沿时尚高街排布12座独栋旗舰店，串联近300家店铺与逾1000个品牌，并保留了大王古庙、郑氏宗祠与古榕树，形成深圳少见的低层高密度“街区+盒子”形态。本库收录该空间快闪案例154条，是本库中深圳快闪案例最多的场地，案例以时装鞋履（55条）、香水（20条）、彩妆（20条）与护肤（17条）为主，代表案例包括海蓝之谜「深海奇迹夜境」华南独展、HR赫莲娜小露珠「好状态」嘉年华与CASETiFY「Hello Kitty 爆闪甜心街」。空间适合国际美妆香氛首发、时装与设计师品牌限时店、咖啡与生活方式主题街区，以及需要独栋门面的大型IP装置。交通方面，地铁1号线高新园站与项目无缝接驳，深南大道、沙河西路自驾可达。
intro_en: MixC World stands at 9668 Shennan Avenue in Nanshan District, inside the Huarun City complex in the Nanshan technology district and on the site of the former Dachong village redevelopment. Developed by China Resources Land and opened on 27 September 2017, it is the group's second MixC-series project in Shenzhen. The scheme covers about 230,000 sqm in two parts — an indoor mall and an open-air block — with twelve standalone flagship houses along a high street, nearly 300 shops and more than 1,000 brands, alongside three retained heritage elements: the Dawang temple, the Zheng ancestral hall and an old banyan tree. The result is an unusually low-rise, high-density “blocks plus box” form for Shenzhen. Our library holds 154 pop-up cases here, the highest count for any Shenzhen venue in our records; apparel and footwear account for 55, fragrance 20, colour cosmetics 20 and skincare 17. Representative cases include La Mer's “Deep Sea Miracle Night” south-China exclusive, HR's Little Dew “Good State” carnival and CASETiFY's Hello Kitty sweet street. It suits international beauty and fragrance launches, fashion and designer temporary stores, coffee and lifestyle concepts, and large IP installations that need a standalone facade. Metro Line 1 connects directly at Gaoxinyuan station, and the site is reached by car from Shennan Avenue and Shahe West Road.

address: 深圳市罗湖区宝安南路1881号
intro_zh: 罗湖万象城位于深圳市罗湖区宝安南路1881号，地处蔡屋围国际高端消费街区，是罗湖核心商圈的地标项目，周边聚集地王大厦、京基100等写字楼与老牌酒店。项目由华润置地开发，2004年12月9日开业，是华润第一座万象城，也被视作中国内地早期真正意义上的购物中心之一；商场面积18.8万平方米，共6层，属于深圳华润中心一期，同期建有29层甲级写字楼，二期则包含君悦酒店与住宅幸福里。空间为封闭式多层室内mall，中庭与入口旗舰店形成清晰的品牌展示面，适合搭建高规格的封闭式展陈。本库收录该空间快闪案例64条，案例以时装鞋履（27条）与珠宝钟表（17条）为两大主力，宝玑、宝格丽、宝珀、伯爵、泰格豪雅、CHAUMET、欧米茄、周大福等品牌均有记录，代表案例包括CURIEL蔻蕊传世廓影展、凯乐石FUGA「防滑实验室」全国快闪首展与LA PRAIRIE「瑞士冰川」沉浸式感官体验展。空间适合高级珠宝腕表展、奢侈品牌限时精品店、高级时装与高定护肤体验。交通方面，地铁1号线、2号线大剧院站与商场直接连接。
intro_en: The MixC in Luohu occupies 1881 Bao'an South Road in Luohu District, at the heart of the Caiwuwei international premium retail quarter and within Luohu's core commercial district, surrounded by office towers such as Diwang Building and KK100 and a cluster of established hotels. Developed by China Resources Land and opened on 9 December 2004, it was the group's first MixC and is regarded as one of mainland China's earliest true shopping centres. The mall covers 188,000 sqm over six levels and forms phase one of Shenzhen China Resources Centre, with a 29-storey grade-A office tower; phase two added the Grand Hyatt hotel and the Xingfuli residences. It is an enclosed multi-level mall whose atria and entrance flagships give brands clear frontage for high-specification, closed-door presentations. Our library holds 64 pop-up cases here, led by apparel and footwear (27) and jewellery and watches (17); Breguet, Bvlgari, Blancpain, Piaget, TAG Heuer, Chaumet, Omega and Chow Tai Fook all appear. Representative cases include CURIEL's heritage silhouette exhibition, Kailas FUGA's national first “Grip Lab” and La Prairie's “Swiss Glacier” immersive sensory exhibition. It suits fine jewellery and watch exhibitions, luxury temporary boutiques, couture and premium skincare experiences. Metro Lines 1 and 2 connect directly at Grand Theater station, and the surrounding Caiwuwei blocks bring a steady office and hotel audience.

address: 广东省深圳市南山区粤海街道海珠社区科苑南路2888号
intro_zh: 深圳湾万象城位于深圳市南山区科苑南路2888号，地处后海—深圳湾商圈，处在后海金融总部基地、深圳湾超级总部基地与高新园总部基地三大经济圈的交汇处，周边为中国华润大厦“春笋”、深圳湾体育中心“春茧”与深圳湾文化广场。项目由华润置地开发，一期2018年12月18日开业，商业面积约8万平方米；二期2025年9月30日开业，一二期合计体量达25万平方米，汇聚超过500个品牌，二期带来近300个新品牌、逾120个首进品牌，并注入超过6万平方米的文化业态，包括深圳湾美术馆、沉浸式剧院与数字艺术中心。空间以室内mall为主，通过多条长廊与二期连廊串联，形成“商业+文化”的双核结构。本库收录该空间快闪案例48条，2026年已有21条，案例以时装鞋履（23条）为主，珠宝腕表（6条）次之，箱包配饰与高端运动品牌亦有落位，路易威登、迪奥、古驰、CHAUMET、宝格丽、宝珀、葆蝶家、Loro Piana、芬迪、路铂廷等品牌均有记录，代表案例包括国泰80周年限时快闪空间、Abercrombie & Fitch BOATING CLUB「假日启航」与ELSEWHERE「游牧自然」主题展。空间适合重奢品牌限时店与新品首发、高端运动户外、艺术文化跨界与航司品牌体验。交通方面，地铁2号线、11号线、13号线后海站与项目无缝连接。
intro_en: MixC Shenzhen Bay stands at 2888 Keyuan South Road in Nanshan District, in the Houhai area where three headquarters clusters meet: Houhai financial headquarters, Shenzhen Bay super headquarters and the High-Tech Park. It sits beside the China Resources Tower (“Spring Bamboo Shoot”), the Shenzhen Bay Sports Centre (“Spring Cocoon”) and Shenzhen Bay Culture Plaza. Developed by China Resources Land, phase one opened on 18 December 2018 with about 80,000 sqm of retail; phase two opened on 30 September 2025, bringing the combined scheme to 250,000 sqm with more than 500 brands. Phase two added nearly 300 new brands, over 120 of them new to the market, plus more than 60,000 sqm of cultural space including the Shenzhen Bay Art Museum, an immersive theatre and a digital art centre. The form is primarily an indoor mall linked by long galleries and phase-two walkways, creating a “retail plus culture” dual core. Our library holds 48 pop-up cases here, 21 of them in 2026 to date; apparel and footwear lead with 23 cases, followed by jewellery and watches (6), with leather goods and premium sportswear also present. Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, Chaumet, Bvlgari, Blancpain, Bottega Veneta, Loro Piana, Fendi and Christian Louboutin all appear. Representative cases include Cathay Pacific's 80th-anniversary pop-up, Abercrombie & Fitch's BOATING CLUB and ELSEWHERE's “Nomadic Nature” exhibition. It suits luxury temporary stores and launches, premium outdoor and sports brands, art and culture collaborations, and airline brand experiences. Metro Lines 2, 11 and 13 connect directly at Houhai station.

address: 深圳市宝安区新安街道新安湖社区新湖路99号壹方城购物中心
intro_zh: 壹方城购物中心（前海壹方城）位于深圳市宝安区新湖路99号，处在宝安中心区、前海·宝中商圈的核心，毗邻宝安区政府与宝安体育中心，是深圳西部体量最大的商业项目之一。项目由鸿荣源集团开发，2017年10月28日开业，总建筑面积约36万平方米，商业空间分地上5层、地下3层，建成时为深圳单体规模最大的购物中心，业态覆盖美食、社交聚会、品质生活、时尚潮流、娱乐视听、儿童成长、人文创意与运动休闲。空间为大体量室内mall，首层中庭与各层公共区域均可承载快闪与路演，B2层与地铁站厅直接连通。本库收录该空间快闪案例43条，案例分布较均衡，时装鞋履12条、护肤8条、彩妆5条、快速消费品5条、香水3条，兰蔻、科颜氏、YSL、菲拉格慕、迪奥、王者荣耀、飞利浦等品牌均有记录，代表案例包括JNBY「错位」限时快闪空间、BKT「7.5m 天使巨人展」华南首展与幸运咖万店快闪，另有大人糖「以她的感受为准」三八妇女节活动。空间适合大众美妆护肤、家庭亲子与儿童业态、游戏IP与快消品牌路演，以及区域首展。交通方面，地铁1号线、5号线宝安中心站B2层直达商场。
intro_en: UniWalk Qianhai occupies 99 Xinhui Road in Bao'an District, at the core of the Bao'an central area and the Qianhai–Bao'zhong retail district, next to the Bao'an district government and Bao'an Sports Centre. It is one of the largest retail projects in western Shenzhen. Developed by Hongrongyuan Group and opened on 28 October 2017, it has about 360,000 sqm of gross floor area arranged over five above-ground and three basement retail levels; on completion it was the largest single-building mall in Shenzhen. Its mix spans dining, social gathering, quality lifestyle, fashion, entertainment, children's play, culture and sport. The form is a large enclosed mall, with a ground-floor atrium and public areas on each level able to host pop-ups and roadshows, while B2 connects directly to the metro concourse. Our library holds 43 pop-up cases here, spread fairly evenly: apparel and footwear 12, skincare 8, colour cosmetics 5, fast-moving consumer goods 5 and fragrance 3. Lancôme, Kiehl's, YSL, Ferragamo, Dior, Honor of Kings and Philips all appear. Representative cases include JNBY's “Misalignment” pop-up, BKT's 7.5-metre Angel Giant south-China premiere and Lucky Cup's ten-thousand-store pop-up, alongside OSUGA's Women's Day event. It suits mass-market beauty and skincare, family and children's brands, gaming IP and FMCG roadshows, and regional premieres. Metro Lines 1 and 5 reach the mall directly at Bao'an Center station via B2.

address: 深圳市福田区福田街道福安社区福华三路268号
