intro_zh: 星河COCO Park位于深圳市福田区福华三路268号，地处福田CBD商圈南端、购物公园片区，邻近深圳会展中心，是深圳最早以“公园+商业”思路打造的购物中心之一。项目由星河集团开发、星盛商业运营，2006年9月30日开业，建筑面积约8.5万平方米，楼高5层，采用国内首个“内街”概念设计，约四分之一面积留给休闲空间，中央设6000平方米下沉式露天广场，配100米空中天桥、9个临街入口与5个不同色调的中庭，动线开阔，适合把广场直接变成活动现场。本库收录该空间快闪案例23条，案例以酒精饮品（5条）、快速消费品（5条）与服装鞋履（4条）为主，乐高、Burberry、YSL、迪奥香水、芝华士、阿迪达斯、Charlotte Tilbury、Calvin Klein等品牌均有记录，代表案例包括Calvin Klein x Jung Kook线下限时体验空间、CHAGEE x Charlotte Tilbury复古车厢主题快闪与霸王茶姬7周年「广东好朋友派对」。空间适合酒类与快消路演、潮流服饰与联名、夜经济主题活动，以及需要下沉广场的大型路演。交通方面，地铁1号线、3号线购物公园站步行可达，会展中心与福田口岸方向车流便利。
intro_en: Galaxy COCO Park stands at 268 Fuhua Third Road in Futian District, at the southern edge of the Futian CBD in the Shopping Park area and close to the Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Centre. It is one of Shenzhen's earliest malls built around a “park plus retail” idea. Developed by Galaxy Group and operated by Xingsheng Commercial, it opened on 30 September 2006 with about 85,000 sqm over five levels. It introduced mainland China's first “inner street” concept, leaving roughly a quarter of the area as leisure space, with a 6,000 sqm sunken open-air plaza at the centre, a 100-metre elevated walkway, nine street-level entrances and five atria in different colour schemes — a layout that lets the plaza become an event venue directly. Our library holds 23 pop-up cases here, led by alcoholic drinks (5), FMCG (5) and apparel and footwear (4). LEGO, Burberry, YSL, Dior Parfums, Chivas, Adidas, Charlotte Tilbury and Calvin Klein all appear. Representative cases include Calvin Klein with Jung Kook, the CHAGEE x Charlotte Tilbury vintage-train pop-up and CHAGEE's seventh-anniversary “Guangdong Good Friends Party”. It suits drinks and FMCG roadshows, streetwear and collaboration drops, night-economy programming, and large roadshows that need the sunken plaza. Metro Lines 1 and 3 serve Shopping Park station within walking distance.

address: 广东省深圳市福田区福华一路348号
intro_zh: One Avenue卓悦中心位于深圳市福田区福华一路348号，坐落在福田CBD商圈核心，介于市民中心、会展中心与岗厦片区之间，是深圳典型的开放式街区型购物中心。项目由金地集团、卓越集团与大百汇集团联合开发，2019年9月12日一期开业，总建筑面积28.6万平方米，一期18.6万平方米、约350间店铺，二期10万平方米；空间由4个主题mall、一条长约800米的中央大街、2座独栋与16个公共空间组成，场内散布雕塑、主题广场与艺术装置，中央大街适合做户外搭建与人流动线。本库收录该空间快闪案例15条，案例以快速消费品（4条）、服装鞋履（3条）与彩妆（2条）为主，小米、卡诗、DIESEL、泡泡玛特、YSL、格兰菲迪等品牌均有记录，代表案例包括HEAD海德服饰「Court to Court」主题限时空间、维达「碰面莎莎，一路绒化」主题巴士快闪与米家「坏空气展览馆」限时展。空间适合3C科技体验、快消路演与移动巴士快闪、潮流服饰与IP潮玩，以及中央大街上的大型艺术装置。交通方面，地铁1号线岗厦站C口步行约380米，北侧与岗厦北枢纽衔接，可换乘1、2、10、11、14号线。
intro_en: One Avenue occupies 348 Fuhua First Road in Futian District, at the core of the Futian CBD between the Civic Center, the Convention and Exhibition Centre and the Gangxia area. It is a textbook open-block shopping centre for Shenzhen. Jointly developed by Gemdale, Excellence Group and Dabaihui Group, phase one opened on 12 September 2019. Total gross floor area is 286,000 sqm: phase one provides 186,000 sqm and about 350 shops, phase two a further 100,000 sqm. The layout comprises four themed malls, an 800-metre central avenue, two standalone buildings and 16 public spaces, with sculptures, themed plazas and art installations distributed throughout; the central avenue is well suited to outdoor builds and crowd routing. Our library holds 15 pop-up cases here, led by FMCG (4), apparel and footwear (3) and colour cosmetics (2). Xiaomi, Kérastase, DIESEL, Pop Mart, YSL and Glenfiddich all appear. Representative cases include HEAD's “Court to Court” temporary space, Vinda's “Meet Sasha” themed bus pop-up and Mijia's “Bad Air Museum”. It suits consumer-tech experiences, FMCG roadshows and mobile bus pop-ups, streetwear and designer toy IP, and large art installations on the central avenue. Metro Line 1 is about 380 metres away at Gangxia station exit C, while the Gangxia North hub to the north links Lines 1, 2, 10, 11 and 14.

address: 广东省深圳市宝安区新安街道建安一路99号
intro_zh: 海雅缤纷城（宝安店）位于深圳市宝安区新安街道建安一路99号，处在宝城5区、新安老城商圈，周边为成熟的居住与行政片区，是宝安体量最大的商业综合体之一。项目由深圳市新安湖实业有限公司投资28亿元开发，2013年1月19日试运营、同年9月13日正式开业，总建筑面积近32万平方米，商业面积约19.8万平方米，由美国Arquitectonica设计，外立面为玻璃盒造型，南北两端各设下沉式广场，内部包含百货、美食街、酒吧街与文化运动中心等业态。空间为封闭式大体量mall，两个下沉广场与首层入口适合做外摆与路演。本库收录该空间快闪案例10条，集中在2022至2024年，案例以护肤护理（4条）为主，辅以服装、餐饮与珠宝，馥蕾诗、周大福、迪奥、Tory Burch、科颜氏、SK-II、HAZZYS等品牌均有记录，代表案例包括HAZZYS「时光之旅」华南首展、Fresh馥蕾诗龙年主题限时快闪与SK-II「天生绝配 一拍即合」520限定快闪。空间适合美妆护肤、区域家庭客群活动、餐饮快闪与儿童亲子主题。交通方面，地铁5号线灵芝站、1号线新安站步行可达，项目周边公交与停车配套成熟。
intro_en: HaiYa Mega Mall (Bao'an) occupies 99 Jian'an First Road in Xin'an subdistrict, Bao'an District, in the Baocheng No.5 area and the Xin'an old-town retail district, surrounded by established residential and administrative neighbourhoods. It is one of Bao'an's largest commercial complexes. Developed by Shenzhen Xin'anhu Industrial with an investment of RMB 2.8 billion, it began trial operation on 19 January 2013 and formally opened on 13 September 2013. Gross floor area is nearly 320,000 sqm, of which about 198,000 sqm is retail. Designed by Arquitectonica, it has a glass-box facade and sunken plazas at both the north and south ends, with department stores, food streets, a bar street and a culture and sports centre inside. The form is a large enclosed mall, and the two sunken plazas plus ground-floor entrances suit outdoor seating and roadshows. Our library holds 10 pop-up cases here, concentrated in 2022–2024 and led by skincare (4), with apparel, dining and jewellery alongside. Fresh, Chow Tai Fook, Dior, Tory Burch, Kiehl's, SK-II and HAZZYS all appear. Representative cases include HAZZYS's “Time Travel” south-China premiere, Fresh's Year of the Dragon pop-up and SK-II's 520 limited pop-up. It suits beauty and skincare, local family-focused campaigns, food pop-ups and children's themes. Metro Line 5 at Lingzhi station and Line 1 at Xin'an station are within walking distance.

address: 重庆市江北区北城天街6、8、10号
intro_zh: 龙湖重庆北城天街位于重庆市江北区北城天街6、8、10号，地处观音桥商圈核心，是龙湖商业“天街”产品线的第一座项目，也是观音桥从传统步行街迈向千亿级商圈的关键起点。项目2003年开业，最初由客车修理厂地块改造而来；2024年2月起分段改造，2025年8月底完成全馆焕新，9月26日以“感新如常”重新开业。焕新后的北城天街分为A馆、B馆，星座广场外立面采用玻璃盒子与退台设计并嵌入裸眼3D巨幕，中心广场以玻璃幕墙强化品牌展示，星座广场改造后提供超过800平方米的开放区域，明确适配品牌快闪、主题展陈与大型文化活动。本库收录该空间快闪案例14条，案例以服装鞋履（8条）为绝对主力，珠宝、香水、护肤各有点位，YSL、卡诗、宝格丽、PUMA等品牌均有记录，代表案例包括MO&Co.「丹宁舞室」限时主题空间、CAMPER「Junction」模块快闪空间与YSL LOVE STORE摘星屋。空间适合潮流服饰、运动与美妆品牌、IP主题快闪，以及商圈级的事件型活动。交通方面，轨道3号线、9号线观音桥站步行可达，周边即观音桥步行街与建新北路等城市干道。
intro_en: Longfor Chongqing Beicheng Tianjie occupies 6, 8 and 10 Beicheng Tianjie in Jiangbei District, at the core of the Guanyinqiao retail district. It is the first project in Longfor's “Tianjie” (Paradise Walk) commercial line and the starting point from which Guanyinqiao grew from a traditional pedestrian street into a billion-yuan retail district. The project opened in 2003 on the site of a former bus repair yard. From February 2024 it was refurbished in phases; the whole building completed its renewal at the end of August 2025 and reopened on 26 September under the theme “renewed as always”. The renewed scheme is split into Hall A and Hall B. The Xingzuo plaza facade now uses glass boxes and stepped terraces with a naked-eye 3D screen, the central plaza has a new glass curtain wall for brand display, and the Xingzuo plaza provides more than 800 sqm of open space explicitly intended for brand pop-ups, themed exhibitions and large cultural events. Our library holds 14 pop-up cases here, overwhelmingly apparel and footwear (8), with jewellery, fragrance and skincare also present. YSL, Kérastase, Bvlgari and PUMA all appear. Representative cases include MO&Co.'s “Denim Dance Studio”, CAMPER's “Junction” modular pop-up and YSL LOVE STORE. It suits trend fashion, sport and beauty brands, IP-themed pop-ups and district-level event programming. Metro Lines 3 and 9 serve Guanyinqiao station within walking distance.

address: 重庆市九龙坡区谢家湾正街55号
intro_zh: 重庆万象城位于重庆市九龙坡区谢家湾正街55号，地处谢家湾、九龙新商圈，是华润置地在西南打造的首个高端商业综合体，与龙湖“天街”分属两条不同的产品线。项目2014年9月19日开业，一期建筑面积约35万平方米，开业当天录得40万客流；二期（北区）2023年6月18日开业，定位“先锋潮流”，引入购物中心、开放街区、住宅与写字楼，一二期合计品牌超过700家，并被华润定位为全国最大的重奢万象城。空间由室内mall与开放街区组合，二期新增的街区与连廊为户外搭建提供条件。本库收录该空间快闪案例10条，案例以时装鞋履（4条）与珠宝腕表（2条）为主，美妆、家电与运动各有点位，浪琴、雅诗兰黛、MISS SIXTY、edition、匡威、安踏、小米等品牌均有记录，代表案例包括AFIONA妍丽 × Cellcosmet瑞妍「奇愈巡光」快闪列车、小米「巨屏风暴」快闪活动与安踏「欧文一代」限时展。空间适合重奢与珠宝腕表、潮流运动、3C家电与美妆快闪。交通方面，轨道2号线与环线在谢家湾站站内换乘，车站有连廊直连万象城北区。
intro_en: MixC Chongqing occupies 55 Xiejiawan Main Street in Jiulongpo District, in the Xiejiawan area of the Jiulong New commercial district. It is China Resources Land's first premium commercial complex in southwest China and belongs to the MixC line, a different product family from Longfor's “Tianjie” malls. The project opened on 19 September 2014; phase one has about 350,000 sqm of gross floor area and drew 400,000 visitors on its opening day. Phase two, the North Zone, opened on 18 June 2023 under the “pioneer trend” positioning, adding a shopping centre, open blocks, residences and offices. Together the two phases host more than 700 brands, and China Resources positions the scheme as its largest luxury-oriented MixC in China. The form combines an indoor mall with open blocks, and the phase-two streets and link bridges create options for outdoor builds. Our library holds 10 pop-up cases here, led by apparel and footwear (4) and jewellery and watches (2), with beauty, appliances and sport also represented. Longines, Estée Lauder, MISS SIXTY, edition, Converse, Anta and Xiaomi all appear. Representative cases include AFIONA x Cellcosmet's “Miracle Healing” pop-up train, Xiaomi's “Giant Screen Storm” and Anta's “Kyrie 1” exhibition. It suits luxury and jewellery, trend sport, consumer tech and beauty pop-ups. Metro Line 2 and the Loop Line interchange inside Xiejiawan station, which has a covered link to the North Zone.

address: 上海市嘉定区伊宁路2000号
status_note: 在营
intro_zh: 上海国际赛车场位于嘉定区安亭，2004年启用，由德国赛道设计师赫尔曼·蒂尔克操刀，是中国第一条符合一级方程式标准的永久赛道，也是F1中国大奖赛的举办地。赛道全长5.451公里、16个弯道，平面布局取汉字“上”的形态，由1.2公里长直道、半径逐渐收窄的1至3号螺旋弯与高速连续弯组成，既考验刹车点也考验下压力设定。主看台与围场区按F1标准建设，配套车队维修区、新闻中心、医疗中心与直升机停机坪，可承接F1、GT、房车与摩托车赛事，也可用于新车发布、试驾与品牌活动。除F1外，这里长期承办中国房车锦标赛、亚洲勒芒系列赛与法拉利挑战赛等。交通上距上海市中心约30公里，地铁11号线上海赛车场站直达，周边有嘉定新城与安亭汽车城配套。从赛事运营角度看，上海国际赛车场的价值不只在赛道本身：围场可容纳全部车队作业，主看台与副看台合计可承接数万观众，配套的新闻中心与医疗中心按FIA标准配置，赛后也能转为试驾、赛道日与汽车文化展使用。对品牌方而言，“上”字布局与F1中国站的历史记忆，是最容易被记住的视觉符号。
intro_en: Shanghai International Circuit opened in 2004 in Anting, Jiading District, designed by Hermann Tilke as China's first permanent circuit built to Formula 1 standards and the home of the Chinese Grand Prix. The 5.451 km layout with 16 corners is shaped like the Chinese character shang, combining a 1.2 km straight, the tightening spiral of turns one to three and fast flowing sections that reward both braking stability and downforce. The grandstand and paddock were built to F1 specification, with team garages, a media centre, medical centre and helipad, allowing the venue to stage F1, GT, touring car and motorcycle events as well as launches, test days and brand activations. Beyond F1 it regularly hosts the China Touring Car Championship, Asian Le Mans Series and Ferrari Challenge. The circuit is about 30 km from central Shanghai, with Metro Line 11 stopping at Shanghai Circuit station and the Jiading and Anting automotive districts nearby. Operationally, the circuit is more than a track: the paddock accommodates every team, the grandstands together seat tens of thousands, and the media and medical centres are built to FIA specification. Outside race weekends the same facilities convert to test days, track experiences and automotive culture events. For brands, the shang character layout and the history of the Chinese Grand Prix provide a visual symbol that audiences recognise immediately.
source: https://www.icsh.sh.cn/；维基百科 Shanghai International Circuit

address: 北京市朝阳区金盏乡金港汽车公园
status_note: 在营（2024年12月起由易车冠名，赛道更名易车金港赛道）
intro_zh: 北京金港国际赛车场位于朝阳区金盏乡温榆河畔的金港汽车公园内，2000年由废旧窑坑改造建成，是华北地区第一座符合国际标准的赛车场，占地约680亩。赛道全长2.390公里、12个弯道，落差约8米，由澳大利亚设计师Michael McDonough设计，以短道、多弯、节奏紧凑著称，适合房车、单一品牌赛与驾驶培训。园区内同时设有试驾场、直线跑道、俱乐部会所、汽车酒店与餐饮配套，形成赛道加汽车主题园区的复合业态。2024年12月，易车独家冠名北京金港俱乐部赛道，三大主场地分别更名为易车金港赛道、易车金港试驾场与易车金港直线跑道，转向专业评测内容生产与用户活动。交通上临近机场第二高速与京平高速，距首都机场约15公里，市区驾车约40分钟。作为城市型赛道，金港的优势是离市区近、使用门槛低：工作日可做企业试驾与媒体评测，周末承办俱乐部赛事与单一品牌赛，园区内的酒店与餐饮能满足全天活动需求。2024年冠名之后，场地重心进一步转向内容生产，赛道、试驾场与直线跑道三条产品线可以打包给汽车品牌使用。
intro_en: Beijing Goldenport International Circuit sits inside the Goldenport motor park beside the Wenyu River in Jinzhan, Chaoyang District. Built in 2000 on reclaimed brick kilns, it was the first circuit in northern China to meet international standards and covers about 680 mu. The 2.390 km track with 12 corners and roughly 8 m of elevation change was designed by Australian architect Michael McDonough and is known for its short, technical layout, well suited to touring cars, one-make series and driver training. The park also houses a test pad, a straight-line runway, club facilities, an automotive hotel and restaurants, forming a circuit-plus-motorsport-park business. In December 2024 Yiche took exclusive naming rights, renaming the three main facilities Yiche Goldenport Circuit, Yiche Goldenport Test Pad and Yiche Goldenport Straight, aimed at professional vehicle evaluation content and user events. The site is close to the Airport Second Expressway and Jingping expressway, about 15 km from Capital Airport and roughly 40 minutes by car from the city centre. As an urban circuit its advantage is proximity and low barriers to use: weekdays for corporate test drives and media evaluation, weekends for club racing and one-make series, with the on-site hotel and restaurants supporting full-day programmes. Since the 2024 naming deal the focus has shifted further towards content production, with the circuit, test pad and straight sold together to automotive brands.
source: https://www.51gt3.com/ 赛道数据库；金港汽车公园公开资料；易车冠名报道

address: 北京经济技术开发区通明湖区域
status_note: 赛事期启用（2025年10月首办GT世界挑战赛亚洲杯收官战）
intro_zh: 北京亦庄街道赛道位于北京经济技术开发区通明湖区域，是为GT世界挑战赛亚洲杯专门设置的临时街道赛道，2025年10月首次办赛，是北京近十年来首次举办国际顶级汽车赛事。与永久赛道不同，街道赛道利用园区道路与湖滨路段围合而成，赛前铺设防撞墙、护栏与缓冲区的临时设施，赛后恢复城市交通，因此赛道长度与弯道数按当年赛事方案确定，逐届可能调整。这类场地的价值在于把赛事直接放进城市核心区：观众通勤距离短、商业配套现成、城市品牌曝光强。对办活动的人而言，可借用的是围场区、发车区、观众看台与配套活动区的组织经验。交通上位于亦庄经开区，地铁亦庄线可达，靠近京沪高速与南六环。街道赛的筹备周期通常以月计：需要与交通、公安、消防逐段确认封路方案，赛道设施在赛前数周进场搭建，赛后一周内恢复通行。这套组织能力本身就是资产——它决定了城市能不能在核心区办大赛。对品牌而言，街道赛提供的是永久赛道给不了的场景：观众就在写字楼与商场之间，赛事与城市生活零距离。
intro_en: The Beijing Yizhuang street circuit occupies the Tongming Lake area of the Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area. Built as a temporary layout for the GT World Challenge Asia finale, it held its first race in October 2025, the first top-level international motorsport event in Beijing in roughly a decade. Unlike permanent circuits, it is assembled from园区 roads and lakeside sections with temporary barriers, Tecpro walls and run-off, then returned to public use, so its length and corner count follow each year's event design and may change between editions. The value of such a venue is that it puts racing inside the urban core: short spectator journeys, existing commercial amenities and strong city branding. For event organisers, what transfers is the paddock, grid, grandstand and fan-zone operating model. The site sits in Yizhuang, reachable by Metro Yizhuang line and close to the Beijing-Shanghai expressway and the South Sixth Ring Road. Preparing a street circuit takes months: road closures must be agreed section by section with traffic, police and fire authorities, facilities go in weeks before the event and the roads return to normal within about a week afterwards. That organisational capability is itself the asset, because it determines whether a city can race in its core. For brands the appeal is a setting permanent circuits cannot offer: spectators stand between office towers and shopping centres.
source: 北京经开区官网 2025/2026 GT世界挑战赛报道

address: 湖南省株洲市天元区株洲汽车博览园内
area_text: 赛道 3.77 km /  弯
status_note: 在营
intro_zh: 株洲国际赛车场位于湖南株洲汽车博览园内，占地约750亩，由国内赛道设计师姚启明博士担纲设计，主赛道按国际汽联二级标准规划，全长3.77公里。它是中南地区首家通过国际汽联认证的赛车场，也是国内第一个拥有类椭圆形赛道、最大横坡与最大落差的赛道，同时是首个面向大众开放深度体验的赛车场。赛道结合园区试车、驾驶培训与品牌体验功能，可承办房车、单一品牌赛、摩托车与新能源车型测试。对活动方而言，赛道加汽车博览园的组合意味着可以把发布会、试驾、培训与赛事放在同一园区完成。交通上位于株洲天元区，靠近京港澳高速与株洲西站，距长沙黄花机场约一小时车程。株洲的赛道设计强调“可体验”：类椭圆布局与横坡让普通驾驶者也能感受到明显速度感，因此除正式赛事外，赛道日、驾驶培训与新能源车型测试占了不小比重。园区内的汽车博览园提供展销、改装与俱乐部配套，形成从看车、买车到下场开车的闭环，这是多数纯赛道不具备的条件。
intro_en: Zhuzhou International Circuit sits inside the Zhuzhou Automotive Expo Park in Tianyuan District, Hunan, covering about 750 mu. Designed by Chinese circuit designer Dr Yao Qiming to FIA Grade 2 standards, the main track runs 3.77 km. It was the first circuit in central-south China to receive FIA certification and the first in the country with a banked, near-oval layout combining maximum camber and elevation change, as well as the first to open deep driving experiences to the public. The facility combines circuit use with proving-ground testing, driver training and brand experience, and can host touring cars, one-make series, motorcycles and electric vehicle testing. For organisers, the circuit-plus-expo-park combination allows launches, test drives, training and racing in one site. It lies in Tianyuan District near the Beijing-Hong Kong-Macau expressway and Zhuzhou West Railway Station, about an hour by car from Changsha Huanghua Airport. Zhuzhou was designed to be experienceable: the banked, near-oval layout gives ordinary drivers a clear sense of speed, so track days, driver training and electric vehicle testing take a large share of the calendar alongside races. The automotive expo park adds sales, tuning and club facilities, closing the loop from seeing a car to buying it and driving it on track, which most pure circuits cannot offer.
source: 株洲国际赛车场公开资料；湖南省体育产业示范项目公示

address: 四川省成都市简阳市简州新城石盘镇
status_note: 在营
intro_zh: 成都天府国际赛道位于成都东部新区简州新城石盘镇，2023年12月1日正式开放，是中国西南地区第一条按国际汽联二级标准建成的赛道，一期占地约943亩。按规划，二期建成后将具备承办一级方程式赛事的能力，成为继上海之后的又一条F1级赛道。赛道以西部的山地丘陵地形为背景，配套试车场、越野赛道与汽车文化活动区，可承办F4方程式中国锦标赛、TCR世界巡回赛分站、单一品牌赛与新车测试。2026年成都国际赛车节在此举办，把赛事与城市消费场景结合。交通上位于成都东部新区，天府国际机场与成都东站均在合理车程内，成安渝高速与成都第二绕城高速可达。作为西南第一条FIA二级赛道，成都天府填补了成渝地区缺少国际标准场地的空白：此前西南车队与品牌测试多要远赴珠海或上海。赛道所在的简州新城把汽车产业、赛事与文旅打包规划，二期按F1标准预留，意味着未来有机会承接更高等级赛事。对活动方而言，新场地设施较新、周边可开发空间大。
intro_en: Chengdu Tianfu International Circuit opened on 1 December 2023 in Shipan, Jianzhou New Town, within Chengdu's eastern new area. It is the first circuit in southwest China built to FIA Grade 2 standards, with a Phase 1 site of about 943 mu. Under the master plan, Phase 2 would bring it to Formula 1 capability, making it China's second F1-grade venue after Shanghai. Set against the hills of western Sichuan, it includes a test facility, off-road track and motorsport culture zone, and can host F4 Chinese Championship rounds, TCR World Tour events, one-make series and vehicle testing. The 2026 Chengdu International Motorsport Festival used the circuit to link racing with city consumer activity. It sits in the eastern new area, within reasonable drive of Tianfu International Airport and Chengdu East Railway Station, reachable via the Chengdu-Anyue expressway and the Second Ring Expressway. As the first FIA Grade 2 circuit in southwest China, Chengdu Tianfu filled a gap: teams and brands in the Chengdu-Chongqing region previously had to travel to Zhuhai or Shanghai for international-standard testing. The surrounding Jianzhou new town plans automotive industry, motorsport and tourism together, and Phase 2 is reserved to Formula 1 standards, leaving room for higher-grade events. Newer facilities and developable land around the site are practical advantages for organisers.
source: 成都天府国际赛道公开资料；2026成都国际赛车节报道

address: 天津市武清区V1汽车世界
status_note: 在营
intro_zh: 天津V1国际赛车场位于天津武清区的V1汽车世界园区内，赛道由德国设计师赫尔曼·蒂尔克团队打造，全长4.300公里、16个弯道，落差约10米，获国际汽联二级认证，可承办除F1之外的大部分国际赛事。园区占地约60万平方米，配套2万平方米沥青试驾广场、名车广场、赛车学院与商业设施，形成赛道、试驾、培训与汽车零售一体的综合体。弯道组合兼顾专业车手与业余爱好者，安全设施按FIA最新规范建设，适合房车赛、单一品牌赛、赛道日与品牌试驾活动。交通上位于京津之间，距天津市区约40公里、北京市区约90公里，京津高速与京沪高速可达。V1的定位不只是赛道，而是“汽车世界”：园区把赛道、试驾广场、名车销售、赛车学院与商业配套放在一起，一场活动可以同时完成媒体试驾、客户交付与品牌发布。京津之间的区位让它能同时覆盖两座城市的客群，这是它在华北赛道中的差异化优势。从使用场景看，这里更适合“赛事加体验”的组合：白天跑赛道日或媒体试驾，晚上在园区做发布与客户活动，不必在城市与赛道之间往返。对北方品牌而言，京津之间的位置意味着可以同时邀请两地媒体与经销商，一天内完成内容拍摄、试驾与交付三件事。
intro_en: Tianjin V1 International Circuit sits within the V1 Motor World park in Wuqing District, Tianjin. The track was created by Hermann Tilke's team, runs 4.300 km with 16 corners and about 10 m of elevation change, and holds FIA Grade 2 certification, allowing most international categories short of Formula 1. The park covers roughly 600,000 sqm and includes a 20,000 sqm asphalt test pad, a premium car showroom area, a racing academy and commercial facilities, forming an integrated circuit, test, training and retail destination. The corner combinations balance professional and amateur drivers, safety installations follow current FIA standards, and the venue suits touring cars, one-make series, track days and brand test drives. Located between Beijing and Tianjin, it is about 40 km from Tianjin city centre and 90 km from Beijing, served by the Beijing-Tianjin and Beijing-Shanghai expressways. V1 is positioned as a motor world rather than a circuit: track, test pad, premium car retail, racing academy and commercial space sit together so that one programme can combine media test drives, customer handovers and a brand launch. Its location between Beijing and Tianjin lets it draw from both cities, which is its main differentiation among northern Chinese circuits. In use, V1 suits a combined race-and-experience format: track days or media test drives by day, launches and customer events in the park at night, without travelling between city and circuit. For northern brands the Beijing-Tianjin position means inviting media and dealers from both cities and completing filming, test drives and handovers in a single day.
source: V1汽车世界官网；51GT3 赛道数据库

address: 浙江省宁波市北仑区春晓爬山岗
status_note: 在营
intro_zh: 宁波国际赛道位于宁波北仑区春晓爬山岗，2017年10月竣工，占地约1111亩，由国际赛道设计师阿兰·威尔逊担纲总设计，获国际汽联二级赛道执照，可承办除F1之外的各种赛事。赛道全长4.010公里、22个弯道，落差达24米，是国内落差较大的赛道之一，对刹车与悬挂调校要求高。场地配套试车场、越野赛道、卡丁车场与汽车文化商业，可承接房车赛、单一品牌赛、摩托车赛事、新车测试与品牌体验活动。周边为宁波国际海洋生态科技城，靠近象山港大桥与甬台温高速。宁波赛道的特点是起伏大、弯道多：24米落差与22个弯道让它在国内赛道中偏“技术流”，对车辆刹车、悬挂与轮胎管理要求高，因此也常被用作新车底盘调校与轮胎测试场地。赛道所在的春晓区域靠海，气候与路面温度变化明显，测试数据的参考价值较高。从使用角度看，宁波适合需要“真实工况”的测试与培训：连续起伏让刹车与悬挂的真实负荷高于平地赛道，数据更有参考价值。赛事方面以房车、单一品牌赛与摩托车为主，围场规模适中，适合中型赛事与品牌包场。
intro_en: Ningbo International Circuit opened in October 2017 in Chunxiao, Beilun District, Ningbo, covering about 1,111 mu. Master-planned by international designer Alan Wilson, it holds an FIA Grade 2 licence and can stage all categories below Formula 1. The track runs 4.010 km with 22 corners and 24 m of elevation change, among the more undulating circuits in China and demanding on brakes and suspension setup. Supporting facilities include a test pad, off-road course, karting track and motorsport-themed retail, enabling touring car races, one-make series, motorcycle events, vehicle testing and brand experiences. The site lies in the Ningbo International Ocean Ecology and Technology City, close to the Xiangshan Port Bridge and the Ningbo-Taizhou-Wenzhou expressway. Ningbo is known for elevation and corner count: 24 m of gradient and 22 corners make it one of the more technical layouts in China, demanding brake, suspension and tyre management, which is why it is often used for chassis tuning and tyre testing. The coastal Chunxiao location brings noticeable weather and track-temperature variation, adding value to test data. Practically, Ningbo suits testing and training that need real-world load: continuous elevation change puts more stress on brakes and suspension than a flat circuit, so the data is more representative. Racing is mainly touring cars, one-make series and motorcycles, with a paddock sized for mid-scale events and brand buy-outs.
source: 宁波国际赛道公开资料；速环赛道设计项目页；51GT3

address: 内蒙古自治区鄂尔多斯市康巴什区
status_note: 在营
intro_zh: 鄂尔多斯国际赛车场位于内蒙古鄂尔多斯市康巴什区，2010年8月开放，是内蒙古首条国际标准赛道，获国际汽联二级认证。赛道全长3.751公里、18个弯道，落差达32米，是国内落差最大的赛道之一，起伏剧烈、视野变化大，对车手体能和车辆调校都是考验。赛场曾承办超级联赛方程式、国际汽联房车锦标赛分站与中国房车锦标赛等赛事，看台、围场与维修区按国际赛事标准建设。周边为康巴什新区，距鄂尔多斯机场约20公里，包茂高速可达。鄂尔多斯赛道是国内落差最大的赛道之一：32米高差带来连续上下坡与盲弯，车手在高速段几乎看不到下一个弯的入口，对体能和判断要求极高。也正因为地形独特，这里常被用作极限工况测试与驾驶培训场地。赛道位于康巴什新区，城市配套成熟，赛事期间接待能力有保障。使用层面，鄂尔多斯更适合封闭测试、驾驶培训与俱乐部赛事：赛道长、落差大、车流少，能让车手在连续上下坡中积累判断经验。城市配套集中在康巴什，赛事接待与住宿不依赖临时搭建，这对多日活动的组织是实打实的便利。
intro_en: Ordos International Circuit opened in August 2010 in Kangbashi District, Ordos, Inner Mongolia. It is the region's first international-standard circuit and holds FIA Grade 2 certification. The 3.751 km track has 18 corners and 32 m of elevation change, among the largest in China, creating dramatic crests and blind approaches that test driver fitness and car setup. It has hosted Superleague Formula, FIA touring car rounds and the China Touring Car Championship, with grandstands, paddock and pit facilities built to international event standards. The circuit lies in the Kangbashi new district, about 20 km from Ordos airport and reachable via the Baotou-Maoming expressway. Ordos has one of the largest elevation changes in China: 32 m of gradient produces consecutive climbs, descents and blind crests where drivers cannot see the next corner entry at speed, placing a premium on fitness and judgement. That terrain also makes it useful for extreme-condition testing and driver training. The circuit sits in Kangbashi new district with mature urban support for event accommodation. In operational terms Ordos fits closed testing, driver training and club racing: a long lap, large elevation change and light traffic let drivers build judgement across repeated climbs and descents. Support facilities are concentrated in Kangbashi, so event accommodation does not depend on temporary building, a real advantage for multi-day programmes.
source: 鄂尔多斯国际赛车场公开资料；51GT3 赛道数据库

address: 广东省珠海市金鼎镇哈工大路200号
status_note: 在营
intro_zh: 珠海国际赛车场位于珠海市金鼎镇，1993年成立、1996年11月正式投入使用，是中国第一条获得国际汽联认可的永久赛道，被称为中国赛车运动的摇篮。赛道全长4.300公里、14个弯道（10个右弯、4个左弯），路面宽度12至15米，大直道长900米，设计最高时速约300公里，现持国际汽联二级执照。这里长期承办中国房车锦标赛、亚洲勒芒系列赛、GT赛事与摩托车比赛，也是国内车队测试与驾驶培训的重要场地。对活动方而言，赛道紧邻珠海高新区与大学城，距港珠澳大桥口岸约30公里，可承接赛事、试驾、发布会与汽车文化节。作为中国第一条FIA认可的赛道，珠海的行业地位来自历史：1996年投入使用后，国内第一批场地赛事、车队与赛事公司都从这里起步。今天它的竞争力在于成熟的赛事运营团队与便利的跨境区位——港澳车队与观众可以当天往返，这是其他内地赛道难以复制的条件。从活动组织看，珠海的赛道长度与弯道数量适中，既能承载正式赛事，也能拆分成试驾与培训段落；围场与看台规模匹配中型国际赛事，不会出现“场地太大、活动填不满”的问题。对跨境品牌活动而言，港澳观众当天往返是最实际的卖点。
intro_en: Zhuhai International Circuit in Jinding, Zhuhai, was founded in 1993 and opened in November 1996 as the first permanent circuit in China to be recognised by the FIA, earning it the reputation as the cradle of Chinese motorsport. The track runs 4.300 km with 14 corners, ten right and four left, on a surface 12 to 15 m wide, with a 900 m main straight and a design speed near 300 km/h; it currently holds an FIA Grade 2 licence. It has long hosted the China Touring Car Championship, Asian Le Mans Series, GT races and motorcycle events, and remains an important venue for team testing and driver training. Close to the Zhuhai high-tech zone and university town, about 30 km from the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge port, it suits races, test days, launches and automotive culture festivals. As the first FIA-recognised circuit in China, Zhuhai's standing comes from history: after opening in 1996 the country's first circuit races, teams and race organisers started here. Its present advantage is a mature operations team and a cross-border location, with Hong Kong and Macau teams and spectators able to travel there and back in a day, a condition other mainland circuits find hard to match. For organisers, the length and corner count are moderate enough to host formal races yet divisible into test and training sessions, while the paddock and grandstand scale matches mid-sized international events without the venue overpowering the activity. For cross-border brand programmes, same-day travel from Hong Kong and Macau is the practical selling point.
source: 珠海国际赛车场 ZIC 公开资料；51GT3

address: 澳门半岛东望洋山周边街道
area_text: 赛道 6.120 km /  弯
status_note: 赛期启用（澳门格兰披治大赛车）
intro_zh: 东望洋赛道位于澳门半岛，1954年首次举办比赛，是世界上最著名的街道赛道之一，也是澳门格兰披治大赛车的举办地。赛道全长6.120公里，由城市街道、山坡路段与东望洋山盘山公路组成，包含高速直道、狭窄弯角与几乎没有缓冲区的护墙路段，被公认为对车手最严苛的赛道之一。它持有国际汽联二级（限制级）认证，主要承办三级方程式、GT世界杯、房车赛与摩托车赛事。由于是街道赛道，平日为正常城市道路，赛前搭建看台、防撞墙与围场，赛后拆除。对活动方而言，它的价值在于城市中心的极端场景与全球转播曝光。东望洋的独特性在于“没有第二次机会”：护墙紧贴赛道，缓冲区极小，一个失误就是退赛甚至事故，这也是它在车手心中分量极重的原因。赛事周之外，它就是普通城市道路，这种“一年一次变身”的模式对组织能力要求极高，也让澳门格兰披治成为城市营销的经典案例。使用层面要分清两件事：平日它是城市道路，不能当常规场地排期；赛事周则是封闭赛道，档期由大赛车日程决定。品牌若要借势，通常走赞助、接待与城市活动，而不是直接租用赛道。理解这一点，才不会把街道赛当成随时可订的场地。
intro_en: The Guia Circuit on the Macau peninsula first hosted racing in 1954 and is one of the world's most famous street circuits, home to the Macau Grand Prix. Its 6.120 km lap combines city streets, hillside sections and the Guia hill climb, mixing high-speed straights, tight corners and barriers with almost no run-off, making it widely regarded as one of the most demanding tracks for drivers. It holds an FIA Grade 2 (restricted) licence and stages Formula 3, the FIA GT World Cup, touring cars and motorcycle races. As a street circuit it functions as ordinary roads during the year, with grandstands, barriers and a paddock built before the event and removed afterwards. For organisers its value lies in an extreme urban setting and global broadcast exposure. Guia is defined by having no second chance: barriers sit immediately beside the track with minimal run-off, so a mistake means retirement or a crash, which is why it carries such weight among drivers. Outside race week it is ordinary city road, and this once-a-year transformation demands exceptional organisational capability, making the Macau Grand Prix a classic case study in city marketing. Use requires separating two things: for most of the year it is ordinary city road and cannot be booked like a circuit; during race week it is a closed track whose dates follow the Grand Prix calendar. Brands participate through sponsorship, hospitality and city activations rather than hiring the track, and understanding that prevents treating a street circuit as an always-available venue.
source: 澳门格兰披治大赛车公开资料；维基百科 Guia Circuit

address: 日本三重县铃鹿市
status_note: 在营
intro_zh: 铃鹿赛道位于日本三重县铃鹿市，1962年由本田技研工业建设，最初用于测试与培训，后成为日本最著名的赛道与F1日本大奖赛的举办地。赛道全长5.807公里、18个弯道，采用罕见的8字形立体交叉布局，前半段与技术性的S弯连续组合考验车辆平衡，后半段的高速弯与长直道考验动力与下压力。赛道周边配套游乐园、酒店与赛车博物馆，形成家庭可参与的赛车主题度假区。对活动方而言，铃鹿的8字布局与本田背景是独特卖点，适合汽车品牌全球活动、试驾与赛事观赛产品。交通上距名古屋约一小时车程，近铁线白子站转乘巴士可达。铃鹿的8字立体交叉是它最独特的技术特征：赛道在后半段从自身下方穿过，形成上下两层，这种布局在全球顶级赛道中极为少见。对本田而言，铃鹿既是研发测试场也是品牌圣地；对观众而言，游乐园、酒店与博物馆让它成为可以安排两天以上的赛车目的地。使用层面，铃鹿的可售产品分层清楚：赛道日与驾驶体验面向个人，试车与包场面向厂商，看台与 hospitality 面向赛事观众，加上游乐园与酒店，可以组合成两天一晚的完整产品。这种“赛道加度假”的结构，是它在亚洲赛道中最难被替代的地方。
intro_en: Suzuka Circuit in Suzuka City, Mie Prefecture, was built by Honda in 1962 for testing and training and has become Japan's most famous circuit and the home of the Japanese Grand Prix. The 5.807 km lap with 18 corners uses a rare figure-of-eight layout with a flyover: the first half's technical esses test balance, while the high-speed section and long straights reward power and downforce. A amusement park, hotels and a racing museum surround the track, creating a family-oriented motorsport resort. For organisers, the figure-of-eight layout and Honda heritage are distinctive drawcards for global brand programmes, test drives and race hospitality. It is about an hour by car from Nagoya, with bus connections from Shiroko station on the Kintetsu line. The figure-of-eight flyover is Suzuka's defining technical feature: the track passes beneath itself in the second half, creating two levels, a layout extremely rare among top-level circuits. For Honda it is both a development facility and a brand shrine, and for spectators the amusement park, hotels and museum make it a motorsport destination worth more than a single day. Commercially the offering is layered: track days and driving experiences for individuals, testing and buy-outs for manufacturers, grandstands and hospitality for race spectators, plus the park and hotels, which combine into two-day products. That circuit-plus-resort structure is what makes Suzuka hard to replace among Asian venues.
source: 维基百科 Suzuka Circuit；铃鹿赛道官网

address: 日本静冈县骏东郡小山町
status_note: 在营
intro_zh: 富士赛道位于日本静冈县小山町，富士山脚下，1965年开放，2000年起由丰田汽车持有，2005年完成大规模改建，现为国际汽联一级赛道。赛道全长4.563公里、16个弯道，主直道长达1.5公里，是F1赛历中最长的直道之一，配合富士山背景形成极具辨识度的画面。这里曾举办F1日本大奖赛、世界耐力锦标赛与Super GT等赛事，也长期作为丰田与日本车企的测试与发布场地。配套有赛车主题酒店、博物馆与驾驶体验项目。交通上距东京约100公里，东名高速与御殿场线可达。富士赛道的主直道长达1.5公里，是F1赛历中最长的直道之一，赛车尾速可超过300公里/小时，配合富士山背景形成极强的画面记忆。2005年改建后，赛道安全标准与围场设施全面升级，如今既承办国际赛事，也是丰田体系新车测试与全球媒体试驾的首选场地之一。使用层面，富士更适合大型厂商活动与长直道相关的测试：1.5 公里直道对动力、制动与空气动力学验证都很直接。赛道周边配套酒店与博物馆，可以在比赛之外安排媒体参观与客户体验，把一次测试变成两天的品牌行程。
intro_en: Fuji Speedway lies at the foot of Mount Fuji in Oyama, Shizuoka Prefecture. Opened in 1965, owned by Toyota since 2000 and extensively rebuilt in 2005, it now holds FIA Grade 1 status. The 4.563 km circuit has 16 corners and a 1.5 km main straight, among the longest in Formula 1, framed by Mount Fuji in one of the sport's most recognisable vistas. It has hosted the Japanese Grand Prix, World Endurance Championship rounds and Super GT, and remains a regular test and launch venue for Toyota and other Japanese manufacturers. A motorsport hotel, museum and driving experiences support the site. It is about 100 km from Tokyo, accessible via the Tomei expressway and the Gotemba line. Fuji's 1.5 km main straight is among the longest in Formula 1, with top speeds above 300 km/h and Mount Fuji framing the run, creating one of the sport's most memorable images. After the 2005 rebuild, safety standards and paddock facilities were upgraded throughout, and the circuit now serves both international events and Toyota-group vehicle testing and global media launches. In use, Fuji suits large manufacturer programmes and straight-line-related testing: the 1.5 km straight gives direct validation of power, braking and aerodynamics. On-site hotels and the museum allow media visits and customer experiences around a test, turning a single session into a two-day brand programme.
source: 维基百科 Fuji Speedway；富士赛道官网

address: 泰国武里南府武里南国际赛道
status_note: 在营
intro_zh: 武里南国际赛道位于泰国东北部武里南府，2014年启用，商业名称为Chang国际赛道（Chang International Circuit），是泰国第一条一级方程式标准的赛道，也是东南亚最重要的赛车场地之一。赛道全长4.554公里、12个弯道，由赫尔曼·蒂尔克设计，直道与重刹弯组合适合超车，现持国际汽联一级执照。这里常年举办世界超级摩托车锦标赛、MotoGP泰国大奖赛与GT赛事，看台可容纳数万观众。武里南府本身以足球与赛车两张城市名片闻名，赛事期间酒店与商业配套集中承载。交通上距曼谷约400公里，武里南机场与泰国东北铁路可达。武里南的意义超出赛道本身：这座泰国东北小城把赛车与足球做成两张城市名片，赛事周末能带来数万外地观众与跨国转播曝光。赛道由蒂尔克设计，直道与重刹弯的组合让超车机会多、观赏性强，这也是MotoGP与超级摩托车世锦赛长期落地于此的原因。使用层面，武里南的优势是“赛事级别高、城市成本低”：同为 FIA 一级赛道，泰国的接待与场地成本明显低于新加坡与日本，适合区域品牌把东南亚活动放在这里。赛事周末之外，赛道也承接试驾与培训，档期相对灵活。
intro_en: Buriram International Circuit, commercially known as Chang International Circuit, opened in 2014 in Buriram Province, northeastern Thailand. It was the country's first Formula 1-standard circuit and remains one of Southeast Asia's most important racing venues. The 4.554 km track with 12 corners was designed by Hermann Tilke, combining long straights with heavy braking zones that encourage overtaking, and holds an FIA Grade 1 licence. It hosts the Superbike World Championship, the Thailand MotoGP Grand Prix and GT events, with grandstands seating tens of thousands. Buriram itself is known for football and motorsport, and the city's hotels and commercial facilities absorb event demand. The circuit is about 400 km from Bangkok, served by Buriram airport and the northeastern railway line. Buriram means more than a track: this small northeastern Thai city has built racing and football into two urban calling cards, with race weekends bringing tens of thousands of visitors and international broadcast exposure. Tilke's design pairs long straights with heavy braking zones for frequent overtaking, which is why MotoGP and the Superbike World Championship keep returning. Operationally, Buriram offers high-grade racing at low city cost: as an FIA Grade 1 circuit in Thailand, venue and hospitality costs sit well below Singapore or Japan, making it practical for regional Southeast Asian programmes. Outside race weekends it hosts test days and training, so availability is comparatively flexible.
source: 维基百科 Buriram International Circuit

name_zh: 新加坡滨海湾街道赛道
address: 新加坡滨海湾滨海大道周边
status_note: 赛期启用（F1新加坡大奖赛）
intro_zh: 新加坡滨海湾街道赛道位于新加坡市中心滨海湾区域，2008年首次举办F1新加坡大奖赛，是世界上第一条F1夜间街道赛道，也是亚洲最具商业价值的赛车场景之一。赛道全长4.927公里、19个弯道，由赫尔曼·蒂尔克设计，穿越滨海湾金沙、鱼尾狮公园、政府大厦大草场等地标，观众在看赛的同时也看到城市天际线。因为是街道赛道，赛前需封闭滨海大道等多条主干道，搭建看台、照明灯塔与围场，赛后恢复交通；夜间照明系统是它的技术特色。对活动方而言，这条赛道提供的不是场地，而是“城市即舞台”的整合方案，适合品牌全球活动与高端接待。滨海湾赛道最核心的技术资产是照明：整套临时照明系统要满足F1夜间比赛的高标准，灯柱布局、照度均匀度与眩光控制都需逐段设计。加上封路、看台与围场搭建，一场比赛的临时工程量远超普通赛道。对城市而言，它证明了核心商务区可以在一周内变成国际赛场。使用层面要认清它的性质：这是一年一度的临时赛道，档期由 F1 赛历决定，平日不可租用；品牌能参与的是赞助、款待与城市活动。也正因为稀缺，它的曝光价值远高于常规赛道。对想进东南亚市场的品牌，这里是一周内触达全球媒体的窗口。
intro_en: The Marina Bay Street Circuit runs through Singapore's downtown Marina Bay district. It hosted the first Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix in 2008, becoming the world's first F1 night street race and one of Asia's most commercially valuable motorsport settings. The 4.927 km, 19-corner layout by Hermann Tilke passes Marina Bay Sands, Merlion Park and the Padang, so spectators see the skyline as much as the racing. Because it is a street circuit, major roads including Raffles Boulevard are closed before the event, with grandstands, lighting towers and a paddock built and removed afterwards; its floodlighting system is a technical signature. For organisers the offering is not a venue but an integrated city-as-stage programme, well suited to global brand campaigns and premium hospitality. Marina Bay's core technical asset is lighting: the temporary floodlighting system must meet F1's night-race standards, with tower placement, illuminance uniformity and glare control designed section by section. Combined with road closures, grandstands and paddock construction, the temporary works far exceed those of a permanent circuit. For the city, it proved that a central business district can become an international racetrack within a week. Its nature matters commercially: it is a once-a-year temporary circuit whose dates follow the F1 calendar and cannot be rented day to day, so brands participate through sponsorship, hospitality and city activations. That scarcity is precisely why its exposure value exceeds conventional circuits, offering a one-week window to reach global media in Southeast Asia.
source: 维基百科 Marina Bay Street Circuit；新加坡大奖赛官网
